word_meanings: अनार्या ignoble, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, आर्जवसमायुक्तं devoted to rectitude of conduct, सत्यवादिनम् truthful, तं रामम् addressing that Rama, भृशदारुणम् extremely cruel, वचनम् words, उवाच said.

text: पुरा देव असुरे युद्धे पित्रा ते मम राघव । रक्षितेन वरौ दत्तौ सशल्येन महा रणे ॥२-१८-३२॥
translation: O descendant of Raghu in the great war between gods and demons in the past your father had granted me two boons for protecting him when he was wounded by a shaft.
word_meanings: राघव O (Rama) descendant of Raghu, पुरा in the past, दैवासुरे युद्धे in the war between gods and demons, महारणे great war, सशल्येन wounded by shafts, रक्षितेन protected (by me), ते पित्रा by your father, मम to me, वरौ two boons, दत्तौ granted.

text: तत्र मे याचितः राजा भरतस्य अभिषेचनम् । गमनम् दण्डक अरण्ये तव च अद्य एव राघव ॥२-१८-३३॥
translation: O scion of the Raghus, hence I have asked the king for consecration of Bharata and your departure to Dandaka forest today itself.
word_meanings: राघव (Rama) scion of the Raghus, तत्र there (so), राजा the king, भरतस्य Bharata's, अभिषेचनम् consecration, अद्यैव today itself, दण्डकारण्ये to Dandaka forest, तव your, गमनम् departure, याचितः has been asked.

text: यदि सत्यप्रतिज्ञं त्वं पितरं कर्तुमिच्छसि । आत्मानं च नरश्रेष्ठ मम वाक्यमिदं शृणु ॥२-१८-३४॥
translation: O the best of men if you want to be true to the word given by you and your father, listen to what I say.
word_meanings: नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, त्वम् you, पितरम् your father, आत्मानं च yourself as well, सत्यप्रतिज्ञम् truthful to promise, कर्तुम् to make, इच्छसि यदि if you want, मम my, इदं वाक्यम् these words, शृणु listen.

text: स निदेशे पितुस् तिष्ठ यथा तेन प्रतिश्रुतम् । त्वया अरण्यम् प्रवेष्टव्यम् नव वर्षाणि पन्च च ॥२-१८-३५॥
translation: Abide by your father's command. As promised by him go to the forest for fourteen years.
word_meanings: पितु: father's, सन्निदेशे by the command, तिष्ठ abide by, तेन by him, यथा in this way, प्रतिश्रुतम् promised, त्वया by you, नव पंच च nine and five (fourteen), वर्षाणि years, अरण्यम् forest, प्रवेष्टव्यम् enter (and stay).

text: भरतस्त्वभिषिच्येत यदेतदभिषेचन्म् । त्वदर्थे विहितम् राज्ञा तेन सर्वेण राघव ॥२-१८-३६॥
translation: Bharata shall be consecrated, O descendant of the Raghu dynasty with all these preparations made by the king to install you.
word_meanings: राघव O son of the Raghu dynasty (Rama), राज्ञा by the king, त्वदर्थे for your sake, यत् which, एतत् this, अभिषेचनम् installation, विहितम् has been arranged, तेन सर्वेण with all these (preparations), भरतः Bharata, अभिषिच्येत shall be consecrated.

text: सप्त सप्त च वर्षाणि दण्डक अरण्यम् आश्रितः । अभिषेकम् इमम् त्यक्त्वा जटा चीर धरः वस ॥२-१८-३७॥
translation: Forsake this consecration, wear matted locks and deerskin and take refuge in Dandaka forest for fourteen years.
word_meanings: इमम् अभिषेकम् this consecration, त्यक्त्वा having forsaken, जटाजिनधर: with matted hair and deerskin, दण्डकारण्यम् आश्रितः taking refuge in Dandaka forest, सप्त सप्त च वर्षाणि seven and seven (fourteen) years, वस live.

text: भरतः कोसल पुरे प्रशास्तु वसुधाम् इमाम् । नाना रत्न समाकीर्णम् सवाजि रथ कुन्जराम् ॥२-१८-३८॥
translation: Let Bharata live in Ayodhya, the capital of Kosala and rule this kingdom rich in gems of different kinds in horses, chariots and elephants.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, कोशलपुरे in Ayodhya, the capital of Kosala country, नानारत्न समाकीर्णाम् abounding in different kinds of gems, सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम् with horses, chariots and elephants, इमां वसुधाम् this earth, प्रशास्तु let (him) rule.

text: एतेन त्वां नरेन्द्रोयम् कारुण्येन समाप्लुतः । शोकसंक्लिष्टवदनो न शक्नोति निरीक्षितुम् ॥२-१८-३९॥
translation: This is why the king with his face tortured by tears and (his heart) overwhelmed with compassion for you, is unable to look at you.
word_meanings: एतेन therefore, अयं नरेन्द्रः this king, कारुण्येन on account of compassion, समाप्लुतः was overwhelmed, शोकसंक्लिष्ट वदनः with a face fortured by tears, त्वाम् you, निरीक्षितुम् to see, न शक्नोति not able.

text: एतत्कुरु नरेन्ध्रस्य वचनं रघुनन्दन । सत्यन महता राम तारयस्व नरेश्वरम् ॥२-१८-४०॥
translation: O Joy of the Raghus, O son of the Raghu race, carry out the word of promise given by the king and save him by helping him keep the truth which is great.
word_meanings: रघुनन्दन O Joy of the Raghus, O son of the Raghu race, नरेन्द्रस्य king's, एतत् वचनम् this word of promise, कुरु carry out, राम Rama, महता सत्येन with your great truthfulness, नरेश्वरम् the king, तारयस्व save.

text: इतीव तस्यां परुषम् वदन्त्याम् । नचैव रामः प्रविवेश शोकम् । प्रविव्यधे चापि महानुभावो । राजा तु पुत्रव्यसनाभितप्तः ॥२-१८-४१॥
translation: Even though she was speaking harsh words, Rama did not come to grief. But the magnanimous king was greatly afflicted to see the calamity on his son. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eighteenth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the oly Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: इतीव in this way, तस्याम् she (Kaikeyi), परुषम् harsh words, वदन्त्याम् was speaking, रामः Rama, शोकम् sorrow, नचैव प्रविदेश did not enter, महानुभावः dignified, राजा तु king, पुत्रव्यसनाभितप्तः afflicted with the son's calamity, प्रविव्यथे was greatly pained.

text: तत् अप्रियम् अमित्रघ्नः वचनम् मरण उपमम् । श्रुत्वा न विव्यथे रामः कैकेयीम् च इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-१९-१॥
translation: The destroyer of enemies (Rama) did not feel distressed to hear these words painful like death. To Kaikeyi he said:
word_meanings: अमित्रघ्नः destroyer of enemies, रामः Rama, अप्रियम् unpleasant, मरणोपमम् like death, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, न विव्यथे was not pained, कैकेयीम् to Kaikeyi, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: एवम् अस्तु गमिष्यामि वनम् वस्तुम् अहम् तु अतः । जटा चीर धरः राज्ञः प्रतिज्ञाम् अनुपालयन् ॥२-१९-२॥
translation: Be it so I shall go from here to the forest and live there with matted hair and deerskin to keep the promise of the king.
word_meanings: एवम् अस्तु be it so अहम् I, राज्ञः king's, प्रतिज्ञाम् promise, अनुपालयन् while obeying, जटाजिनधरः wearing matted locks and deer skin , इतः from here, वनम् to the forest, वस्तुम् to live, गमिष्यामि shall go.

text: इदम् तु ज्ञातुम् इच्चामि किम् अर्थम् माम् मही पतिः । न अभिनन्दति दुर्धर्षो यथा पुरम् अरिम् दमः ॥२-१९-३॥
translation: Nevertheless I would like to know why king Dasaratha, an unassailable subduer of enemies does not greet me as usual.
word_meanings: दुर्धर्षः unassailable, अरिन्दमः subduer of enemies, महीपतिः lord of the earth (king Dasaratha), यथापूर्वम् as usual, माम् me, किमर्थम् why, नाभिनन्दति does not greet, इदं तु this nevertheless, ज्ञातुम् to know, इच्छामि (I) wish.

text: मन्युर् न च त्वया कार्यो देवि ब्रूहि तव अग्रतः । यास्यामि भव सुप्रीता वनम् चीर जटा धरः ॥२-१९-४॥
translation: O Devi you should not grieve. I declare in your presence that I shall go to the forest wearing tattered clothes (bark) and matted locks. Rejoice (to hear this).
word_meanings: देवि O Devi त्वया by you, मन्युः indignation, न कार्यः should not be expressed, तव your, अग्रतः in front of, ब्रूमि am telling, चीरजटाधरः wearing tattered clothes (bark robes) and with matted locks, वनम् to the forest, यास्यामि shall go, सुप्रीता भव rejoice.

text: हितेन गुरुणा पित्रा कृतज्ञेन नृपेण च । नियुज्यमानो विस्रब्धः किं न कुर्यामहं प्रियम् ॥२-१९-५॥
translation: Ordered by my father who is my wellwisher, my guru, one with a sense of gratidude and, above all a king, shall I not, without hesitation do what pleases him?
word_meanings: हितेन seeking wellbeing, गुरुणा by guru, कृतज्ञेन grateful person, नृपेण च also the king, पित्रा by father, नियुज्यमानः having been ordered, अहम् I, विस्रब्ध without hesitation, प्रियम् what pleases (him), न कुर्यां किम् shall I not do?

text: अलीकं मानसं त्वेकं हृदयं दहतीव मे । स्वयं यन्नाह मां राजा भरतस्याभिषेचनम् ॥२-१९-६॥
translation: One thing which hurts me is that the king himself did not tell me about Bharata's consecration. That alone is burning my heart.
word_meanings: भरतस्य Bharata's, अभिषेचनम् consecration, राजा king, स्वयम् himself, माम् to me, यत् नाह which he did not tell, एकम् that one, मानसम् in my mind, अलीकम् one which hurts, मे my , हृदयम् heart, दहतीव as if burning.

text: अहं हि सीतां राज्यं च प्राणानिष्टान्धनानि च । हृष्टो भ्रात्रे स्वयं दद्यां भरतायाप्रचोदितः ॥२-१९-७॥
translation: Unurged, I would have gladly given to Bharata the kingdom, wealth, my most coveted life, and even Sita.
word_meanings: अहम् I, अप्रचोदितः unurged, हृष्टः pleased, भ्रात्रे to my brother, भरताय for Bharata, सीताम् Sita, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राणान् life, इष्टान् most coveted, धनानि च wealth also, स्वयम् myself, दद्याम् shall give.

text: किम् पुनर् मनुज इन्द्रेण स्वयम् पित्रा प्रचोदितः । तव च प्रिय काम अर्थम् प्रतिज्ञाम् अनुपालयन् ॥२-१९-८॥
translation: In order to keep the promise I shall do everything to fulfil your desire. Needless to say that my father has ordered this.
word_meanings: पित्रा by father, मनुजेन्द्रेण by the king, स्वयम् on his own, प्रचोदितः having been ordered, तव your, प्रियकामार्थम् for the sake of (your) pleasure, प्रतिज्ञाम् promise, अनुपालयन् to keep up, किं पुन: needless to say.

text: तत् आश्वासय हि इमम् त्वम् किम् न्व् इदम् यन् मही पतिः । वसुधा आसक्त नयनो मन्दम् अश्रूणि मुन्चति ॥२-१९-९॥
translation: Please console him. Why is it that the king with his eyes fixed upon the ground is shedding tears drop by drop?
word_meanings: तत् further, त्वम् you, इमम् him, आश्वासय console, महीपतिः king, वसुधासक्तनयनः with eyes fixed upon the ground, मन्दम् slowly, अश्रूणि tears, मुञ्चति इति यत् is shedding, इदं this, किं नु why indeed?

text: गच्छन्तु चैवानयितुं दूताश्श्रीघ्रजवैर्हयैः । भरतं मातुलकुलादद्यैव नृपशासनात् ॥२-१९-१०॥
translation: With the king's orders let messengers go right away on swift horses to fetch Bharata from his maternal uncle's house.
word_meanings: नृपशासनात् by the king's order, मातुलकुलात् from his maternal uncle's house, भरतम् Bharata, आनयितुम् to bring back, दूताः messengers, शीघ्रजवैः speedy, हयैः horses, अद्यैव (today itself) right now, गच्छन्तु let go.

text: दण्डक अरण्यम् एषो अहम् इतः गच्चामि सत्वरः । अविचार्य पितुर् वाक्यम् समावस्तुम् चतुर् दश ॥२-१९-११॥
translation: As for me, without deliberating on the propriety of my father's orders, I shall go from here at once to Dandaka forest to live (there) for fourteen years.
word_meanings: एषः अहम् as for me, पितुः father's, वाक्यम् word, अविचार्य without deliberating, सत्वरः at once, चतुर्दश fourteen, समाः years, वस्तुम् to live, इतः from here, दण्डकारण्यम् to Dandaka forest, गच्छामि will go.

text: सा हृष्टा तस्य तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा रामस्य कैकयी । प्रस्थानं श्रद्धधाना हि त्वरयामास राघवम् ॥२-१९-१२॥
translation: Kaikeyi, happy to hear the words of the son of the Raghus as she was convinced that his departure (to the forest) was certain, hastened him (to set out).
word_meanings: सा कैकयी that Kaikeyi, तस्य रामस्य such Rama's, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, हृष्टा happy, प्रस्थानम् departure, श्रद्धधाना believing, राघवम् to Rama, त्वरयामास hastened (him).

text: एवम् भवतु यास्यन्ति दूताः शीघ्र जवैः हयैः । भरतम् मातुल कुलात् उपावर्तयितुम् नराः ॥२-१९-१३॥
translation: Let it be so. Messengers shall go at once on swift horses to bring Bharata from his maternal uncle's house.
word_meanings: एवं भवतु let it happen, मातुलकुलात् from maternal uncle's house, भरतम् to Bharata, उपावर्तयितुम् to bring him back, दूताः messengers, नराः men, शीघ्रजवैः swiftfooted, हयैः by horses, यास्यन्ति will go.

text: तव तु अहम् क्षमम् मन्ये न उत्सुकस्य विलम्बनम् । राम तस्मात् इतः शीघ्रम् वनम् त्वम् गन्तुम् अर्हसि ॥२-१९-१४॥
translation: Since you are eager (to go to the forest), I do not think it is proper to delay. O Rama therefore it behoves you to proceed immediately from here to the forest.
word_meanings: तु but, उत्सुकस्य eager (to go to the forest), तव your, विलंबनम् delay, क्षमम् appropriate, अहम् I, न मन्ये do not think, राम Rama, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, इतः from here, शीघ्रम् immediately, वनम् to the forest, गन्तुम् to go, अर्हसि behoves you.

text: व्रीडान्वित स्स्वयं यच्च नृपस्त्वां नाभिभाषते । नैतत्किञ्चिन्नरश्रेष्ठ मन्युरेषोऽपनीयताम् ॥२-१९-१५॥
translation: Out of shame the king is unable to speak to you. There is nothing other than this. O Rama, the best of men, dispel this distress (of mind).
word_meanings: नरश्रेष्ठ best among men, Rama, व्रीडान्वित: being ashamed, नृपः king, स्वयम् himself, त्वाम् you, यत् since, नाभिभाषते does not speak, एतत् this one, न किञ्चित् is nothing, एषः this, मन्युः distress, अपनीयताम् you may dispel.

text: यावत् त्वम् न वनम् यातः पुरात् अस्मात् अभित्वरन् । पिता तावन् न ते राम स्नास्यते भोक्ष्यते अपि वा ॥२-१९-१६॥
translation: O Rama, as long as you do not hasten to leave this city for the forest, your father will neither bathe nor eat.
word_meanings: राम Rama, त्वम् you, अभित्वरन् hastening up, अस्मात् this, पुरात् from this city, यावत् as long as, वनम् to the forest, न यातः do not go, तावत् till then, ते your, पिता father, स्नास्यते will neither bathe, न भोक्ष्यतेपि वा nor will eat.

text: धिक् कष्टम् इति निह्श्वस्य राजा शोक परिप्लुतः । मूर्चितः न्यपतत् तस्मिन् पर्यन्के हेम भूषिते ॥२-१९-१७॥
translation: 'Fie, what a calamity' sighing thus, the king, overwhelmed with sorrow, fainted and fell back on the golden couch.
word_meanings: राजा king, धिक् fie, कष्टम् what a calamity, इति thus, निःश्वस्य sighing, शोकपरिप्लुतः overwhelmed with sorrow, मूर्छितः having fainted, हेमभूषिते adorned with gold, तस्मिन् पर्यङ्के on that couch, न्यपतत् fell down.

text: रामोऽप्युत्थाप्य राजानं कैकेय्याभिप्रचोदितः । कशयेवाहतो वाजी वनं गन्तुं कृतत्वरः ॥२-१९-१८॥
translation: Rama lifted up the king and, urged by Kaikeyi, hastened to depart for the forest like a horse flogged by a whip.
word_meanings: कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, अभिप्रचोदितः urged, रामोऽपि Rama also, राजानम् the king, उत्थाप्य having lifted, कशया by a whip आहतः flogged, वाजीव like a horse, वनम् to the forest, गन्तुम् to depart, कृतत्वरः hastened

text: तत् अप्रियम् अनार्याया वचनम् दारुण उदरम् । श्रुत्वा गत व्यथो रामः कैकेयीम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-१९-१९॥
translation: Rama listened to the dreadful, cruel words of the ignoble woman but, without feeling any sorrow, said to Kaikeyi, these words:
word_meanings: रामः Rama, अनार्यायाः of that ignoble (lady), दारुणोदयम् of dreadful consequence, अप्रियम् unpleasant, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, गतव्यथः bereft of pain, कैकेयीम् to Kaikeyi, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: नाहमर्थपरो देवि लोकमावस्तुमुत्सहे । विद्धिमामृषिभिस्तुल्यं केवलं धर्ममास्थितम् ॥२-१९-२०॥
translation: O Devi, I have no desire to live in this world for the sake of wealth. Know me as one with the sages who are devoted only to righteousness.
word_meanings: देवि O Devi, अहम् I, अर्थपरः interested in wealth, न not, लोकम् this world, आवस्तुम् to live, उत्सहे am striving, केवलम् only, धर्मम् righteousness, आस्थितम् devoted to, माम् me, ऋषिभिः with ascetics, तुल्यम् similar, विद्धि know.

text: यदत्र भवतः किञ्चिच्छक्यं कर्तुं प्रियं मया । प्राणानपि परित्यज्य सर्वथा कृतमेव तत् ॥२-१९-२१॥
translation: If I am able to do anything which pleases my venerable father, it shall be done in every possible manner, may be even at the cost of my life.
word_meanings: मया by me, अत्र भवतः to the venerable (father), किञ्चित् even a little, यत् प्रियम् which pleases him, कर्तुम् to do, शक्यम् is possible, तत् that one, प्राणान् life, परित्यज्यापि even by giving up, सर्वथा in every way, कृतमेव it is done.

text: न हि अतः धर्म चरणम् किम्चित् अस्ति महत्तरम् । यथा पितरि शुश्रूषा तस्य वा वचन क्रिया ॥२-१९-२२॥
translation: There is no greater observance of righteousness than doing service to one's father or carrying out his orders.
word_meanings: पितरि in respect of one's father, शुश्रूषा service, तस्य his, वचनक्रिया वा or carrying out orders, यथा as, अतः than that, महत्तरं greater, धर्मचरणम् observing righteousness, किञ्चित् anything, नास्ति हि is not there.

text: अनुक्तः अपि अत्रभवता भवत्या वचनात् अहम् । वने वत्स्यामि विजने वर्षाणि इह चतुर् दश ॥२-१९-२३॥
translation: Though this has not been said by my respectable father himself, I shall live in the forlorn forest for fourteen years in accordance with your word.
word_meanings: अहम् I, अत्र भवता by this venerable (father), अनुक्तोपि even without being told, भवत्याः your, वचनात् by your word, इह now, चतुर्दश वर्षाणि fourteen years, विजने solitary, वने in the forest, वत्स्यामि will live.

text: न नूनम् मयि कैकेयि किम्चित् आशम्ससे गुणम् । यद् राजानम् अवोचः त्वम् मम ईश्वरतरा सती ॥२-१९-२४॥
translation: Since in my case you have exercised more authority (than my father) and pleaded with the king, it follows, you, for sure, do not see any virtue in me, O Kaikeyi (Or else, you should not have asked for Bharata's kingship).
word_meanings: कैकेयि O Kaikeyi, त्वम् you, मम in my affair, ईश्वरतरा सती even though capable of exercising greater authority, राजानम् to the king, यत् अवोचः for which you pleaded, मयि in me, किञ्चित् even a little, गुणम् virtue, न आशंससे do not expect, नूनम् this is certain.

text: यावन्मातरमाप्नच्छे सीतां चानुनयाम्यहम् । ततोऽद्यैव गमिष्यामि दण्डकानां महद्वनम् ॥२-१९-२५॥
translation: After taking leave of my mother and consoling Sita, today itself I shall go to that wild Dandaka forest.
word_meanings: मातरम् my mother, यावत् आप्नच्छे until I take leave, सीतां च Sita also, अहम् I, अनुनयामि console, ततः after that, अद्यैव today itself, महत् great (wild), दण्डकानां वनम् Dandaka forest, गमिष्यामि I shall go.

text: भरतः पालयेद् राज्यम् शुश्रूषेच् च पितुर् यथा । तहा भवत्या कर्तव्यम् स हि धर्मः सनातनः ॥२-१९-२६॥
translation: It is your bounden duty to see that Bharata rules the kingdom and serves father.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, यथा so that, राज्यम् the kingdom, पालयेत् rules, पितुः for father, शुश्रूषेच्च serves, तथा thus, भवत्या by you, कर्तव्यम् it should be done, सः that, सनातनः eternal, धर्मः हि duty indeed.

text: स रामस्य वचश्श्रृत्वा भृशं दुःखहतः पिता । शोकादशक्नुवन्वकतुं प्ररुरोद महास्वनम् ॥२-१९-२७॥
translation: Father (Dasaratha), too tormented with grief to speak cried out loudly on hearing the words of Rama.
word_meanings: रामस्य Rama's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, पिता father, सः that (Dasaratha), भृशम् greatly, दुःखहतः hit with grief, शोकात् out of sorrow, वक्तुम् to speak, अशक्नुवन् was not able, महास्वनम् with a loud voice, प्ररुरोद cried.

text: वन्दित्वा चरणौ रामः विसम्ज्ञस्य पितुस् तदा । कैकेय्याः च अपि अनार्याया निष्पपात महा द्युतिः ॥२-१९-२८॥
translation: Effulgent Rama bowed at the feet of his father who had fallen into a swoon. He bowed at the feet of the ignoble Kaikeyi and set out.
word_meanings: महाद्युतिः effulgent, रामः Rama, विसंज्ञस्य who had fallen into a swoon, पितुः father's, चरणौ feet, तथा and, अनार्यायाः of the ignoble, कैकेय्याश्चापि those of Kaikeyi, वन्दित्वा bowing down with respect, निष्पपात set out.

text: स रामः पितरं कृत्वा कैकेयीं च प्रदक्षिणम् । निष्क्रम्यान्तःपुरात्तस्मात्स्वं ददर्श सुहृज्जनम् ॥२-१९-२९॥
translation: Hardly had Rama withdrawn from the harem after circumambulating his father and Kaikeyi when he saw his friends .
word_meanings: सः रामः that Rama, पितरम् father, कैकेयीं च also, Kaikeyi, प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा having made circumambulation, तस्मात् from that, अन्तःपुरात् from that harem, निष्क्रम्य after stepping out, स्वम् own, सुहृज्जनम् friends, ददर्श saw.

text: तं बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्षः पृष्ठतोऽनुजगाम ह । लक्ष्मणः परमक्कृध्दः स्सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः ॥२-१९-३०॥
translation: Lakshmana, the enhancer of Sumitra's delight, with his eyes brimming with tears, followed him in a rage.
word_meanings: सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः enhancer of the delight of Sumitra, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, परमक्कृद्धः furious, बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्षः with eyes full of tears, तम् him, पृष्ठतः behind, अनुजगाम ह followed.

text: अभिषेचनिकं भाण्डं कृत्वा रामः प्रदक्षिणम् । शनैर्जगाम सापेक्षो दृष्टिं तत्राविचालयन् ॥२-१९-३१॥
translation: Rama circumambulated the vessels meant for the consecration ceremony and steadily glancing at them with attention slowly moved away.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, अभिषेचनिकम् pertaining to consecration, भाण्डम् vessels, प्रदक्षिणम् कृत्वा having circumambulated, सापेक्षः with attention, तत्र there, दृष्टिम् glance, अविचालयन् without moving, शनैः slowly, जगाम moved away.

text: न च अस्य महतीम् लक्ष्मीम् राज्य नाशो अपकर्षति । लोक कान्तस्य कान्तत्वम् शीत रश्मेर् इव क्षपा ॥२-१९-३२॥
translation: Rama was the beloved of the people. Loss of kingdom did not diminish his splendour just like night cannot diminish the splendour of the coolrayed Moon.
word_meanings: कान्तत्वात् because of his loveliness, लोककान्तस्य of the beloved of the people, अस्य his, महतीम् great, लक्ष्मीम् splendour, शीतरश्मेः of coolrayed (of Moon), क्षपा इव like night, राज्यनाशः loss of kingdom, न अपकर्षति did not diminish.

text: न वनम् गन्तु कामस्य त्यजतः च वसुम्धराम् । सर्व लोक अतिगस्य इव लक्ष्यते चित्त विक्रिया ॥२-१९-३३॥
translation: Rama was determined to renounce the kingdom and go to the forest. So none could see any change in his mind. (For) he was one beyond all worldly affairs.
word_meanings: वनम् to the forest, गन्तुकामस्य having determined to go, वसुन्धराम् the earth, त्यजतश्च renouncing, सर्वलोकातिगस्येव who is beyond all worldly affairs, चित्तविक्रिया change of mind, नलक्ष्यते could not to be seen.

text: प्रतिषिद्ध्य शुभम् छत्रं व्यजने च स्वलंकृते । विसर्जयित्वा स्वजनं रथम् पौरास्तथा जन्नान् ॥२-१९-३४॥
translation: Selfpossessed Rama held back his sorrow within his mind, abandoned the auspicious umbrella, welldecorated fans and chariot, sent away kinsmen, citydwellers and others and entered his mother's residence to break the unpleasant news.
word_meanings: आत्मवान् selfpossessed, शुभम् auspicious, छत्रम् umbrella, स्वलङ्कृते welldecorated, व्यजने च also two fans, प्रतिषिध्य preventing, स्वजनम् (his) own kinsmen, रथम् chariot, तथा and, पौरान् citydwellers, जनान् people, विसर्जयित्वा sending forth, मनसा with mind, दुःखम् sorrow, धारयन् holding, इन्द्रियाणि senses, निगृह्य च having controlled, अप्रियशंसिवान् with a view to communicate the unpleasant news, मातुः mother's, वेश्म residence, प्रविवेश entered.

text: धारयन् मनसा दुःखमिन्द्रियाणि निगृह्य च । प्रविवेशात्मवान्वेश्म मातुरप्रियशंसिवान् ॥२-१९-३५॥
translation: Selfpossessed Rama held back his sorrow within his mind, abandoned the auspicious umbrella, welldecorated fans and chariot, sent away kinsmen, citydwellers and others and entered his mother's residence to break the unpleasant news.
word_meanings: आत्मवान् selfpossessed, शुभम् auspicious, छत्रम् umbrella, स्वलङ्कृते welldecorated, व्यजने च also two fans, प्रतिषिध्य preventing, स्वजनम् (his) own kinsmen, रथम् chariot, तथा and, पौरान् citydwellers, जनान् people, विसर्जयित्वा sending forth, मनसा with mind, दुःखम् sorrow, धारयन् holding, इन्द्रियाणि senses, निगृह्य च having controlled, अप्रियशंसिवान् with a view to communicate the unpleasant news, मातुः mother's, वेश्म residence, प्रविवेश entered.

text: सर्वो ह्यभिजनः श्रीमान् श्रीमतः सत्यवादिनः । नालक्षयत् रामस्य किम्चिदाकारमानने ॥२-१९-३६॥
translation: All the glorious people around him did not observe any change in the countenance of that dignified and truthful Rama.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् glorious, सर्वः all, अभिजनः people around him, श्रीमतः of the dignified, सत्यवादिनः of the truthful, रामस्य Rama's, आनने in the countenance, किंचित् even a little, आकारम् change, नालक्षयत did not see.

text: उचितम् च महाबाहुर्न जहौ हर्षमात्मनः । शारदः समुदीर्णाम्शुश्चन्द्रस्तेज इवात्मजम् ॥२-१९-३७॥
translation: The mightyarmed (Rama) did not leave his habitual cheerfulness like the autumnal Moon his own brightness.
word_meanings: महाबाहुः mightyarmed, समुदीर्णांशुः with profuse radiance, शारदः autumnal, चन्द्र: the Moon, आत्मजम् his own, तेज इव like brightness, आत्मनः his own, उचितम् fitting, हर्षम् cheer, न जहौ did not leave.

text: वाचा मधुरया रामः स्र्वं सम्मानयन् जनम् । मातुस्समीपं धीरात्मा प्रविवेश महायशाः ॥२-१९-३८॥
translation: Firmminded and illustrious Rama treated all people with sweet words and approached his mother.
word_meanings: धीरात्मा firmminded, महायशाः illustrious, रामः Rama, मधुरया वाचा in sweet words, जनम् people, सम्मानयन् honouring, मातुः mother's, समीपम् presence, प्रविवेश entered.

text: तं गुणैस्समतां प्राप्तो भ्राता विपुलविक्रमः । सौमित्रिरनुवव्राज धारयन् दुःखमात्मजम् ॥२-१९-३९॥
translation: Mighty Lakshmana as virtuous as his brother held the sorrow in his mind and followed him.
word_meanings: गुणैः in virtues, समतां equality, प्राप्तः obtained, विपुलविक्रमः with great power, भ्राता brother, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, आत्मजम् born in his mind, दुःखम् sorrow, धारयन् controlling, तम् him, अनुवव्राज followed.

text: प्रविश्य वेश्मातिभृशं मुदाऽन्वितं समीक्ष्य तां चार्थविपत्तिमागताम् । न चैव रामोऽत्रजगामविक्रियां सुहृज्जनस्यात्मविपत्तिशङ्कया ॥२-१९-४०॥
translation: Rama entered the palace which was full of great rejoicing. He did not disclose the obstruction that had come on the way of achieving his objective for fear of causing distress to his friends. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the nineteenth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, अतिभृशम् very great, मुदा rejoicing, अन्वितम् filled with, प्रविश्य having entered, वेश्म palace, आगताम् arrived, ताम he, अर्थविपत्तिम् obstruction to the objective, समीक्ष्य having seen, अत्र there, सुहृज्जनस्य for his friends, आत्मविपत्तिशङ्कया with the fear that they will be distressed, विक्रियाम् change, न चैव जगाम did not obtain.

text: तस्मिम्स्तु पुरुष्व्याघ्रे निष्क्रामति कृताञ्जलौ । आर्तशच्दो महान् जज्ञे स्त्रीणाम न्तःपुरे तदा ॥२-२०-१॥
translation: When the tiger among men (Rama) was coming out with folded palms, there arose a huge cry of distress among the ladies of the harem:
word_meanings: तदा then, पुरुषव्याघ्रे tiger among men, तस्मिन् that Rama, कृताज्ञलौ with folded palms, निष्क्रामति while (he was) leaving, अन्तःपुरे in the inner apartment, स्त्रीणाम् women's, महान् great, आर्तशब्दः cries of distress, जज्ञे arose.

text: कृत्येष्वचोदितः पित्रा सर्वस्यान्तःपुरस्य च । गतिर्यश्शरणं चापि स रामोऽद्य प्रवत्स्यति ॥२-२०-२॥
translation: Rama was the refuge and protector of all the inmates lot of the inner apartment although it was not his duty nor was he forced by his father to safeguard them. That Rama is now going on exile.
word_meanings: यः who (Rama), पित्रा by father, कृत्येषु in his duty, अचोदितः without being urged, सर्वस्य entire, अन्तः पुरस्य for the inner apartment, गतिः refuge, शरणं च (आसीत्) was protector, सः रामः that Rama, अद्य now, प्रवत्स्यति is now going on exile.

text: कौसल्यायाम् यथा युक्तो जनन्याम् वर्तते सदा । तथैव वर्ततेऽस्मासु जन्मप्रभृति राघवः ॥२-२०-३॥
translation: Rama conducted himself towards us in the same way as he did towards his mother Kausalya right from the begining.
word_meanings: जन्मप्रभृति right from birth, राघवः Rama, जनन्याम् with regard to his mother, कौशल्यायाम् in Kausalya, सदा always, युक्तः devoted, यथा how, वर्तते is conducting himself, अस्मासु in all of us, तथैव in the same way, वर्तते is conducting.

text: न क्रुध्यत्यभिशस्तोऽपि क्रोधनीयानि वर्जयन् । कृद्धान् प्रसादयन् सर्वान् स इतोऽद्य प्रवत्स्यति ॥२-२०-४॥
translation: Rama who used to avoid deeds that caused anger, pacified those who were angry with him, and never lost his cool even when cursed, that Rama is going on exile today.
word_meanings: क्रोधनीयानि deeds that cause anger, वर्जयन् avoiding, क्रुद्धान् सर्वान् all cholerictempered persons, प्रसादयन् pacifying them, अभिशप्तोऽपि even cursed, न क्रुध्यति does not get angry, सः such Rama, अद्य today, इतः from here, प्रवत्स्यति is going on exile.

text: अभुद्धिर्बत नो राजा जीवलोकम् चरत्ययम् । यो गतिम् सर्वभूतानाम् परित्यजति राघवम् ॥२-२०-५॥
translation: Alas our king who has lost his brain, who has ordered the banishment of Rama, the refuge of all living beings, (on the other hand) is moving about in the world.
word_meanings: बत alas यः who (Dasaratha), सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, गतिम् who is the refuge, राघवम् to the son of the Raghus (Rama), परित्यजति is abandoning, अयम् this, नः राजा our king, अबुद्धि: devoid of intellect, जीवलोकम् in the world of living beings, चरति moving.

text: इति सर्वा महिष्यस्ता विवत्सा इव धेनवः । पतिमाचुक्रुशुश्चैव सस्वरम् चापि चुक्रुशुः ॥२-२०-६॥
translation: Thus all the queens like calfless cows cried loudly blaming their husband.
word_meanings: इति thus, सर्वाः all, ताः महिष्यः the king's wives, विवत्साः calfless, धेनवः इव like cows, सस्वरम् loudly, चुक्रुशुः च अपि cried and also, पतिम् husband, अचुक्रुशुश्च एव blamed also.

text: स हि चान्तः पुरे घोरमार्तशब्धम् महीपतिः । पुत्रशोकाभिसन्तप्तः श्रुत्वा व्यालीयतासने ॥२-२०-७॥
translation: Tormented with grief on account of his son, the king sank in his seat on hearing the cries of distress from the inner apartment
word_meanings: सः महीपतिः that lord of the earth (king), अन्तःपुरे in the harem, घोरम् painful, आर्तशब्दम् cries of distress, श्रुत्वा having heard, पुत्र शोकाभिसन्तप्तः tormented with grief on account of his son, आसने in his seat, व्यालीयत sank down.

text: रामस्तु भृशमायस्तो निश्श्वसन्निव कुञ्जरः । जगाम सहितो भ्रात्रा मातुरन्तःपुरं वशी ॥२-२०-८॥
translation: Deeply pained yet selfpossessed Rama, heaving sighs like an elephant went towards the inner apartment of his mother along with his brother.
word_meanings: वशी having selfcontrol, रामस्तु Rama however, भृशम् highly, आयस्तः troubled, कुञ्जरः इव like an elephant, निःश्वसन् heaving sighs, भ्रात्रा brother, सहितः together with, मातुः mother's, अन्तःपुरम् towards inner apartment, जगाम went.

text: सोऽपश्यत्पुरुषं तत्र वृद्धं परमपूजितम् । उपविष्टं गृहद्वारि तिष्ठतश्चापरान्बहून् ॥२-२०-९॥
translation: Rama beheld a highly venerable elderly man seated at the entrance of the residence and many others standing (nearby).
word_meanings: सः he, तत्र there, गृहद्वारि at the entrance of the residence, उपविष्टम् seated, परमपूजितम् highly venerable, वृद्धं पुरुषम् aged man, तिष्ठतः standing, बहून् many, अपरांश्च others, अपश्यत् beheld.

text: दृष्ट्वैव तु तदा रामं ते सर्वे सहसोत्थिताः । जयेन जयतां श्रेष्ठं वर्धयन्ति स्म राघवम् ॥२-२०-१०॥
translation: On seeing Rama, all the eminent among the victors got up immediately and greeted him, saying, 'Victory to you'.
word_meanings: तदा then, रामम् Rama, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing, ते सर्वे all of them, सहसा immediately, उत्थिताः stood up, जयताम् among victors, श्रेष्ठम् best, राघवम् to the scion of the Raghu dynasty (Rama), जयेन with victory, वर्धयन्ति स्म caused prosperity.

text: प्रविश्य प्रथमां कक्ष्यां द्वितीयायां ददर्श सः । ब्राह्मणान्वेदसम्पन्नान्वृद्धान्राज्ञाऽभिसत्कृतान् ॥२-२०-११॥
translation: With the first courtyard crossed, Rama saw in the second aged brahmins versed in the Vedas, and duly honoured by the king.
word_meanings: सः he (Rama), प्रथमां कक्ष्याम् first courtyard, प्रविश्य having entered, द्वितीयायाम् in the second courtyard, वेदसम्पन्नान् learned in the Vedas, राज्ञा by the king, अभिसत्कृतान् wellhonoured, वृद्धान् aged, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, ददर्श saw.

text: प्रणम्य रामस्तान्विप्रांस्तृतीयायां ददर्श सः । स्त्रियो वृद्धास्तथा बाला द्वाररक्षणतत्पराः ॥२-२०-१२॥
translation: Rama wished the brahmins and saw old men, women and children vigilantly guarding the door in the third courtyard.
word_meanings: सः राम that Rama, तान् विप्रान् those brahmins, प्रणम्य having paid obeisance, तृतीयायाम् in the third courtyard, द्वाररक्षणतत्पराः vigilantly guarding the door, स्त्रियः women, वृद्धा: the old, तथा as also, बालाः young children, ददर्श saw.

text: वर्धयित्वा प्रहृष्टास्ताः प्रविश्य च गृहं स्त्रियः । न्यवेदयन्त त्वरिता राममातुः प्रियं तदा ॥२-२०-१३॥
translation: Wellpleased, the women then greeted him wishing prosperity. They hurried into the abode of Kausalya and gave her the happy news (of Rama's arrival).
word_meanings: तदा then, ताः those, स्त्रियः women, प्रहृष्टाः were very pleased, वर्धयित्वा greeting him with words wishing prosperity, त्वरिताः in great haste, गृहम् in the apartment, प्रविश्य having entered, राममातुः Rama's mother, (Kausalya), प्रियम् pleasant (tidings), न्यवेदयन्त informed.

text: कौसल्या अपि तदा देवी रात्रिम् स्थित्वा समाहिता । प्रभाते तु अकरोत् पूजाम् विष्णोह् पुत्र हित एषिणी ॥२-२०-१४॥
translation: Having spent the night with a composed mind (abosorbed in meditation), Kausalya was worshipping lord Visnu in the early morning to secure her son's welfare.
word_meanings: तदा then, कौशल्या Kausalya, रात्रिम् night, समाहिता with composed mind, स्थित्वा remaining (in meditation), प्रभाते in the early morning, पुत्रहितैषिणी to secure her son's welfare, विष्णोः Visnu's, पूजाम् worship, अकरोत् performed.

text: सा क्षौमवसना हृष्टा नित्यं व्रतपरायणा । अग्निं जुहोति स्म तदा मन्त्रवत्कृतमङ्गला ॥२-२०-१५॥
translation: Always engaged in the observance of vows, Kausalya (then) clad in silk cloth was performing rituals of auspiciousness, offering oblations to the firegod in accordance with mantras (Vedic hymns).
word_meanings: नित्यम् always, व्रतपरायणा devoted to performing vows, सा she, क्षौमवसना clad in silk cloth, हृष्टा in delight, कृतमङ्गला having performed the rituals of auspiciousness, मन्त्रवत् in accordance with mantras, अग्निं fire, जुहोति स्म offered oblations.

text: प्रविश्य च तदा रामः मातुर् अन्तः पुरम् शुभम् । ददर्श मातरम् तत्र हावयन्तीम् हुत अशनम् ॥२-२०-१६॥
translation: Rama entered the auspicious inner apartment of his mother and saw her exhorting the priests to offer sacrificial oblations to Agni (firegod).
word_meanings: तदा then, रामः Rama, शुभम् auspicious, मातु: अन्तःपुरम् inner apartment of his mother, प्रविश्य having entered, तत्र there, हुताशनम् to Agni, हावयन्तीम् exhorting the priests to offer sacrificial oblations, मातरम् to mother, ददर्श saw.

text: देवकार्यनिमित्तम् च तत्रापश्यत् समुद्यतम् । दध्यक्षतम् घृतम् चैव मोदकान् हविषस्तदा ॥२-२०-१७॥
translation: There Rama saw curd, grains of rice, clarified butter, sweetmeats, oblations, parched grain, white garlands, porridge of cooked rice mixed with sesame seeds, sacrirficial faggots, vessels filled with water, etc. kept ready for religious rites.
word_meanings: रघुनन्दनः scion of the Raghus or delight of the Raghu race (Rama), तत्र there, देवकार्यनिमित्तम् on account of religious acts, समुद्यतम् (things) kept ready, अपश्यत् saw, दध्यक्षतम् curd, grains of rice (smeared with turmeric), घृतं चैव also clarified butter, मोदकान् sweetmeats, तथा as also, हविषः oblations, लाजान् parched grain, शुक्लानि white, माल्यानि garlands of flowers, पायसम् porridge, कृसरम् sesame seeds mixed with cooked rice, समिधः sacrirficial faggots, पूर्णकुम्भान् vessels filled with water, ददर्श saw.

text: लाजान् माल्यानि शुक्लानि पायसम् कृसरम् तथा । समिधः पूर्णकुम्भाम्श्छ ददर्श रघुनम्दनः ॥२-२०-१८॥
translation: There Rama saw curd, grains of rice, clarified butter, sweetmeats, oblations, parched grain, white garlands, porridge of cooked rice mixed with sesame seeds, sacrirficial faggots, vessels filled with water, etc. kept ready for religious rites.
word_meanings: रघुनन्दनः scion of the Raghus or delight of the Raghu race (Rama), तत्र there, देवकार्यनिमित्तम् on account of religious acts, समुद्यतम् (things) kept ready, अपश्यत् saw, दध्यक्षतम् curd, grains of rice (smeared with turmeric), घृतं चैव also clarified butter, मोदकान् sweetmeats, तथा as also, हविषः oblations, लाजान् parched grain, शुक्लानि white, माल्यानि garlands of flowers, पायसम् porridge, कृसरम् sesame seeds mixed with cooked rice, समिधः sacrirficial faggots, पूर्णकुम्भान् vessels filled with water, ददर्श saw.

text: ताम् शुक्लक्षौमसम्वीताम् व्रतयोगेन कर्शिताम् । तर्पयन्तीम् ददर्शाद्भिः देवताम् देववर्णिनीम् ॥२-२०-१९॥
translation: Kausalya, emaciated due to observance of vows and clad in white silk looked like a celestial being. She was engaged in offering libations to the deities.
word_meanings: शुक्लक्षौमसंवीताम् wearing white silk, व्रतयोगेन due to observance of vows, कर्शिताम् emaciated, देववर्णिनीम् having divine complexion, अद्भिः with water, देवताम् to deities, तर्पयन्तीम् engaged in propitiating, ताम् her (Kausalya), ददर्श beheld.

text: सा चिरस्यात्मजं दृष्ट्वा मातृनन्दनमागतम् । अभिचक्राम संहृष्टा किशोरं बडबा यथा ॥२-२०-२०॥
translation: Seeing her son who had come after a long time and who is a source of joy to his mother, Kausalya approached him with great delight like a mare to her young calf.
word_meanings: सा she, चिरस्य after a long time, आगतम् arrived, मातृनन्दनम् delight to mother, आत्मजम् her son, दृष्ट्वा having seen, संहृष्टा in great delight, बडबा mare, किशोरं यथा like its offspring, अभिचक्राम went towards him.

text: स मातरमभिक्रान्तामुपसम्गृह्य राघवः । परिष्वक्तश्च बाहुभ्यामुपाग्रातश्च मूर्धनि ॥२-२०-२१॥
translation: The scion of the Raghus saw his mother coming and bowed her. She held him in both her arms and kissed his forehead.
word_meanings: सः राघवः that scion of the Raghus (Rama), अभिक्रान्ताम् who had come to him, मातरम् mother, उपसंगृह्य with respectful salutations, बाहुभ्याम् with both arms, परिष्वक्तः was embraced, मूर्धनि on his forehead, उपाघ्रातश्च was kissed.

text: तम् उवाच दुराधर्षम् राघवम् सुतम् आत्मनः । कौसल्या पुत्र वात्सल्यात् इदम् प्रिय हितम् वचः ॥२-२०-२२॥
translation: Out of love for her son, the invincible scion of the Raghu dynasty, Kausalya spoke with gentle and pleasant words:
word_meanings: कौशल्या Kausalya, दुराधर्षम् invincible, आत्मनः her own, सुतम् son, तं राघवम् that Rama, पुत्रवात्सल्यात् out of filial affection, प्रियहितम् pleasant and beneficial, इदम् these, वचः words, उवाच spoke.

text: वृद्धानां धर्मशीलानां राजर्षीणां महात्मनाम् । प्राप्नुह्यायुश्च कीर्तिं च धर्मं चोपहितं कुले ॥२-२०-२३॥
translation: May you attain long life and fame like those of the aged, virtuous and great rajarsis who upheld the righteousness in the race.
word_meanings: वृद्धानाम् of the aged, धर्मशीलानाम् of the virtuous, महात्मनाम् great, राजर्षीणाम् of the rajarsis, आयुश्च long life, कीर्तिं च fame, कुले in the race, उपहितम् maintained over a long time, धर्मं च righteousness, प्राप्नु हि you may attain.

text: सत्य प्रतिज्ञम् पितरम् राजानम् पश्य राघव । अद्य एव हि त्वाम् धर्म आत्मा यौवराज्ये अभिषेक्ष्यति ॥२-२०-२४॥
translation: O scion of the Raghu race see the king, your righteous and truthful father, who will consecrate you as princeregent today itself.
word_meanings: राघव scion of the Raghu dynasty (Rama), सत्यप्रतिज्ञम् true to his promise, पितरम् your father, राजानम् king, पश्य see, धर्मात्मा righteous one, त्वाम् you, अद्यैव today, यौवराज्ये as heirapparent, अभिषेक्ष्यति will coronate you.

text: दत्तमासनमालभ्य भोजनेन निमन्त्रितः । मातरम् राघवः किम्चित् प्रसार्य अन्जलिम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-२०-२५॥
translation: Invited (by Kausalya) to partake the food, Rama out of abashment only touched the seat provided to him and having stretched his folded palms spoke to his mother.
word_meanings: भोजनेन with food, निमन्त्रितः a man invited, राघवः Rama, दत्तम् provided, आसनम् seat, आलभ्य having touched, व्रोडात् out of shame, किञ्चित् a little, अञ्जलिम् with folded hands, प्रसार्य having stretched, मातरम् to mother, अब्रवीत् said.

text: स स्वभाव विनीतः च गौरवाच् च तदा आनतः । प्रस्थितो दण्डकारण्यमाप्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे ॥२-२०-२६॥
translation: Modest by nature, Rama with respectful humility began seeking her permission for his departure to Dandaka forest:
word_meanings: स्वभावविनीतश्च by nature modest, तदा then, गौरवात् out of reverence (for his mother), नतः च humble also, सः he, दण्डकारण्यम् to Dandaka forest, प्रस्थितः for his departure, अप्रष्टुम् to seek her permission, उपचक्रमे commenced.

text: देवि नूनम् न जानीषे महद् भयम् उपस्थितम् । इदम् तव च दुह्खाय वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणस्य च ॥२-२०-२७॥
translation: O mother surely you do not know that a great misfortune has befallen, causing distress to you, Sita and Lakshmana, too.
word_meanings: देवि O Devi, नूनम् certainly, उपस्थितम् has befallen, महत् great, भयम् misfortune, न जानीषे you do not know, इदम् this one, तव च to you, वैदेह्याः of Sita, लक्ष्मणस्य च of Lakshmana also, दुःखाय for distress.

text: गमिष्ये दण्डकारण्यम् किमनेनासनेन मे । विष्टरासनयोग्यो हि कालोऽयम् मामुपस्थितः ॥२-२०-२८॥
translation: I am setting forth to Dandaka forest. What is this seat for? A time has come for me when I am fit for a seat of kusa grass.
word_meanings: दण्डकारण्यम् to Dandaka forest, गमिष्ये setting forth, मे for me, अनेन आसनेन with this seat, किम् what is the purpose, विष्टरासनयोग्यः worthy of a mat made of kusa grass, अयम् this, कालः time, मम for me, उपस्थितः has come.

text: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने । मधु मूल फलैः जीवन् हित्वा मुनिवद् आमिषम् ॥२-२०-२९॥
translation: Abstaining from eating meat like hermits and living on honey, fruits and roots, I am to live in the solitary forest for fourteen years.
word_meanings: अमिषम् all meat, हित्वा abstaining, मुनिवत् like a hermit, मधुमूलफलैः honey, fruits and roots, जीवन् while living on, चतुर्दश fourteen, वर्षाणि years, विजने in a solitary, वने in the forest, वत्स्यामि am to dwell.

text: भरताय महा राजो यौवराज्यम् प्रयच्चति । माम् पुनर् दण्डक अरण्यम् विवासयति तापसम् ॥२-२०-३०॥
translation: The great king is conferring the status of heirapparent on Bharata while he is banishing me to Dandaka forest to live like an ascetic.
word_meanings: महाराजः great king, भरताय to Bharata, यौवराज्यम् status of heirapparent, प्रयच्छति is conferring, मां पुनः for me again, तापसम् like an ascetic, दण्डकारण्ये in Dandaka forest, विवासयति sending in exile.

text: स ष्ट्चाअष्टौ च वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने । आसेवमानो वन्यानि फलमूलैश्च चर्तयन् ॥२-२०-३१॥
translation: Living on things available in the forest, on fruits and roots, I am to dwell in the uninhabited jungle for fourteen years.
word_meanings: सः that (I am), वन्यानि forest products, आसेवमानः eating, फलमूलैः fruits and roots, वर्तयन् while living, षट्चाष्टौ च six and eight (fourteen), वर्षाणि years, विजने वने in the desolate forest, वत्स्यामि shall dwell.

text: सा निकृत्तैव सालस्य यष्टिः परशुना वने । पपात सहसा देवी देवतेव दिवश्च्युता ॥२-२०-३२॥
translation: All on a sidden Kausalya fell down on the ground like the branch of a sal tree in the forest severed by an axe, like a goddess dropped from heaven.
word_meanings: सा देवी that Kausalya, परशुना with an axe, वने in the forest, निकृत्ता severed, सालस्य sal tree's, यष्टिः इव like a stick (branch), दिवः from heaven, च्युता fallen down, देवतेव like a celestial, सहसा suddenly, पपात fell down.

text: तामदुःखोचितां दृष्ट्वा पतितां कदलीमिव । रामस्तूत्थापयामास मातरं गतचेतसम् ॥२-२०-३३॥
translation: Seeing his mother who had done nothing to deserve (this) suffering and who had fallen down like a plantain tree, deprived of her senses, Rama raised her up (from the ground).
word_meanings: अदुःखोचिताम् who does not deserve sorrow, पतिताम् fallen on the ground, कदलीमिव like a plantain tree, गतचेतसम् deprived of her senses, तां मातरम् to that mother, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रामः Rama, उत्थापयामास lifted her up.

text: उपावृत्त्योत्थितां दीनां बडबामिव वाहिताम् । पांसुकुण्ठितसर्वाङ्गीं विममर्श च पाणिना ॥२-२०-३४॥
translation: Rama gently wiped away the dust that had covered her body as Kausalya stood miserable, like a mare who stands up after having rolled on the ground while pulling the load.
word_meanings: उपावृत्त्य rolled on the ground, उत्थिताम् arisen, वाहिताम् for drawing (heavy burden), बडबामिव like a mare, दीनाम् miserable, पांसुकुण्ठितसर्वाङ्गीम् all her body covered with dust, पाणिना with the hand, विममर्श caressed (wiped away).

text: सा राघवमुपासीनमसुखार्ता सुखोचिता । उवाच पुरुषव्याघ्रमुपशृण्वति लक्ष्मणे ॥२-२०-३५॥
translation: Kausalya who deserved happiness yet was struck down by (this) distress spoke to Rama, the tiger among men who was sitting nearby, while Lakshmana was listening.
word_meanings: असुखार्ता struck by lack of happiness, सुखोचिता deserving happiness, सा she Kausalya, लक्ष्मणे in Lakshmana, उपशृण्वति while listening, उपासीनम् sitting nearby, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् to the tiger (the best) among men, राघवम् to Rama, उवाच said.

text: यदि पुत्र न जायेथा मम शोकाय राघव । न स्म दुह्खम् अतः भूयः पश्येयम् अहम् अप्रजा ॥२-२०-३६॥
translation: O my son, if you were not born to me, I, even as a woman without progeny, would not have experienced grief, more intense than this.
word_meanings: पुत्र O my son, राघव Rama, मम to me, शोकाय to cause sorrow, न जायेथाः यदि if you were not born, अहम् I, अप्रजाः without progeny, अतः more than this, भूयः greater, दुःखम् sorrow, न स्म पश्येयम् would not have seen.

text: एकएव हि वन्ध्यायाः शोको भवति मानवः । अप्रजा अस्मि इति सम्तापो न हि अन्यः पुत्र विद्यते ॥२-२०-३७॥
translation: O my son a barren woman has only one mental agony that she has no progeny. Except that she does not have any other sorrow.
word_meanings: पुत्र O my son, वन्ध्यायाः for a barren woman, अप्रजाः issueless, अस्मि I am, इति thus, मानसः in mind, एकः one, शोकः affliction, भवति हि surely happens, अन्यः any other, सन्तापः sorrow, न विद्यते हि does not exist.

text: न दृष्टपूर्वं कल्याणं सुखं वा पतिपौरुषे । अपि पुत्रे ऽपि पश्येयमिति रामाऽस्थितं मया ॥२-२०-३८॥
translation: I did not have the fortune, O Rama, to enjoy any auspicious moment or pleasure earlier when my husband was in authority. I exist with the hope that I will have it when my son assumes authority.
word_meanings: राम O Rama, पतिपौरुषे when my husband was exercising authority, कल्याणम् auspicious moment, सुखं वा or pleasure, न दृष्टपूर्वम् was not seen earlier, पुत्रेऽपि in son, पश्येयम् can I see, इति thus, मया by me, आस्थितम् life is sustained.

text: सा बहून्यमनोज्ञानि वाक्यानि हृदयच्छिदाम् । अहं श्रोष्ये सपत्नीनामवराणां वरा सती ॥२-२०-३९॥
translation: I, being the eldest (of the queens) will have to listen to many heartbreaking and unpleasant words from my fellowwives who are younger to me.
word_meanings: सा अहम् such am I वरा सती being the eldest (of the queens), अवराणाम् by the younger ones, हृदयच्छिदाम् heartbreaking, सपत्नीनाम् cowives, अमनोज्ञानि unpleasant, बहूनि many, वाक्यानि words, श्रोष्ये will have to listen.

text: अतः दुह्खतरम् किम् नु प्रमदानाम् भविष्यति । त्वयि सम्निहिते अपि एवम् अहम् आसम् निराकृता ॥२-२०-४०॥
त्वयि सन्निहितेऽप्येवमहमासं निराकृता । किम् पुनः प्रोषिते तात ध्रुवम् मरणम् एव मे ॥२-२०-४१॥
translation: O child even when you are nearby I am neglected like this. What to say when you are banished. Death is certain to me.
word_meanings: तात O child, त्वयि you, सन्निहितेऽपि even when you are nearby, अहम् I, एवम् in this way, निराकृता आसम् I am rejected, प्रोषिते when you are banished, किं पुनः what to say again, मे for me, मरणम् death, ध्रुवम् is certain.

text: अत्यन्तनिगृहीतास्मि भर्तुर्नित्य्मतन्त्रिता । परिवारेण कैकेय्या समा वाप्यथवाऽवरा ॥२-२०-४२॥
translation: Treating me as an equal or inferior to the attendants of Kaikeyi and making me always dependent, my husband has greatly suppressed me.
word_meanings: कैकेय्याः of Kaikeyi's, परिवारेण attendants, समा वा equal to, अथवा or, अवरा inferior, अतन्त्रिता without independence, नित्यम् always, भर्तुः by husband, अत्यन्तनिगृहीता अस्मि am greatly repressed.

text: यो हि माम् सेवते कश्चित् अथ वा अपि अनुवर्तते । कैकेय्याः पुत्रम् अन्वीक्ष्य स जनो न अभिभाषते ॥२-२०-४३॥
translation: Any one who serves me or follows me will not talk to me after seeing Bharata (installed as heirapparent).
word_meanings: यः whoever, कश्चित् any one, माम् me, सेवते serving, अथवा or, अनुवर्तते following me, सः जनः such person, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi's, पुत्रम् son, अन्वीक्ष्य having seen, नाभिभाषते हि will not talk to me.

text: नित्यक्रोधतया तस्याः कथं नु खरवादि तत् । कैकेय्या वदनम् द्रष्टुम् पुत्र शक्ष्यामि दुर्गता ॥२-२०-४४॥
translation: Fallen into an unfortunate state how can I look at Kaikeyi's face who is always harsh and in temper?
word_meanings: पुत्र O son, दुर्गता fallen into a bad state, नित्यक्रोधतया due to being always in temper, खरवादि speaking harsh words, तस्याः कैकेय्याः that Kaikeyi's, तत्वदनम् that face, द्रष्टुम् to look at, कथं नु how, शक्ष्यामि will be able?

text: दश सप्त च वर्षाणि तव जातस्य राघव । असितानि प्रकान्क्षन्त्या मया दुह्ख परिक्षयम् ॥२-२०-४५॥
translation: O Rama, I have spent the last seventeen years after your birth with the expectaion that my sorrows would come to an end.
word_meanings: राघव Rama, तव जातस्य after you were (re) born (after your investiture with the sacred thread regarded as second birth), दश सप्त च ten and seven (seventeen), वर्षाणि years, दुःखपरिक्षयम् end of my sorrows, प्रकाङ्क्षन्त्या longing, मया by me, अतितानि have been spent.

text: तदक्षयम् महाद्दुःखम् नोत्सहे सहितुम् चिरम् । विप्रकारम् सपत्नीनामेवम् जीर्णापि राघव ॥२-२०-४६॥
translation: Therefore, O Rama, I cannot at this old age endure this great, endless sorrow and the insults from cowives for long.
word_meanings: राघव Rama, तत् for that reason, एवम् like this, जीर्णापि grown old, अक्षयम् unending, महत् great, दुःखम् sorrow, सपत्नीनाम् of my cowives, विप्रकारम् insult, चिरम् for long time, सहितुम् to tolerate, नोत्सहे do not desire.

text: अपश्यन्ती तव मुखम् परिपूर्णशशिप्रभम् । कृपणा वर्तयिष्यामि कथम् कृपणजीविकाम् ॥२-२०-४७॥
translation: Without beholding your face that is as bright as the full Moon, how can this wretched woman live this pitiable life?
word_meanings: कृपणा wretched I am, तव your, परिपूर्णशशिप्रभम् as bright as the full Moon, मुखम् face, अपश्यन्ती without beholding, कृपणजीविकाम् pitiable means of existence, कथम् how, वर्तयिष्यामि will live.

text: उपवासैः च योगैः च बहुभिः च परिश्रमैः । दुह्खम् सम्वर्धितः मोघम् त्वम् हि दुर्गतया मया ॥२-२०-४८॥
translation: Through meditation, through fasts and with a great deal of efforts you have been brought up by this luckless (mother). But alas this is all in vain.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, दुर्गतया मया by me so unfortunate, उपवासैश्च through fasts, योगैश्च through meditation, बहुभिः many, परिश्रमैश्च with efforts, दुःखम् with difficulty, मोघम् in vain, संवर्धितः have been brought up.

text: स्थिरम् तु हृदयम् मन्ये मम इदम् यन् न दीर्यते । प्रावृषि इव महा नद्याः स्पृष्टम् कूलम् नव अम्भसा ॥२-२०-४९॥
translation: I think my heart must be very firm (hard) like the bark of a great river which, touched by (a flood of) fresh water in the rainy season does not disintegrate.
word_meanings: प्रावृषि in rainy season, नवाम्भसा with fresh water, स्पृष्टम् contacted, महानद्याः mighty river's, कूलम् इव like bank, मम my, इदम् this, हृदयम् heart, यत् for which reason, न दीर्यते does not break, स्थिरम् firm (hard), मन्ये am thinking.

text: ममैव नूनं मरणं न विद्यते न चावकाऽशोस्ति यमक्षयेऽमम । यदन्तकोऽद्यैव न मां जिहीर्षति । प्रसह्य सिंहो रुदतीं मृगीमिव ॥२-२०-५०॥
translation: There is no room for me in the abode of Yama (the god of death). If he does not carry me off forcibly like a lion carrying away a crying female deer, certainly there is no death for me.
word_meanings: सिंहः lion, रुदतीम् crying, मृगीमिव like a female deer, माम् myself, अन्तकः Yama, (the god of death), प्रसह्य forcibly, अद्यैव now itself, यत् since, न जिहीर्षति is not willing to carry, मम to me, नूनम् certainly, मरणम् death, न विद्यते does not befall, मम for me, यमक्षये in the abode of (the god of death), Yama, अवकाशः opportunity, नास्ति not there.

text: स्थिरम् हि नूनम् हृदयम् मम आयसम् । न भिद्यते यद् भुवि न अवदीर्यते । अनेन दुःखेन च देहम् अर्पितम् । ध्रुवम् हि अकाले मरणम् न विद्यते ॥२-२०-५१॥
translation: Surely my still (hard) heart is made of iron. It neither bursts nor breaks down on the ground. Pervaded by grief, there is no untimely death for this my body, too.
word_meanings: नूनम् assuredly, मम my, स्थिरम् still (hard), हृदयम् heart, आयसम् is made of iron, यत् since, न भिद्यते is not breaking, भुवि on this earth, नावदीर्यते does not disintegrate, अनेन this, दुःखेन due to sorrow, देहम् body, अर्पितम् surrendered (pervaded), अकाले untimely, मरणम् death, न विद्यते may not be possible, ध्रुवम् this is certain.

text: इदम् तु दुःखम् यद् अनर्थकानि मे । व्रतानि दानानि च सम्यमाः च हि । तपः च तप्तम् यद् अपत्य कारणात् । सुनिष्फलम् बीजम् इव उप्तम् ऊषरे ॥२-२०-५२॥
translation: My regret is that all my mortifications, gifts of charity and penances are of no avail. Even the asceticism which I practised for the sake of progeny was fruitless like a seed sown in a barren land.
word_meanings: मे my, व्रतानि mortifications, दानानि च charitable gifts, संयमाश्च selfrestraint, अनर्थकानीति यत् are all meaningless, इदम् this, दुःखम् regret, अपत्यकारणात् for the sake of progeny, तप्तम् practised, यत् which, तपः asceticism, ऊषरे in a barren land, उप्तम् sown, बीजम् इव like a seed, सुनिष्फलम् was fruitless.

text: यदि हि अकाले मरणम् स्वया इच्चया । लभेत कश्चित् गुरु दुःख कर्शितः । गता अहम् अद्य एव परेत सम्सदम् । विना त्वया धेनुर् इव आत्मजेन वै ॥२-२०-५३॥
translation: If any one, tormented with great sorrow, could willingly commit suicide I would have gone the way to the assembly of Yama (the lord of death) right away as without you I will be now like a cow without a calf.
word_meanings: कश्चित् any one, गुरुदुःखकर्शितः tormented with deep grief, स्वया of one's own, इच्छया by free will, अकाले untimely, मरणम् death, लभेत यदि if he gets, अहम् I, अद्यैव now itself, आत्मजेन विना without offspring, धेनुरिव like a cow, त्वया विना without you, परेतसंसदम् to the assembly of Yama, गता would have reached.

text: अथापि किम् जीवित मद्य मे वृथा । त्वया विना च्न्द्रनिभाननप्रभ । अनुव्रजिष्यामि वनम् त्वयैव गौः । सुदुर्बला वत्समिवानुकाङ्क्षया ॥२-२०-५४॥
translation: What is the use of this life now? What is life without you whose countenance glows like the full Moon? Like a cow emaciated by its search for the calf, I will follow you into the forest.
word_meanings: अथापि even then, चन्द्रनिभाननप्रभ one having a countenance resembling the splendour of the full Moon, त्वया विना without you, मे my, जीवितम् life, अद्य today, किम् what use, वृथा fruitless, सुदुर्बला enfeebled, गौः cow, वत्सम् इव like a calf, अनुकाङ्क्षया in its affection, त्वयैव with you alone, अद्य now, वनम् to the forest, अनुव्रजिष्यामि shall follow.

text: भृशम् असुखम् अमर्षिता तदा । बहु विललाप समीक्ष्य राघवम् । व्यसनम् उपनिशाम्य सा महत् । सुतम् इव बद्धम् अवेक्ष्य किम्नरी ॥२-२०-५५॥
translation: Kausalya, filled with anger due to extreme sorrow reflected over her misfortune, and burst into harrowing tears, looking at Rama, like a kinnari looking at her grownup son taken captive. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentieth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सा that (Kausalya), राघवम् Rama, समीक्ष्य having seen, महत् great, व्यसनम् misfortune, उपनिशम्य having heard, बद्धम् is made captive, सुतम् son, अवेक्ष्य looking on, किन्नरीव like a kinnari, तदा then, असुखम् unhappy, अमर्षिता wrathful, भृशम् extremely, बहु much, विललाप lamented.

text: तथा तु विलपन्तीम् ताम् कौसल्याम् राम मातरम् । उवाच लक्ष्मणो दीनः तत् काल सदृशम् वचः ॥२-२१-१॥
translation: While Rama's mother, Kausalya was lamenting, miserable Lakshmana said to her these words appropriate to the occasion:
word_meanings: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, दीनः miserable, तथा thus, विलपन्तीम् lamenting, राममातरम् Rama's mother, तां कौशल्याम् to that Kausalya, तत्कालसदृशम् befitting to the occasion, वचः words, उवाच said.

text: न रोचते मम अपि एतत् आर्ये यद् राघवो वनम् । त्यक्त्वा राज्य श्रियम् गच्चेत् स्त्रिया वाक्य वशम् गतः ॥२-२१-२॥
translation: O venerable one, I do not like that Rama should go to the forest yielding to the words of a woman and renouncing the welfare of the kingdom.
word_meanings: आर्ये O venerable one, राघवः Rama, स्त्रियाः a woman's, वाक्यवशं गतः yielding to the words, राज्यश्रियम् the welfare of the kingdom, त्यक्त्वा renouncing, वनम् to the forest, गच्छेत् (इति) यत् should go , एतत् all this, ममापि to me also, न रोचते is not pleasing.

text: विपरीतः च वृद्धः च विषयैः च प्रधर्षितः । नृपः किम् इव न ब्रूयाच् चोद्यमानः समन्मथः ॥२-२१-३॥
translation: The king has a perverse nature. He is aged. He is overpowered by passions. He is under the spell of carnal pleasures and is incited (by Kaikeyi). Such a man can speak anything.
word_meanings: विपरीतश्च man of perverse nature, वृद्धश्च aged also, विषयैः by carnal pleasures, प्रधर्षितः च struck, समन्मथः ruled by passion, नृपः king, चोद्यमानः incited by (Kaikeyi), किमिव whatever words, न ब्रूयात् not speak.

text: न अस्य अपराधम् पश्यामि न अपि दोषम् तथा विधम् । येन निर्वास्यते राष्ट्रात् वन वासाय राघवः ॥२-२१-४॥
translation: I do not see any fault in Rama nor any offence committed by him for which he is exiled from the kingdom.
word_meanings: राघवः Rama, येन for which, राष्ट्रात् from the kingdom, वनवासाय to dwell in the forest, निर्वास्यते is banished, तथाविधम् such, अस्य his, अपराधं offence, न पश्यामि do not see, दोषम् अपि fault also, न not.

text: न तम् पश्याम्य् अहम् लोके परोक्षम् अपि यो नरः । स्वमित्रोऽपि निरस्तोऽपि योऽस्यदोषमुदाहरेत् ॥२-२१-५॥
translation: I do not find anybody in this world, even an adversary or one defeated, who finds fault with him even in his absence.
word_meanings: स्वमित्रोऽपि even an adversary, निरस्तोऽपि or the defeated, यः नरः any man, परोक्षमपि in his absence also, अस्य his, दोषम् fault, उदाहरेत् can cite, तम् him, अहम् I, लोके in this world, न पश्यामि do not find.

text: देव कल्पम् ऋजुम् दान्तम् रिपूणाम् अपि वत्सलम् । अवेक्षमाणः को धर्मम् त्यजेत् पुत्रम् अकारणात् ॥२-२१-६॥
translation: With no cause nor concern for righteousness, will any one abandon his son who is nearly equal to god, upright, selfrestrained and loved even by his enemies ?
word_meanings: धर्मम् righteousness, अवेक्षमाणः without caring, कः who, देवकल्पम् equal to god, ऋजुम् upright, दान्तम् with subdued passions, रिपूणामपि even for his enemies, वत्सलम् a loved man, पुत्रम् son, अकारणात् without any cause, त्यजेत् will abandon.

text: तदिदं वचनं राज्ञःपुनर्बाल्यमुपेयुषः । पुत्रः को हृदये कुर्याद्राजवृत्तमनुस्मरन् ॥२-२१-७॥
translation: Will any son with the ideals of a king in mind accept such words of this king who has entered his chilhood again ?
word_meanings: राजवृत्तम् leading the life of a king, अनुस्मरन् remembering, कः पुत्रः which son, पुनः again, बाल्यम् childhood, उपेयुषः regained, राज्ञः king's, तत् इदं वचनम् that such words, हृदये in the heart, कुर्यात् will accept?

text: यावद् एव न जानाति कश्चित् अर्थम् इमम् नरः । तावद् एव मया साधम् आत्मस्थम् कुरु शासनम् ॥२-२१-८॥
translation: Before this news is known to any one bring the kingdom under your control with my assistance.
word_meanings: कश्चित् any one, नरः man, इमम् अर्थम् this information, यावदेव until, न जानाति does not come to know, तावदेव before that period, मया साधे with my assistance, शासनम् authority (over the kingdom ), आत्मस्थम् under your control, कुरु do (assume).

text: मया पार्श्वे सधनुषा तव गुप्तस्य राघव । कः समर्थो अधिकम् कर्तुम् कृत अन्तस्य इव तिष्ठतः ॥२-२१-९॥
translation: O Rama who can commit excesses on you, when you stand like Yama, god of death, protected by me with my bow?
word_meanings: राघव O Rama, पार्श्वे by your side, स धनुषा with bow, मया by me, गुप्तस्य protected, कृतान्तस्येव like Yama, (god of death), तिष्ठतः (yourself) standing, अधिकम् excess, कर्तुं to challenge, कः who, समर्थः is able?

text: निर्मनुष्याम् इमाम् सर्वाम् अयोध्याम् मनुज ऋषभ । करिष्यामि शरैअः तीक्ष्णैः यदि स्थास्यति विप्रिये ॥२-२१-१०॥
translation: O best of men, if the whole of Ayodhya stands against you I shall depopulate it with my sharp arrows.
word_meanings: मनुजर्षभ O best among men, विप्रिये against you, स्थास्यति यदि if any one stands up, इमाम् this, कृत्स्नाम् entire, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, तीक्ष्णैः with sharp, शरैः arrows, निर्मनुष्याम् depopulate, करिष्यामि I shall do.

text: भरतस्य अथ पक्ष्यो वा यो वा अस्य हितम् इच्चति । सर्वान् एतान् वधिष्यामि मृदुर् हि परिभूयते ॥२-२१-११॥
translation: I shall slay all of them who support Bharata and those who seek his prosperity. A gentleman is treated with disgrace indeed.
word_meanings: अथ even so, भरतस्य Bharata's, पक्ष्यो वा or any supporter, यो वा or any one, अस्य his, हितम् welfare, इच्छति seeking, एतान् सर्वान् all those, वधिष्यामि I shall slay, मृदुः a soft (person), परिभूयते हि is treated with disgrace indeed.

text: प्रोत्साहितोऽयम् कैकेय्या स दुष्टो यदिः पिता । अमित्रभूतो निस्सङ्गम् वध्यताम् बध्यतामपि ॥२-२१-१२॥
translation: Even if our father instigated by Kaikeyi becomes our enemy, he shall be imprisoned or even slain regardless of our relationship with him.
word_meanings: कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, प्रोत्साहितः instigated, सः that, दुष्टः vicious, नः पिता our father, अमित्रभूतः यदि becomes enemy, निस्सङ्गं without caring for any relationship, अयम् I will, बध्यताम् shall be imprisoned, वध्यतामपि also shall be slain.

text: गुरोरप्यवलिप्तस्य कार्याकार्यमजानतः । उत्फथम् प्रतिपन्नस्य कार्यम् भवति शासन्म् ॥२-२१-१३॥
translation: Even a preceptor who follows the unrighteous path and is filled with haughtiness and does not know how to discriminate between good and bad, deserves to be disciplined (punished).
word_meanings: अवलिप्तस्य filled with haughtiness, कार्याकार्यम् acts good and bad, अजानतः of one who does not know, उत्पथम् unrighteous path, प्रतिपन्नस्य of one who has resorted to, गुरोरपि even of a preceptor, शासनम् discipline, कार्यम् duty, भवति becomes.

text: बलमेष किमाश्रित्य हेतुम् वा पुरुषर्षभ । दातुमिच्छति कैकेय्य राज्यम् स्थितमिदम् तव ॥२-२१-१४॥
translation: O best of men, under what authority or reason this king wants to confer on Kaikeyi the kingdom that rightfully belongs to you?
word_meanings: पुरुषर्षभ O best of men, तव your, स्थितम् belongings, इदम् this, राज्यम् kingdom, एषः he, किम् what, बलम् power, हेतुं वा or reason, आश्रित्य resorting to, कैकेय्यै to Kaikeyi, दातुम् to confer, इच्छति wishes.

text: त्वया चैव मया चैव कृत्वा वैरम् अनुत्तमम् । कस्य शक्तिः श्रियम् दातुम् भरताय अरि शासन ॥२-२१-१५॥
translation: What authority, O Rama, chastiser of foes, this king has to bestow the kingdom upon Bharata by entering into undesirable hostility towards you and me?
word_meanings: अरिशासन O chastiser of foes, त्वया चैव with you, मया चैव with me, अनुत्तमम् undesirable, वैरम् hostility, कृत्वा having created, अस्य for him, भरताय to Bharata, श्रियम् kingdom, दातुम् to bestow, का शक्तिः what strength he has?

text: अनुरक्तः अस्मि भावेन भ्रातरम् देवि तत्त्वतः । सत्येन धनुषा चैव दत्तेन इष्टेन ते शपे ॥२-२१-१६॥
translation: O mother, (Lakshmana now tells Kausalya) I am truly loyal to my brother from the bottom of my heart. I swear this by my bow, on my merits earned through charity, by my truthfulness and by the good deeds I have done.
word_meanings: देवि mother, तत्त्वत: truly, भावेन from the bottom of my heart, भ्रातरम् my brother, अनुरक्तः अस्मि I am loyal, सत्येन truthfully, धनुषा चैव with bow also, दत्तेन on charity, इष्टेन on sacrifice, ते to you, शपे I swear.

text: दीप्तम् अग्निम् अरण्यम् वा यदि रामः प्रवेक्ष्यते । प्रविष्टम् तत्र माम् देवि त्वम् पूर्वम् अवधारय ॥२-२१-१७॥
translation: O mother rest assured should Rama enter a blazing fire or a forest I must have already entered it.
word_meanings: देवि O mother, रामः Rama, दीप्तम् blazing, अग्निम् fire, अरण्यं वा or to the forest, प्रवेक्ष्यति यदि if he enters, पूर्वम् prior, माम् me, तत्र there, प्रविष्टम् one who entered, त्वम् you, अवधारय know.

text: हरामि वीर्यात् दुह्खम् ते तमः सूर्यैव उदितः । देवी पश्यतु मे वीर्यम् राघवः चैव पश्यतु ॥२-२१-१८॥
translation: Like the rising Sun dispelling darkness, I shall eliminate your sorrow. O mother Let Rama see my valour. You, too.
word_meanings: उदितः arisen, सूर्यः Sun, तम इव like darkness, वीर्यात् with my valour, ते दुःखम् your sorrow, हरामि shall take away, देवी mother, मे वीर्यम् my valour, पश्यतु one shall see, राघवश्चैव Rama also, पश्यतु shall see.

text: एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य महात्मनः । उवाच रामम् कौसल्या रुदन्ती शोक लालसा ॥२-२१-१९॥
translation: Having heard the words of the magnanimous Lakshmana, Kausalya, depressed and weeping, said to Rama:
word_meanings: महात्मनः of the magnanimous, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, एतत् वचनम् these words, श्रुत्वा having heard, कौशल्या Kausalya, रुदन्ती weeping, शोकलालसा depressed with sorrow, रामम् to Rama, उवाच said.

text: भ्रातुस् ते वदतः पुत्र लक्ष्मणस्य श्रुतम् त्वया । यद् अत्र अनन्तरम् तत् त्वम् कुरुष्व यदि रोचते ॥२-२१-२०॥
translation: O my son you have heard what your brother Lakshmana said and if it pleases you, do later what is to be done.
word_meanings: पुत्र O son, ते your, भ्रातुः brother's, लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, वदतः saying, त्वया by you, श्रुतम् has been heard, रोचते यदि if it pleases (you), अत्र in this matter, अनन्तरम् later, यत् what, कार्यम् is to be done, कुरूष्व you may do it.

text: न च अधर्म्यम् वचः श्रुत्वा सपत्न्या मम भाषितम् । विहाय शोक सम्तप्ताम् गन्तुम् अर्हसि माम् इतः ॥२-२१-२१॥
translation: By heeding the unrighteous words of my cowife (Kaikeyi) it does not behove you to leave me griefstricken and go away from here.
word_meanings: मम my, सपत्न्या by (my) cowife (Kaikeyi), भाषितम् spoken, अधर्म्यम् unrighteous, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, शोकसन्तप्ताम् stricken with grief, माम् me, विहाय leaving, इतः from here, गन्तुम् to go, नार्हसि does not behove you.

text: धर्मज्ञ यदि धर्मिष्ठो धर्मम् चरितुम् इच्चसि । शुश्रूष माम् इहस्थः त्वम् चर धर्मम् अनुत्तमम् ॥२-२१-२२॥
translation: You are righteous. You know your duty. If you wish to follow the path of righteousness, stay here, serve me and follow the best of dharma.
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञ O knower of duties, धर्मिष्ठः pious, धर्मम् righteousness, चरितुम् to follow, इच्छसि यदि if you wish, त्वम् you, इहस्थः by staying here, माम् me, शुश्रूष serve, अनुत्तमम् best, धर्मम् of virutes, चर follow.

text: शुश्रूषुर् जननीम् पुत्र स्व गृहे नियतः वसन् । परेण तपसा युक्तः काश्यपः त्रिदिवम् गतः ॥२-२१-२३॥
translation: O son Kasyapa who led a life of selfdiscipline and served his mother at home, attained heaven credited with (the merit of) the highest penance.
word_meanings: पुत्र O son, काश्यपः Kasyapa, जननीम् his mother, शुश्रूषुः by serving, नियतः with selfdiscipline, स्वगृहे in his own home, वसन् while dwelling, परेण with the highest, तपसा with penance, युक्तः engaged in, त्रिदिवम् heaven, गतः went.

text: यथा एव राजा पूज्यः ते गौरवेण तथा हि अहम् । त्वाम् न अहम् अनुजानामि न गन्तव्यम् इतः वनम् ॥२-२१-२४॥
translation: Just as the king is worthy of your respectful homage, so am I. I will not permit you to go from here to the forest.
word_meanings: राजा king, गौरवेण out of reverence, ते to you, यथैव how, पूज्यः is worthy of homage, अहम् I, तथा हि in the same manner, अहम् I, त्वाम् to you, नानुजानामि will not permit, इतः from here, वनम् to the forest, न गन्तव्यम् shall not go.

text: त्वद् वियोगान् न मे कार्यम् जीवितेन सुखेन वा । त्वया सह मम श्रेयः तृणानाम् अपि भक्षणम् ॥२-२१-२५॥
translation: Separated from you, I have no use of this life or happiness. I prefer to live with you even if it means eating grass.
word_meanings: त्वद्वियोगात् by being separated from you, मे for me, जीवितेन with life, सुखेन वा or with happiness, कार्यम् any purpose, न not, त्वया सह along with you, मम to me, तृणानाम् of grass, भक्षणम् अपि feeding also, श्रेयः is preferable.

text: यदि त्वम् यास्यसि वनम् त्यक्त्वा माम् शोक लालसाम् । अहम् प्रायम् इह आसिष्ये न हि शक्ष्यामि जीवितुम् ॥२-२१-२६॥
translation: If you depart for the forest leaving me griefstricken I cannot live. Here I shall seek death by fasting.
word_meanings: शोकलालसाम् overtaken by sorrow, माम् me, त्यक्त्वा after leaving, त्वम् you, वनम् to the forest, यास्यसि यदि if you depart, अहम् I, इह here, प्रायम् असिष्ये I shall seek death by fasting, जीवितुम् to live, न शक्ष्यामि हि I am not able.

text: ततः स्त्वम् प्राप्स्यसे पुत्र निरयम् लोक विश्रुतम् । ब्रह्म हत्याम् इव अधर्मात् समुद्रः सरिताम् पतिः ॥२-२१-२७॥
translation: O son you will then fall into hell. As wellknown in the world, the ocean, the lord of rivers, incurred the guilt of slaying a brahmin through unrighteous conduct.
word_meanings: ततः after that, पुत्र O son, त्वम् you, सरितां पतिः lord of all rivers, समुद्रः ocean, अधर्मात् through unrighteous conduct, ब्रह्महत्यामिव like slaying a brahmin, लोकविश्रुतम् renowned in the world, निरयम् hell, प्राप्स्यसे will attain.

text: विलपन्तीम् तथा दीनाम् कौसल्याम् जननीम् ततः । उवाच रामः धर्म अत्मा वचनम् धर्म सम्हितम् ॥२-२१-२८॥
translation: Thereafter, virtuous Rama addressed these words consistent with righteousness to his miserable mother Kausalya who was thus lamenting:
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, धर्मात्मा virtuous, रामः Rama, दीनाम् miserable lady, तथा in that way, विलपन्तीम् lamenting, जननीम् to his mother, कौशल्याम् to Kausalya, धर्मसंहितम् consistent with righteousness, वचनम् words, उवाच said.

text: न अस्ति शक्तिः पितुर् वाक्यम् समतिक्रमितुम् मम । प्रसादये त्वाम् शिरसा गन्तुम् इच्चाम्य् अहम् वनम् ॥२-२१-२९॥
translation: I do not have the power to transgress the orders of my father. Bowing my head I beseech you, allow me to go to the forest.
word_meanings: पितुः father's, वाक्यम् words (order), समतिक्रमितुम् to transgress, मम for me, शक्तिः power, नास्ति is not there, अहम् I, शिरसा bowing my head, प्रसादये I am propitiating, वनम् to forest, गन्तुम् to depart, इच्छामि wishing.

text: ऋषिणा च पितुर् वाक्यम् कुर्वता व्रत चारिणा । गौर् हता जानता धर्मम् कण्डुना अपि विपश्चिता ॥२-२१-३०॥
translation: Learned sage Kandu who knew what is righteousness and a strict observant of vows, slew a cow for carrying out the command of his father.
word_meanings: ऋषिणा by the sage, व्रतचारिणा by a man observing the vows, धर्मम् righteousness, जानता by the knower, विपश्चिता by a learned man, अपि even, कण्डुना by Kandu, पितुः father's, वाक्यम् command, कुर्वता carrying out, गौ: cow, हता slew.

text: अस्माकम् च कुले पूर्वम् सगरस्य आज्ञया पितुः । खनद्भिः सागरैः भूतिम् अवाप्तः सुमहान् वधः ॥२-२१-३१॥
translation: Earlier the sons of Sagara, born in our family, while excavating the earth by the order of their father met a terrible death.
word_meanings: पूर्वम् earlier, अस्माकम् in our, कुले च race, पितुः of father, सगरस्य Sagara's, आज्ञया by command, भूमिम् earth, खनद्भि: by those excavating, सागरैः by the sons of Sagara, सुमहान् very great (fearful), वधः slaughter, आवाप्तः was met with.

text: जामदग्न्येन रामेण रेणुका जननी स्वयम् । कृत्ता परशुना अरण्ये पितुर् वचन कारिणा ॥२-२१-३२॥
translation: Parasurama, son of Jamadagni himself in obedience to the words of his father, decapitated his mother Renuka in the forest with an axe.
word_meanings: पितुः father's, वचनकारिणा in obedience to the words, जामदग्न्येन by the son of Jamadagni, रामेण by Parasurama, जननी his mother, रेणुका Renuka, स्वयम् himself, अरण्ये in the forest, परशुना by an axe, कृत्ता was severed.

text: एतैरन्यैश्च बहुभिर्देवि देवसमैः कृतम् । पितुर्वचनमक्लीबम् करिष्यामि पितुर्शितम् ॥२-२१-३३॥
translation: All of them including many other godlike persons, O Mother fulfilled the words of their father. I shall also make my father's wish come true.
word_meanings: देवि O Devi, एतैः by these, देवसमैः by godlike people, बहुभिः many, अन्यैश्च by others also, पितुः father's, वचनम् words, अक्लीबम् fruitful, कृतम् was made, पितुः father's, हितम् wish, करिष्यामि I will do.

text: न खल्व् एतन् मया एकेन क्रियते पितृ शासनम् । एतैरपि कृतम् देवि ये मया तव कीर्तिताः ॥२-२१-३४॥
translation: I am not O Devi the only one obeying my father's command. All I have mentioned to you did.
word_meanings: देवि O Devi, मया by me, एकेन by me alone, एतत् this, पितृशासनम् father's command, न क्रियते has not been obeyed, मया by me, ये all those, तव to you, कीर्तिताः have been mentioned, एतैरपि even by them, कृतम् it has been done.

text: नाहम् धर्ममपूर्वम् ते प्रतिकूलम् प्रवर्तये । पूर्वैः अयम् अभिप्रेतः गतः मार्गो अनुगम्यते ॥२-२१-३५॥
translation: I am not advancing anything new, contrary to the existing practice. I am only following the trodden path of our ancestors.
word_meanings: अहम् I, प्रतिकूलम् contrary to the old practice, अपूर्वम् anything new, धर्मम् practice, ते to you, न प्रवर्तये I am not advancing, पूर्वैः by ancestors, अभिप्रेतः acceptable, गतः followed by them, अयम् this, मार्गः path, अनुगम्यते is being followed.

text: तत् एतत् तु मया कार्यम् क्रियते भुवि न अन्यथा । पितुर् हि वचनम् कुर्वन् न कश्चिन् नाम हीयते ॥२-२१-३६॥
translation: I will not do as duty anything contrary to what is done by others in this world. No one who obeys the commands of his father falls off the path of righteousness.
word_meanings: भुवि in this world, कार्यम् duty, तत् एतत् that this(compliance with the command), मया by me, अन्यथा in any other manner, न क्रियते will not be done, पितुः father's, वचनम् orders, कुर्वन् while carrying out, कश्चित् any one, न हीयते नाम will not perish.

text: ताम् एवम् उक्त्वा जननीम् लक्ष्मणम् पुनर् अब्रवीत् । तव लक्ष्मण जानामि मयि स्नेहम् अनुत्तमम् ॥२-२१-३७॥
तव लक्ष्मण जानामि मयि स्नेहमनुत्तमम् । विक्रमम् चैव सत्यम् च तेजश्च सुदुरासदम् ॥२-२१-३८॥
translation: I know, O Lakshmana, your profound affection for me. I also know your valour, strength and unassailable energy.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, तव your, मयि in me, अनुत्तमम् exceedingly great, स्नेहम् affection, विक्रमं चैव also valour, सत्त्वं च also strength, सुदुरासदम् unassailable, तेजश्च energy, जानामि I know.

text: मम मातुर्महद्दुःखमतुलम् शुभलक्षम्ण । अभिप्रायम् अविज्ञाय सत्यस्य च शमस्य च ॥२-२१-३९॥
translation: O Lakshamana of auspicious qualities, since my mother is not aware of the significance of truth and selfrestraint, she is overcome with grief, great and incomparable.
word_meanings: शुभलक्षण O one of auspicious qualities (Lakshmana), सत्यस्य च of truth, शमस्य च of selfrestraint, अभिप्रायम् the meaning, अविज्ञाय without realising, मम मातुः my mother's, अतुलम् incomparable, महत् दुःखम् great grief.

text: धर्मः हि परमः लोके धर्मे सत्यम् प्रतिष्ठितम् । धर्म सम्श्रितम् एतच् च पितुर् वचनम् उत्तमम् ॥२-२१-४०॥
translation: Righteousness alone is supreme in this world and truth is established in righteousness. This excellent command of our father is supported by righteousness.
word_meanings: धर्मः righteousness, लोके in this world, परमो हि is supreme, धर्मे in righteousness, सत्यम् truth, प्रतिष्ठितम् is established, एतत् this, उत्तमम् excellent, पितुः father's, वचनं च words, धर्मसंश्रितम् is supported by righteousness.

text: सम्श्रुत्य च पितुर् वाक्यम् मातुर् वा ब्राह्मणस्य वा । न कर्तव्यम् वृथा वीर धर्मम् आश्रित्य तिष्ठता ॥२-२१-४१॥
translation: Any one, O hero, who has taken recourse to righteousness should not allow the promise made to his father, mother or a brahmin to go in vain.
word_meanings: वीर O hero, पितुः of father, मातुर्वा or of mother, ब्राह्मणस्य वा or of brahmins, संश्रुत्य having promised, धर्मम् righteouness, आश्रित्य having taken recourse, तिष्ठता by one who abides in, वाक्यम् words, वृथा in vain, न कर्तव्यम् is not to be done.

text: सो अहम् न शक्ष्यामि पितुर् नियोगम् अतिवर्तितुम् । पितुर् हि वचनात् वीर कैकेय्या अहम् प्रचोदितः ॥२-२१-४२॥
translation: O hero I cannot transgress the command of my father since at his instance only Kaikeyi urged me (to go to the forest).
word_meanings: वीर O warrior, सः अहम् such me, पितुः father's, नियोगम् command, अतिवर्तितुम् to transgress, न शक्ष्यामि I am not competent, पितुः father's, वचनात् from the words, अहम् I, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, प्रचोदितः हि urged.

text: तत् एनाम् विसृज अनार्याम् क्षत्र धर्म आश्रिताम् मतिम् । धर्मम् आश्रय मा तैक्ष्ण्यम् मद् बुद्धिर् अनुगम्यताम् ॥२-२१-४३॥
translation: Therefore, leave this ignoble thought, resort to the duty of a kshatriya, take the righteous path. Do not adopt violence. Follow my decision.
word_meanings: तत् for that reason, अनार्याम् ignoble, क्षत्रधर्माश्रिताम् resorting to the duty of a kshatriya, मतिम् intellect, विसृज you may give up, धर्मम् righteousness, आश्रय adopt, तैक्ष्ण्यम् violence, मा do not follow, मद्बुद्धिः my thought, अनुगम्यताम् be followed.

text: तम् एवम् उक्त्वा सौहार्दात् भ्रातरम् लक्ष्मण अग्रजः । उवाच भूयः कौसल्याम् प्रान्जलिः शिरसा आनतः ॥२-२१-४४॥
translation: Speaking affectionately to his brother Lakshmana, Rama with folded hands and head bowed again addressed Kausalya:
word_meanings: लक्ष्मणाग्रजः elder brother of Lakshmana, Rama, तम् that, भ्रातरम् his brother, सौहार्दात् affectionately, एवम् in this way, उत्त्वा having spoken, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, शिरसा with head, नतः down, भूयः again, कौशल्याम् to Kausalya, उवाच said.

text: अनुमन्यस्व माम् देवि गमिष्यन्तम् इतः वनम् । शापिता असि मम प्राणैः कुरु स्वस्त्ययनानि मे ॥२-२१-४५॥
translation: I have decided, O mother to go to the forest from here. Grant me the permission to do so. I swear on my life. Perform all the ceremonies for securing prosperity for me.
word_meanings: देवि O Devi, इतः from here, वनम् to the forest, गमिष्यन्तम् one who has decided to go, अनुमन्यस्व you may permit, मम me, प्राणैः with life, शापिता असि you are sworn, मे to me, स्वस्त्ययनानि all ceremonial means of securing prosperity, कुरु perform.

text: तीर्ण प्रतिज्ञः च वनात् पुनर् एष्याम्य् अहम् पुरीम् । ययातिरिव राजर्षिः पुरा हित्वा पुनर्धिवम् ॥२-२१-४६॥
translation: Like rajarshi Yayati of yore who lost heaven and rejained it, I shall return from the forest to the city (of Ayodhya) after the vow is fulfilled.
word_meanings: पुरा in the past, ययातिः Yayati, राजर्षिः rajarshi, दिवम् heaven, हित्वा having left, पुनः again, दिवम् इव like heaven, अहम् I, तीर्ण प्रतिज्ञः having fulfilled my vow, वनात् from the forest, पुनः again, पुरीम् to the city (of Ayodhya), एष्यामि shall return.

text: शोकस्सम्धार्यताम् मातर्हृदये साधु मा शुचः । वनवासादिहैष्यामि पुनः कृत्वा पितुर्वचः ॥२-२१-४७॥
translation: Do not grieve, O mother Be prudent enough to subdue your sorrow in your heart. Having fulfilled father's words, I shall come back from my sojourn in the forest.
word_meanings: मात O mother, शोकः sorrow, हृदये in the heart, साधु prudently, सन्धार्यताम् be subdued, मा शुचः do not grieve, पितुः father's, वचः words, कृत्वा having fulfilled, वनवासात् from exile, पुनः again, इह here, एष्यामि will come back.

text: त्वया मया च वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन सुमित्रया । पितुर्नियोगे स्थातव्यमेष धर्मः सनाअनः ॥२-२१-४८॥
translation: You, Sita, Lakshmana, Sumitra and I -- all of us shall abide by the words of my father. This indeed is eternal law.
word_meanings: त्वया by you, मया च by me, वैदेह्या by Sita, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, सुमित्रया by Sumitra, पितुः father's, नियोगे by the orders, स्थातव्यम् we shall abide, एषः this alone, सनातनः eternal, धर्मः law.

text: अम्ब सम्हृत्य सम्भारान् दुःखम् हृदि निगृह्य च । वनवासकृता बुद्धिर्मम धर्म्यानुवर्त्यताम् ॥२-२१-४९॥
translation: O mother in withdrawing the articles (for consecration) and also in subduing the sorrow in your heart approve of my plan to dwell in the forest.
word_meanings: अम्ब O mother, सम्भारान् articles (for consecration), संहृत्य after withdrawing, दुःखम् sorrow, हृदि in the heart, निगृह्य च also after subduing, वनवासकृता relating to my dwelling in the forest, धर्म्या conforming to duty, मम बुद्धि: my thinking, अनुवर्त्यताम् follow.

text: एतद्वच स्तस्य निशम्य माता । सुधर्म्यमव्यग्रमविक्लबम् च । मृतेव सम्ज्ञाम् प्रतिलभ्य देवी । समीक्ष्य रामम् पुनरित्युवाच ॥२-२१-५०॥
translation: Having heard these words so unruffled and tranquil which conformed to righteousness, mother (Kausalya), like a dead person regaining consciousness spoke to Rama again:
word_meanings: माता mother, देवी Devi (Kausalya), तस्य that Rama's, सुधर्म्यम् conforming to virtue, अव्यग्रम् unruffled, अविक्लबं च also without getting distressed, एतत् all this, वचः words, निशम्य having heard, मृतेव like a dead person, संज्ञाम् consciousness, प्रतिलभ्य having regained, रामम् Rama, समीक्ष्य having looked at intently, पुनः again, इति thus, उवाच said.

text: यथैव ते पुत्र पिता तथाहम् । गुरुः स्वधर्मेण सुहृत्तया च । न त्वानुजानामि न मांविहाय । सुदुःखितामर्हसि गन्तुमेवम् ॥२-२१-५१॥
translation: By virtue of my own duty and affection towards you, O my son I am as much your preceptor as your father is. I will not grant you permission. You should not go, leaving me deeply distressed.
word_meanings: पुत्र O my son, स्वधर्मेण by virtue of one's own duty, सुहृत्तया च out of affection, ते your, पिता father, यथैव as he is to you, तथा like that, अहम् I, गुरुः preceptor, त्वा you, न अनुजानामि do not permit, सुदुःखिताम् highly distressed, माम् me, विहाय leaving, एवम् in this manner, गन्तुम् to go, नार्हसि does not behove you.

text: किम् जीवितेनेह विना त्वया मे । लोकेन वा किम् स्वधयाऽमृतेन । श्रेयो मुहूर्तम् तव सन्निधानम् । ममेह कृत्स्नादपि जीवलोकात् ॥२-२१-५२॥
translation: What is the purpose of my life in this world without you? What purpose do I have with the other world or with the oblations (offered to manes) or with nectar (availble to the gods). I would prefer one moment in your company to the whole world of living beings (without you).
