text: न ते क्षौद्रम् च दधि च ब्राह्मणा वेद पारगाः । मूर्ध्नि मूर्ध अवसिक्तस्य दधति स्म विधानतः ॥२-२६-१३॥
translation: How is it that brahmins versed in the Vedas have not duly sprinkled the mixture of honey and curd on your head (prior to your consecration)?
word_meanings: वेदपारगाः versed in the Vedas, ब्राह्मणाः brahmins, मूर्धाभिषिक्तस्य having been consecrated, ते your, मूर्ध्नि on head, विधानतः conforming to rites, क्षौद्रं च honey also, दधि च curds, न ददति स्म did not sprinkle.

text: न त्वाम् प्रकृतयः सर्वा श्रेणी मुख्याः च भूषिताः । अनुव्रजितुम् इच्चन्ति पौर जापपदाः तथा ॥२-२६-१४॥
translation: How is it that welladorned ministers, citizens from towns and villages, heads of guilds and others do not follow you?
word_meanings: सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः ministers, श्रेणीमुख्याश्च also the heads of guilds, तथा also, पौरजानपदाः citizens of towns and villages, भूषिताः adorned, त्वाम् you, अनुव्रजितुम् to follow, न इच्छन्ति do not seek.

text: चतुर्भिर् वेग सम्पन्नैः हयैः कान्चन भूषणैः । मुख्यः पुष्य रथो युक्तः किम् न गच्चति ते अग्रतः ॥२-२६-१५॥
translation: How is it that the chief ceremonial chariot, decorated with gold and harnessed by four galloping horses is not preceding you?
word_meanings: वेगसम्पन्नैः running swiftly, काञ्चनभूषितैः decorated with gold, चतुर्भिः four, हयैः horses, युक्तः harnessed, मुख्यः important, पुष्यरथः ceremonial chariot, किम् why, ते अग्रतः preceding you, न गच्छति is not going.

text: न हस्ती च अग्रतः श्रीमाम्स् तव लक्षण पूजितः । प्रयाणे लक्ष्यते वीर कृष्ण मेघ गिरि प्रभः ॥२-२६-१६॥
translation: How is it that the elephant, whose lustre resembles that of a mountain or a dark cloud and endowed with auspicious features is not seen leading your procession, O valiant one
word_meanings: वीर O valiant one, तव your, प्रयाणे in your journey, अग्रतः in front, लक्षणपूजितः endowed with good features and revered, कृष्णमेघगिरिप्रभः with the lustre of a dark cloud or a mountain, श्रीमान् auspicious one, हस्ती an elephant, न लक्ष्यते is not seen.

text: न च कान्चन चित्रम् ते पश्यामि प्रिय दर्शन । भद्र आसनम् पुरः कृत्य यान्तम् वीर पुरह्सरम् ॥२-२६-१७॥
translation: O heroic one O handsome one how is it that I do not see your attendants proceeding in front with the throne carved in gold?
word_meanings: वीर O heroic one, प्रियदर्शन O one with a pleasant countenance, काञ्चनचित्रम् carved in gold, ते to you, भद्रासनम् throne, पुरस्कृत्य keeping in front of, यान्तम् proceeding, पुरस्कृतम् keeping in front, न च पश्यामि I do not see.

text: अभिषेको यदा सज्जः किम् इदानीम् इदम् तव । अपूर्वो मुख वर्णः च न प्रहर्षः च लक्ष्यते ॥२-२६-१८॥
translation: How is it that when arrangements are under way now for your consecration, the complexion of your countenance does not look like what it was before? There is no joy on your face.
word_meanings: अभिषेकः consecration, यथा as, सज्जः arranged, तव your, मुखवर्णः complexion of your face, अपूर्वः unusual, प्रहर्षश्च delightful, न लक्ष्यते not seen, इदानीम् now, इदम् this, किम् why?

text: इति इव विलपन्तीम् ताम् प्रोवाच रघु नन्दनः । सीते तत्रभवाम्स् तात प्रव्राजयति माम् वनम् ॥२-२६-१९॥
translation: O Sita my venerable father is banishing me to the forest, said Rama, the scion of the Raghus, the joy of the Raghu race, seeing her thus lamenting.
word_meanings: इतीव in this way, विलपन्तीम् lamenting, ताम् to her, रघुनन्दनः Rama, प्रोवाच said , सीते O Sita, तत्रभवान् venerable, तातः father, माम् me, वनम् to the forest, प्रव्राजयति banishing.

text: कुले महति सम्भूते धर्मज्ञे धर्म चारिणि । शृणु जानकि येन इदम् क्रमेण अभ्यागतम् मम ॥२-२६-२०॥
translation: You were born in a noble family. You know and practise dharma. I shall tell you how this banishment has come about. Do listen.
word_meanings: महति in a noble, कुले family, सम्भूते born in, धर्मज्ञे knower of righteousness, धर्मचारिणि for an observer of righteousness, जानकि Sita, येन क्रमेण in such course, इदम् this, अभ्यागतम् has befallen, शृण listen.

text: राज्ञा सत्य प्रतिज्ञेन पित्रा दशरथेन मे । कैकेय्यै प्रीत मनसा पुरा दत्तौ महा वरौ ॥२-२६-२१॥
translation: My father, king Dasaratha, true to his promise, had earlier granted two great boons to my mother Kaikeyi.
word_meanings: राज्ञा by the king, सत्यप्रतिज्ञेन true to his promise, पित्रा my father, दशरथेन by Dasaratha, पुरा earlier, मम मात्रे to my mother, कैकेय्यै to Kaikeyi, महावरौ two great boons, दत्तौ were given.

text: तया अद्य मम सज्जे अस्मिन्न् अभिषेके नृप उद्यते । प्रचोदितः स समयो धर्मेण प्रतिनिर्जितः ॥२-२६-२२॥
translation: When the king was preparing for my consecration, she reminded him of the promise and in the name of righteousness he has been cornered.
word_meanings: अद्य now, नृपोद्यते the king was getting ready, मम my, अस्मिन् अभिषेके for this consecration, सज्जे in the preparation, तया by her, सः that, समयः promise, प्रचोदितः was urged, धर्मेण in the name of righteousness, प्रतिनिर्जितः has been conquered.

text: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वस्तव्यम् दण्डके मया । पित्रा मे भरतः च अपि यौवराज्ये नियोजितः ॥२-२६-२३॥
translation: I am to dwell in the Dandaka forest for fourteen years while father has appointed Bharata princeregent.
word_meanings: मया by me, चतुर्दश वर्षाणि fourteen years, दण्डके in Dandaka forest, वस्तव्यम् am to dwell, मे पित्रा by my father, भरतश्चापि Bharata also, यौवराज्ये as heirapparent, नियोजितः has been appointed.

text: सो अहम् त्वाम् आगतः द्रष्टुम् प्रस्थितः विजनम् वनम् । भरतस्य समीपे ते न अहम् कथ्यः कदाचन ॥२-२६-२४॥
translation: I have come to see you before departing for the desolate Dandaka forest. You should never praise me in the presence of Bharata because intellectuals cannot tolerate others being praised before them. You should never extol my virtues before him.
word_meanings: विजनम् desolate, वनम् forest, प्रस्थितः set to depart, सः अहम् such me, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, आगतः I have come, भरतस्य Bharata's, समीपे in the presence of, कदाचन at any time, अहम् I, न कथ्यः not to be told , बुद्धियुक्ताः intellectuals, पुरुषाः men, परस्तवम् praising others , न सहन्ते हि cannot endure, तस्मात् for that reason, भरतस्य Bharata's, अग्रतः infront of, ते those, मम गुणाः my virtues, न कथ्याः should not be mentioned.

text: ऋद्धि युक्ता हि पुरुषा न सहन्ते पर स्तवम् । तस्मान् न ते गुणाः कथ्या भरतस्य अग्रतः मम ॥२-२६-२५॥
translation: I have come to see you before departing for the desolate Dandaka forest. You should never praise me in the presence of Bharata because intellectuals cannot tolerate others being praised before them. You should never extol my virtues before him.
word_meanings: विजनम् desolate, वनम् forest, प्रस्थितः set to depart, सः अहम् such me, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, आगतः I have come, भरतस्य Bharata's, समीपे in the presence of, कदाचन at any time, अहम् I, न कथ्यः not to be told , बुद्धियुक्ताः intellectuals, पुरुषाः men, परस्तवम् praising others , न सहन्ते हि cannot endure, तस्मात् for that reason, भरतस्य Bharata's, अग्रतः infront of, ते those, मम गुणाः my virtues, न कथ्याः should not be mentioned.

text: न अपि त्वम् तेन भर्तव्या विशेषेण कदाचनअनुकूलतया शक्यम् समीपे तस्य वर्तितुम् ॥२-२६-२६॥
translation: Never expect special treatment from Bharata. You can (continue to) stay with him (here) by conducting yourself in a favourable manner.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, तेन by him, कदाचन at any time, विशेषेण with a special treatment, न भर्तव्या should not be supported, अनुकूलतया तु by being favourable only, अस्य his, समीपे in his vicinity, वर्तितुम् to remain, शक्यम् is possible.

text: तस्मै दत्तम् नृवतिना यौवराज्यम् सनातनम् । स प्रसाद्यस्त्वया सीते नृपतिश्च विशेषतः ॥२-२६-२७॥
translation: O Sita the king has conferred the hereditary regency on him. Therefore, O Sita, you must make efforts to win his favour, especially a king's.
word_meanings: नृपतिना by the king, तस्मै for him, सनातनम् perpetual, यौवराज्यम् regency, दत्तम् given, सीते O Sita, सः he, त्वया by you, प्रसाद्यः has to be pleased, नृपतिश्च king also, विशेषतः especially.

text: अहम् च अपि प्रतिज्ञाम् ताम् गुरोह् समनुपालयन् । वनम् अद्य एव यास्यामि स्थिरा भव मनस्विनि ॥२-२६-२८॥
translation: I am leaving for the forest right away for fulfilling my father's pledge. O highminded Sita be steady.
word_meanings: अहं चापि I also, गुरोः father's, तां प्रतिज्ञाम् that promise, समनुपालयन् while fulfilling, अद्यैव now itself, वनम् to the forest, यास्यामि shall go, मनस्विनि highminded, Sita, त्वम् you, स्थिरा भव keep steady.

text: याते च मयि कल्याणि वनम् मुनि निषेवितम् । व्रत उपवास रतया भवितव्यम् त्वया अनघे ॥२-२६-२९॥
translation: O sinless, auspicious one engage yourself in vratas and fasting after my departure to the forest inhabited by ascetics.
word_meanings: अनघे O sinless one, कल्याणि O auspicious one, मयि me, मुनिनिषेवितम् inhabited by ascetics, वनम् to the forest, याते when I am gone, त्वया by you, व्रतोपवास परया engaged in vratas and fasting, भवितव्यम् should be done.

text: काल्यम् उत्थाय देवानाम् कृत्वा पूजाम् यथा विधि । वन्दितव्यो दशरथः पिता मम नर ईश्वरः ॥२-२६-३०॥
translation: You must rise in time and with the (household) gods duly worshipped, pay obeisance to my father, king Dasaratha.
word_meanings: काल्यम् fimely, उत्थाय rising, यथाविधि according to the prescribed rituals, देवानाम् of the gods, पूजाम् कृत्वा having worshipped, मम पिता my father, नरेश्वरः lord of the people, दशरथः to Dasaratha, वन्दितव्यः is worthy of homage (by you).

text: माता च मम कौसल्या वृद्धा सम्ताप कर्शिता । धर्मम् एव अग्रतः कृत्वा त्वत्तः सम्मानम् अर्हति ॥२-२६-३१॥
translation: You should give importance to duty(dharma) and show respect to my aged mother who is emaciated due to grief.
word_meanings: सन्तापकर्शिता emaciated due to grief, वृद्धा aged, मम माता च my mother, कौशल्या Kausalya, धर्ममेव duty only, अग्रतः कृत्वा placing ahead, त्वत्तः by you, सम्मानम् respect, अर्हति deserves.

text: वन्दितव्याः च ते नित्यम् याः शेषा मम मातरः । स्नेह प्रणय सम्भोगैः समा हि मम मातरः ॥२-२६-३२॥
translation: In terms of love, affection and service, the rest of my mothers are all equal. Therefore, you must pay them due respect regularly.
word_meanings: शेषाः the rest of them, या मम मातरः my mothers, ते to you also, नित्यम् always, वन्दितव्याः should be respected, मम my, मातरः mothers, स्नेहप्रणय सम्भोगैः with love, affection and service, समाः हि are equal.

text: भ्रातृ पुत्र समौ च अपि द्रष्टव्यौ च विशेषतः । त्वया लक्ष्मण शत्रुघ्नौ प्राणैः प्रियतरौ मम ॥२-२६-३३॥
translation: What is more important is that you should look on Bharata as your brother and Satrughna as your son. They are dearer to me than my life.
word_meanings: मम to me, प्राणैः more than life , प्रियतरौ dearer, भरतशत्रुघ्नौ Bharata and Satrughna, विशेषतः specially, त्वया by you, भ्रातृपुत्रसमौ as your brother and your sons, द्रष्टव्यौ च are to be looked after.

text: विप्रियम् न च कर्तव्यम् भरतस्य कदाचन । स हि राजा प्रभुः चैव देशस्य च कुलस्य च ॥२-२६-३४॥
translation: Now Bharata is the king of the country and head of the family. Therefore, you should never do anything disagreeable to him.
word_meanings: कदाचन at any time, भरतस्य of Bharata, विप्रियम् disagreeable, न कर्तव्यम् should not be done, सः he, देशस्य च of the country, कुलस्य च of the family also, राजा king, प्रभुश्चैव also the lord.

text: आराधिता हि शीलेन प्रयत्नैः च उपसेविताः । राजानः सम्प्रसीदन्ति प्रकुप्यन्ति विपर्यये ॥२-२६-३५॥
translation: Kings are gratified if they are served with zeal and good conduct. If the contrary happens, they get provoked.
word_meanings: राजान: kings, शीलेन with good conduct, आराधिताः are gratified, प्रयत्नैः with endeavours, उपसेविताः having been served, सम्प्रसीदन्ति are satisfied, विपर्यये in contrary to that, कुप्यन्तिच are also enraged.

text: औरसान् अपि पुत्रान् हि त्यजन्ति अहित कारिणः । समर्थान् सम्प्रगृह्णन्ति जनान् अपि नर अधिपाः ॥२-२६-३६॥
translation: Kings abandon (even) their own sons if they are harmful and receive capable people even if they are strangers.
word_meanings: नराधिपाः kings, अहितकारिणः harmful men, औरसान् पुत्रानपि even their own sons, त्यजन्ति will abandon, समर्थान् capable men, जनानपि even other people, सम्प्रगृह्णन्ति accept.

text: सा त्वम् वसेह कल्याणि राज्ञः समनुवर्तिनी । भरतस्य रता धर्मे सत्यव्रतपरायणा ॥२-२६-३७॥
translation: O auspicious one live here by being obedient to king Bharata. Absorbed in righteousness, follow truth and (religious) vows.
word_meanings: कल्याणि O auspicious one, सा त्वम् so you, राज्ञः of the king, भरतस्य of Bharata, समनुवर्तिनी an obedient lady, धर्मे in righteousness, रता absorbed one, सत्यव्रत परायणा following the truth and the vows, इह वस live here.

text: अहम् गमिष्यामि महा वनम् प्रिये । त्वया हि वस्तव्यम् इह एव भामिनि । यथा व्यलीकम् कुरुषे न कस्यचित् । तथा त्वया कार्यम् इदम् वचो मम ॥२-२६-३८॥
translation: O my beloved Sita I am going to the wild forest. Stay here and never cause displeasure to any one in any way. Could you carry out these words of mine? इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षड्विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentysixth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: प्रिये O beloved one, भामिनि beauty (Sita), अहम् I, महावनम् to the great forest, गमिष्यामि I am going, त्वया by you, इहैव here itself, कस्यचित् to any one, यथा in any way, व्यलीकम् harm, न कुरुषे would not do, तथा in that way, वस्तव्यम् you shall live here, मम my, इदं वचः these words, कार्यम् should be done.

text: एवम् उक्ता तु वैदेही प्रिय अर्हा प्रिय वादिनी । प्रणयात् एव सम्क्रुद्धा भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-२७-१॥
translation: When the sweettongued daughter of Videha (Sita) who deserved affection, heard this she was very angry out of her love (for Rama). She said these wordsto her husband (in reply):
word_meanings: प्रियवादिनी speaking pleasant words, प्रियार्हा deserving affection, वैदेही Sita, एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, प्रणयादेव out of love, संक्रुद्धा mighty angry, भर्तारम् to her husband, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: किमिदम् भाषसे राम वाक्यम् लघुतया ध्रुवम् । त्वया यदपहास्यम् मे श्रुत्वा नरवरात्मज ॥२-२७-२॥
translation: O Rama why are you speaking so lightly? O prince if you hear these very same words (spoken to you), you will ridicule me.
word_meanings: नरवरात्मज O Prince, राम Rama, यत् since, लघुतया lightly, त्वया by you, ध्रुवम् certainly, अपहास्यम् fit to be ridiculed, श्रुत्वा having heard, मे to me (by me also), इदम् these, किं वाक्यम् what words, भाषसे are speaking.

text: आर्य पुत्र पिता माता भ्राता पुत्रः तथा स्नुषा । स्वानि पुण्यानि भुन्जानाः स्वम् स्वम् भाग्यम् उपासते ॥२-२७-३॥
translation: O son of a noble monarch father, mother, brother, son or daughterinlaw (everybody) experiences the merit (of their past deeds) and receives what is due from destiny.
word_meanings: आर्यपुत्र O son of a noble monarch, पिता father, माता mother, भ्राता brother, पुत्रः son, तथा also, स्नुषा daughterinlaw, स्वानि their own, पुण्यानि merits, भुञ्जानाः while enjoying, स्वं स्वम् due to each of them, भाग्यम् destiny, उपासते are receiving.

text: भर्तुर् भाग्यम् तु भार्या एका प्राप्नोति पुरुष ऋषभ । अतः चैव अहम् आदिष्टा वने वस्तव्यम् इति अपि ॥२-२७-४॥
translation: A wife alone, O best of men shares the destiny of her husband. I am also therefore, ordered to dwell in the forest. ( a command to you is a command to me).
word_meanings: पुरुषर्षभ O best of men, (Rama), भर्तुर्भाग्यं the destiny of husband, एका only, भार्या wife, प्राप्नोति receives, अतश्च therefore, अहमपि I also, वने in the forest, वस्तव्यमिति should dwell, अदिष्टा एव ordered.

text: न पिता न आत्मजो न आत्मा न माता न सखी जनः । इह प्रेत्य च नारीणाम् पतिर् एको गतिः सदा ॥२-२७-५॥
translation: It is not her father or mother, nor her son or herself, nor her friends but her husband alone gives a woman the permanent refuge in this or in the next world.
word_meanings: पिता father, न not, आत्मजः son, न not, आत्मा own self, न not, माता mother, न not, सखीजनः friends, न not, नारीणाम् for women, इह here, प्रेत्य च in the next world also, सदा always, एकः alone, पतिः husband, गतिः is the ultimate refuge.

text: यदि त्वम् प्रस्थितः दुर्गम् वनम् अद्य एव राघव । अग्रतः ते गमिष्यामि मृद्नन्ती कुश कण्टकान् ॥२-२७-६॥
translation: O son of the Raghus if you set out for the impenetrable forest now itself, I shall also go, walking ahead of you and crushing the thorns and (spiky) kusa grass (rendering the path comfortable for you to walk).
word_meanings: राघव son of the Raghus (Rama), अद्यैव now itself, त्वम् you, दुर्गम् impenetrable, वनम् forest, प्रस्थितः यदि if you set out, कुशकण्टकान् on thorns and on Kusa grass, मृद्नन्ती crushing, ते अग्रतः in front of you, गमिष्यामि I shall go.

text: ईर्ष्या रोषौ बहिष् कृत्य भुक्त शेषम् इव उदकम् । नय माम् वीर विश्रब्धः पापम् मयि न विद्यते ॥२-२७-७॥
translation: Do take me with you, O valiant one without hesitation. Dismiss all anger and envy (from your mind) like the leftover water after drinking (anger because she disobeys and envy because she, too, like Rama, is willing to brave the hazards of forest life). There is no fault on my part.
word_meanings: वीर O Valiant one, ईर्ष्यारोषौ anger and jealousy, भुक्तशेषम् leftover after drinking, उदकम् इव like water, बहिष्कृत्य dismissing, विस्रब्ध: without hesitation, माम् me, नय take me, मयि in me, पापम् fault, न विद्यते does not exist.

text: प्रासाद अग्रैः विमानैः वा वैहायस गतेन वा । सर्व अवस्था गता भर्तुः पादच् चाया विशिष्यते ॥२-२७-८॥
translation: Every woman, everywhere be it on the top of mansions or in lovely palaces or flying in the sky should take shelter at his (her husband's) feet (or follow his footsteps).
word_meanings: प्रासादाग्रैः on top of mansions, विमानैर्वा or in lovely palaces, वैहायसगतेन वा moving in air, सर्वावस्थागता in all stages of life, भर्तुः husband's, पादच्छाया shelter at his feet, विशिष्यते is preferable.

text: अनुशिष्टा अस्मि मात्रा च पित्रा च विविध आश्रयम् । न अस्मि सम्प्रति वक्तव्या वर्तितव्यम् यथा मया ॥२-२७-९॥
translation: I have been so instructed by my parents about diverse duties in all stages of life that I need not be told anything (about my duties) now.
word_meanings: मात्रा च by mother, पित्रा च by father, विविधाश्रयम् with regard to diverse duties, अनुशिष्टाअस्मि I have been instructed, मया by myself, यथा in such a way, वर्तितव्यम् to abide, संप्रति now, वक्तव्या नास्मि need not be told to me.

text: अहम् दुर्गम् गमिष्यामि वनम् पुरुषवर्जितम् । नानामृगगणाकीर्णम् शार्दूलवृकसेवितम् ॥२-२७-१०॥
translation: I will also go to the forest, which is impassable, uninhabited, teeming with various kinds of animals and infested with tigers and wolves.
word_meanings: अहम् I, दुर्गम् impassable, पुरुषवर्जितम् uninhabited by men, नानामृगगणाकीर्णम् teeming with various kinds of animals, शार्दूलवृकसेवितम् inhabited by tigers and wolves, वनम् forest, गमिष्यामि I shall go.

text: सुखम् वने निवत्स्यामि यथा एव भवने पितुः । अचिन्तयन्ती त्रीम्ल् लोकामः चिन्तयन्ती पति व्रतम् ॥२-२७-११॥
translation: Free from any anxiety about the three worlds, my only concern will be my duties towards my husband. I shall dwell as happily in the forest as I did in my father's abode.
word_meanings: त्रीन् लोकान् the three worlds, अचिन्तयन्ती without thinking, पतिव्रतम् duties to the husband, चिन्तयन्ती while thinking, वने in the forest, पितुः father's, भवने in the palace, यथैव the same way, सुखम् happily, निवत्स्यामि I shall dwell.

text: शुश्रूषमाणा ते नित्यम् नियता ब्रह्म चारिणी । सह रम्स्ये त्वया वीर वनेषु मधु गन्धिषु ॥२-२७-१२॥
translation: I shall wander with you, O heroic Rama in the honeyscented forest remaining selfpossessed, always doing your service, and observing the vow of celibacy.
word_meanings: वीर O hero , नित्यम् always, ते to you, शुश्रूषमाणा doing service, नियता self possessed, ब्रह्मचारिणी observing vow of celibacy, मधुगन्धिषु honeyscented, वनेषु in forests, त्वया सह with you, रंस्ये I shall sport.

text: त्वम् हि कर्तुम् वने शक्तः राम सम्परिपालनम् । अन्यस्य पै जनस्य इह किम् पुनर् मम मानद ॥२-२७-१३॥
translation: O respector of individuals when you are capable of protecting other people in the forest, what of me?
word_meanings: मानद O bestower of honour, राम Rama, त्वम् you, इह here, वने in the forest, अन्यस्य of others, जनस्य man's, सम्परिपालनमपि protection also, कर्तुम् to do, शक्त: हि is capable, मम about my protection, किं पुनः why again say?

text: सह त्वया गमिश्यामि वसमद्य न सम्शयः । नाहम् शक्या महाभाग निवर्तयितु मुद्यता ॥२-२७-१४॥
translation: There is no doudt that I shall go with you to the forest today. O distinguished one I cannot be restrained from this resolve.
word_meanings: अद्य today, त्वया सह along with you, वनम् to the forest, गमिष्यामि shall go, संशयः न no doubt about it, महाभाग O distinguished one, उद्यता resolved, अहम् I, निवर्तयितुम् to restrain, न शक्या not able.

text: फल मूल अशना नित्यम् भविष्यामि न सम्शयः । न ते दुह्खम् करिष्यामि निवसन्ती सह त्वया ॥२-२७-१५॥
translation: Do not doubt that I shall not be able to live on fruits and roots or that I will create difficulty for you while living with you.
word_meanings: नित्यम् always, फलमूलाशना living on fruits and roots, भविष्यामि I will become, संशयः न no doubt, त्वया सह with you, निवसन्ती while living, ते to you, दुःखम् hardship, न करिष्यामि will not do.

text: इच्चामि सरितः शैलान् पल्वलानि वनानि च । द्रष्टुम् सर्वत्र निर्भीता त्वया नाथेन धीमता ॥२-२७-१६॥
translation: Living with you sans fear, O my sagacious husband, I wish to see the rivers, mountains, lakes and forests here and there.
word_meanings: धीमता with the sagacious, नाथेन by my lord, त्वया along with you, सर्वत्र everywhere, निर्भीता without fear, सरितः rivers, शैलान् mountains, पल्वलानि lakes and, वनानि च and the forests, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I wish.

text: हम्स कारण्डव आकीर्णाः पद्मिनीः साधु पुष्पिताः । इच्चेयम् सुखिनी द्रष्टुम् त्वया वीरेण सम्गता ॥२-२७-१७॥
translation: I wish to enjoy the lotus lakes in full bloom, abounding in swans and ducks in the company of a brave husband like you.
word_meanings: वीरेण by a warrior (like you), त्वया with you, सङ्गता in company of, सुखिनी happy, हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णाः abounding in swans and ducks, साधु पुष्पिताः fully bloomed, पद्मिनी: lotus ponds, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छेयम् I wish.

text: अभिषेकम् करिष्यामि तासु नित्यम् यतव्रता । सह त्वया विशाल अक्ष रम्स्ये परम नन्दिनी ॥२-२७-१८॥
translation: Observing such vows and bathing daily in the lotus lakes, I shall be very much happy to sport with you, O largeeyed one
word_meanings: विशालाक्ष O largeeyed one, यतव्रता observing such vows, नित्यम् daily, तासु in those lotus ponds, अभिषेकम् bathing, करिष्यामि will take, परमनन्दिनी attaining great happiness, त्वया सह along with you, रंस्ये I will sport.

text: एवम् वर्ष सहस्राणाम् शतम् वा अहम् त्वया सह । व्यतिक्रमम् न वेत्स्यामि स्वर्गोऽपि हि न मे मतः ॥२-२७-१९॥
translation: Thus living in your company for a thousand years or even a hundred thousand years, I shall not feel the passing of time. I shall not desire even heaven.
word_meanings: एवम् in this way, अहम् I, त्वया सह with you, वर्षसहस्राणाम् a thousand years, शतं वापि or even a hundred thousand years (of living with you), व्यतिक्रमम् bassing of time, न वेत्स्यामि I shall not feel, मे to me, स्वर्ग: अपि even heaven, न मतः हि is not desirable.

text: स्वर्गे अपि च विना वासो भविता यदि राघव । त्वया मम नर व्याघ्र न अहम् तम् अपि रोचये ॥२-२७-२०॥
translation: O Raghava, tiger among men, if I were given heaven to live in without you, even that I shall not covet.
word_meanings: नरव्याघ्र O best of men, राघव Rama, त्वया विना without you, मम to me, स्वर्गेऽपि even in heaven, वासः living, भविता यदि if it were to happen, अहम् I, तमपि that one also, न रोचये I do not like.

text: अहम् गमिष्यामि वनम् सुदुर्गमम् । मृग आयुतम् वानर वारणैः युतम् । वने निवत्स्यामि यथा पितुर् गृहे । तव एव पादाव् उपगृह्य सम्मता ॥२-२७-२१॥
translation: I shall go (along with you) to the highly impenetrable forest infested with animals like monkeys and elephants. I shall live in the forest in (full) discipline as in my father's abode, taking shelter at your feet.
word_meanings: अहम् I, सुदुर्गमम् highly impenetrable, मृगायुतम् full of animals, वानरवारणैः with monkeys and elephants, वनम् to the forest, गमिष्यामि shall go, तव your, पादावेव feet alone, उपगृह्य taking refuge, संयता restraining myself, वने in the forest, पितुः father's, गृहे यथा like in his house, निवत्स्यामि I shall reside.

text: अनन्य भावाम् अनुरक्त चेतसम् । त्वया वियुक्ताम् मरणाय निश्चिताम् । नयस्व माम् साधु कुरुष्व याचनाम् । न ते मया अतः गुरुता भविष्यति ॥२-२७-२२॥
translation: Since I have no thought other than you and my heart is (irretrievably) attached to you I have resolved to die if separated from you. Pray, be favourably disposed to take me. I shall not be a burden to you.
word_meanings: अनन्यभावाम् without any other thought, अनुरक्तचेतसम् with heart deeply attached, त्वया by you, वियुक्ताम् separated (from you), मरणाय for death, निश्चिताम् resolved, माम् me, नयस्व take, याचनाम् my prayer, साधु be welldisposed, कुरुष्व do, अतः for that, ते for you, मया by me, गुरुता burden, न भविष्यति will not be.

text: तथा ब्रुवाणाम् अपि धर्म वत्सलो । न च स्म सीताम् नृ वरः निनीषति । उवाच च एनाम् बहु सम्निवर्तने । वने निवासस्य च दुह्खिताम् प्रति ॥२-२७-२३॥
translation: Although Sita was thus appealing, Rama, devoted to righteousness, was (still) unwilling to take her. In order to dissuade her, he began to describe to the mournful Sita the many hardships of forest life. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyseventh sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: धर्मवत्सलः devoted to righteousness, नृवरः best of men, तथा that way, ब्रूवाणामपि though speaking, सीताम् tp Sita, न निनीषति स्म was unwilling to take, सन्निवर्तने to dissuade her, एनाम् to her, वने in the forest, निवासस्य of stay, दुःखितां प्रति to the grieved, बहु in many ways, उवाच च said.

text: सएवम् ब्रुवतीम् सीताम् धर्मज्ञो धर्म वत्सलः । निवर्तन अर्थे धर्म आत्मा वाक्यम् एतत् उवाच ह ॥२-२८-१॥
translation: Rama, who knew his duties and was devoted to righteousness, reflected on the difficulties of forest (life) and did not agree to take Sita even though she was pleading the way she did.
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञः knower of righteousness, धर्मवत्सलः devoted to righteousness, सः he, एवम् thus, ब्रुवतीम् speaking, सीताम् to Sita, नेतुम् to take, बुद्धिम् decision, वने in the forest, दुःखानि difficulties, चिन्तयन् while reflecting so, न कुरुते did not make.

text: सान्त्वयित्वा पुनस्ताम् तु बाष्पदूषितलोचनाम् । निवर्तनार्थे धर्मात्मा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ॥२-२८-२॥
translation: Righteous Rama consoled Sita whose eyes were blurred with tears, and in order to dissuade her (from going to the forest) said again:
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा righteous, बाष्पदूषितलोचनाम् whose eyes were blurred with tears, ताम् her, सान्त्वयित्वा having consoled, निवर्तनार्थे to dissuade, पुनः again, एतत् this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच ह said.

text: सीते महा कुलीना असि धर्मे च निरता सदा । इह आचर स्वधर्मम् त्वम् मा यथा मनसः सुखम् ॥२-२८-३॥
translation: Born in a noble race, O Sita, you are always devoted to duty. Follow your duty, here. It will make me happy.
word_meanings: सीते O Sita, महाकुलीना born in a noble race, सदा always, धर्मे to duty ,निरता असि you are devoted, इह here, यथा as, मे मनसः to my mind, सुखम् brings happiness, त्वम् you, स्वधर्मम् your duty, आचर practise.

text: सीते यथा त्वाम् वक्ष्यामि तथा कार्यम् त्वया अबले । वने दोषा हि बहवो वदतः तान् निबोध मे ॥२-२८-४॥
translation: Do as I tell you, O delicate Sita. There are, indeed, many hardships in the forest. I shall tell you all about them. Listen to me.
word_meanings: अबले O frail one, सीते O Sita, त्वाम् you, यथा as, वक्ष्यामि I shall tell you, तथा like that, त्वया by you, कार्यम् should be done, वने in the forest, बहवः many, दोषाः हि hardships are there indeed, वदतः being told, मे by me, तान् about them, निबोध pray attention.

text: सीते विमुच्यताम् एषा वन वास कृता मतिः । बहु दोषम् हि कान्तारम् वनम् इति अभिधीयते ॥२-२८-५॥
translation: Give up the desire to live in the forest, O Sita Living in the dreary jungle, it is said, has many hardships.
word_meanings: सीते O Sita, वनवासकृता to live in the forest, एषा this, मति: mind, विमुच्यताम् give up, कान्तारम् a dreary forest, वनम् forest, बहुदोषं (बहुदोषयुतं) has many hardships, अभिधीयते हि is being said.

text: हित बुद्ध्या खलु वचो मया एतत् अभिधीयते । सदा सुखम् न जानामि दुह्खम् एव सदा वनम् ॥२-२८-६॥
translation: I am saying all this in your interest. The forest is a haven of hardships. I know of no happiness in the forest.
word_meanings: मया by me, एतत् वचः these words, हितबुद्ध्या with prudence, अभिधीयते हि is being said, वनम् forest, सदा always, सुखम् as happy, न जानामि I do not know, सदा always, दुःखमेव grief only.

text: गिरि निर्झर सम्भूता गिरि कन्दर वासिनाम् । सिम्हानाम् निनदा दुह्खाः श्रोतुम् दुह्खम् अतः वनम् ॥२-२८-७॥
translation: It is frightening to hear the sounds of waterfalls and the roar of lions living in the mountain caves. Therefore forest life is painful (fearful).
word_meanings: गिरिनिर्झरसम्भूताः arising from the falling waters from mountains, निनदाः sounds, गिरिकन्दर वासिनाम् living in the mountain caves, सिंहानाम् of lions, श्रोतुम् to hear, दुःखाः fearful, अतः therefore, वनम् forest, दुःखम् source of pain, दुःखमतो painful.

text: क्रीडमानाश्च विस्रब्धा मत्ताह् शून्ये महामृगाः । दृष्ट्वा समभिवर्तन्ते सीते दुःखमतो वनम् ॥२-२८-८॥
translation: Big, wild animals, moving about freely and sporting in the deserted forest, attack on seeing a human. Thus forest is full of danger.
word_meanings: विस्रब्धाः fearless, मत्ताः wild, शून्ये in a deserted place, क्रीडमानाः while sporting, महामृगाः great animals, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, समभिवर्तन्ते attack, सीते Sita, अतः therefore, वनम् forest, दुःखम् is a source of danger.

text: सग्राहाः सरितश्चैव पङ्कवत्यश्च दुस्तराः । मत्तैरपि गजैर्नित्यमतो दुःखतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-९॥
translation: The rivers, infested with crocodiles and filled with mud are difficult to cross even for elephants in rut. Hence forest life is always extremely dangerous.
word_meanings: सग्राहाः with crocodiles, पङ्कवत्यः च filled with mud, सरितश्चैव rivers also, मत्तै: intoxicated, गजैरपि by elephants also, दुस्तराः difficult to cross, अतः therefore, वनम् the forest, नित्यम् always, दुःखतरम् more dangerous.

text: लताकण्टकसम्पूर्णाः कृकवाकूपनादिताः । निरपाश्च सुदुर्गाश्च मार्गा दुःखमतो वनम् ॥२-२८-१०॥
translation: . The paths full of thorny creepers, echoing with the noise of wild fowls, and with no water (to drink) are difficult to tread. So forest is a source of suffering.
word_meanings: मार्गाः the paths, लताकण्टकसङ्कीर्णाः full of thorny creepers, कृकवाकूपनादिताः echoing with the noise of wild fowls, निरपाः with no water, सुदुर्गाः च are extremely difficult to traverse, अतः therefore, वनम् forest, दुःखम् is a difficult place.

text: सुप्यते पर्ण शय्यासु स्वयम् भग्नासु भू तले । रात्रिषु श्रम खिन्नेन तस्मात् दुह्खतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-११॥
translation: Exhausted with struggles one has to sleep at night on a bed of leaves fallen on their own on the ground. Therefore, forest life is extremely painful.
word_meanings: स्वयम् on their own, भग्नासु broken (fallen), पर्णशय्यासु bed of leaves, भूतले on the ground, श्रमखिन्नेन exhausted with struggles, रात्रिषु at night, सुप्यते will have to sleep, तस्मात् therefore, वनम् forest life, दुःखतरम् is extremely painful.

text: अहोरात्रम् च सन्तोषः कर्तव्यो नियतात्मना । फलैर्वृक्षावपतितैः सीते दुःखमतो वनम् ॥२-२८-१२॥
translation: With the senses under control night and day, O Sita, one must be satisfied with the fruits fallen from trees. Therefore, forest life is full of suffering.
word_meanings: सीते O Sita, अहोरात्रम् night and day, नियतात्मना with senses under control, वृक्षावपतितैः fallen down the trees, फलैः with fruits, सन्तोषः satisfaction, कर्तव्यः to be derived, अतः therefore, वनम् forest life, दुःखम् is full of suffering.

text: उपवासः च कर्तव्या यथा प्राणेन मैथिलि । जटा भारः च कर्तव्यो वल्कल अम्बर धारिणा ॥२-२८-१३॥
translation: One has to wear robes of bark and matted hair and take to fasting as long as one can, O daughter of Mithila
word_meanings: मैथिलि O Daughter of Mithila, यथाप्राणेन according to one's ability, उपवासश्च fasting also, कर्तव्यः has to be undertaken, वल्कलाम्बरधारिणा wearing robes of bark, जटाभारश्च also burden of matted hair, कर्तव्यः has to be borne.

text: देवतानाम् पितृइणाम् चकर्तव्यम् विधिपूर्वकम् । प्राप्तानामतिथीनाम् च नित्यशः प्रतिपूजनम् ॥२-२८-१४॥
translation: One has to worship gods and ancestors according to tradition and extend hospitality to guests, (who arrive unexpectedly).
word_meanings: देवतानाम् of devatas, पित्रूणां च also of ancestors, प्राप्तानाम् of those arrived, अतिथीनां च of guests also, विधिपूर्वकम् duly, नित्यशः always, प्रतिपूजनम् worship, कर्तव्यम् needs to be done.

text: कार्यस्त्रीरभिषेकश्च काले काले च नित्यशः । चरता नियमेनैव तस्माद्दुःखतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-१५॥
translation: One has to wander about all the while (like an ascetic) as per the customs and take ablutions three times a day at prescribed hours. Hence life in the forest is extremely hard.
word_meanings: नियमेनैव as per rule, चरता while wandering (like an ascetic), नित्यशः always, काले काले at prescribed hours, त्रिः three times, अभिषेकः bathing, कार्यः will have to be done, तस्मात् therefore, वनम् life in the forest, दुःखतरम् is extremely difficult.

text: उपहारश्च कर्तव्यः कुसुमैः स्वयमाहृतैः । आर्षेण विधिना वेद्याम् बाले दुःखमतो वनम् ॥२-२८-१६॥
translation: Flowers collected with one's own hands, O innocent one, should be offered on the altar as per injunction of the Vedas. Therefore (life in the) forest is difficult.
word_meanings: बाले O innocent one, स्वयम् on your own, आहृतैः has been brought, कुसुमैः with flowers, आर्षेण विधिना as per the injunction of the Vedas, वेद्याम् on the altar, उपहारश्च offering, कर्तव्यः needs to be made, अतः therefore, वनम् living in the forest, दुःखम् is difficult.

text: यथालब्धेन कर्तव्यः सन्तोष्स्तेन मैथिलि । यताहारैर्वनचरैः सीते दुःखमतो वनम् ॥२-२८-१७॥
translation: The wanderers in the jungle, O daughter of Mithila, have to be satisfied daily with whatever little food is available. So forest (life) is a hard life.
word_meanings: मैथिलि O daughter of Mithila, वनचरैः by wanderers in the forest, यताहारैः with limited food, यथालब्धेन whatever is available, तेन with that alone, सन्तोषः satisfaction, कर्तव्यः should be derived, अतः for that reason, वनम् forest life, दुःखम् is difficult.

text: अतीव वातः तिमिरम् बुभुक्षा च अत्र नित्यशः । भयानि च महान्ति अत्र ततः दुह्खतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-१८॥
translation: There is extreme wind and darkness, hunger and fear. Therefore forest (life) is difficult.
word_meanings: अत्र there (in the forest), वाताः wind, तिमिरम् darkness, अतीव is extreme, नित्यशः always, बुभुक्षा hunger, महान्ति great, भयानि च fears also, ततः therefore, वनम् forest life, दुःखतरम् is extremely difficult.

text: सरी सृपाः च बहवो बहु रूपाः च भामिनि । चरन्ति पृथिवीम् दर्पात् अतः दुखतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-१९॥
translation: There are various forms of fierce reptiles fearlessly crawling on the ground. So (living in the) forest is extremely dangerous.
word_meanings: भामिनि O Beautiful lady, बहुरूपाः च of various forms too, बहवः many, सरीसृपाः च reptiles also, दर्पात् fiercely, पृथिवीम् on the ground, चरन्ति move about, ततः therefore, वनम् to live in the forest, दुःखतरं is extremely dangerous.

text: नदी निलयनाः सर्पा नदी कुटिल गामिनः । तिष्ठन्ति आवृत्य पन्थानम् अतः दुह्खतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-२०॥
translation: The serpents that live in and move like meandering rivers always obstruct the paths. Therefore, living in the forest is tremendously difficult.
word_meanings: नदी निलयनाः live in rivers, नदीकुटिलगामिनः meandering like rivers, सर्पाः serpents, पन्थानम् the path, आवृत्य having obstructed, तिष्ठन्ति stay, ततः therefore, वनम् life in the forest, दुःखतरम् is full of sufferings.

text: पतम्गा वृश्चिकाः कीटा दम्शाः च मशकैः सह । बाधन्ते नित्यम् अबले सर्वम् दुह्खम् अतः वनम् ॥२-२८-२१॥
translation: Birds, scorpions, insects, gnats and mosquitoes always create trouble. Therefore, life in the forest is all suffering.
word_meanings: पतङ्गा: birds, वृश्चिकाः scorpions, कीटाः insects, मशकैः सह with mosquitoes, दंशाश्च gnats, नित्यम् always, सर्वम् everyone, बाधन्ते trouble, अतः therefore, वनम् the life in forest, दुःखम् is a source of suffering.

text: द्रुमाः कण्टकिनः चैव कुश काशाः च भामिनि । वने व्याकुल शाखा अग्राः तेन दुह्खतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-२२॥
translation: O lovely Sita there are thorny trees with branches on the top interlaced with one another. There are kusa grass and reeds. So forest life is very hard.
word_meanings: भामिनि O lovely Sita, वने in the forest, द्रुमाः trees, कुशा काशाः च kusa grass and reeds, कण्टकिनश्चैव thorny ones, व्याकुलशाखाग्राः with tops of branches interlaced with each other, तेन therefore, वनम् forest life, दुःखतरम् is full of difficulties.

text: कायक्लेशाश्च बहवो भयानि विविधानि च । अरण्यवासे वसतो क्धुःखमेव ततो वनम् ॥२-२८-२३॥
translation: There are various physical afflictions and fears for one who lives in the forest. Therefore, forest brings suffering.
word_meanings: अरण्यवासे living in the forest, वसतः while living, बहवः many, कायक्लेशाः physical afflictions, विविधानि various, भयानि च fears, ततः therefore, वनम् forest, दुःखमेव is full of difficulties only.

text: क्रोधलोभे विमोक्तव्यौ कर्तव्या तपसे मतिः । न भेतव्यम् च भेतव्ये नित्यम् दुःखमतो वनम् ॥२-२८-२४॥
translation: Anger and greed have to be given up, with the mind preoccupied with ascetic practices. One should not be afraid of fearful situations. Hence forest (life) always very hard.
word_meanings: क्रोधलोभौ anger and greed, विमोक्तव्यौ should be given up, तपसे in asceticism, मतिः mind, कर्तव्या must be fixed, भेतव्ये even in alarming situations, न भेतव्यम् one should not be afraid, अतः therefore, वनम् life in the forest, नित्यम् always, दुःखम् full of misery.

text: तत् अलम् ते वनम् गत्वा क्षमम् न हि वनम् तव । विमृशन्न् इह पश्यामि बहु दोषतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-२५॥
translation: Thus forest life is not suitable for you. On reconsideration, I see that there are many dangers in forest life.
word_meanings: तत् for that reason, ते to you, वनम् to the forest, गत्वा going, अलम् is not desirable, तव for you, वनम् forest life, क्षमम् न हि is not fit, इह now, विमृशन् while reconsidering, वनम् forest life, बहुदोषतरम् is full of great dangers, पश्यामि I see.

text: वनम् तु नेतुम् न कृता मतिस् तदा । बभूव रामेण यदा महात्मना । न तस्य सीता वचनम् चकार तत् । ततः अब्रवीद् रामम् इदम् सुदुह्खिता ॥२-२८-२६॥
translation: When the great Rama decided not to take her along with him to the forest, Sita, deeply grieved said these words. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टाविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyeighth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: महात्मना by the great, रामेण by Rama, यदा when, वनम् to the forest, नेतुम् to take, मतिः mind (decision), कृता has been made, न बभूव did not happen, तदा then, सीता Sita, तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं words, न चकार did not follow, ततः threafter, सुदुःखिता deeply grieved, रामम् to Rama, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा सीता रामस्य दुह्खिता । प्रसक्त अश्रु मुखी मन्दम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-२९-१॥
translation: Having heard the words of Rama, thus spoke Sita in a faint voice in sadness, with tears flowing incessantly from her eyes:
word_meanings: सीता Sita, रामस्य Rama's, एतत् these, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, दुःखिता sad, प्रसक्ताश्रुमुखी with tears flowing incessantly from her face, मन्दम् in a faint voice, इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: ये त्वया कीर्तिता दोषा वने वस्तव्यताम् प्रति । गुणान् इति एव तान् विद्धि तव स्नेह पुरः कृतान् ॥२-२९-२॥
translation: Understand that the difficulties of forest life described by you will be turned into advantages if they are accompanied by your affection.
word_meanings: वने in the forest, वस्तव्यतां प्रति about dwelling in the forest, त्वया by you, ये those, दोषाः difficulties, कीर्तिताः described, तव your, स्नेहपुरस्कृतान् accompanied by your affection, तान् them, गुणानित्येव as virtues only, विद्धि understand.

text: मृगाः सिम्हा गजाश्चैव शार्दूलाः शरभास्तथा । पक्षिणः सृमराश्चैव ये चान्ये वनचारिणः ॥२-२९-३॥
translation: O scion of the Raghu race antelopes, lions, elephants, tigers, sarabhas, birds, srimaras and other wild beasts wandering in the forest have not seen your beauty before. Now on seeing you, they will flee away. In fact, who will not be afraid of seeing an object of fear?.
word_meanings: राघव Rama, मृगाः antelopes, सिंहाः lions, गजाश्चैव elephants also, शार्दूला: tigers, तथा also, शरभाः sarabhas (a fabulous deer said to have eight legs), पक्षिणः birds, सृमराश्चैव srimaras (a kind of deer), अन्ये other, ये all, वनचारिणः wild beasts wandering in the forest, ते सर्वे all those, तव your, अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात् which had not been seen by you before, रूपम् your appearance, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing alone, अपसर्पेयुः will flee away, भये when fear arises, सर्वे all, बिभ्यति हि are afraid of.

text: अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात्सर्वे ते तव राघव । रूपम् दृष्ट्वापसर्पेयुर्भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति ॥२-२९-४॥
translation: O scion of the Raghu race antelopes, lions, elephants, tigers, sarabhas, birds, srimaras and other wild beasts wandering in the forest have not seen your beauty before. Now on seeing you, they will flee away. In fact, who will not be afraid of seeing an object of fear?.
word_meanings: राघव Rama, मृगाः antelopes, सिंहाः lions, गजाश्चैव elephants also, शार्दूला: tigers, तथा also, शरभाः sarabhas (a fabulous deer said to have eight legs), पक्षिणः birds, सृमराश्चैव srimaras (a kind of deer), अन्ये other, ये all, वनचारिणः wild beasts wandering in the forest, ते सर्वे all those, तव your, अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात् which had not been seen by you before, रूपम् your appearance, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing alone, अपसर्पेयुः will flee away, भये when fear arises, सर्वे all, बिभ्यति हि are afraid of.

text: त्वया च सह गन्तव्यम् मया गुरु जन आज्ञया । त्वद् वियोगेन मे राम त्यक्तव्यम् इह जीवितम् ॥२-२९-५॥
translation: In accordance with the command of the elders, I must accompany you to the forest. If I am separated from you, I will give up my life here itself.
word_meanings: गुरुजनाज्ञया with the command of elders, त्वया सह along with you, मया च गन्तव्यम् I should follow, राम Rama, त्वद्वियोगेन if separated from you, मे my, जीवितम् life, इह here, त्यक्तव्यम् will have to be given up.

text: न च माम् त्वत् समीपस्थम् अपि शक्नोति राघव । सुराणाम् ईश्वरः शक्रः प्रधर्षयितुम् ओजसा ॥२-२९-६॥
translation: If I am in your company, O Rama even the lord of the gods, Indra with all his might will not be able to hurt me.
word_meanings: राघव O Rama, त्वत्समीवस्थाम् in your company, माम् me, सुराणाम् for gods, ईश्वरः lord, शक्र: अपि even Indra, ओजसा with his might, प्रधर्षयितुम् to injure, न शक्नोति will not be able

text: पति हीना तु या नारी न सा शक्ष्यति जीवितुम् । कामम् एवम् विधम् राम त्वया मम विदर्शितम् ॥२-२९-७॥
translation: Your salutary instruction to me, O Rama, is 'A woman cannot live without her husband'. This truth is greatly applicable to me.
word_meanings: या नारी a woman, पतिहीना without her husband, सा she, जीवितुम् to live, न शक्ष्यति cannot live, राम Rama, त्वया by you, कामम् greatly, एवं विधम् in this manner, मम to me, निदर्शितम् has been illustrated.

text: अथ च अपि महा प्राज्ञ ब्राह्मणानाम् मया श्रुतम् । पुरा पितृ गृहे सत्यम् वस्तव्यम् किल मे वने ॥२-२९-८॥
translation: O highly sagacious Rama I had also heard in my father's house long ago, from brahmins prophesing that some day I shall have certainly to dwell in the forest.
word_meanings: महाप्राज्ञ O Sagacious one, अथ चापि moreover, पुरा formerly, पितृगृहे at my father's house, मया by me, ब्राह्माणानाम् brahmins' (word), श्रुतम् has been heard, मे about me, सत्यम् in sooth, वने in the forest, वस्तव्यं किल to dwell certainly.

text: लक्षणिभ्यो द्विजातिभ्यः श्रुत्वा अहम् वचनम् गृहे । वन वास कृत उत्साहा नित्यम् एव महा बल ॥२-२९-९॥
translation: O mighty hero ever since I heard the prophesies from the brahmin palmists I am yearning to dwell in the forest.
word_meanings: महाबल O mighty one, अहम् I, पुरा long ago, लक्षणिभ्यः from palmist, द्विजातिभ्यः from brahmins, वचनम् words, शृत्वा having heard, नित्यमेव always, वनवासकृतोत्साहा I have become eager to dwell in the forest.

text: आदेशो वन वासस्य प्राप्तव्यः स मया किल । सा त्वया सह तत्र अहम् यास्यामि प्रिय न अन्यथा ॥२-२९-१०॥
translation: Therefore, O my beloved I must certainly obtain such a command to dwell in the forest. I must accompany you to the forest and it cannot be otherwise.
word_meanings: प्रिय O beloved Rama, मया by me, वनवासस्य to dwell in the forest, सः आदेशः such orders, प्राप्तव्यः किल certainly needs to be obtained, सा अहम् such I am, त्वया सह along with you, तत्र there, यास्यामि I shall accompany, अन्यथा न not otherwise.

text: कृत आदेशा भविष्यामि गमिष्यामि सह त्वया । कालः च अयम् समुत्पन्नः सत्य वाग् भवतु द्विजः ॥२-२९-११॥
translation: I will go with you, true to the prediction of the brahmin. That time has come and let his prediction come to pass.
word_meanings: कृतादेशा carrying out the orders, भविष्यामि I shall become, त्वया सह along with you, गमिष्यामि shall go, अयम् this, कालश्च time, समुत्पन्नः has come, द्विज: brahmin, सत्यवाक् true to his words, भवतु let him be.

text: वन वासे हि जानामि दुह्खानि बहुधा किल । प्राप्यन्ते नियतम् वीर पुरुषैः अकृत आत्मभिः ॥२-२९-१२॥
translation: I am aware, O valiant one, that there are hardships of every kind in forest life. But they befall those whose senses are not under their control.
word_meanings: वीर O valiant one, वनवासे while residing in the forest, दुःखानि hardships, बहुथा किल certainly of every kind, अभिजानामि I am aware, अकृतात्मभिः by those whose senses are not under their control, पुरुषैः by men, नियतम् definitely, प्राप्यन्ते will be experienced.

text: कन्यया च पितुर् गेहे वन वासः श्रुतः मयाभिक्षिण्याः साधु वृत्ताया मम मातुर् इह अग्रतः ॥२-२९-१३॥
translation: When I was young in my father's house, a holy female mendicant foretold in the presence of my mother that I would dwell in the forest (in this life).
word_meanings: पितुः father's, गेहे in the house, कन्यया when I was young, मया by me, मम मातुः my mother's, अग्रतः in the presence, साधुवृत्तायाः a saint, भिक्षिण्या a female mendicant, इह in this world, वनवासः forest life, श्रुतः heard.

text: प्रसादितः च वै पूर्वम् त्वम् वै बहु विधम् प्रभो । गमनम् वन वासस्य कान्क्षितम् हि सह त्वया ॥२-२९-१४॥
translation: Pleased with my long entreaties in the past to dwell with you in the forest, O lord, you had granted my desire.
word_meanings: प्रभो O Lord, पूर्वम् in the past, त्वम् you, बहुतिथम् for a long time, मे for me, प्रसादितश्च वै favoured, त्वया सह along with you, वनवासस्य गमनम् to go to the forest, काङ्क्षितं हि is wished for.

text: कृत क्षणा अहम् भद्रम् ते गमनम् प्रति राघव । वन वासस्य शूरस्य चर्या हि मम रोचते ॥२-२९-१५॥
translation: Since then I have been counting time for this forest life. It pleases me to follow my valiant hero as he lives in the forest. Rama, prosperity to you
word_meanings: राघव Rama, ते to you, वनवासस्य of forest life, गमनं प्रति about departure, अहम् I, कृतक्षणा counting time, ते भद्रम् prosperity to you, शूरस्य of a valiant one, चर्या movement, मम to me, रोचते हि is pleasing.

text: शुद्ध आत्मन् प्रेम भावाद्द् हि भविष्यामि विकल्मषा । भर्तारम् अनुगच्चन्ती भर्ता हि मम दैवतम् ॥२-२९-१६॥
translation: O my purehearted one by following my husband with love I shall become sinless, because my husband is my god.
word_meanings: शुद्धात्मन् O purehearted one, प्रेमभावात् with feeling of love, भर्तारम् husband, अनुगच्छन्ती following, विकल्मषा sinless, भविष्यामि I shall become, भर्ता husband, मम to me, दैवतं हि is a god.

text: प्रेत्य भावे अपि कल्याणः सम्गमः मे सह त्वया । श्रुतिर् हि श्रूयते पुण्या ब्राह्मणानाम् यशस्विनाम् ॥२-२९-१७॥
translation: My union with you, O highminded one, is auspicious even beyond death. A woman, given away by her parents in accordance with traditional offerings of water belongs to him even after death and lives with him. This is a statement from the Vedas quoted by famous brahmins.
word_meanings: प्रेत्यभावेऽपि even after death, त्वया सह with you, मे to me, कल्याणः auspiciousness, सङ्गमः union, यशस्विनाम् by the famous, ब्राह्मणानाम् brahmins', पुण्या pious, श्रुतिः statement from the Vedas, श्रूयते is heard, महामते O highminded one, या स्त्री that woman, इह लोके in this world, पितृभिः by parents, यस्य to whom, स्वधर्मेण in accordance with one's own tradition, अद्भि: with waters, दत्ता is given, प्रेत्यभावेऽपि even after death, सा she, तस्य belongs to him.

text: इह लोके च पितृभिर् या स्त्री यस्य महा मते । अद्भिर् दत्ता स्वधर्मेण प्रेत्य भावे अपि तस्य सा ॥२-२९-१८॥
translation: My union with you, O highminded one, is auspicious even beyond death. A woman, given away by her parents in accordance with traditional offerings of water belongs to him even after death and lives with him. This is a statement from the Vedas quoted by famous brahmins.
word_meanings: प्रेत्यभावेऽपि even after death, त्वया सह with you, मे to me, कल्याणः auspiciousness, सङ्गमः union, यशस्विनाम् by the famous, ब्राह्मणानाम् brahmins', पुण्या pious, श्रुतिः statement from the Vedas, श्रूयते is heard, महामते O highminded one, या स्त्री that woman, इह लोके in this world, पितृभिः by parents, यस्य to whom, स्वधर्मेण in accordance with one's own tradition, अद्भि: with waters, दत्ता is given, प्रेत्यभावेऽपि even after death, सा she, तस्य belongs to him.

text: एवम् अस्मात् स्वकाम् नारीम् सुवृत्ताम् हि पति व्रताम् । न अभिरोचयसे नेतुम् त्वम् माम् केन इह हेतुना ॥२-२९-१९॥
translation: Why don't you want to take to the forest your own wife who is loyal and devoted, and is of good conduct.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, केन हेतुना for what reason, इह now, एवम् this way, सुवृत्ताम् a woman of good conduct, पतिव्रताम् faithful and loyal wife, स्वकां नारीम् your own woman, माम् me, अस्मात् from this place, नेतुम् to take, नाभिरोचयसे you are not willing.

text: भक्ताम् पति व्रताम् दीनाम् माम् समाम् सुख दुह्खयोह् । नेतुम् अर्हसि काकुत्स्थ समान सुख दुह्खिनीम् ॥२-२९-२०॥
translation: O Rama, I am faithful and devoted to you. I have equal disposition to happiness and sorrow. I equally share your prosperity and adversity. Therefore, you should take your wife (to the forest). In this time of distress.
word_meanings: काकुत्थ्स O descendant of Kakutstha, भक्ताम् devotee, पतिव्रताम् faithful to the husband, दीनां distressed, सुखदुःखयोः in happines and sorrow, समाम् having equal disposition, समान सुख दुःखिनीम् equally share your prosperity and adversity, माम् me, नेतुम् अर्हसि should take.

text: यदि माम् दुह्खिताम् एवम् वनम् नेतुम् न च इच्चसि । विषम् अग्निम् जलम् वा अहम् आस्थास्ये मृत्यु कारणात् ॥२-२९-२१॥
translation: If you do not wish to take your wife in this time of distress to the forest I shall die by consuming poison or throwing myself into fire or drowning in water.
word_meanings: एवम् in this, दुःखिताम् distressed, माम् me, वनम् to the forest, नेतुम् to take, न च इच्छसि यदि if you do not wish, मृत्युकारणात् to seek death, विषम् poison, अग्निम् fire, जलं वा or water, आस्थास्ये I shall take refuge.

text: एवम् बहु विधम् तम् सा याचते गमनम् प्रति । न अनुमेने महा बाहुस् ताम् नेतुम् विजनम् वनम् ॥२-२९-२२॥
translation: Despite Sita's pleadings with him in various ways the mightyarmed Rama would not consent to take her to the desolate forest.
word_meanings: एवम् in this way, सा she, गमनं प्रति about her departure, बहुविधम् in several ways, तम् him, याचते requested, महाबाहुः mightyarmed Rama, ताम् her, विजनम् desolate, वनम् forest, नेतुम् to take, नानुमेने did not consent.

text: एवम् उक्ता तु सा चिन्ताम् मैथिली समुपागता । स्नापयन्ती इव गाम् उष्णैः अश्रुभिर् नयन च्युतैः ॥२-२९-२३॥
translation: Thus spoken to (prevented), Sita was filled with grief and cried, drenching the ground with warm tears that fell from her eyes.
word_meanings: एवम् in this way, उक्ता spoken, सा मैथिली that daughter from Mithila, नयनच्युतैः fallen from her eyes, उष्णैः by warm, अश्रुभिः tears, गाम् the ground, स्नापयन्तीव as if drenching, चिन्ताम् grief, समुपागता obtained.

text: चिन्तयन्तीम् तथा ताम् तु निवर्तयितुम् आत्मवान् । ताम्रोष्ठीं स तदा सीताम् काकुत्स्थो बह्व् असान्त्वयत् ॥२-२९-२४॥
translation: That selfpossessed scion of the Kakutstha dynasty consoled the copperredlipped Sita in several ways to dissuade her (from going to the forest). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyninth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: आत्मवान् selfpossessed, सः काकुत्स्थ: that scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, तथा that way, चिन्तयन्तीम् grieving, ताम्रोष्ठीम् to the lady with copperred lips, तां सीताम् to that Sita, तदा then, निवर्तयितम् to dissuade her (from going to the forest), बहु many ways, असान्त्वयत् consoled.

text: सान्त्व्यमाना तु रामेण मैथिली जनक आत्मजा । वन वास निमित्ताय भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-३०-१॥
translation: In response to Rama's consolation with regard to her stay in the forest, the daughter of Janaka, Maithili (Sita) said:
word_meanings: वनवासनिमित्ताय for stay in forest, रामेण by Rama, सान्त्व्यमाना consoled, जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, मैथिली Maithili, भर्तारम् to husband, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: सा तम् उत्तम सम्विग्ना सीता विपुल वक्षसम् । प्रणयाच् च अभिमानाच् च परिचिक्षेप राघवम् ॥२-३०-२॥
translation: Sita agitated over a supreme cause upbraided the broadchested scion of the Raghu race out of love and injured selfrespect.
word_meanings: उत्तमसंविग्ना agitated for a supreme cause, सा सीता that Sita, विपुल वक्षसम् man of broadchested, राघवम् scion of the Raghu dynasty, प्रणयात् out of love, अभिमानाच्च injured selfrespect, परिचिक्षेप blamed.

text: किम् त्वा अमन्यत वैदेहः पिता मे मिथिला अधिपः । राम जामातरम् प्राप्य स्त्रियम् पुरुष विग्रहम् ॥२-३०-३॥
translation: O Rama while accepting you as soninlaw did my father, king of Mithila and lord of Videha ever think that you are a woman in the guise of a man?
word_meanings: राम O Rama, पुरुषविग्रहम् in the form of a man, स्त्रियम् a woman, त्वा you, जामातरम् as soninlaw, प्राप्य having obtained, मिथिलाधिपः king of Mithila, वैदेहः lord of Videha, मे पिता my father, किम् what, अमन्यत thought of.

text: अनृतम् बल लोको अयम् अज्ञानात् यद्द् हि वक्ष्यति । तेजो न अस्ति परम् रामे तपति इव दिवा करे ॥२-३०-४॥
translation: Alas that will be a falschood if people out of ignorance say that there is no supreme splendour in Rama like the shining Sun.
word_meanings: तपति in a blazing, दिवाकरे इव like in the Sun, रामे in Rama, परम् great, तेजः splendour, नास्ति is not to be found, अयं लोकः this world, अज्ञानात् out of ignorance, वक्ष्यति यदि if they say so, then that one, अनृतम् is a falsehood, बत alas

text: किम् हि कृत्वा विषण्णः त्वम् कुतः वा भयम् अस्ति ते । यत् परित्यक्तु कामः त्वम् माम् अनन्य परायणाम् ॥२-३०-५॥
translation: What may be the cause for your fear and depression behind your desire to desert one who is so exclusively devoted to you?
word_meanings: त्वम् you, अनन्यपरायणाम् with none else as her refuge, माम् me, परित्यक्तुकामः (इति) यत् that you want to desert, त्वम् you, किं हि कृत्वा for what reason, विषण्णः depressed, ते to you, कुतः वा from where, भयम् fear, अस्ति exists.

text: द्युमत्सेन सुतम् वीर सत्यवन्तम् अनुव्रताम् । सावित्रीम् इव माम् विद्धि त्वम् आत्म वश वर्तिनीम् ॥२-३०-६॥
translation: Know, O valiant one, that by remaining subordinate to you, I am as faithful to you as Savitri was to her husband, Satyavanta, son of Dyumatsena.
word_meanings: वीर O valiant one, माम् me, द्युमत्सेन सुतम् son of Dyumatsena, सत्यवन्तम् Satyavanta, अनुव्रताम् faithfully following, सावित्रीमिव like Savitri, आत्मवशवर्तिनीम् remaining under your subordination, विद्धि know.

text: न तु अहम् मनसा अपि अन्यम् द्रष्टा अस्मि त्वद् ऋते अनघ । त्वया राघव गच्चेयम् यथा अन्या कुल पाम्सनी ॥२-३०-७॥
translation: O sinless son of the Raghus I am not like other women who bring disgreace to the family. I have not looked at any one except you, even with my mind's eye. I will go (to the forest) along with you.
word_meanings: अनघ O sinless one, राघव Rama, कुलपांसनी a woman who bring disgrace to the family, अन्या यथा like any other ordinary woman, अहम् I, त्वदृते except you, अन्यम् other one, मनसापि even in mind, न द्रष्टास्मि not see, त्वया with you, गच्चेयम् I shall go to the forest.

text: स्वयम् तु भार्याम् कौमारीम् चिरम् अध्युषिताम् सतीम् । शैलूषैव माम् राम परेभ्यो दातुम् इच्चसि ॥२-३०-८॥
translation: I have been living with you for a long time, O Rama I am young and chaste. Why do you, like an actor, wish to hand me over to others.
word_meanings: राम O Rama कौमारीम् young, चिरम् for a long time, अध्युषिताम् living with you, सतीम् chaste, भार्याम् wife, माम् me, शैलूषः इव like an actor, स्वयम् on your own accord, परेभ्यः to others, दातुम् to give, इच्छसि wish.

text: यस्य पथ्यम् च रामात्थ यस्य चार्थेऽवरुध्यसे । त्वम् तस्य भव वश्यश्च विधेयश्छ सदानघ ॥२-३०-९॥
translation: You, O sinless Rama, may become subservient and obedient to them about whose wellfare you are speaking of and on account of whom you are preventing me to go (along with you).
word_meanings: अनघ O sinless, राम O Rama यस्य whose, पथ्यम् welfare, आत्थ are speaking, यस्य च अर्थे on account of whom, अवरुध्यसे you are preventing me, त्वम् you, तस्य for him, सदा always, वश्यः च subservient, विधेयः च also obedient, भव shall be.

text: स माम् अनादाय वनम् न त्वम् प्रस्थातुम् अर्हसि । तपो वा यदि वा अरण्यम् स्वर्गो वा स्यात् सह त्वया ॥२-३०-१०॥
translation: You should not depart for the forest without taking me. Be it for penance or for the forest or for heaven, I wish to be with you.
word_meanings: सः त्वम् such as you, माम् me, अनादाय without taking me, वनम् to the forest, प्रस्थातुम् to set forth, नार्हसि it does not behove you, तपो वा either for penance, यदि वा or, अरण्यम् to forest, स्वर्गो वा or to heaven, मे me, त्वया सह स्यात् to be with you.

text: न च मे भविता तत्र कश्चित् पथि परिश्रमः । पृष्ठतः तव गच्चन्त्या विहार शयनेष्व् अपि ॥२-३०-११॥
translation: While following you, I will feel no fatigue there on the way as if I am going on a pleasurestroll or in a comfortable couch.
word_meanings: तव your, पृष्ठतः behind, गच्छन्त्याः going, मे to me, तत्र there, पथि on the way, विहारशयनेष्विव on a pleasure stroll or in a (luxurious) couch, कश्चित् even a little, परिश्रमः strain, न भविता will not be.

text: कुश काश शर इषीका ये च कण्टकिनो द्रुमाः । तूल अजिन सम स्पर्शा मार्गे मम सह त्वया ॥२-३०-१२॥
translation: The white reeds, the kusha, the sara and the ishika grasses and thorny trees on the way will feel as soft as cotton or as the skin of a black antelope.
word_meanings: त्वया सह along with you, मार्गे on the way, कुशकाशशरेषीकाः Kusha, white reeds, Sara and Ishika grasses, कण्टकिनः thorny, ये द्रुमाः च other trees, तूलाजिन समस्पर्शाः shall feel like the touch of cotton and the skin of a black antelope.

text: महा वात समुद्धूतम् यन् माम् अवकरिष्यति । रजो रमण तन् मन्ये पर अर्ध्यम् इव चन्दनम् ॥२-३०-१३॥
translation: I shall regard, O charming Rama, the harmful dust raised by the stormy wind and settled on me as the most excellent sandal powder.
word_meanings: रमण O Charming one महावातसमुद्धूतम् raised by the stormy wind, यत् which, रजः dust, माम् me, अपकरिष्यति will harm, तत् that one, परार्थ्यम् most excellent, चन्दनम् इव like sandal powder, मन्ये shall consider.

text: शाद्वलेषु यद् आसिष्ये वन अन्ते वन गोरचा । कुथा आस्तरण तल्पेषु किम् स्यात् सुखतरम् ततः ॥२-३०-१४॥
translation: O rover of the forest I will feel happier when I sleep on the meadows (of tender green grass) on the outskirts of the forest than when I sleep on the couch spread with carpets.
word_meanings: वनगोचर Rover of the forest, वनान्ते on the outskirts of the forest, शाद्वलेषु on the meadows (of tender green grass), यथा as, शिश्ये I will lie down, ततः more than that, कुथास्तरणतल्पेषु in the couch spread with carpets, सुखतरम् more comfortable, स्यात्किम् what shall be?

text: पत्रम् मूलम् फलम् यत् त्वम् अल्पम् वा यदि वा बहु । दास्यसि स्वयम् आहृत्य तन् मे अमृत रस उपमम् ॥२-३०-१५॥
translation: Whatever leaves or roots or fruits you collect with your own hands for me little or much, they will be nectar to me.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, यत् whichever, पत्रम् leaf, मूलम् root, फलम् fruit, अल्पं वा even a little, यदि वा or, बहु much, स्वयम् on your own, आहृत्य having collected, दास्यसि you will give me, तत् that one, मे to me, अमृतरसोपमम् like nectar, (भवेत् shall become).

text: न मातुर् न पितुस् तत्र स्मरिष्यामि न वेश्मनः । आर्तवानि उपभुन्जाना पुष्पाणि च फलानि च ॥२-३०-१६॥
translation: Enjoying the seasonal flowers and fruits in the forest, I will not remember my mother or father or home.
word_meanings: तत्र there, आर्तवानि seasonal, पुष्पाणि flowers, फलानि च also fruits, उपभुञ्जाना while enjoying, मातुः mother, न स्मरिष्यामि will not remember, पितुः न not about father, वेश्मनः about home, न will not.

text: न च तत्र गतः किम्चित् द्रष्टुम् अर्हसि विप्रियम् । मत् कृते न च ते शोको न भविष्यामि दुर्भरा ॥२-३०-१७॥
translation: Therefore, you should not anticipate any problem from me in the forest. Neither shall I be burdensome to you nor shall I make you experience any sorrow on my account.
word_meanings: ततः for that reason, तत्र there, किञ्चित् even a little, विप्रियम् unpleasant, द्रष्टुम् to see, नार्हसि does not behove you, मत्कृते on my account, ते to you, शोकः sorrow, न will not come, दुर्भरा burden, न भविष्यामि I will not be.

text: यः त्वया सह स स्वर्गो निरयो यः त्वया विना । इति जानन् पराम् प्रीतिम् गच्च राम मया सह ॥२-३०-१८॥
translation: Wherever I be with you is heaven and without, hell. O Rama, recognise this truth, and derive great pleasure in my company.
word_meanings: त्वया सह in your company, यः that which is obtained, सः that alone, स्वर्गः is heaven, त्वया विना without you, निरयः is hell, इति thus, जानन् while being aware, राम Rama, मया सह along with me, पराम् great, प्रीतिम् pleasure, गच्छ obtain.

text: अथ माम् एवम् अव्यग्राम् वनम् न एव नयिष्यसि । विषम् अद्य एव पास्यामि मा विशम् द्विषताम् वशम् ॥२-३०-१९॥
translation: If you do not take me to the forest without the least hesitation I shall consume poison right now, but not live under the control of enemies (at Ayodhya).
word_meanings: अथ otherwise, एवम् in this way, अव्यग्राम् with unhesitant disposition, माम् me, वनम् to the forest, नैव नयिष्यति यदि if you do not at all take, अद्यैव rightaway, विषम् poison, पास्यामि will drink, द्विषताम् enemies', वशम् in the company of, मा गमम् not go.

text: पश्चात् अपि हि दुह्खेन मम न एव अस्ति जीवितम् । उज्झितायाः त्वया नाथ तदा एव मरणम् वरम् ॥२-३०-२०॥
translation: If forsaken, O Lord I shall not live a life of sorrow. Instant death is better (than abandoned existence).
word_meanings: नाथ O Lord, त्वया by you, उज्झितायाः of an abandoned lady, मम to me, पश्चादपि even afterwards, दुःखेन through grief, जीवितम् life, नैवास्ति will not be there, तदैव than abandonment, मरणम् death, वरम् is better.

text: इदम् हि सहितुम् शोकम् मुहूर्तम् अपि न उत्सहे । किम् पुनर् दश वर्षाणि त्रीणि च एकम् च दुह्खिता ॥२-३०-२१॥
translation: I cannot bear this grief even for a moment, what to speak of fourteen (ten and three and one) years of grieving.
word_meanings: इमम् this, शोकम् grief, मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, सहितुम् to endure, नोत्सहे will not agree, दश ten, त्रीणि three, एकं च one, वर्षाणि years, दुःखिता a grieving woman, किं पुनः what to say again?

text: इति सा शोक सम्तप्ता विलप्य करुणम् बहु । चुक्रोश पतिम् आयस्ता भृशम् आलिन्ग्य सस्वरम् ॥२-३०-२२॥
translation: Tormented with grief, Sita piteously and profusely lamented, and then exhausted, embraced her husband tightly and cried bitterly.
word_meanings: सा that Sita, शोकसन्तप्ता tormented with grief, आयस्ता exhausted, इति thus, करुणम् piteously, बहु profusely, विलप्य lamenting, पतिम् husband, आलिङ्ग्य embracing, सस्वरम् with loud voice, भृशम् tightly, चुक्रोश cried.

text: सा विद्धा बहुभिर् वाक्यैः दिग्धैः इव गज अन्गना । चिर सम्नियतम् बाष्पम् मुमोच अग्निम् इव अरणिः ॥२-३०-२३॥
translation: Pierced by so many words (of objection from Rama), Sita felt like a cowelephant penetrated by poisonsmeared arrrows. And shed her longsuppressed tears like arani (a firekindling stick) kindling fire.
word_meanings: दिग्धै: arrows smeared with poison, गजाङ्गना इव like a cowelephant, सा she, बहुभिः many, वाक्यैः with words, विद्धा was pierled, चिरसन्नियतम् longsuppressed, बाष्पम् tears, आरणिः अग्निमिव like fire produced by arani (a firekindling stick), मुमोच released.

text: तस्याः स्फटिक सम्काशम् वारि सम्ताप सम्भवम् । नेत्राभ्याम् परिसुस्राव पन्कजाभ्याम् इव उदकम् ॥२-३०-२४॥
translation: Crystallike tears arising out of distress flowed from her eyes like water trickling from two lotuses.
word_meanings: तस्याः her, नेत्राभ्याम् from the eyes, सन्तापसम्भवम् arising out of distress, स्फटिक सङ्काशम् like crystal, वारि water, पङ्कजाभ्याम् from two lotuses, उदकमिव like water, परिसुस्राव flowed.

text: तच्चैवामलचन्ध्रभम् मुखमायतलोचनम् । पर्यशुष्यत बाष्पेण जलोद्धृतमिवामुबुजम् ॥२-३०-२५॥
translation: Her face with large eyes assumed the brightness of an immaculate Moon and withered with tears like a lotus plucked out of water.
word_meanings: अमलचन्द्राभम् possessing the brightness of the stainless Moon, आयतलोचनम् having large eyes, तत् that, मुखंचैव from the face, जलोद्धृतम् plucked from water, अम्बुजमिव like a lotus, बाष्पेण with tears, पर्यशुष्यत withered.

text: ताम् परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्याम् विसम्ज्ञाम् इव दुह्खिताम् । उवाच वचनम् रामः परिविश्वासयम्स् तदा ॥२-३०-२६॥
translation: With his arms Rama embraced Sita who had almost fainted in grief. And in order to create confidence in her he said these words:
word_meanings: तदा then, रामः Rama, दुःखिताम् in grief, विसंज्ञामिव as if fainted, ताम् her, बाहुभ्याम् with arms, परिष्वज्य having embraced, परिविश्वासयन् creating her confidence, वचनम् words, उवाच said.

text: न देवि तव दुह्खेन स्वर्गम् अपि अभिरोचये । न हि मे अस्ति भयम् किम्चित् स्वयम्भोर् इव सर्वतः ॥२-३०-२७॥
translation: When you are in grief O Devi I do not desire even heaven. Like the selfcreated Brahma, I have no fear for any one.
word_meanings: देवि O Devi, तव your, दुःखेन with grief, स्वर्गमपि even heaven, न अभिरोचये I do not desire, मे to me, स्वयम्भोरिव like selfcreated Brahma, सर्वतः from everything, किञ्चित् even a little, भयम् fear, नास्ति हि is not there.

text: तव सर्वम् अभिप्रायम् अविज्ञाय शुभ आनने । वासम् न रोचये अरण्ये शक्तिमान् अपि रक्षणे ॥२-३०-२८॥
translation: O Sita of auspicious countenance even though I am capable of protecting you I did not like your stay in the forest as I did not know your intentions.
word_meanings: शुभानने O one possessing auspicious countenance, रक्षणे in protecting you, शक्तिमानपि even though powerful, तव your, सर्वम् fully, अभिप्रायम् intention, अविज्ञाय without knowing, अरण्ये in the forest, वासम् your residing, न रोचये do not like.

text: यत् सृष्टा असि मया सार्धम् वन वासाय मैथिलि । न विहातुम् मया शक्या कीर्तिर् आत्मवता यथा ॥२-३०-२९॥
translation: Since you, O daughter of Mithila, were born to go along with me to the forest, I cannot abandon you just as a selfrespecting man cannot forsake his reputation.
word_meanings: मैथिलि O daughter of Mithila (Sita), यत् since, मयासार्धम् along with me, वनवासाय for living in the forest, सृष्टासि created, आत्मवता by selfrespecting, कीर्तिर्यथा like reputation, मया by me, विहातुम् to abandon, न शक्या is not possible.

text: धर्मः तु गज नास ऊरु सद्भिर् आचरितः पुरा । तम् च अहम् अनुवर्ते अद्य यथा सूर्यम् सुवर्चला ॥२-३०-३०॥
translation: O one with (shapely) thighs like the trunk of an elephant follow only the path of righteousness practised earlier by the virtuous as Suvarchala follows the Sun.
word_meanings: गजनासोरु O Lady with thighs like the trunk of an elephant, धर्मः righteousness, पुरा formerly, सद्भिः by virtuous men, आचरितः is practised, सुवर्चला wife of Sun (Suvarchala), सूर्यं यथा like Sun, तम् that righteousness, अहम् I, अद्य now, अनुवर्ते shall follow.

text: न खल्वहम् न गच्छेयम् वनम् जनकनन्दिनि । वचनम् त्न्नयति माम् पितुः सत्योपबृंहितम् ॥२-३०-३१॥
translation: Not that I shall not go to the forest (go I must). My father's word nourished by truth is leading me there, O daughter of Janaka
word_meanings: जनकनन्दिनि O daughter of Janaka, अहम् I, वनम् to the forest, न खलु न गच्छेयम् it is not that I shall not go, पितुः father's, सत्योपबृंहितम् nourished by truth, तत् वचनं that word, माम् me, नयति is leading.

text: एष धर्मः तु सुश्रोणि पितुर् मातुः च वश्यता । अतः च आज्ञाम् व्यतिक्रम्य न अहम् जीवितुम् उत्सहे ॥२-३०-३२॥
translation: Obedience to parents is a righteous act. Therefore, O one with fair hips I cannot live and disobey the word of truth.
word_meanings: सुश्रोणि O one with beautiful posteriors, पितुः of father, मातुश्च of mother, वश्यता in obedience, एषः this one, धर्मस्तु is a righteous act, अतश्च for that reason, तम् that (word of truth), व्यतिक्रम्य disobeying, अहम् I, जीवितुम् to live, न उत्सहे do not wish.

text: अस्वाधीनम् कथम् दैवम् प्रकारैरभिराध्यते । स्वाधीनम् समतिक्रम्य मातरम् पितरम् गुरुम् ॥२-३०-३३॥
translation: Mother, father and preceptor are present before us. By overstepping them, how can we, in various ways, worship God who is beyond reach (not visible)?
word_meanings: स्वाधीनम् within our reach, मातरम् mother, पितरम् father, गुरुम् preceptor, समतिक्रम्य over stepping, अस्वाधीनम् beyond reach, दैवम् God, प्रकारैः in various ways, कथम् how, अभिराध्यते is worshipped?

text: यत्त्रयम् तत्त्रयो लोकाः पवित्रम् तत्समम् भुवि । नान्यदस्ति शुभापाङ्गे तेनेदमभिराध्यते ॥२-३०-३४॥
translation: Where these three(mother,father and preceptor) equal to the three worlds are, O one with loverly sideglances, there is none in this world as holy. Therefore, they are to be worshipped.
word_meanings: शुभापाङ्गे O one having lovely side glances, यत्र which, त्रयम् all the three (father, mother and preceptor), तत्र that, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, तत्समम् equal to those three, पवित्रम् अन्यत् any other holy thing, लोके in the world, नास्ति none, तेन therefore, इदम् this, अभिराध्यते is worshipped.

text: न सत्यम् दानमानौ वा न यज्ञाश्चाप्तदक्षिणाः । तथा बलकराः सीते यथा सेवा पितुर्मता ॥२-३०-३५॥
translation: Truth or munificence or homage or distribution of gifts to the revered ones or sacrifices, O Sita, are not considered as efficacious as service to father.
word_meanings: सीते O Sita, पितुः of father, सेवा service, यथा as, हिता salutary, तथा so, सत्यम् truth, न not, दानमानौ charity, honour, न not, आप्तदक्षिणाः gifts for the revered ones, यज्ञाःच sacrifices, बलकराः न not strengthening.

text: स्वर्गो धनम् वा धान्यम् वा विद्याः पुत्राः सुखानि च । गुरुवृत्त्यनुरोधेन न किम्चित्\दपि दुर्लभम् ॥२-३०-३६॥
translation: By fulfilling father's wish, nothing is difficult to achieve, whether it is heaven, or wealth, or foodgrains, or learning, or sons or other comforts.
word_meanings: गुरुवृत्त्यनुरोधेन fulfilling father's desire, स्वर्गः is heaven, धनं वा or wealth, धान्यं वा or foodgrains, विद्याः learning, पुत्राः sons, सुखानि च comforts, किञ्चिदपि anything, दुर्लभम् difficult to obtain, न not.

text: देवगन्धर्वगोलोकान् ब्रह्मलोकम् तथापरान् । प्राप्नुवन्ति महात्मानो मातापितृपरायणाः ॥२-३०-३७॥
translation: Great men who are devoted to the service of their parents attain the world of the gods, of gandharvas, of cows, of Visnu, of Brahma and other worlds.
word_meanings: मातापितृपरायणाः people devoted to the service of parents, महात्मानः great men, देवगन्धर्वगोलोकान् the world of the gods, gandharvas, and the cows or Visnu, ब्रह्मलोकम् the world of Brahma, तथा and, अपरान् other worlds, प्राप्नुवन्ति will attain.

text: स माम् पिता यथा शास्ति सत्य धर्म पथे स्थितः । तथा वर्तितुम् इच्चामि स हि धर्मः सनातनः ॥२-३०-३८॥
translation: My father who follows the path of truth and dharma whatever be his commands, I wish to obey. He is, indeed, dharma eternal.
word_meanings: सत्यधर्मपथे On the path of truth and dharma, स्थितः firmly fixed, सः पिता such father, माम् me, यथा as, शास्ति commands, तथा accordingly, वर्तितुम् to abide by, इच्छामि wish सः that one, सनातनः eternal, धर्मः हि is truth indeed.

text: मम सन्ना मतिः सीते त्वाम् नेतुम् दण्डकावनम् । वसिष्यामीति सात्वम् मामनुयातुम् सुनिश्चिता ॥२-३०-३९॥
translation: O Sita, my discretion fails me in deciding whether to take you to Dandaka forest or not. You are, however, firmly determined to follow me, saying, you can live in the forest.
word_meanings: सीते O Sita, त्वाम् you, दण्डकावनम् to Dandaka forest, नेतुम् to take you, मम my, मतिः mind, सन्ना is determined, सा त्वम् such you, वसिष्यामि I can live in the forest, इति like that, माम् me, अनुयातुम् to follow, सुनिश्चिता firmly determined.

text: सा हि दिष्टाऽनवद्याङ्गी वनाय वदिरेक्षणे । अनुगच्चस्व माम् भीरु सह धर्म चरी भव ॥२-३०-४०॥
translation: O one with fascinating eyes and exquisite beauty you were born to live in the forest. O gentle lady, assist me in carrying out my duties.
word_meanings: मदिरेक्षणे O one with fascinating eyes, अनवद्याङ्गि exquisitely beautiful, सा you, वनाय to the forest, सृष्टा you have been created, भीरु O gentle lady, माम् me, अनुगच्छस्व follow me, सहधर्मचरी carrying out together duties, भव become,

text: सर्वथा सदृशम् सीते मम स्वस्य कुलस्य च । व्यवसायमनुक्रान्ता कान्ते त्वमतिशोभनम् ॥२-३०-४१॥
translation: You, O my lovely beloved Sita, have taken in the right time a highly dignified decision befitting in all ways your family, myself and yourself.
word_meanings: कान्ते O my lovely beloved, सीते Sita, त्वम् you, मम for me, स्वस्य your own, कुलस्य च of the family, सर्वथा in all ways, सदृशम् befitting, अतिशोभनम् highly dignified, व्यवसायम् resolution, अनुक्रान्ता done in due order.

text: आरभस्व शुभश्रोणि वनवासक्षमाः क्रियाः । नेदानीम् त्वदृते सीते स्वर्गोऽपि मम रोचते ॥२-३०-४२॥
translation: O Sita, begin right now all preparations necessary for residing in the forest. O one, with beautiful buttocks, without you even the very heaven does not please me.
word_meanings: शुभश्रोणि O One with beautiful buttocks Sita, वनवासक्षमाः suitable for residing in the forest, क्रियाः those acts, इदानीम् now, आरभस्व commence, सीते O Sita, त्वदृते without you, मम to me, स्वर्गोपि even heaven, न रोचते does not please.

text: ब्राह्मणेभ्यः च रत्नानि भिक्षुकेभ्यः च भोजनम् । देहि च आशम्समानेभ्यः सम्त्वरस्व च माचिरम् ॥२-३०-४३॥
translation: Give away your jewels to brahmins who need them and food to religious mendicants. Hurry up Do not delay.
word_meanings: आशंसमानेभ्यः for the needy, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to brahmins, रत्नानि च jewels, भिक्षुकेभ्यः to mendicants, भोजनं च food also, देहि you may bestow, सन्त्वरस्व च hasten, मा चिरम् do not delay.

text: भूषणानि महार्हाणि वरवस्त्राणि यानि च । रमणीयाश्च ये केचित्क्रीडार्थाश्चापुयुपस्कराः ॥२-३०-४४॥
translation: Distribute among your attendants highly valuable ornaments and excellent clothing, charming articles meant for (court) sport, my couches, chariots and all other things. Offer the rest to brahmins.
word_meanings: महार्हाणि highly valuable, यानि all, भूषणानि ornaments, वरवस्त्राणि excellent clothing, रमणीयाः charming, ये केचित् whichever, क्रीडार्थाः meant for sport, उपस्कराः articles, मम my, शयनीयानि couches, यानानि chariots, अन्यानि other, यानि च all things, स्वभृत्यवर्गस्य to your attendants, देहि give, अनन्तरम् after that, ब्राह्मणानाम् to brahmins.

text: शयनीयानि यानानि मम चान्यानि यानि च । देहि स्वभृत्यवर्गस्य ब्राह्मणानामनन्तरम् ॥२-३०-४५॥
translation: Distribute among your attendants highly valuable ornaments and excellent clothing, charming articles meant for (court) sport, my couches, chariots and all other things. Offer the rest to brahmins.
word_meanings: महार्हाणि highly valuable, यानि all, भूषणानि ornaments, वरवस्त्राणि excellent clothing, रमणीयाः charming, ये केचित् whichever, क्रीडार्थाः meant for sport, उपस्कराः articles, मम my, शयनीयानि couches, यानानि chariots, अन्यानि other, यानि च all things, स्वभृत्यवर्गस्य to your attendants, देहि give, अनन्तरम् after that, ब्राह्मणानाम् to brahmins.

text: अनुकूलम् तु सा भर्तुर् ज्ञात्वा गमनम् आत्मनः । क्षिप्रम् प्रमुदिता देवी दातुम् एव उपचक्रमे ॥२-३०-४६॥
translation: Having come to know that her departure to the forest is acceptable to her husband, Sita, highly delighted, quickly got ready to give away (things).
word_meanings: सा देवी Devi, आत्मनः her own, गमनम् departure, भर्तुः with her husband, अनुकूलम् is favourable, ज्ञात्वा having come to know, प्रमुदिता happy, क्षिप्रम् quickly, दातुमेव to gift away, उपचक्रमे began.

text: ततः प्रहृष्टा परिपूर्ण मानसा । यशस्विनी भर्तुर् अवेक्ष्य भाषितम् । धनानि रत्नानि च दातुम् अन्गना । प्रचक्रमे धर्मभृताम् मनस्विनी ॥२-३०-४७॥
एवम् श्रुत्वा तु सम्वादम् लक्ष्मणः पूर्वमागतः । बाष्पपर्याकुलमुखः शोकम् सोढुमशक्नुवन् ॥२-३१-१॥
translation: Lakshmana who had already reached there heard the conversation (between Sita and Rama). His eyes brimming with tears, he was unable to bear the grief. He held the feet of his brother tightly and said to the illustrious Sita and Rama of great resolve:
word_meanings: पूर्वम् previously, आगतः had come, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, एवम् in this way, संवादम् conversation, श्रुत्वा having heard, शोकम् sorrow, सोढुम् to endure, अशक्नुवन् being unable, बाष्पपर्याकुलमुखः (बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः) with his eyes filled with tears, सः that, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghu race, Lakshmana, भ्रातुः brother's, चरणौ feet, गाढम् tightly, निपीड्य pressing, महाव्रतम् of great resolve, राघवं च to Rama, अतियशाम् illustrious, सीताम् Sita, उवाच said.

text: स भ्रातुश्चरणौ गाढम् निपीड्य रघुनन्दनः । सीतामुवाचातियशाम् राघवम् च महाव्रतम् ॥२-३१-२॥
translation: Lakshmana who had already reached there heard the conversation (between Sita and Rama). His eyes brimming with tears, he was unable to bear the grief. He held the feet of his brother tightly and said to the illustrious Sita and Rama of great resolve:
word_meanings: पूर्वम् previously, आगतः had come, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, एवम् in this way, संवादम् conversation, श्रुत्वा having heard, शोकम् sorrow, सोढुम् to endure, अशक्नुवन् being unable, बाष्पपर्याकुलमुखः (बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः) with his eyes filled with tears, सः that, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghu race, Lakshmana, भ्रातुः brother's, चरणौ feet, गाढम् tightly, निपीड्य pressing, महाव्रतम् of great resolve, राघवं च to Rama, अतियशाम् illustrious, सीताम् Sita, उवाच said.

text: यदि गन्तुम् कृता बुद्धिर्वनम् मृगगजायुतम् । अहम् त्वानुगमिष्यामि वनमद्रे धनुर्धरः ॥२-३१-३॥
translation: If you have decided to go to the forest where deer and elephants abound, I shall also accompany you by walking before you, holding the bow.
word_meanings: मृगगजायुतम् abounding in deer and elephants, वनम् to the forest, गन्तुम् to go, बुद्धि: decision, कृता यदि if made, अहम् I, अग्रे in front, धनुर्धरः one holding a bow, त्वा you, वनम् to the forest, अनुगमिष्यामि I shall follow.

text: मया समेतोऽरण्यानि बहूनि विचरिष्यसि । पक्षिभिर्मृगयूथैश्च सम्घुष्टानि समन्ततः ॥२-३१-४॥
translation: Accompanied by me, you will roam the forests echoing with the cries of birds and sounds of herds of animals.
word_meanings: समन्ततः from all sides, पक्षिभिः with birds, मृगयूथैः च with herds of animals, संघुष्टानि echoing with the sounds of, बहूनि many, अरण्यानि forests, मया by me, समेतः accompanied by, विचरिष्यसि you will roam.

text: न देवलोकाक्रमणम् नामरत्वमहम् वृणे । ऐश्वर्यम् वापि लोकानाम् कामये न त्वया विना ॥२-३१-५॥
translation: Without you, I do not want victory over the gods or sovereignty over the worlds or even immortality.
word_meanings: अहम् I, त्वया विना without you, देवलोकाक्रमणम् the seizure of the world of devatas, न वृणे do not wish to choose, अमरत्वम् immortality, न not, लोकानाम् of the worlds, ऐश्वर्यं वापि sovereignty, न कामये do not desire.

text: एवम् ब्रुवाणः सौमित्रिर्विनवासाय निश्चितः । रामेण बहुभिः सान्वैर्निषिद्धः पुनरब्रवीत् ॥२-३१-६॥
translation: When Rama tried to dissuade Lakshmana with many words of consolation Lakshmana who was determined to go to the forest said again:
word_meanings: वनवासाय to dwell in the forest, निश्चितः having decided, एवम् in this way, ब्रुवाणः speaking, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, रामेण by Rama, बहुभिः with many, सान्त्वैः with the words of consolation, निषिद्धः dissuaded, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said.

text: अनुज्ञातश्च भवता पूर्वमेव यदस्म्यहम् । किमिदानीम् पुनरिदम् क्रियते मे निवारणम् ॥२-३१-७॥
translation: You have granted permission to me earlier.Why are you now preventing me?
word_meanings: अहम् I, भवता by you, पूर्वमेव even earlier, अनुज्ञातः was permitted, अस्मि यत् I have been, इदानीम् now, पुनः again, इदम् this, (मत्)निवारणम् prevention (of me), किम् why, क्रियते is being done?

text: यदर्थम् प्रतिषेधो मे क्रियते गन्तुमिच्छतः । एतदिच्छामि विज्ञातुम् सम्शयो हि ममानघ ॥२-३१-८॥
