translation: I wish to know, O sinless one, the reason why you are dissuading me, when I am willing to go with you. This creates a doubt in my mind.
word_meanings: अनघ O sinless one, गन्तुम् to go, इच्छतः desiring, मे my, प्रतिषेधः restriction, यदर्थम् for what reason, क्रियते is being done, एतत् all this, विज्ञातुम् to know, इच्छामि desiring, मम to me, संशयः हि I have a doubt.

text: ततः अब्रवीन् महा तेजा रामः लक्ष्मणम् अग्रतः । स्थितम् प्राग् गामिनम् वीरम् याचमानम् कृत अन्जलिम् ॥२-३१-९॥
translation: Addressing the heroic Lakshmana in front of him imploring with folded hands to take him to the forest so that he may walk ahead (and guard them), the effulgent Rama said:
word_meanings: ततः after that, महातेजाः brilliant, रामः Rama, अग्रतः in front of him, स्थितम् standing, प्राग्गामिनम् ready to walk ahead of, वीरम् heroic one, याचमानम् imploring, कृताञ्जलिम् with folded palms, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said.

text: स्निग्धो धर्मरतो वीरस्सततम् सत्पथे स्थितः । प्रियः प्राणसमो वशो भ्राता चापि सखा च मे ॥२-३१-१०॥
translation: You are affectionate, you are devoted to dharma. You are valiant. You always walk the path of virtue. You are dear to me like my own life. You are not only an obedient brother but also a friend.
word_meanings: स्निग्धः affectionate, धर्मरतः engaged in righteous activites, वीरः valiant, सततम् always, सत्पथे on the path of virtue, स्थितः abiding, मे to me, प्राणसमः like my own life, प्रियः dear, वश्यः obedient, भ्राता चापि brother also, सखा च friend.

text: मया अद्य सह सौमित्रे त्वयि गच्चति तत् वनम् । को भरिष्यति कौसल्याम् सुमित्राम् वा यशस्विनीम् ॥२-३१-११॥
translation: O Lakshmana, if you also accompany me to the forest, who will take care of mother Kausalya and the illustrious Sumitra?
word_meanings: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, त्वयि if you, अद्य today, मया सह along with me, तत् वनम् to the forest, गच्छति go, कौशल्याम् to Kausalya, यशस्विनीम् illustrious, सुमित्रां च Sumitra, कः who, भरिष्यति will take care?

text: अभिवर्षति कामैः यः पर्जन्यः पृथिवीम् इव । स काम पाश पर्यस्तः महा तेजा मही पतिः ॥२-३१-१२॥
translation: Dasaratha, the mighty king like Parjanya (the raingod), lord of the earth used to shower favours on earth. But now he is bound by the noose of passion.
word_meanings: महातेजाः mighty one, यः that, महीपतिः lord of the earth, पृथिवीम् the earth, पर्जन्यः इव like Parjanya (Indra), कामैः favours (desires), अभिवर्षति showers, सः he, कामपाशपर्यस्तः he is bound by cords of passion.

text: सा हि राज्यम् इदम् प्राप्य नृपस्य अश्व पतेः सुता । दुह्खितानाम् सपत्नीनाम् न करिष्यति शोभनम् ॥२-३१-१३॥
translation: Once the daughter of king Aswapati (Kaikeyi) gains control over the kingdom, she will do nothing to help her afflicted cowives (Kausalya and Sumitra).
word_meanings: नृपस्य king, अश्वपतेः Aswapati's, सुता daughter, सा that (Kaikeyi), इदं राज्यम् this kingdom, प्राप्य having obtained, दुःखितानाम् afflicted ladies, सपत्नीनाम् of her cowives, शोभनम् welfare, न करिष्यति हि will not extend.

text: न स्मरिष्यति कौसल्याम् सुमित्राम् च सुदुःखिताम् । भरतो राज्यमासाद्य कैकेय्याम् पर्यवस्थितः ॥२-३१-१४॥
translation: When Bharata secures the kingdom, his confidence reposed in Kaikeyi he will not bother about the miserable Kausalya and Sumitra.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, राज्यम् kingdom, आसाद्य having obtained, कैकेय्याम् in Kaikeyi, पर्यवस्थितः repose confidence, कौशल्याम् Kausalya, सुदुःखिताम् grieved, सुमित्रां च also Sumitra, न स्मरिष्यति will not remember.

text: तामार्याम् स्वयमेवेह राजाऽनुग्रहणेन वा । सौमित्रे भर कौसल्या मुक्तमर्थमिमम् चर ॥२-३१-१५॥
translation: Either by yourself or by seeking the favour of the king, O son of Sumitra, lend support to venerable Kausalya. This is the objective you must accomplish.
word_meanings: सौमित्रे स्वयमेव by yourself, राजानुग्रहणेन वा or by seeking the favour of king, इह stay here, आर्याम् venerable, तां कौशल्याम् that Kausalya, भर maintain, इमम् this, उक्तम् what is told, अर्थम् objective, चर accomplish.

text: एवम् मम च ते भक्तिर्भविष्यति सुदर्शिता । धर्मज्ञ गुरुपूजायाम् धर्मश्चाप्यतुलो महान् ॥२-३१-१६॥
translation: If you do this, your devotion to me will be amply demonstrated. Service to the elders, O dutiful one, is a virtue, great and unequalled.
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma (duty), एवम् in this way, मम in me, ते your, भक्तिः devotion, सुदर्शिता is welldemonstrated, भविष्यति will become, गुरुपूजायाम् in worshipping the elders, अतुलः unequalled, महान् great, धर्मश्च is virtue also.

text: एवं कुरुष्व सौमित्रे मत्कृते रघुनन्दन । अस्माभिर्विप्रहीणाया मातुर्नो न भवेत्सुखम् ॥२-३१-१७॥
translation: O delight of the Raghu race, do this for my sake, since deprived of us, there will be no happiness for our mother, O son of Sumitra
word_meanings: रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghu race, सौमित्रे O Son of Sumitra, मत्कृते for my sake, एवम् like this, कुरुष्व you may act, अस्माभिः by us, विप्रहीणायाः lady deprived of, नः our, मातुः for mother, सुखम् happiness, न भवेत् will not be.

text: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण लक्ष्मणः श्लक्ष्णया गिरा । प्रत्युवाच तदा रामम् वाक्यज्ञो वाक्य कोविदम् ॥२-३१-१८॥
translation: Thus addressed by Rama who was an adept in the use of words, eloquent Lakshmana gently replied:
word_meanings: रामेण by Rama, एवम् in this way, उक्तः addressed, वाक्यज्ञः eloquent, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तदा then, वाक्यकोविदम् proficient in the use of words, रामम् Rama, श्लक्ष्णया in gentle voice, गिरा in words, प्रत्युवाच replied.

text: तव एव तेजसा वीर भरतः पूजयिष्यति । कौसल्याम् च सुमित्राम् च प्रयतः न अत्र सम्शयः ॥२-३१-१९॥
translation: Aware of your power O valiant one, Bharata will undoubtedly pay respect to Kausalya and Sumitra with all humility.
word_meanings: वीर O heroic one, भरतः Bharata, तव your, तेजसैव with your power, प्रयतः in humble manner, कौसल्यां च Kausalya and, सुमित्रा च also Sumitra, पूजयिष्यति he will honour, अत्र here, संशयः doubt, न not.

text: कौसल्या बिभृयात् आर्या सहस्रम् अपि मद् विधान् । यस्याः सहस्रम् ग्रामाणाम् सम्प्राप्तम् उपजीवनम् ॥२-३१-२०॥
translation: Noble Kausalya has under her charge a thousand villages for her sustenance. She can support a thousand men like me.
word_meanings: यस्याः for (Kausalya), उपजीवनम् sustenance, ग्रामाणाम् of villages, सहस्रम् one thousand, सम्प्राप्तम् has been obtained, आर्या noble lady, कौशल्या Kausalya, मद्विधान् men like me, सहस्रमपि even one thousand, बिभृयात् she can support.

text: तदात्मभरणे चैव मम मातुस्तथैव च । पर्याप्ता मद्विधानाम् च भरणाय यशस्विनी ॥२-३१-२१॥
translation: Illustrious Kausalya is competent enough to support herself, my mother and men like me.
word_meanings: तत् for that, यशस्विनी illustrious Kausalya, आत्मभरणे चैव to support herself, तथैव च also, मम मातुः my mother's, मद्विधानां च of men like me, भरणाय च to support, पर्याप्ता is competent.

text: कुरुष्व मामनुचरम् वैधर्म्यम् नेह विद्यते । कृतार्थोऽहम् भविष्यामि तव चार्थः प्रकल्पते ॥२-३१-२२॥
translation: Make me your follower. There is no breach of virtue in this. I will have my purpose accomplished. Your object also will be fulfilled.
word_meanings: माम् me, अनुचरम् as your follower, कुरुष्व make (take) me, इह in this, वैधर्म्यम् breach of virtue, न विद्यते is not considered, अहम् I, कृतार्थः accomplish my purpose, भविष्यामि I will become, तव your, अर्थः च object also, प्रकल्पते will be fulfilled.

text: धनुर् आदाय सशरम् खनित्र पिटका धरः । अग्रतः ते गमिष्यामि पन्थानम् अनुदर्शयन् ॥२-३१-२३॥
translation: Holding the bow and arrows and carrying a crowbar and a basket, I shall go in front of you leading the way.
word_meanings: सशरम् (stringed) with arrows, धनुः bow, आदाय holding, खनित्रपिटकाधरः holding a basket and a crowbar, ते your, अग्रतः in front of, पन्थानम् the way, अनुदर्शयन् indicating, गमिष्यामि I shall go.

text: आहरिष्यामि ते नित्यम् मूलानि च फलानि च । वन्यानि यानि च अन्यानि स्वाहाराणि तपस्विनाम् ॥२-३१-२४॥
translation: I shall daily collect roots, fruits and other forest products fit for ascetics.
word_meanings: मूलानि roots, फलानि च fruits also, तपस्विनाम् for ascetics, स्वाहाराणि eatables, वन्यानि available in the forest, यानि those, अन्यानि च other products, नित्यम् daily, ते to you, आहरिष्यामि shall collect.

text: भवाम्स् तु सह वैदेह्या गिरि सानुषु रम्स्यते । अहम् सर्वम् करिष्यामि जाग्रतः स्वपतः च ते ॥२-३१-२५॥
translation: When you go about for pleasure on mountain slopes along with Sita, I shall do everything for you, whether you are awake or asleep.
word_meanings: भवांस्तु you, वैदेह्या सह with Sita, गिरिसानुषु on mountain slopes, रंस्यते you will go sporting, ते you, जाग्रतः while you are awake, स्ववतश्च while you are asleep, अहम् I,सर्वम् all tasks, करिष्यामि I will do.

text: रामः तु अनेन वाक्येन सुप्रीतः प्रत्युवाच तम् । व्रज आपृच्चस्व सौमित्रे सर्वम् एव सुहृज् जनम् ॥२-३१-२६॥
translation: Pleased with his words Rama said, O Lakshmana go and take leave of all your friends.
word_meanings: रामस्तु Rama also, अनेन वाक्येन with these words, सुप्रीतः immensely pleased man, तम् to him, प्रत्युवाच replied, सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, व्रज go forth, सर्वमेव all, सुहृज्जनम् friends, आपृच्छस्व ask leave of them.

text: ये च राज्ञो ददौ दिव्ये महात्मा वरुणः स्वयम् । जनकस्य महा यज्ञे धनुषी रौद्र दर्शने ॥२-३१-२७॥
translation: O Lakshmana in the great sacrifice performed by the highsouled Janaka, Varuna himself gave him two aweinspiring celestial bows, two impenetrable divine armours, two quivers with inexhaustible arrows, two swords plated with gold and as bright as the sun. All these weapons are deposited in the house of our preceptor (sage Vasistha) where they are being worshipped. Go and bring them swiftly.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, महात्मा highsouled, वरुणः Varuna, स्वयम् himself, राज्ञः of the king, जनकस्य Janaka's, महायज्ञे in the great sacrifice, दिव्ये divine, रौद्रदर्शने awesome, ये those, धनुषी bows, दिव्ये divine, अभेद्यकवचे impenetrable armour, अक्षयसायकौ two sets of inexhaustible arrows, तूणी च two quivers, हेमपरिष्कृतौ plated with gold, आदित्यविमलौ as bright as the sun, उभौ both, खड्गौ swords, ददौ gave, एतत् that, सर्वम् everything, सत्कृत्य after having worshipped, आचार्य सद्मनि in the house of the preceptor (sage Vasistha), निहितम् is deposited, सर्वम् all, आयुधम् weaponry, आदाय after collecting , क्षिप्रं swiftly, आव्रज come forth.

text: अभेद्य कवचे दिव्ये तूणी च अक्षय सायकौ । आदित्य विमलौ च उभौ खड्गौ हेम परिष्कृतौ ॥२-३१-२८॥
translation: O Lakshmana in the great sacrifice performed by the highsouled Janaka, Varuna himself gave him two aweinspiring celestial bows, two impenetrable divine armours, two quivers with inexhaustible arrows, two swords plated with gold and as bright as the sun. All these weapons are deposited in the house of our preceptor (sage Vasistha) where they are being worshipped. Go and bring them swiftly.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, महात्मा highsouled, वरुणः Varuna, स्वयम् himself, राज्ञः of the king, जनकस्य Janaka's, महायज्ञे in the great sacrifice, दिव्ये divine, रौद्रदर्शने awesome, ये those, धनुषी bows, दिव्ये divine, अभेद्यकवचे impenetrable armour, अक्षयसायकौ two sets of inexhaustible arrows, तूणी च two quivers, हेमपरिष्कृतौ plated with gold, आदित्यविमलौ as bright as the sun, उभौ both, खड्गौ swords, ददौ gave, एतत् that, सर्वम् everything, सत्कृत्य after having worshipped, आचार्य सद्मनि in the house of the preceptor (sage Vasistha), निहितम् is deposited, सर्वम् all, आयुधम् weaponry, आदाय after collecting , क्षिप्रं swiftly, आव्रज come forth.

text: सत्कृत्य निहितम् सर्वम् एतत् आचार्य सद्मनि । स त्वम् आयुधम् आदाय क्षिप्रम् आव्रज लक्ष्मण ॥२-३१-२९॥
translation: O Lakshmana in the great sacrifice performed by the highsouled Janaka, Varuna himself gave him two aweinspiring celestial bows, two impenetrable divine armours, two quivers with inexhaustible arrows, two swords plated with gold and as bright as the sun. All these weapons are deposited in the house of our preceptor (sage Vasistha) where they are being worshipped. Go and bring them swiftly.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, महात्मा highsouled, वरुणः Varuna, स्वयम् himself, राज्ञः of the king, जनकस्य Janaka's, महायज्ञे in the great sacrifice, दिव्ये divine, रौद्रदर्शने awesome, ये those, धनुषी bows, दिव्ये divine, अभेद्यकवचे impenetrable armour, अक्षयसायकौ two sets of inexhaustible arrows, तूणी च two quivers, हेमपरिष्कृतौ plated with gold, आदित्यविमलौ as bright as the sun, उभौ both, खड्गौ swords, ददौ gave, एतत् that, सर्वम् everything, सत्कृत्य after having worshipped, आचार्य सद्मनि in the house of the preceptor (sage Vasistha), निहितम् is deposited, सर्वम् all, आयुधम् weaponry, आदाय after collecting , क्षिप्रं swiftly, आव्रज come forth.

text: स सुहृज् जनम् आमन्त्र्य वन वासाय निश्चितः । इष्क्वाकु गुरुम् आमन्त्र्य जग्राह आयुधम् उत्तमम् ॥२-३१-३०॥
translation: Lakshmana, who was resolved to go to the forest, took leave of his friends, and collected from the house of Vasistha, preceptor of the Ikshvaku race, the powerful weapons deposited with him.
word_meanings: वनवासाय to live in the forest, निश्चित: one who was determined, सः Lakshmana, सुहृज्जनम् friends, आमन्त्र्य taking leave of, इक्ष्वाकुगुरुम् preceptor of the Ikshvakus, Vasistha, आगम्य having reached, उत्तमम् powerful, आयुधम् weapons, जग्राह received.

text: तत् दिव्यम् राज शार्दूलः सत्कृतम् माल्य भूषितम् । रामाय दर्शयाम् आस सौमित्रिः सर्वम् आयुधम् ॥२-३१-३१॥
translation: Lakshmana, tiger among princes, brought all those divine weapons sanctified and decorated with garlands and showed them to Rama.
word_meanings: राजशार्दूलः tiger among princes, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, दिव्यम् divine, सत्कृतम् sanctified, माल्यभूषितम् decorated with garlands, सर्वम् all, तत् आयुधम् those weapons, रामाय to Rama, दर्शयामास showed.

text: तम् उवाच आत्मवान् रामः प्रीत्या लक्ष्मणम् आगतम् । काले त्वम् आगतः सौम्य कान्क्षिते मम लक्ष्मण ॥२-३१-३२॥
translation: O handsome Lakshmana, you have come at the expected time, said the selfpossessed Rama affectionately when he saw him arrive.
word_meanings: आत्मवान् selfpossessed, रामः Rama, आगतम् having arrived, तं लक्ष्मणम् to that Lakshmana, प्रीत्या affectionately, उवाच said, सौम्य O handsome, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, त्वम् you, मम to me, काङ्क्षिते काले at the desired moment, आगतः have come.

text: अहम् प्रदातुम् इच्चामि यद् इदम् मामकम् धनम् । ब्राह्मणेभ्यः तपस्विभ्यः त्वया सह परम्तप ॥२-३१-३३॥
translation: Let us give away, O tormentor of enemies (Lakshmana) my belogings to the ascetic brahmins.
word_meanings: परन्तप O tormentor of enemies, अहम् I, त्वया सह with you, यत् all that, इदम् this, मामकम् my belonging, धनम् wealth, तपस्विभ्यः to ascetics, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to brahmins, प्रदातुम् to give away, इच्छामि I wish.

text: वसन्ति इह दृढम् भक्त्या गुरुषु द्विज सत्तमाः । तेषाम् अपि च मे भूयः सर्वेषाम् च उपजीविनाम् ॥२-३१-३४॥
translation: Here live the best of brahmins who are deeply devoted to their teachers along with those who are dependent on me for their livelihood.
word_meanings: इह here, गुरुषु among teachers, दृढम् deep, भक्त्या with devotion, द्विजसत्तमाः best of brahmins, वसन्ति are living, तेषामपि च for them, भूयः also, सर्वेषाम् for all, मे my, उपजीविनां च to my dependents.

text: वसिष्ठ पुत्रम् तु सुयज्ञम् आर्यम् । त्वम् आनय आशु प्रवरम् द्विजानाम् । अभिप्रयास्यामि वनम् समस्तान् । अभ्यर्च्य शिष्टान् अपरान् द्विजातीन् ॥२-३१-३५॥
translation: Fetch Suyajna, son of Vasistha, best among the brahmins along with all other distinguished brahmins to whom I will pay my homage and leave for the forest. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfirst sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, द्विजानाम् among the brahmins, प्रवरम् best, वशिष्ठपुत्रम् son of Vasistha, आर्यम् venerable, सुयज्ञम् Suyajna, आशु swiftly, आनय bring, शिष्टान् distinguished, अपरान् other, समस्तान् all, द्विजातीन् brahmins, अभ्यर्च्य having paid homage, वनम् to the forest, अभिप्रयास्यामि I shall go.

text: ततः शासनम् आज्ञाय भ्रातुः शुभतरम् प्रियम् । गत्वा स प्रविवेश आशु सुयज्ञस्य निवेशनम् ॥२-३२-१॥
translation: Lakshmana having understood the very auspicious and welcome order (of Rama) immediately proceeded to the house of Suyajna.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, सः he, भ्रातुः brother's, शुभतरम् very much auspicious, प्रियम् pleasing, शासनम् command, आज्ञाय having understood, आशु immediately, गत्वा having gone, सुयज्ञस्य Suyajna's, निवेशनम् house, प्रविवेश entered.

text: तम् विप्रम् अग्नि अगारस्थम् वन्दित्वा लक्ष्मणो अब्रवीत् । सखे अभ्यागच्च पश्य त्वम् वेश्म दुष्कर कारिणः ॥२-३२-२॥
translation: Lakshmana paid homage to him who was in the firesanctuary, and said O friend, come and see the palace of Rama who is the accomplisher of all difficult tasks.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अग्न्यगारस्थम् staying in the firesanctuary, तं विप्रम् that brahmin, वन्दित्वा after saluting, अब्रवीत् said, सखे O friend, अभ्यागच्छ come, त्वम् you, दुष्करकारिणः accomplisher of all difficult tasks , वेश्म palace of Rama, पश्य behold.

text: ततः सम्ध्याम् उपास्य आशु गत्वा सौमित्रिणा सह । जुष्टम् तत् प्राविशल् लक्ष्म्या रम्यम् राम निवेशनम् ॥२-३२-३॥
translation: After performing the twilight prayers, Suyajna along with Lakshmana went straight away and entered the beautiful and prosperous palace of Rama.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, सन्ध्याम् the twilight prayers, उपास्य having performed, सौमित्रिणा सह along with Lakshmana, आशु swiftly, गत्वा went, लक्ष्म्या with prosperity, जुष्टम् endowed with, रम्यम् beautiful, तत् that, रामनिवेशनम् Rama's palace, प्राविशत् he entered.

text: तम् आगतम् वेदविदम् प्रान्जलिः सीतया सह । सुयज्ञम् अभिचक्राम राघवो अग्निम् इव अर्चितम् ॥२-३२-४॥
translation: On the arrival of sage Suyajna wellversed in the Vedas, both Rama and Sita offered obeisance to him as to firegod and circumambulated him.
word_meanings: राघवः Rama, प्राञ्जलिः folded hands, आगतम् who has come, वेदविदम् versed in Vedas, तं सुयज्ञम् that Suyajna, अर्चितम् worshipped, अग्निम् इव like fire, सीतया सह with Sita, अभिचक्राम circumambulated.

text: जात रूपमयैः मुख्यैः अन्गदैः कुण्डलैः शुभैः । सहेम सूत्रैः मणिभिः केयूरैः वलयैः अपि ॥२-३२-५॥
translation: Rama, scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, worshipped Suyajna with a collection of golden ornaments such as earrings, anklets, armlets, bracelets and many other ornaments of precious stones. Then urged by Sita, Rama said to him:
word_meanings: काकुत्स्थ: scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, जातरूपमयैः by golden, मुख्यैः with excellent, अङ्गदैः anklets, शुभैः auspicious, कुण्डलैः with earrings, सहेमसूत्रैः with golden strings, मणिभिः gems, केयूरैः bracelets, वलयैरपि armlets also, अन्यैः others, बहुभिः many, रत्नैश्च jewels, सुयज्ञम् to Suyajna, प्रत्यपूजयत् worshipped, तदा then, सः रामः that Rama, सीताप्रचोदितः urged by Sita, उवाच said.

text: अन्यैः च रत्नैः बहुभिः काकुत्स्थः प्रत्यपूजयत् । सुयज्ञम् स तदा उवाच रामः सीता प्रचोदितः ॥२-३२-६॥
translation: Rama, scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, worshipped Suyajna with a collection of golden ornaments such as earrings, anklets, armlets, bracelets and many other ornaments of precious stones. Then urged by Sita, Rama said to him:
word_meanings: काकुत्स्थ: scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, जातरूपमयैः by golden, मुख्यैः with excellent, अङ्गदैः anklets, शुभैः auspicious, कुण्डलैः with earrings, सहेमसूत्रैः with golden strings, मणिभिः gems, केयूरैः bracelets, वलयैरपि armlets also, अन्यैः others, बहुभिः many, रत्नैश्च jewels, सुयज्ञम् to Suyajna, प्रत्यपूजयत् worshipped, तदा then, सः रामः that Rama, सीताप्रचोदितः urged by Sita, उवाच said.

text: हारम् च हेम सूत्रम् च भार्यायै सौम्य हारय । रशनाम् च अधुना सीता दातुम् इच्चति ते सखे ॥२-३२-७॥
translation: O handsome friend now Sita intends to give away to your wife her necklace, her golden chain and girdle. Could you accept them?
word_meanings: सौम्य O handsome, सखे friend, सीता Sita, अधुना at this time, हारं च necklace also, हेमसूत्रं च golden chain, रशनां च also girdle, ते to you, दातुम् to give, इच्छति wishes, भार्यायै to your wife, हारय take them.

text: अङ्गदानि विचित्राणि केयूराणि शुभानि च । पर्यन्कम् अग्र्य आस्तरणम् नाना रत्न विभूषितम् ॥२-३२-८॥
पर्यङ्कमग्र्यास्तरणम् नानारत्नविभूषितम् । तम् अपि इच्चति वैदेही प्रतिष्ठापयितुम् त्वयि ॥२-३२-९॥
translation: Sita also wishes to give away a couch with an exquisite cover, encrusted with a variety of precious stones.
word_meanings: वैदेही Sita, अग्य्रास्तरणम् exquisite bed cover, नानारत्नविभूषितम् encrusted with various gems, तं पर्यङ्कम् that couch, अपि also, त्वयि in you, प्रतिष्ठापयितुम् to place (in your house), इच्छति wishes.

text: नागः शत्रुम् जयो नाम मातुलो यम् ददौ मम । तम् ते गज सहस्रेण ददामि द्विज पुम्गव ॥२-३२-१०॥
translation: I am gifting you, O best among brahmins a thousand elephants including Satrunjaya an elephant my maternal uncle had given me.
word_meanings: द्विजसत्तम O best among brahmins, अयम् this one, शत्रुञ्जयो नाम by name Satrunjaya, नागः an elephant, मातुलः my maternal uncle, मम to me, ददौ gave, तम् to that (elephant), गजसहस्रेण along with a thousand elephants, ते to you, ददामि I am giving.

text: इति उक्तः स हि रामेण सुयज्ञः प्रतिगृह्य तत् । राम लक्ष्मण सीतानाम् प्रयुयोज आशिषः शिवाः ॥२-३२-११॥
translation: Thus addressed by Rama, Suyajna accepted the gifts and conferred auspicious blessings on Rama, Lakshmana and Sita.
word_meanings: रामेण by Rama, इति thus, उक्तः spoken, सः सुयज्ञः that Suyajna, तत् that, प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, रामलक्ष्मणसीतानाम् to Rama, Lakshmana and Sita, शुभाः auspicious, आशिषः blessings, प्रयुयोज bestowed.

text: अथ भ्रातरम् अव्यग्रम् प्रियम् रामः प्रियम् वदः । सौमित्रिम् तम् उवाच इदम् ब्रह्मा इव त्रिदश ईश्वरम् ॥२-३२-१२॥
translation: Sweettongued Rama calmly said to his brother (Lakshmana) like Brahma addressing Indra:
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, प्रियंवद: sweettongued, रामः Rama, प्रियम् to his beloved, भ्रातरम् to his brother, तं सौमित्रिम् to Lakshmana, ब्रह्मा creator, त्रिदशेश्वरम् इव like lord of heaven, Indra, अव्यग्रम् without haste, इदम् this word, उवाच said.

text: अगस्त्यम् कौशिकम् चैव ताव् उभौ ब्राह्मण उत्तमौ । अर्चय आहूय सौमित्रे रत्नैः सस्यम् इव अम्बुभिः ॥२-३२-१३॥
translation: O Lakshmana invite Agastya and Kausika, the two celebrated brahmins, and bestow on them with reverence plenty of precious gems like showers of rain on standing crops.
word_meanings: सौमित्रे Lakshmana, अगस्त्यम् sage Agasthya, कौशिकं चैव to sage Kausika, उभौ both, तौ ब्राह्मणोत्तमौ two eminent brahmins, आहूय having invited, रत्नैः gems, सस्यं crops, अम्बुभिः इव like rain waters, अर्चय worship.

text: तर्पयस्व महाबाहो गोसहसरैश्च मानद । सुवर्णै रजतैश्चैव मणिभिश्च महाधनैः ॥२-३२-१४॥
translation: Satisfy them, O highlyarmed Lakshmana, O bestower of honour with a thousand cows, gold, silver and with the great wealth of gems.
word_meanings: महाबाहो O mightyarmed Lakshmana, मानद O bestower of honour, गोसहस्रैश्च with a thousand cows, सुवर्णैः gold, रजतैश्चैव and also silver, महाधनैः great wealth, मणिभिश्च with gems also, तर्पयस्व you satisfy them.

text: कौसल्याम् च याअशीर्भिर् भक्तः पर्युपतिष्ठति । आचार्यः तैत्तिरीयाणाम् अभिरूपः च वेदवित् ॥२-३२-१५॥
translation: O Lakshmana, give away chariots, maidservants, silk clothes to learned brahmins of Taittiriya branch and wellversed in the Vedas, to agreeable and faithful brahmins attending on Kausalya with their blessings till they are fully satisfied.
word_meanings: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, तैत्तिरीयाणाम् of the Taittiriya branch of the Vedas, आचार्यः learned preceptor, अभिरूपश्च agreeable man, वेदवित् versed in the Vedas, यः who, भक्तः devotee, आशीर्भिः with blessings, कौशल्याम् of Kausalya, पर्युपतिष्ठति attends on her, तस्य to him, सः द्विजः that brahmin, यावत् till such time, तुष्यति is fully satisfied, यानं च chariots, दासीश्च maidservants, कौशेयानि वस्त्राणि च silk clothes also, संप्रदापय arrange to give away.

text: तस्य यानम् च दासीः च सौमित्रे सम्प्रदापय । कौशेयानि च वस्त्राणि यावत् तुष्यति स द्विजः ॥२-३२-१६॥
translation: O Lakshmana, give away chariots, maidservants, silk clothes to learned brahmins of Taittiriya branch and wellversed in the Vedas, to agreeable and faithful brahmins attending on Kausalya with their blessings till they are fully satisfied.
word_meanings: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, तैत्तिरीयाणाम् of the Taittiriya branch of the Vedas, आचार्यः learned preceptor, अभिरूपश्च agreeable man, वेदवित् versed in the Vedas, यः who, भक्तः devotee, आशीर्भिः with blessings, कौशल्याम् of Kausalya, पर्युपतिष्ठति attends on her, तस्य to him, सः द्विजः that brahmin, यावत् till such time, तुष्यति is fully satisfied, यानं च chariots, दासीश्च maidservants, कौशेयानि वस्त्राणि च silk clothes also, संप्रदापय arrange to give away.

text: सूतः चित्र रथः च आर्यः सचिवः सुचिर उषितः । तोषय एनम् महा अर्हैः च रत्नैः वस्त्रैः धनैअः तथा ॥२-३२-१७॥
translation: Noble counsellor (of our father) and charioteer Chitraratha has been in our service for many years. Gratify him with invaluable jewels, clothes, wealth, with young female calves and a thousand cows.
word_meanings: आर्यसचिवः noble counsellor (of our father), चित्ररथः Chitraratha, सूतः charioteer, सुचिरोषितः lived with us for many years, एनम् him, महार्है: with invaluable, रत्नैश्च with jewels, वस्त्रै: clothes, तथा similarly, धनैः with wealth,सर्वाभिः with all ,पशुकाभिः च with young female calves, गवाम् cows, दशशतेन च by (a thousand) ten hundreds, तोषय you may gratify him.

text: पशुकाभिकछ सर्वाभिर्गवाम् दशशतेन च । ये चेमे कथकालापा बहवो दण्डमाणवाः ॥२-३२-१८॥
नित्यस्वाध्यायशीलत्वान्नान्यत्कुर्वन्ति किम्चन । अलसाः स्वादुकामाश्च महताम् चापि सम्मताः ॥२-३२-१९॥
translation: O Lakshmana many brahmacharis with a staff (as a mark of religious authority) wellversed in Katha and Kalapa portions of the Vedas engaged daily in the study of the Vedas and nothing else. Not active otherwise, they are fond of delicious food and are respected even by great people. Give them eighty carts filled with gems, a thousand bulls capable of carrying paddy, and two hundred oxen capable of ploughing land and a thousand cows for preparing food (with milk products).
word_meanings: कठकालापाः men versed in Katha and Kalapa portions of the Vedas, ये which, इमे these, बहवः many, दण्डमाणवाः brahmacharis holding a staff (as authority given to an ascetic), नित्यस्वाध्यायशीलत्वात् engaged daily in the study of Vedas, अन्यत् other, किञ्चन any work, न कुर्वन्ति not doing, अलसाः inactive people, स्वादुकामाश्च fond of delicious food, महतां चापि even for great people, सम्मताः are highly respected, तेषाम् for them, रत्नपूर्णानि filled with gems, अशीतियानानि eighty carts, शालिवाहसहस्रं च a thousand bulls capable of carrying corn, द्वे शते two hundred, भद्रकान् bulls, दापय arrange to give away, सौमित्रे O Lakshmana व्यञ्जनार्थम् for preparing food (with milk products), गोसहस्रम् a thousand cows, उपाकुरु arrange to give away.

text: शालि वाह सहस्रम् च द्वे शते भद्रकाम्स् तथा । व्यन्जन अर्थम् च सौमित्रे गो सहस्रम् उपाकुरु ॥२-३२-२०॥
translation: O Lakshmana many brahmacharis with a staff (as a mark of religious authority) wellversed in Katha and Kalapa portions of the Vedas engaged daily in the study of the Vedas and nothing else. Not active otherwise, they are fond of delicious food and are respected even by great people. Give them eighty carts filled with gems, a thousand bulls capable of carrying paddy, and two hundred oxen capable of ploughing land and a thousand cows for preparing food (with milk products).
word_meanings: कठकालापाः men versed in Katha and Kalapa portions of the Vedas, ये which, इमे these, बहवः many, दण्डमाणवाः brahmacharis holding a staff (as authority given to an ascetic), नित्यस्वाध्यायशीलत्वात् engaged daily in the study of Vedas, अन्यत् other, किञ्चन any work, न कुर्वन्ति not doing, अलसाः inactive people, स्वादुकामाश्च fond of delicious food, महतां चापि even for great people, सम्मताः are highly respected, तेषाम् for them, रत्नपूर्णानि filled with gems, अशीतियानानि eighty carts, शालिवाहसहस्रं च a thousand bulls capable of carrying corn, द्वे शते two hundred, भद्रकान् bulls, दापय arrange to give away, सौमित्रे O Lakshmana व्यञ्जनार्थम् for preparing food (with milk products), गोसहस्रम् a thousand cows, उपाकुरु arrange to give away.

text: मेखलीनाम् महासघः कौसल्याम् समुपस्थितः । तेषाम् सहस्रम् सौमित्रे प्रत्येकम् सम्प्रदापय ॥२-३२-२१॥
translation: Give each of the large number of brahmacharis wearing girdles and working under Kausalya a thousand (cows or gold coins), O Lakshmana
word_meanings: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana मेखलीनाम् of brahmacharis (who wear a triple girdle worn by the first three castes), महासङ्घः in large numbers, कौशल्याम् of Kausalya, समुपस्थितः depending on, तेषाम् to them, प्रत्येकम् for each of them, सहस्रम् thousand (cows), सम्प्रदापय gift away.

text: अम्बा यथा च सा नन्देत्कौसल्या मम दक्षिणाम् । तथा द्विजातीम् स्तान्सर्वान् लक्ष्मणार्च ॥२-३२-२२॥
translation: You should, O Lakshmana treat all those brahmins in such a way that my mother shall be pleased on seeing my respectful offerings.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, अम्बा mother, सा कौशल्या Kausalya, मम my, दक्षिणाम् respectful offerings, यथा in whichever way, नन्देत् that pleases, तथा in that way, तान् those, सर्वान् all, द्विजातीन् brahmins, सर्वशः in all ways, अर्चय you may honour.

text: ततः स पुरुष व्याघ्रः तत् धनम् लक्ष्मणः स्वयम् । यथा उक्तम् ब्राह्मण इन्द्राणाम् अददात् धनदो यथा ॥२-३२-२३॥
translation: Thereupon Lakshmana, a tiger among men, personally distributed like Kubera, gifts of riches to all those Indras among brahmins (best of brahmins) in accordance with the instructions of Rama.
word_meanings: ततः thereupon, पुरुषव्याघ्रः tiger among men (best of men), सः लक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, धनदो यथा like Kubera, bestower of wealth, तत् धनम् that wealth, यथोक्तम् as told (by Rama), स्वयम् personally, ब्राह्मणेन्द्राणाम् to the Indras among brahmins (best brahmins), अददात् gave.

text: अथ अब्रवीद् बाष्प कलाम्स् तिष्ठतः च उपजीविनः । सम्प्रदाय बहु द्रव्यम् एकैकस्य उपजीविनः ॥२-३२-२४॥
translation: Rama then bestowed abundant wealth on each of the dependents as they stood with their throats choked with tears, saying:
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, बाष्पकलान् men with their throats choked with tears, तिष्ठतः remaining, उपजीविनः dependents, एकैकस्य for each one of them, बहु abundance of, द्रव्यम् wealth, उपजीवनम् as subsistence, सम्प्रदाय having bestowed, अब्रवीत् said.

text: लक्ष्मणस्य च यद् वेश्म गृहम् च यद् इदम् मम । अशून्यम् कार्यम् एकैकम् यावद् आगमनम् मम ॥२-३२-२५॥
translation: Till I come back, guard each of the palaces of Lakshmana and mine and ensure that they are not left unattended.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, यत् which, वेश्म palace, मम my, इदम् this, यत् which, गृहं च palace also, एकैकम् each one, मम my, यावदागमनम् till I return, अशून्यम् without being unattended, कार्यम् fit to be done.

text: इति उक्त्वा दुह्खितम् सर्वम् जनम् तम् उपजीविनम् । उवाच इदम् धन ध्यक्षम् धनम् आनीयताम् इति ॥२-३२-२६॥
translation: Having spoken thus to all dependents who were overcome with grief, Rama ordered the treasury officer to bring the entire treasure.
word_meanings: दुःखितम् filled with grief, उपजीविनम् dependents, सर्वम् all, तं जनम् to that group, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, धनम् treasure, आनीयताम् bring, इति thus, इदम् this word, धनाध्यक्षम् to treasury officer, उवाच said.

text: ततः अस्य धनम् आजह्रुः सर्वम् एव उपजीविनः । स राशिः सुमहाम्स्तत्र दर्शनीयो ह्यदृश्यत ॥२-३२-२७॥
translation: When all the dependents fetched the entire wealth of Rama, they were pleased to see the great heap of wealth.
word_meanings: ततः after that, उपजीविनः dependents, अस्य Rama's, सर्वमेव entire, धनम् wealth, आजह्रुः brought, तत्र there, सुमहान् extremely great, सः राशिः that heap of wealth, दर्शनीयः pleasing to see, अदृश्यत beheld.

text: ततः स पुरुष व्याघ्रः तत् धनम् सह लक्ष्मणः । द्विजेभ्यो बाल वृद्धेभ्यः कृपणेभ्यो अभ्यदापयत् ॥२-३२-२८॥
translation: Rama, best among men, got the entire wealth distributed among indigent brahmins, and young and old alike with the help of Lakshmana.
word_meanings: ततः then, पुरुषव्याघ्रः tiger among men (best of men), सः that Rama, सहलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, तत् धनम् that wealth, द्विजेभ्यः to brahmins, बालवृद्धेभ्यः to the young and old, कृपणेभ्यः to the poor, अदापयत् got it distributed.

text: तत्र आसीत् पिन्गलो गार्ग्यः त्रिजटः नाम वै द्विजः । क्षतवृत्तिर्वने नित्यम् फालकुद्दाललाङ्गली ॥२-३२-२९॥
translation: A brahmin by name, Trijata, a descendant of sage Garga and of reddishbrown colour used to live in that region earning his livelihood in the forest by digging the earth with an ironspade and a plough.
word_meanings: तत्र there, नित्यम् always, फालकुद्दाललाङ्गली with an ironspade and a plough, वने in the forest, क्षतवृत्ति: digging the earth as profession, पिङ्गलः a man of reddishbrown colour, गार्ग्यः descendant of sage Gargya, त्रिजटो नाम by name Trijata, द्विजः brahmin, आसीत् lived.

text: तम् वृद्धम् तरुणी भार्या बालानादाय दारकान् । अब्रवीद्बाह्मणम् वाक्यम् दारिद्र्येणाभिपीडिता ॥२-३२-३०॥
translation: His young wife, highly distressed due to poverty, keeping her young sons before her said to the aged brahmin:
word_meanings: तरुणी young, भार्या wife, दारिद्र्येण due to poverty, अभिपीडिता highly distressed, बालान् young, दारकान् sons, आदाय after presenting, वृद्धम् aged, तं ब्राह्मणम् to that brahmin, अब्रवीत् said.

text: अपास्य फालम् कुद्दालम् कुरुष्व वचनम् ममम् । रामम् दर्शय धर्मज्जनम् यदि किम्चिदवाप्स्यसि ॥२-३२-३१॥
translation: Listen to me throw away this ironspade. Go and see the righteous Rama.You may obtain something.
word_meanings: फालम् iron, कुद्दालम् spade, अपास्य throwing away, मम my, वचनम् words, कुरुष्व implement, धर्मज्ञम् knower of righteousness, रामम् to Rama, दर्शय you may present yourself, किञ्चित् something, अवाप्स्यसि यदि if at all you may obtain.

text: स भार्यावचनम् श्रुत्वा शाटीमाच्छाद्य दुश्छदाम् । स प्रतिष्ठत पन्थानम् यत्र रामनिवेशनम् ॥२-३२-३२॥
translation: At the words of his wife, Trijata took the path to Rama's palace, having wrapped himself with a torn upper garment .
word_meanings: सः that Trijata, भार्यावचनम् wife's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, दुःश्छदाम् tattered clothes, शाटीम् upper garment, आच्छाद्य having wrapped, रामनिवेशनम् Rama's palace, यत्र where it is located, पन्थानम् about the path, प्रातिष्ठत he set forth.

text: भृग्वङ्गिरसमम् दीप्त्या त्रिजटम् जनसम्सदि । आ पन्चमायाः कक्ष्याया न एनम् कश्चित् अवारयत् ॥२-३२-३३॥
translation: No one in the crowd stopped Tirjata until he reached the fifth courtyard as he looked like Bhrigu and Angirasa in brilliance.
word_meanings: जनसंसदि in the crowd, दीप्त्या in lustre, भृग्वङ्गिरसमम् like Bhrugu and Angirasa, एनम् this, त्रिजटम् Trijata, आपञ्चमायाः कक्ष्यायाः up to the fifth courtyard, कश्चित् any one, न अवारयत् did not stop him.

text: स राज पुत्रम् आसाद्य त्रिजटः वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । निर्धनो बहु पुत्रः अस्मि राज पुत्र महा यशः । क्षतवृत्तिर्वने नित्यम् प्रत्यवेक्षस्व मामिति ॥२-३२-३४॥
translation: Trijata approached Rama and said O illustrious prince I am a destitute and have many children. I am living in the forest by collecting leftover grains. Look at me.
word_meanings: सः त्रिजटः that Trijata, राजपुत्रम् prince Rama, आसाद्य having approached, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् uttered, महायशः O illustrious one, राजपुत्र O Prince, निर्धनः I am a destitute, बहुपुत्रः father of many children, नित्यम् daily, वने in the forest, उञ्छवृत्ति: अस्मि living on collecting the leftover grain of the field, माम् me, प्रत्यवेक्षस्व look at, इति thus.

text: तमुवाच ततो रामः परिहाससमन्वितम् । गवाम् सहस्रमप्येकम् न च विश्राणितम् मया । परिक्षिपसि दण्डेन यावत्तावदवाप्य्ससि ॥२-३२-३५॥
translation: Rama jokingly replied to him, I have not yet gifted one thousand cows. Throw your staff and the cows on the space your staff covers will be yours.
word_meanings: ततः then, रामः Rama, परिहाससमन्वितम् jokingly, तम् him, उवाच said, मया by me, एकम् one, गवां सहस्रमपि thousand cows, न च विश्राणितम् not yet given away, दण्डेन with staff, यावत् as far as, परिक्षिपसि you will hurl, तावत् till such place, अवाप्स्यसि you will obtain.

text: स शाटीम् त्वरितः कट्याम् सम्ब्रान्तः परिवेष्ट्य ताम् । आविद्ध्य दण्डम् चिक्षेप सर्वप्राणेन वेगितः ॥२-३२-३६॥
translation: Bewildered Trijata swiftly tightened up his upper garment around his waist, set the direction for his staff and hurled it with all his might.
word_meanings: सः Trijata, सम्भ्रान्तः bewildered, त्वरितः swiftly, तां शाटीम् his upper garment, कट्याम् on his waist, परिवेष्ट्य after throwing round, दण्डम् staff, आविद्ध्य after setting the direction, वेगितः swiftly, सर्वप्राणेन with all his might, चिक्षेप hurled.

text: स तीर्त्वा सरयूपारम् दण्डस्तस्य कराच्च्युतः । गोव्रजे बहुसाहास्रे पपातोक्षणसन्निधौ ॥२-३२-३७॥
translation: The staff he hurled crossed the bank of the river Sarayu and fell near a bull in the midst of a thousands cows.
word_meanings: तस्य his, करात् from the hand, च्युतः released, सः दण्डः that staff, सरयूपारम् the bank of Sarayu river, तीर्त्वा having crossed, बहुसाहस्रे in very many thousands, गोव्रजे in the midst of multitude of cows, उक्षणसन्निधौ near a bull, पपात fell.

text: तम् परिष्वज्य धर्मात्मा आतस्मात्सरयूतटात् । आनयामास ता गोपैस्त्रिजटायाश्रमम् प्रति ॥२-३२-३८॥
translation: The virtuous Rama embraced Trijata, and despatched all the cattle extending up to the bank of Sarayu to his hermitage.
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा virtuous , तम् him, परिष्वज्य having embraced, तस्मात् that, आसरयूतटात् up to the bank of Sarayu river, ताः those cows, गोपैः by herdsmen, त्रिजटाय Trijata's, आश्रमं प्रति towards the hermitage, आनयामास brought them.

text: उवाच च ततो रामस्तम् गार्ग्यमभिसान्त्वयन् । मन्युर्न खलु कर्तव्यः परिहासो ह्ययम् मम ॥२-३२-३९॥
translation: Afterwards Rama sought to placate Trijata, that descendant of Ganga, saying: This was a joke. Do not be angry.
word_meanings: ततः afterwards, रामः Rama, तं गार्ग्यम् that Gargya, अभिसान्त्वयन् consoling (him), उवाच said, मन्युः anger, न खलु कर्तव्यः should not be made, अयम् this, मम my, परिहासः a joke.

text: इदम् हि तेजस्तव यद्धुरत्ययम् । तदेव जिज्ञासितु मिच्छता मया । इमम् भवानर्थमभिप्रचोदितो । वृणीष्व किम्चेदपरम् व्यवस्यति ॥२-३२-४०॥
translation: Your power is unsurpassable and to ascertain this, I incited you to do this act. If there is anything else, ask for it.
word_meanings: तव your, दुरत्ययम् unsurpassable, यत् which, तेजः power, तत् that, जिज्ञासितुम् to ascertain, इच्छता एव indeed desiring, मया by me, भवान् you, इमम् this, अर्थम् act, अभिप्रचोदितः incited, अपरम् other, किम् any other, व्यवस्यति चेत् if sought, वृणीष्व you may ask for.

text: ब्रवीमि सत्येन न तेऽस्ति यन्त्रणा । धनम् हि यद्यन्मम विप्रकारणात् । भवत्सु सम्यक्र्पतिपादनेन त । न्मयार्जितम् प्रीतियश्स्करम् भवेत् ॥२-३२-४१॥
translation: Truly speaking, there is no limit to seeking wealth. My wealth is specifically meant for brahmins. By distributing all the wealth earned by me, I get pleasure and renown.
word_meanings: सत्येन truly, ब्रवीमि I speak, ते to you, यन्त्रणा restraint (to seek this much only), नास्ति is not there, मम my, यद्यत् whichever, धनम् wealth, विप्रकारणात् हि indeed for brahmins only, मया by me, र्जितम् earned, तत् that, भवत्सु in you, सम्यक् correctly, प्रतिपादनेन by offering, प्रीतियशस्करम् भवेत् gives me pleasure and renown.

text: तत स्सभार्य स्त्रिजटो महामुनि । र्गवामनीकम् प्रतिगृह्य मोदितः । यशोबलप्रीतिसुखोपबृम्हणी । स्तदाशिषः प्रत्यवदन्महात्मनः ॥२-३२-४२॥
translation: Thereafter that great sage Trijata along with his wife, immensely happy to receive multitudes of cows, pronounced blessings on the magnanimous Rama for glory, power, pleasure and prosperity.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, सभार्यः along with his wife, महामुनिः great sage, त्रिजटः Trijata, गवाम् cows, अनीकम् multitude, प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, मोदितः delighted, तदा then, महात्मनः magnanimous (Rama), यशोबलप्रीतिसुखोपबृंहणीः enhancing glory, power, pleasure and prosperity, आशिषः blessings, प्रत्यवदत् gave in reply.

text: स चापि रामः प्रतिपूर्णमानसो । महद्धनम् धर्मबलैरुपार्जितम् । नियोजयामास सुहृज्जनेऽचिरा । द्यथार्हसम्मानवचःप्रचोदितः ॥२-३२-४३॥
translation: Prompted by the deserving words of acclaim from his friends, Rama distributed with joy and without delay the entire wealth earned by him through dharma.
word_meanings: सः that, राम: चापि Rama also, प्रतिपूर्णमानसः with completely satisfied mind, धर्मबलैः through dharma, उपार्जितम् earned, महत् धनम् vast wealth, अचिरात् without delay, यथार्हसम्मानवचः प्रचोदितः prompted by the deserving words of acclaim, सुहृज्जने among his friends, नियोजयामास offered.

text: द्विजः सुहृद्भृत्यजनोऽथवा तदा । दरिद्रभिक्षाचरणश्च योऽभवत् । न तत्र कश्चिन्न बभूव तर्पितो । यथार्ह सम्मानन दान सम्ब्रमैः ॥२-३२-४४॥
translation: Thus there was none among those brahmins, attendants, poor people, and beggars, who was not satisfied with the honour (received) or with the charity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वात्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysecond sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: तत्र there, तदा then, यः such, द्विज: a brahmin, सुहृत् friend, अथवा or, भृत्यजनः servant, दरिद्र भिक्षाचरणश्च poor or beggar, कश्चित् any one, यथार्हसम्माननदानसम्भ्रमैः with the befitting honour or with charity, न तर्पितः not satisfied, न बभूव there was none.

text: दत्त्वा तु सह वैदेह्या ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनम् बहु । जग्मतुः पितरम् द्रष्टुम् सीतया सह राघवौ ॥२-३३-१॥
translation: After giving away plenty of wealth to brahmins in charity, Rama and Lakshmana along with Sita set out to see their father, king Dasaratha.
word_meanings: राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, वैदेह्या सह along with Sita, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to brahmins, बहु plenty, धनम् wealth, दत्वा having given (in charity), पितरम् to father, द्रष्टुम् to see, सीतया सह along with Sita, जग्मतुः both of them set out.

text: ततो गृहीते दुष्प्रेक्ष्येअशोभेताम् तदा आयुधे । माला दामभिर् आसक्ते सीतया समलम्कृते ॥२-३३-२॥
translation: The pair of dazzling weapons held (by Rama and Lakshmana) looked splendid decorated with flower garlands by Sita.
word_meanings: ततः then, दुष्प्रेक्षे dazzling, गृहीते held, सीतया by Sita, मालादामभिः with garlands, अबद्धे bound, समलङ्कृते decorated, तदायुथे pair of weapons of Rama and Lakshmana, अशोभेताम् shone.

text: ततः प्रासाद हर्म्याणि विमान शिखराणि च । अधिरुह्य जनः श्रीमान् उदासीनो व्यलोकयत् ॥२-३३-३॥
translation: The rich climbed their palaces and mansions, terraces of sevenstoried buildings and watched them sadly.
word_meanings: ततः then, श्रीमान् prosperous, जनः people, प्रासादहर्म्याणि palaces and mansions, विमानशिखराणि च terraces of sevenstoried buildings, अधिरुह्य having climbed, उदासीनः sad, व्यलोकयत् looked.

text: न हि रथ्याः स्म शक्यन्ते गन्तुम् बहु जन आकुलाः । आरुह्य तस्मात् प्रासादान् दीनाः पश्यन्ति राघवम् ॥२-३३-४॥
translation: The streets were so thronged with multitudes of citizens that they were impassable. Therefore, people felt miserable and ascended their mansions and gazed at Rama.
word_meanings: बहुजनाकुलाः thronged with multitudes of citizens, रथ्याः streets, गन्तुम् to walk, न शक्यन्ते स्म हि indeed were unable, तस्मात् for that reason, दीनाः miserable, प्रासादन् the palace, आरुह्य having ascended, राघवम् Rama, पश्यन्ति were looking.

text: पदातिम् वर्जितच् चत्रम् रामम् दृष्ट्वा तदा जनाः । ऊचुर् बहु विधा वाचः शोक उपहत चेतसः ॥२-३३-५॥
translation: Seeing Rama walking without the royal umbrella, people were very much shocked. They expressed their reaction in so many words:
word_meanings: तदा then, जनाः people, पदातिम् pedestrian, वर्जितच्छत्रम् without the (royal) umbrella, रामम् to Rama, दृष्ट्वा having seen, शोकोपहतचेतसः griefstricken, बहुविधाः in many ways, वाचः words, ऊचुः uttered.

text: यम् यान्तम् अनुयाति स्म चतुर् अन्ग बलम् महत् । तम् एकम् सीतया सार्धम् अनुयाति स्म लक्ष्मणः ॥२-३३-६॥
translation: Whenever Rama went out, powerful army of four divisions used to follow him. Today he is walking alone followed by Lakshmana and Sita.
word_meanings: यान्तम् while going, यम् whom, महत् powerful, चतुरङ्गबलम् army of four divisions, अनुयाति स्म used to follow, तम् such, एकम् alone, सीतया सार्धम् along with Sita, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अनुयाति स्म followed.

text: ऐश्वर्यस्य रसज्ञः सन् कामिनाम् चैव कामदः । न इच्चति एव अनृतम् कर्तुम् पितरम् धर्म गौरवात् ॥२-३३-७॥
translation: Rama who enjoyed the comforts of affluence gratifies those who have desires. Out of veneration for righteousness, he does not want to prove his father false (to his promise).
word_meanings: ऐश्वर्यस्य of affluence, रसज्ञः सन् while enjoying, कामिनाम् for those who have desires, कामदः चैव fulfiller of desires (Rama), धर्मगौरवात् out of veneration for righteousness, पितरं to father, अनृतम् false, कर्तुम् to make, नेच्छत्येव does not wish.

text: या न शक्या पुरा द्रष्टुम् भूतैः आकाशगैः अपि । ताम् अद्य सीताम् पश्यन्ति राज मार्ग गता जनाः ॥२-३३-८॥
translation: It was not possible even for the creatures wandering in the sky (birds) to have a glimpse of Sita before. Now passersby walking the highway can behold her.
word_meanings: पुरा earlier, या Sita, आकाशगैः by those wandering in the sky (birds), भूतैरपि creatures, द्रष्टुम् to see, न शक्या not possible, तां सीताम् to that Sita, अद्य now, राजमार्गगताः those walking on the highway, जनाः passersby, पश्यन्ति are beholding.

text: अङ्ग राग उचिताम् सीताम् रक्त चन्दन सेविनीम् । वर्षम् उष्णम् च शीतम् च नेष्यति आशु विवर्णताम् ॥२-३३-९॥
translation: Sita who used to apply fragrant unguents and smear the body with redsandal cream will now be exposed to the rain, the heat and the cold which will quickly discolour her body.
word_meanings: अङ्गरागोचिताम् used to fragrant unguents, रक्तचन्दन सेविनीम् smeared with red sandalpaste, सीताम् Sita, वर्षम् rain, उष्णं च heat, शीतं च cold, आशु quickly, विवर्णताम् discoloured, नेष्यन्ति will render.

text: अद्य नूनम् दशरथः सत्त्वम् आविश्य भाषते । न हि राजा प्रियम् पुत्रम् विवासयितुम् अर्हति ॥२-३३-१०॥
translation: Surely king Dasaratha possessed of an evil spirit spoke the way he did today. Otherwise, should a king banish his beloved son?
word_meanings: अद्य today, नूनम् surely, दशरथः Dasaratha, सत्त्वम् by evil spirit, आविश्य after being possessed by, भाषते is speaking, राजा king, प्रियम् beloved, पुत्रम् son, विवासयितुम् to banish, न अर्हति हि is not fit enough.

text: निर्गुणस्य अपि पुत्रस्या काथम् स्यात् विप्रवासनम् । किम् पुनर् यस्य लोको अयम् जितः वृत्तेन केवलम् ॥२-३३-११॥
translation: Even a son who is bereft of virtues cannot be banished, what to say about Rama, who by good conduct alone has conquered the world.
word_meanings: निर्गुणस्यापि even one bereft of virtues, पुत्रस्य of a son, विप्रवासनम् banishment, कथम् how, स्यात् can it be, यस्य whose, वृत्तेन केवलम् by good conduct alone, अयं लोकः this world, जितः conquered, किं पुनः why to say again?

text: आनृशम्स्यम् अनुक्रोशः श्रुतम् शीलम् दमः शमः । राघवम् शोभयन्ति एते षड् गुणाः पुरुष उत्तमम् ॥२-३३-१२॥
translation: Harmlessness, compassion, learning, good conduct, restraint of senses and selfcontrol, all these six qualities adorn Rama, the greatest among men.
word_meanings: आनृशंस्यम् harmlessness, अनुक्रोशः compassion, श्रुतम् learning, शीलम् good conduct, दमः restraint of senses, शमः self control, एते all these, षट् six, गुणाः qualities, पुरुषोत्तमम् greatest among men, राघवम् Rama, शोभयन्ति adorn.

text: तस्मात् तस्य उपघातेन प्रजाः परम पीडिताः । औदकानि इव सत्त्वानि ग्रीष्मे सलिल सम्क्षयात् ॥२-३३-१३॥
translation: Therefore, people are deeply pained to see Rama afflicted. They look like aquatic creatures in summer when the water dries up.
word_meanings: तस्मात् for that reason, तस्य Rama's, उपघातेन by hurting, ग्रीष्मे in summer, सलिलसङ्क्षयात् due to drying up of water, औदकानि aquatic, सत्त्वानीव like creatures, प्रजाः people, परमपीडिताः were highly tormented.

text: पीडया पीडितम् सर्वम् जगद् अस्य जगत् पतेः । मूलस्य इव उपघातेन वृक्षः पुष्प फल उपगः ॥२-३३-१४॥
translation: Just as severed at the root, an entire tree along with its fruits and flowers is destroyed, similarly the whole world gets afflicted when Rama, the ruler of the world, comes to harm.
word_meanings: जगत्पतेः of the ruler of the earth, अस्य this Rama's, पीडया on account of his suffering, सर्वम् entire, जगत् earth, मूलस्य at the root, उपघातेन by destruction, पुष्पफलोपगः bearing flowers and fruits, वृक्षः इव like a tree, पीडितम् is distressed.

text: मूलं ह्येष मनुष्याणाम् धर्मसारो महाद्युतिः । पुष्पम् फलम् च पत्रम् च शाखाश्चा स्येतरे जनाः ॥२-३३-१५॥
translation: Effulgent Rama personifies the essence of dharma. He is the root of (the tree of) humanity. The other people are connected with this tree like flowers, fruit, leaves and branches.
word_meanings: धर्मसारः the essence of dharma, महाद्युतिः effulgent, एषः this Rama, मनुष्याणाम् of humanity, मूलं हि is root indeed, इतरे other, जनाः people, अस्य Rama's (like the trunk of a tree), पुष्पम् flower, फलं च fruit as well, पत्रं च leaf also, शाखाश्च branches.

text: ते लक्ष्मणैव क्षिप्रम् सपत्न्यः सह बान्धवाः । गच्चन्तम् अनुगच्चामः येन गच्चति राघवः ॥२-३३-१६॥
translation: Let all of us without delay along with our wives and relations follow Rama, like Lakshmana, wherever he goes.
word_meanings: ते such men as we are, सपत्न्यः with (our) wives, सहबान्धवाः together with (our) relations, राघवः Rama, येन on which (way), गच्छति is going, गच्छन्तम् departing, लक्ष्मण इव like Lakshmana, क्षिप्रम् without delay, अनुगच्छामः we will follow.

text: उद्यानानि परित्यज्य क्षेत्राणि च गृहाणि च । एक दुह्ख सुखा रामम् अनुगच्चाम धार्मिकम् ॥२-३३-१७॥
translation: Deserting our gardens, fields and houses and experiencing the same joy and sorrow of the virtuous Rama, we shall follow him.
word_meanings: उद्यानानि gardens, क्षेत्राणि fields, गृहाणि च houses also, परित्यज्य deserting, एक दुःखसुखाः experiencing the same joy and sorrow (as Rama), धार्मिकम् virtuous, रामम् Rama, अनुगच्छामः shall follow.

text: समुद्धृत निधानानि परिध्वस्त अजिराणि च । उपात्त धन धान्यानि हृत साराणि सर्वशः ॥२-३३-१८॥
translation: Let Kaikeyi take possession of our deserted and dilapidated homes with ruined courtyards which seem as though struck by calamities. They are drained of wealth and foodgrains, covered with dust and abandoned by the gods. There is no water or smoke (from kitchen). They are infested with rats. They stand unswept. There foodgrains lie around ratholes, and broken earthenwares lie scattered. There are no offerings, no sacrifices, no recitation of sacred hymns, no libations and no invocations.
word_meanings: समुद्धृतनिधानानि with treasures unearthed, परिध्वस्ताजिराणि च and ruined courtyards, उपात्त धनधान्यानि with wealth and foodgrains removed, सर्वशः wholly, हृतसाराणि deprived of wealth, रजसा with dust, अभ्यवकीर्णानि spread, दैवतैः by gods, परित्यक्तानि abandoned, उद्बिलैः emerging out of burrows, परिथावद्भि: by those running quickly around, मूषकैः by rats, आवृतानि च filled with, अपेतोदकधूमानि (houses) without water and without (emitting) smoke, हीनसम्मार्जनानि च also unswept, प्रणष्टबलिकर्मेज्यामन्त्रहोमजपानि च absence of offerings, sacrifices, recitation of sacred hymns, libations, and invocations, दुष्कालेन famine, भग्नानि इव like dilapidated, भिन्नभाजनवन्ति च places with broken utensils, अस्मत्त्यक्तानि deserted by us, वेश्मानि homes, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, प्रतिपद्यताम् let her own.

text: रजसा अभ्यवकीर्णानि परित्यक्तानि दैवतैः । मूषकैः परिधावद्भिरुद्बिलैरावृतानि च ॥२-३३-१९॥
translation: Let Kaikeyi take possession of our deserted and dilapidated homes with ruined courtyards which seem as though struck by calamities. They are drained of wealth and foodgrains, covered with dust and abandoned by the gods. There is no water or smoke (from kitchen). They are infested with rats. They stand unswept. There foodgrains lie around ratholes, and broken earthenwares lie scattered. There are no offerings, no sacrifices, no recitation of sacred hymns, no libations and no invocations.
word_meanings: समुद्धृतनिधानानि with treasures unearthed, परिध्वस्ताजिराणि च and ruined courtyards, उपात्त धनधान्यानि with wealth and foodgrains removed, सर्वशः wholly, हृतसाराणि deprived of wealth, रजसा with dust, अभ्यवकीर्णानि spread, दैवतैः by gods, परित्यक्तानि abandoned, उद्बिलैः emerging out of burrows, परिथावद्भि: by those running quickly around, मूषकैः by rats, आवृतानि च filled with, अपेतोदकधूमानि (houses) without water and without (emitting) smoke, हीनसम्मार्जनानि च also unswept, प्रणष्टबलिकर्मेज्यामन्त्रहोमजपानि च absence of offerings, sacrifices, recitation of sacred hymns, libations, and invocations, दुष्कालेन famine, भग्नानि इव like dilapidated, भिन्नभाजनवन्ति च places with broken utensils, अस्मत्त्यक्तानि deserted by us, वेश्मानि homes, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, प्रतिपद्यताम् let her own.

text: अपेतोदकधूमानि हीनसम्मार्जनानि च । प्रनष्टबलिकर्मेज्यमन्त्रहोमजपानि च ॥२-३३-२०॥
translation: Let Kaikeyi take possession of our deserted and dilapidated homes with ruined courtyards which seem as though struck by calamities. They are drained of wealth and foodgrains, covered with dust and abandoned by the gods. There is no water or smoke (from kitchen). They are infested with rats. They stand unswept. There foodgrains lie around ratholes, and broken earthenwares lie scattered. There are no offerings, no sacrifices, no recitation of sacred hymns, no libations and no invocations.
word_meanings: समुद्धृतनिधानानि with treasures unearthed, परिध्वस्ताजिराणि च and ruined courtyards, उपात्त धनधान्यानि with wealth and foodgrains removed, सर्वशः wholly, हृतसाराणि deprived of wealth, रजसा with dust, अभ्यवकीर्णानि spread, दैवतैः by gods, परित्यक्तानि abandoned, उद्बिलैः emerging out of burrows, परिथावद्भि: by those running quickly around, मूषकैः by rats, आवृतानि च filled with, अपेतोदकधूमानि (houses) without water and without (emitting) smoke, हीनसम्मार्जनानि च also unswept, प्रणष्टबलिकर्मेज्यामन्त्रहोमजपानि च absence of offerings, sacrifices, recitation of sacred hymns, libations, and invocations, दुष्कालेन famine, भग्नानि इव like dilapidated, भिन्नभाजनवन्ति च places with broken utensils, अस्मत्त्यक्तानि deserted by us, वेश्मानि homes, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, प्रतिपद्यताम् let her own.

text: दुष्कालेनेव भग्नानि भिभाजनवन्ति च । अस्मत् त्यक्तानि वेश्मानि कैकेयी प्रतिपद्यताम् ॥२-३३-२१॥
translation: Let Kaikeyi take possession of our deserted and dilapidated homes with ruined courtyards which seem as though struck by calamities. They are drained of wealth and foodgrains, covered with dust and abandoned by the gods. There is no water or smoke (from kitchen). They are infested with rats. They stand unswept. There foodgrains lie around ratholes, and broken earthenwares lie scattered. There are no offerings, no sacrifices, no recitation of sacred hymns, no libations and no invocations.
word_meanings: समुद्धृतनिधानानि with treasures unearthed, परिध्वस्ताजिराणि च and ruined courtyards, उपात्त धनधान्यानि with wealth and foodgrains removed, सर्वशः wholly, हृतसाराणि deprived of wealth, रजसा with dust, अभ्यवकीर्णानि spread, दैवतैः by gods, परित्यक्तानि abandoned, उद्बिलैः emerging out of burrows, परिथावद्भि: by those running quickly around, मूषकैः by rats, आवृतानि च filled with, अपेतोदकधूमानि (houses) without water and without (emitting) smoke, हीनसम्मार्जनानि च also unswept, प्रणष्टबलिकर्मेज्यामन्त्रहोमजपानि च absence of offerings, sacrifices, recitation of sacred hymns, libations, and invocations, दुष्कालेन famine, भग्नानि इव like dilapidated, भिन्नभाजनवन्ति च places with broken utensils, अस्मत्त्यक्तानि deserted by us, वेश्मानि homes, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, प्रतिपद्यताम् let her own.

text: वनम् नगरम् एव अस्तु येन गच्चति राघवः । अस्माभिः च परित्यक्तम् पुरम् सम्पद्यताम् वनम् ॥२-३३-२२॥
translation: Since the scion of the Raghu race is going to the forest, let that forest itself be our city and let the city deserted by us become the forest.
word_meanings: राघवः scion of the Raghus, येन wherever, गच्छति is going, वनमेव forest itself, नगरम् as city, अस्तु shall be, अस्माभिः by us, परित्यक्तम् deserted, पुरं च the city also, वनम् as forest, सम्पद्यताम् may become.

text: बिलानि दम्ष्ट्रिणः सर्वे सानूनि मृग पक्षिणः । अस्मत् त्यक्तम् प्रपद्यन्ताम् सेव्यमानम् त्यजन्तु च ॥२-३३-२३॥
translation: Let all the fanged creatures leave their lairs, birds and animals the mountain slopes, lions and elephants, their haunts due to the fear caused by our presence and occupy the city left by us (on seeing us deserting).
word_meanings: सर्वे all, दंष्ट्रिणः fanged creatures, बिलानि lairs, मृगपक्षिणः animals and birds, सानूनि slopes of mountain, गजाः elephants, सिंहाः lions, वनानि च the forests, अस्मद्भयात् due to the fear caused by our presence, भीताः having been frightened, त्यजस्तु let them leave, अस्मत्त्यक्तम् left by us, प्रपद्यन्ताम् shall reach, सेव्यमानम् the place occupied by us, त्यजन्तु च desert.

text: इति एवम् विविधा वाचो नाना जन समीरिताः । तृणमाम्सफलादानाम् देशम् व्यालमृगद्विजम् ॥२-३३-२४॥
प्रपद्यताम् हि कैकेयी सपुत्रा सहबान्धवैः । राघावेण वने सर्वे सह वत्स्याम निर्वृताः ॥२-३३-२५॥
translation: Let Kaikeyi along with her son and her relatives acquire that country which will be inhabited by birds and animals living on grass, fruits, and flesh. Withdrawn, we shall happily live in the forest along with Rama.
word_meanings: कैकेयी Kaikeyi, सपुत्रा with her son, सहबान्धवैः with her relations, Rव्यालमृगद्विजम् occupied by birds and wild animals, तृणमांसफलादानाम् of those animals subsisting on grass, fruits and flesh, देशम् country, प्रपद्यतां हि be acquired, सर्वे all, निर्वृताः relieved, राघवेण सह with Rama, वने in the forest, वत्स्याम will live.

text: इत्येवम् विविधा वाचो नानाजनसमीरिताः । शुश्राव रामः श्रुत्वा च न विचक्रे अस्य मानसम् ॥२-३३-२६॥
translation: Such were the various words uttered by the people. Even after hearing them his (Rama's) mind remained unmoved (from his resolve).
word_meanings: रामः Rama, इत्येवम् this way, नानाजनसमीरिताः uttered by various people, विविधाः different, वाचः words, शुश्राव heard, श्रुत्वा च also having, अस्य his, मानसम् mind, न विचक्रे did not deviate.

text: स तु वेश्म पितुर्दूरा त्कैलासशिखरप्रभम् । अभिचक्राम धर्मात्मा मत्तमातङ्गविक्रमः ॥२-३३-२७॥
translation: Dutiful Rama, endowed with the prowess of an intoxicated elephant, approached the residence of his father that resembled from a distance the peak of mount Kailasa in splendour.
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा dutiful, मत्तमातङ्ग विक्रमः having the prowess of an intoxicated elephant, सः he (Rama), दूरात् from a distance, कैलासशिखरप्रभम् resembling the splendour of the peak of Kailasa, पितुः father's, वेश्म palace, अभिचक्राम reached.

text: विनीतवीरपुरुषं प्रविश्य तु नृपालयम् । ददर्शवस्थितम् दीनम् सुमन्त्रमविदूरतः ॥२-३३-२८॥
translation: Rama entered the royal palace guarded by welltrained warriors and not from very far saw Sumantra who stood a picture of dejection.
word_meanings: विनीतवीरपुरुषम् welltrained warriors, नृपालयम् royal palace, प्रविश्य तु having entered, अविदूरतः not from very far, अवस्थितम् standing, दीनम् dejected, सुमन्त्रम् Sumantra, ददर्श saw.

text: प्रतीक्षमाणो अभिजनम् तदा आर्तम् । अनार्त रूपः प्रहसन्न् इव अथ । जगाम रामः पितरम् दिदृक्षुः । पितुर् निदेशम् विधिवच् चिकीर्षुः ॥२-३३-२९॥
translation: Even after observing the people in grief, Rama did not reveal his sorrowful feelings. Bound by duty he went in as if with a smile to see his father.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, तदा then, आर्तम् distressed, जनम् people, प्रतीक्षमाणोऽपि even though observing, अनार्तरूपः without revealing his sorrowful feelings, अथ also, प्रहसन्निव looking as if smiling, पितुः father's, निदेशम् palace, विधिवत् in accordance with duty, चिकीर्षुः intent on carrying out, पितरम् father, दिदृक्षुः intent to see, जगाम went.

text: तत् पूर्वम् ऐक्ष्वाक सुतः महात्मा । रामः गमिष्यन् वनम् आर्त रूपम् । व्यतिष्ठत प्रेक्ष्य तदा सुमन्त्रम् । पितुर् महात्मा प्रतिहारण अर्थम् ॥२-३३-३०॥
translation: Seeing Sumantra stricken with grief for the first time the magnanimous Rama, scion of the Ikshvaku dynasty, on the way to the forest waited there for his father to be informed of his arrival.
word_meanings: ऐक्ष्वाकसुतः son of the Ikshvaku race, महात्मा great intellectual, महात्मा highly courageous, रामः Rama, तत् पूर्वम् for the first time, वनम् to the forest, गमिष्यन् while departing, तदा then, आर्तरूपम् sad appearance, सुमन्त्रम् Sumantra, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, पितुः to father, प्रतिहारणार्थम् to inform, व्यतिष्ठत stood.

text: पितुर्निदेशेन तु धर्मवत्सलो । वन प्रवेशे कृत बुद्धि निश्चयः । स राघवः प्रेक्ष्य सुमन्त्रम् अब्रवीन् । निवेदयस्व आगमनम् नृपाय मे ॥२-३३-३१॥
translation: Rama, lover of righteousness, determined to go to the forest in obedience to his father's command said to Sumantra, Inform the king of my arrival. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रयस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtythird sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: धर्मवत्सलः lover of righteousness, सः राघवः that son of the Raghus, पितुः father's, र्निदेशेन by command, वनप्रवेशे to enter forest, कृतबुद्धिनिश्चय: having made the decision, सुमन्त्रम् to Sumantra, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, अब्रवीत् said, नृपाय to king, मे my, आगमनम् arrival, निवेदयस्व inform

text: ततःकमलपत्राक्षः श्यामो निरुपमो महान् । उवाच रामस्तम् सूतं पितुराख्याहि मामिति ॥२-३४-१॥
translation: Let my father be informed of my arrival, said the lotuseyed, darkcomplexioned, venerable, peerless Rama to the charioteer.
word_meanings: ततः then, कमलपत्राक्षः lotuseyed, श्यामः of dark complexion, निरुपमः peerless, महान् great, रामः Rama, माम् about me, पितुः to father, आख्याहि inform, इति thus, तं सूतम् to that charioteer, उवाच he said.

text: स राम प्रेषितः क्षिप्रम् सम्ताप कलुष इन्द्रियः । प्रविश्य नृपतिम् सूतः निह्श्वसन्तम् ददर्श ह ॥२-३४-२॥
translation: At the command of Rama, charioteer Sumantra whose senses were overwhelmed with grief quickly entered the apartment of the king and found him heaving sighs.
word_meanings: सन्तापकलुषेन्द्रिय: senses overwhelmed with grief, सः सूतः that charioteer (Sumantra), रामप्रेषितः sent forth by Rama, क्षिप्रम् quickly, प्रविश्य having entered, निःश्वसन्तम् sighing, नृपतिम् to king Dasaratha, ददर्श saw.

text: उपरक्तमिवादित्यं भस्मच्छन्नमिवानलम् । तटाकमिव निस्तोयमपश्यज्जगतीपतिम् ॥२-३४-३॥
translation: He saw the lord of the world (Dasaratha) dull like the Sun in eclipse, like the fire covered with ashes, like a tank with its water dried up.
word_meanings: उपरक्तम् eclipsed, आदित्यम् इव like the Sun, भस्मच्छन्नम् covered with ashes, अनलम् इव like fire, निस्तोयम् dried up, तटाकम् इव like a tank, जगतीपतिम् lord of the world, अपश्यत् saw.

text: आलोक्य तु महा प्राज्ञः परम आकुल चेतसम् । रामम् एव अनुशोचन्तम् सूतः प्रान्जलिर् आसदत् ॥२-३४-४॥
translation: Seeing the king brooding over Rama, in an extremely agitated state, the sagacious charioteer approached him with folded hands.
word_meanings: महाप्राज्ञः sagacious one, सूतः charioteer, राममेव to Rama only, अनुशोचन्तम् grieving, परमाकुल चेतनम् extremely agitated mind, आलोक्य तु having seen, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, आसदत् approached.

text: तम् वर्धयित्वा राजानम् सूतः पूर्वम् जयाशिषा । भयविक्लबया वाचा मन्दया श्लक्ष्णमब्रवीत् ॥२-३४-५॥
translation: At first greeting the king with the words 'victory be yours', the charioteer, trembling with fear, gently said in a feeble voice.
word_meanings: सूतः the charioteer, तं राजानम् to that king (Dasaratha), पूर्वम् at first, जयाशिषा greeting with (the words) 'Victory be yours', वर्धयित्वा having greeted, भयविक्लबया trembling with fear, मन्दया in a feeble, वाचा voice, श्लक्ष्णम् gently, अब्रवीत् said.

text: अयम् स पुरुष व्याघ्र द्वारि तिष्ठति ते सुतः । ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनम् दत्त्वा सर्वम् चैव उपजीविनाम् ॥२-३४-६॥
translation: Your son Rama, the best of men, having given away his entire wealth in charity to brahmins and to all the dependents is waiting at the entrance.
word_meanings: पुरुषव्याघ्रः a tiger among men (best of men), सः अयम् ते सुतः this son of yours, (Rama), ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to brahmins, उपजीविनां चैव to all the dependents, सर्वम् entire, धनम् wealth, दत्त्वा having given away (in charity), द्वारि at the entrance, तिष्ठति is waiting.

text: स त्वा पश्यतु भद्रम् ते रामः सत्य पराक्रमः । सर्वान् सुहृदाअपृच्च्य त्वाम् इदानीम् दिदृक्षते ॥२-३४-७॥
translation: Be blessed audience may be granted to Rama who possesses proven prowess, and now waits, after taking leave of his friends, to see you.
word_meanings: ते to you, भद्रम् may you prosper, सत्यपराक्रमः possessing proven prowess, सः रामः that Rama, त्वा you, पश्यतु let him see, सर्वान् all, सुहृदः friends, आपृच्छय after taking leave, इदानीम् now, त्वाम् you, दिदृक्षते desirous of seeing you.

text: गमिष्यति महा अरण्यम् तम् पश्य जगती पते । वृतम् राज गुणैः सर्वैः आदित्यम् इव रश्मिभिः ॥२-३४-८॥
translation: O Lord of the world behold him embellished with all princely virtues like the Sun encircled with its rays, (now) leaving for the forest.
word_meanings: महारण्यम् to wild forest, गमिष्यति he will go, जगतीपते O Lord of the world, सर्वैः by all, राजगुणैः princely virtues, वृतम् embellisted with, तम् he, रश्मिभिः (encircled) by rays, आदित्यमिव like the Sun, पश्य see.

text: स सत्य वादी धर्म आत्मा गाम्भीर्यात् सागर उपमः । आकाशैव निष्पन्को नर इन्द्रः प्रत्युवाच तम् ॥२-३४-९॥
translation: That truthful and virtuous king (Dasaratha) who was deep like the ocean and free from mud (pure) like the sky replied:
word_meanings: सत्यवादी truthful, धर्मात्मा virtuous, गाम्भीर्यात् in depth, सागरोपमः like the ocean, आकाश इव like the sky, निष्पङ्क: free from mud (clean), सः नरेन्द्रः that king, तम् to him (Sumantra), प्रत्युवाच replied.

text: सुमन्त्र आनय मे दारान् ये केचित् इह मामकाः । दारैः परिवृतः सर्वैः द्रष्टुम् इच्चामि राघवम् ॥२-३४-१०॥
translation: O Sumantra bring all my consorts who are here. In the company of all my wives, I desire to give audience to virtuous Rama.
word_meanings: सुमन्त्र: Sumantra, मामकाः all my (consorts), ये केचित् whosoever, इह are here, मे दारान् my wives, आनय bring them, सर्वैः by all, दारैः with wives, परिवृतः surrounded by, धार्मिकम् virtuous Rama, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I want.

text: सो अन्तः पुरम् अतीत्य एव स्त्रियः ता वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । आर्यो ह्वयति वो राजा गम्यताम् तत्र माचिरम् ॥२-३४-११॥
translation: O venerable ones, king Dasaratha summons you. Go there without delay, said Sumantra to the king's consorts after crossing the inner apartment.
word_meanings: सः Sumantra, अन्तःपुरम् inner apartment, अतीत्यैव having crossed, ताः those, स्त्रियः to the ladies, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, आर्याः venerable ones, वः you, राजा king, आह्वयति summons, तत्र there, गम्यताम् please go, चिरम् मा do not delay.

text: एवम् उक्ताः स्त्रियः सर्वाः सुमन्त्रेण नृप आज्ञया । प्रचक्रमुस् तत् भवनम् भर्तुर् आज्ञाय शासनम् ॥२-३४-१२॥
translation: Thus addressed by Sumantra in accordance with the king's order, all the women went to their husband's palace.
word_meanings: नृपाज्ञया by king's order, सुमन्त्रेण by Sumantra, एवम् in this way, उक्ताः spoken, सर्वाः all, स्त्रियः ladies, भर्तुः husband's, शासनम् command, आज्ञाय having known, तद्भवनम् to the palace, प्रचक्रमुः went.

text: अर्ध सप्त शताः ताः तु प्रमदाः ताम्र लोचनाः । कौसल्याम् परिवार्य अथ शनैः जग्मुर् धृत व्रताः ॥२-३४-१३॥
translation: Thereafter, Kausalya surrounded by three hundred and fifty ladies who were faithful to their vows, reached there slowly with their eyes turned copperred (in grief).
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, धृतव्रताः faithful to their vows, ताम्रलोचनाः women with copperred eyes, ताः those, अर्धसप्तशताः half of seven hundred (three hundred and fifty), प्रमदाः women, कौशल्याम् to Kausalya, परिवार्य surrounding, शनैः slowly, जग्मुः reached.

text: आगतेषु च दारेषु समवेक्ष्य मही पतिः । उवाच राजा तम् सूतम् सुमन्त्र आनय मे सुतम् ॥२-३४-१४॥
translation: Usher in my son (Rama), O Sumantra, said the lord of the world (king Dasaratha) to the charioteer on seeing his wives arrive.
word_meanings: दारेषु the wives आगतेषु having arrived, महीपतिः lord of the world (Dasaratha), राजा king, समवेक्ष्य having seen, तं सूतम् to that charioteer, उवाच said, सुमन्त्र Sumantra, मे सुतम् my son (Rama), आनय usher in

text: स सूतः रामम् आदाय लक्ष्मणम् मैथिलीम् तदा । जगाम अभिमुखः तूर्णम् सकाशम् जगती पतेः ॥२-३४-१५॥
translation: Then the charioteer fetched Rama, Lakshmana and Sita and advanced towards the king without delay.
word_meanings: सः सूतः that charioteer, तदा then, रामम् to Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, मैथिलीम् to Sita, आदाय having brought, तूर्णम् without delay, जगतीपतेः the king's, सकाशम् presence, अभिमुखः facing, जगाम went.

text: स राजा पुत्रम् आयान्तम् दृष्ट्वा दूरात् कृत अन्जलिम् । उत्पपात आसनात् तूर्णम् आर्तः स्त्री जन सम्वृतः ॥२-३४-१६॥
translation: When the king saw from a distance his son coming with folded hands, he, surrounded by the ladies and tormented with grief, stood up.
word_meanings: स्त्रीजनसंवृतः surrounded by women, सः राजा that king, कृताञ्जलिम् with folded hands, आयान्तम् coming, पुत्रम् son, दूरात् at distance, दृष्ट्वा having seen, आर्तः with grief, तूर्णम् suddenly, आसनात् from the throne, उत्पपात stood up.

text: सो अभिदुद्राव वेगेन रामम् दृष्ट्वा विशाम् पतिः । तम् असम्प्राप्य दुह्ख आर्तः पपात भुवि मूर्चितः ॥२-३४-१७॥
translation: At the sight of Rama, the lord of men (king Dasaratha), tortured with grief, immediately ran towards him but before he could reach him, fell unconscious on the floor.
word_meanings: विशाम् पतिः lord of men, रामम् to Rama, दृष्ट्वा having seen, वेगेन quickly, अभिदुद्राव ran forward, असम्प्राप्य unable to reach, दुःखार्तः tormented with grief, मूर्च्छितः unconscious, भुवि on the ground, पपात he fell.

text: तम् रामः अभ्यपातत् क्षिप्रम् लक्ष्मणः च महा रथः । विसम्ज्ञम् इव दुह्खेन सशोकम् नृपतिम् तदा ॥२-३४-१८॥
translation: Rama and the mighty warrior Lakshmana, quickly reached the king who lay as though he had lost his senses due to grief.
word_meanings: तदा then, दुःखेन due to agony, विसंज्ञम् इव like one who had lost his senses, सशोकम् with grief, तं नृपतिम् to that king, रामः Rama, महारथः a mighty warrior, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana also, क्षिप्रम् quickly, अभ्यपतत् reached.

text: स्त्री सहस्र निनादः च सम्जज्ञे राज वेश्मनि । हाहा राम इति सहसा भूषण ध्वनि मूर्चितः ॥२-३४-१९॥
translation: All on a sudden there arose from (the mouths of) a thousand women of the palace cries of 'alas, alas, Rama' mingled with the tinkling sounds of their ornaments.
word_meanings: सहसा suddenly, राजवेश्मनि in the palace, भूषणध्वनिमूर्छितः mingled with the (tinkling) sounds of ornaments, हा हा राम इति alas, alas, Rama, स्त्री सहस्रनिनादश्च wailing of a thousand women, संजज्ञे was produced.

text: तम् परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्याम् ताव् उभौ राम लक्ष्मणौ । पर्यन्के सीतया सार्धम् रुदन्तः समवेशयन् ॥२-३४-२०॥
translation: Thereafter Rama and Lakshmana assisted by Sita, lifted him wailing in their arms and laid him on a couch.
word_meanings: तौ those, उभौ two, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, सीतया सार्धम् along with Sita, तम् him (Dasaratha), बाहुभ्याम् with their arms, परिष्वज्य having embraced, रुदन्तः while wailing, पर्यङ्के on the couch, समवेशयन् seated.

text: अथ रामः मुहूर्तेन लब्ध सम्ज्ञम् मही पतिम् । उवाच प्रान्जलिर् भूत्वा शोक अर्णव परिप्लुतम् ॥२-३४-२१॥
translation: After the king regained his consciousness in a moment, Rama with folded hands said to him, who was immersed in a sea of sorrow:
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, रामः Rama, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, भूत्वा being, मुहूर्तेन in a moment , लब्धसंज्ञम् who regained consciousness, शोकार्णवपरिप्लुतम् immersed in the sea of sorrow, महीपतिम् to the king, उवाच said.

text: आपृच्चे त्वाम् महा राज सर्वेषाम् ईश्वरः असि नः । प्रस्थितम् दण्डक अरण्यम् पश्य त्वम् कुशलेन माम् ॥२-३४-२२॥
translation: O great king, I am asking leave of you, for you are lord of all of us. I am set to depart for the Dandaka forest. See me (off) in a cheerful mood.
word_meanings: महाराज O great king, त्वाम् you, अपृच्छे I am seeking leave, सर्वेषाम् of all, न: of us, ईश्वरः असि you are the Lord, त्वम् you, कुशलेन cheerfully, दण्डकारण्यम् to Dandaka forest, प्रस्थितम् departing, माम् me, पश्य you may see.

text: लक्ष्मणम् च अनुजानीहि सीता च अन्वेति माम् वनम् । कारणैः बहुभिस् तथ्यैः वार्यमाणौ न च इच्चतः ॥२-३४-२३॥
translation: Allow Lakshmana and Sita to follow me into the forest. I tried to dissuade them with a number of reasons but they did not agree.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मणं च (to) Lakshmana also, अनुजानीहि may allow, सीता च Sita also, माम् me, वनम् to the forest, अन्वेति will be following, तथ्यैः by genuine, बहुभिः many, कारणैः with reasons, वार्यमाणौ dissuaded, न च इच्छतः both do not agree.

text: अनुजानीहि सर्वान् नः शोकम् उत्सृज्य मानद । लक्ष्मणम् माम् च सीताम् च प्रजापतिर् इव प्रजाः ॥२-३४-२४॥
translation: Discard your grief and, like Brahma, the creator, allow Lakshmana, Sita and me all of us, your subjects, O respector of men
word_meanings: मानद O respector of men, शोकम् grief, उत्सृज्य discarding, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, मां च also me, सीतां च to Sita too, सर्वान् all, नः us, प्रजापतिः creator Bramha, प्रजाः इव like subjects, अनुजानीहि permit.

text: प्रतीक्षमाणम् अव्यग्रम् अनुज्ञाम् जगती पतेः । उवाच रर्जा सम्प्रेक्ष्य वन वासाय राघवम् ॥२-३४-२५॥
translation: On seeing Rama, unruffled, waiting for his permission to proceed to the forest, the lord of the earth, king Dasaratha said:
word_meanings: राजा king, वनवासाय to dwell in the forest, जगतीपतेः king's (his), अनुज्ञाम् permission, प्रतीक्षमाणम् awaiting, अव्यग्रम् to the unruffled, राघवम् to Rama, सम्प्रेक्ष्य having seen, उवाच said.

text: अहम् राघव कैकेय्या वर दानेन मोहितः । अयोध्यायाः त्वम् एव अद्य भव राजा निगृह्य माम् ॥२-३४-२६॥
translation: I have been deluded by Kaikeyi into bestowing boons. Imprison me and be now king of Ayodhya, O scion of the Raghu dynasty
word_meanings: राघव O Son of the Raghu dynasty, अहम् I, कैकेय्या Kaikeyi's, वरदानेन by bestowing boons, मोहितः have been deluded, अद्य now, माम् me, निगृह्य by confining, त्वमेव yourself, अयोध्यायाः of Ayodhya, राजा भव be king.

text: एवम् उक्तः नृपतिना रामः धर्मभृताम् वरः । प्रत्युवाच अन्जलिम् कृत्वा पितरम् वाक्य कोविदः ॥२-३४-२७॥
translation: Thus spoken to by the king, Rama, skilled in speech and upholder of righteousness, replied to his father with folded palms:
word_meanings: धर्मभृताम् among upholders of righteousness, वरः best, वाक्यकोविदः skilled in speech, रामः Rama, नृपतिना by the king, एवम् in this way, उक्तः spoken, अञ्जलिं कृत्वा with folded palms, पितरम् to his father, प्रत्युवाच replied.

text: भवान् वर्ष सहस्राय पृथिव्या नृपते पतिः । अहम् तु अरण्ये वत्स्यामि न मे कार्यम् त्वया अनृतम् ॥२-३४-२८॥
translation: You will remain the lord of this earth for a thousand years to come, O king As for me, I will dwell in the forest. Do not deviate from truth on my account.
word_meanings: नृपते O king, वर्षसहस्राय for a thousand years, भवान् you alone, पृथिव्याः of this earth, पतिः are the lord, अहं तु as for me, अरण्ये in the forest, वत्स्यामि I will dwell, त्वया by you, मे to me, अनृतम् untruth, न कार्यम् should not be done.

text: नव पञ्च च वर्षाणि वनवासे विहृत्य ते । पुनः पादौ ग्रहीष्यामि प्रतिज्ञान्ते नराधिपः ॥२-३४-२९॥
translation: Having fulfilled the vow on the completion of fourteen years of wandering in the forest I shall come back to touch your feet, O lord of men
word_meanings: नराधिप O lord of men (king), नव पञ्च च nine plus five (fourteen), वर्षाणि years, वनवासे dwelling in the forest, विहृत्य after wandering, प्रतिज्ञान्ते after fulfilling the vow, पुनः again, ते your, पादौ feet, ग्रहीष्यामि I will grasp.

text: रुदन्नाह प्रियम् पुत्रं सत्यपाशेन संयतः । कैकेय्या चोद्यमान्स्तु मिथो राजा तमब्रवीत् ॥२-३४-३०॥
translation: The king who was bound by the cord of truth and instigated by Kaikeyi said, wailing in distress:
word_meanings: सत्यपाशेन by the cord of truth, संयतः bound, राजा king, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, मिथः by mutual talk, चोद्यमानस्तु instigated (to send Rama away), आर्तः distressed, रुदन् while wailing, तम् that, प्रियं पुत्रम् beloved son Rama, अब्रवीत् said.

text: श्रेयसे वृद्धये तात पुनर् आगमनाय च । गच्चस्व अरिष्टम् अव्यग्रः पन्थानम् अकुतः भयम् ॥२-३४-३१॥
translation: Go, my dear child, wish you wellMay your path be auspicious, free from obstacles and fear (from any quarters). Come back (after fulfilment of the pledge)
word_meanings: तात dear child, Rama, अरिष्टम् auspicious, अव्यग्रम् without sorrows, अकुतोभयम् without threat (from any quarter), पन्थानम् path, श्रेयसे for your welfare, वृद्धये for prosperity, पुनः आगमनाय च and to return, गच्छस्व go.

text: न हि सत्यात्मनस्तात धर्माभिमनसस्तव । विनिवर्त यितुं बुद्धि शक्यते रघुनन्दन ॥२-३४-३२॥
translation: O my beloved son O delight of the Raghus you are devoted to truth and duty. It is difficult to dissuade you from your resolve .
word_meanings: तात dear child, रघुनन्दन delight of the Raghus (Rama), सत्यात्मनः upright one, धर्माभिमनसः devoted to duty, तव your, बुद्धि: mind, विनिवर्तयितुम् to dissuade, न शक्यते हि am not able.

text: अद्य तु इदानीम् रजनीम् पुत्र मा गच्च सर्वथा । मातरम् माम् च सम्पश्यन् वस इमाम् अद्य शर्वरीम् ॥२-३४-३३॥
मातरं माम् च सम्पश्यन् वसेमामद्य शर्वरीम् । तर्पितः सर्वकामैस्त्वम् स्वः काले साधयिष्यसि ॥२-३४-३४॥
translation: Stay tonight in the company of your mother and me. With all our desire satisfied, you can set out tomorrow at the appropriate time.
word_meanings: मातरम् mother, मां च me also, सम्पश्यन् seeing, अद्य today, इमाम् this, शर्वरीम् night, वस stay, सर्वकामैः with all desires, तर्पितः satisfied, त्वम् you, श्वः tomorrow, काले in proper time, साधयिष्यसि set out.

text: दुष्करम् क्रियते पुत्र सर्वथा राघव तया । मत्प्रियार्थम् प्रियाम्स्त्यक्त्वा यद्यासि विजनम् वनम् ॥२-३४-३५॥
translation: O my son, O descendant of the Raghus, you are called upon to accomplish, by all means, a very difficult task. For the sake of my pleasure you are forsaking your dear ones and going to the desolate forest.
word_meanings: पुत्र son, राघव descendant of the Raghus, त्वया by you, सर्वथा by all means, दुष्करम् difficult task, क्रियते is being done, यत् for that reason, मत् प्रियार्थम् for the sake of my pleasure, प्रियान् dear ones, त्यक्त्वा having forsaken, विजनम् deserted place, वनम् to the forest, यासि are going.

text: न चैतन्मे प्रियम् पुत्र शपे सत्येन राघव । छन्नया छलितस्त्वस्नु स्त्रुया छन्नाग्निकल्पया ॥२-३४-३६॥
translation: I swear by truth, O my beloved son, that your departure to the forest is in no way a pleasure to me. With a hidden motive, this woman who is like fire concealed by ashes has duped me.
word_meanings: पुत्र O son, राघव Rama, एतत् all this, मे to me, प्रियम् pleasing, न च not, सत्येन on truth, शपे am swearing, छन्नाग्निकल्पया by a woman resembling concealed fire, छन्नया with a hidden motive, स्त्रिया by a woman, चलितः अस्मि I am deceived.

text: पञ्चना या तु लब्धा मे तां त्वम् निस्तर्तुमिच्छसि । अनया वृत्तसादिन्या कैकेय्याऽभिप्रचोदितः ॥२-३४-३७॥
translation: Instigated by this Kaikeyi, the destroyer of traditions (of the race) I have been deceived for which you wish to pay.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, वृत्तसादिन्या one who destroys the tradition of the race, अनया this, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, अभिप्रचोदितः having been instigated, या वञ्चना whichever deceit, लब्धा has been experienced, ताम् that one, निस्तर्तुम् to cross over, इच्छसि wish.

text: न चैतदाश्चर्यतमम् यत्तज्ज्येष्ठस्सुतो मम । अपानृतकथम् पुत्र पितरम् कर्तुमिच्छ्सि ॥२-३४-३८॥
translation: It is not a great surprise that you, O my son, being the eldest, want to make your father free from a false promise.
word_meanings: पुत्र son, मम my, ज्येष्ठः eldest, सुतः son, पितरम् of father, अपानृतकथम् free from a false promise, कर्तुम् to do, इच्छसि (इति) यत् that you wish, तत् एतत् all that, आश्चर्यतमम् most wonderful, न not.

text: अथ रामः तथा श्रुत्वा पितुर् आर्तस्य भाषितम् । लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा दीनो वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-३४-३९॥
translation: Rama and Lakshmana were sad to hear the words of their anguished father. Rama replies:
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, रामः Rama, तथा in that way, आर्तस्य of the distressed one, पितुः father's, भाषितम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, भ्रात्रा with brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह along with Lakshmana, दीनः distressed, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: प्राप्स्यामि यान् अद्य गुणान् को मे श्वस्तान् प्रदास्यति । अपक्रमणम् एव अतः सर्व कामैः अहम् वृणे ॥२-३४-४०॥
translation: Who will give me the merit (of propriety) I earn today? Therefore, I want to depart (today), discarding all my desires.
word_meanings: अद्य today, यान् गुणान् merit, प्राप्स्यामि obtain, तान् those, श्वः tomorrow, मे to me, कः who, प्रदास्यति will give, अतः therefore, सर्वकामैः with all desires, अपक्रमणमेव departing, अहम् I, वृणे am seeking.

text: इयम् सराष्ट्रा सजना धन धान्य समाकुला । मया विसृष्टा वसुधा भरताय प्रदीयताम् ॥२-३४-४१॥
translation: The kingdom abdicated by me with all its people, its wealth and foodgrains may be bestowed on Bharata.
