translation: With folded palms Sumantra informed the prince that a chariot, decked in gold and harnessed with excellent horses, is ready.
word_meanings: सूतः the charioteer (Sumantra), अञ्जलिं कृत्वा with folded palms, राजपुत्राय the king's son, कनकभूषितम् decked in gold, परमवाजिभिः with excellent horses, युक्तम् harnessed, तं रथम् that chariot, आचचक्षे informed.

text: राजा सत्वरम् आहूय व्यापृतम् वित्त सम्चये । उवाच देश कालज्ञो निश्चितम् सर्वतः शुचि ॥२-३९-१४॥
translation: The king who was aware of the right place and time summoned hurriedly the treaury officer, who was firm and honest and said to him:
word_meanings: राजा the king, देशकालज्ञो aware of (the right) place and time, निश्चितम् firm, सर्वतः in every way, शुचिम् honest, वित्तसञ्चये in the treasury, व्यापृतम् working as officer, सत्वरम् hurriedly, आहूय having summoned, उवाच said.

text: वासाम्सि च महा अर्हाणि भूषणानि वराणि च । वर्षाणि एतानि सम्ख्याय वैदेह्याः क्षिप्रम् आनय ॥२-३९-१५॥
translation: Assess the (needs for) number of years the princess of Videha (Sita) is going to be in the forest, and fetch her quickly highly valuable garments and excellent ornaments.
word_meanings: एतानि these, वर्षाणि years, सङ्ख्याय calculating, वैदेह्याः for the princess of Videha (Sita), महार्हाणि highly valuable, वासांसि च garments, वराणि excellent, भूषणानि च ornaments, क्षिप्रम् quickly, आनय fetch.

text: नर इन्द्रेण एवम् उक्तः तु गत्वा कोश गृहम् ततः । प्रायच्चत् सर्वम् आहृत्य सीतायै क्षिप्रम् एव तत् ॥२-३९-१६॥
translation: Ordered thus by the king, the officer went to the treasury, collected all the things and presented them to Sita.
word_meanings: नरेन्द्रेण by the king, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, ततः then, कोशगृहम् to the treasury, गत्वा having gone, सर्वम् all those things, आहृत्य having brought, तत् that, सममेव wholly, सीतायै for Sita, प्रायच्छत् gave.

text: सा सुजाता सुजातानि वैदेही प्रस्थिता वनम् । भूषयाम् आस गात्राणि तैः विचित्रैः विभूषणैः ॥२-३९-१७॥
translation: That princess of noble birth from Videha adorned her beautiful limbs with the sparkling ornaments and got ready to depart for the forest.
word_meanings: वनम् to the forest, प्रस्थिता ready to depart, सुजाता of noble birth, सा वैदेहि that princess from Videha (Sita), सुजातानि beautiful, गात्राणि limbs, विचित्रैः sparkling, तैः विभूषणैः those ornaments, भूषयामास adorned.

text: व्यराजयत वैदेही वेश्म तत् सुविभूषिता । उद्यतः अम्शुमतः काले खम् प्रभा इव विवस्वतः ॥२-३९-१८॥
translation: Welladorned Sita illumined the palace like the rising Sun lighting up the sky at dawn.
word_meanings: सुविभूषिता well adorned, वैदेही Sita, तत् वेश्म that palace, काले at dawn, उद्यतः rising, विवस्वतः Sun's, प्रभा light, खमिव like sky, व्यराजयत got illumined.

text: ताम् भुजाभ्याम् परिष्वज्य श्वश्रूर् वचनम् अब्रवीत् । अनाचरन्तीम् कृपणम् मूध्नि उपाघ्राय मैथिलीम् ॥२-३९-१९॥
translation: Kausalya, Sita's motherinlaw, took her in her arms, embraced her, kissed her on the forehead, and said to her who conducted herself without evoking any pity.
word_meanings: श्वश्रूः motherinlaw ( Kausalya), कृपणम् compassionately, अनाचरन्तीम् not acting, तां मैथिलीम् that princess from Mithila (Sita), भुजाभ्याम् with arms, परिष्वज्य having embraced, मूर्ध्नि on the forehead, उपाघ्राय after kissing, अब्रवीत् said.

text: असत्यः सर्व लोके अस्मिन् सततम् सत्कृताः प्रियैः । भर्तारम् न अनुमन्यन्ते विनिपात गतम् स्त्रियः ॥२-३९-२०॥
translation: Those women who, although always gratified, do not follow their husband when they fall into misfortune, are regarded as unfaithful.
word_meanings: अस्मिन् in this, सर्वलोके in all the worlds, असत्यः untrue, स्त्रियः women, प्रियैः by husbands, सततम् at all times, सत्कृताः though honoured, विनिपातगतम् fallen into misfortunes, भर्तारम् husband, नानुमन्यन्ते do not agree (follow).

text: एष स्वभावो नारीणामनुभूय पुरा सुखम् । अल्पामप्यापदम् प्राप्य दुष्यन्ति प्रजहत्यपि ॥२-३९-२१॥
translation: Though they have enjoyed all pleasures (with their husbands) earlier, they censure them in the wake of the slightest trouble or even abandon them. This is the nature of women.
word_meanings: पुरा earlier, सुखम् pleasures, अनुभूय having enjoyed, अल्पामपि though in small measure, आपदम् trouble, प्राप्य having obtained, दुष्यन्ति censure them, प्रजहत्यपि or even abandon them, एषः this, नारीणाम् women's, स्वभावः nature.

text: असत्यशीला विकृता दुर्र्गाह्याहृदयास्तथा । युवत्यः पापसम्कल्पाः क्षणमात्राद्विरागिणः ॥२-३९-२२॥
translation: Evilminded young ladies are infidels. They are of perverted nature. They are inscrutable. In an instant they lose their love (for their husbands).
word_meanings: पापसङ्कल्पाः evilminded, युवत्यः young ladies, असत्यशीलाः infidel, विकृताः perverted ones, तथा also, दुर्ग्राह्यहृदयाः hard to read their hearts, क्षणमात्रात् in an instant, विरागिणः are devoid of affection.

text: न कुलम् न कृतम् विद्या न दत्तम् नापि सम्ग्रहः । स्त्रीणाम् गृह्णाति हृदयमनित्यहृदया हि ताः ॥२-३९-२३॥
translation: Neither family traditions nor benefits received, nor education nor affection nor gifts nor even accumulated wealth attract women's hearts. Their minds are unstable indeed.
word_meanings: स्त्रीणाम् women's, हृदयम् heart, कुलम् family tradition, न गृह्णाति does not attract, कृतम् benefit received, न not, विद्या education, दत्तम् gifts, न not, सङ्ग्रहः अपि not even accumulated wealth, न not, ताः those, अनित्यहृदयाः हि unstable minds indeed.

text: साध्वीनाम् हि स्थितानाम् तु शीले सत्ये श्रुते शमे । स्त्रीणाम् पवित्रम् परमम् पतिरेको विशिष्यते ॥२-३९-२४॥
translation: But for those virtuous women whose minds are fixed in chastity, truth, scriptures and stability, the husband occupies a distinguished place and is considered supremely holy.
word_meanings: तु but, शीले in chastity, सत्ये in truth, श्रुते in scriptures, शमे in stability, स्थितानाम् remaining fixed, साध्वीनाम् of virtuous ones, स्त्रीणाम् women, एकः only, पतिः husband, परमम् supreme, पवित्रम् as holy, विशिष्यते is distinguished.

text: स त्वया न अवमन्तव्यः पुत्रः प्रव्राजितः मम । तव दैवतम् अस्तु एष निर्धनः सधनो अपि वा ॥२-३९-२५॥
translation: You must not underestimate my son in his exile. You must treat him as your god whether he is wealthy or not.
word_meanings: प्रव्राजितः exiled, मम my, सः पुत्रः son, त्वया by you, नावमन्तव्यः is not to be underestimated, निर्धनः without wealth, सधनोऽपि वा or with wealth, एषः he, तव your, दैवम् अस्तु be your god.

text: विज्ञाय वचनम् सीता तस्या धर्म अर्थ सम्हितम् । कृत अन्जलिर् उवाच इदम् श्वश्रूम् अभिमुखे स्थिता ॥२-३९-२६॥
translation: Sita who understood the import of these words which were in conformity with dharma and artha, repiled to her motherinlaw facing her with folded palms:
word_meanings: सीता Sita, तस्याः her, धर्मार्थसंहितम् in conformity with dharma and artha, वचनम् words, विज्ञाय having understood, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, अभिमुखे facing her, स्थिताम् standing, श्वश्रूम् to her motherinlaw, इदम् this word, उवाच said.

text: करिष्ये सर्वम् एव अहम् आर्या यद् अनुशास्ति माम् । अभिज्ञा अस्मि यथा भर्तुर् वर्तितव्यम् श्रुतम् च मे ॥२-३९-२७॥
translation: I shall do exactly all that the venerable motherinlaw instructs me. I have heard it earlier and have fully understood as to how I should conduct myself towards my husband.
word_meanings: आर्या venerable one, यथा as, माम् me, अनुशास्ति instructing, सर्वमेव all that, अहम् I, करिष्ये shall do, भर्तुः in relation to my husband, यथा how, वर्तितव्यम् should conduct myself, अभिज्ञा अस्मि I am aware, मे श्रुतं च I have heard it earlier.

text: न माम् असज् जनेन आर्या समानयितुम् अर्हति । धर्मात् विचलितुम् न अहम् अलम् चन्द्रात् इव प्रभा ॥२-३९-२८॥
translation: My worshipful motherinlaw should not equate me with wicked people (women). I cannot swerve from the path of virtue like radiance which never leaves the Moon.
word_meanings: आर्या the worshipful lady, माम् me, असज्जनेन with wicked people, समानयितुम् to equate, न अर्हति not fit for, अहम् I, प्रभा radiance, चन्द्रादिव like from the Moon, धर्मात् from virtue, विचलितुम् to swerve, नालम् I cannot.

text: न अतन्त्री वाद्यते वीणा न अचक्रः वर्तते रथः । न अपतिः सुखम् एधते या स्यात् अपि शत आत्मजा ॥२-३९-२९॥
translation: A veena (lute) sans strings cannot be played. A chariot without wheels cannot move. Similarly, a woman without her husband finds no happiness even though she has one hundred sons.
word_meanings: अतन्त्री without strings, वीणा veena (lute), न वाद्यते cannot be played, अचक्रः without wheels, रथ: a chariot, न वर्तते does not move, अपतिः without husband, शतात्मजा a hundred sons, स्यादपि even if she has, सुखम् happiness, न एधेत one does not flourish.

text: मितम् ददाति हि पिता मितम् माता मितम् सुतः । अमितस्य हि दातारम् भर्तारम् का न पूजयेत् ॥२-३९-३०॥
translation: While the happiness that the father, mother and son give is limited, a husband gives unlimited happiness. Which wife will not worship such a husband?
word_meanings: पिता father, मितम् to a limited extent, ददाति हि gives, माता mother, सुतः son, अमितस्य unlimited extent, दातारम् giver, भर्तारम् husband, न पूजयेत् who will not worship?

text: सा अहम् एवम् गता श्रेष्ठा श्रुत धर्म पर अवरा । आर्ये किम् अवमन्येयम् स्त्रीणाम् भर्ता हि दैवतम् ॥२-३९-३१॥
translation: Instructed about my obligations by an eminent lady (her mother?), imbued with these ideals, how can I, O exalted one, underestimate him (my husband)? For a woman the husband is a god indeed
word_meanings: आर्ये O exalted lady, एवं गता one with these (ideals), श्रेष्ठा an eminent woman, श्रुतधर्मपरावरा having been instructed in ordinary and special obligations, सा अहम् I, किम् why, अवमन्येयम् understimate him, स्त्रीणाम् for women, भर्ता husband, दैवतं हि is god indeed.

text: सीताया वचनम् श्रुत्वा कौसल्या हृदयम् गमम् । शुद्ध सत्त्वा मुमोच अश्रु सहसा दुह्ख हर्षजम् ॥२-३९-३२॥
translation: Listening to the heartstirring words of Sita, Kausalya with her heart so pure burst instantaneously into tears of joy and grief.
word_meanings: कौशल्या Kausalya, हृदयङ्गमम् heartstirring, सीतायाः Sita's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, शुद्धसत्त्वा with purified mind, सहसा instantaneously, दुःखहर्षजम् produced out of joy and grief, अश्रु tears, मुमोच shed.

text: ताम् प्रान्जलिर् अभिक्रम्य मातृ मध्ये अतिसत्कृताम् । रामः परम धर्मज्ञो मातरम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-३९-३३॥
translation: Most virtuous Rama approached his mother, that highly revered lady among all his mothers, and with folded hands said:
word_meanings: परमधर्मात्मा extremely virtuous, रामः Rama, मातृमध्ये in the midst of his mothers, अतिसत्कृताम् highly revered lady, ताम् that, मातरम् to mother (Kausalya), प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, अभिक्रम्य having approached, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: अम्ब मा दुह्खिता भूस् त्वम् पश्य त्वम् पितरम् मम । क्षयो हि वन वासस्य क्षिप्रम् एव भविष्यति ॥२-३९-३४॥
translation: O mother, do not grieve. Look after my father. My stay in the forest will soon come to an end.
word_meanings: अम्ब O mother, त्वम् you, दुःखिता मा भूः do not grieve, त्वम् you, मम पितरम् my father, पश्य look after, वनवासस्य of my exile in the forest, क्षयः end, क्षिप्रमेव quickly, भविष्यति will come.

text: सुप्तायाः ते गमिष्यन्ति नव वर्षाणि पन्च च । सा समग्रम् इह प्राप्तम् माम् द्रक्ष्यसि सुहृद् वृतम् ॥२-३९-३५॥
translation: Fourteen years will pass off like a night's sleep. You will see me come home safe and sound, surrounded by my friends.
word_meanings: ते you, सुप्तायाः while asleep, नव पञ्च च nine plus five (fourteen), वर्षाणि years, गमिष्यन्ति will pass off, सा you, इह here, (सम्) प्राप्तम् have arrived, सुहृद्वृतम् surrounded by my friends, समग्रम् completely, माम् me, द्रक्ष्यसि will see.

text: एतावद् अभिनीत अर्थम् उक्त्वा स जननीम् वचः । त्रयः शत शत अर्धा हि ददर्श अवेक्ष्य मातरः ॥२-३९-३६॥
translation: Speaking thus to his mother with highly polished words, he then turned his gaze at his other three hundred and fifty mothers.
word_meanings: सः he, अभिनीतार्थम् with highly polished meaning, एतावत् up to this extent, वचः words, उक्त्वा having spoken, आवेक्ष्य after looking at them, त्रयः three, त्रयश्शतशतार्धा: three hundred and fifty, मातरः च mothers, ददर्श he saw.

text: ताः च अपि स तथैव आर्ता मातृऋर् दशरथ आत्मजः । धर्म युक्तम् इदम् वाक्यम् निजगाद कृत अन्जलिः ॥२-३९-३७॥
translation: To all the mothers who stood deeply distressed with grief the son of Dasaratha spoke with folded hands these words suffused with virtue:
word_meanings: सः that, दशरथात्मजः Son of Dasaratha (Rama), तथैव similarly, आर्ताः distressed, ताः those, मातृरपि mothers also, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, धर्मयुक्तम् steeped in virtue, इदं वाक्यम् these words, निजगाद uttered.

text: सम्वासात् परुषम् किम्चित् अज्ञानात् वा अपि यत् कृतम् । तन् मे समनुजानीत सर्वाः च आमन्त्रयामि वः ॥२-३९-३८॥
translation: If I have been harsh towards you, on account of our living together or through ignorance may you forgive me. I (now) seek leave of you all.
word_meanings: संवासात् by virtue of our living together, अज्ञानाद्वा or through ignorance, किञ्चित् even a little, यत् any, परुषम् harsh gesture, कृतम् has been done, मे to me, तत् that, समनुजानीत forgive, वः you, सर्वाः all, आमन्त्रयामि I am seeking leave of you.

text: वचनम् राघवस्यैतद्धर्मयुक्तम् समाहितम् । शुश्रुवु स्ताः स्त्रियम् सर्वाः शोकोपहतचेतसः ॥२-३९-३९॥
translation: All the women with their senses afflicted by grief heard the virtuous and wellbalanced words of the scion of the Raghu race:
word_meanings: ताः those, सर्वाः all, स्त्रियः women, राघवस्य of the descendant of the Raghus (Rama's), धर्मयुक्तम् endowed with virtue, समाहितम् well balanced, एतत् this, वचनम् words, शोकोपहतचेतसः senses afflicted by grief, शुश्रुवुः heard.

text: जज्ञे अथ तासाम् सम्नादः क्रौन्चीनाम् इव निह्स्वनः । मानव इन्द्रस्य भार्याणाम् एवम् वदति राघवे ॥२-३९-४०॥
translation: While Rama said so, there arose a loud cry of the wives of the king like the cry of the female herons.
word_meanings: राघवे when Rama, एवम् in this way, वदति while he was saying, अथ thereafter, तासाम् of those women, भार्याणाम् of wives, सन्नादः cry, क्रौञ्चीनाम् of female geese (or herons), निस्वन: इव like sound, जज्ञे arose.

text: मुरज पणव मेघ घोषव । द्दशरथ वेश्म बभूव यत् पुरा । विलपित परिदेवन आकुलम् । व्यसन गतम् तत् अभूत् सुदुह्खितम् ॥२-३९-४१॥
translation: Dasaratha's palace which reverberated, like the rumblings of the cloud, with the sounds of drums and other musical instruments earlier, now immensely griefsticken and trapped in calamity, is filled with wailings and lamentations. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyninth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: यत् दशरथवेश्म Dasaratha's palace, पुरा earlier, मुरजपणवमेघघोषवत् reechoed with the sounds of drums and other musical instruments like rumbling of the cloud, तत् that one, विलपितपरिदेवनाकुलम् filled with wailings and lamentations, व्यसनगतम् trapped in calamity, सुदुःखितम् अभूत् was filled with sorrow.

text: अथ रामः च सीता च लक्ष्मणः च कृत अन्जलिः । उपसम्गृह्य राजानम् चक्रुर् दीनाः प्रदक्षिणम् ॥२-४०-१॥
translation: Thereafter, Sita, Rama and Lakshmana with folded palms in a forlom state touched (the feet of) the king and circumambulated him.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, कृताज्ञलिः folded hands, रामश्च Rama also, सीता च Sita also, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana also, राजानम् king, उपसङ्गृह्य holding, दीनाः forlom, प्रदक्षिणं चक्रुः circumambulated him.

text: तम् च अपि समनुज्ञाप्य धर्मज्ञः सीतया सह । राघवः शोक सम्मूढो जननीम् अभ्यवादयत् ॥२-४०-२॥
translation: Taking leave of Dasaratha, the righteous descendant of the Raghus (Rama) along with Sita paid obeisance to his mother Kausalya who was afflicted with deep grief.
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञः knower of duty, राघवः Rama, सीतया सह along with Sita, तम् (to him), समनुज्ञाप्य after taking leave of, शोकसम्मूढः griefstricken, जननीम् to mother, अभ्यवादयत् paid obeisance.

text: अन्वक्षम् लक्ष्मणो भ्रातुः कौसल्याम् अभ्यवादयत् । अथ मातुः सुमित्राया जग्राह चरणौ पुनः ॥२-४०-३॥
translation: Immediately following Rama, his brother, Lakshmana also paid obeisance to Kausalya and, thereafter, held the feet of his own mother Sumitra.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भ्रातुः to his brother, अन्वक्षम् following immediately, कौशल्याम् of Kausalya, अभ्यवादयत् paid obeisance, अथ thereafter, मातुः of his mother, सुमित्रायाः Sumitra's, चरणौ feet, पुनः again, जग्राह held.

text: तम् वन्दमानम् रुदती माता सौमित्रिम् अब्रवीत् । हित कामा महा बाहुम् मूर्ध्नि उपाघ्राय लक्ष्मणम् ॥२-४०-४॥
translation: While the mightyarmed Lakshmana paid her homage, Sumitra wailed, kissed him on his forehead, wished him well and said:
word_meanings: माता mother, वन्दमानम् who was paying homage, सौमित्रिम् her son, महाबाहुम् mightyarmed, लक्ष्मणम् of Lakshmana, मूर्ध्नि on his forehead, उपाघ्राय having smelt, रुदती wailing, हितकामा wellwisher, अब्रवीत् said.

text: सृष्टः त्वम् वन वासाय स्वनुरक्तः सुहृज् जने । रामे प्रमादम् मा कार्षीः पुत्र भ्रातरि गच्चति ॥२-४०-५॥
translation: Although deeply attached to your beloved ones, O Son, you are born to dwell in the forest. Never be inattentive towards your brother Rama who is on his way (to the forest).
word_meanings: पुत्र O son, सुहृज्जने in beloved ones, स्वनुरक्तः deeply attached, वनवासाय to dwell in the forest, सृष्टः born , गच्छति leaving for the forest, भ्रातरि with regard to your brother, रामे of Rama, प्रमादम् inattention, मा कार्षीः never do.

text: व्यसनी वा समृद्धो वा गतिर् एष तव अनघ । एष लोके सताम् धर्मः यज् ज्येष्ठ वशगो भवेत् ॥२-४०-६॥
translation: Rama is your refuge in times of adversity or prosperity, O sinless one To be obedient to the eldest (brother) is the duty of virtuous men in this world.
word_meanings: अनघ O sinless one, व्यसनी वा in adversity, समृद्धो वा or in prosperity, एषः this one, तव your, गतिः is refuge, ज्येष्ठवशगः following the eldest brother, भवेत् इति यत् if it happens, एषः this, लोके in this world, सताम् of virtuous men, धर्मः is the duty.

text: इदम् हि वृत्तम् उचितम् कुलस्य अस्य सनातनम् । दानम् दीक्षा च यज्ञेषु तनु त्यागो मृधेषु च ॥२-४०-७॥
translation: Charity, initiation at sacrifices and yielding life in battles are the befitting ancient traditions prevailing in your race.
word_meanings: दानम् charity, यज्ञेषु in sacrifices, दीक्षा च initiation, मृधेषु in battles, तनुत्यागः च giving one's body, इदम् this one, अस्य कुलस्य of this race, उचितम् befitting, सनातनम् ancient, वृत्तं हि is the tradition.

text: लक्स्मणम् त्वेवम्क्त्वा सा सम्सिद्धम् प्रियराघवम् । सुमित्रा गच्छ गच्छेति पुनः पुनरुवाच तम् ॥२-४०-८॥
translation: Having said this to Lakshmana Sumitra again and again said to her beloved Rama, who was fully prepared, 'Go, go'.
word_meanings: सा सुमित्रा that Sumitra, प्रियराघवम् to beloved Rama, संसिद्धम् fully prepared, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, गच्छ गच्छ इति exclaiming 'go, go', तम् to him, पुनः पुनः again and again, उवाच said.

text: रामम् दशरथम् विद्धि माम् विद्धि जनक आत्मजाम् । अयोध्याम् अटवीम् विद्धि गच्च तात यथा सुखम् ॥२-४०-९॥
translation: (To Lakshmana she said) Regard Rama as Dasaratha, Sita as me and the forest as Ayodhya. My child, go in peace.
word_meanings: रामम् to Rama, दशरथम् as Dasaratha, विद्धि know, जनकात्मजाम् Sita, माम् as me, विद्धि know, अटवीम् forest, अयोध्याम् as Ayodhya, विद्धि know, तात child, यथासुखम् in peace, गच्छ go.

text: ततः सुमन्त्रः काकुत्स्थम् प्रान्जलिर् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । विनीतः विनयज्ञः च मातलिर् वासवम् यथा ॥२-४०-१०॥
translation: Then Sumantra who knows the ways of politeness and humility spoke to Rama, with folded hands as Matali did to Indra.
word_meanings: ततः then, विनीतः humble, विनयज्ञश्च knower of politeness, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, मातलिः Matali, वासवं यथा as Indra, काकुत्स्थम् to the scion of the Kakutstha race, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: रथम् आरोह भद्रम् ते राज पुत्र महा यशः । क्षिप्रम् त्वाम् प्रापयिष्यामि यत्र माम् राम वक्ष्यसि ॥२-४०-११॥
translation: O Illustrious prince, wish you well Mount the chariot. I shall convey you speedily whereever you want.
word_meanings: राजपुत्र O Prince, महायशः O illustrious one, रथं chariot, आरोह mount, ते to you, भद्रम् wish you well, यत्र whereever, वक्ष्यसि you guide (one), त्वाम् you, क्षिप्रम् speedily, प्रापयिष्यामि I will take.

text: चतुर् दश हि वर्षाणि वस्तव्यानि वने त्वया । तानि उपक्रमितव्यानि यानि देव्या असि चोदितः ॥२-४०-१२॥
translation: You have been directed by Kaikeyi to live in the forest for fourteen years. Accordingly you must now commence counting those years as directed.
word_meanings: चतुर्दश fourteen, वर्षाणि years, त्वया by you, वने in the forest, वस्तव्यानिव you will dwell, यानि those, देव्या by queen Kaikeyi, चोदितः असि you have been directed, तानि those, उपक्रमितव्यानि should be commenced.

text: तम् रथम् सूर्य सम्काशम् सीता हृष्टेन चेतसा । आरुरोह वर आरोहा कृत्वा अलम्कारम् आत्मनः ॥२-४०-१३॥
translation: Sita of lovely limbs decorated herself and with a cheerful mind boarded the chariot which was shining like the Sun.
word_meanings: वरारोहा lovely limbs, सीता Sita, आत्मनः her person, अलङ्कारम् decoration, कृत्वा having made, हृष्टेन with pleased, चेतसा mind, सूर्यसङ्काशम् resembling the Sun, तं रथम् that chariot, आरुरोह boarded.

text: तथैव आयुध जातानि भ्रातृभ्याम् कवचानि च । रथ उपस्थे प्रतिन्यस्य सचर्म कठिनम् च तत् ॥२-४०-१४॥
वनवासम् हि सम्ख्यय वासाम्स्याभरणानि च । भर्तारमनुगच्छन्त्यै सीतायै श्वशुरो ददौ ॥२-४०-१५॥
translation: Fatherinlaw (Dasaratha) gave clothes and ornaments on the assessment of the number of years Sita was going to spend in the forest with her husband.
word_meanings: श्वशुरः fatherinlaw (Dasaratha), भर्तारम् to the husband, अनुगच्छन्त्यै following, सीतायै to Sita, वनवासम् going to dwell in the forest, संख्याय having counted, वासांसि clothes, आभरणानि च ornamets, ददौ gave.

text: तथैवायुधजालानि भ्रातृभ्याम् कवचानि च । रथोपस्थे प्रतिन्यस्य सचर्म कठिनम् च तत् ॥२-४०-१६॥
translation: So also Dasaratha secured a multitude of weapons, shields and protective leathercoverings for hands and placed them at the centre of the chariot, for use by the brothers. When Sumantra ensured that Sita, Rama and Lakshmana boarded the chariot, he briskly hastened the horses which were as speedy as the wind.
word_meanings: तथैव similarly, भ्रातृभ्याम् for brothers, आयुधजालानि multitude of weapons, कवचानि armours, सचर्म along with shield, तत् कठिनं च protective leather covering the hand, रथोपस्थे in the centre of the chariot, प्रतिन्यस्य placing, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, सीतातृतीयान् Rama and Lakshmana with Sita as third person, आरूढान् ascended, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सम्मतान् honoured, जवे in speed, वायुवेग समान् like the speed of the wind, अश्वान् horses, धृष्टम् briskly, अचोदयत् drove them.

text: सीता तृतीयान् आरूढान् दृष्ट्वा धृष्टम् अचोदयत् । सुमन्त्रः सम्मतान् अश्वान् वायु वेग समान् जवे ॥२-४०-१७॥
translation: So also Dasaratha secured a multitude of weapons, shields and protective leathercoverings for hands and placed them at the centre of the chariot, for use by the brothers. When Sumantra ensured that Sita, Rama and Lakshmana boarded the chariot, he briskly hastened the horses which were as speedy as the wind.
word_meanings: तथैव similarly, भ्रातृभ्याम् for brothers, आयुधजालानि multitude of weapons, कवचानि armours, सचर्म along with shield, तत् कठिनं च protective leather covering the hand, रथोपस्थे in the centre of the chariot, प्रतिन्यस्य placing, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, सीतातृतीयान् Rama and Lakshmana with Sita as third person, आरूढान् ascended, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सम्मतान् honoured, जवे in speed, वायुवेग समान् like the speed of the wind, अश्वान् horses, धृष्टम् briskly, अचोदयत् drove them.

text: प्रयाते तु महा अरण्यम् चिर रात्राय राघवे । बभूव नगरे मूर्च्चा बल मूर्च्चा जनस्य च ॥२-४०-१८॥
translation: Having seen Rama set out for the great forest for a long period, the city was stilled and men were enervated.
word_meanings: राघवे Rama, चिररात्राय for a long period, महारण्यम् to the great forest, प्रतियाते having set out, नगरे in the city, मूर्छा बभूव was deprived of senses, जनस्य for men, बलमूर्छा च were deprived of their strength.

text: तत् समाकुल सम्भ्रान्तम् मत्त सम्कुपित द्विपम् । हय शिन्जित निर्घोषम् पुरम् आसीन् महा स्वनम् ॥२-४०-१९॥
translation: The city was distressed and flurried by the intoxicated elephants, provoked by the mighty sound of the tinkling of bells and the neighing of the horses.
word_meanings: तत् पुरम् that city, मत्तसङ्कुपितद्विपम् with elephants intoxicated and provoked (by sounds), हयशिञ्जितनिर्घोषम् the tinkling of bells and the neighing of the horses, महास्वनम् mighty roar, आकुलसम्भ्रान्तम् आसीत् became flurried and distressed.

text: ततः सबाल वृद्धा सा पुरी परम पीडिता । रामम् एव अभिदुद्राव घर्म आर्तः सलिलम् यथा ॥२-४०-२०॥
translation: Thereafter the extremely afflicted people of the city, including young and old alike, ran towards Rama like men oppressed with heat running for water.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, बालवृद्धा including young and old, सा पुरी that city, परमपीडिता extremely afflicted, घर्मार्तः oppressed with heat, सलिलं यथा like water, रामम् एव towards Rama only, अभिदुद्राव ran.

text: पार्श्वतः पृष्ठतः च अपि लम्बमानाः तत् उन्मुखाः । बाष्प पूर्ण मुखाः सर्वे तम् ऊचुर् भृश दुह्खिताः ॥२-४०-२१॥
translation: All the people hanging from the chariot from behind and by the sides, heaving deeply, their faces covered with tears, thus addressed to Sumantra:
word_meanings: सर्वे all, पार्श्वतः by his side, पृष्ठतश्चैव behind, लम्बमानाः hanging upon, तदुन्मुखाः facing him, बाष्पपूर्णमुखाः faces covered with tears, भृशनिस्वनाः heaving deeply, तम् addressing that Sumantra, ऊचुः said.

text: सम्यच्च वाजिनाम् रश्मीन् सूत याहि शनैः शनैः । मुखम् द्रक्ष्यामि रामस्य दुर्दर्शम् नो भविष्यति ॥२-४०-२२॥
translation: O charioteer, control the reins of the horses and go slow so that we may look at the face of Rama, for soon we will not be able to see him.
word_meanings: सूत O charioteer, वाजिनाम् horses, रश्मीन् reins, संयच्छ control, शनैः शनैः slowly, slowly, याहि go, रामस्य Rama's, मुखम् face, द्रक्ष्यामः we will see, नः for us, दुर्दर्शम् difficult to see, भविष्यति will become.

text: आयसम् हृदयम् नूनम् राम मातुर् असम्शयम् । यद् देव गर्भ प्रतिमे वनम् याति न भिद्यते ॥२-४०-२३॥
translation: Alas, the heart of Kausalya whose son, Rama, resembles the offspring of the gods, does not break even though he is going to the forest Undoubtedly it must be made of iron.
word_meanings: देवगर्भप्रतिमे resembling the offspring of gods, वनम् to the forest, याति while going, यत् for what reason, न भिद्यते does not break, नूनम् certainly, राममातुः of the mother of Rama (Kausalya's), हृदयम् heart, आयसम् is made of iron, असंशयम् no doubt.

text: कृत कृत्या हि वैदेही चाया इव अनुगता पतिम् । न जहाति रता धर्मे मेरुम् अर्क प्रभा यथा ॥२-४०-२४॥
translation: Sita, deeply attached to her duty, and with her desire fulfilled is following her husband like a shadow just as the sunlight which never leaves mount Meru.
word_meanings: धर्मे in duty, रता attached, छायेव like shadow, अनुगता following, वैदेहि Sita, अर्कप्रभा sunlight, मेरुम् यथा like mount Meru, पतिम् her husband, न जहाति does not leave, कृतकृत्या हि accomplished her purpose.

text: अहो लक्ष्मण सिद्ध अर्थः सतताम् प्रिय वादिनम् । भ्रातरम् देव सम्काशम् यः त्वम् परिचरिष्यसि ॥२-४०-२५॥
translation: With your desires fulfilled, O Lakshmana, you will attend to your godlike brother who always speaks pleasant words.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, यः त्वम् such as you, प्रियवादिनम् who speaks pleasant words, देवसङ्काशम् godlike, भ्रातरम् to brother, सततम् always, परिचरिष्यसि attend, सिद्धार्थः fulfilled the purpose, अहो oh.

text: महति एषा हि ते सिद्धिर् एष च अभ्युदयो महान् । एष स्वर्गस्य मार्गः च यद् एनम् अनुगच्चसि ॥२-४०-२६॥
translation: The very fact that you are following Rama is a great achievement and a great fortune for you. This, in fact, is the way to heaven.
word_meanings: एनम् this Rama, अनुगच्छसि (इति) यत् the fact that you are following him, एषा that one, ते for you, महती great, सिध्दि: achievement, एषः this, महान् great, अभ्युदयः prosperity, एषः this one, स्वर्गस्य to heaven, मार्गश्च way.

text: एवम् वदन्तः ते सोढुम् न शेकुर् बाष्पम् आगतम् । अथ राजा वृतः स्त्रीभिर् दीनाभिर् दीन चेतनः ॥२-४०-२७॥
अथ राजा वृतः स्त्रीभिर्दीनाभिर्दीनचेतनः । निर्जगाम प्रियम् पुत्रम् द्रक्ष्यामि इति ब्रुवन् गृहात् ॥२-४०-२८॥
translation: I wish to see my beloved son said the king with a sense of desolation and emerged, surrounded by forlorn women, from the palace.
word_meanings: अथ then, दीनचेतनः in desolation, राजा king, प्रियम् beloved, पुत्रम् son, द्रक्ष्यामीति I wish to see him, ब्रुवन् saying, दीनाभिः distressed, स्त्रीभिः by ladies, वृतः surrounded, गृहात् from the palace, निर्जगाम emerged.

text: शुश्रुवे च अग्रतः स्त्रीनाम् रुदन्तीनाम् महा स्वनः । यथा नादः करेणूनाम् बद्धे महति कुन्जरे ॥२-४०-२९॥
translation: He heard the women crying loudly in front like wailings of cowelephants when their bull elephant is captured.
word_meanings: अग्रतः in front of, रुदन्तीनाम् crying, स्त्रीणाम् of women, महास्वनः loud sound, महति when great, कुञ्जरे elephant, बद्धे when fastened, करेणूनाम् of female elephants, नादः यथा like a sound, शुश्रुवे heard.

text: पिता च राजा काकुत्स्थः श्रीमान् सन्नः तदा बभौ । परिपूर्णः शशी काले ग्रहेण उपप्लुतः यथा ॥२-४०-३०॥
translation: The king born in the race of Kakutstha, though bright, looked dull then like the full Moon eclipsed (by Rahu).
word_meanings: श्रीमान् one of great prosperity, काकुत्स्थ: born in the race of Kakutstha (Dasaratha), पिता father, राजा king, तदा then, काले at that time, ग्रहेण by Rahu, उपप्लुतः eclipsed, पूर्णशशी यथा like the full Moon, सन्नः अभवत् was shrunk.

text: स च श्रीमानचिन्त्यात्मा रामो दशरथात्मजः । सूतम् सम्चोदयामास त्वरितम् वाह्यतामिति ॥२-४०-३१॥
translation: The son of Dasaratha, glorious Rama of inconceivable courage, exhorted the charioteer to drive the chariot fast.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् glorious one, अचिन्त्यात्मा unimaginable form, सः दशरथात्मजः that son of Dasaratha, रामः Rama, त्वरितम् fast, वाह्यताम् इति drive, सूतम् charioteer, सञ्चोदयामास exhorted.

text: रामो याहीति सूतम् तम् तिष्ठेति स जनस्तदा । उभयम् नाशकत्सूतः कर्तुमध्वनि चोदितः ॥२-४०-३२॥
translation: Urged by Rama to drive fast on the one hand and by the citizens to stay, on the other, the charioteer could do neither on the way.
word_meanings: तदा then, रामः Rama, याहि इति saying 'drive on', जनः citizens, तिष्ठेति 'stay, stay', तं सूतम् to the charioteer, चोदितः urged, सूतः that charioteer, अध्वनि on the way, उभयम् both the acts, कर्तुम् to do, नाशकत् was unable.

text: निर्गच्छति महाबाहौ रामे पौरजनाश्रुभिः । पतितैरभ्यवहितम् प्रशशाम महीरजः ॥२-४०-३३॥
translation: As the mightyarmed Rama was going away, the dust raised from the earth subsided with the tears falling from the citizens' (eyes).
word_meanings: महाबाहौ mightyarmed, रामे Rama, निर्गच्छति going away, अभ्यवहितम् raised, महीरजः dust of the earth, पतितैः by the fallen, पौरजनाश्रुभिः with the tears of the citizens, प्रशशाम subsided.

text: रुदिताश्रुपरिद्यूनम् हाहाकृतमचेतनम् । प्रयाणे राघवस्यासीत्पुरम् परमपीडितम् ॥२-४०-३४॥
translation: At the time of Rama's departure, the insensate city was drenched with tears of the deeply afflicted people crying, 'Alas, Alas'.
word_meanings: राघवस्य Rama's, प्रयाणे at the time of departure, पुरम् the city, रुदिताश्रुपरिद्यूनम् drenched with tears from weeping, हाहाकृतम् 'Alas, Alas', अचेतनम् insensate, परम पीडितम् आसीत् became tormented.

text: सुस्राव नयनैः स्त्रीणामस्रमायाससम्भवम् । मीनसम्क्षोभचलितैः सलिलम् पङ्कजैरिव ॥२-४०-३५॥
translation: Tears born of anguish fell from the eyes of women just as waterdrops fall from lotuses shaken by the movements of fishes.
word_meanings: स्त्रीणाम् women's, नयनैः with (from) eyes, आयाससम्भवम् born of anguish, अस्रम् tears, मीनसङ्क्षोभ चलितैः shaken by the movements of fish, पङ्कजैः by lotuses, सलिलमिव like waterdrops, सुस्राव fell.

text: दृष्ट्वा तु नृपतिः श्रीमानेकचित्तगतम् पुरम् । निपपातैव दुःखेन हतमूल इव द्रुमः ॥२-४०-३६॥
translation: Having seen the city (people) absorbed in one single thought, the prosperous king, griefstricken, fell down on the ground like a tree severed at its root.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् prosperous, नृपतिः king, एकचित्तगतम् absorbed in the same thought, पुरम् the city, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दुःखेन with grief, हतमूलः with roots severed, द्रुमः इव like tree, निपपातैव fell down.

text: ततओ हल हला शब्दो जज्ञे रामस्य पृष्ठतः । नराणाम् प्रेक्ष्य राजानम् सीदन्तम् भृश दुह्खितम् ॥२-४०-३७॥
translation: When the people saw the king enfeebled by deep grief, they raised an uproar behind Rama's (chariot).
word_meanings: ततः then, भृश दुःखितम् intensely grieved, सीदन्तम् enfeebled, राजानम् king, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, नराणाम् men's, हलहलाशब्दः a tumultous roar, रामस्य Rama's, पृष्ठतः behind, जज्ञे emanated.

text: हा राम इति जनाः केचित् राम माता इति च अपरे । अन्तः पुरम् समृद्धम् च क्रोशन्तम् पर्यदेवयन् ॥२-४०-३८॥
translation: Some among them wailed 'Oh Rama', while some others cried 'Oh mother of Rama' By crying loudly, they made the women in the inner apartment cry too.
word_meanings: केचित् some, जनाः people, हा रामेति O Rama, अपरे some others, राममातेति O mother of Rama, क्रोशन्तः while crying, समृद्धम् loudly, अन्तःपुरं च inner apartment, पर्यदेवयन् made them weep.

text: अन्वीक्षमाणो रामः तु विषण्णम् भ्रान्त चेतसम् । राजानम् मातरम् चैव ददर्श अनुगतौ पथि ॥२-४०-३९॥
translation: When Rama glanced back, he saw his mother and father trailing behind him on the highway, with an agitated and dejected mind.
word_meanings: रामस्तु Rama, अन्वीक्षमाणः glanced back, विषण्णम् dejected, भ्रान्तचेतसम् with a disturbed mind, राजानम् king, मातरं चैव mother also, पथि on the highway, अनुगतौ following, ददर्श beheld.

text: स बद्ध इव पाशेन किशोरो मातरम् यथा । धर्मपाशेन सम्क्षिप्तः प्रकाशम् नाभुदैक्षत ॥२-४०-४०॥
translation: Like a fastened foal cannot see its mother, Rama restrained by bonds of duty could not see his parents clearly.
word_meanings: पाशेन बद्धः fastened by cord, किशोरः इव like a foal, सः Rama, धर्मपाशेन by bonds of duty, सङ्क्षिप्तः restrained, मातरं यथा like mother, प्रकाशम् clearly, नाभ्युदैक्षत did not see.

text: पदातिनौ च यान अर्हाव् अदुह्ख अर्हौ सुख उचितौ । दृष्ट्वा सम्चोदयाम् आस शीघ्रम् याहि इति सारथिम् ॥२-४०-४१॥
translation: Seeing his parents, who were worthy of riding a chariot now going on foot, who were accustomed to comforts and did not deserve any suffering, Rama urged his charioteer to drive fast.
word_meanings: यानार्हौ worthy of going on chariot, पदातिनौ (now) going on foot, सुखोचितौ accustomed to comforts, अदु:खार्हौ unworthy of experiencing sorrow, दृष्ट्वा having seen, शीघ्रम् swiftly, याहि इति 'go' thus, सारथिम् of charioteer, सञ्चोदयामास urged.

text: न हि तत् पुरुष व्याघ्रः दुह्खदम् दर्शनम् पितुः । मातुः च सहितुम् शक्तः तोत्र अर्दितैव द्विपः ॥२-४०-४२॥
translation: Rama the best among men, could not, like an elephant tormented by the goad, endure that pitiful sight of his father and mother.
word_meanings: पुरुषव्याघ्रः tiger (best) among men, तोत्रार्दितः tormented by the goads, द्विपः इव like an elephant, दुःखदम् causing agony, पितुः father's, मातुश्च mother's, तत् दर्शनम् that sight, सहितुम् to endure, न शक्तः हि was not able.

text: प्रत्यगारमिवायान्ती वत्सला वत्सकारणात् । बद्धवत्सा यथा धेनू राममाताभ्याधावत ॥२-४०-४३॥
translation: Rama's mother ran after the chariot, like an affectionate cow running towards the shed to join its fastened calf.
word_meanings: बद्धवत्सा fastened calf, वत्सला affectionate, अगारं प्रति towards the shed, आयन्ती coming, धेनुः इव like cow, वत्सकारणात् यथा for its calf, राममाता Rama's mother, अभ्यधावत ran behind.

text: तथा रुदन्तीम् कौसल्याम् रथम् तम् अनुधावतीम् । क्रोशन्तीम् राम राम इति हा सीते लक्ष्मण इति च ॥२-४०-४४॥
translation: While Kausalya was weeping and running after the chariot, crying O 'Rama, O Sita, O Lakshmana, shedding tears for them, Rama repeatedly glanced at her who was twisting and bending as if in a dancing pose.
word_meanings: (सः Rama), तथा thus, रुदन्तीम् weeping, राम रामेति O Rama, O Rama, हा सीते O Sita, लक्ष्मणेति च O Lakshmana, क्रोशन्तीम् crying, रामलक्ष्मणसीतार्थम् for Rama, Lakshmana and Sita, नेत्रजम् born of eyes, वारि tears, स्रवन्तीम् shedding, नृत्यन्तीम् इव like a dancer, मातरम् mother, तां कौशल्याम् that Kausalya, असकृत् repeatedly, प्रैक्षत saw.

text: रामलक्ष्मणसीतार्थम् स्रवन्तीम् वारि नेत्रजम् । असकृत् प्रैक्षत तदा नृत्यन्तीम् इव मातरम् ॥२-४०-४५॥
translation: While Kausalya was weeping and running after the chariot, crying O 'Rama, O Sita, O Lakshmana, shedding tears for them, Rama repeatedly glanced at her who was twisting and bending as if in a dancing pose.
word_meanings: (सः Rama), तथा thus, रुदन्तीम् weeping, राम रामेति O Rama, O Rama, हा सीते O Sita, लक्ष्मणेति च O Lakshmana, क्रोशन्तीम् crying, रामलक्ष्मणसीतार्थम् for Rama, Lakshmana and Sita, नेत्रजम् born of eyes, वारि tears, स्रवन्तीम् shedding, नृत्यन्तीम् इव like a dancer, मातरम् mother, तां कौशल्याम् that Kausalya, असकृत् repeatedly, प्रैक्षत saw.

text: तिष्ठ इति राजा चुक्रोष याहि याहि इति राघवः । सुमन्त्रस्य बभूव आत्मा चक्रयोः इव च अन्तरा ॥२-४०-४६॥
translation: The king cried, 'Stay, Stay', while Rama said 'Go on, Go on'. Sumantra's mind was caught as if in between two wheels.
word_meanings: राजा king, तिष्ठेति 'stay, stay', चुक्रोश cried, राघवः Rama, याहि इति 'go, go', सुमन्त्रस्य Sumantra's, आत्मा mind, चक्रयो: two wheels, अन्तरा इव like in between, बभूव became.

text: न अश्रौषम् इति राजानम् उपालब्धो अपि वक्ष्यसि । चिरम् दुह्खस्य पापिष्ठम् इति रामः तम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-४०-४७॥
translation: When the king reproaches you for not stopping the chariot, you can say 'I could not hear'.Prolonging agony is sinful, said Rama to Sumantra.
word_meanings: उपालब्धोऽपि even when reproached, नाश्रौषमिति 'I did not hear', राजानम् to the king, वक्ष्यसि you will tell, दुःखस्य agony, चिरम् for long time, पापिष्ठम् cannot be endured, इति thus, रामः Rama, तम् to him, अब्रवीत् said.

text: रामस्य स वचः कुर्वन्न् अनुज्ञाप्य च तम् जनम् । व्रजतः अपि हयान् शीघ्रम् चोदयाम् आस सारथिः ॥२-४०-४८॥
translation: Obeying the command of Rama and after taking leave of the people, Sumantra hastened the horses although they were galloping.
word_meanings: स सारथिः charioteer, रामस्य Rama's, वचः words, कुर्वन् obeying, तम् जनम् that multitude of people, अनुज्ञाप्य having given permision (taking leave), व्रजतोऽपि even though moving, हयान् horses, शीघ्रम् with greater speed, चोदयामास hastened.

text: न्यवर्तत जनो राज्ञो रामम् कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् । मनसा अपि अश्रु वेगैः च न न्यवर्तत मानुषम् ॥२-४०-४९॥
translation: The king's men returned, with Rama circumambulated (on the plane of their minds). But from their minds they could not hold back their tears (grief).
word_meanings: राज्ञः king's, जनः people, रामम् of Rama, प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा circumanbulating him in imaginataion, न्यवर्तत returned, मानुषम् people, मनसा अपि even mentally, अश्रुवेगैश्च flow of their tears, न न्यवर्तत did not stop.

text: यम् इच्चेत् पुनर् आयान्तम् न एनम् दूरम् अनुव्रजेत् । इति अमात्या महा राजम् ऊचुर् दशरथम् वचः ॥२-४०-५०॥
translation: We should not follow over a long distance those we wish to return, said the ministers to king Dasaratha.
word_meanings: यम् whom, पुनः again, आयान्तम् returning, इच्छेत् desires, एनम् him, दूरम् for a long distance, न अनुव्रजेत् should not follow, इति thus, अमात्याः ministers, महाराजम् king, दशरथम् to Dasaratha, वचः words, ऊचुः said.

text: तेषाम् वचः सर्व गुण उपपन्नम् । प्रस्विन्न गात्रः प्रविषण्ण रूपः । निशम्य राजा कृपणः सभार्यो । व्यवस्थितः तम् सुतम् ईक्षमाणः ॥२-४०-५१॥
translation: Dasaratha and his wives, overcome with grief, heard their words steeped in virtue (wisdom). The king stood there with his perspiring body and melancholic appearance, fixing his gaze on his son. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortieth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: प्रस्विन्नगात्रः with a perspiring body, प्रविषण्णरूपः with a melancholic appearance, कृपणः overcome with grief, सभार्यः along with his wives, राजा the king, तेषाम् their, सर्वगुणोपपन्नम् endowed with every virtue, वचः words, निशम्य having heard, तं सुतम् that son, ईक्षमाणः while looking at, व्यवस्थितः stood there.

text: तस्मिम्स्तु पुरुषव्याघ्रे विनिर्याति कृताञ्जलौ । आर्तशब्दोऽथ सम्जज्ञे स्त्रीणामन्तह्पुते तदा ॥२-४१-१॥
translation: When Rama, the foremost men, was departing with folded palms there arose a huge cry of distress from the inner apartment of ladies.
word_meanings: पुरुषव्याघ्रे tiger (foremost) among men, तस्मिन् that Rama, कृताञ्जलौ with folded palms, विनिर्याति having departed, अन्तःपुरे in the inner apartment (of the palace), स्त्रीणाम् of women, आर्तशब्दः cries of distress, संजज्ञे arose.

text: अनाथस्य जनस्य अस्य दुर्बलस्य तपस्विनः । यो गतिम् शरणम् च आसीत् स नाथः क्व नु गच्चति ॥२-४१-२॥
translation: Rama was a refuge and a protector to all the people who were defenceless, weak and miserable. Where is such a protector going now? (said the people).
word_meanings: अनाथस्य of the orphan, दुर्बलस्य of the weak, तपस्विनः of the miserable, अस्य जनस्य of these people, यः who, गतिः refuge, शरणं च also the protector, आसीत् was, सः नाथः such protector, क्व नु गच्छति where is he now going?

text: न क्रुध्यति अभिशस्तः अपि क्रोधनीयानि वर्जयन् । क्रुद्धान् प्रसादयन् सर्वान् सम दुह्खः क्व गच्चति ॥२-४१-३॥
translation: Where is he who, even if reviled, never gets angry, never does acts that provoke anger, pacifies those who are enraged and shares the sorrows of others going now?
word_meanings: अभिशप्तोऽपि even when denounced, न क्रुध्यति will not be angry, क्रोधनीयानि acts provoking wrath, वर्जयन् while abandoning, क्रुद्धान् those who were enraged, सर्वान् all of them, प्रसादयन् pacifies, समदुःखः sharing their sorrow, क्व where, गच्छति is going?

text: कौसल्यायाम् महा तेजा यथा मातरि वर्तते । तथा यो वर्तते अस्मासु महात्मा क्व नु गच्चति ॥२-४१-४॥
translation: Where is he, that effulgent, magnanimous one who treated us (with the same respect) as he treated his mother Kausalya, going now?
word_meanings: महातेजाः effulgent, यः Rama, मातरि with regard to his mother, कौशल्यायाम् Kausalya, यथा as, वर्तते treats, तथा in that way, अस्मासु in us, वर्तते treats, महात्मा a magnanimous one, क्व नु where, गच्छति is he going?

text: कैकेय्या क्लिश्यमानेन राज्ञा सम्चोदितः वनम् । परित्राता जनस्य अस्य जगतः क्व नु गच्चति ॥२-४१-५॥
translation: Tormented by Kaikeyi, the king ordered him to go to the forest. Where is he, who happened to be the protector of the people of this world, going now?
word_meanings: कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, क्लिश्यमानेन by being tormented, राज्ञा by the king, वनम् to the forest, सञ्चोदितः one ordered, अस्य जनस्य of these people, जगतः of the whole world, परित्राता protector, Rama, क्व नु where, गच्छति is he going?

text: अहो निश्चेतनो राजा जीव लोकस्य सम्प्रियम् । धर्म्यम् सत्य व्रतम् रामम् वन वासो प्रवत्स्यति ॥२-४१-६॥
translation: Alas, the king must be devoid of any sense as he is sending away Rama, who is dear to the world, is righteous and truthful, to dwell in the forest.
word_meanings: राजा king, निश्चेतनः nonsense, अहो alas, जीवलोकस्य of the world of living beings, सम्प्रियम् is dear, धर्म्यम् is righteous, सत्यव्रतम् faithful to truth, रामम् Rama, वनवासे to dwell in the forest, प्रवत्स्यति is sending away.

text: इति सर्वा महिष्यः ता विवत्साइव धेनवः । रुरुदुः चैव दुह्ख आर्ताः सस्वरम् च विचुक्रुशुः ॥२-४१-७॥
translation: So wept aloud the anguished wives of the king like cows separated from their calves.
word_meanings: इति thus, सर्वाः all, ताः महिष्यः all the wives, विवत्साः deprived of their calfs, धेनवः इव like cows, दुःखार्ताः tormented with sorrow, रुरुदुश्चैव wept, सस्वरम् loudly, विचुक्रुशुः cried.

text: स तम् अन्तः पुरे घोरम् आर्त शब्दम् मही पतिः । पुत्र शोक अभिसम्तप्तः श्रुत्वा च आसीत् सुदुह्खितः ॥२-४१-८॥
translation: Upon hearing the dreadful wailing from the inner apartments of the palace, the king already devasted at the separation from his son, grew even more distressed.
word_meanings: पुत्रशोकाभिसन्तप्तः oppressed with sorrow caused by the departure of his son, सः महीपतिः that king, अन्तःपुरे in the inner apartment (of the palace), घोरम् horible, तम् that, आर्त शब्दम् wailings, श्रुत्वा having heard, सुदुःखितः आसीत् became increasingly distressed.

text: न अग्नि होत्राणि अहूयन्त सूर्यः च अन्तर् अधीयत । व्यसृजन् कवलान् नागा गावो वत्सान् न पाययन् ॥२-४१-९॥
व्यसृजन् कबलान्नागा गावो वत्सान्न पाययन् । पुत्रम् प्रथमजम् लब्ध्वा जननी नाभ्यनन्दत ॥२-४१-१०॥
translation: Elephants dropped their morsel of food. Cows did not suckle their calves. Even the mothers were not pleased with their firstborn sons.
word_meanings: नागाः elephants, कबलान् mouthful of food, व्यसृजन् shed, गावः cows, वत्सान् calves, न पाययन् did not suckle, जननी mothers, प्रथमजम् to the firstborn, पुत्रम् son, लब्धवा having begotten, नाभ्यनन्दत were not pleased.

text: त्रिशन्कुर् लोहित अन्गः च बृहस्पति बुधाव् अपि । दारुणाः सोमम् अभ्येत्य ग्रहाः सर्वे व्यवस्थिताः ॥२-४१-११॥
translation: The constellation Trishanku, the planets Mars, Jupiter, Mercury and other fierce planets took their position near the Moon.
word_meanings: त्रिशङ्कु: Trishanku, लोहिताङ्गश्च Mars, बृहस्पतिबुधावपि Jupiter as also Mercury, दारुणाः fierce aspect, सर्वे all, ग्रहाः planets, सोमम् Moon, अभ्येत्य approaching, व्यवस्थिताः remained.

text: नक्षत्राणि गत अर्चीम्षि ग्रहाः च गत तेजसः । विशाखाः च सधूमाः च नभसि प्रचकाशिरे ॥२-४१-१२॥
translation: The stars were shorn of their radiance. The brilliance of the planets diminished. Shrouded in smoke the Visakha constellation appeared in the sky.
word_meanings: नक्षत्राणि the constellation of stars, गतार्चींषि shorn of their radiance, ग्रहाश्च planets also, गततेजसः diminished their brilliance, विशाखास्तु as for Visakha stars, सधूमाः with smoke, नभसि in the sky, प्रचकाशिरे were shining.

text: कालिकानिलवेगेन महोदधिरिवोत्थितः । रामे वनम् प्रव्रजिते नगरम् प्रचचाल तत् ॥२-४१-१३॥
translation: After Rama left for the forest, dark clouds appeared (in the sky) like the (waves of) the great ocean uplifted by the speed of the wind which shook the city.
word_meanings: महोदधिः great ocean, कालिकानिलवेगेन इव like windblown dark clouds, उत्थितः aroused, रामे Rama, वनम् to the forest, प्रव्रजिते having been exiled, तत् नगरम् that city (of Ayodhya), प्रचचाल was shaken.

text: दिशः पर्याकुलाः सर्वा स्तिमिरेणेव सम्वृताः । न ग्रहो नापि नक्षत्रं प्रचकाशे न किंचन ॥२-४१-१४॥
translation: As if covered with darkness, all the cardinal points became agitated. No planet, no star nor was anything (any heavenly body) shining (in the sky).
word_meanings: सर्वाः all, दिशः cardinal points, पर्याकुलाः agitated, तिमिरेण with darkness, संवृताः इव covered, ग्रहः planet, न प्रचकाशे did not shine, नक्षत्रमपि even stars, किञ्चन anything, न not shining.

text: अकस्मान् नागरः सर्वो जनो दैन्यम् उपागमत् । आहारे वा विहारे वा न कश्चित् अकरोन् मनः ॥२-४१-१५॥
translation: All of a sudden the people of the city became miserable. No one was interested in eating and enjoying (life).
word_meanings: सर्वः all, नागरः relating to the city, जनः people, अकस्मात् suddenly, दैन्यम् helplessness, उपागमत् obtained, आहारे वा either in nourishment, विहारे वा or in recreation, कश्चित् none, मनः their mind, न अकरात् not done.

text: शोकपर्यायसन्तप्तः सततं दीर्घमुच्छ्वसन् । अयोध्यायाम् जनः सर्वः शुशोच जगतीपतिम् ॥२-४१-१६॥
translation: All the citizens of Ayodhya, afflicted with a series of grief and heaving deep sighs ceaselessly bewailed at the sight of the lord of the world (Dasaratha).
word_meanings: अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, सर्वः all, जनः people, शोकपर्यायसन्तप्तः afflicted with a series of grief, सततम् always, दीर्घम् deeply, उच्छवसन् heaving, जगतीपतिम् the lord of the world, शुशोच bewailed.

text: बाष्प पर्याकुल मुखो राज मार्ग गतः जनः । न हृष्टः लक्ष्यते कश्चित् सर्वः शोक परायणः ॥२-४१-१७॥
translation: The faces of the people on the highway were turbid with tears. None looked happy. All were plunged in sorrow.
word_meanings: राजमार्गगतः in the royal highway, जनः people, बाष्पपर्याकुलमुखः faces full of tears, कश्चित् any body, हृष्टः happy, न लक्ष्ययते could not be seen, सर्वः all, शोकपरायणः was plunged in sorrow.

text: न वाति पवनः शीतः न शशी सौम्य दर्शनः । न सूर्यः तपते लोकम् सर्वम् पर्याकुलम् जगत् ॥२-४१-१८॥
translation: The breeze did not blow cool. No more did the Moon look pleasant. The Sun did not give warmth to the world. All the world was agitated.
word_meanings: पवनः wind, शीतः cool, न वाति does not blow, शशी Moon, सौम्यदर्शनः with pleasant appearance, न not, सूर्यः Sun, लोकम् the world, न तपते did not warm, सर्वम् entire, जगत् world, पर्याकुलम् was agitated.

text: अनर्थिनः सुताः स्त्रीणाम् भर्तारः भ्रातरः तथा । सर्वे सर्वम् परित्यज्य रामम् एव अन्वचिन्तयन् ॥२-४१-१९॥
translation: Mothers stopped thinking of their sons and husbands of their wives. Brothers were no longer interested in each other. Every one deserted every one and thought only of Rama.
word_meanings: सुताः sons, भर्तारः husbands, स्त्रीणाम् towards women, अनर्थिनः had no concern, तथा similarly, भ्रातरः brothers, अनर्थिनः had no mutual interest, सर्वे all, सर्वम् everything, परित्यज्य having deserted, राममेव about Rama only, अन्वचिन्तयन् they thought.

text: ये तु रामस्य सुहृदः सर्वे ते मूढ चेतसः । शोक भारेण च आक्रान्ताः शयनम् न जुहुस् तदा ॥२-४१-२०॥
translation: All the friends of Rama were stupefied. Afflicted with the burden of sorrow they did not leave their bed.
word_meanings: तदा then, रामस्य Rama's, ये सुहृदः those friends, ते सर्वे all of them, मूढचेतसः bewildered, शोकभारेण with burden of sorrow, आक्रान्ताः afflicted, शयनम् couches, न जहुः did not leave.

text: ततः तु अयोध्या रहिता महात्मना । पुरम्दरेण इव मही सपर्वता । चचाल घोरम् भय भार पीडिता । सनाग योध अश्व गणा ननाद च ॥२-४१-२१॥
translation: Without magnanimous Rama, Ayodhya thereafter looked like the earth along with its mountains bereft of Indra. Afflicted with fear and sorrow it started shaking dreadfully with the sounds of horses, elephants and warriors. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfirst sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, पुरन्दरेण by Indra, रहिता without, सपर्वता with mountains, महीव like earth, महात्मना magnanimous Rama, रहिता without, अयोध्या Ayodhya, भयशोकपीडिता agitated by fear and sorrow, घोरम् dreadfully, चचाल had shaken, सनागयोधाश्वगणा filled with hosts of warriors, elephants and horses, ननाद च made sounds.

text: यावत् तु निर्यतः तस्य रजो रूपम् अदृश्यत । न एव इक्ष्वाकु वरः तावत् सम्जहार आत्म चक्षुषी ॥२-४२-१॥
translation: As long as the dust raised by the wheels of the chariot of Rama (who was departing to the forest) was visible, Dasaratha, the best of the Ikshvakus, could not withdraw his eyes (from Rama).
word_meanings: तस्य that Rama, निर्यतः as he was going, रजोरूपम् the form of dust, यावत् as long as, अदृश्यत was visible, तावत् so long, इक्ष्वाकुवरः the best of Ikshvaku dynasty, king Dasaratha, आत्मचक्षुषी his eyes, नैव सञ्जहार did not withdraw.

text: यावद् राजा प्रियम् पुत्रम् पश्यति अत्यन्त धार्मिकम् । तावद् व्यवर्धत इव अस्य धरण्याम् पुत्र दर्शने ॥२-४२-२॥
translation: So long as king Dasaratha was able to see his exceedingly virtuous and beloved son (Rama), it appeared that his body kept rising from the earth to have a sight of his son.
word_meanings: राजा king, प्रियम् beloved, अत्यन्तधार्मिकम् exceedingly virtuous, पुत्रम् son, यावत् as long as, पश्यति was able to see, तावत् so long, अस्य his, पुत्रदर्शने for the sight of the son, धरण्याम् the dust on the earth, व्यवर्धतेव appeared growing.

text: न पश्यति रजो अपि अस्य यदा रामस्य भूमिपः । तदा आर्तः च विषण्णः च पपात धरणी तले ॥२-४२-३॥
translation: When the king could no longer see even the dust, he fell on the ground, despondent and grief stricken.
word_meanings: भूमिपः the king, यदा when, अस्य रामस्य that Rama's, रजोऽपि even the dust, न पश्यति could not see, तदा then, आर्तः च stricken with grief, विषण्णः च with despondency, धरणीतले on the earth, पपात fell down.

text: तस्य दक्षिणम् अन्वगात् कौसल्या बाहुम् अन्गना । वामम् च अस्य अन्वगात् पार्श्वम् कैकेयी भरत प्रिया ॥२-४२-४॥
translation: Kausalya reached for the right hand of Dasaratha (to raise him up) and Kaikeyi the beloved (mother) of Bharata reached for his left.
word_meanings: अङ्गना wife, कौशल्या Kausalya, तस्य his, दक्षिणं बाहुम् right hand, अन्वगात् reached, ,भरतप्रिया beloved (mother) of Bharata, कैकेयी च Kaikeyi, वामम् left, पार्श्वम् side, अन्वगात् reached.

text: ताम् नयेन च सम्पन्नो धर्मेण निवयेन च । उवाच राजा कैकेयीम् समीक्ष्य व्यथित इन्द्रियः ॥२-४२-५॥
translation: The king, endowed with rectitude, virtue and also humility, stared at and said to Kaikeyi with pain.
word_meanings: नयेन with rectitude, धर्मेण with virtue, विनयेन च also with humility, सम्पन्नः endowed with, राजा king, तां कैकेयीम् to that Kaikeyi, समीक्ष्य having seen, व्यथितेन्द्रियः one with painful senses reeling, उवाच said.

text: कैकेयि मा मम अन्गानि स्प्राक्षीस् त्वम् दुष्ट चारिणी । न हि त्वाम् द्रष्टुम् इच्चामि न भार्या न च बान्धवी ॥२-४२-६॥
translation: O Kaikeyi you are a woman of evil conduct. Do not touch my body. I do not wish to see you. You are not my wife or my relation.
word_meanings: कैकेयि O Kaikeyi, दुष्टचारिणी a woman of evil conduct, त्वम् you, मम my, अङ्गानि limbs, मा स्प्राक्षीः do not touch, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to look at, न हि इच्छामि do not wish, भार्या wife, न not, बान्धवी relation, न not.

text: ये च त्वाम् उपजीवन्ति न अहम् तेषाम् न ते मम । केवल अर्थ पराम् हि त्वाम् त्यक्त धर्माम् त्यजाम्य् अहम् ॥२-४२-७॥
translation: Your dependents have nothing to do with me nor I with them. I denounce you since you are a selfseeker without any sense off righteousness.
word_meanings: ये च who, त्वाम् you, अनुजीवन्ति depend upon you for subsistence, तेषाम् their, अहम् I, न not, ते they, मम to me, न not, केवलार्थपराम् seeking your selfish interests alone, त्यक्तधर्माम् deserting righteousness, त्वाम् you, अहम् I, त्यजामि abandon.

text: अगृह्णाम् यच् च ते पाणिम् अग्निम् पर्यणयम् च यत् । अनुजानामि तत् सर्वम् अस्मिम्ल् लोके परत्र च ॥२-४२-८॥
translation: I renounce the relationship established with you through marriage by taking your hand and circumambulating the fire, both in this world and in the next.
word_meanings: ते your, पाणिम् hand, अगृह्णां (इति) यत् the fact of holding, अग्निम् of (to) fire, पर्यणयं च (इति) यत् the fact of having circumambulated, तत्सर्वम् all that, अस्मिन् in this, लोके world, परत्र च in the next orld also, अनुजानामि renouncing.

text: भरतः चेत् प्रतीतः स्यात् राज्यम् प्राप्य इदम् अव्ययम् । यन् मे स दद्यात् पित्र् अर्थम् मा मा तत् दत्तम् आगमत् ॥२-४२-९॥
translation: If Bharata feels pleased to secure this imperishable kingdom, then may his obsequial offerings at my funeral not reach me
word_meanings: अव्ययम् imperishable, (इदं) राज्यम् this kingdom, प्राप्य having secured, भरतः Bharata, प्रतीतः स्यात् चेत् if he is pleased, सः he, पित्रर्थम् in the form of funeral offerings, मे to me, यत् which, दद्यात् gives, तद्दत्तम् given by him, माम् me, मागमत् may it not reach.

text: अथ रेणु समुध्वस्तम् तम् उत्थाप्य नर अधिपम् । न्यवर्तत तदा देवी कौसल्या शोक कर्शिता ॥२-४२-१०॥
translation: Then Kausalya, emaciated due to sorrow, lifted the king who was thoroughly coated with dust and returned to the palace.
word_meanings: अथ then, रेणुसमुध्वस्तम् coated with dust, तं नराधिपम् to that king, समुत्थाप्य having lifted, देवी queen, कौशल्या Kausalya, शोककर्शिता emaciated due to sorrow, तदा then, न्यवर्तत returned to her palace.

text: हत्वा इव ब्राह्मणम् कामात् स्पृष्ट्वा अग्निम् इव पाणिना । अन्वतप्यत धर्म आत्मा पुत्रम् सम्चिन्त्य तापसम् ॥२-४२-११॥
translation: That virtuous Dasaratha, recalling (the sight of) his son with the robes of an ascetic, burned with remorse as if he had intentionally slain a brahmin or placed his hand in fire.
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा virtuous one, तापसम् wearing the robes of an ascetic, पुत्रम् son, सञ्चिन्त्य remembering, कामात् intentionally, ब्राह्मणम् to a brahmin, हत्वेव as if slew, पाणिना with hand, अग्निम् to fire, स्पृष्ट्वा इव as if touched, अन्वतप्यत plunged in grief.

text: निवृत्य एव निवृत्य एव सीदतः रथ वर्त्मसु । राज्ञो न अतिबभौ रूपम् ग्रस्तस्य अम्शुमतः यथा ॥२-४२-१२॥
translation: Turning back again and again at the trail of (Rama's) chariot, the grieving king appeared lustreless like the Sun in eclipse.
word_meanings: रथवर्त्मसु trail of the chariot, निवृत्त्यैव निवृत्त्यैव turning again and again, सीदतः grieving, राज्ञः the king's, रूपम् countenance, ग्रस्तस्य as if swallowed by Rahu, अंशुमत: यथा like Sun, नातिबभौ did not shine.

text: विललाप च दुह्ख आर्तः प्रियम् पुत्रम् अनुस्मरन् । नगर अन्तम् अनुप्राप्तम् बुद्ध्वा पुत्रम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥२-४२-१३॥
translation: The griefstricken king began to lament thinking of his beloved son, and (suddenly) realizing that his son had crossed the limits of the city, said:
word_meanings: प्रियम् beloved, पुत्रम् son, अनुस्मरन् reflecting, दुःखार्तः tortured with sorrow, विललाप च lamented, अथ then, पुत्रम् son, नगरान्तम् end of the city, अनुप्राप्तम् havng reached, बुध्वा having realised, अब्रवीत् said.

text: वाहनानाम् च मुख्यानाम् वहताम् तम् मम आत्मजम् । पदानि पथि दृश्यन्ते स महात्मा न दृश्यते ॥२-४२-१४॥
translation: I can see the marks of the hooves of the splendid horses carrying my son on the highway but not that magnanimous Rama.
word_meanings: मम my, आत्मजम् son, तम् that Rama, वहताम् carrying, मुख्यानाम् preeminent, वाहनानाम् horses', पदानि hoofprints, पथि in the path, दृश्यन्ते are seen, महात्मा magnanimous, सः Rama, न दृश्यत is not to be seen.

text: स नूनम् क्वचित् एव अद्य वृक्ष मूलम् उपाश्रितः । काष्ठम् वा यदि वा अश्मानम् उपधाय शयिष्यते ॥२-४२-१५॥
translation: Rama, the best of all my sons who, smeared with sandalpaste and fanned by graceful women used to sleep (with his head) on comfortable cushions will surely, from now on, lie down somewhere at the foot of a tree, (his head) pillowed upon a piece of wood or stone.
word_meanings: यः मम सुतोत्तमः best among my sons, चन्दनरूषितः daubed with sandal cream, महार्हाभिः graceful, स्त्रीभिः by women, वीज्यमानः being fanned, सुखेषु luxurious, उपधानेषु on cushions, शेते was sleeping, सः such Rama, अद्य today, नूनम् surely, क्वचिदेव some where, वृक्षमूलम् at the foot of a tree, उपाश्रितः taking refuge, काष्ठं a log, यदि वा or, आश्मानम् a stone, उपधाय using as pillow, शयिष्यते he will sleep.

text: उत्थास्यति च मेदिन्याः कृपणः पाम्शु गुण्ठितः । विनिह्श्वसन् प्रस्रवणात् करेणूनाम् इव ऋषभः ॥२-४२-१६॥
उत्थास्यति च मेदिन्याः कृपणः पाम्सुगुण्ठितः । विनिःस्वसन् प्रस्रवणात्क रेणूनामि वर्ष्भः ॥२-४२-१७॥
translation: That unfortunate Rama, having been covered with dust, will get up from the ground sighing like a bull elephant rising from mount Prasravana.
word_meanings: करेणूनाम् of female elephants, ऋषभः lord, bull elephant, प्रस्रवणात् इव like from Prasravana mountain, विनिश्वसन् heaving sighs, पांसुकुण्ठितः crusted with dust, कृपणः unfortunate Rama, मेदिन्याः from the ground, उत्थास्यति च will rise up.

text: द्रक्ष्यन्ति नूनम् पुरुषा दीघ बाहुम् वने चराः । रामम् उत्थाय गच्चन्तम् लोक नाथम् अनाथवत् ॥२-४२-१८॥
translation: Surely the forestrovers will be gazing upon the longarmed Rama, protector of the world, as he rises (from the ground) and wanders in the jungle unprotected.
word_meanings: दीर्घबाहुम् longarmed, लोकनाथं lord of the world, अनाथवत् like without a protector, उत्थाय rising (from the ground), गच्छन्तम् walking, रामम् Rama, नूनम् surely, वनेचराः forestdwellers, पुरुषाः men, द्रक्ष्यन्ति they will see.

text: सकामा भव कैकेयि विधवा राज्यम् आवस । कण्टकाक्रमण क्लान्तावनमद्य गमिष्यति ॥२-४२-१९॥
अनभिज्ञा वनानाम् सा नूनम् भयमुपैष्यति । श्वापदान्र्धितम् श्रुत्वा गमिभीरम् रोमहर्ष्णम् ॥२-४२-२०॥
translation: Sita who knows not the forest will now live in terror, listening to the hairraising, horrible roars of wild animals.
word_meanings: वनानाम् of the forests, अनभिज्ञा un acquainted, सा Sita, नूनम् surely, गम्भीरम् deep and fearful, रोमहर्षणम् causing horripilation, श्वापदानर्दितम् roaring of wild animals, श्रुत्वा having heard, भयम् fear, उपैष्यति will obtain.

text: सकामा भवकैकेयि विधवा राज्य मावस । न हि तम् पुरुष व्याघ्रम् विना जीवितुम् उत्सहे ॥२-४२-२१॥
translation: O Kaikeyi, your desire is fulfilled. Rule the kingdom as a widow. Without Rama, the best of men, I don't desire to live.
word_meanings: कैकेयि Kaikeyi, सकामा भव desire be fulfilled, विधवा as widow, राज्यम् kingdom, आवस inhabit, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् tiger among men, तं विना without him, जीवितुम् to live, न उत्सहे हि do not desire.

text: इति एवम् विलपन् राजा जन ओघेन अभिसम्वृतः । अपस्नातैव अरिष्टम् प्रविवेश पुर उत्तमम् ॥२-४२-२२॥
translation: Thus the king, who looked like one after the inauspicious (funeral) bath, surrounded by streams of people entered the most beautiful city (Ayodhya) which portended misfortune.
word_meanings: इत्येवम् in this manner, विलपन् lamenting, राजा king, जनौघेन by the multitude of people, अभिसंवृतः surrounded, अपस्नातः one who has taken inauspicious (funeral) bath, अरिष्टं इव like an ominous, पुरोत्तमम् best of cities (Ayodhya), प्रविवेश entered.

text: शून्य चत्वर वेश्म अन्ताम् सम्वृत आपण देवताम् । क्लान्त दुर्बल दुह्ख आर्ताम् न अत्याकीर्ण महा पथाम् । ताम् अवेक्ष्य पुरीम् सर्वाम् रामम् एव अनुचिन्तयन् । विलपन् प्राविशद् राजा गृहम् सूर्यैव अम्बुदम् ॥२-४२-२३॥
translation: There the mansions and squares on the highways were all deserted. The temples and marketplaces were closed. The people were weak, fatigued and tormented with grief. The highways were not much crowded. Having seen such a sight of the city on all sides, lamenting and brooding over Rama, Dasaratha entered his palace like the Sun plunging into a cloud.
word_meanings: शून्यचत्वरवेश्मान्ताम् where the courtyards or the mansions were deserted, संवृतापणदेवताम् where temples and marketplaces were closed, क्लान्तदुर्बलदुःखार्ताम् weak and exhausted with with grief, नात्याकीर्णमहापथाम् the highways no longer crowded, ताम् that, सर्वाम् entire, पुरीम् to city of Ayodhya, आवेक्ष्य having seen, राजा king, राममेव about Rama only, अनुचिन्तयन् thinking, विलपन् lamenting, सूर्यः sun, अम्बुदम् इव like clouds, प्राविशत् entered.

text: महा ह्रदम् इव अक्षोभ्यम् सुपर्णेन हृत उरगम् । रामेण रहितम् वेश्म वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च ॥२-४२-२४॥
translation: The palace without Rama, Lakshmana and Sita, stood like a vast, unperturbed lake with serpents snatched away by Suparna (Garuda).
word_meanings: रामेण with Rama, वैदेह्या with Sita, लक्ष्मणेन च also with Lakshmana, रहितम् absent, वेश्म palace, सुपर्णेन by Suparna, हृतोरगम् a serpent snatched away, अक्षोभ्यम् an unperturbed, महाह्रदम् इव like a great tank

text: अथ गद्गदशब्दस्तु विलपन्मनुजाधिपः । उवाच मृदुमन्धार्थम् वचनम् दीन मस्वरम् ॥२-४२-२५॥
translation: Thereupon Dasaratha lamenting with his throat choked addressed (his attendants) in a low, feeble, melancholic, gentle voice:
word_meanings: अथ thereupon, मनुजा (वसुधा) धिपः lord of men, गद्गदशब्दः with choked throat, विलपन् lamenting, मृदु gently, मन्दार्थम् in low voice, अस्वरम् feeble, दीनं वचनम् in melancholic tones, उवाच said.

text: कौसल्याया गृहम् शीघ्रम् राम मातुर् नयन्तु माम् । इति ब्रुवन्तम् राजानम् अनयन् द्वार दर्शितः ॥२-४२-२६॥
इति ब्रुवन्तम् राजान मनयन् द्वार्दर्शिनः । कौसल्याया गृहम् तत्र न्यवेश्यत विनीतवत् ॥२-४२-२७॥
translation: Having heard the king, the doorkeepers took him to the apartment of Kausalya and there respectfully made him rest.
word_meanings: इति in this way, ब्रुवन्तम् while saying, राजानम् king Dasaratha, द्वारदर्शिनः doorkeepers, कौशल्यायाः Kausalya's, गृहम् apartment, अनयन् brought him, तत्र there, विनीतवत् respectfully, न्यवेश्यत he was made to rest.

text: ततः तत्र प्रविष्टस्य कौसल्याया निवेशनम् । अधिरुह्य अपि शयनम् बभूव लुलितम् मनः ॥२-४२-२८॥
translation: His mind tossed restlessly although he entered Kausalya's palace and climbed into the couch.
word_meanings: ततः then, कौशल्यायाः Kausalya's, निवेशनम् residence, प्रविष्टस्य having entered, तस्य his, मनः mind, शयनम् couch, अधिरुह्यापि though having climbed, लुलितम् बभूव was tossed about.

text: पुत्रद्वयविहीनम् च स्नुषयापि विवर्जितम् । अपश्यद्भवनम् राजा नष्टचन्ध्रमिवाम्बरम् ॥२-४२-२९॥
translation: To the king, the palace deserted by his two sons and his daughterinlaw, seemed like the sky without the Moon.
word_meanings: राजा king, पुत्रद्वयविहीनम् without his two sons, स्नुषयापि also by daughterinlaw, विवर्जितम् deserted, भवनम् palace, नष्टचन्द्रम् devoid of the Moon, अम्बरम् इव like the sky, अपश्यत् he saw.

text: तच् च दृष्ट्वा महा राजो भुजम् उद्यम्य वीर्यवान् । उच्चैः स्वरेण चुक्रोश हा राघव जहासि माम् ॥२-४२-३०॥
translation: The valiant maharaja looked around that palace, lifted up his arms and shouted in a loud voice, Oh scion of the Raghus (Rama) you have forsaken me.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् valiant, महाराजः the great king, तत् that palace, दृष्ट्वा having seen, भुजम् his hands, उद्यम्य having lifted up, हा राघव Oh Rama, माम् me, जहासि are forsaking, उच्चौः स्वरेण in loud voice, चुक्रोश screamed.

text: सुखिता बत तम् कालम् जीविष्यन्ति नर उत्तमाः । परिष्वजन्तः ये रामम् द्रक्ष्यन्ति पुनर् आगतम् ॥२-४२-३१॥
translation: Oh how fortunate are those best of men who will live until that time to see Rama return and embrace him.
word_meanings: ये नरोत्तमाः those fortunate people, तं कालम् till that tme, जीविष्यन्ति will live, पुनः again, आगतम् return, रामम् Rama, परिष्वजन्तः while embracing, सुखिताः happily, द्रक्ष्यन्ति will see, बत what a pity?

text: अथ रात्र्याम् प्रपन्नायाम् कालरात्र्यामिआत्मनः । अर्धरात्रे दशरथह् कौसल्यामिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-४२-३२॥
translation: In the middle of the night which, for him, felt like the night of death Dasaratha said to Kausalya thus:
word_meanings: अथ then, दशरथः Dasaratha, आत्मनः for himself, कालरात्र्यामिव like the night of death, रात्र्याम् night, प्रपन्नायाम् had set in, अर्धरात्रे in the middle of the night, कौशल्याम् addressing Kausalya, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: रामम् मेऽनुगता दृष्टिरद्यापि न निवर्तते । न त्वाम् पश्यामि कौसल्ये साधु माम् पाणिना स्पृश ॥२-४२-३३॥
translation: O Kausalya, my sight that had followed Rama has not yet returned. I cannot see you clearly. Please touch me with your hand.
word_meanings: कौशल्ये O Kausalya, रामम् Rama, अनुगता having followed, मे दृष्टिः my sight, अद्यापि even now, न निवर्तते has not returned, त्वा you, साधु clearly, न पश्यामि unable to see, माम् me, पाणिना with your hand, स्पृश touch.

text: तम् रामम् एव अनुविचिन्तयन्तम् । समीक्ष्य देवी शयने नर इन्द्रम् । उप उपविश्य अधिकम् आर्त रूपाउप । विनिह्श्वसन्ती विललाप कृच्च्रम् ॥२-४२-३४॥
translation: Having seen the king in bed brooding over Rama, the queen, (Kausalya), sitting by his side, sighed and lamented, deeply anguished. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्विचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysecond sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: देवी Kausalya, शयने in bed, रामम् एव Rama alone, अनुविचिन्तयन्तम् one who was continuously brooding, तं नरेन्द्रम् that king, समीक्ष्य having seen, उपोपविश्य sitting by his side, अधिकम् extremely, आर्तरूपा distressed, विनिश्वसन्ती sighing deeply, कृच्छ्रम् being in painful situation, विललाप lamented.

text: ततः समीक्ष्य शयने सन्नम् शोकेन पार्थिवम् । कौसल्या पुत्र शोक आर्ता तम् उवाच मही पतिम् ॥२-४३-१॥
translation: Struck by the grief of her son's departure, Kausalya looked at the king who lay on the couch completely exhausted and said to him.
word_meanings: ततः then, पुत्रशोकार्ता struck by grief on account of her son's departure, कौशल्या Kausalya, शयने on the couch, शोकेन due to grief, सन्नम् exhausted, पार्थिवम् king, समीक्ष्य having gazed, तं महीपतिम् to that lord of the world, Dasaratha, उवाच said.

text: राघवो नर शार्दूल विषम् उप्त्वा द्विजिह्ववत् । विचरिष्यति कैकेयी निर्मुक्ता इव हि पन्नगी ॥२-४३-२॥
translation: Moving crookedly like a snake, Kaikeyi has released her venom on Rama, the best among men. Now she will move about freely like a sheserpent that has cast off its slough.
word_meanings: अहिजह्मगा moving obliquely like a serpent, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, नरशार्दूले tiger (best) among men, राघवे in Rama, विषम् venom, उप्त्वा having sown out, निर्मुक्ता casting off the slough, पन्नगी इव like a sheserpent, विचरिष्यति will wander about.

text: विवास्य रामम् सुभगा लब्ध कामा समाहिता । त्रासयिष्यति माम् भूयो दुष्ट अहिर् इव वेश्मनि ॥२-४३-३॥
translation: Having banished Rama, she is now happy with her desires fulfilled. And like a vicious serpent living in the house she will again frighten me.
word_meanings: सुभगा happly, (Kaikeyi), रामम् Rama, विवास्य having banished, लब्दकामा having satisfied her desires, भूयः again, वेश्मनि in the house, दुष्टाहिरिव like a vicious serpent, माम् me, समाहिता accomplished, त्रासयिष्यति will torture me.

text: अथ स्म नगरे रामः चरन् भैक्षम् गृहे वसेत् । काम कारः वरम् दातुम् अपि दासम् मम आत्मजम् ॥२-४३-४॥
translation: It would have been better had I offered her my son as a slave. He would have lived on in the house by doing his duties and begging his food in the city.
word_meanings: मम my, आत्मजम् son, दासम् as slave, दातुम् अपि even to give, वरम् is better, अथ thereafter, रामः Rama, कामकारः discharging the duties, नगरे in the city (Ayodhya), भैक्षम् food obtained by begging, चरन् moving about, गृहे in the house, वसेत् would have lived.

text: पातयित्वा तु कैकेय्या रामम् स्थानात् यथा इष्टतः । प्रदिष्टः रक्षसाम् भागः पर्वणि इव आहित अग्निना ॥२-४३-५॥
translation: You have thrown away Rama from his place as per the whim of Kaikeyi, like the share of offering meant for gods given away to rakshasas by the sacrificers on the new Moon days.
word_meanings: कैकेय्या of Kaikeyi, यथेष्टतः according to her whim, रामम् to Rama, स्थानात् from his place, पातयित्वा having thrown down, अहिताग्निना by the sacrificers, पर्वणि on the new moon days, रक्षसाम् to rakshasas, भागः इव like the share, प्रदिष्टः is given.

text: गज राज गतिर् वीरः महा बाहुर् धनुर् धरः । वनम् आविशते नूनम् सभार्यः सह लक्ष्मणः ॥२-४३-६॥
translation: My mightyarmed son, a great archer and a hero, Rama whose gait is like that of the king of elephants, must be entering the forest along with his consort Sita and Lakshmana.
word_meanings: गजराजगतिः having the gait of the king of the elephants, वीरः hero, महाबाहुः mightyarmed, धनुर्धरः archer Rama, सभार्यः with wife, सहलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, नूनम् surely, वनम् forest, आविशते is entering.

text: वने तु अदृष्ट दुह्खानाम् कैकेय्या अनुमते त्वया । त्यक्तानाम् वन वासाय का न्व् अवस्था भविष्यति ॥२-४३-७॥
translation: You have banished them as per the desire of Kaikeyi. What will be their plight in the forest, for they have never experienced any hardship earlier
word_meanings: अदृष्टदुःखानाम् who have never seen suffering, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi's, अनुमते her desire, त्वया by you, वनवासाय to dwell in the forest, त्यक्तानाम् have been abandoned, वने in the forest, का नु what, अवस्था भविष्यति will be their state.

text: ते रत्न हीनाः तरुणाः फल काले विवासिताः । कथम् वत्स्यन्ति कृपणाः फल मूलैः कृत अशनाः ॥२-४३-८॥
translation: Deprived of all costly things they have been banished at the tender age of youth, a time for enjoying their lives. How will they lead a miserable life subsisting on fruits and roots?
word_meanings: रत्नहीनाः deprived of best of things, फलकाले at the time of fruition (enjoyment), विवासिताः having been exiled, तरुणाः young people, ते they, कृपणाः living in misery, फलमूलैः fruits and roots, कृताशनाः for food, कथम् how, वत्स्यन्ति will they live?

text: अपि इदानीम् स कालः स्यान् मम शोक क्षयः शिवः । सभार्यम् यत् सह भ्रात्रा पश्येयम् इह राघवम् ॥२-४३-९॥
translation: Will there ever be that auspicious moment to end my sorrow? When I can see Rama here along with his wife and brother?
word_meanings: यत् when, सभार्यम् with wife, राघवम् Rama, सह भ्रात्रा with Lakshmana, इह here, पश्येयम् I shall see, शोकक्षयः annhilation of sorrow, शिवः auspcious, सः कालः that time, इदानीम् now, मम to me, अपि स्यात् will it come?

text: श्रुत्वा एव उपस्थितौ वीरौ कदा अयोध्या भविष्यति । यशस्विनी हृष्ट जना सूच्च्रित ध्वज मालिनी ॥२-४३-१०॥
translation: When will the city of Ayodhya attain that glory when having heard that both the brave brothers have come back the people will rejoice and fill it with uplifted banners?
word_meanings: वीरौ the two heroes, उपस्थितौ having returned, श्रुत्वैव hearing, यशस्विनी famous, अयोध्या Ayodhya, हृष्टजना with cheerful people, सूच्छ्रितध्वजमालिनी uplifted flags, कदा when?, भविष्यति will it be?

text: कदा प्रेक्ष्य नर व्याघ्राव् अरण्यात् पुनर् आगतौ । नन्दिष्यति पुरी हृष्टा समुद्रैव पर्वणि ॥२-४३-११॥
translation: When will, like the swelling sea on a full Moon day, the city hail the return of Rama and Lakshmana, the best among men?
word_meanings: अरण्यात् from the forest, पुनः again, आगतौ having come back, नरव्याघ्रौ tigers (best) among men, Rama and Lakshmana, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, पुरी the city of Ayodhya, पर्वणि on a fullmoon day, समुद्र इव like the sea, हृष्टा overflow (overjoyed), कदा when, नन्दिष्यति will it rejoice?

text: कदा अयोध्याम् महा बाहुः पुरीम् वीरः प्रवेक्ष्यति । पुरः कृत्य रथे सीताम् वृषभो गो वधूम् इव ॥२-४३-१२॥
translation: When will the mightyarmed hero (Rama) enter the city of Ayodhya with Sita in front in the chariot, like a bull following the cow?
word_meanings: महाबाहुः mightyarmed, वीरः hero, वृषभः bull, गोवधूमिव like cow, सीताम् Sita, रथे on the chariot, पुरस्कृत्य placing in front, अयोध्यां पुरीम् to the city of Ayodhya, कदा when, प्रवेक्ष्यति will enter?

text: कदा प्राणि सहस्राणि राज मार्गे मम आत्मजौ । लाजैः अवकरिष्यन्ति प्रविशन्ताव् अरिम् दमौ ॥२-४३-१३॥
translation: When will the people in their thousands shower the parched grain on the highway when my sons (Rama and Lakshmana), subduers of enemies, enter the city?
word_meanings: प्रविशन्तौ when they enter, अरिन्दमौ subduers of enemies, मम my, आत्मजौ sons, राजमार्गे on the highway, प्राणिसहस्राणि thousands of people, लाजैः with parched grain, कदा when, अवकिरिष्यन्ति shower.

text: प्रविशनौ कदाऽपियोध्याम् द्रक्ष्यामि शुभकुण्डता । उदग्रायुधनिस्त्रीम्शौ सशृङ्गाविव पर्वतौ ॥२-४३-१४॥
translation: When shall I see both of them wearing auspicious earrings and holding poweful weapons (bows) and swords high, like two mountain peaks?
word_meanings: अयोध्याम् of Ayodhya, प्रविशन्तौ when they enter, शुभकुण्डलौ wearing auspicious earrings, उदग्रायुधनिस्त्रिंशौ with powerful weapons and swords raised high, सश्रृङ्गौ with peaks, पर्वताविव like mountains, कदा when, द्रक्ष्यामि shall I see?

text: कदा सुमनसः कन्या द्विजातीनाम् फलानि च । प्रदिशन्त्यः पुरीम् हृष्टाः करिष्यन्ति प्रदक्षिणम् ॥२-४३-१५॥
translation: When will I see them delightfully moving round the city with young brahmin girls offering them flowers and fruits.
word_meanings: हृष्टाः delighted, कन्याद्विजातीनाम् to young girls and to brahmins, सुमनसः flowers, फलानि च fruits also, प्रदिशन्तः while offering, कदा when, पुरीम् the city, प्रदक्षिणम् circling, करिष्यन्ति will do?

text: कदा परिणतः बुद्ध्या वयसा च अमर प्रभः । अभ्युपैष्यति धर्मज्ञः त्रिवर्षैव माम् ललन् ॥२-४३-१६॥
translation: When will Rama, the knower of righteousness, possessing the lustre of gods, and fully mature in age and wisdom come back to me playfully like a threeyearold boy?
word_meanings: अमरप्रभः possessing the lustre of gods, धर्मज्ञः knower of righteousness (Rama), बुद्ध्या in wisdom, वयसा च in age, परिणतः fully mature, त्रिवर्षः इव like a three year old boy, ललन् playfully, माम् me, कदा when, अभ्युपैष्यति will he reach?

text: निह्सम्शयम् मया मन्ये पुरा वीर कदर्यया । पातु कामेषु वत्सेषु मातृऋणाम् शातिताः स्तनाः ॥२-४३-१७॥
translation: O valiant one, in my previous birth I must have undoubtedly hacked off the udders of cows when the calves were thirsting for milk from their mothers.
word_meanings: वीर O valiant one, कदर्यया out of avarice, मया by myself, निस्संशयम् undoubtedly, पुरा formerly, वत्सेषु calves, पातुकामेषु thirsting for milk, मातृ़णाम् of mothers, स्तनाः udders, शातिताः hacked by me.

text: सा अहम् गौर् इव सिम्हेन विवत्सा वत्सला कृता । कैकेय्या पुरुष व्याघ्र बाल वत्सा इव गौर् बलात् ॥२-४३-१८॥
translation: O best of men I have been forcibly separated from my affectionate son by Kaikeyi just like a cow from its calf by a lion.
word_meanings: पुरुषव्य्राघ्र O tiger among men, बालवत्सा young calf, गौरिव like cow, वत्सला having affection in the calf, सा अहम् I, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, सिंहेन by lion, गौरिव like cow, बलात् forcibly, विवत्सा separated from the calf, कृता is rendered.

text: न हि तावद् गुणैः जुष्टम् सर्व शास्त्र विशारदम् । एक पुत्रा विना पुत्रम् अहम् जीवितुम् उत्सहे ॥२-४३-१९॥
translation: I cannot live without my only son who is adept in all scriptures and endowed with all virtues.
word_meanings: एकपुत्रा having only one son, अहम् I, तावद्गुणैः with such virtue, जुष्टम् endowed with, सर्वशास्त्रविशारदम् adept in all shastras, पुत्रं विना without my son, जीवितुम् to live, न उत्सहे हि I do not desire.

text: न हि मे जीविते किम्चित् सामर्थम् इह कल्प्यते । अपश्यन्त्याः प्रियम् पुत्रम् महा बाहुम् महा बलम् ॥२-४३-२०॥
translation: Without seeing my beloved son, longarmed and mighty, I have but little strength to live in this world.
word_meanings: महाबाहुम् mightyarmed, महाबलम् immensely strong, प्रियं पुत्रम् beloved son, अपश्यन्त्या: without seeing him, मे for me, इह in this world, जीविते in this life, किञ्चित् little, सामर्थ्यम् ability, न कल्प्यते हि is not provided.

text: अयम् हि माम् दीपयते समुत्थितः । तनूज शोक प्रभवो हुत अशनः । महीम् इमाम् रश्मिभिर् उत्तम प्रभो । यथा निदाघे भगवान् दिवा करः ॥२-४३-२१॥
translation: I am consumed by this blazing fire of grief caused by separation from my son like the earth scorched in summer by the Sungod with his oppressive rays इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रिचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortythird sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: तनूजशोकप्रभवः born out of the grief of separation from my son, अयम् this, हुताशनः fire, समुत्थितः having arisen, निदाघे in summer, उद्धतप्रभः immense heat, भगवान् divine, दिवाकरः Sun, रश्मिभिः with his rays, इमाम् this, महीं यथा like earth, माम् me, दीपयते is burning.

text: विलपन्तीम् तथा ताम् तु कौसल्याम् प्रमद उत्तमाम् । इदम् धर्मे स्थिता धर्म्यम् सुमित्रा वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-४४-१॥
translation: While Kausalya, the best of women was thus lamenting, virtuous Sumitra spoke to her these righteous words:
word_meanings: धर्मे in virtues, स्थिता abiding, सुमित्रा Sumitra, तथा then, विलपन्तीम् lamenting, प्रमदोत्तमाम् best among women, तां कौशल्याम् to that Kausalya, धर्म्यम् conforming to righteousness, इदं वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: तव आर्ये सद् गुणैः युक्तः पुत्रः स पुरुष उत्तमः । किम् ते विलपितेन एवम् कृपणम् रुदितेन वा ॥२-४४-२॥
translation: My venerable lady, your son Rama is the greatest among men and is endowed with every virtue. Why do you lament in this way? Why do you weep bitterly?
word_meanings: आर्ये O venerable one, सद्गुणैः with every good quality, युक्तः endowed with, तव your, सः पुत्रः such a son, पुरुषोत्तमः the greatest among men, एवम् in this way, ते you, विलपितेन with lamentation, कृपणम् bitterly, रुदितेन वा or by weeping, किम् what is the use?

text: यः तव आर्ये गतः पुत्रः त्यक्त्वा राज्यम् महा बलः । साधु कुर्वन् महात्मानम् पितरम् सत्य वादिनाम् ॥२-४४-३॥
translation: In order to vindicate the words of his great and truthful father, O noble lady,your mighty son has renounced the kingdom and has gone (to the forest). He has stuck to the path so scrupulously followed by the wise, the everlasting results of which can be fully realised in the world to come. Such a peerless son is never to be grieved over.
word_meanings: आर्ये O noble lady, महाबलः mighty, यः Rama, तव पुत्रः your son, महात्मानम् magnanimous, पितरम् father, साधु worthy of, सत्यवादिनम् as truthful one, कुर्वन् to do, राज्यम् kingdom, त्यक्त्वा renouncing, शिष्टैः by virtuous men, सम्यक् fully, शश्वत् everlasting, आचरिते followed, प्रेत्य in the next world, फलोदये at the time of fruition, धर्मे in virtues, स्थितः stuck, श्रेष्ठः best, सः that, रामः Rama, कदाचन at any point, शोच्यः न not to be grieved over.

text: शिष्टैः आचरिते सम्यक् शश्वत् प्रेत्य फल उदये । रामः धर्मे स्थितः श्रेष्ठो न स शोच्यः कदाचन ॥२-४४-४॥
translation: In order to vindicate the words of his great and truthful father, O noble lady,your mighty son has renounced the kingdom and has gone (to the forest). He has stuck to the path so scrupulously followed by the wise, the everlasting results of which can be fully realised in the world to come. Such a peerless son is never to be grieved over.
