word_meanings: शुभेक्षण one who has auspicious looks, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, मृगम् an antelope, हत्वा having killed, क्षिप्रम् quickly, इह here, आनय bring, शास्त्रदृष्ट: as prescribed by the scriptures, विधि: rites, कर्तव्यः हि will have to be carried out, धर्मम् the tradition, अनुस्मर recollect.

text: भ्रातुर्वचन माज्ञाय लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा । चकार स यथोक्तम् च तम् रामः पुनरब्रवीत् ॥२-५६-२४॥
translation: Lakshmana, slayer of heroes on the enemy's side, understood and implemented what he was told. Rama again said to him:
word_meanings: परवीरहा slayer of heroes of the enemy's side, स लक्ष्मण: that Lakshmana, भ्रातु: brother' s, वचनम् words, आज्ञाय having understood, यथोक्तम् as told, चकार carried out, राम: Rama, तम् him, पुन: again, अब्रवीत् said.

text: इणेयम् श्रपयस्वैतच्च्चालाम् यक्ष्यमहे वयम् । त्वरसौम्य मुहूर्तोऽयम् ध्रुवश्च दिवसोऽप्ययम् ॥२-५६-२५॥
translation: Cook this venison, O handsome one We will offer it to the presiding deity of this hut. Hasten, the day and time are fixed (for the rites)
word_meanings: सौम्य O handsome one, एतत् this, ऐणेयम् venison, श्रपयस्व cook, वयम् we, शालाम् hut, यक्ष्यामहे will worship, अयम् this, दिवस: day, अयम् this, मुहूर्त:अपि this moment also, ध्रुवश्च is fixed, त्वर hasten.

text: स लक्ष्मणः कृष्ण मृगम् हत्वा मेध्यम् पतापवान् । अथ चिक्षेप सौमित्रिः समिद्धे जात वेदसि ॥२-५६-२६॥
translation: Then the powerful son of Sumitra killed a black antelope fit for offering, and offered it to the wellkindled fire.
word_meanings: अथ then, सौमित्रि: son of Sumitra, प्रतापवान् powerful, स: लक्ष्मण: that Lakshmana, मेथ्यम् fit for offering pure, कृष्णमृगम् black antelope, हत्वा having killed, समिद्धे in a wellkindled, जातवेदसि fire, चिक्षेप offered.

text: तम् तु पक्वम् समाज्ञाय निष्टप्तम् चिन्न शोणितम् । लक्ष्मणः पुरुष व्याघ्रम् अथ राघवम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५६-२७॥
translation: With the blood drained out of the venison, Lakshmana roasted it and cooked it well, and then said to Rama, the tiger (best) among men.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण: Lakshmana, निष्टप्तम् roasted well, छिन्नशोणितम् with blood drained out, तम् that, पक्वम् cooked, परिज्ञाय having found, अथ then, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् tiger (best) among men, राघवम् to Rama, अब्रवीत् said.

text: अयम् कृष्णः समाप्त अन्गः शृतः कृष्ण मृगो यथा । देवता देव सम्काश यजस्व कुशलो हि असि ॥२-५६-२८॥
translation: This black antelope with all its limbs is wellcooked. O divine sire, you may make the offering to Vastu devata in which you are proficient.
word_meanings: समस्ताङ्ग: with all the limbs, अयम् this, कृष्णमृग: black antelope, सर्व: completely, मया by me, श्रुत: is wellcooked, देवसङ्काश like a god, देवता: devatas, यजस्व offer with sacrifice, कुशल: असि हि you are proficient.

text: रामः स्नात्वा तु नियतः गुणवान् जप्य कोविदः । सम्ग्रहेणाकरोत्सर्वान् मन्त्रन् सत्रावसानिकान् ॥२-५६-२९॥
translation: Virtuous Rama, who was an expert in the recitation of mantras, took his bath and his mind controlled, intoned briefly all the mantras appropriate to the completion of the ritual.
word_meanings: गुणवान् virtuous,जप्यकोविद: expert in reciting appropriate mantras, राम: Rama, स्नात्वा having bathed, नियत: with his senses restrained, सत्रावसानिकान् rites performed at the end of the ritual, सर्वान् all that, मन्त्रान् mantras, सङ्ग्रहेण briefly, अकरोत् performed (intoned).

text: इष्ट्वा देवगणान् सर्वान् विवेशावसथम् शुचिः । बभूव च मनोह्लादो रामस्यामिततेजसः ॥२-५६-३०॥
translation: Sanctified with the worship of all the gods, Rama of immeasurable lustre felt a great happiness on entering the hut.
word_meanings: सर्वान् all, देवगणान् gods, इष्ट्वा having worshipped by offering, शुचिः becoming pure, अवसथम् the leafhut, विवेश entered, अमिततेजस: immeasurable lustre, रामस्य to Rama, मनोह्लादः cheer of mind, बभूव च caused.

text: वैश्वदेवबलिं कृत्वा रौद्रं वैष्णव मेव च । वास्तुसंशमनीयानि मङ्गलानि प्रवर्तयन् ॥२-५६-३१॥
translation: Rama, offered oblations to Visvadevas, Rudra and Visnu, performed the auspices for the appeasement of the household deity. And having muttered japa silently in conformity with tradition, he took his ablution in the river as enjoined (by the sastras) and offered his final oblations for the expiation of his sins.
word_meanings: राम: Rama, वैश्वदेवबलिम् oblations to Visvadevas (the entire pantheon of gods), रौद्रम् to Rudra, वैष्णवमेव च to Visnu, कृत्वा having offered, वास्तुसंशमनीयानि propitiation of the household deity (Vastu devata), मङ्गलानि auspices, प्रवर्तयन् doing, न्यायत: according to precept, जपं च कृत्वा muttering the silent prayers, नद्याम् in the river, यथाविधि duly, स्नात्वा after bathing, पापसंशमनम् for the expiation of sins, उत्तमं बलिम् final oblation, चकार made.

text: जपम् च न्यायतः कृत्वा स्नात्वा नद्याम् यथाविधि । पाप सम्शमनम् रामः चकार बलिम् उत्तमम् ॥२-५६-३२॥
translation: Rama, offered oblations to Visvadevas, Rudra and Visnu, performed the auspices for the appeasement of the household deity. And having muttered japa silently in conformity with tradition, he took his ablution in the river as enjoined (by the sastras) and offered his final oblations for the expiation of his sins.
word_meanings: राम: Rama, वैश्वदेवबलिम् oblations to Visvadevas (the entire pantheon of gods), रौद्रम् to Rudra, वैष्णवमेव च to Visnu, कृत्वा having offered, वास्तुसंशमनीयानि propitiation of the household deity (Vastu devata), मङ्गलानि auspices, प्रवर्तयन् doing, न्यायत: according to precept, जपं च कृत्वा muttering the silent prayers, नद्याम् in the river, यथाविधि duly, स्नात्वा after bathing, पापसंशमनम् for the expiation of sins, उत्तमं बलिम् final oblation, चकार made.

text: वेदिस्थलविधानानि चैत्यान्यायतनानि च । आश्रमस्यानुरूपाणि स्थापयामास राघवः ॥२-५६-३३॥
translation: Rama, son of the Raghus, made altars in all the quarters, places of worship and sacred spots for fire befitting a hermitage.
word_meanings: राघव: the scion of the Raghus (Rama), आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, अनुरूपाणि befitting, वेदिस्थलविधानानि making of altars, चैत्यानि places of worship, आयतनानि च sacred places for fire, स्थापयामास established.

text: वन्यैर्माल्यैः फलैर्मूलैः पक्वैर्माम्सैर्यथाविधि । अद्भर्जपैश्च वेदोक्तै र्धर्भैश्च ससमित्कुशैः ॥२-५६-३४॥
तौ तर्पयित्वा भूतानि राघवौ सह सीतया । तदा विविशतुः शालाम् सुशुभाम् शुभलक्षणौ ॥२-५६-३५॥
translation: Bestowed with auspicious qualities, Rama and Lakshmana along with Sita propitiated those celestial beings with garlands of forest flowers, fruits and roots, wellcooked venison, water, muttering of prayers as expounded in the Vedas, faggots and kusa grass and entered that auspicious hermitage.
word_meanings: शुभलक्षणौ bestowed with auspicious qualities, राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, सह सीतया accompanied by Sita, वन्यै: माल्यै: with garlands of forest flowers, फलै: with fruits, मूलै: with roots, पक्वै: with wellcooked, मांसै: with venison, अद्भिः with water, वेदोक्तै: as expounded in the Vedas, जपैश्च with muttering of prayers, दर्भैश्च with darbha grass, सुसमित्कुशै: with faggots and kusa grass, भूतानि all beings, तर्पयित्वा after propitiating, तदा then, शुभाम् auspicious, शालाम् hut, विविशतुः entered.

text: ताम् वृक्ष पर्णच् चदनाम् मनोज्ञाम् । यथा प्रदेशम् सुकृताम् निवाताम् । वासाय सर्वे विविशुः समेताः । सभाम् यथा देव गणाः सुधर्माम् ॥२-५६-३६॥
translation: Just like the gods enter the court of Sudharma, they all stepped into the hut to dwell there. The hut was charming wellbuilt on a suitable site and protected against storm.
word_meanings: वृक्षपर्णच्छदनाम् covered with the leaves of trees, मनोज्ञाम् charming, यथाप्रदेशम् built on a suitable site, सुकृताम् wellbuilt, निवाताम् protected against storm, ताम् that hut, सर्वे all, समेता together, वासाय for purposes of living, देवगणाः gods, सुधर्माम् Sudharma, सभां यथा like the court, विविशु: entered.

text: अनेक नाना मृग पक्षि सम्कुले । विचित्र पुष्प स्तबलैः द्रुमैः युते । वन उत्तमे व्याल मृग अनुनादिते । तथा विजह्रुः सुसुखम् जित इन्द्रियाः ॥२-५६-३७॥
translation: Then they with their senses conquered, enjoyed perfect happiness in that splendid forest teeming with many varieties of animals and birds, with trees full of brilliant clusters of flowers and echoing with the sounds of wild animals.
word_meanings: तदा then, जितेन्द्रियाः who had conquered the senses, अनेकनानामृगपक्षिसङ्कुले filled with many varieties of animals and birds, विचित्रपुष्पस्तबकै: with bunches of bright flowers, द्रुमै with trees, युते full of, व्यालमृगानुनादिते echoing with the sounds of wild animals, वनोत्तमे in that splendid forest, सुसुखम् very happily, विजह्रु: wandered.

text: सुरम्यम् आसाद्य तु चित्र कूटम् । नदीम् च ताम् माल्यवतीम् सुतीर्थाम् । ननन्द हृष्टः मृग पक्षि जुष्टाम् । जहौ च दुह्खम् पुर विप्रवासात् ॥२-५६-३८॥
translation: Having reached the marvellous mount Chitrakuta and river Malyavati with excellent holy places and full of animals and birds, Rama shed the sorrow of his banishment from the city (of Ayodhya) and rejoiced with a gladdened heart. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षट्पञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftysixth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सुरम्यम् marvellous, चित्रकूटम् mount Chitrakuta, आसाद्य having reached, सुतीर्थाम् with excellent holy places, मृगपक्षिजुष्टाम् full of animals and birds, ताम् that, माल्यवतीं नदीं च that Malyavati river, हृष्ट: filled with delight, ननन्द rejoiced, पुरविप्रवासात् banishment from the city, दुखम् sorrow, जहौ च left.

text: कथयित्वा सुदुह्ख आर्तः सुमन्त्रेण चिरम् सह । रामे दक्षिण कूलस्थे जगाम स्व गृहम् गुहः ॥२-५७-१॥
translation: Until Rama reached the southern bank, Guha kept talking with Sumantra for long and returned home with great sorrow.
word_meanings: रामे Rama, दक्षिणकूलस्थे had reached the southern bank (of the river), गुह: Guha, सुमन्त्रेण सह with Sumantra, चिरम् for a long while, कथयित्वा after talking, सुदुःखार्तः tormented with anguish, स्वगृहम् his home, जगाम reached.

text: भरद्वाजाभिगमनम् प्रयागे च सहासनम् । आगिरेर्गमनम् तेषाम् तत्रस्थैरभिलक्षितम् ॥२-५७-२॥
translation: Positioned there, they could mark their arrival at Bharadwaja's at Prayaga, their stay (nighthalt) and their onward journey to Chitrakuta mountain.
word_meanings: तेषाम् their, भरद्वाजाभिगमनम् arrival at the hermitage of Bharadwaja, प्रयागे at Prayaga, सहाऽसनम् stay with him, आगिरेः till that Chitrakuta mountain, गमनम् journey, तत्रस्थैः by the men waiting there, उपलक्षितम् has been observed.

text: अनुज्ञातः सुमन्त्रः अथ योजयित्वा हय उत्तमान् । अयोध्याम् एव नगरीम् प्रययौ गाढ दुर्मनाः ॥२-५७-३॥
translation: Permitted by Rama to leave, Sumantra harnessed the best of horses and set out for the city of Ayodhya with a heavy heart.
word_meanings: अथ after this, अनुज्ञातः having been permitted by Rama to leave, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, हयोत्तमान् best of horses, योजयित्वा harnessing, गाढदुर्मनाः with a heavy heart, अयोध्यां नगरीमेव to the city of Ayodhya, प्रययौ set out.

text: स वनानि सुगन्धीनि सरितः च सराम्सि च । पश्यन्न् अतिययौ शीघ्रम् ग्रामाणि नगराणि च ॥२-५७-४॥
translation: Beholding the fragrancefilled forests, rivers, lakes, villages and towns on the way, Sumantra quickly crossed them.
word_meanings: सः that, सुगन्धीनि fragrant, वनानि forests, सरितः च rivers as well, सरांसि च lakes also, ग्रामाणि villages, नगराणि च towns also, पश्यन् seeing, शीघ्रम् swiftly, अतिययौ passed through them.

text: ततः साय अह्न समये तृतीये अहनि सारथिः । अयोध्याम् समनुप्राप्य निरानन्दाम् ददर्श ह ॥२-५७-५॥
translation: The charioteer reached Ayodhya on the third day at dusk and found the city cheerless.
word_meanings: सारथिः charioteer, तृतीये on the third, अहनि day, सायाह्न समये at dusk, निरानन्दाम् cheerless, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, समनुप्राप्य having reached, ददर्श ह saw.

text: स शून्याम् इव निह्शब्दाम् दृष्ट्वा परम दुर्मनाः । सुमन्त्रः चिन्तयाम् आस शोक वेग समाहतः ॥२-५७-६॥
translation: Beholding the silent city, almost empty, the deeply depressed Sumantra, afflicted with gushing tears reflected:
word_meanings: सः सुमन्त्रः that Sumantra, निश्शब्दाम् silent, शून्यामिव almost empty, दृष्ट्वा having seen, परमदुर्मनाः deeply dejected, शोकवेगसमाहतः afflicted with gushing tears, चिन्तयामास reflected.

text: कच्चिन् न सगजा साश्वा सजना सजन अधिपा । राम सम्ताप दुह्खेन दग्धा शोक अग्निना पुरी ॥२-५७-७॥
translation: Has the city along with its elephants, horses, people and its king perished in the fire of grief for Rama?
word_meanings: सगजाः with elephants, साऽश्वाः with horses, सजनाः with its people, सजनाधिपा with the king, पुरी city, रामसन्तापदुःखेन in the sorrow caused by Rama's suffering, शोकाग्निना by the fire of sorrow, दग्धा burnt.

text: इति चिन्ता परः सूतः वाजिभिः श्रीघ्रपातिभिः । नगरद्वारमासाद्य त्वरितः प्रविवेश ह ॥२-५७-८॥
translation: Absorbed in these thoughts, the charioteer came to the citygate, carried by the swiftfooted horses, and quickly entered the city.
word_meanings: इति in this way, चिन्तापरः absorbed in this thought, सूतः the charioteer, शीघ्रपातिभिः by the swiftrunning, वाजिभिः horses, नगरद्वारम् entrance to the city, आसाद्य having arrived, त्वरितः quickly, प्रविवेश ह entered.

text: सुमन्त्रम् अभियान्तम् तम् शतशो अथ सहस्रशः । क्व रामैति पृच्चन्तः सूतम् अभ्यद्रवन् नराः ॥२-५७-९॥
translation: Meanwhile as the charioteer was moving towards the city, hundreds and thousands of men came pouring towards him enquiring, 'Where is Rama?'
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, अभियान्तम् moving towards, तम् that, सूतम् charioteer, सुमन्त्रम् Sumantra, रामः Rama, क्व where?, इति thus, पृच्छन्तः enquiring, नराः people, शतशः in hundreds, सहस्रशः in thousands, अभ्यद्रवन् poured towards him.

text: तेषाम् शशम्स गङ्गायाम् अहम् आपृच्च्य राघवम् । अनुज्ञातः निवृत्तः अस्मि धार्मिकेण महात्मना ॥२-५७-१०॥
translation: I took leave of the great, righteous Rama on the bank of the Ganga and have returned with his permission. (replied Sumantra).
word_meanings: अहम् I, गङ्गायाम् river Ganga, राघवम् Rama, आपृच्छ्य having taken leave, धार्मिकेण by the righteous, महात्मना great (Rama), अनुज्ञातः having been permitted, निवृत्तः अस्मि I have returned, तेषाम् to them, शशंस said.

text: ते तीर्णाइति विज्ञाय बाष्प पूर्ण मुखा जनाः । अहो धिग् इति निश्श्वस्य हा राम इति च चुक्रुशुः ॥२-५७-११॥
translation: Hearing that they had (the trio) crossed the river Ganga, the people, with their faces filled with tears sighed and saying 'Fie upon us Alas, Rama' cried out aloud.
word_meanings: ते they, तीर्णाः इति crossed the river, thus, विज्ञाय having come to know, जनाः people, बाष्पपूर्णमुखाः faces filled with tears, अहो Oh, धिक् O fie upon us, इति thus, निश्श्वस्य sighing, हा राम इति saying 'Alas Rama', चुक्रुशुः च cried aloud.

text: शुश्राव च वचः तेषाम् बृन्दम् बृन्दम् च तिष्ठताम् । हताः स्म खलु ये न इह पश्यामैति राघवम् ॥२-५७-१२॥
translation: He saw them gathering in groups, saying, Henceforth we will not be able to see Rama and without him, we are lost indeed.
word_meanings: ये all of us, इह here, राघवम् Rama, न पश्यामः unable to see, हताः स्म खलु indeed we are lost (deprived), इति thus saying, बृन्दम् बृन्दम् in groups, तिष्ठताम् standing, तेषाम् their, वचः words, शुश्राव च also heard.

text: दान यज्ञ विवाहेषु समाजेषु महत्सु च । न द्रक्ष्यामः पुनर् जातु धार्मिकम् रामम् अन्तरा ॥२-५७-१३॥
translation: No longer will we see Rama at sacrifices, weddings, great assemblies and at places of charitable activity.
word_meanings: दानयज्ञविवाहेषु in acts of charity, sacrifices and weddings, महत्सु in great, समाजेषु च assemblies also, अन्तरा in their midst, धार्मिकम् righteous, रामम् Rama, पुनः again, जातु ever, न द्रक्ष्यामः will not see.

text: किम् समर्थम् जनस्य अस्य किम् प्रियम् किम् सुख आवहम् । इति रामेण नगरम् पितृवत् परिपालितम् ॥२-५७-१४॥
translation: Rama looked after his people like a father always thinking what was good for them, dear to them and comfortable to them.
word_meanings: अस्य जनस्य to these people, किम् what, समर्थम् is meaningful, किम् what, प्रियम् pleases, किम् what, सुखावहम् brings happiness, इति in this way, रामेण by Rama, नगरम् this city of Ayodhya, पितृवत् like father, परिपालितम् looked after.

text: वात अयन गतानाम् च स्त्रीणाम् अन्वन्तर आपणम् । राम शोक अभितप्तानाम् शुश्राव परिदेवनम् ॥२-५७-१५॥
translation: (He) heard wailings of women looking through the window and of the people in marketplaces burning with sorrow over Rama's exile.
word_meanings: वातायनगतानाम् looking through the windows, स्त्रीणाम् women's, अन्वन्तरापणम् in the stalls, रामशोकाभितप्तानाम् burning with sorrow due to Rama's exile, परिदेवनम् bewailings, शुश्राव heard.

text: स राज मार्ग मध्येन सुमन्त्रः पिहित आननः । यत्र राजा दशरथः तत् एव उपययौ गृहम् ॥२-५७-१६॥
translation: Sumantra with his face muffled, drove along the highway straight to the palace of king Dasaratha.
word_meanings: सः सुमन्त्रः that Sumantra, पिहिताननः with his face muffled, राजमार्गमध्येन along the highway, राजा दशरथः king Dasaratha, यत्र where, तत् that, गृहम् house, उपययौ reached straight.

text: सो अवतीर्य रथात् शीघ्रम् राज वेश्म प्रविश्य च । कक्ष्याः सप्त अभिचक्राम महा जन समाकुलाः ॥२-५७-१७॥
translation: Quickly alighting from the chariot, he entered the king's palace and crossed the seven courtyards overcrowded with people.
word_meanings: सः that, रथात् from the chariot, अवतीर्य alighting, शीघ्रम् quickly, राजवेश्म king's palace, प्रविश्य च having entered, महाजनसमाकुलाः overcrowded with people, सप्त seven, कक्ष्याः courtyards, अभिक्राम crossed.

text: हर्म्यैर्विमानैः प्रासादैरवेक्ष्याथ समागतम् । हाहाकारकृता नार्यो रामदर्शनकर्शिताः ॥२-५७-१८॥
translation: Women from mansions, sevenstoried buildings and from royal palaces, sighted him and pained at not seeing Rama cried out 'Alas, Alas'.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, नार्यः women, हर्म्यैः from mansions, विमानैः from sevenstoried buildings, प्रासादैः from royal palaces, समागतम् arrived, आवेक्ष्य having seen, रामदर्शन कर्शिताः sad at not seeing Rama, हाहाकारकृताः cried out 'Alas, Alas'.

text: आयतैर्विमलैर्नेत्रैरश्रुवेगपरिप्लुतैः । अन्योन्यमभिवीक्षन्तेऽव्यक्तमार्ततराः स्त्रीयः ॥२-५७-१९॥
translation: The women in great anguish stood silently looking at one another, their large eyes flooded with overflowing tears.
word_meanings: स्त्रियः women, आर्ततराः in greater anguish,आयतैः large,विमलैःclean, अश्रुवेगपरिप्लुतैः flooded with the force of tears, नेत्रैः with eyes, अव्यक्तम् silently अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिवीक्षन्ते were looking.

text: ततः दशरथ स्त्रीणाम् प्रासादेभ्यः ततः ततः । राम शोक अभितप्तानाम् मन्दम् शुश्राव जल्पितम् ॥२-५७-२०॥
translation: From different spots in the palace, Sumantra heard the sobs and whispers of Dasaratha's wives who were tormented with the sorrow of Rama's exile.
word_meanings: ततः then, ततस्ततः here and there, प्रासाद्येभ्यः from palaces, रामशोकाभितप्तानाम् afflicted with sorrow due to Rama's exile, दशरथस्त्रीणाम् of the wives of Dasaratha, मन्दम् जल्पितम् whispers, शुश्राव heard.

text: सह रामेण निर्यातः विना रामम् इह आगतः । सूतः किम् नाम कौसल्याम् शोचन्तीम् प्रति वक्ष्यति ॥२-५७-२१॥
translation: The charioteer left with Rama and returned without him. What can he say to the wailing Kausalya?
word_meanings: रामेण सह with Rama, निर्यातः went out, विना रामम् without Rama, इह here, आगतः returned, सूतः charioteer, शोचन्तीम् worrying, कौशल्याम् Kausalya, किं नाम what can, प्रतिवक्ष्यति will he say?

text: यथा च मन्ये दुर्जीवम् एवम् न सुकरम् ध्रुवम् । आच्चिद्य पुत्रे निर्याते कौसल्या यत्र जीवति ॥२-५७-२२॥
translation: I think it is indeed difficult for Kausalya to live wherever and whichever way she tries as she has been separated from her son. (the queens said).
word_meanings: पुत्रे when the son, आच्छिद्य severing all connections, निर्याते had set out, कौसल्या Kausalya, यथा in whichever way, यत्र जीवति wherever surviving still, दुर्जीवम् it is difficult to live, मन्ये I consider, एवम् like this, सुकरम् easily, न not, ध्रुवम् certain.

text: सत्य रूपम् तु तत् वाक्यम् राज्ञः स्त्रीणाम् निशामयन् । प्रदीप्तम् इव शोकेन विवेश सहसा गृहम् ॥२-५७-२३॥
translation: Listening to the correct words of the king's wives, he immediately entered the palace as if in flames (of grief).
word_meanings: राज्ञ: king's, स्त्रीणाम् wives, सत्यरूपम् truth embodied, तत् वाक्यम् that word, निशामयन् listening, सहसा immediately, शोकेन with grief, प्रदीप्तमिव as if burning, गृहम् house, विवेश entered.

text: स प्रविश्य अष्टमीम् कक्ष्याम् राजानम् दीनम् आतुलम् । पुत्र शोक परिम्लानम् अपश्यत् पाण्डुरे गृहे ॥२-५७-२४॥
translation: On entering the eighth courtyard, he saw in a pale white chamber king Dasaratha desolate, anguished and withered with the sorrow of separation from his son.
word_meanings: सः he (Sumantra), अष्टमीम् eighth, कक्ष्याम् courtyard, प्रविश्य having entered, पाण्डुरे in pale white, गृहे chamber, दीनम् desolate, आतुरम् anguished, पुत्रशोकपरिम्लानम् withered by sorrow over his son, राजानम् king, अपश्यत् saw.

text: अभिगम्य तम् आसीनम् नर इन्द्रम् अभिवाद्य च । सुमन्त्रः राम वचनम् यथा उक्तम् प्रत्यवेदयत् ॥२-५७-२५॥
translation: Sumantra approached the king who was seated, paid obeisance to him and conveyed Rama's words verbatim.
word_meanings: सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, असीनम् seated, नरेन्द्रम् king, अभिगम्य having approached, अभिवाद्य paying obeisance, रामवचनम् Rama's words, यदोक्तम् verbatim, प्रत्यवेदयत् conveyed.

text: स तूष्णीम् एव तत् श्रुत्वा राजा विभ्रान्त चेतनः । मूर्चितः न्यपतत् भूमौ राम शोक अभिपीडितः ॥२-५७-२६॥
translation: The king silently listened to Rama's message. Bewildered and tormented by the grief of Rama's absence, he fell down on the ground in a swoon.
word_meanings: सः that, राजा king, तूष्णीमेव silently, तत् those words, श्रुत्वा having listened, विभ्रान्तचेतनः with a bewildered mind, रामशोकाभिपीडितः tormented by the grief due to Rama's absence, मूर्छितः with senses lost, भूमौ on the ground, न्यपतत् fell.

text: ततः अन्तः पुरम् आविद्धम् मूर्चिते पृथिवी पतौ । उद्धृत्य बाहू चुक्रोश नृपतौ पतिते क्षितौ ॥२-५७-२७॥
translation: The moment the lord of the earth fell down on the ground unconscious, the women in the inner apartment burst into tears, raising their arms.
word_meanings: ततः then, पृथिवीपतौ when lord of the earth (the king), मूर्छिते had fallen unconscious, अन्तःपुरम् inner apartment, आविद्धम् broken down, नृपतौ king, क्षितौ on the ground, पतिते had fallen, बाहू arms, उद्धृत्य having raised, चुक्रोश cried loudly.

text: सुमित्रया तु सहिता कौसल्या पतितम् पतिम् । उत्थापयाम् आस तदा वचनम् च इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५७-२८॥
translation: Having seen her husband collapsed on the ground, Kausalya assisted by Sumitra lifted him up and said to him thus:
word_meanings: तदा then, सुमित्रया सहिता together with Sumitra, कौशल्या Kausalya, पतितम् fallen on the ground, पतिम् husband, उत्थापयामास lifted him up, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: इमम् तस्य महा भाग दूतम् दुष्कर कारिणः । वन वासात् अनुप्राप्तम् कस्मान् न प्रतिभाषसे ॥२-५७-२९॥
translation: O distinguished king, why are you not enquiring from the messenger about him (Rama) who is capable of performing arduous tasks?
word_meanings: महाभाग O distinguished one, वनवासात् from the forest, अनुप्राप्तम् returned, दुष्करकारिणः one who had accomplished arduous tasks, तस्य Rama's, इमम् this, दूतम् messenger, कस्मात् why, न प्रतिभाषसे are not talking.

text: अद्य इमम् अनयम् कृत्वा व्यपत्रपसि राघव । उत्तिष्ठ सुकृतम् ते अस्तु शोके न स्यात् सहायता ॥२-५७-३०॥
translation: O descendant of the Raghus are you ashamed of having done an injustice? Arise. you may be a blessed one (for fulfilling your promise). If you grieve, none will help you.
word_meanings: राघव O descendant of the Raghus, अनयम् injustice, कृत्वा having done, अद्य now, एवम् in this way, व्यपत्रपसि are feeling ashamed, उत्तिष्ठ rise, ते to you, सुकृतम् the merit (of having fullfilled your word), अस्तु obtained, शोके in this sorrow, सहायता help, न स्यात् will not get.

text: देव यस्या भयात् रामम् न अनुपृच्चसि सारथिम् । न इह तिष्ठति कैकेयी विश्रब्धम् प्रतिभाष्यताम् ॥२-५७-३१॥
translation: Kaikeyi for fear of whom you dare not ask the charioteer about Rama, O king is not here. You may speak to him without fear.
word_meanings: देव O king, यस्याः by whose, भयात् from fear, सारथिम् charioteer, रामम् about Rama, नानुपृच्छसि you are not enquiring, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, इह now, न तिष्ठति not here, विस्रब्धम् without fear, प्रतिभाष्यताम् you may speak.

text: सा तथा उक्त्वा महा राजम् कौसल्या शोक लालसा । धरण्याम् निपपात आशु बाष्प विप्लुत भाषिणी ॥२-५७-३२॥
translation: Absorbed in grief, Kausalya spoke to the maharaja in a voice choked with tears and then collapsed on the floor.
word_meanings: बाष्पविप्लुतभाषिणी speaking with a voice choked with tears, शोकलालसा absorbed in grief, सा कौशल्या that Kausalya, महाराजम् to the maharaja, तथा that way, उक्त्वा having said, आशु suddenly, धरण्याम् on the ground, निपपात fell down.

text: एवम् विलपतीम् दृष्ट्वा कौसल्याम् पतिताम् भुवि । पतिम् च अवेक्ष्य ताः सर्वाः सुस्वरम् रुरुदुः स्त्रियः ॥२-५७-३३॥
translation: All those women saw weeping Kausalya as well as their husband fallen on the ground and wailed loudly in a chorus.
word_meanings: सर्वाः all, ताः स्त्रियः those women, एवम् thus, विलपतीम् lamenting, भुवि पतिताम् fallen on the ground, कौशल्याम् Kausalya, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पतिं च also their husband, अवेक्ष्य having seen, सुस्वरम् in chorus, रुरुदुः wailed loudlly.

text: ततः तम् अन्तः पुर नादम् उत्थितम् । समीक्ष्य वृद्धाः तरुणाः च मानवाः । स्त्रियः च सर्वा रुरुदुः समन्ततः । पुरम् तदा आसीत् पुनर् एव सम्कुलम् ॥२-५७-३४॥
translation: Having heard the sound emanating from the inner apartment, people, old, young and women, of the city lamented. The city was crowded again. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyseventh sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, उत्थितम् rising, तम् that, अन्तःपुरनादम् sound from the inner apartment, समीक्षय having seen, वृद्धा: old, तरुणाश्च young, मानवाः people, सर्वाः all, स्त्रीयश्च also women, समन्ततः all around, रुरुदुः lamented, तदा then, पुरम् city, पुनरेव again, सङ्कुलम् आसीत् was filled (with people).

text: प्रत्याश्वस्तः यदा राजा मोहात् प्रत्यागतः पुनः । थाजुहाव तम् सूतम् राम वृत्त अन्त कारणात् ॥२-५८-१॥
translation: When the king regained his consciousness and was consoled, he summoned the charioteer to hear news about Rama.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, राजा king, यदा when, प्रत्याश्वस्तः consoled, मोहात् from loss of consciousness, पुनः again, प्रत्यागतम् having regained his senses, रामवृत्तान्त कारणात् due to the news about Rama, तं सूतम् that charioteer, आजुहाव called for him.

text: तदा सूतो महाराज कृताञ्जलिरुपस्थितः । राममेव अनुशोचन्तं दुःखशोकसमन्वितम् ॥२-५८-२॥
translation: Then the charioteer with folded palms approached the king who, deeply afflicted with grief and pain, was brooding over Rama alone. Aged Dasaratha was heaving deep sighs like a newlycaptured, indisposed elephant.
word_meanings: अथ then, सूतः the charioteer, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, राममेव Rama alone, अनुशोचन्तम् thinking of Rama, दुःखशोकसमन्वितम् by grief and sorrow, वृद्धम् aged, परमसन्तप्तम् deeply afflicted, नवग्रहम् newlycaptured, द्विपमिव like an elephant, विनिःश्वसन्तम् heaving deep sighs, अस्वस्थम् indisposed, कुञ्जरमिव like an elephant, ध्यायन्तम् brooding, महाराजम् king, उपस्थितः approached.

text: वृद्धम् परम सम्तप्तम् नव ग्रहम् इव द्विपम् । विनिःश्वसन्तम् ध्यायन्तम् अस्वस्थम् इव कुन्जरम् ॥२-५८-३॥
translation: Then the charioteer with folded palms approached the king who, deeply afflicted with grief and pain, was brooding over Rama alone. Aged Dasaratha was heaving deep sighs like a newlycaptured, indisposed elephant.
word_meanings: अथ then, सूतः the charioteer, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, राममेव Rama alone, अनुशोचन्तम् thinking of Rama, दुःखशोकसमन्वितम् by grief and sorrow, वृद्धम् aged, परमसन्तप्तम् deeply afflicted, नवग्रहम् newlycaptured, द्विपमिव like an elephant, विनिःश्वसन्तम् heaving deep sighs, अस्वस्थम् indisposed, कुञ्जरमिव like an elephant, ध्यायन्तम् brooding, महाराजम् king, उपस्थितः approached.

text: राजा तु रजसा सूतम् ध्वस्त अङ्गम् समुपस्थितम् । अश्रु पूर्ण मुखम् दीनम् उवाच परम आर्तवत् ॥२-५८-४॥
translation: Seeing the dejected charioteer standing before him, the desolate king covered all over with dust and his face bathed in tears, said to him in extreme grief:
word_meanings: राजा king, रजसा with dust, ध्वस्ताङ्गम् covered all over, अश्रुपूर्णमुखम् face bathed in tears, दीनम् dejected, समुपस्थितम् standing nearby, सूतम् charioteer, परमार्तवत् filled with extreme grief, उवाच said.

text: क्व नु वत्स्यति धर्म आत्मा वृक्ष मूलम् उपाश्रितः । सो अत्यन्त सुखितः सूत किम् अशिष्यति राघवः ॥२-५८-५॥
translation: O charioteer Rama is rightous and he is acustoomed to all sorts of comfort. Taking refuge at the foot of a tree how shall he live and what shall he eat?
word_meanings: सूत the charioteer, धर्मात्मा righteous (Rama), वृक्षमूलम् foot of the tree, उपाश्रितः having taken refuge, क्वनु where, वत्स्यति will he live?, अत्यन्त सुखितः enjoyed supreme luxury, स: राघवः that Rama, किम् what?, अशिष्यति will he eat?

text: दुःखस्यानुचितो दुःखम् सुमन्त्र शयनोचितः । भूमि पाल आत्मजो भूमौ शेते कथम् अनाथवत् ॥२-५८-६॥
translation: How can the son of the guardian of the earth who is accustomed to a comfortable bed and not to undeserved suffering lie down on the ground like an orphan, O Sumantra
word_meanings: सुमन्त्र Sumantra, दुःखस्य to sorrow, अनुचितः not deserving, शयनोचितः accustomed to comfortable couches, भूमिपालात्मजः son of the guardian of the earth (prince Rama), अनाथवत् like an orphan, भूमौ on the ground, दुःखम् sadly, कथम् how?, शेते can lie down?

text: यं यान्तमनुयान्ति स्म पदातिरथकुञ्जराः । स वत्स्यति कथं रामो विजनं वन माश्रितः ॥२-५८-७॥
translation: Wherever Rama went, elephants, chariots and footsoldiers followed him. How can he (now) live in the desolate forest where he has taken refuge?
word_meanings: यान्तम् when he went out, यम् whom, पदातिरथकुञ्जरा: footsoldiers, chariots and elephants, अनुयान्ति स्म followed, सः that, रामः Rama, विजनम् desolate, वनम् forest, आश्रितः having taken shelter, कथम् how, वत्स्यति can live.

text: व्यालैर्मृगैराचरितं कृष्णसर्पनिषेवितम् । कथं कुमारौ वैदेह्या सार्धं वन मुपस्थितौ ॥२-५८-८॥
translation: How can the two young men along with Vaidehi live in the forest infested with black cobras and wicked, wild animals?
word_meanings: कुमारौ the two youths (Rama and Lakshmana), वैदेह्या सार्धम् with Vaidehi also, व्यालैः by wicked wild elephants, मृगैः animals, आचरितम् ranging about, कृष्णसर्पनिषेवितम् abounding in black cobras, वनम् forest, कथम् how, उपस्थितौ exist.

text: सुकुमार्या तपस्विन्या सुमन्त्र सह सीतया । राज पुत्रौ कथम् पादैः अवरुह्य रथात् गतौ ॥२-५८-९॥
translation: O Sumantra how did those two princes along with pitiable, delicate Sita, alight from the chariot, and enter the forest on foot?
word_meanings: सुमन्त्र Sumantra, राजपुत्रौ king's sons, सुकुमार्या along with delicate, तपस्विन्या by the pitiable, सीतया सह with Sita, रथात् from the chariot, पादैः on foot, अवरुह्य alighting, कथम् how, गतौ did they go.

text: सिद्ध अर्थः खलु सूत त्वम् येन दृष्टौ मम आत्मजौ । वन अन्तम् प्रविशन्तौ ताव् अश्विनाव् इव मन्दरम् ॥२-५८-१०॥
translation: You are blessed indeed, O charioteer to have seen my sons entering the outskirts of the forest like Aswinis stepping into the region of the Mandara mountain.
word_meanings: सूत O charioteer, येन by you, अश्विनौ Aswinis, मन्दरम् इव like Mandara mountain, वनान्तम् on the outskirts of the forest, प्रविशन्तौ entering, मम my, आत्मजौ sons, दृष्टौ have been seen, त्वम् you, सिद्धार्थः खलु are blessed indeed.

text: किम् उवाच वचो रामः किम् उवाच च लक्ष्मणः । सुमन्त्र वनम् आसाद्य किम् उवाच च मैथिली ॥२-५८-११॥
translation: Upon reaching the forest, O Sumantra what did Rama, Lakshmana and Sita say?
word_meanings: सुमन्त्र Sumantra, वनम् forest, आसाद्य on reaching, रामः Rama, किम् what?, वचः words, उवाच did speak, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, किम् what, उवाच did say, मैथिली च and Sita, किम् what, उवाच did say.

text: आसितम् शयितम् भुक्तम् सूत रामस्य कीर्तय । जीविष्याम्यहमेतेन ययातिरिव साधुषु ॥२-५८-१२॥
translation: Tell me, O charioteer where Rama sat, where he slept, what (food) he ate. Only your words will enable me to live like Yayati among saints.
word_meanings: सूत charioteer, रामस्य Rama's, आसितम् seat, शयितम् bed, भुक्तम् food, कीर्तय describe, अहम् I, ययातिः Yayati, साधुषु इव as in the company of saints, एतेन with this, जीविष्यामि shall live.

text: इति सूतः नर इन्द्रेण चोदितः सज्जमानया । उवाच वाचा राजानम् स बाष्प परिर्बद्धया ॥२-५८-१३॥
translation: Thus questioned by the king the charioteer, his voice choked with tears and words faltering in grief, addressed the king:
word_meanings: नरेन्द्रेण by the king, Dasaratha, इति in this way, बोधितः questioned, सः सूतः that charioteer, बाष्पपरिबद्धया with voice choked with tears, सज्जमानया faltering with grief, वाचा with words, राजानम् to the king, उवाच said.

text: अब्रवीन् माम् महा राज धर्मम् एव अनुपालयन् । अन्जलिम् राघवः कृत्वा शिरसा अभिप्रणम्य च ॥२-५८-१४॥
translation: With palms folded and head bowed, O great king Rama offered his salutations to you in confirmity with righteousness and said to me:
word_meanings: महाराज O great king, राघवः the descendant of the Raghu race (Rama), धर्ममेव righteousness also, अनुपालयन् guarding, अञ्जलिम् with folded hands, कृत्वा having set, शिरसा bowing his head, अभिप्रणम्य च offering salutations, माम् to me, अब्रवीत् said.

text: सूत मद्वचनात् तस्य तातस्य विदित आत्मनः । शिरसा वन्दनीयस्य वन्द्यौ पादौ महात्मनः ॥२-५८-१५॥
translation: 'Convey on my behalf, O charioteer to my illustrious father who is known for his selfknowledge, and is worthy of homage, that I am saluting his feet with my head bowed.
word_meanings: सूत O charioteer, मद्वचनात् as my words, विदितात्मनः knower of the self, महात्मनः illustrious, वन्दनीयस्य worthy of salutations, तस्य that, तातस्य father's, पादौ feet, शिरसा head, वन्द्यौ are worthy of salutations.

text: सर्वम् अन्तः पुरम् वाच्यम् सूत मद्वचनात्त्वया । आरोग्यम् अविशेषेण यथा अर्हम् च अभिवादनम् ॥२-५८-१६॥
translation: 'On my behalf convey, O charioteer, without any distinction, my salutations to all the women befitting their status and tell them I was enquiring about their wellbeing.
word_meanings: सूत O charioteer, त्वया by you, मद्वचनात् at my words, सर्वम् entire, अन्तःपुरम् inmates of the inner apartment, अविशेषेण without distinction, आरोग्यम् wellbeing, यथार्हम् befitting their status, अभिवादनं च salutations, वाच्यम् fit to be conveyed.

text: माता च मम कौसल्या कुशलम् च अभिवादनम् । अप्रमादम् च वक्तव्या ब्रूयाश्चैमिदम् वचः ॥२-५८-१७॥
translation: 'Convey my mother carefully my saluations and my wellbeing and tell her:
word_meanings: मम my, माता mother, कौसल्या Kausalya, कुशलम् welfare, अभिवादनं च salutations, अप्रमादं च alertness, वक्तव्या is worthy of conveying, इदम् this, वचश्च word, ब्रूयाः tell.

text: धर्मनित्या यथाकालमग्न्यगारपरा भव । देवि देवस्य पादौ च देववत् परिपालय ॥२-५८-१८॥
translation: 'O mother, adhering to the righteous path and performing in time the rituals in the chamber of sacrificial fire, offer your services at the feet of king Dasaratha as if he were a god.
word_meanings: देवि O mother, धर्मनित्या adhering to the righteous path, यथाकालम् in time, अग्न्यगारपरा भव perform the rituals in the chamber of sacrificial fire, देवस्य (your) lord's (king Dasaratha's), पादौ च feet also, देववत् like a god, परिपालय serve.

text: अभिमानम् च मानम् च त्यक्त्वा वर्तस्व मातृषु । अनु राजान मार्याम् च कैकेयीमम्ब कारय ॥२-५८-१९॥
translation: 'O mother, conduct yourself with other mothers without pride and egoism. Ensure that venerable Kaikeyi remains welldisposed towards the king.
word_meanings: अभिमानं च egoism, मानं च pride, मातृषु towards mothers, वर्तस्व conduct yourself, अम्ब O mother, आर्याम् venerable, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, राजानम् अनु welldisposed towards the king, कारय mould her.

text: कुमारे भरते वृत्तिर्वर्तितव्याच राजवत् । अर्थज्येष्ठा हि राजानो राजधर्ममनुस्मर ॥२-५८-२०॥
translation: 'Behave towards young Bharata as to a king. Irrespective of age, a king is a king. (Hence should be honoured). You should keep this rajadharma (royal prerogative) in mind.
word_meanings: कुमारे young, भरते towards Bharata, राजवत् like a king, वृत्ति: conduct, वर्तितव्या to be followed, राजानः kings, अर्थज्येष्ठाः हि senior by virtue of their royalty, राजधर्मम् prerogative of kings, अनुस्मर remember.

text: भरतः कुशलम् वाच्यो वाच्यो मद् वचनेन च । सर्वास्व एव यथा न्यायम् वृत्तिम् वर्तस्व मातृषु ॥२-५८-२१॥
translation: 'Tell Bharata of my welfare and tell him on my behalf that he should honour all our mothers equally.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, कुशलम् welfare, वाच्यः deserves to be told, मद्वचनेन by my word, वाच्यः च is to be told, सर्वासु among all, मातृषु mothers, यथान्यायम् rightly, वृत्तिम् behaviour, वर्तस्व follow.

text: वक्तव्यः च महा बाहुर् इक्ष्वाकु कुल नन्दनः । पितरम् यौवराज्यस्थो राज्यस्थम् अनुपालय ॥२-५८-२२॥
translation: The mighty-armed delight of the Ikshvaku race should be told this: installed as prince regent, rule the kingdom in obedience to your father.
word_meanings: इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः delight of the race of Ikshvaku, महाबाहुः mightyarmed, वक्तव्यश्च deserves be told this way, यौवराज्यस्थः crowned as prince regent, राज्यस्थम् being in the kingdom, पितरम् father, अनुपालय rule the kingdom (by being obedient to him).

text: अतिक्रान्तवया राजा मास्मैनम् व्यवरोरुधः । कुमारराज्ये जीव त्वम् तस्यैवाज्ञ्प्रवर्तनाम् ॥२-५८-२३॥
translation: 'The king is advanced in age. Do not restrict him in any manner. Carry out his orders as prince regent, and live happily'.
word_meanings: राजा king Dasaratha, अतिक्रान्तवयाः is advanced in age, एनम् him, मा स्म व्यवरोरुधः do not restrict him, त्वम् you, तस्यैव that king's, आज्ञाप्रवर्तनात् carrying out the commands, कुमारराज्ये as prince regent, जीव live.

text: अब्रवीच्चापि माम् भूयो भृशमश्रूणि वर्तयन् । मातेव मम माता ते द्रष्टव्या पुत्रगर्धिनी ॥२-५८-२४॥
translation: Shedding profuse tears, Rama continued, 'Look after my mother who is covetous of her son as your own mother'.
word_meanings: भृशम् excessively, अश्रूणि tears, वर्तयन् shedding, माम् addressing me, भूयः more, अब्रवीच्चापि uttered, पुत्रगर्धिनी covetous of her son, मम माता my mother, ते by you, मातेव as your mother, द्रष्टव्या worthy of being looked after.

text: इति एवम् माम् महाराज बृवन्न् एव महा यशाः । रामः राजीव ताम्र अक्षो भृशम् अश्रूणि अवर्तयत् ॥२-५८-२५॥
translation: While saying this the red lotuslike eyes of illustrious Rama streamed with tears, O maharaja
word_meanings: महाराज O king, महायशाः renowned, राजीवताम्राक्षः with red lotuslike eyes, रामः Rama, माम् to me, इत्येवम् thus, ब्रुवन्नेव while saying, भृशम् copious, अश्रूणि tears, अवर्तयत् shed.

text: लक्ष्मणः तु सुसम्क्रुद्धो निह्श्वसन् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । केन अयम् अपराधेन राज पुत्रः विवासितः ॥२-५८-२६॥
translation: But Lakshmana, seething with anger and sighing said, 'For what offence has this king's son been banished'?
word_meanings: लक्ष्मणस्तु Lakshmana, सुसङ्कृद्धः mighty angry, निश्श्वसन् sighing, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, अयम् this, राजपुत्रः king's son, केन by what, अपराधेन offence, विवासितः has been banished?

text: राज्ञा तु खलु कैकेय्या लघु त्वाश्रित्य शासनम् । कृतम् कार्यमकार्यम् वा वयम् येनाभिपीडिताः ॥२-५८-२७॥
translation: 'The king, too, submitting to the trash command of Kaikeyi has perpetrated an act, just or unjust (he knows better), for which we are made to suffer so much.
word_meanings: राज्ञा तु by the king also, कैकेय्याः of Kaikeyi, लघु trash, शासनम् command, आश्रित्य having taken refuge, अकार्यम् a forbidden act, कार्यं वा or a worthy act, कृतम् has been done, येन by which, वयम् we, अभिपीडिताः have been made to suffer.

text: यदि प्रव्राजितः रामः लोभ कारण कारितम् । वर दान निमित्तम् वा सर्वथा दुष्कृतम् कृतम् ॥२-५८-२८॥
translation: 'Whether it was out of greed (for the kingdom) or for (the execution of) the boon bestowed, this act of banishment is by all means wicked'.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, लोभकारणकारितम् out of greed (for the kingdom), वरदाननिमित्तं वा or on account of the boons bestowed, प्रव्राजितः यदि if banished, सर्वथा by all means, दुष्कृतम् wicked act, कृतम् has been done.

text: इदम् तावद्यथाकाममीश्वरस्य कृते कृतम् । रामस्य तु परित्यागे न हेतुम् उपलक्षये ॥२-५८-२९॥
translation: 'Or he might have thought he is the overlord and can do as he likes. (Or, he might have done this for fear of God) Otherwise, I do not see any reason for the abandonment of Rama'.
word_meanings: इदं तावत् this one, ईश्वरस्य कृते for (fear of) God, यथाकामम् this act, कृतम् done, रामस्य Rama's, परित्यागे in abandonment, हेतुम् reason, न उपलक्षये I do not see.

text: असमीक्ष्य समारब्धम् विरुद्धम् बुद्धि लाघवात् । जनयिष्यति सम्क्रोशम् राघवस्य विवासनम् ॥२-५८-३०॥
translation: 'Unjustly, foolishly and without (proper) consideration Rama has been banished. This will (definitely) cause sorrow'.
word_meanings: बुद्धिलाघवात् out of lack of intelligence, असमीक्ष्य without (proper) consideration, समारब्धम् commenced, विरुद्धम् contrary (to justice), राघवस्य Rama's, विवासनम् banishment, सङ्क्रोशम् bewailment, जनयिष्यति will produce.

text: अहम् तावन् महा राजे पितृत्वम् न उपलक्षये । भ्राता भर्ता च बन्धुः च पिता च मम राघवः ॥२-५८-३१॥
translation: 'I do not regard the great king as my father. Rama alone is my brother, protector, friend and father.
word_meanings: अहम् I, महाराजे in that great king, पितृत्वम् fatherhood, नोपलक्ष्ये I do not see, मम to me, राघवः Rama alone, भ्राता च brother, भर्ताच also protector, बन्धुश्च friend, पिता father.

text: सर्व लोक प्रियम् त्यक्त्वा सर्व लोक हिते रतम् । सर्व लोको अनुरज्येत कथम् त्वा अनेन कर्मणा ॥२-५८-३२॥
translation: 'How can anyone in this world be pleased with you for deserting Rama, the beloved of all, and ever devoted to their welfare?
word_meanings: सर्वलोकप्रियम् beloved to all, सर्वलोकहिते in the welfare of all, रतम् devoted, त्यक्त्वा after deserting, अनेन कर्मणा with this act, त्वा towards you, सर्वलोकः entire world, कथम् how, अनुरज्येत will be pleased?

text: सर्वप्रजाभिरामम् हि रामम् प्रव्राज्य धार्मिकम् । सर्वलोकम् विरुध्येमम् कथम् राजा भविष्यसि ॥२-५८-३३॥
translation: 'Having banished the righteous Rama, the delight of all subjects and, thereby, antagonizing the entire world, how can you claim to be their king?'
word_meanings: सर्वप्रजाभिरामम् Delight of all subjects, धार्मिकम् righteous, रामम् to Rama, प्रव्राज्य having used banishment, इमम् this, सर्वलोकम् entire world, विरुध्य antagonizing, राजा king, कथम् how, भविष्यसि will continue to rule?

text: जानकी तु महा राज निःश्वसन्ती तपस्विनी । भूत उपहत चित्ता इव विष्ठिता वृष्मृता स्थिता ॥२-५८-३४॥
translation: O great king as for that sensitive Janaki, she stood sighing, stupefied and oblivious (of the past), yet smiling as though her mind was possessed by an evil spirit.
word_meanings: महाराज O great king, मनस्विनी sensitive lady, जानकी तु Janaki, निश्श्वसन्ती heaving sighs, भूतोपहतचित्तेव like one possessed, विस्मृता स्मिता like one unconcerned with the surroundings and yet smiling, विष्ठिता stood stupefied.

text: अदृष्ट पूर्व व्यसना राज पुत्री यशस्विनी । तेन दुह्खेन रुदती न एव माम् किम्चित् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५८-३५॥
translation: That glorious princess Sita who had never experienced any adversity earlier, weeping with sorrow, could not even speak to me anything.
word_meanings: अदृष्टपूर्वव्यसना who had never experienced adversity, यशस्विनी celebrated, राजपुत्री that princess, तेन that, दुःखेन with sorrow, रुदती weeping, माम् to me, किञ्चित् even a little, नैव अब्रवीत् did not at all say.

text: उद्वीक्षमाणा भर्तारम् मुखेन परिशुष्यता । मुमोच सहसा बाष्पम् माम् प्रयान्तम् उदीक्ष्य सा ॥२-५८-३६॥
translation: When she saw me leaving, she looked at her husband with a dry (pale) face and suddenly burst into tears.
word_meanings: सा she, प्रयान्तम् moving, माम् me, उदीक्ष्य having seen, परिशुष्यता with driedup, मुखेन face, भर्तारम् husband, उद्वीक्षमाणा beholding, सहसा suddenly, बाष्पम् tears, मुमोच shed.

text: तथैव रामः अश्रु मुखः कृत अन्जलिः । स्थितः अभवल् लक्ष्मण बाहु पालितः स्थितः । तथैव सीता रुदती तपस्विनी । निरीक्षते राज रथम् तथैव माम् ॥२-५८-३७॥
translation: Supported by Lakshmana's arms, Rama stood, his face streaming with tears and palms folded, while the wretched Sita, glaring at me and the royal chariot, weeping. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyeighth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: तथैव thus, रामः Rama, अश्रुमुखः with his face filled with tears, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, लक्ष्मणबाहुपालितः supported by the arms of Lakshmana, स्थितः अभवत् stood, तपस्विनी pitiable, सीता Sita, रुदती weeping, राजरथम् king's chariot, माम् me, निरीक्षते kept gazing.

text: मम तु अश्वा निवृत्तस्य न प्रावर्तन्त वर्त्मनि । उष्णम् अश्रु विमुन्चन्तः रामे सम्प्रस्थिते वनम् ॥२-५९-१॥
translation: When Rama set out for the forest, and I turned back, my horses shedding hot tears were reluctant to walk the path.
word_meanings: रामे Rama, वनम् for the forest, सम्प्रस्थिते when setting out, निवृत्तस्य when I returned, मम my, अश्वा: तु as for horses, उष्णम् hot, अश्रुप्रमुञ्चन्तः shedding tears, वर्त्मनि on the path, न प्रावर्तन्त did not proceed.

text: उभाभ्याम् राज पुत्राभ्याम् अथ कृत्वा अहम् ज्ञलिम् । प्रस्थितः रथम् आस्थाय तत् दुह्खम् अपि धारयन् ॥२-५९-२॥
translation: Thereafter, controlling my grief and paying obeisance to both the princes with folded palms, I ascended the chariot and returned.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, अहम् I, उभाभ्याम् to both, राजपुत्राभ्याम् princess, अञ्जलिम् folded palms, कृत्वा having made, तत् that, दुःखम् अपि grief, धारयन् controlling, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय ascending, प्रस्थितः set out.

text: गुहा इव सार्धम् तत्र एव स्थितः अस्मि दिवसान् बहून् । आशया यदि माम् रामः पुनः शब्दापयेद् इति ॥२-५९-३॥
translation: There along with Guha I waited for (three) days that Rama might call me back.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, पुनः again, माम् me, शब्दापयेत् यदि if calls me, इति thus, आशया with hope, तत्रैव there itself, गुहेन सार्धम् with Guha, बहून् many (three), दिवसान् अस्मि I waited.

text: विषये ते महा राज माम व्यसन कर्शिताः । अपि वृक्षाः परिम्लानः सपुष्प अन्कुर कोरकाः ॥२-५९-४॥
translation: O great king even trees with their flowers, buds and shoots throughout your empire have withered because of the calamity on Rama.
word_meanings: महाराज O great king, ते विषये throughout your empire, वृक्षाः अपि even trees, सपुष्पाङ्कुरकोरकाः with flowers, buds and shoots, रामव्यसनकर्शिताः oppressed on account of the calamity on Rama, परिम्लानाः withered.

text: उपतप्तोदका नद्यः पल्वलानि सराम्सि च । परिष्कुपलाशानि वनान्युपवनानि च ॥२-५९-५॥
translation: Water in rivers, ponds and lakes has heated up while all the foliage in the forests and gardens have shrivelled.
word_meanings: नद्यः rivers, उपतप्तोदकाः with heated waters, पल्वलानि ponds, सरांसि च lakes, वनानि forests, उपवनानि च gardens, परिशुष्कपलाशानि have their foliage shrivelled.

text: न च सर्पन्ति सत्त्वानि व्याला न प्रसरन्ति च । राम शोक अभिभूतम् तन् निष्कूजम् अभवद् वनम् ॥२-५९-६॥
translation: No living being move about and even wild animals roam no more. Overwhelmed with grief on account of Rama a great silence pervades the forest.
word_meanings: सत्त्वानि living beings, न च सर्पन्ति are not moving, व्यालाः च wild animals also, नप्रचरन्ति not ranging, तत् वनम् that forest, रामशोकाभिभूतम् overpowered by grief on account of Rama, निष्कूजम् silent, अभवत् became.

text: लीन पुष्कर पत्राः च नर इन्द्र कलुष उदकाः । सम्तप्त पद्माः पद्मिन्यो लीन मीन विहम्गमाः ॥२-५९-७॥
translation: The water in the lotus lakes, O king, has become turbid. The blue lotuses have withered and their shrivelled petals are submerged in water. The fishes and aquatic birds are hidden under waters.
word_meanings: नरेन्द्र O king, पद्मिन्यः lotus lakes, लीनपुष्करपत्राः च with the shrivelled blue lotus leaves submerged in water, कलुषोदकाः with waters turbid, सन्तप्तपद्माः withered lotuses, लीनमीनविहङ्गमाः devoid of fishes and birds.

text: जलजानि च पुष्पाणि माल्यानि स्थलजानि च । न अद्य भान्ति अल्प गन्धीनि फलानि च यथा पुरम् ॥२-५९-८॥
translation: Bunches of flowers grown in water and on land, as well as fruits with their scant fragrance do not shine as before.
word_meanings: जलजानि born in water, पुष्पाणि flowers, स्थलजानि born on the land, माल्यानि garlands of flowers, फलानि च fruits, अद्य now, अल्पगन्धीनि with scant fragrance, यथापुरम् as before, न भान्ति do not shine.

text: अत्रोद्यानानि शून्यानि प्रलीनविहगानि च । न चाभिरामानारामान् पश्यामि मनुजर्षभ ॥२-५९-९॥
translation: Pleasuregardens are all deserted as the birds have vanished. O best of men, as such they do not look beautiful.
word_meanings: अत्र there, उद्यानानि gardens, शून्यानि are deserted, प्रलीनविहगानि च with birds vanished (into the depth of woods), मनुजर्षभ O (best) among men, आरामान् parks, अभिरामन् as beautiful, न पश्यामि I do not see.

text: प्रविशन्तम् अयोध्याम् माम् न कश्चित् अभिनन्दति । नरा रामम् अपश्यन्तः निह्श्वसन्ति मुहुर् मुहुः ॥२-५९-१०॥
translation: None greeted me when I entered Ayodhya, People heaved sighs repeatedly when they did not see Rama.
word_meanings: अयोध्यायाम् Ayodhya, प्रविशन्तम् entering, कश्चित् any one, न अभिनन्दति is not greeting, नराः people, रामम् Rama, अपश्यन्तः without beholding, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, निश्श्वसन्ति are heaving sighs.

text: देव राजरथम् दृष्ट्वा विना राममिहागतम् । दुःखादश्रुमुखः सर्वो राजमार्गगतो जनः ॥२-५९-११॥
translation: Beholding the royal chariot arrive without Rama, all were on the highway shedding tears of anguish.
word_meanings: देव O lord, विना रामम् without Rama, इह here, आगतम् arrived, राजरथम् royal chariot, दृष्ट्वा having seen, राजमार्गगतः thronged the highway, सर्वः all, जनः people, दुःखात् due to agony, अश्रुमुखः with tears on their faces.

text: हर्म्यैः विमानैः प्रासादैः अवेक्ष्य रथम् आगतम् । हाहा कार कृता नार्यो राम अदर्शन कर्शिताः ॥२-५९-१२॥
translation: When the women from mansions, sevenstoried buildings and from royal palaces saw the chariot without Rama, they, overwhelmed with sorrow, cried, 'Alas, Alas'.
word_meanings: नार्य: women, हर्म्यै: from mansions, विमानैः from sevenstoried buildings, प्रासादैः from royal palaces, आगतम् arrived, रथम् chariot, अवेक्ष्य having seen, रामादर्शनकर्शिताः afflicted by the absence of Rama, हाहाकारकृताः cried 'Alas, Alas'.

text: आयतैः विमलैः नेत्रैः अश्रु वेग परिप्लुतैः । अन्योन्यम् अभिवीक्षन्ते व्यक्तम् आर्ततराः स्त्रियः ॥२-५९-१३॥
translation: The women, with their large, bright eyes flooded with gushing tears looked in silence at one another in deep anguish.
word_meanings: स्त्रियः women, आर्ततराः in deep anguish, आयतैः with large, विमलैः bright, अश्रुवेगपरिप्लुतैः flooded with gushing tears, नेत्रै: with their eyes, अव्यक्तम् silently, अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिवीक्षन्ते are looking at.

text: न अमित्राणाम् न मित्राणाम् उदासीन जनस्य च । अहम् आर्ततया कम्चित् विशेषम् न उपलक्षये ॥२-५९-१४॥
translation: I did not see any difference in the degree of anguish among friends, those who are not friends and and those who are indifferent. (The degree of agony was same in all).
word_meanings: अहम् I, आर्ततया in great agony, अमित्राणाम् among those who are not friends, किञ्चित् even a little, विशेषम् diference, न उपलक्षये could not see, मित्राणाम् among friends, उदासीनजनस्य of people indifferent, न could not see.

text: अप्रहृष्ट मनुष्या च दीन नाग तुरम्गमा । आर्त स्वर परिम्लाना विनिह्श्वसित निह्स्वना ॥२-५९-१५॥
निरानन्दा महा राज राम प्रव्राजन आतुला । कौसल्या पुत्र हीना इवायोध्या प्रतिभाति मा मा ॥२-५९-१६॥
translation: O maharaja, Ayodhya is filled with cheerless people with deep sighs, agonised voices and pale faces depressed and distressed due to Rama's exile. (Even) elephants and horses look spiritless. For me it (the city) resembles (dejected) Kausalya deprived of her son.
word_meanings: महाराज O great king, अप्रहृष्टमनुष्या च people cheerless, दीननागतुरङ्गमा spiritless elephants and horses, आर्तस्वरपरिम्लाना with agonised voices and pale faces, विनिश्वसित निस्स्वना with deep sighs, निरानन्दा depressed, रामप्रव्राजनातुरा distressed due to Rama's exile, पुत्रहीना deprived of her son, कौसल्या इव like Kausalya, मा प्रतिभाति appears to me.

text: सूतस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा वाचा परम दीनया । बाष्प उपहतया राजा तम् सूतम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५९-१७॥
translation: At these words of the charioteer, the king in deep distress replied with a voice choked with tears:
word_meanings: राजा king, सूतस्य charioteer's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, परमदीनया deeply dejected, बाष्पोपहतया choked with tears, वाचा with a voice, तं सूतम् to the charioteer, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: कैकेय्या विनियुक्तेन पाप अभिजन भावया । मया न मन्त्र कुशलैः वृद्धैः सह समर्थितम् ॥२-५९-१८॥
translation: Incited by Kaikeyi of sinful relations and sinful motive, I did not consult expert, elderly counsellers.
word_meanings: पापाभिजनभावया by one who has wicked relations and sinful intention, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, विनियुक्तेन having been incited, मया by me, मन्त्रकुशलैः with men skilled in giving advice, वृद्धै: सह with seniors, न समर्थितम् was not consulted.

text: न सुहृद्भिर् न च अमात्यैः मन्त्रयित्वा न नैगमैः । मया अयम् अर्थः सम्मोहात् स्त्री हेतोह् सहसा कृतः ॥२-५९-१९॥
translation: For the sake of a woman, this act was committed in great haste, without consulting friends or ministers or men of prudence.
word_meanings: सुहृद्भि: with friends, अमात्यैः with ministers, नैगमैः च with men of prudence, न मन्त्रयित्वा without consulting, मया by me, अयम् this, अर्थः act, स्त्रीहेतो: for the sake of a woman, सहसा in great haste, कृतः committed.

text: भवितव्यतया नूनम् इदम् वा व्यसनम् महत् । कुलस्य अस्य विनाशाय प्राप्तम् सूत यदृच्चया ॥२-५९-२०॥
translation: Surely it is destiny and this calamity has befallen for the wilful destruction of the (entire) race, O charioteer
word_meanings: सूत O charioteer, वा otherwise, इदम् this, महत् great, व्यसनम् calamity, भवितव्यतया because it was destined to happen this way, अस्य this, कुलस्य race's, विनाशाय for destruction, यदृच्छया wilfully, प्राप्तम् has befallen, नूनम् surely.

text: सूत यद्य् अस्ति ते किम्चिन् मया अपि सुकृतम् कृतम् । त्वम् प्रापय आशु माम् रामम् प्राणाः सम्त्वरयन्ति माम् ॥२-५९-२१॥
translation: O Charioteer, if ever I have rendered you any favour, quickly take me to Rama. My life is hastening me (fast running out).
word_meanings: सूत O Charioteer, मया by me, ते to you, किंचित् even a little, सुकृतम् favour, कृतम् अस्ति यदि if it has been rendered, त्वम् you, आशु quickly, माम् me, रामम् to Rama, प्रापय take, प्राणाः life, माम् me, संत्वरयन्ति are hastening me up.

text: यद् यद् या अपि मम एव आज्ञा निवर्तयतु राघवम् । न शक्ष्यामि विना राम मुहूर्तम् अपि जीवितुम् ॥२-५९-२२॥
translation: If my command prevails today, Rama may be brought back. Without Rama I cannot live for a moment even.
word_meanings: अद्यापि even now, मम my, आज्ञैव by command, राघवम् Rama, निवर्तयतु be brought back, रामं विना without Rama, मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, जीवितुम् to live, न शक्ष्यामि am not able.

text: अथवा अपि महा बाहुर् गतः दूरम् भविष्यति । माम् एव रथम् आरोप्य शीघ्रम् रामाय दर्शय ॥२-५९-२३॥
translation: Otherwise if (you think) the mightyarmed (Rama) has gone too far then quickly put me in the chariot, and show me Rama (Carry me to him).
word_meanings: अथवा or otherwise also, महाबाहुः mightyarmed, दूरम् far away, गतः भविष्यति must have gone, मामेव me alone, रथम् on the chariot, आरोप्य placing, शीघ्रम् quickly, रामाय to Rama, दर्शय show.

text: वृत्त दम्ष्ट्रः महा इष्वासः क्व असौ लक्ष्मण पूर्वजः । यदि जीवामि साध्व् एनम् पश्येयम् सह सीतया ॥२-५९-२४॥
translation: Where is that Rama, elder brother to Lakshmana who has wellshaped teeth and wields a mighty bow? If I can see him along with Sita I will survive.
word_meanings: वृत्तदंष्ट्रः one with wellshaped teeth, महेष्वासः a great archer, असौ that, लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः elder brother of Lakshmana, Rama, क्व where is he?, एनम् him, सीतया सह along with Sita, साधु well, पश्येयं यदि if I can see him, जीवामि I can live.

text: लोहित अक्षम् महा बाहुम् आमुक्त मणि कुण्डलम् । रामम् यदि न पश्यामि गमिष्यामि यम क्षयम् ॥२-५९-२५॥
translation: If I cannot see Rama of redcoloured eyes, the mightyarmed one and wearing earrings bedecked with precious stones I shall surely go to the abode of Yama, the god of death.
word_meanings: लोहिताक्षम् one with redcoloured eyes, महाबाहुम् mightyarmed, आमुक्तमणिकुण्डलम् wearing earrings bedecked with gems, रामम् Rama, न पश्येयं यदि if I cannot see him, यमक्षयम् kingdom of Yama, lord of death, गमिष्यामि I will go.

text: अतः नु किम् दुह्खतरम् यो अहम् इक्ष्वाकु नन्दनम् । इमाम् अवस्थाम् आपन्नो न इह पश्यामि राघवम् ॥२-५९-२६॥
translation: What else can be of greater sorrow to me who having reached this state, am still unable to see Rama?
word_meanings: इमाम् this, अवस्थाम् condition, आपन्नः having reached, सः अहम् such me, इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनम् Delight of the Ikshvakus, राघवम् Rama, इह now, न पश्यामि see not, अतः than this, दुःखतरम् greater sorrow, किं नु what more.

text: हा राम राम अनुज हा हा वैदेहि तपस्विनी । न माम् जानीत दुह्खेन म्रियमाणम् अनाथवत् ॥२-५९-२७॥
translation: Ah Rama, Ah Lakshmana, Ah unfortunate Vaidehi, you do not know that I am dying like an orphan because of my grief.
word_meanings: हा राम Ah Rama, हा रामानुज Ah Lakshmana, तपस्विनि the unfortunate, हा वैदेहि Ah Vaidehi, माम् me, दुःखेन due to grief, अनाथवत् like an orphan, म्रियमाणम् dying, न जानीत you do not know.

text: स तेन राजा दुःखेन भृशमर्पितचेतनः । अवगाढः सुदुष्पारम् शोकसागमब्रवीत् ॥२-५९-२८॥
translation: The king whose mind was extremely enfeebled due to grief and who was immersed in a sea of tears which he was unable to cross continued:
word_meanings: तेन दुःखेन by that sorrow, भृशम् extremely, अर्पित चेतनः with enfeebled mind, सः राजा that king, सुदुष्पारम् difficult to cross, शोकसागरम् sea of sorrow, अवगाढः immersed, अब्रवीत् said.

text: रामशोकमहाभोगः सीताविरहपारगः । श्वसितोर्मिमहावर्तो बाष्पफेनजलाविलः ॥२-५९-२९॥
बाहुविक्षेपमीनौघो विक्रन्दितमहास्वनः । प्रकीर्णकेशशैवालः कैकेयीबडबामुखः ॥२-५९-३०॥
ममाश्रुवेगप्रभवः कुब्जावाक्यमहाग्रहः । वरवेलो नृशम्साया रामप्रव्राजनायतः ॥२-५९-३१॥
यस्मिन् बत निमग्नोऽहम् कौसल्ये राघवम् विना । दुस्तरः जीवता देवि मया अयम् शोक सागरः ॥२-५९-३२॥
translation: O queen Kausalya, I am completely immersed in this ocean of sorrow. The misfortune due to Rama's separation is its breadth. Sita's separation is the other end of the shore. Sighs are its turbulent waves and whirlpools. Tears are its foam and turbid waters. Waving of arms is its fishes. Cries of agony are its roars. My dishevelled hair is its moss. Kaikeyi is the mouth of Badaba. My copious tears are its source. Words of the hunchback (Manthara) are the monstrous crocodiles. The cruel boons to Kaikeyi are its shores. Without Rama I cannot cross this sea of sorrow alive. Ah, what a pity
word_meanings: देवि O queen, कौशल्ये Kausalya, अहम् I, यस्मिन् in which, निमग्नः immersed, (असौ this, शोकसागरः ocean of sorrow), रामशोकमहाभोगः sorrow due to Rama's separation as its breadth, सीताविरहपारगः Sita's separation as its other shore, श्वसितोर्मिमहावर्तः sighs as its turbulent waves and whirlpools, बाष्पफेनजलाविलः tears as its foam and turbid waters, बाहुविक्षेपमीनौघः waving of the arms as fishes, विक्रन्दितमहास्वनः cries of agony as its roar, प्रकीर्णकेशशैवालः dishevelled hair as its moss, कैकेयीबडबामुखः Kaikeyi as mouth of Badaba mythical seamare, मम to me, अश्रुवेगप्रभवः source of copious tears, कुब्जावाक्यमहाग्रहः the words of hunchback (Manthara) as monstrous crocodiles, नृशंसायाः cruel, वरवेल boons as shores, रामप्रव्राजनायतः exile of Rama as its expanse, अयम् this, शोकसागरः sea of sorrow, राघवं विना without Rama, मया by me, जीवता with my life, दुस्तरः difficult to cross, बत on what a pity

text: अशोभनम् यो अहम् इह अद्य राघवम् । दिदृक्षमाणो न लभे सलक्ष्मणम्इति इव राजा विलपन् महा यहाशःपपात तूर्णम् शयने स मूर्चितः ॥२-५९-३३॥
translation: Though I wish I cannot see Rama together with Lakshmana. Indeed this is very unfortunate. Lamenting thus, king Dasaratha of great reknown fell on the bed, unconscious.
word_meanings: यः he who, अहम् I, अद्य now, दिदृक्षमाणः wishing to see, सलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshamana, राघवम् Rama, इह here, न लभे unable to get them, अशोभनम् inauspicious, इतीव in this way, महायशाः of great reknown, सः राजा that king, विलपन् lamenting, मूर्छितः lying unconcsious, तूर्णम् immediately, शयने on the bed, पपात fell.

text: इति विलपति पार्थिवे प्रनष्टे । करुणतरम् द्विगुणम् च राम हेतोः । वचनम् अनुनिशम्य तस्य देवी । भयम् अगमत् पुनर् एव राम माता ॥२-५९-३४॥
translation: Wailing, Dasaratha fell unconscious. He was doubly grieved due to his yearning for Rama. Rama's mother was seized with fear hearing those lamentations. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyninth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: पार्थिवे king, रामहेतोः for the sake of Rama, करुणतरम् in greater grief, द्विगुणं च doubly, विलपति lamenting, प्रणष्टे losing senses, राममाता Rama's mother, देवी queen Kausalya, तस्य वचनम् his words, अनुनिशम्य having heard, पुनरेव once again, भयम् fear, अगमत् seized.

text: ततः भूत उपसृष्टा इव वेपमाना पुनः पुनः । धरण्याम् गत सत्त्वा इव कौसल्या सूतम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-६०-१॥
translation: Thereafter Kausalya, trembling as if possessed by an evil spirit and rolling on the floor like one who her senses now and again, said to the charioteer (Sumantra):
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, कौशल्या Kausalya, भूतोपसृष्टेव as if possessed by an evil spirit, वेपमाना trembling, गतसत्त्वेव like one who has his senses lost, पुनः पुनः again and again, धरण्याम् on the floor, सूतम् to the charioteer (Sumantra), अब्रवीत् said.

text: नय माम् यत्र काकुत्स्थः सीता यत्र च लक्ष्मणः । तान् विना क्षणम् अपि अत्र जीवितुम् न उत्सहे हि अहम् ॥२-६०-२॥
translation: Take me where Rama, Sita and Lakshmana are. I do not wish to live even for a moment without them.
word_meanings: काकुत्स्थः Rama, सीता च Sita, यत्र wherever, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, यत्र wherever, तत्र there, माम् to me, नय take, तान् विना without them, अत्र here, क्षणमपि even for a moment, जीवितुम् to live, अहम् I, न उत्सहे do not wish.

text: निवर्तय रथम् शीघ्रम् दण्डकान् नय माम् अपि । अथ तान् न अनुगच्चामि गमिष्यामि यम क्षयम् ॥२-६०-३॥
translation: 'Turn back your chariot immediately and take me to the Dandaka forest. If I do not follow them, I shall enter the world of Yama'.
word_meanings: रथम् chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, निवर्तय turn back, मामपि me also, दण्डकान् to Dandaka, नय take, अथ if, तान् them, नानु गच्छामि if I do not follow, यमक्षयम् to the world of Yama, गमिष्यामि shall go.

text: बाष्प वेगौपहतया स वाचा सज्जमानया । इदम् आश्वासयन् देवीम् सूतः प्रान्जलिर् अब्रवीत् ॥२-६०-४॥
translation: With folded hands and faltering words choked by his fastflowing tears the charioteer tried to console Kausalya:
word_meanings: सः सूतः that charioteer, बाष्पवेगोपहतया prevented by fastflowing tears, सज्जमानया faltering, वाचा with words, देवीम् to Kausalya, आश्वसयन् consoling, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: त्यज शोकम् च मोहम् च सम्भ्रमम् दुह्खजम् तथा । व्यवधूय च सम्तापम् वने वत्स्यति राघवः ॥२-६०-५॥
translation: Abandon your tears, delusion and despair arising out of sorrow. Rama is going to live in the forest, brushing aside all agony.
word_meanings: शोकम् grief, मोहम् delusion, तथा also, दुःखजम् arising out of sorrow, सम्भ्रमं च despair, त्यज abandon, राघवः Rama, सन्तापम् difficulties, व्यवधूय after brushig aside, वने in the forest, वत्स्यति is going to live.

text: लक्ष्मणः च अपि रामस्य पादौ परिचरन् वने । आराधयति धर्मज्ञः पर लोकम् जित इन्द्रियः ॥२-६०-६॥
translation: Selfcontrolled Lakshmana, aware of his duty, serves Rama in the forest. By this he is securing his next world.
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञ: knower of duty, लक्ष्मणश्चापि also Lakshmana, वने in the forest, जितेन्द्रियः one whose senses are controlled, रामस्य to Rama' s, पादौ feet, परिचरन् serving at, परलोकम् the other world, आराधयति is accomplishing.

text: विजने अपि वने सीता वासम् प्राप्य गृहेष्व् इव । विस्रम्भम् लभते अभीता रामे सम्न्यस्त मानसा ॥२-६०-७॥
translation: Sita with her mind fixed on Rama is living confidently in that desolate forest without any fear as if it were her home.
word_meanings: सीता Sita, विजने in the desolate, वनेपि in the forest also, गृहेष्विव like at home, वासम् living, प्राप्य having obtained, रामे in Rama, सन्न्यस्तमानसा with her mind fixed, अभीता without fear, विस्रम्भम् confidence, लभते is getting.

text: न अस्या दैन्यम् कृतम् किम्चित् सुसूक्ष्मम् अपि लक्षये । उचिता इव प्रवासानाम् वैदेही प्रतिभाति मा ॥२-६०-८॥
translation: I could not see even the slightest depression in Sita as if she was accustomed to staying away from home.
word_meanings: अस्याः of her, सुसूक्ष्ममपि even the slightest, दैन्यम् dejection, किञ्चित् not even a little, कृतम् done, न लक्ष्यते not to be seen, वैदेही Sita, प्रवासानाम् for staying away from home, उचितेव as if accustomed, मा to me, प्रतिभाति appears.

text: नगर उपवनम् गत्वा यथा स्म रमते पुरा । तथैव रमते सीता निर्जनेषु वनेष्व् अपि ॥२-६०-९॥
translation: Earlier, just as Sita used to revel in the gardens of the city, so does she now in those desolate forests.
word_meanings: सीता Sita, पुरा earlier, नगरोपवनम् to the pleasuregardens of the city, गत्वा having gone, यथा as, रमतेस्म was enjoying, निर्जनेषु in desolate, वनेष्वपि even in the forest, तथैव in the same way, रमते enjoying.

text: बाला इव रमते सीता बाल चन्द्र निभ आनना । रामा रामे हि अदीन आत्मा विजने अपि वने सती ॥२-६०-१०॥
translation: Charming Sita whose face resembles the full Moon, with her mind fixed on Rama, is enjoying even the desolate forest like a child.
word_meanings: रामा charming lady, रामे in Rama, अधीनात्मा one with absorbed mind, अबालचन्द्रनिभानना countenance resembling the full Moon, सीता Sita, विजने desolate, वने in the forest also, सती अपि staying, बालेव like a child, रमते is enjoying.

text: तत् गतम् हृदयम् हि अस्याः तत् अधीनम् च जीवितम् । अयोध्या अपि भवेत् तस्या राम हीना तथा वनम् ॥२-६०-११॥
translation: Her heart is ever united with Rama, and her life is under his control. Without Rama, even Ayodhya would become a forest for her.
word_meanings: अस्याः her, हृदयम् heart, तद्गतम् united with Rama, जीवितं च life also, तदधीनम् under his control, अयोध्यापि even Ayodhya too, रामहीना without Rama, तदा then, तस्याः to her, वनम् forest, भवेत् would have become.

text: परि पृच्चति वैदेही ग्रामामः च नगराणि च । गतिम् दृष्ट्वा नदीनाम् च पादपान् विविधान् अपि ॥२-६०-१२॥
translation: Seeing villages, cities, trees of different kinds and courses of rivers, Sita is enquiring from Rama or Lakshmana about them. She feels as though she is sporting in the pleasuregarden just a krosa from Ayodhya.
word_meanings: अयोध्या क्रोशमात्रे at the distance of a krosa from Ayodhya, विहारम् pleasuregarden, संश्रिता इव as if sporting, वैदेही Sita, ग्रामांश्च villages, नगराणि च cities,नदीनाम् rivers', गतिं च courses, विविधान् different kinds of, पादपानपि trees also, दृष्ट्वा seeing, रामम् to Rama, परिपृच्छति enquiring, लक्ष्मणं वापि or Lakshmana, पृष्ट्वा asking, जानाति knowing.

text: रामम् हि लक्ष्मनम् वापि पृष्ट्वा जानाति जानती । अयोध्याक्रोशमात्रे तु विहारमिव सम्श्रिता ॥२-६०-१३॥
translation: Seeing villages, cities, trees of different kinds and courses of rivers, Sita is enquiring from Rama or Lakshmana about them. She feels as though she is sporting in the pleasuregarden just a krosa from Ayodhya.
word_meanings: अयोध्या क्रोशमात्रे at the distance of a krosa from Ayodhya, विहारम् pleasuregarden, संश्रिता इव as if sporting, वैदेही Sita, ग्रामांश्च villages, नगराणि च cities,नदीनाम् rivers', गतिं च courses, विविधान् different kinds of, पादपानपि trees also, दृष्ट्वा seeing, रामम् to Rama, परिपृच्छति enquiring, लक्ष्मणं वापि or Lakshmana, पृष्ट्वा asking, जानाति knowing.

text: इदमेव स्मराम्यस्याः सहसैवोपजल्पितम् । कैकेयीसम्श्रितम् वाक्यम् नेदानीम् प्रतिभाति माम् ॥२-६०-१४॥
translation: Sita did say something about Kaikeyi, but now I do not remember what.
word_meanings: अस्याः her, इदमेव this much, स्मरामि I remember, सहसैव suddenly, उपजल्पितम् utterance, कैकेयी संश्रितम् about Kaikeyi, वाक्यम् words, इदानीम् now, मा to me, न प्रतिभाति does not come to my mind.

text: ध्वम्सयित्वा तु तद्वाक्यम् प्रमादात्पर्युपस्थितम् । ह्लदनम् वचनम् सूतो देव्या मधुरमब्रवीत् ॥२-६०-१५॥
translation: Diverting the context of what he uttered inadvertently relating to Kaikeyi, the charioteer said pleasing words of consolation to Kausalya.
word_meanings: सूतः charioteer, प्रमादात् inadvertently, पर्युपत्स्थितम् uttered by all means, तद्वाक्यम् those words relating to Kaikeyi, ध्वंसयित्वा holding back, देव्याः to Kausalya, ह्लादनम् causing delight, मधुरम् pleasing, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: अध्वना वात वेगेन सम्भ्रमेण आतपेन च । न हि गच्चति वैदेह्याः चन्द्र अम्शु सदृशी प्रभा ॥२-६०-१६॥
translation: Just like the beams of the Moon, Sita's glow is not affected by the fatigue of the journey or by the speed of the wind or by the scorching heat.
word_meanings: वैदेह्याः Sita's, चन्द्रांशु सदृशी resembling the beams of the Moon, प्रभा lustre, अध्वना on the way, वातवेगेन or by the speed of the wind, सम्भ्रमेण or due to haste, आतपेन च or due to scorching heat also, न विगच्छति does not fade.

text: सदृशम् शत पत्रस्य पूर्ण चन्द्र उपम प्रभम् । वदनम् तत् वदान्याया वैदेह्या न विकम्पते ॥२-६०-१७॥
translation: The countenance of Sita with her gentle eloquence resembles a hundredpetalled lotus. She has the luminance of the full Moon that has not wilted.
word_meanings: वदान्यायाः of that munificent, वैदेह्याः Sita, शतपत्रस्य a hundredpetalled lotus, सदृशम् similar to, पूर्णचन्द्रोपमप्रभम् like the splendour of the full Moon, तत् वदनम् that countenance, न विकम्पते does not change at all.

text: अलक्त रस रक्त अभाव् अलक्त रस वर्जितौ । अद्य अपि चरणौ तस्याः पद्म कोश सम प्रभौ ॥२-६०-१८॥
translation: Her feet, now devoid of lacdye, still look red like lac and shine like the lotus bud.
word_meanings: अलक्तरसक्ताभौ shining red like the liquid lac, अलक्तरसवर्जितौ no longer tinted with such liquid, तस्याः her, चरणौ feet, अद्यापि even now, पद्मकोशसमप्रभौ are shining like the lotus buds.

text: नूपुर उद्घुष्ट हेला इव खेलम् गच्चति भामिनी । इदानीम् अपि वैदेही तत् रागा न्यस्त भूषणा ॥२-६०-१९॥
translation: Casting off her ornaments, the damsel (Sita) is gracefully walking as if dalliant with her tinkling anklets for her love for him (Rama).
word_meanings: भामिनी damsel (Sita), नूपुरोद्घुष्ट हेलेव tinkling anklets proclaiming dalliance, खेलम् (as if) playing, गच्छति going, वैदेही Sita, इदानीमपि even now, तद्रागात् due to affection for Rama, नयस्तभूषणा cast off the ornaments.

text: गजम् वा वीक्ष्य सिम्हम् वा व्याघ्रम् वा वनम् आश्रिता । न आहारयति सम्त्रासम् बाहू रामस्य सम्श्रिता ॥२-६०-२०॥
translation: Though in the forest, Sita, under the protection of Rama's arms, is afraid of neither elephants nor lions nor tigers.
word_meanings: वनम् forest, आश्रिता resorted, रामस्य Rama's, बाहू arms, संश्रिता having taken refuge, गजं वा elephant, सिंहं वा or lion, व्याघ्रं वा or tiger, वीक्ष्य having seen, सन्त्रासं fear, नाऽहारयति does not get.

text: न शोच्याः ते न च आत्मा ते शोच्यो न अपि जन अधिपः । इदम् हि चरितम् लोके प्रतिष्ठास्यति शाश्वतम् ॥२-६०-२१॥
translation: You need not lament for them or for yourself or for the king. This story of Rama will endure permanently in the world.
word_meanings: ते they, न शोच्याः need not be pitied, आत्मनः च yourself, न not, जनाधिप अपि king also, इदम् this, चरितम् history, लोके in the world, शाश्वतम् permanently, प्रतिष्ठास्यति will endure.

text: विधूय शोकम् परिहृष्ट मानसा । महर्षि याते पथि सुव्यवस्थिताः । वने रता वन्य फल अशनाः पितुः । शुभाम् प्रतिज्ञाम् परिपालयन्ति ते ॥२-६०-२२॥
translation: They are upholding the sacred promise of their father with cheerful hearts, grief given the goby, steadfastly pursuing the path established by maharsis, subsisting on forest fruits and enjoying the forest life.
word_meanings: ते they, शोकम् grief, विधूय shaking off, परिहृष्टमानसाः with cheerful hearts, महर्षियाते established by maharshis, पथि in the path, सुव्यवत्स्थिताः firmly fixed, वने in the forest, रताः are enjoying, वन्यफलाशनाः subsisting on forest fruits, पितुः father's, शुभाम् auspicious, प्रतिज्ञाम् promise, परिपालयन्ति are upholding.

text: तथा अपि सूतेन सुयुक्त वादिना । निवार्यमाणा सुत शोक कर्शिता । न चैव देवी विरराम कूजितात् । प्रिय इति पुत्र इति च राघव इति च ॥२-६०-२३॥
translation: Though Sumantra was speaking with befitting words to prevent Kausalya from weeping over her son which had enfeebled her, she did not stop crying, 'O my beloved', 'O my son', 'O Rama'. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtieth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सुयुक्तवादिना by one who was speaking befittingly, सूतेना by Sumantra, तथा like that, निवार्यमाणापि though prevented, देवी queen Kausalya, सुतशोककर्शिता enfeebled with weeping over her son, प्रियेति 'O My beloved', पुत्रेति 'O my son', राघवेति च 'O Rama', कूजितात् from crying, नचैव विरराम did not stop.

text: वनम् गते धर्म परे रामे रमयताम् वरे । कौसल्या रुदती स्वार्ता भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-६१-१॥
translation: When Rama, the greatest among those who please the people, he who was conscious of his duty left for the forest. Kausalya, sobbing in bitter anguish, said to her husband:
word_meanings: धर्मपरे dutiful, रमयताम् pleasing others, वरे greatest, रामे Rama, वनम् forest, गते had gone, कौशल्या Kausalya, स्वार्ता in bitter anguish, रुदती sobbing, भर्तारम् to her husband, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: यद्यपि त्रिषु लोकेषु प्रथितम् ते मयद् यशः । सानुक्रोशो वदान्यः च प्रिय वादी च राघवः ॥२-६१-२॥
translation: Your great fame has spread all over the three worlds. People know you as compassionate, generous and sweetspeaking scion of the Raghus.
word_meanings: राघवः Dasaratha, scion of the Raghu dynasty, सानुक्रोशः compassionate, वदान्यश्च generous, प्रियवादी च sweettongued, ते your, महत् great, यशः fame, त्रिषु three, लोकेषु in worlds, प्रथितं यद्यपि even though very popular.

text: कथम् नर वर श्रेष्ठ पुत्रौ तौ सह सीतया । दुह्खितौ सुख सम्वृद्धौ वने दुह्खम् सहिष्यतः ॥२-६१-३॥
translation: O Dasaratha, the best among kings, how will your two sons and Sita brought up in great comfort now tolerate the hardships of forest life?
word_meanings: नरवरश्रेष्ठ best among kings (Dasaratha), सुखसंवृद्धौ brought up with comfort, तौ पुत्रौ your two sons, सीतया सह with Sita, दुःखितौ stricken with grief, वने in the forest, दुःखम् suffering, कथम् how?, सहिष्यतः endure?

text: सा नूनम् तरुणी श्यामा सुकुमारी सुख उचिता । कथम् उष्णम् च शीतम् च मैथिली प्रसहिष्यते ॥२-६१-४॥
translation: How can the daughter of Mithila (Sita) who in the prime of her life, accustomed to comforts, endure heat and cold indeed?
word_meanings: तरुणी young, श्यामा in the prime of life, सुकुमारी delicate, सुखोचिता accustomed to comfort, सा मैथिली that Sita, उष्णं च heat, शीतं च cold, नूनम् surely, कथम् how?, प्रसहिष्यते will bear.

text: भुक्त्वा अशनम् विशाल अक्षी सूप दम्श अन्वितम् शुभम् । वन्यम् नैवारम् आहारम् कथम् सीता उपभोक्ष्यते ॥२-६१-५॥
translation: How can the largeeyed Sita having enjoyed delicious food mixed with condiments and soup now partake the food prepared with wild grains?
word_meanings: विशालाक्षी largeeyed, सीता Sita, सूपदं शान्वितम् with condiments and soup, शुभम् wellprepared, अशनम् food, भुक्त्वा having partaken, वन्यम् in the forest, नैवारम् made with wild rice, आहारम् food, कथं उपभोक्ष्यते how will she eat?

text: गीत वादित्र निर्घोषम् श्रुत्वा शुभम् अनिन्दिता । कथम् क्रव्य अद सिम्हानाम् शब्दम् श्रोष्यति अशोभनम् ॥२-६१-६॥
translation: How can the blameless Sita, used to the soft sound of songs and musical instruments hear the frightful roars of lions and other carnivorous animals?
word_meanings: अनिन्दिता blameless, शुभम् auspicious, गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषम् sounds of songs and musical instruments, श्रुत्वा having heard, अशोभनम् inauspicious, क्रव्यादसिंहानाम् carnivorous animals' and lions', शब्दम् sound, कथम् how?, श्रोष्यति can hear.

text: महा इन्द्र ध्वज सम्काशः क्व नु शेते महा भुजः । भुजम् परिघ सम्काशम् उपधाय महा बलः ॥२-६१-७॥
translation: Where will that mightyarmed and powerful Rama, as lofty as Indra's banner, sleep using his ironbarlike arm as pillow?.
word_meanings: महेन्द्रध्वजसङ्काशः resembling mighty Indra's banner, महाभुजः longarmed one, महाबलः mighty, परिघसङ्काशम् like a sword, भुजम् arm, उपधाय using as a pillow, क्व where, शेते नु is he sleeping?

text: पद्म वर्णम् सुकेश अन्तम् पद्म निह्श्वासम् उत्तमम् । कदा द्रक्ष्यामि रामस्य वदनम् पुष्कर ईक्षणम् ॥२-६१-८॥
translation: When shall I see Rama with his lotushued face, his beautiful locks of hair, breath of lotus fragrance and eyes like blue lotus?
word_meanings: पद्मवर्णम् lotuslike complexion, सुकेशान्तम् having beautiful hairends, पद्मनिश्श्वासम् breath of lotus fragrance, पुष्करेक्षणम् eyes like blue lotus, उत्तमम् excellent, रामस्य वदनम् Rama's countenance, कदा when, द्रक्ष्यामि shall I behold?.

text: वज्र सारमयम् नूनम् हृदयम् मे न सम्शयः । अपश्यन्त्या न तम् यद् वै फलति इदम् सहस्रधा ॥२-६१-९॥
translation: No doubt my heart must be made of thunderbolt, since unable to see Rama it does not split into a thousand pieces.
word_meanings: मे हृदयम् my heart, वज्रसारमयम् is made of thunderbolt, नूनम् surely, संशयः doubt, न not, यत् since, तम् Rama, अपश्यन्त्याः without seeing, इदम् this heart, सहस्रधा thousand pieces, न फलति वै does not shatter.

text: यत्त्वया करुणम् कर्म व्यपोह्य मम बान्धवाः । निरस्ता परिधावन्ति सुखार्हः कृपणा वने ॥२-६१-१०॥
translation: (O king) It is because of your heartless action, my Rama and my relatives who deserve to enjoy pleasures at this age have been banished and are miserably wandering in wilderness.
word_meanings: त्वया by you, करुणम् heartless, कर्म act, व्यपोह्य cast away, सुखार्हाः deserve pleasures, मम बान्धवाः my relations, निरस्ताः are banished, कृपणाः the miserable ones, वने in the forest, यत् since, परिधावन्ति are running around.

text: यदि पञ्चदशे वर्षे राघवः पुनरेष्यति । जह्याद्राज्यम् च कोशम् च भरतो नोपल्स्ख्यते ॥२-६१-११॥
translation: Even if Rama returns in the fifteenth year, it is unlikely that Bharata will give up the kingdom and royal treasury (in favour of Rama).
word_meanings: राघवः Rama, पञ्चदशे वर्षे in the fifteenth year, पुनः एष्यति यदि if returns, भरतः Bharata, राज्यं च kingdom, कोषं च treasury too, जह्यात् will give up, नोपलक्ष्यते it does not appear.

text: भोजयन्ति किल श्राद्धे केचित्स्वनेव बान्धवान् । ततः पश्चात्समीक्षन्ते कृतकार्या द्विजर्षभान् ॥२-६१-१२॥
translation: Some first feed their own relatives in shraddha ceremony and thereafter look for the best of brahmins to feed.
word_meanings: केचित् some people, श्राद्धे in the shraddha ceremony, स्वान् own, बान्धवानेव relatives only, भोजयन्ति किल feed them, कृतकार्याः having completed this ceremony, ततः पश्चात् thereafter, द्विजर्षभान् bulls (best) among brahmins, समीक्षन्ते will look for.

text: तत्र ये गुणवन्तश्च विद्वाम्सश्च द्विजातयः । न पश्चात्तेऽभिमन्यन्ते सुधामपि सुरोपमाः ॥२-६१-१३॥
translation: The godlike brahmins who are virtuous and learned will not accept the food after others have partaken even if it is ambrosia.
word_meanings: तत्र there, ये those, गुणवन्तश्च virtuous, विद्वांसश्च learned, सुरोपमाः similar to devatas, द्विजातयः ते those brahmins, पश्चात् after others, सुधामपि even ambrosia, न अभिमन्यन्ते will not accept.

text: ब्राह्मणेष्वपि तृप्तेषु पश्चाद्भोक्तुम् द्विजर्षभाः । नाभ्युपैतुमलम् प्राज्ञाः शृङ्गच्चेदमिवर्ष्भाः ॥२-६१-१४॥
translation: The bulls (best) among the wise brahmins would not like to accept the food after it is tasted by other brahmins, just as bulls dislike their horns being shorn.
word_meanings: तृप्तेषु contented, ब्राह्मणेष्वपि even if they are brahmins, प्राज्ञाः the wise, द्विजर्षभाः bulls (best) among brahmins, ऋषभाः like bulls, श्रुङ्गच्छेदमिव shorn of their horns, पश्चात् afterwards, भोक्तुम् to partake, अभ्युपैतुम् to accept, नालम् should not.

text: एवम् कनीयसा भ्रात्रा भुक्तम् राज्यम् विशाम् पते । भ्राता ज्येष्ठा वरिष्ठाः च किम् अर्थम् न अवमम्स्यते ॥२-६१-१५॥
translation: O Lord of the world why not the eldest and the most distinguished among the brothers likewise disdain the kingdom enjoyed by the younger brother?
word_meanings: विशाम्पते O Lord of the world (Dasaratha), एवम् likewise, ज्येष्ठः eldest, वरिष्ठश्च most distinguished one, भ्राता brother, कनीयसा by the younger, भ्रात्रा brother, भुक्तम् enjoyed, राज्यम् kingdom, किमर्थम् why, नावमंस्यते will not disdain.

text: न परेण आहृतम् भक्ष्यम् व्याघ्रः खादितुम् इच्चति । एवम् एव नर व्याघ्रः पर लीढम् न मम्स्यते ॥२-६१-१६॥
