word_meanings: नित्यम् always, नः our, कुलस्य race, ज्येष्ठस्य the eldest one, राजता kingship, उचिता हि is befitting (tradition) indeed, कुशलाः intelligent, जनाः people, भवन्तः all of you, माम् me, एवम् in this way, वक्तुम् to tell, न अर्हन्ति does not behove.

text: रामः पूर्वो हि नो भ्राता भविष्यति मही पतिः । अहम् तु अरण्ये वत्स्यामि वर्षाणि नव पन्च च ॥२-७९-८॥
translation: Our eldest brother, Rama shall become king. As for me, I shall dwell in the forest for fourteen years.
word_meanings: नः our, पूर्वः eldest, भ्राता brother, रामः Rama, महीपतिः भविष्यति shall become king, अहं तु as for me, नव पञ्च च nine and four (fourteen), वर्षाणि years, अरण्ये in the forest, वत्स्यामि I shall dwell.

text: युज्यताम् महती सेना चतुर् अन्ग महा बला । आनयिष्याम्य् अहम् ज्येष्ठम् भ्रातरम् राघवम् वनात् ॥२-७९-९॥
translation: Let the great and powerful army of four divisions be marshalled. I will bring back my eldest brother Rama from the forest.
word_meanings: चतुरङ्गमहाबला powerful army of four divisions, महती great, सेना army, युज्यताम् be marshalled, अहम् I, ज्येष्ठम् eldest, भ्रातरम् brother, राघवम् Rama, वनात् from the forest, आनयिष्यामि I will bring back.

text: आभिषेचनिकम् चैव सर्वम् एतत् उपस्कृतम् । पुरः कृत्य गमिष्यामि राम हेतोर् वनम् प्रति ॥२-७९-१०॥
translation: I shall go to the forest to (bring back) Rama, with all these articles, procured for coronation kept in front.
word_meanings: एतत् उपस्कृतम् these collected, सर्वम् all, आभिषेचनिकम् all these articles for coronation, पुरस्कृत्य kept in front, रामहेतोः for Rama, वनं प्रति to the forest, गमिष्यामि I shall go.

text: तत्र एव तम् नर व्याघ्रम् अभिषिच्य पुरः कृतम् । आनेष्यामि तु वै रामम् हव्य वाहम् इव अध्वरात् ॥२-७९-११॥
translation: After coronating Rama, the best of men, there itself, I will definitely bring him back, letting him go ahead of me, like the sacred fire carried from the place of sacrifice.
word_meanings: नरव्याघ्रम् tiger among men, तम् him, तत्रैव there itself, अभिषिच्य having crowned, पुरस्कृतम् going ahead of me, रामम् to Rama, अध्वरात् from the place of sacrifice, हव्यवाहमिव like the fire, आनेष्यामि तु वै will definitely bring back.

text: न सकामा करिष्यामि स्वम् इमाम् मातृ गन्धिनीम् । वने वत्स्याम्य् अहम् दुर्गे रामः राजा भविष्यति ॥२-७९-१२॥
translation: I shall never fulfil the wishes of that woman called my mother. I shall dwell in the inaccessible forest and Rama shall become king.
word_meanings: स्वाम् my own, मातृगन्धिनीम् called mother, इमाम् this, सकामाम् fulfil her desire, न करिष्यामि shall never do, अहम् I, दुर्गे in the inaccessible, वने in the forest, वत्स्यामि shall dwell, रामः Rama, राजा भविष्यति shall become king.

text: क्रियताम् शिल्पिभिः पन्थाः समानि विषमाणि च । रक्षिणः च अनुसम्यान्तु पथि दुर्ग विचारकाः ॥२-७९-१३॥
translation: Let the road be aligned by artisans and uneven ground be levelled. The guards who judge the inaccessible terrains should follow them on their way.
word_meanings: शिल्पिभि: by the artisans, पन्थाः road, क्रियताम् let it be laid, विषमाणि uneven ground, समानि be levelled, दुर्गविचारकाः judging the inaccessible terrains, रक्षिणश्च guards, पथि on the way, अनुसम्यान्तु be followed.

text: एवम् सम्भाषमाणम् तम् राम हेतोर् नृप आत्मजम् । प्रत्युवाच जनः सर्वः श्रीमद् वाक्यम् अनुत्तमम् ॥२-७९-१४॥
translation: When prince Bharata was thus speaking in favour of Rama, all the people responded with these excellent, propitious words:
word_meanings: रामहेतोः on behalf of Rama, एवम् in this way, सम्भाषमाणम् speaking, तं नृपात्मजम् to the son of the king, Bharata, सर्वः all, जनः the people, श्रीमत् with auspiciousness, अनुत्तमम् excellent, वाक्यम् words, प्रत्युवाच replied.

text: एवम् ते भाषमाणस्य पद्मा श्रीर् उपतिष्ठताम् । यः त्वम् ज्येष्ठे नृप सुते पृथिवीम् दातुम् इच्चसि ॥२-७९-१५॥
translation: May Lakshmi, goddess of prosperity, abide in you for having expressed your desire to bestow the kingdom upon the king's eldest son.
word_meanings: यः त्वम् such as you are, ज्येष्ठे in the eldest, नृप सुते in king's son, पृथिवीम् kingdom, दातुम् to bestow, इच्छसि are desiring, एवम् in this way, भाषमाणस्य talking, ते to you, श्रीः goddess of prosperity, पद्मा Lakshmi, उपतिष्ठताम् may grace you.

text: अनुत्तमम् तत् वचनम् नृप आत्मज । प्रभाषितम् सम्श्रवणे निशम्य च । प्रहर्षजाः तम् प्रति बाष्प बिन्दवो । निपेतुर् आर्य आनन नेत्र सम्भवाः ॥२-७९-१६॥
translation: With such graceful words spoken by the prince within their hearing, tears of joy filled the eyes of the noble people and fell drop by drop down their faces.
word_meanings: संश्रवणे within hearing range, नृपात्मजप्रभाषितम् spoken by the king's son, अनुत्तमम् graceful, तत् वचनम् that speech, निशम्य च having heard, तं प्रति to him, प्रहर्षजाः born of joy, आर्यानननेत्रसम्भवाः arising from the eyes and countenances of noble ones, बाष्पबिन्दवः drops of tears, निपेतुः trickled down.

text: ऊचुस् ते वचनम् इदम् निशम्य हृष्टाः । सामात्याः सपरिषदो वियात शोकाः । पन्थानम् नर वर भक्तिमान् जनः च । व्यादिष्टः तव वचनाच् च शिल्पि वर्गः ॥२-७९-१७॥
translation: All the ministers and members of the council, relieved of their distress, were delighted to hear these words and said O best among men, on your orders devoted people and groups of artisans have been instructed to lay the road. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनाशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventyninth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: इदम् this, वचनम् word, निशम्य having heard, हृष्टाः delighted, सामात्याः with ministers, सपरिषदः with council of members, ते they, वियातशोकाः relieved of their distress, इदं वचनम् these words, ऊचुः uttered, नरवर O best among men, भक्तिमान् devoted man, जनश्च people, शिल्पि वर्गः groups of artisans, तव your, वचनात् from orders, पन्थानम् to prepare the way, व्यादिष्टः have been instructed.

text: अथ भूमि प्रदेशज्ञाः सूत्र कर्म विशारदाः । स्व कर्म अभिरताः शूराः खनका यन्त्रकाः तथा ॥२-८०-१॥
translation: Then surveyors, experts in measurment, energetic and zealous labourers, excavators, engineers, skilled workers, architects, craftsmen, carpenters, roadlevellers, woodcutters, welldiggers, whitewashers, basketmakers, competent supervisors were sent in advance.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, भूमिप्रदेशज्ञाः land surveyors, सूत्रकर्मविशारदा: experts in measurement, स्वकर्माभिरताः zealous workers, शूराः energetic, खनकाः excavators, तथा also, यन्त्रकाः engineers, कर्मान्तिकाः skilled workers, स्थपतयः architects, यन्त्रकोविदाः expert mechanics, पुरुषाः men, तथा similarly, वार्धकयः carpenters, मार्गिण road workers, वृक्षतक्षकाः woodcutters, कूपकाराः welldrillers, सुधाकाराः whitewashers, तथा also, वंशकर्मकृतः bambooworkers (basketmakers), समर्थाः competent, ये those, द्रष्टारः supervisors, ते they, पुरतः in advance, प्रतस्थिरे set out.

text: कर्म अन्तिकाः स्थपतयः पुरुषा यन्त्र कोविदाः । तथा वर्धकयः चैव मार्गिणो वृक्ष तक्षकाः ॥२-८०-२॥
translation: Then surveyors, experts in measurment, energetic and zealous labourers, excavators, engineers, skilled workers, architects, craftsmen, carpenters, roadlevellers, woodcutters, welldiggers, whitewashers, basketmakers, competent supervisors were sent in advance.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, भूमिप्रदेशज्ञाः land surveyors, सूत्रकर्मविशारदा: experts in measurement, स्वकर्माभिरताः zealous workers, शूराः energetic, खनकाः excavators, तथा also, यन्त्रकाः engineers, कर्मान्तिकाः skilled workers, स्थपतयः architects, यन्त्रकोविदाः expert mechanics, पुरुषाः men, तथा similarly, वार्धकयः carpenters, मार्गिण road workers, वृक्षतक्षकाः woodcutters, कूपकाराः welldrillers, सुधाकाराः whitewashers, तथा also, वंशकर्मकृतः bambooworkers (basketmakers), समर्थाः competent, ये those, द्रष्टारः supervisors, ते they, पुरतः in advance, प्रतस्थिरे set out.

text: कूप काराः सुधा कारा वम्श कर्म कृतः तथा । समर्था ये च द्रष्टारः पुरतः ते प्रतस्थिरे ॥२-८०-३॥
translation: Then surveyors, experts in measurment, energetic and zealous labourers, excavators, engineers, skilled workers, architects, craftsmen, carpenters, roadlevellers, woodcutters, welldiggers, whitewashers, basketmakers, competent supervisors were sent in advance.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, भूमिप्रदेशज्ञाः land surveyors, सूत्रकर्मविशारदा: experts in measurement, स्वकर्माभिरताः zealous workers, शूराः energetic, खनकाः excavators, तथा also, यन्त्रकाः engineers, कर्मान्तिकाः skilled workers, स्थपतयः architects, यन्त्रकोविदाः expert mechanics, पुरुषाः men, तथा similarly, वार्धकयः carpenters, मार्गिण road workers, वृक्षतक्षकाः woodcutters, कूपकाराः welldrillers, सुधाकाराः whitewashers, तथा also, वंशकर्मकृतः bambooworkers (basketmakers), समर्थाः competent, ये those, द्रष्टारः supervisors, ते they, पुरतः in advance, प्रतस्थिरे set out.

text: स तु हर्षात् तम् उद्देशम् जन ओघो विपुलः प्रयान् । अशोभत महा वेगः सागरस्य इव पर्वणि ॥२-८०-४॥
translation: Like a swollen ocean on a fullmoon day the multitude of people proceeded joyfully with great speed to the appointed place.
word_meanings: हर्षात् with joy, तम् उद्देशम् to the appointed region, प्रयान् proceeding, सः that, विपुलः multitude, जनौघः people, पर्वणि on fullmoon day, महावेगः with great speed, समुद्रः इव like an ocean, अशोभत shone.

text: ते स्व वारम् समास्थाय वर्त्म कर्माणि कोविदाः । करणैः विविध उपेतैः पुरस्तात् सम्प्रतस्थिरे ॥२-८०-५॥
translation: Those groups who were skilled in the construction of roads took up their places with every kind of tool and departed ahead of others.
word_meanings: वर्त्मकर्मणि in the construction of roads, कोविदाः skilled, ते those, विविधोपेतैः with different kinds of, करणैः tools, स्ववारम् their own group, समास्थाय taking up the place, पुरस्तात् ahead, सम्प्रतस्थिरे departed.

text: लता वल्लीः च गुल्मामः च स्थाणून् अश्मनएव च । जनाः ते चक्रिरे मार्गम् चिन्दन्तः विविधान् द्रुमान् ॥२-८०-६॥
translation: Clearing and cutting branches of various trees and creepers, shrubs, plants branchless trees and hewing boulders, the road was paved by the king's men.
word_meanings: लतावल्लीः च creepers, गुल्मांश्च shrubs, स्थाणून् branchless trees, अश्मन एव च boulders, विविधान् various, द्रुमान् trees, छिन्दन्त hewing off, मार्गम् way, जनायांचक्रिरे paved by the (king's) men.

text: अवृक्षेषु च देशेषु केचित् वृक्षान् अरोपयन् । केचित् कुठारैअः टन्कैः च दात्रैः चिन्दन् क्वचित् क्वचित् ॥२-८०-७॥
translation: Some of them, planted saplings in places where there were none, while some others severed trees here and there with axes, hatchets and sickles.
word_meanings: केचित् some of them, अवृक्षेषु where there were no trees, देशेषु in places, वृक्षान् saplings, अरोपयन् planted, केचित् some, क्वचित् क्वचित् here and there, कुठारैः with axes, टङ्कैश्च with hatchets, दात्रैः च with sickles, छिन्दन् severing.

text: अपरे वीरण स्तम्बान् बलिनो बलवत्तराः । विधमन्ति स्म दुर्गाणि स्थलानि च ततः ततः ॥२-८०-८॥
translation: Some other stronger men, plucked the strongrooted tufts of fragrant grass. Here and there they made impassable terrains even.
word_meanings: बलवत्तराः stronger men, अपरे some others, बलिनः strongrooted, वीरणस्तम्भान् tufts of fragrant grass, विधमन्ति स्म removed, ततस्ततः here and there, दुर्गाणि impassable terrains, स्थलानि were made even.

text: अपरे अपूरयन् कूपान् पाम्सुभिः श्वभ्रम् आयतम् । निम्न भागाम्स् तथा केचित् समामः चक्रुः समन्ततः ॥२-८०-९॥
translation: Some filled wells and chasms with loose soil, while others made low level grounds plain and wide on all sides.
word_meanings: अपरे some others, कूपान् wells, आयतम् wide, श्वभ्रम् chasm, पांसुभिः with loose soil, अपूरयन् filled, ततः thereafter, केचित् some, निम्नभागान् low level grounds, समन्ततः on all sides, समान् evenly, चक्रुः made.

text: बबन्धुर् बन्धनीयामः च क्षोद्यान् सम्चुक्षुदुस् तदा । बिभिदुर् भेदनीयामः च ताम्स् तान् देशान् नराः तदा ॥२-८०-१०॥
translation: People threw bridges at places that needed to be bridged. They pulverised stones that obstructed the path and split open big stones to drain out water.
word_meanings: तदा then, नराः people, बन्धनीयान् required to be bridged, तांस्तान् at such, देशान् places, बबन्धु: bridged, क्षोद्यान् required crushing, सञ्चुक्षुदुः pulverised, भेदनीयान् च required to be split open, बिभिदुः broke them.

text: अचिरेण एव कालेन परिवाहान् बहु उदकान् । चक्रुर् बहु विध आकारान् सागर प्रतिमान् बहून् ॥२-८०-११॥
translation: In a short time they constructed many water reservoirs of different shapes capable of holding large volumes of water like the sea.
word_meanings: अचिरेणकालेनैव in a short time, बहूदकान् having large volumes of water, बहुविधाकारान् of different shapes, सागरप्रतिमान् like the sea, बहून् many, परिवाहान् water courses, चक्रुः constructed.

text: निर्जलेषु च देशेषु खानयामासुरुत्तमान् । उदपानान् बहुविधान् वेदिका परिमण्डितान् ॥२-८०-१२॥
translation: In arid places, various good drinkingwaterwells surrounded by dykes were dug.
word_meanings: निर्जलेषु where there was no water, देशेषु in places, उत्तमान् best, बहुविधान् various, वेदिकापरिमण्डितान् surrounded by circular dykes, उदपानान् drinking water wells, खानयामासुः were dug.

text: ससुधा कुट्टिम तलः प्रपुष्पित मही रुहः । मत्त उद्घुष्ट द्विज गणः पताकाभिर् अलम्कृतः ॥२-८०-१३॥
translation: The highway for the army was paved smooth, with its surface decorated with mosaic. It was lined with blossoming trees with flocks of birds intoxicated with singing. It was decked with banners and sprinkled with sandal water and a strewn with flowers of every kind. Like the path of gods, the highway shone with brilliance.
word_meanings: ससुधाकुट्टिमतलः surface decorated with mosaic, प्रपुष्पितमहीरुहः avenue lined with blossoming trees, मत्तोद्घुष्ट द्विजगणः with flocks of birds intoxicated with singing, पताकाभिः with banners, अलङ्कृतः decorated, चन्दनोदकसंसिक्तः sprinkled with sandal water, नानाकुसुमभूषितः embellished with various kinds of flowers, सेनायाः army's सुरपथोपमः like the path of the gods, (सः) पन्थाः that highway, बहु brilliantly, अशोभत shone.

text: चन्दन उदक सम्सिक्तः नाना कुसुम भूषितः । बह्व् अशोभत सेनायाः पन्थाः स्वर्ग पथ उपमः ॥२-८०-१४॥
translation: The highway for the army was paved smooth, with its surface decorated with mosaic. It was lined with blossoming trees with flocks of birds intoxicated with singing. It was decked with banners and sprinkled with sandal water and a strewn with flowers of every kind. Like the path of gods, the highway shone with brilliance.
word_meanings: ससुधाकुट्टिमतलः surface decorated with mosaic, प्रपुष्पितमहीरुहः avenue lined with blossoming trees, मत्तोद्घुष्ट द्विजगणः with flocks of birds intoxicated with singing, पताकाभिः with banners, अलङ्कृतः decorated, चन्दनोदकसंसिक्तः sprinkled with sandal water, नानाकुसुमभूषितः embellished with various kinds of flowers, सेनायाः army's सुरपथोपमः like the path of the gods, (सः) पन्थाः that highway, बहु brilliantly, अशोभत shone.

text: आज्ञाप्य अथ यथा आज्ञप्ति युक्ताः ते अधिकृता नराः । रमणीयेषु देशेषु बहु स्वादु फलेषु च ॥२-८०-१५॥
translation: Those authorised ordered the artisans to perform their respective tasks. Thereafter, they selected lovely tracts of land filled with trees bearing varieties of sweet fruits as restingplace for great Bharata and decorated them so splendidly, that they looked like ornaments themseleves.
word_meanings: अधिकृता authorised, ते नराः those persons, यथाज्ञप्ति in accordance with the orders (of Bharata), युक्ताः performing their work, आज्ञप्य issued orders (to the artisans), अथ thereafter, बहुस्वादुफलेषु with varieties of sweet fruits, रमणीयेषु lovely, देशेषु places, महात्मनः of great, भरतस्य Bharata, यः निवेशः restingplace, अभिप्रेतः selected, तम् that place, भूषाभिः with ornaments, भूषणोपमम् like ornaments , भूयः well, शोभयामासुः shone.

text: यो निवेशः तु अभिप्रेतः भरतस्य महात्मनः । भूयः तम् शोभयाम् आसुर् भूषाभिर् भूषण उपमम् ॥२-८०-१६॥
translation: Those authorised ordered the artisans to perform their respective tasks. Thereafter, they selected lovely tracts of land filled with trees bearing varieties of sweet fruits as restingplace for great Bharata and decorated them so splendidly, that they looked like ornaments themseleves.
word_meanings: अधिकृता authorised, ते नराः those persons, यथाज्ञप्ति in accordance with the orders (of Bharata), युक्ताः performing their work, आज्ञप्य issued orders (to the artisans), अथ thereafter, बहुस्वादुफलेषु with varieties of sweet fruits, रमणीयेषु lovely, देशेषु places, महात्मनः of great, भरतस्य Bharata, यः निवेशः restingplace, अभिप्रेतः selected, तम् that place, भूषाभिः with ornaments, भूषणोपमम् like ornaments , भूयः well, शोभयामासुः shone.

text: नक्षत्रेषु प्रशस्तेषु मुहूर्तेषु च तद्विदः । निवेशम् स्थापयाम् आसुर् भरतस्य महात्मनः ॥२-८०-१७॥
translation: Men wellversed in the study of planetary positions relating to auspicious constellations and auspicious times arranged different restingplaces at different times during the sojourn of great Bharata.
word_meanings: तद्विदः men well versed in the study of planetary positions relating to auspicious constellations and auspicious time (astrologers), प्रशस्तेषु at auspicious, नक्षत्रेषु in the constellation, मुहूर्तेषु at auspicious time, महात्मनः highsouled, भरतस्य for Bharata, निवेशान् restplace, स्थापयामासुः established.

text: बहु पाम्सु चयाः च अपि परिखा परिवारिताः । तन्त्र इन्द्र कील प्रतिमाः प्रतोली वर शोभिताः ॥२-८०-१८॥
translation: They heaped sand and dug moats around the restingplace. It was adorned with wellbuilt highways and broad thoroughfares, lined with mansions surrounded by walls as high as mount Indrakeela. The peaks of those tall residences decorated with flags which looked as if spreading into the sky. (Thus the restingplace) shone like the abode of Indra.
word_meanings: तत्र there, बहुपांसुचयाश्चपि heaps of sand, परिखापरिवारिताः encircled by moats, इन्द्रकीलप्रतिमाः comparable to mount Indrakeela, प्रतोलीवरशोभिताः adorned with broad highways, प्रासादमालावितताः lined with mansions, सौधप्राकारसंवृताः surrounded by walls, पताकाशोभिताः decorated with flags, सुनिर्मित महापथाः with wellbuilt, broad thoroughfares, ते निवेशाः those residences, आकाशे in the sky, विसर्पद्भिरिव like one spreading, समुच्छ्रितैः tall, विटङ्काग्रविमानकैः with the peaks of mansions, शक्रपुरोपमाः like the abode of Indra, बभुः shone.

text: प्रासाद माला सम्युक्ताः सौध प्राकार सम्वृताः । पताका शोभिताः सर्वे सुनिर्मित महा पथाः ॥२-८०-१९॥
translation: They heaped sand and dug moats around the restingplace. It was adorned with wellbuilt highways and broad thoroughfares, lined with mansions surrounded by walls as high as mount Indrakeela. The peaks of those tall residences decorated with flags which looked as if spreading into the sky. (Thus the restingplace) shone like the abode of Indra.
word_meanings: तत्र there, बहुपांसुचयाश्चपि heaps of sand, परिखापरिवारिताः encircled by moats, इन्द्रकीलप्रतिमाः comparable to mount Indrakeela, प्रतोलीवरशोभिताः adorned with broad highways, प्रासादमालावितताः lined with mansions, सौधप्राकारसंवृताः surrounded by walls, पताकाशोभिताः decorated with flags, सुनिर्मित महापथाः with wellbuilt, broad thoroughfares, ते निवेशाः those residences, आकाशे in the sky, विसर्पद्भिरिव like one spreading, समुच्छ्रितैः tall, विटङ्काग्रविमानकैः with the peaks of mansions, शक्रपुरोपमाः like the abode of Indra, बभुः shone.

text: विसर्पत्भिर् इव आकाशे विटन्क अग्र विमानकैः । समुच्च्रितैः निवेशाः ते बभुः शक्र पुर उपमाः ॥२-८०-२०॥
translation: They heaped sand and dug moats around the restingplace. It was adorned with wellbuilt highways and broad thoroughfares, lined with mansions surrounded by walls as high as mount Indrakeela. The peaks of those tall residences decorated with flags which looked as if spreading into the sky. (Thus the restingplace) shone like the abode of Indra.
word_meanings: तत्र there, बहुपांसुचयाश्चपि heaps of sand, परिखापरिवारिताः encircled by moats, इन्द्रकीलप्रतिमाः comparable to mount Indrakeela, प्रतोलीवरशोभिताः adorned with broad highways, प्रासादमालावितताः lined with mansions, सौधप्राकारसंवृताः surrounded by walls, पताकाशोभिताः decorated with flags, सुनिर्मित महापथाः with wellbuilt, broad thoroughfares, ते निवेशाः those residences, आकाशे in the sky, विसर्पद्भिरिव like one spreading, समुच्छ्रितैः tall, विटङ्काग्रविमानकैः with the peaks of mansions, शक्रपुरोपमाः like the abode of Indra, बभुः shone.

text: जाह्नवीम् तु समासाद्य विविध द्रुम काननाम् । शीतल अमल पानीयाम् महा मीन समाकुलाम् ॥२-८०-२१॥
translation: The reached Ganga with its cool and limpid waters abounding in large fishes, its bank lined with groves of various trees.
word_meanings: विविधद्रुमकाननाम् with groves of various trees, शीतलामलपानीयाम् with cool and limpid waters, महामीनसमाकुलाम् abounding in large fishes, जाह्नवीम् the river Ganga, समासाद्य having reached.

text: सचन्द्र तारा गण मण्डितम् यथा । नभः क्षपायाम् अमलम् विराजते । नर इन्द्र मार्गः स तथा व्यराजत । क्रमेण रम्यः शुभ शिल्पि निर्मितः ॥२-८०-२२॥
translation: The lovely royal road constructed in an orderly fashion by eminent craftsmen looked splendid like the clear sky decorated with by the Moon and clusters of stars. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightieth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सचन्द्रतारागणमण्डितम् decorated with the Moon and stars, अमलम् clear, नभः sky, क्षपायाम् in the night, याथा how, विराजते shines, क्रमेण orderly manner, शुभशिल्पिनिर्मितः constructed by eminent craftsmen, रम्यः lovely, सः that, नरेन्द्रमार्गः royal road, तथा that way, व्यराजत shone.

text: ततः नान्दी मुखीम् रात्रिम् भरतम् सूत मागधाः । तुष्टुवुर् वाग् विशेषज्ञाः स्तवैः मन्गल सम्हितैः ॥२-८१-१॥
translation: Thereafter bards and panegyrists adept in conversation with an auspicious start pleased Bharata with eulogy in the last part of the night.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, वाग्विशेषज्ञाः experts in conversation, सूतमागधाः bards and panegyrists, नान्दीमुखीम् with an auspicious start, रात्रिम् the night, मङ्गलसंहितैः filled with an auspicious notes, स्तवैः praises, भरतम् Bharata, तुष्टुवुः pleased.

text: सुवर्ण कोण अभिहतः प्राणदद् याम दुन्दुभिः । दध्मुः शन्खामः च शतशो वाद्यामः च उच्च अवच स्वरान् ॥२-८१-२॥
translation: The drums of the night watch were beaten by golden sticks. Conches in hundreds were blown and sounds of various modulations were created.
word_meanings: सुवर्णकोणाभिहतः beaten by golden sticks, यामदुन्दुभिः the drums of the nightwatch (to indicate watchers of the night), प्राणदत् was struck, शङ्खांश्च conches, उच्चावचस्वरान् of various modulations, नादांश्च sounds, शतशः in hundreds, दध्मुः people blew.

text: स तूर्य घोषः सुमहान् दिवम् आपूरयन्न् इव । भरतम् शोक सम्तप्तम् भूयः शोकैः अरन्ध्रयत् ॥२-८१-३॥
translation: The shrill trempets which seemed to fill the heavens caused much more distress to the already griefstricken Bharata.
word_meanings: सुमहान् shrill, सः that, तूर्यघोषः sound of trumpets, दिवम् the heaven, आपूरयन्निव as if filling, शोकसंतप्तम् griefstricken, भरतम् Bharata, भूयः still more, शोकैः with sorrows, अरन्ध्रयत् filled.

text: ततः प्रबुद्धो भरतः तम् घोषम् सम्निवर्त्य च । न अहम् राजा इति च अपि उक्त्वा शत्रुघ्नम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-८१-४॥
translation: Then Bharata waking up, exclaimed, I am not the king, ordered the pipers to stop and said to Satrughna:
word_meanings: ततः then, प्रबुद्ध: awakened, भरतः Bharata, अहम् I, राजा king, न not, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, तम् घोषम् that sound, सन्निवर्त्य च having stopped, शत्रुघ्नम् to Satrughna, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: पश्य शत्रुघ्न कैकेय्या लोकस्य अपकृतम् महत् । विसृज्य मयि दुह्खानि राजा दशरथो गतः ॥२-८१-५॥
translation: O Satrughna see what great harm has been done to these people at the instance of Kaikeyi. King Dasaratha has gone, leaving me to suffer.
word_meanings: शत्रुघ्न O Satrughna, पश्य see, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, लोकस्य to the people, महत् great, अपकृतम् harm has been done, राजा king, दशरथः Dasaratha, दुःखानि all sufferings, मयि in me, विसृज्य having left, गतः went.

text: तस्य एषा धर्म राजस्य धर्म मूला महात्मनः । परिभ्रमति राज श्रीर् नौर् इव अकर्णिका जले ॥२-८१-६॥
translation: This kingdom, rooted in the righteousness of that noble king, is now whirling like a boat in a whirlpool without a helmsman.
word_meanings: धर्मराजस्य of righteous king, तस्य his, महात्मनः noble one's, धर्ममूला rooted in righteousness, एषा such, राज्यश्रीः the goddess of kingdom, जले in water, आकर्णिका without helmsman, नौः इव like a boat, परिभ्रमति is revolving.

text: यो हि नः सुमहान्नाथः सोऽपि प्रव्राजितो वनम् । अनया धर्ममुत्सृज्य मात्रा मे राघवः स्वयम् ॥२-८१-७॥
translation: Even Rama, a great protector for all of us, has been banished to the forest by my mother bereft of virtuous conduct.
word_meanings: यः whoever, नः for us, सुमहान् great, नाथः protector, सः (राघवः) अपि that Rama also, अनया this, मे मात्रा by my mother, धर्मम् virtuous conduct, उत्सृज्य having abandoned, स्वयम् herself, वनम् forest, प्रव्राजितः has been banished.

text: इति एवम् भरतम् प्रेक्ष्य विलपन्तम् विचेतनम् । कृपणम् रुरुदुः सर्वाः सस्वरम् योषितः तदा ॥२-८१-८॥
translation: Thus lamenting, Bharata fainted. Seeing him (in this state) all the women (of the inner apartment) at once cried aloud piteously.
word_meanings: तदा then, इत्येवम् in this way, विलपन्तम् lamenting, विचेतनम् lying unconscious, भरतम् Bharata, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, सर्वाः all, योषितः women, सस्वरम् in one voice, कृपणम् piteously, रुरुदुः cried loudly.

text: तथा तस्मिन् विलपति वसिष्ठो राज धर्मवित् । सभाम् इक्ष्वाकु नाथस्य प्रविवेश महा यशाः ॥२-८१-९॥
translation: While Bharata was weeping, illustrious Vasistha, conversant with royal traditions, entered the assembly hall of the lord of the Iksvakus (king Dasaratha).
word_meanings: तस्मिन् that Bharata, तथा in that way, विलपति lamenting, राजधर्मवित् conversant with royal traditions, महायशाः illustrious man, वसिष्ठः Vasistha, इक्ष्वाकुनाथस्य of the lord of Iksvakus (king Dasaratha's), सभाम् assembly hall, प्रविवेश entered.

text: शात कुम्भमयीम् रम्याम् मणि रत्न समाकुलाम् । सुधर्माम् इव धर्म आत्मा सगणः प्रत्यपद्यत ॥२-८१-१०॥
translation: Righteous Vasistha along with his disciples reached the lovely golden assembly hall inlaid with gems and precious stones, which resembled Sudharma, (the assembly hall of Indra).
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा righteous, सगणः along with his disciples, शातकुम्भमयीम् with gold finishing, रम्याम् lovely, मणिरत्नसमाकुलाम् inlaid with gems and precious stones, सुधर्मामिव like Sudharma, (the assembly hall of Indra), प्रत्यपद्यत reached.

text: स कान्चनमयम् पीठम् पर अर्ध्य आस्तरण आवृतम् । अध्यास्त सर्व वेदज्ञो दूतान् अनुशशास च ॥२-८१-११॥
translation: Vasistha, wellversed in all the Vedas, sat on a golden seat with a comfortable cover and ordered the messengers:
word_meanings: सर्ववेदज्ञः wellversed in all the Vedas, सः Vasistha, सुखास्तरणसंवृतम् covered with comfortable spread, काञ्चनमयम् made of gold, पीठम् seat, अध्यास्त sat, दूतान् messengers, अनुशशास च ordered too.

text: ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियान् योधान् अमात्यान् गण बल्लभान् । क्षिप्रम् आनयत अव्यग्राः कृत्यम् आत्ययिकम् हि नः ॥२-८१-१२॥
translation: Fetch quietly brahmins, kshatriyas, vaisyas, ministers and army commanders at once. A matter of great urgency awaits us.
word_meanings: अव्यग्राः with a steady mind, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, क्षत्रियान् kshatriyas, वैश्यान् Vaisyas, अमात्यान् ministers, गणवल्लभान् army commanders, क्षिप्रम् at once, आनयत fetch, नः for us, आत्ययिकम् of great urgency, कृत्यं हि work to be done.

text: सराजभृत्यम् शत्रुघ्नम् भरतम् च यश्स्विनम् । युधाजितम् सुमन्त्रम् च ये च तत्र हिता जनाः ॥२-८१-१३॥
translation: Bring all the royal attendants, Satrughna, the illustrious Bharata, Yudhajit, Sumantra and all those wellwishers of the king.
word_meanings: सराजभृत्यम् along with royal attendants, शत्रुघ्नम् Satrughna, यशस्विनम् the illustious one, भरतं च Bharata too, युधाजितम् Yudhajit, सुमन्त्रं च Sumantra also, तत्र there, हिताः well wishers of the king, ये जनाः all those people.

text: ततः हलहला शब्दो महान् समुदपद्यत । रथैः अश्वैः गजैः च अपि जनानाम् उपगच्चताम् ॥२-८१-१४॥
translation: As they (invitees) began arriving on chariots, horses and elephants, there arose a great tumult.
word_meanings: ततः then, रथैः with chariots, अश्वैः on horses, गजैश्चापि on elephants, उपगच्छताम् of those arriving, जनानाम् people's, सुमहान् great, हलहला शब्दः tumultuous sound, समपद्यत arose.

text: ततः भरतम् आयान्तम् शत क्रतुम् इव अमराः । प्रत्यनन्दन् प्रकृतयो यथा दशरथम् तथा ॥२-८१-१५॥
translation: Then as Bharata apprroached, ministers and subjects greeted him as they used to greet Dasaratha, just as gods greet Indra, the performer of a hundred sacrifices.
word_meanings: ततः then, आयान्तम् approaching, भरतम् Bharata, प्रकृतयः ministers and other subjects, दशरथम् Dasaratha, यथा like, तथा like, अमराः gods, शतक्रतुमिव like Indra, the performer of hundred sacrifices, प्रत्यनन्दन् greeted.

text: ह्रदैव तिमि नाग सम्वृतः । स्तिमित जलो मणि शन्ख शर्करः । दशरथ सुत शोभिता सभा । सदशरथा इव बभौ यथा पुरा ॥२-८१-१६॥
translation: The assembly hall looked splendid like a lake of tranquil waters with gems, shells pebbles, grains of sand and teeming with whales and serpents in the presence of the son of king Dasaratha. It appeared as though Dasaratha himself was present. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकाशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightyfirst sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: दशरथसुतशोभिता graced by the son of Dasaratha, सभा assembly hall, सदशरथा इव as if Dasaratha was present, तिमिनाग संवृतः filled with whales and serpents, मणिसङ्खशर्करः with gems, shells, pebbles and grains of sand, स्तिमितजलः with placid water, ह्रद इव like a lake, यथापुरा as of yore, बभौ shone.

text: ताम् आर्य गण सम्पूर्णाम् भरतः प्रग्रहाम् सभाम् । ददर्श बुद्धि सम्पन्नः पूर्ण चन्द्राम् निशाम् इव ॥२-८२-१॥
translation: Sagacious Bharata beheld that assembly hall filled with honourable members, like the fullmoon beholds the night stretching forth (with stars).
word_meanings: बुद्धिसम्पन्नः sagacious, भरतः Bharata, आर्यगणसम्पूर्णाम् full of honourable members, तां सभाम् that assembly hall, पूर्णचन्द्रः fullmoon, प्रग्रहाम् stretching forth, निशामिव like night, ददर्श beheld.

text: आसनानि यथा न्यायम् आर्याणाम् विशताम् तदा । अदृश्यत घन अपाये पूर्ण चन्द्रा इव शर्वरी ॥२-८२-२॥
सा विद्वज्जनसम्पूर्णा सभा सुरुचिरा तदा । अदृश्यत घनापाये पूर्णचन्द्रेव शर्वरी ॥२-८२-३॥
translation: The most splendid assembly filled with learned people looked brilliant like the night with the autumnal fullmoon.
word_meanings: तदा then, विद्वज्जनसम्पूर्णा filled with learned people, सुरुचिरा most splendid, सा सभा that assembly, घनापाये after the departure of rains, पूर्णचन्द्रा with fullmoon, शर्वरीव like the night, अदृश्यत looked.

text: राज्ञः तु प्रकृतीः सर्वाः समग्राः प्रेक्ष्य धर्मवित् । इदम् पुरोहितः वाक्यम् भरतम् मृदु च अब्रवीत् ॥२-८२-४॥
translation: The chief priest Vasistha, knower of righteousness, looked at all the ministers present and addressed Bharata in a gentle voice.
word_meanings: धर्मवित् knower of righteousness, पुरोहितः the chief priest, समग्राः complete, सर्वाः all, राज्ञः king's, प्रकृतीः ministers, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, भरतम् Bharata, मृदु in a gentle way, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: तात राजा दशरथः स्वर् गतः धर्मम् आचरन् । धन धान्यवतीम् स्फीताम् प्रदाय पृथिवीम् तव ॥२-८२-५॥
translation: O dear child following the righteous path king Dasaratha conferred on you this vast kingdom abounding in wealth and grains before attaining heaven.
word_meanings: तात dear child, राजा king, दशरथः Dasaratha, धर्मम् righteousness, आचरन् while following, धनधान्यवतीम् abounding in wealth and grains, स्फीताम् vast, पृथिवीम् kingdom, तव to you, प्रदाय having given, स्वर्गतः attained heaven.

text: रामः तथा सत्य धृतिः सताम् धर्मम् अनुस्मरन् । न अजहात् पितुर् आदेशम् शशी ज्योत्स्नाम् इव उदितः ॥२-८२-६॥
translation: Abiding in truth, remembering the righteous ways of virtuous men just as the rising Moon does not leave its beams, Rama too did not move away from his father's command.
word_meanings: तथा and, सत्यधृतिः abiding in truth, रामः Rama, सताम् of the virtuous, धर्मम् righteousness, अनुस्मरन् remembering, उदितः rising, शशी moon, ज्योत्स्नामिव like moon light, पितुः father's, आदेशम् command, नाजहात् did not abandon.

text: पित्रा भ्रात्रा च ते दत्तम् राज्यम् निहत कण्टकम् । तत् भुन्क्ष्व मुदित अमात्यः क्षिप्रम् एव अभिषेचय ॥२-८२-७॥
translation: The kingdom free from obstacles has been passed on to you by your father and brother. Get yourself coronated quickly and enjoy it along with your cheerful ministers.
word_meanings: पित्रा by your father, भ्रात्रा च by your brother also, निहतकण्टकम् all thorns removed, राज्यम् kingdom, ते to you, दत्तम् has been given, मुदितामात्यः with ministers pleased, तत् that king dom, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy, क्षिप्रमेव quickly, अभिषेचय be consecrated.

text: उदीच्याः च प्रतीच्याः च दाक्षिणात्याः च केवलाः । कोट्या अपर अन्ताः सामुद्रा रत्नानि अभिहरन्तु ते ॥२-८२-८॥
translation: Let kings from the north, the west, the south, the bordering kingdoms, and the seatraders offer you crores of gems as gifts.
word_meanings: उदीच्याः kings from the north, प्रतीच्या श्च from the west, दाक्षिणात्याश्च from the south, केवलाः solely, अपरान्ताः kings of the bordering kingdoms, सामुद्राः seatraders, ते they, कोट्या crores in number, रत्नानि gems, अभिहरन्तु may offer to you as gift.

text: तत् श्रुत्वा भरतः वाक्यम् शोकेन अभिपरिप्लुतः । जगाम मनसा रामम् धर्मज्ञो धर्म कान्क्षया ॥२-८२-९॥
translation: On hearing those words, Bharata who knew his duty was overwhelmed with distress and, resolved to abide by righteousness, reached Rama through his mind (thought of Rama).
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञः knower of duty, भरतः Bharata, तत् that, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, शोकेन with distress, अभिपरिप्लुतः overwhelmed, धर्मकाङ्क्षया wishing to abide by righteousness, रामम् Rama, मनसा with mind, जगाम reached.

text: स बाष्प कलया वाचा कल हम्स स्वरः युवा । विललाप सभा मध्ये जगर्हे च पुरोहितम् ॥२-८२-१०॥
translation: Young Bharata with the melodious voice of a swan, choked with tears, lamenting in the assembly, reproached the family priest Vasistha, saying:
word_meanings: कलहंसस्वरः voice resembling the melodious cackle of a swan, युवा the young man, सबाष्पकलया voice choked with sobs, वाचा words, सभामध्ये in the midst of the assembly, विललाप lamented, पुरोहितम् to the family priest Vasistha, जगर्हे च reproached.

text: चरित ब्रह्मचर्यस्य विद्या स्नातस्य धीमतः । धर्मे प्रयतमानस्य को राज्यम् मद्विधो हरेत् ॥२-८२-११॥
translation: Would any man seize this kingdom which rightfully belongs to sagacious Rama, who practises brahmacharya, who is wellversed in all branches of learning and who endeavours to protect righteousness?
word_meanings: चरितब्रह्मचर्यस्य one who practised brahmacharaya, विद्यास्नातस्य who is wellversed in all branches of learning, धीमतः of the sagacious, धर्मे in righteousness, प्रयतमानस्य endeavouring, राज्यम् kingdom, मद्विधः a man like me, कः who, हरेत् will seize?

text: कथम् दशरथाज् जातः भवेद् राज्य अपहारकः । राज्यम् च अहम् च रामस्य धर्मम् वक्तुम् इह अर्हसि ॥२-८२-१२॥
translation: How can any usurper of the kingdom be born of Dasaratha? Or, how would any progeny of Dasaratha become the usurper of the kingdom? I and the kingdom, both belong to Rama. You should tell the truth about this.
word_meanings: दशरथात् from Dasaratha, जातः born, राज्यापहारकः usurper of the kingdom, कथम् भवेत् how will he become?, राज्यं च kingdom, अहं च I also, रामस्य belong to Rama, इह in this matter, धर्मम् truth, वक्तुम् to tell, अर्हसि it behoves you.

text: ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठः च धर्म आत्मा दिलीप नहुष उपमः । लब्धुम् अर्हति काकुत्स्थो राज्यम् दशरथो यथा ॥२-८२-१३॥
translation: The eldest, eminent and righteous Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, who is comparable to Dilipa and Nahusha deserves to inherit this kingdom just as Dasaratha did.
word_meanings: ज्येष्ठः eldest, श्रेष्ठः च and also eminent, धर्मात्मा righteous one, दिलीपनहुषोपमः comparable to Dilipa and Nahusha, काकुत्स्थ Rama of Kakutstha dynasty, दशरथो यथा like Dasaratha, राज्यम् kingdom, लब्धुम् to inherit, अर्हति deserves.

text: अनार्य जुष्टम् अस्वर्ग्यम् कुर्याम् पापम् अहम् यदि । इक्ष्वाकूणाम् अहम् लोके भवेयम् कुल पाम्सनः ॥२-८२-१४॥
translation: If I commit this evil act followed by wretched people which would not lead any one to heaven, I shall only be bringing disgrace to the kings of the Ikshvaku dynasty.
word_meanings: अहम् I, अनार्यजुष्टम् followed by wretched ones, अस्वर्ग्यम् not leading to heaven, पापम् sin, कुर्यां यदि if I do, लोके in this world, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् to the Ikshvaku kings, कुलपांसनः one who is a disgrace to the family, भवेयम् I shall become.

text: यद्द् हि मात्रा कृतम् पापम् न अहम् तत् अभिरोचये । इहस्थो वन दुर्गस्थम् नमस्यामि कृत अन्जलिः ॥२-८२-१५॥
translation: I will never accept the evil deed committed by my mother. From here itself I shall pay obeisance with folded palms to my brother who dwells in the impenetrable forest.
word_meanings: मात्रा by my mother, यत् which, पापम् sin, कृतम् was committed, तत् अपि that one also, अहम् I, न रोचये हि do not accept, इहस्थः from here, वनदुर्गस्थम् one staying in impenetrable forest, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, नमस्यामि pay obeisance.

text: रामम् एव अनुगच्चामि स राजा द्विपदाम् वरः । त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् राघवो राज्यम् अर्हति ॥२-८२-१६॥
translation: I shall follow Rama the best among men. He alone and no one else deserves to rule over the kingdom of the three worlds.
word_meanings: राममेव Rama alone, अनुगच्छामि I will follow, द्विपदां वरः best among men, सः he alone, राजा is the king, राघवः Rama, त्रयाणां लोकानाम् of the three worlds', राज्यमपि kingdom, अर्हति deserves.

text: तत् वाक्यम् धर्म सम्युक्तम् श्रुत्वा सर्वे सभासदः । हर्षान् मुमुचुर् अश्रूणि रामे निहित चेतसः ॥२-८२-१७॥
translation: Hearing the words of Bharata full of righteousness, all the men assembled there shed tears of joy, thinking of Rama.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, सभासदः members of the assembly, धर्मसंयुक्तम् bound by righteousness, तद्वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामे on Rama, निहितचेतसः fixing their thoughts, हर्षात् out of joy, अश्रूणि tears, मुमुचुः shed.

text: यदि तु आर्यम् न शक्ष्यामि विनिवर्तयितुम् वनात् । वने तत्र एव वत्स्यामि यथा आर्यो लक्ष्मणः तथा ॥२-८२-१८॥
translation: If I am not able to bring back my noble brother (Rama) from the forest, I shall also dwell there like my noble brother Lakshmana.
word_meanings: आर्यम् my noble brother, वनात् from the forest, विनिवर्तयितुम् to bring back, न शक्ष्यामि यदि if I am not able, आर्यः noble brother, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, यथा as, तथा so, तत्र there, वने एव in the forest itself, वत्स्यामि I shall dwell.

text: सर्व उपायम् तु वर्तिष्ये विनिवर्तयितुम् बलात् । समक्षम् आर्य मिश्राणाम् साधूनाम् गुण वर्तिनाम् ॥२-८२-१९॥
translation: I shall employ all possible means to bring him back and join you who are respectable, virtuous and pious.
word_meanings: गुणवर्तिनाम् of the virtuous, साधूनाम् of the pious, आर्यमिश्राणाम् noble ones, समक्षम् in the presence, बलात् with all force, विनिवर्तयितुम् to bring back, सर्वोपायम् by all means, वर्तिष्ये I shall attempt.

text: विष्टिकर्मान्तिकाः सर्वे मार्गशोधनरक्षकाः । प्रस्थापिता मया पूर्वम् यात्रापि मम रोचते ॥२-८२-२०॥
translation: I have already despatched the explorers and protectors of roads who work for wages and without wages as well. It also pleases me to undertake this journey.
word_meanings: मार्गशोधकरक्षकाः explorers and protectors of the paths, सर्वे all, विष्टिकर्मान्तिकाः who work for wages and no wages, मया by me, पूर्वम् previously, प्रस्थापिताः have been despatched, मम for me, यात्रापि this journey, रोचते pleases.

text: एवम् उक्त्वा तु धर्म आत्मा भरतः भ्रातृ वत्सलः । समीपस्थम् उवाच इदम् सुमन्त्रम् मन्त्र कोविदम् ॥२-८२-२१॥
translation: Righteous Bharata who was full of devotion towards his brother having uttered thus, addressed the skilful counsellor Sumantra standing nearby:
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा righteous one, भ्रातृवत्सलः a devoted brother, भरतः Bharata, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा तु having uttered, समीपस्थम् standing nearby, मन्त्रकोविदम् skilled in counselling, सुमन्त्रम् to Sumantra, इदम् these words, उवाच said.

text: तूर्णम् उत्थाय गच्च त्वम् सुमन्त्र मम शासनात् । यात्राम् आज्ञापय क्षिप्रम् बलम् चैव समानय ॥२-८२-२२॥
translation: O Sumantra quickly rise and go. On my authority, order the expedition and let the army be marshalled at once.
word_meanings: सुमन्त्र Sumantra, मम my, शासनात् on command, तूर्णम् quickly, उत्थाय after rising, गच्छ त्वं go, क्षिप्रम् speedily, यात्राम् expedition, आज्ञापय order, बलं चैव army also, समानय bring.

text: एवम् उक्तः सुमन्त्रः तु भरतेन महात्मना । हृष्टः सो अदिशत् सर्वम् यथा सम्दिष्टम् इष्टवत् ॥२-८२-२३॥
translation: On hearing the words of the magnanimous Bharata, Sumantra was delighted and as instructed, ordered everything as if he was anxious to do it himself.
word_meanings: महात्मना magnanimous, भरतेन by Bharata, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having been instructed, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, हृष्टः in delight, तत् then, सर्वम् entirely, यथासन्दिष्टम् as has been commanded, इष्टवत् as if he longed, आदिशत् ordered.

text: ताः प्रहृष्टाः प्रकृतयो बल अध्यक्षा बलस्य च । श्रुत्वा यात्राम् समाज्ञप्ताम् राघवस्य निवर्तने ॥२-८२-२४॥
translation: Having come to know that orders were issued to send the army on an expedition to bring back Rama, the subjects and the army chiefs were delighted.
word_meanings: राघवस्य Rama's, निवर्तने return, समाज्ञप्ताम् ordered, बलस्य च army's, यात्राम् the expedition, श्रुत्वा having heard, ताः those, प्रकृतयः subjects, बलाध्यक्षाः chiefs of army, प्रहृष्टाः were delighted.

text: ततः योध अन्गनाः सर्वा भर्तृऋन् सर्वान् गृहे गृहे । यात्रा गमनम् आज्ञाय त्वरयन्ति स्म हर्षिताः ॥२-८२-२५॥
translation: Then, the wives of the soldiers having come to know of the expedition were all delighted and in every household hastened up their husbands.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, गृहेगृहे in every house, सर्वाः all, योधाङ्गनाः wives of soldiers, यात्रागमनम् for expedition, आज्ञाय having come to know, हर्षिताः gladly, सर्वान् all, भर्त्रून् their husbands, त्वरयन्ति स्म hastened them up.

text: ते हयैः गो रथैः शीघ्रैः स्यन्दनैः च मनो जवैः । सह योधैः बल अध्यक्षा बलम् सर्वम् अचोदयन् ॥२-८२-२६॥
translation: Those chiefs of the army urged the soldiers, horses, fastmoving bullockcarts and swift chariots (to move on).
word_meanings: ते those, बलाध्यक्षाः chiefs of army, हयैः horses, शीघ्रैः fastmoving, गोरथैः bullock carts, महाजवैः of swift, स्यन्दनैश्च by chariots, योधैश्च सह with soldiers, सर्वम् all, बलम् army, अचोदयन् urged.

text: सज्जम् तु तत् बलम् दृष्ट्वा भरतः गुरु सम्निधौ । रथम् मे त्वरयस्व इति सुमन्त्रम् पार्श्वतः अब्रवीत् ॥२-८२-२७॥
translation: When Bharata saw that the army was ready, he instructed Sumantra who was standing by the side of the preceptor to quickly prepare his chariot.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, सज्जम् ready, तत् बलम् that army, दृष्ट्वा having seen, गुरुसन्निधौ in the presence of the preceptor (Vasistha), पार्श्वतः on his side, सुमन्त्रम् to Sumantra, मे my, रथम् chariot, त्वरयस्व quickly prepare, इति like this, अब्रवीत् said.

text: भरतस्य तु तस्य आज्ञाम् प्रतिगृह्य प्रहर्षितः । रथम् गृहीत्वा प्रययौ युक्तम् परम वाजिभिः ॥२-८२-२८॥
translation: He (Sumantra) received the command of Bharata in great delight and set out with a chariot harnessed with excellent horses.
word_meanings: तस्य भरतस्य that Bharata's, आज्ञाम् command, प्रतिगृह्य having received, हर्षितः delighted, परमवाजिभिः with excellent horses, युक्तम् harnessed, रथम् chariot, गृहीत्वा grasping, प्रययौ went.

text: स राघवः सत्य धृतिः प्रतापवान् । ब्रुवन् सुयुक्तम् दृढ सत्य विक्रमः । गुरुम् महा अरण्य गतम् यशस्विनम् । प्रसादयिष्यन् भरतः अब्रवीत् तदा ॥२-८२-२९॥
translation: Bharata, a descendant of the Raghu race, firm in truth, one whose valour comes out of unswerving truth, speaking judiciously said this to propitiate his esteemed brother who was in the dense forest:
word_meanings: तदा then, राघवः Bharata, सत्यधृतिः firm in truth, प्रतापवान् valiant, दृढसत्यविक्रमः whose valour comes out of unshakable truth, सुयुक्तम् judiciously, ब्रुवन् speaking, भरतः Bharata, महारण्यगतम् gone to the great forest, यशस्विनम् illustrious, गुरुम् esteemed brother, प्रसादयिष्यन् to propitiate, अब्रवीत् said.

text: तूण समुत्थाय सुमन्त्र गच्च । बलस्य योगाय बल प्रधानान् । आनेतुम् इच्चामि हि तम् वनस्थम् । प्रसाद्य रामम् जगतः हिताय ॥२-८२-३०॥
translation: O Sumantra, arise, go at once to the leaders of the army and ask them to assemble the troops. I shall propifiate Rama who is in the deep forest and bring him back for the welfare of the world.
word_meanings: सुमन्त्र Sumantra, समुत्थाय arise, बलस्य the army's, योगाय to assemble, बलप्रधानान् to leaders of the army, तूर्णम् quickly, गच्छ go, वनस्थम् who is in the forest, तम् रामम् that Rama, प्रसाद्य having appeased, जगतः world's, हिताय welfare, आनेतुम् to bring, इच्छामि हि am wishing.

text: स सूत पुत्रः भरतेन सम्यग् । आज्ञापितः सम्परिपूर्ण कामः । शशास सर्वान् प्रकृति प्रधानान् । बलस्य मुख्यामः च सुहृज् जनम् च ॥२-८२-३१॥
translation: The charioteer categorically commanded by Bharata, his desire fulfilled, communicated the royal mandate to all important subjects, chiefs of army and friends.
word_meanings: भरतेन by Bharata, सम्यक् distinctly, आज्ञापितः having been ordered, सम्परिपूर्णकामः with his desire fulfilled, सः that, सूतपुत्रः charioteer, सर्वान् all, प्रकृतिप्रधानान् to important subjects, बलस्य army's, मुख्यांश्च chiefs, सुहृज्जनं च to friends, शशास ordered.

text: ततः समुत्थाय कुले कुले ते । राजन्य वैश्या वृषलाः च विप्राः । अयूयुजन्न् उष्ट्र रथान् खरामः च । नागान् हयामः चैव कुल प्रसूतान् ॥२-८२-३२॥
translation: Thereafter, men from every household, kshatriyas, vaisyas, sudras and brahmins came out and harnessed their chariots to the camels and asses, elephants and horses of high pedigree. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्व्यशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightysecond sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: ततः there after, कुले कुले in every household, ते those, राजन्यवैश्याः kshatriyas, vaisyas वृषलाश्च sudras, विप्राः brahmins, समुत्थाय after rising up, उष्ट्रखरान् camels and asses, रथांश्च chariots, कुलप्रसूतान् born in a good race, नागान् elephants, हयांश्चैव horses as well, अयूयुजन् harnessed.

text: ततः समुत्थितः काल्यम् आस्थाय स्यन्दन उत्तमम् । प्रययौ भरतः शीघ्रम् राम दर्शन कान्क्षया ॥२-८३-१॥
translation: Getting up at dawn, Bharata boarded his excellent chariot and set forth swiftly, longing to see Rama.
word_meanings: ततः then, भरतः Bharata, काल्यम् at dawn, समुत्थितः risen, स्यन्दनोत्तमम् best chariot, आस्थाय having boarded, रामदर्शनकाङ्क्षया longing to see Rama, शीघ्रम् swiftly, प्रययौ set forth.

text: अग्रतः प्रययुस् तस्य सर्वे मन्त्रि पुरोधसः । अधिरुह्य हयैः युक्तान् रथान् सूर्य रथ उपमान् ॥२-८३-२॥
translation: All the ministers and priests went ahead of Bharata mounting their chariots, harnessed with horses and resembling the chariot of the Sun god.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, मन्त्रिपुरोधस: ministers and priests, हयैः horses, युक्तान् harnessed, सूर्यरथोपमान् resembling the chariot of the Sun, रथान् chariots, अधिरुह्य having mounted, तस्य his, अग्रतः in front of, प्रययुः went.

text: नव नाग सहस्राणि कल्पितानि यथा विधि । अन्वयुर् भरतम् यान्तम् इक्ष्वाकु कुल नन्दनम् ॥२-८३-३॥
translation: As per tradition, nine thousand elephants were arranged to follow Bharata, delight of the race of the Ikshvakus as he set out.
word_meanings: यथाविधि as per tradition, कल्पितानि arranged, नवनागसहस्राणि nine thousand elephants, यान्तम् while going, इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनम् the delight of the house of Ikshvakus, भरतम् Bharata, अन्वयुः followed.

text: षष्ठी रथ सहस्राणि धन्विनो विविध आयुधाः । अन्वयुर् भरतम् यान्तम् राज पुत्रम् यशस्विनम् ॥२-८३-४॥
translation: Sixty thousands chariots and many archers holding weapons of every kind followed the illustrious prince Bharata as he went.
word_meanings: षष्टि: sixty, रथसहस्राणि thousands of chariots, विविधायुधा: men with weapons of every kind, धन्विनः archers, यान्तम् while going, यशस्विनम् illustrious, राजपुत्रम् king's son, भरतम् Bharata, अन्वयुः followed.

text: शतम् सहस्राणि अश्वानाम् समारूढानि राघवम् । अन्वयुर् भरतम् यान्तम् राज पुत्रम् यशस्विनम् ॥२-८३-५॥
translation: One hundred thousand horses each mounted by a rider followed Bharata, one who had conquered his passion and adhered to truth.
word_meanings: राघवम् born in the Raghu race (Bharata), सत्यसन्धम् adhering to truth, जितेन्द्रियम् one who conquered passions, यान्तम् while going, भरतम् Bharata, समारूढानि mounted by riders, अश्वानाम् of horses, शतम् hundred, सहस्राणि thousand, अन्वयुः followed.

text: कैकेयी च सुमित्रा च कौसल्या च यशस्विनी । राम आनयन सम्हृष्टा ययुर् यानेन भास्वता ॥२-८३-६॥
translation: Kaikeyi, Sumitra as well as the illustrious Kausalya travelled by a resplendent chariot, delighted with the thought of bringing Rama back.
word_meanings: कैकेयी च Kaikeyi as well as, सुमित्रा च Sumitra also, यशस्विनी illustrious, कौसल्या च Kausalya also, रामानयनसंहृष्टाः delighted at the thought of bringing Rama back, भास्वता by a resplendent, यानेन by the chariot, ययुः went.

text: प्रयाताः च आर्य सम्घाता रामम् द्रष्टुम् सलक्ष्मणम् । तस्य एव च कथाः चित्राः कुर्वाणा हृष्ट मानसाः ॥२-८३-७॥
translation: Venerable people in groups, narrating various accomplishments of Rama and eager to see him with Lakshmana, proceeded in a delightful mood.
word_meanings: आर्यसङ्घाताश्च venerable groups of people, हृष्टमानसाः delighted in their hearts, चित्राः various, तस्यैव Rama's only, कथाः accomplishments, कुर्वाणाः doing, सलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, रामम् Rama, द्रष्टुम् to see, प्रयाताः went forth.

text: मेघ श्यामम् महा बाहुम् स्थिर सत्त्वम् दृढ व्रतम् । कदा द्रक्ष्यामहे रामम् जगतः शोक नाशनम् ॥२-८३-८॥
translation: When shall we see that mightyarmed Rama of darkblue complexion like the raincloud, firm in strength and steadfast in vows and the destroyer of the sorrows of this world?
word_meanings: मेघश्यामम् darkblue like raincloud, महाबाहुम् the mightyarmed, स्थिरसत्त्वम् firm in strength, दृढव्रतम् steadfast in vows, जगतः of this world, शोकनाशनम् destroyer of sorrow, रामम् Rama, कदा when, द्रक्ष्यामहे shall see?

text: दृष्टएव हि नः शोकम् अपनेष्यति राघवः । तमः सर्वस्य लोकस्य समुद्यन्न् इव भास्करः ॥२-८३-९॥
translation: At his sight alone our sorrows will be dispelled, the way the darkness of the entire world is dispelled by the rising Sun.
word_meanings: समुद्यन् rising, भास्करः Sun, सर्वस्य of the entire, लोकस्य world's, तमः इव like darkness, राघवः Rama, दृष्ट एव at his sight alone, नः our, शोकम् sorrow, अपनेष्यति will dispel.

text: इति एवम् कथयन्तः ते सम्प्रहृष्टाः कथाः शुभाः । परिष्वजानाः च अन्योन्यम् ययुर् नागरिकाः तदा ॥२-८३-१०॥
translation: The inhabitants of the town proceeded joyfully, narrating Rama's delightful achievements on their way by embracing one another.
word_meanings: ते they, नागरिकाः जनाः inhabitants of the city, इत्येवम् in this way, शुभाः delightful, कथाः achievements, कथयन्तः narrating, सम्प्रहृष्टाः joyfully, अन्योन्यम् mutually, परिष्वजानाश्च embracing also, ययुः proceeded.

text: ये च तत्र अपरे सर्वे सम्मता ये च नैगमाः । रामम् प्रति ययुर् हृष्टाः सर्वाः प्रकृतयः तदा ॥२-८३-११॥
translation: Respectable city folks, like traders and other subjects went along in great delight towards Rama.
word_meanings: तत्र there, ये च अपरे all the others, सम्मताः respectable, ये च नैगमाः those merchants, तथा similarly, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः subjects, हृष्टाः delighted, रामम् प्रति to Rama, ययुः went along.

text: मणि काराः च ये केचित् कुम्भ काराः च शोभनाः । सूत्र कर्म कृतः चैव ये च शस्त्र उपजीविनः ॥२-८३-१२॥
translation: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.
word_meanings: ये those, केचित् some others, मणिकाराः gempolishers, शोभनाः richly decorated, कुम्भकाराश्च potters, ये शस्त्रोपजीविनः those who live on making weapons (weaponsmiths), सूत्रकर्मकृतश्चैव those who work with thread (weavers), मयूरकाः makers of adornments with peacock feathers, क्राकचिकाः those who work with saws (sawyers), रोचकाः makers of artificial ornaments, वेधकाः perforators (of shells and ornaments), तथा also, दन्तकाराः artists who work with ivory, सुधाकाराः those engaged in whitewashing, तथा also, गन्धोपजीविनः subsisting on selling fragrant essences (perfumers), प्रख्याताः renowned, सुवर्णकाराः goldsmiths, तथा also, कम्भलधावकाः blanketcleaners, स्नापकोष्णोदकाः hot bath attendants, वैद्याः physicians, शौण्डिकाः distillers and sellers of spiritual liquor (vintners), धूपकाः incense merchants, रजकाः washermen, तुन्नवायाश्च those who do sewing work (tailors), ग्रामघोषमहत्तराः important people in villages and hamlets where cowherds reside, स्त्रीभिः सह along with women, शैलूषाः actors, तथा similarly, कैवर्तकाः fishermen, ययुः went.

text: मायूरकाः क्राकचिका रोचका वेधकाः तथा । दन्त काराः सुधा काराः तथा गन्ध उपजीविनः ॥२-८३-१३॥
translation: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.
word_meanings: ये those, केचित् some others, मणिकाराः gempolishers, शोभनाः richly decorated, कुम्भकाराश्च potters, ये शस्त्रोपजीविनः those who live on making weapons (weaponsmiths), सूत्रकर्मकृतश्चैव those who work with thread (weavers), मयूरकाः makers of adornments with peacock feathers, क्राकचिकाः those who work with saws (sawyers), रोचकाः makers of artificial ornaments, वेधकाः perforators (of shells and ornaments), तथा also, दन्तकाराः artists who work with ivory, सुधाकाराः those engaged in whitewashing, तथा also, गन्धोपजीविनः subsisting on selling fragrant essences (perfumers), प्रख्याताः renowned, सुवर्णकाराः goldsmiths, तथा also, कम्भलधावकाः blanketcleaners, स्नापकोष्णोदकाः hot bath attendants, वैद्याः physicians, शौण्डिकाः distillers and sellers of spiritual liquor (vintners), धूपकाः incense merchants, रजकाः washermen, तुन्नवायाश्च those who do sewing work (tailors), ग्रामघोषमहत्तराः important people in villages and hamlets where cowherds reside, स्त्रीभिः सह along with women, शैलूषाः actors, तथा similarly, कैवर्तकाः fishermen, ययुः went.

text: सुवर्ण काराः प्रख्याताः तथा कम्बल धावकाः । स्नापक आच्चादका वैद्या धूपकाः शौण्डिकाः तथा ॥२-८३-१४॥
translation: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.
word_meanings: ये those, केचित् some others, मणिकाराः gempolishers, शोभनाः richly decorated, कुम्भकाराश्च potters, ये शस्त्रोपजीविनः those who live on making weapons (weaponsmiths), सूत्रकर्मकृतश्चैव those who work with thread (weavers), मयूरकाः makers of adornments with peacock feathers, क्राकचिकाः those who work with saws (sawyers), रोचकाः makers of artificial ornaments, वेधकाः perforators (of shells and ornaments), तथा also, दन्तकाराः artists who work with ivory, सुधाकाराः those engaged in whitewashing, तथा also, गन्धोपजीविनः subsisting on selling fragrant essences (perfumers), प्रख्याताः renowned, सुवर्णकाराः goldsmiths, तथा also, कम्भलधावकाः blanketcleaners, स्नापकोष्णोदकाः hot bath attendants, वैद्याः physicians, शौण्डिकाः distillers and sellers of spiritual liquor (vintners), धूपकाः incense merchants, रजकाः washermen, तुन्नवायाश्च those who do sewing work (tailors), ग्रामघोषमहत्तराः important people in villages and hamlets where cowherds reside, स्त्रीभिः सह along with women, शैलूषाः actors, तथा similarly, कैवर्तकाः fishermen, ययुः went.

text: रजकाः तुन्न वायाः च ग्राम घोष महत्तराः । शैलूषाः च सह स्त्रीभिर् यान्ति कैवर्तकाः तथा ॥२-८३-१५॥
translation: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.
word_meanings: ये those, केचित् some others, मणिकाराः gempolishers, शोभनाः richly decorated, कुम्भकाराश्च potters, ये शस्त्रोपजीविनः those who live on making weapons (weaponsmiths), सूत्रकर्मकृतश्चैव those who work with thread (weavers), मयूरकाः makers of adornments with peacock feathers, क्राकचिकाः those who work with saws (sawyers), रोचकाः makers of artificial ornaments, वेधकाः perforators (of shells and ornaments), तथा also, दन्तकाराः artists who work with ivory, सुधाकाराः those engaged in whitewashing, तथा also, गन्धोपजीविनः subsisting on selling fragrant essences (perfumers), प्रख्याताः renowned, सुवर्णकाराः goldsmiths, तथा also, कम्भलधावकाः blanketcleaners, स्नापकोष्णोदकाः hot bath attendants, वैद्याः physicians, शौण्डिकाः distillers and sellers of spiritual liquor (vintners), धूपकाः incense merchants, रजकाः washermen, तुन्नवायाश्च those who do sewing work (tailors), ग्रामघोषमहत्तराः important people in villages and hamlets where cowherds reside, स्त्रीभिः सह along with women, शैलूषाः actors, तथा similarly, कैवर्तकाः fishermen, ययुः went.

text: समाहिता वेदविदो ब्राह्मणा वृत्त सम्मताः । गो रथैः भरतम् यान्तम् अनुजग्मुः सहस्रशः ॥२-८३-१६॥
translation: Brahmins learned in the Vedas and renowned for their virtuous conduct followed Bharta in their thousands on bullock carts with composed minds.
word_meanings: समाहिताः with composed mind, वृत्तसम्मताः renowned for their virtuous conduct, वेदविदः learned in the Vedas, सहस्रशः in thousands, ब्राह्मणाः brahmins, यान्तम् departing, भरतम् Bharata, गोरथैः on bullock carts, अनुजग्मुः followed.

text: सुवेषाः शुद्ध वसनाः ताम्र मृष्ट अनुलेपनाः । सर्वे ते विविधैः यानैः शनैः भरतम् अन्वयुः ॥२-८३-१७॥
translation: Dressed well in clean clothes and anointed with pure red sandalpaste, they all slowly followed Bharata, mounting on various vehicles.
word_meanings: सुवेषाः welldressed, शुद्धवसनाः in clean clothing, ताम्रमृष्टानुलेपनाः anointed with pure red sandalpaste, ते सर्वे all those, विविधैः various, यानैः on vehicles, शनैः slowly, भरतम् Bharata, अन्वयुः followed.

text: प्रहृष्ट मुदिता सेना सान्वयात् कैकयी सुतम् । भ्रातुरानयने यान्तम् भरतम् भ्रातृवत्सलम् ॥२-८३-१८॥
translation: The army, overwhelmed with joy and cheer followed the devoted brother Bharata who had set out to bring back Rama.
word_meanings: प्रहृष्टमुदिता overwhelmed with joy and cheer, सा सेना that army, भ्रातुः brother's, आनयने to bring back, यान्तम् set out, कैकयीसुतम् Kaikeyi's son (Bharata), भ्रातृवत्सलम् to his brother, Rama, भरतम् Bharata, अन्वयात् followed.

text: ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानम् रथम् यानाश्वकुञ्जरैः । समासेदुस्ततो गङ्गाम् शृङ्गिबेरपुरम् प्रति ॥२-८३-१९॥
translation: After travelling a long distance on chariots, carriages, horses and elephants, they reached the river Ganga close to Srngiberapura, a country ruled vigilantly by Rama's friend, the valiant Guha who lived there along with his relatives.
word_meanings: ते they, रथयानाश्वकुञ्जरैः on chariots, carriages, horses and elephants, दूरम् a great distance, अध्वानम् the path, गत्वा having travelled, ततः thereafter, रामसखः Rama's friend, वीरः valiant, गुहः Guha, ज्ञातिगणैः with relatives, वृतः surrounded by, तम् that, देशम् country, अप्रमादेन vigilantly, परिपालयन् ruling, यत्र where, निवसति living, शृङ्गीबेरपुरं प्रति near Srngiberapura, गङ्गाम् Ganges, समासेदुः reached.

text: यत्र रामसखो वीरो गुहो ज्ञातिगणैर्वृतः । निवसत्यप्रमादेन देशम् तम् परिपालयन् ॥२-८३-२०॥
translation: After travelling a long distance on chariots, carriages, horses and elephants, they reached the river Ganga close to Srngiberapura, a country ruled vigilantly by Rama's friend, the valiant Guha who lived there along with his relatives.
word_meanings: ते they, रथयानाश्वकुञ्जरैः on chariots, carriages, horses and elephants, दूरम् a great distance, अध्वानम् the path, गत्वा having travelled, ततः thereafter, रामसखः Rama's friend, वीरः valiant, गुहः Guha, ज्ञातिगणैः with relatives, वृतः surrounded by, तम् that, देशम् country, अप्रमादेन vigilantly, परिपालयन् ruling, यत्र where, निवसति living, शृङ्गीबेरपुरं प्रति near Srngiberapura, गङ्गाम् Ganges, समासेदुः reached.

text: उपेत्य तीरम् गङ्गायाश्चक्रमाकैरलङ्कतम् । व्यवतिष्ठत सा सेना भरतस्य अनुयायिनी ॥२-८३-२१॥
translation: The army following Bharata reached the bank of the river Ganga, graced by chakravakas (ruddy geese) and halted there.
word_meanings: भरतस्य अनुयायिनी following Bharata, सा सेना that army, चक्रवाकैः with chakravakas (the ruddy geese), अलङ्कृतम् graced, गङ्गायाः river Ganga's, तीरम् bank, उपेत्य having reached, व्यवातिष्ठत halted there.

text: निरीक्ष्य अनुगताम् सेनाम् ताम् च गन्गाम् शिव उदकाम् । भरतः सचिवान् सर्वान् अब्रवीद् वाक्य कोविदः ॥२-८३-२२॥
translation: As he beheld the army following him and the river Ganga of sacred waters in front of him, Bharata who was proficient in speech said to his ministers:
word_meanings: अनुगताम् following, सेनाम् army, शिवोदकाम् having sacred waters, तां गङ्गां च that river Ganga, निरीक्षय having gazed at, वाक्यकोविदः proficient in speech, भरतः Bharata, सर्वान् all, सचिवान् to ministers, अब्रवीत् said.

text: निवेशयत मे सैन्यम् अभिप्रायेण सर्वशः । विश्रान्तः प्रतरिष्यामः श्वैदानीम् महा नदीम् ॥२-८३-२३॥
translation: You may, according to your convenience, halt the army anywhere here and, after taking rest (for the night), we shall cross the river Ganga tomorrow.
word_meanings: मे सैन्यम् my army, अभिप्रायेण according to their desires, सर्वतः all over, निवेशयत you may halt, इदानीम् now, विश्रान्ताः having taken rest, नदीम् river, श्वः tomorrow, प्रतरिष्यामः will cross.

text: दातुम् च तावद् इच्चामि स्वर् गतस्य मही पतेः । और्ध्वदेह निमित्त अर्थम् अवतीर्य उदकम् नदीम् ॥२-८३-२४॥
translation: Meanwhile, I shall get into this river and offer libations with water to the departed king for the good of his life in the other world.
word_meanings: नदीम् river, अवतीर्य descending, स्वर्गतस्य to the departed, महीपतेः king's, और्ध्वदेहनिमित्तार्थम् for the good of his life in the other world, उदकम् libations with water, दातुम् च to offer, इच्छामि तावत् I wish.

text: तस्य एवम् ब्रुवतः अमात्याः तथा इति उक्त्वा समाहिताः । न्यवेशयम्स् तामः चन्देन स्वेन स्वेन पृथक् पृथक् ॥२-८३-२५॥
translation: While he (Bharata's) was speaking this way, all the ministers assented by saying 'Be it so' and made arrangement for their troops to rest separately according to their pleasure.
word_meanings: तस्य his (Bharata's), एवम् in this way, ब्रुवतः while saying, अमात्याः ministers, तथेति 'be it so', उक्त्वा saying, समाहिताः with composed minds, ताम् they, स्वेन स्वेन each of their, छन्देन with pleasure, पृथक् पृथक् separately न्यवेशयन् rested.

text: निवेश्य गन्गाम् अनु ताम् महा नदीम् । चमूम् विधानैः परिबर्ह शोभिनीम् । उवास रामस्य तदा महात्मनो । विचिन्तयानो भरतः निवर्तनम् ॥२-८३-२६॥
translation: The army encamped by Bharata looked splendid with royal insigaia. After making necessary arrangements for the army on the bank of the mighty river Ganga and pondering over the means of bringing back the magnanimous Rama, Bharata stayed. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्र्यशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightythird sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, परिबर्हशोभिनीम् looking splendid with their royal insignia, चमूम् army, ताम् that, महानदीम् mighty river, गङ्गाम् अनु following Ganga, विधानैः with adequate arrangements, निवेश्य encamping, तदा then, महात्मनः magnanimous, रामस्य Rama's, निवर्तनम् to bring back, विचिन्तयानः pondering, उवास stayed.

text: ततः निविष्टाम् ध्वजिनीम् गन्गाम् अन्वाश्रिताम् नदीम् । निषाद राजो दृष्ट्वा एव ज्ञातीन् सम्त्वरितः अब्रवीत् ॥२-८४-१॥
translation: Guha, king of the nishadas, observed the bannered army encamped all along the bank of the river Ganga, hurried off and said to his kinsmen:
word_meanings: ततः then, निषादराजः king of the nishadas (Guha), गङ्गां नदीम् river Ganga, अन्वाश्रिताम् all along the bank, निविष्टाम् encamped, ध्वजिनीम् the bannered army, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing, सन्त्वरितः hurriedly, ज्ञातीन् to relatives, अब्रवीत् said.

text: महती इयम् अतः सेना सागर आभा प्रदृश्यते । न अस्य अन्तम् अवगच्चामि मनसा अपि विचिन्तयन् ॥२-८४-२॥
translation: Here is an army as vast as the ocean, and I am unable to comprehend its magnitude even mentally.
word_meanings: इतः this side, सागराभा looking like an ocean, इयम् this, महती vast, सेना army, प्रदृश्यते appearing, मनसा in my mind, विचिन्तयन्नपि even by thinking, अस्याः this army's, अन्तम् end, नाधिगच्छामि I am not able to reach.

text: यथा तु खलु दुर्भद्धिर्भरतः स्वयमागतः । स एष हि महा कायः कोविदार ध्वजो रथे ॥२-८४-३॥
translation: It appears that the evilminded Bharata himself has come here. The emblem of a huge kovidara (pomegranate) tree is seen on his chariot.
word_meanings: दुर्बुद्धि: evilminded, भरतः Bharata, स्वयम् himself, यथा तु आगतः खलु has come it appears, सः that, महाकायः of huge size, कोविदारध्वजः having the emblem of kovidara (promegranate) tree, एषः this one, रथे हि on the chariot.

text: बन्धयिष्यति वा दाशान् अथ वा अस्मान् वधिष्यति । अथ दाशरथिम् रामम् पित्रा राज्यात् विवासितम् ॥२-८४-४॥
translation: Could it be that Bharata, son of Kaikeyi, has come here to bind us with the cords or to slay us? Or is he marching forward with the intention of taking possession of a prosperous, rare kingdom by slaying Rama who has been banished by his father:
word_meanings: कैकयीपुत्रः Kaikeyi's son, भरतः Bharata, दाशान् fishermen, बन्धयिष्यति is going to bind us with cords?, अथवा or, अस्मान् us, वधिष्यति will slay?, अथ or, तस्य राज्ञः that king's, सम्पन्नाम् prosperous, सुदुर्लभाम् not easily obtainable, श्रियम् wealth, अन्विच्छन् wishing, पित्रा by father, राज्यात् from kingdom, विवासितम् banished, दाशरथिम् son of Dasaratha, रामम् to Rama, हन्तुम् to slay, समधिगच्छति is he marching forward?

text: सम्पन्नाम् श्रियमन्विच्चम्स्तस्य राज्ञः सुदुर्लभाम् । भरतः कैकेयी पुत्रः हन्तुम् समधिगच्चति ॥२-८४-५॥
translation: Could it be that Bharata, son of Kaikeyi, has come here to bind us with the cords or to slay us? Or is he marching forward with the intention of taking possession of a prosperous, rare kingdom by slaying Rama who has been banished by his father:
word_meanings: कैकयीपुत्रः Kaikeyi's son, भरतः Bharata, दाशान् fishermen, बन्धयिष्यति is going to bind us with cords?, अथवा or, अस्मान् us, वधिष्यति will slay?, अथ or, तस्य राज्ञः that king's, सम्पन्नाम् prosperous, सुदुर्लभाम् not easily obtainable, श्रियम् wealth, अन्विच्छन् wishing, पित्रा by father, राज्यात् from kingdom, विवासितम् banished, दाशरथिम् son of Dasaratha, रामम् to Rama, हन्तुम् to slay, समधिगच्छति is he marching forward?

text: भर्ता चैव सखा चैव रामः दाशरथिर् मम । तस्य अर्थ कामाः सम्नद्धा गन्गा अनूपे अत्र तिष्ठत ॥२-८४-६॥
translation: Rama, son of Dasaratha, is not only my master but also my friend. Therefore, to safeguard his interests remain stationed here on the bank of the river Ganga.
word_meanings: दाशरथिः son of Dasaratha, रामः Rama, मम to me, भर्ता चैव is my master, सखाचैव friend too, तस्य his, अर्थकामाः wealth and desires, गङ्गाऽनूपे on the bank of river Ganga, प्रतिष्ठत remain stationed.

text: तिष्ठन्तु सर्व दाशाः च गन्गाम् अन्वाश्रिता नदीम् । बल युक्ता नदी रक्षा माम्स मूल फल अशनाः ॥२-८४-७॥
translation: Let all the fishermen, who live on meat, roots and fruits and protect the river, stay here with the troops by taking up positions along the banks of the river Ganga.
word_meanings: मांसमूलफलाशनाः living on meat, roots and fruits, नदीरक्षाः protectors of the river, सर्वे all, दाशाश्च fishermen, बलयुक्ताः with your troops, गङ्गां नदीम् river Ganga, अन्वाश्रिताः following and taking up your positions, तिष्ठन्तु stay here.

text: नावाम् शतानाम् पन्चानाम् कैवर्तानाम् शतम् शतम् । सम्नद्धानाम् तथा यूनाम् तिष्ठन्तु अत्यभ्यचोदयत् ॥२-८४-८॥
translation: Let five hundred boats, each manned by a hundred young fishermen fully equipped, be in readiness he exhorted them.
word_meanings: पञ्चानाम् five, शतानाम् hundred, नावाम् boats, सन्नद्धानाम् fully equipped, तथा also, यूनाम् youths, कैवर्तानाम् fishermen, शतं शतम् one hundred in each, तिष्ठन्तु stand, इति like that, अभ्यचोदयत् exhorted.

text: यदा तुष्टः तु भरतः रामस्य इह भविष्यति । सा इयम् स्वस्तिमयी सेना गन्गाम् अद्य तरिष्यति ॥२-८४-९॥
translation: Should it happen that Bharata is not illdisposed toward Rama, the army will safe cross the river Ganga today itself.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, इह here, रामस्य toward Rama, अदुष्टः not illdisposed, यदा तु भविष्यति when it be proved, सा इयम् that this, सेना army, अद्य today, स्वस्तिमती in safety, गङ्गाम् Ganga, तरिष्यति will cross over.

text: इति उक्त्वा उपायनम् गृह्य मत्स्य माम्स मधूनि च । अभिचक्राम भरतम् निषाद अधिपतिर् गुहः ॥२-८४-१०॥
translation: Having spoken thus, Guha, lord of the nishadas, approached Bharata, taking with him fish, meat and wine as offerings.
word_meanings: निषादाधिपतिः गुहः overlord of the nishadas, Guha, इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, मत्स्यमांसमधूनि fish, meat and wine, उपायनम् as gifts, गृह्य holding, भरतम् to Bharata, अभिचक्राम approached.

text: तम् आयान्तम् तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य सूत पुत्रः प्रतापवान् । भरताय आचचक्षे अथ विनयज्ञो विनीतवत् ॥२-८४-११॥
translation: The valiant Sumantra, conversant with ways of modesty, observed Guha approaching them and humbly informed Bharata.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, प्रतापवान् valiant, विनयज्ञः conversant with modesty, सूतपुत्रः son of charioteer, Sumantra, आयान्तम् approaching, तम् him, सम्प्रेक्ष्य having seen, विनीतवत् humbly, भरताय to Bharata, आचचक्षे informed.

text: एष ज्ञाति सहस्रेण स्थपतिः परिवारितः । कुशलो दण्डक अरण्ये वृद्धो भ्रातुः च ते सखा ॥२-८४-१२॥
translation: Guha who has come here surrounded by too many thousands of his relations is fully acquainted with the Dandaka forest. He is an aged man and a friend of your brother said Sumatra.
word_meanings: ज्ञातिसहस्रेण with thousands of relations, परिवारितः surrounded by, एषः स्थपतिः this lord, दण्डकारण्ये in the Dandaka forest, कुशलः skilled, वृद्धः aged one, ते your, भ्रातुः brother's, सखा च friend also.

text: तस्मात् पश्यतु काकुत्स्थ त्वाम् निषाद अधिपो गुहः । असम्शयम् विजानीते यत्र तौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥२-८४-१३॥
translation: O scion of the Kakusthas (Bharata) therefore, give audience to the overlord of the nishadas, Guha, who undoubtedly knows the whereabouts of Rama and Lakshmana.
word_meanings: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, तस्मात् therefore, निषादाधिपः overlord of Nishadas, गुहः Guha, त्वाम् you, पश्यतु let him see, तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ both Rama and Lakshmana, यत्र where, असंशयम् undoubtedly, विजानीते he will know.

text: एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा सुमन्त्रात् भरतः शुभम् । उवाच वचनम् शीघ्रम् गुहः पश्यतु माम् इति ॥२-८४-१४॥
translation: On hearing these auspicious words of Sumantra, Bharata said Let Guha see me at once.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, सुमन्त्रात् from Sumantra, एतत् शुभम् these auspicious, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, गुहः Guha, शीघ्रम् at once, माम् me, पश्यतु let him see, इति these, वचनम् word, उवाच said.

text: लब्ध्वा अभ्यनुज्ञाम् सम्हृष्टः ज्ञातिभिः परिवारितः । आगम्य भरतम् प्रह्वो गुहो वचनम् अब्रवीइत् ॥२-८४-१५॥
translation: Having obtaind the permission, a delighted Guha, escorted by his relatives, approached Bharata and humbly said:
word_meanings: गुहः Guha, अभ्यनुज्ञाम् permission, लब्ध्वा having obtained, संहृष्टः delighted, ज्ञातिभिः relatives, परिवारितः escorted by, आगम्य having approached, प्रह्वः bowing humbly, भरतम् to Bharata, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: निष्कुटः चैव देशो अयम् वन्चिताः च अपि ते वयम् । निवेदयामः ते सर्वे स्वके दाश कुले वस ॥२-८४-१६॥
translation: This country is like a pleasuregarden at the backyard of your palace. All of us are subordinate to you and we solicit you to stay in the house of this servant of yours.
word_meanings: अयम् this, देशः country, ते your, निष्कुटः is like a pleasuregarden behind your house, वयम् we, वञ्चिताश्चापि are subordinate, ते सर्वे all of us, निवेदयामः soliciting, दासकुले in the house of this servant, वस stay.

text: अस्ति मूलम् फलम् चैव निषादैः समुपाहृतम् । आर्द्रम् च माम्सम् शुष्कम् च वन्यम् च उच्च अवचम् महत् ॥२-८४-१७॥
translation: Here are roots, fruits and a great variety of forest produce, fresh and dried meat brought by the nishadas.
word_meanings: निषादैः by nishadas, समुपाहृतम् have been brought, मूलम् root, फलं चैव fruits also, वन्यम् the forest produce, आर्द्रम् fresh, शुष्कं च dried, उच्चावचम् of great variety, महत् best, मांसं च अस्ति meat are here.

text: आशम्से स्वाशिता सेना वत्स्यति इमाम् विभावरीम् । अर्चितः विविधैः कामैः श्वः ससैन्यो गमिष्यसि ॥२-८४-१८॥
translation: We hope your army having refreshed themselves will spend the night here. With our hospitality extended, you can proceed tomorrow. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुरशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightyfourth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सेना army, स्वाशिता refreshed, इमाम् विभावरीम् this night, वत्स्यति will spend, आशंसे I hope, विविधैः by various, कामैः by our hospitality, अर्चितः treated, श्वः tomorrow, ससैन्यः with army, गमिष्यसि will go.

text: एवम् उक्तः तु भरतः निषाद अधिपतिम् गुहम् । प्रत्युवाच महा प्राज्ञो वाक्यम् हेतु अर्थ सम्हितम् ॥२-८५-१॥
translation: When thus spoken to, Bharata, a great intellectual, replied to Guha with these well thought out and meaningful words.
word_meanings: एवम् thus, उक्तः having spoken, महाप्राज्ञः great intellectual, भरतः Bharata, निषादाधिपतिम् the overlord of the nishadas, गुहम् Guha, हेत्वर्थसंहितम् in well thought out and significant, वाक्यम् words, प्रत्युवाच replied.

text: ऊर्जितः खलु ते कामः कृतः मम गुरोह् सखे । यो मे त्वम् ईदृशीम् सेनाम् एको अभ्यर्चितुम् इच्चसि ॥२-८५-२॥
translation: O dear friend of my elder brother, your desire to extend hospitality to this large army all alone is indeed noble.
word_meanings: मम my, गुरोः elder brother's, सखे friend, यः त्वम् you, एकः alone, ईदृशीम् this large, सेनाम् army, अभ्यर्चितुम् to extend hospitality, इच्छसि want, ते your, कृतः done, कामः desire, ऊर्जितः खलु is indeed great.

text: इति उक्त्वा तु महा तेजा गुहम् वचनम् उत्तमम् । अब्रवीद् भरतः श्रीमान् निषाद अधिपतिम् पुनः ॥२-८५-३॥
translation: Having spoken to Guha courteously, the majestic, radiant Bharata continued:
word_meanings: महातेजाः of great radiance, श्रीमान् the majestic one, भरतः Bharata, गुहम् to Guha, उत्तमम् courteous, वचनम् word, उक्त्वा तु having said, पुनः again, निषादाधिपतिम् addressing king of the nishadas, अब्रवीत् said.

text: कतरेण गमिष्यामि भरद्वाज आश्रमम् गुह । गहनो अयम् भृशम् देशो गन्गा अनूपो दुरत्ययः ॥२-८५-४॥
translation: O Guha this region of Ganga with its dense forest is very difficult to cross. How can I reach the hermitage of Bharadwaja?
word_meanings: गुह Guha, कतरेण by which path, भरद्वाजाश्रमम् to the hermitage of Bharadwaja, गमिष्यामि can I go, गङ्गनूपः marshy banks of Ganga, अयम् this, देशः region, भृशम् highly, गहनः is dense, दुरत्ययः very difficult to traverse.

text: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राज पुत्रस्य धीमतः । अब्रवीत् प्रान्जलिर् वाक्यम् गुहो गहन गोचरः ॥२-८५-५॥
translation: When he heard those words of the sagacious Bharata, Guha the forest ranger answered him reverentially with folded palms.
word_meanings: धीमतः of the sagacious, तस्य राजपुत्रस्य of that king's son, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, गहनगोचरः one who ranges in the dense forest, गुहः Guha, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms (in reverence), वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: दाशाः तु अनुगमिष्यन्ति धन्विनः सुसमाहिताः । अहम् च अनुगमिष्यामि राज पुत्र महा यशः ॥२-८५-६॥
translation: O prince of great renown I shall follow you, wellprepared with these fishermen, armed with bows.
word_meanings: महायशः a man of great renown, राजपुत्रः king's son, धन्विनः armed with bows, दाशाः fishermen, सुसमाहिताः wellprepared, त्वा you, अनुगमिष्यन्ति shall follow, अहम् I, त्वा you, अनुगमिष्यामि shall follow.

text: कच्चिन् न दुष्टः व्रजसि रामस्य अक्लिष्ट कर्मणः । इयम् ते महती सेना शन्काम् जनयति इव मे ॥२-८५-७॥
translation: Are you not going to that place with the evil intention of causing harm to Rama of unwearied actions? This large army of yours arouses doubts in me.
word_meanings: अक्लिष्टकर्मणः of unwearied actions, रामस्य towards Rama, दुष्टः bearing illwill, न व्रजसि कच्छित् are you not going to that place?, महती large, ते your, इयं सेना this army, मे to me, शङ्काम् doubt, जनयतीव as though arouses.

text: तम् एवम् अभिभाषन्तम् आकाशैव निर्मलः । भरतः श्लक्ष्णया वाचा गुहम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-८५-८॥
translation: When he heard Guha thus speaking, Bharata who was as tranquil as the sky, said to him in a gentle voice.
word_meanings: आकाशः इव like the sky, निर्मलः tranquil, भरतः Bharata, एवम् thus, अभिभाषन्तम् talking, तं गुहम् addressing Guha, श्लक्ष्णया in gentle, वाचा voice, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: मा भूत् स कालो यत् कष्टम् न माम् शन्कितुम् अर्हसि । राघवः स हि मे भ्राता ज्येष्ठः पितृ समः मम ॥२-८५-९॥
translation: That calmitous time will never come (again). You should not suspect me. I look upon Rama, my eldest brother, as my father.
word_meanings: यत् which, कष्टम् calamity, सः कालः that time, मा भूत् shall not come, माम् to me, शङ्कितुम् to suspect, नार्हसि you should not, मे my, ज्येष्ठः eldest, भ्राता brother, सः राघवः that Rama, पितृसमः is equal to my father, मतः हि he has been held in high esteem.

text: तम् निवर्तयितुम् यामि काकुत्स्थम् वन वासिनम् । बुद्धिर् अन्या न ते कार्या गुह सत्यम् ब्रवीमि ते ॥२-८५-१०॥
translation: I am going to bring back that scion of the kakutsthas (Rama) who resides in the forest. O Guha, do not entertain any other thought. I am tellng you the truth.
word_meanings: वनवासिनम् residing in the forest, तम् काकुत्स्थम् to that scion of the Kakutsthas, निवर्तयितुम् to bring back, यामि I am going, गुह O Guha, ते to you, अन्या other, बुद्धि: thought, न कार्या not to be entertained, ते to you, सत्यम् truth, ब्रवीमि I am telling.

text: स तु सम्हृष्ट वदनः श्रुत्वा भरत भाषितम् । पुनर् एव अब्रवीद् वाक्यम् भरतम् प्रति हर्षितः ॥२-८५-११॥
translation: When he heard those words of Bharata, Guha was delighted and his face beamed with joy as he said to Bharata:
word_meanings: भरतभाषितम् Bharata's words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, संहृष्टवदनः one whose is face beaming with joy, सः तु that Guha, हर्षितः delighted, भरतं प्रति looking at Bharata, पुनरेव once again, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: धन्यः त्वम् न त्वया तुल्यम् पश्यामि जगती तले । अयत्नात् आगतम् राज्यम् यः त्वम् त्यक्तुम् इह इच्चसि ॥२-८५-१२॥
translation: Blessed indeed you are as you desire to renounce the kingdom that has come to you effortlessly. I see none equal to you on this earth.
word_meanings: यः त्वम् such a man as you are, इह now, अयत्नात् effortlessly, आगतम् arrived, राज्यम् kingdom, त्यक्तुम् to renounce, इच्छसि wish, त्वम् you, धन्यः are blessed, त्वया your, तुल्यम् equal, जगतीतले on this earth, न पश्यामि I do not see.

text: शाश्वती खलु ते कीर्तिर् लोकान् अनुचरिष्यति । यः त्वम् कृच्च्र गतम् रामम् प्रत्यानयितुम् इच्चसि ॥२-८५-१३॥
translation: You desire to bring back Rama who is in great difficulty. This everlasting fame of yours will spread all over the world.
word_meanings: यः त्वम् you, कृच्छ्रगतम् who is in great difficulty, रामम् Rama, प्रत्यानयितुम् to bring back, इच्छसि desire, ते your, शाश्वती everlasting, कीर्तिः fame, लोकान् in this world, अनुचरिष्यति will spread.

text: एवम् सम्भाषमाणस्य गुहस्य भरतम् तदा । बभौ नष्ट प्रभः सूर्यो रजनी च अभ्यवर्तत ॥२-८५-१४॥
translation: As Guha was thus conversing with Bharata, the rays of the Sun diminished and the night set in.
