text: अथोवाच भरद्वाजो भरतं प्रहसन्निव । जाने त्वां प्रीतिसंयुक्तं तुष्येस्त्वं येन केनचित् ॥२-९१-३॥
translation: Bharadwaja then said to Bharata with a gentle smile, I know you are full of love and content with whatever is offered you.
word_meanings: अथ then, भरद्वाजः Bharadwaja, प्रहसन्निव with a gentle smile, भरतम् to Bharata, उवाच said, त्वाम् you, प्रीतिसंयुक्तम् are full of love, जाने I know, त्वाम् you, येन केन चित् with whatever offered, तुष्येः are contented.

text: सेनायास्तु तवैतस्या: कर्तुमिच्छामि भोजनम् । मम प्रीतिर्यथारूपा त्वमर्हो मनुजाधिप ॥२-९१-४॥
translation: O Bharata, the best of men, I want to treat your army with food. This will please me and I hope you will act accordingly.
word_meanings: मनुजर्षभ best among mortals, तव your, एतस्याः for all the, सेनायाः the army men, भोजनम् food, कर्तुम् I am to offer, इच्छामि wish, मम my, प्रीतिः pleasure, यथा रूपा in whatever way, तथा accordingly, अर्हः worthy of.

text: किमर्थं चापि निक्षिप्य दूरे बलमिहागत: । कस्मान्नेहोपयातोसि सबल: पुरुषर्षभ ॥२-९१-५॥
translation: Why did you, O Bharata, the best of men, station your army at a distance before coming here? Could you not approach me along with your army?
word_meanings: पुरुषर्षभः best of men, किमर्थम् for what reason, बलम् army, दूरे at a distance, निक्षिप्य having stationed, इह here, आगतः you have come, इह here, सबलः with your army, कस्मात् why, न उपयातः असि not come with.

text: भरत: प्रत्युवाचेदं प्राञ्जलिस्तं तपोधनम् । ससैन्यो नोपयातो ऽस्मि भगवन् भगवद्भयात् ॥२-९१-६॥
translation: With folded palms (in reverence), Bharata said to sage Bharadwaja whose penance was his wealth: I did not approach you with the army for fear of you, O venerable one.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms (in reverence), तपोधनम् who has benance as his wealth (sage), तम् him, इदम् this, प्रत्युवाच replied, भगवन् O venerable one, भगवद्भयात् for fear of you, ससैन्यः with army, नोपयातोऽस्मि did not approach.

text: राज्ञा च भगवन् नित्यं राजपुत्रेण वा सदा । यत्नत: परिहर्त्तव्या विषयेषु तपस्विन: ॥२-९१-७॥
translation: O venerable one a king or a prince ought to intentionally avoid those places occupied by ascetics.
word_meanings: भगवन् O venerable one, राज्ञा by the king, राजपुत्रेण वा or by a king's son, विषयेषु in places, सदा always, तपस्विनः of ascetics, यत्नतः intentionally, परिहर्तव्याः should be avoided.

text: वाजिमुख्या मनुष्याश्च मत्ताश्च वरवारणा: । प्रच्छाद्य भगवन् भूमिं महतीमनुयान्ति माम् ॥२-९१-८॥
translation: O venerable sage spirited horses, men and mighty rutting elephants follow me covering a wide expanse of land.
word_meanings: भगवन् O Lord, वाजिमुख्याः spirited horses, मनुष्याश्च men also, मत्ताः rutting, वरवारणाश्च mighty elephants, महतीम् wide, भूमिम् earth, प्रच्छाद्य spread over, माम् me, अनुयान्ति are following.

text: ते वृक्षानुदकं भूमिमाश्रमेषूटजांस्तथा । न हिंस्युरिति तेनाहमेक एव समागत: ॥२-९१-९॥
translation: Lest the army should damage the huts, trees, land, and defile the water in the ashram, I came here alone.
word_meanings: ते they, आश्रमेषु in ashrams, वृक्षान् trees, उदकम् water, भूमिम् land, तथा also, उटजान् huts, न हिंस्युः shall not damage, इति so, तेन therefore, अहम् I, एक एव alone, समागतः came here.

text: आनीयतामित: सेनेत्याज्ञप्त: परमर्षिणा । ततस्तु चक्रे भरत: सेनाया: समुपागमम् ॥२-९१-१०॥
translation: Thus commanded the great ascetic, 'Let the army be brought here'. Accordingly, Bharata ordered the army to come.
word_meanings: ततस्तु all, सेना army, इतः here, अनीयताम् be brought, इति thus, परमर्षिणा great sage, आज्ञप्तः having been commanded, भरतः Bharata, सेनायाः the army's, समुपागमम् to get, चक्रे made.

text: अग्निशालां प्रविश्याथ पीत्वाप: परिमृज्य च । आतिथ्यस्य क्रियाहेतोर्विश्वकर्माणमाह्वयत् ॥२-९१-११॥
translation: Then Bharadwaja entered the fire sanctuary, sipped water and washed his hands with water and invoked Visvakarma to provide hospitality.
word_meanings: अथ then, अग्निशालाम् fire sanctuary, प्रविश्य entered, आपः water, पीत्वा sipped, परिमृज्य च washing his hands, आतिथ्यस्य for the hospitality, क्रियाहेतोः to provide, विश्वकर्माणम् to Visvakarma, आह्वयत् invoked.

text: आह्वये विश्वकर्माणमहं त्वष्टारमेव च । आतिथ्यं कर्तुमिच्छामि तत्र मे संविधीयताम् ॥२-९१-१२॥
translation: I intend to provide hospitality for which I am invoking Visvakarma and Tvastara who builds houses. Let adequate arrangements be made.
word_meanings: अहम् I, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, कर्तुम् to perform, इच्छामि am intending, त्वष्टारम् एव च even Tvastara who builds homes, विश्वकर्माणम् Visvakarma, आह्वये I am invoking, तत्र in this matter, मे to me, संविधीयताम् things may be arranged.

text: आह्वये लोकपालांस्त्रीन् देवान् शक्रमुखांस्तथा । आतिथ्यं कर्तुमिच्छामि तत्र मे संविधीयताम् ॥२-९१-१३॥
translation: I invoke the three deities, guardians of the four quarters headed by Indra to extend hospitality (to Bharata). Let them make adequate arrangements in this regard.
word_meanings: तथा like that, शक्रमुखान् Indra in the forefront, लोकपालान् guardians of the (four) quarters, त्रीन् देवान् three deities, आह्वये I am invoking, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, कर्तुम् to provide, इच्छामि desiring तत्र in this matter, मे to me, संविधीयताम् arrangements be made.

text: प्राक्स्रोतसश्च या नद्य: प्रत्यक्स्रोतस एव च । पृथिव्यामन्तरिक्षे च समायान्त्वद्य सर्वश: ॥२-९१-१४॥
translation: Let the rivers flowing towards the east, and the west, flowing on the earth and in the sky, flowing everywhere reach here and now.
word_meanings: या नद्यः those revers, पृथिव्याम् on the earth, अन्तरिक्षे in the sky, प्राक्स्रोतसः flowing towards the east, प्रत्यक्स्रोतसः towards the west, सर्वशः from everywhere, अद्य now, समायान्तु may come.

text: अन्या: स्रवन्तु मैरेयं सुरामन्या: सुनिष्ठिताम् । अपराश्चोदकं शीतमिक्षुकाण्डरसोपमम् ॥२-९१-१५॥
translation: Let some rivers flow with liquor made of datepalms, some with wellprepared wine and some with cool water which tastes like sugarcane juice.
word_meanings: अन्याः other rivers, मैरेयम् intoxicating liquour (made of datepalms), स्रवन्तु let them flow, अन्याः other rivers, सुविष्ठिताम् wellprepared, सुराम् wine, अपराश्च still others, इक्षुकाण्डरसोपमम् tasting like sugar cane juice, शीतम् cool, उदकम् water, स्रवन्तु let them flow.

text: आह्वये देवगन्धर्वान् विश्वावसुहहाहुहून् । तथैवाप्सरसो देवीर्गन्धर्व्वीश्चापि सर्वश: ॥२-९१-१६॥
translation: I invoke the gandharvas, Visvavasu, Ha Ha and Hu Hu, and also goddesses like gandharvas (heavenly musicians) and apsaras (nymphs) from all regions.
word_meanings: देवगन्धर्वान् the gandharvas of deities, विश्वावसु Visvavasu, हहाहुहून् Ha Ha and Hu Hu, तथैव also, देवीः goddesses, गन्धर्वीश्चापि female gandharvas (heavenly musicians), अप्सरसः apsaras (nymphs), सर्वशः from all regions, आह्वये invoke.

text: घृताचीमथ विश्वाचीं मिश्रकेशीमलम्बुसाम् । नागदन्तां च हेमां च हिमामद्रिकृतस्थलाम् ॥२-९१-१७॥
translation: I summon also Grutachi, Visvachi, Misrakesi, Alambusa, Nagadantha, Hema and Hima whose abode is on the mountain.
word_meanings: अथ also, घृताचीम् Grutachi, विश्वाचीम् Visvachi, मिश्रकेशीम् Misrakesi, अलंबुसाम् Alambusa, नागदन्तां च Nagadanta, हेमां च Hema, अद्रिकृतस्थलाम् whose abode is on the mountain, हिमाम् Hima I am summoning.

text: शक्रं याश्चोपतिष्ठन्ति ब्रह्माणं याश्च योषित: । सर्वास्तुम्बुरुणा सार्द्धमाह्वये सपरिच्छदा: ॥२-९१-१८॥
translation: I invoke all the women who attend on Indra and Bramha along with tumbur with all their (musical) instruments.
word_meanings: याश्च those, योषितः women, शक्रम् Indra, उपतिष्ठन्ति are serving, याश्च those, ब्रह्माणम् attending on Bramha, सपरिच्छदाः with all their musical instruments, सर्वाः all, तुम्बुरुणा सार्धम् with their tumbur, आह्वये I am invoking.

text: वनं कुरुषु यद्दिव्यं वासोभूषणपत्ऺत्रवत् । दिव्यनारीफलं शश्वत्तत्कौबेरमिहैतु च ॥२-९१-१९॥
translation: Let Kubera's divine forest situated in the land of Kurus, where leaves serve as raiment and ornaments and celestial women as its fruits come here.
word_meanings: कुरुषु in the land of Kurus, शश्वत् always, वासोभूषणपत्रवत् leaves serving as raiment and ornaments, दिव्यनारीफलम् celestial women as fruits, कौबेरम् relating to Kubera, यत् which, दिव्यं वनम् divine forest, तत् that, इह here, एतु let it come over.

text: इह मे भगवान् सोमो विधत्तामन्नमुत्तमम् । भक्ष्यं भोज्यं च चोष्यं च लेह्यं च विविधं बहु ॥२-९१-२०॥
translation: Let the blessed Moon furnish me with excellent food of every kind -- solid, liquid, soft and those which are to be sucked and licked in great variety and quantity.
word_meanings: भगवान् the lord, सोमः Moon, मे for me, इह here, उत्तमम् excellent, अन्नम् food, विविधम् many kinds, बहु many varieties, भक्ष्यम् eatables, भोज्यम् chewable food, चोष्यम् food eaten by sucking, लेह्यं च that which is licked, विधत्ताम् be provided.

text: विचित्राणि च माल्यानि पादपप्रच्युतानि च । सुरादीनि च पेयानि मांसानि विविधानि च ॥२-९१-२१॥
translation: Let her furnish me with manycoloured garlands of fresh flowers from trees, wines and other drinks and meat of different kinds.
word_meanings: पादपप्रच्युतानि those dropped from trees, विचित्राणि manycoloured, माल्यानि च flower garlands, सुरादीनि wines and others, पेयानि drinks, विविधानि of different kinds, मांसानि च meat be furnished.

text: एवं समाधिना युक्तस्तेजसा ऽप्रतिमेन च । शीक्षास्वरसमायुक्तं तपसा चाब्रवीन्मुनि: ॥२-९१-२२॥
translation: The valiant ascetic of incomparable lustre and power of penance in profound meditation said this in an accent in conformity with Vedic instruction.
word_meanings: समाधिना in profound meditation, अप्रतिमेन incomparable, तेजसा च with radiance, तपसा च with the power of penance, युक्तं filled with, मुनिः ascetic, शीक्षास्वरसमायुक्तम् with accent in conformity with Vedic instruction, एवम् in this way, अब्रवीत् said.

text: मनसा ध्यायतस्तस्य प्राङ्मुखस्य कृताञ्जले: । आजग्मुस्तानि सर्वाणि दैवतानि पृथक्पृथक् ॥२-९१-२३॥
translation: As Bharadwaja with folded palms was thus meditating with his face turned eastward, all the deities appeared there one by one.
word_meanings: तस्य his, प्राङ्मुखस्य facing east, कृताञ्जलेः with folded palms, मनसा in mind, ध्यायतः while meditating, सर्वाणि all, तानि दैवतानि those deities, पृथक्पृथक् one by one, आजग्मुः arrived.

text: मलयं दर्दुरं चैव तत: स्वेदनुदऽ ऽनिल: । उपस्पृश्य ववौ युक्त्या सुप्रियात्मा सुख: शिव: ॥२-९१-२४॥
translation: Meanwhile, soft auspicious and pleasant breeze passing over Malaya and Dardura mountains, comforting and cooling the sweat, began to blow.
word_meanings: ततः then, अनिलः wind, मलयम् Malaya hill, दर्दुरं चैव mount Dardura, उपस्पृश्य having touched, युक्त्या by virtue of contact, सुप्रियात्मा most pleasant, सुखः comforting, शिवः auspicious, स्वेदनुदः cooling the sweat, ववौ blew.

text: ततोभ्यवर्तन्त घना दिव्या: कुसुमवृष्टय: । दिव्यदुन्दुभिघोषश्च दिक्षु सर्वासु शुश्रुवे ॥२-९१-२५॥
translation: Then divine clouds rolled in and showered celestial flowers. The sounds of heavenly gongs could be heard in every direction.
word_meanings: ततः then, दिव्याः celestial, कुसुमवृष्टयः rain of flowers, घनाः clouds, अभ्यवर्षन्त showered, सर्वासु in all, दिक्षु directions, दिव्यदुन्दुभिघोषश्च sounds of divine musical gongs, शुश्रुवे could be heard.

text: प्रववुश्चोत्तमा वाताननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणा: । प्रजगुर्देवगन्धर्वा वीणा: प्रमुमुचु: स्वरान् ॥२-९१-२६॥
translation: Gentle breeze began to blow. Troops of apsaras danced. Gandharvas and gods sang and the lyres rang.
word_meanings: उत्तमाः gentle, वाताश्च winds, प्रववु blew, अप्सरोगणाः troops of apsaras, ननृतुश्च also danced, देवगन्धर्वाः divine gandharvas, जगुश्च sang, वीणाः lyres, स्वरान् notes, प्रमुमुचुः issued forth.

text: स शब्दो द्यां च भूमिं च प्राणिनां श्रवणानि च । विवेशोऺच्चारित: श्लक्ष्ण: समो लयगुणान्वित: ॥२-९१-२७॥
translation: That soft, melodious, rhythmic and wellmodulated sound entered the heaven and earth as well as the ears of all living beings.
word_meanings: उच्चरितः uttered, श्लक्षणः soft melody, लयसमन्वितः rhythmic, समः modulation, सः शब्दः those sounds, द्यां च the sky, भूमिं च the earth, प्राणिनाम् of all living beings, श्रवणानि च in the ears, विवेश entered.

text: तस्मिन्नुपरते शब्दे दिव्ये श्रोतृ(त्र)सुखे नृणाम् । ददर्श भारतं सैन्यं विधानं विश्वकर्मण: ॥२-९१-२८॥
translation: When the celestial sounds pleasing to the ears of men had subsided, the army of Bharata beheld the wonderful creations of Visvakarma.
word_meanings: नृणाम् for men, शोत्रसुखे pleasing to the ears, तस्मिन् when that, दिव्ये celestial, शब्दे sound, उपरते had subsided, भारतम् relating to Bharata, सैन्यम् army, विश्वकर्मणः Visvakarma's, विधानम् the creations, ददर्श he beheld.

text: बभूव हि समा भूमि: समन्तात्पञ्चयोजना । शाद्वलैर्बहुभिश्छन्ना नीलवैडूर्य्यसन्निभै: ॥२-९१-२९॥
translation: The ground was levelled on every side for five yojanas and covered with several grass lawns resembling lapis lazuli (blue sapphire) and cat's eye.
word_meanings: समन्तात् on every side, पञ्चयोजना five yojanas (forty miles), भूमिः the ground, समा has been levelled, नीलवैढूर्यसन्निभैः with sapphires or gems called cat'seye (beryl) spread, बहुभिः by many, शाद्वलैः grass lawns, छन्ना covered with, बभूव हि became৷৷

text: तस्मिन् बिल्वा: कपित्थाश्च पनसा बीजपूरका: । आमलक्यो बभूवुश्च चूताश्च फलभूषणा: ॥२-९१-३०॥
translation: There the best of fruitbearing trees like bilva trees, woodapple trees, citrons, emblic myrobalan trees and mango trees laden with fruits sprang up.
word_meanings: तस्मिन् there, फलभूषणाः fruits as adorenments, बिल्वाः Bilva, कपित्थाश्च woodapple trees, पनसाः jackfruit trees, बीजपूरकाः citron trees, आमलक्यः emblic myrobalan trees, चूताश्च mangotrees, बभूवुः sprang up.

text: उत्तरेभ्य: कुरुभ्यश्च वनं दिव्योपभोगवत् । आजगाम नदी दिव्या तीजैर्बहुभिर्वृता ॥२-९१-३१॥
translation: From the forests of the northern Kuru kingdom, with all delights of heaven, a divine river with innumerable trees that grow on river banks came into existence.
word_meanings: उत्तरेभ्यः कुरुभ्यः from the kingdom of northern Kurus, दिव्योपभोगवत् with all heavenly delights, वनम् forest, बहुभिः by innumerable, तीरजैः trees growing on the banks, कृता surrounded, दिव्या divine, नदी river, आजगाम came into existence.

text: चतु:शालानि शुभ्राणि शालाश्च गजवाजिनाम् । हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधास्तोरणानि शुभानि च ॥२-९१-३२॥
translation: Bright quadrangles, stables for elephants and horses, auspicious arch ways for palaces and mansions sprang up.
word_meanings: शुभ्राणि bright, चतुश्शालानि quadrangles, गजवाजिनाम् for horses and elephants, शालाश्च stables, शुभानि auspicious, हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधास्तोरणानि consisting of archways for palaces and mansions sprang up.

text: सितमेघनिभं चापि राजवेश्मसु तोरणम् । दिव्यमाल्यकृताकारं दिव्यगन्धसमुक्षितम् ॥२-९१-३३॥
translation: An auspicious royal palace with splendid archs resembling white clouds sprang up. It was sprinkled with celestial perfumes and adorned with beautiful garlands. That royal palace forming a quadrangle was furnished with couches, seats and carriages and furnished with celestial drinks of every kind, delicious food and splendid garments. It was stocked with food of every variety in clean and spotless vessels. Seats for every one and magnificent couches covered with excellent bedstead were arranged.
word_meanings: सितमेघनिभम् like white clouds, सुतोरणम् with beautiful archs, दिव्यमाल्यकृताकारम् adorned with fine garlands, दिव्यगन्धसमुक्षितं sprinkled with celestial perfumes, चतुरश्रम् forming a quadrangle, असंबाधम् very spacious, शयनासनयानवत् furnished with couches, seats and carriages, दिव्यैः by the celestial, सर्वरसैः with all kinds of drinks, युक्तम् arranged with, दिव्यभोजनवस्त्रवत् with heavenly food and dress, उपकल्पितसर्वान्नं stocked with food of every variety, धौतनिर्मलभाजनम् clean washed pots, क्लुप्तसर्वासनम् with seats arranged for every one, स्वास्तीर्णशयनोत्तमम् with magnificent couches covered with excellent bedstead, श्रीमत् auspicious, राजवेश्मचापि a royal palace also sprang up.

text: चतुरश्रमसम्बाधं शयनासनयानवत् । दिव्यै: सर्वरसैर्युक्तं दिव्यभोजनवस्त्रवत् । उपकल्पितसर्वान्नं धौतनिर्मलभाजनम् ॥२-९१-३४॥
translation: An auspicious royal palace with splendid archs resembling white clouds sprang up. It was sprinkled with celestial perfumes and adorned with beautiful garlands. That royal palace forming a quadrangle was furnished with couches, seats and carriages and furnished with celestial drinks of every kind, delicious food and splendid garments. It was stocked with food of every variety in clean and spotless vessels. Seats for every one and magnificent couches covered with excellent bedstead were arranged.
word_meanings: सितमेघनिभम् like white clouds, सुतोरणम् with beautiful archs, दिव्यमाल्यकृताकारम् adorned with fine garlands, दिव्यगन्धसमुक्षितं sprinkled with celestial perfumes, चतुरश्रम् forming a quadrangle, असंबाधम् very spacious, शयनासनयानवत् furnished with couches, seats and carriages, दिव्यैः by the celestial, सर्वरसैः with all kinds of drinks, युक्तम् arranged with, दिव्यभोजनवस्त्रवत् with heavenly food and dress, उपकल्पितसर्वान्नं stocked with food of every variety, धौतनिर्मलभाजनम् clean washed pots, क्लुप्तसर्वासनम् with seats arranged for every one, स्वास्तीर्णशयनोत्तमम् with magnificent couches covered with excellent bedstead, श्रीमत् auspicious, राजवेश्मचापि a royal palace also sprang up.

text: क्लृप्तसर्वासनं श्रीमत् स्वास्तीर्णशयनोत्तमम् । प्रविवेश महाबाहुरनुज्ञातो महर्षिणा । वेश्म तद्रत्नसम्पूर्णं भरत: केकयीसुत: ॥२-९१-३५॥
translation: Longarmed Bharata, son of Kaikeyi entered that palace full of jewels with the permission of the great sage.
word_meanings: महाबाहुः longarmed, कैकयीसुतः son of Kaikeyi, भरतः Bharata, महर्षिणा by the great sage, अनुज्ञातः having been permitted, रत्नसम्पूर्णम् full of jewels, तत् that, वेश्म house, प्रविवेश entered.

text: अनुजग्मुश्च तं सर्वे मन्त्रिण: सपुरोहिता: । बभूवुश्च मुदा युक्ता दृष्ट्वा तं वेश्मसंविधिम् ॥२-९१-३६॥
translation: All the ministers, priests followed him and were glad to see the arrangement in that mansion.
word_meanings: सपुरोहिताः along with priests, सर्वे all, मन्त्रिणः ministers, तम् that Bharata, अनुजग्मुश्च followed, तम् संविधिम् that arrangement, दृष्ट्वा having seen all over, मुदा full of joy, युक्ताः filled with बभूवुश्च became.

text: तत्र राजासनं दिव्यं व्यजनं छत्रमेव च । भरतो मन्त्रिभि: सार्द्धमभ्यवर्त्तत राजवत् ॥२-९१-३७॥
translation: There where stood an exquisite throne, a fan and a parasol Bharata stayed in the company of ministers.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, मन्त्रिभिः सार्धं in the company of ministers, तत्र there, दिव्यम् exquisite, राजासनम् throne, व्यजनम् a fan (of yak's tail), छत्रमेव च parasol, राजवत् like a king, अभ्यवर्तत stayed.

text: आसनं पूजयामास रामायाभिप्रणम्य च । वालव्यजनमादाय न्यषीदत् सचिवासने ॥२-९१-३८॥
translation: He bowed in reverence and worshipped the throne (as though Rama were seated there). Taking hold of a fan made of yak's tail he sat in a minister's seat.
word_meanings: रामाय to Rama, अभिप्रणम्य च having bowed in reverence, आसनम् that throne, पूजयामास worshipped, वालव्यजनम् fan made of yak's tail, आदाय taking hold of, सचिवासने in a minister's seat, न्यषीदत् sat down

text: आनुपूर्व्यानिषेदुश्च सर्वे मन्त्रिपुरोहिता: । तत: सेनापति: पश्चात् प्रशास्ता च निषेदतु: ॥२-९१-३९॥
translation: First the ministers and priests took their respective seats in accordance with their rank, and then the army chief and finally the supervisor of the camp.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, मन्त्रिपुरोहिताः ministers and priests, आनुपूर्व्यात् in order, निषेदुः sat, ततः सेनापति after that the army chief, पश्चात् later, प्रशास्ता च and the supervisor of the camp, निषेदतुः sat.

text: ततस्तत्र मुहूर्त्तेन नद्य: पायसकर्दमा: । उपातिष्ठन्त भरतं भरद्वाजस्य शासनात् ॥२-९१-४०॥
translation: Rivers filled with payasam (rice cooked in milk and sugar) in the shape of mud flowed towards Bharata at the command of Bharadwaja.
word_meanings: ततः then, भरद्वाजस्य by Bharadwaja, शासनात् order, मुहूर्तेन instantly, तत्र there, पायसकर्दमाः payasam (rice cooked in milk with sugar) as mud, नद्यः rivers, भरतम् Bharata, उपातिष्ठन्त approached.

text: तासामुभयत:कूलं पाण्डुमृत्तिकलेपना: । रम्याश्चावसथा दिव्या ब्रह्मणस्तु प्रसादजा: ॥२-९१-४१॥
translation: On both the banks of those rivers, charming, celestial houses plastered with white clay appeared by the grace of Brahma.
word_meanings: तासाम् those rivers, उभयतः कूलम् on both the banks, पाण्डुमृत्तिलेपनाः plastered with white clay, ब्रह्मणः Brahma, प्रसादजाः produced by the grace, दिव्याः celestial, रम्याः charming, आवसधाश्च houses appeared.

text: तेनैव च मुहूर्त्तेन दिव्याभरणभूषिता: । आगुर्विंशतिसाहस्रा ब्रह्मणा प्रहिता: स्त्रिय: ॥२-९१-४२॥
translation: At that very moment twenty thousand women adorned with beautiful ornaments sent by Brahma presented themselves.
word_meanings: तेन at that, मुहूर्तेन च moment, दिव्याभरणभूषिताः adorned with beautiful ornaments, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, प्रहिताः sent, विंशतिसाहस्राः twenty thousand, स्त्रियः women, आगुः came.

text: सुवर्णमणिमुक्तेन प्रवालेन च शोभिता: । आगुर्विंशतिसाहस्रा: कुबेरप्रहिता: स्त्रिय: ॥२-९१-४३॥
translation: Twenty thousand women adorned with gold, gems and corals sent by Kubera came.
word_meanings: सुवर्णमणिमुक्तेन wearing golden ornaments and gems, प्रवालेन with corals, शोभिता shining, कुबेरप्रहिताः sent by Kubera, विंशतिसाहस्राः twenty thousand, स्त्रियः आगुः women came.

text: याभिर्गृहीतपुरुष: सोन्माद इव लक्ष्यते । आगुर्विंशतिसाहस्रा नन्दनादप्सरोगणा: ॥२-९१-४४॥
translation: Troops of twenty thousand apsaras by whom any man when taken hold of in their arms could be intoxicated with intense passion, came from Nandana gardens.
word_meanings: याभिः by whom, गृहीतः when taken hold of (in their arms), पुरुषः man, सोन्माद इव filled with intense passion, लक्ष्यते is observed, such, विंशतिसाहस्राः twenty thousand, अप्सरोगणाः troops of apsaras, नन्दनात् from Nandana, आगुः came.

text: नारदस्तुम्बुरुर्गोप: प्रवरा: सूर्य्यवर्चस: । एते गन्धर्वराजानो भरतस्याग्रतो जगु: ॥२-९१-४५॥
translation: There along with Narada, Tumburu and Gopa, distinguished kings of the gandharvas, looking bright like the Sun, began to sing in the presence of Bharata.
word_meanings: नारदः Narada, तुम्भुरुः Tumburu, गोपः Gopa, प्रवराः distinguished ones, सूर्यवर्चसः resembling the brightness of the Sun, एते these, गन्धर्वराजानः kings among gandharvas, भरतस्य Bharata's, अग्रतः presence, जगुः began to sing.

text: अलम्बुसा मिश्रकेशी पुण्डरीकाथ वामना । उपानृत्यंस्तु भरत भरद्वाजस्य शासनात् ॥२-९१-४६॥
translation: Thereafter, the apsaras, Alambusa, Misrakesi, Pundarika and Vamana danced near Bharata at the command of Bharadwaja.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, भरद्वाजस्य Bharadwaja's, शासनात् command, अलम्बुसा Alambusa, मिश्रकेशी Misrakese, पुण्डरीका Pundarika, वामना Vamana, भरतम् Bharata, उपानृत्यन् तु danced near.

text: यानि माल्यानि देवेषु यानि चैत्ररथे वने । प्रयागे तान्यदृश्यन्त भरद्वाजस्य तेजसा ॥२-९१-४७॥
translation: The garlands of the gods available in Chitraratha's (Kubera's) garden could not match those obtained under the orders of Bharadwaja.
word_meanings: यानि those, माल्यानि garlands, देवेषु among the gods, यानि those garlands, चैत्ररथे of Chaitraratha, वने in the garden, तानि all those, भरद्वाजस्य Bharadwaja's, शासनात् at the command, प्रयागे Prayaga, अदृश्यन्त were found.

text: बिल्वा मार्दङ्गिका आसन् शम्याग्राहा विभीतका: । अश्वत्थानर्त्तकाश्चासन् भरद्वाजस्य शासनात् ॥२-९१-४८॥
translation: At the command of Bharadwaja, bilva trees acted as drummers, vibhitaka trees as cymbalists and the pipal trees as dancers.
word_meanings: भरद्वाजस्य at Bharadwaja's, शासनात् command, बिल्वाः bilva trees, मार्दङ्गिकाः as drummers, आसन् became, विभीतकाः vibhitaka (palm) trees, शम्याग्राहा as cymbalists, अश्वत्था pipal trees, नर्तकाश्च as dancers, आसन् became.

text: तत: सरलतालाश्च तिलका नक्तमालका: । प्रहृष्टास्तत्र सम्पेतु: कुब्जा भूत्वाथ वामना: ॥२-९१-४९॥
translation: Thereafter pine, palmyra, tilaka, and naktamala trees were transformed into hunchbacks and dwarfs and moved about in great delight.
word_meanings: ततः then, सरलतालाश्च pine and palmyra trees, तिलकाः tilaka trees, नक्तमालकाः naktamala (that bear flowers at night), प्रहृष्टाः out of great joy, कुब्जाः hunchbacked, अथ also, वामनाः dwarfs, भूत्वा तत्र सम्पेतुः taking the form moved about there.

text: शिंशुपामलकीजम्ब्वो याश्चान्या: काननेषु ता: । मालती मल्लिका जातिर्याश्चान्या: कानने लता: ॥२-९१-५०॥
translation: Asohka, emblic myrobalan and all other trees found in the forest malati, mallika and jati creepers assumed the form of women, came over to the hermitage of Bharadwaja and said:
word_meanings: शिंशुपामलकीजम्ब्वः ashoka and emblic myrobalan trees, काननेषु in the forest, अन्याः and other, याः those, ताः they, मालती jasmine creeper, मल्लिका mallika creeper, जातिः jati creeper, कानने in the forest, अन्याः other, याः लताः all those creepers, प्रमदाविग्रहम् taking the form of women, कृत्वा having made, भरद्वाजाश्रमे in the hermitage of Bharadwaja, अवदन् said.

text: प्रमदाविग्रहं कृत्वा भरद्वाजाश्रमे ऽवदन् । सुरा: सुरापा: पिबत पायसं च बुभुक्षिता: । मांसानि च सुमेध्यानि भक्ष्यन्तां यावदिच्छथ ॥२-९१-५१॥
translation: 'O wine drinkers, drink as much as you can those who are hungry partake payasam and sacred meat'.
word_meanings: सुरापाः O those of you who drink liquor, यावत् until, इच्छथ you desire, सुराः liquor, पिबत drink, बुभुक्षिताः those who are hungry to eat, पायसं च payasam (made of milk and rice), सुमेध्यानि sacred, मांसानि च meat, भक्ष्यन्ताम् let them eat.

text: उच्छाद्य स्नापयन्ति स्म नदीतीरेषु वल्गुषु । अप्येकमेकं पुरुषं प्रमदा: सप्त चाष्ट च ॥२-९१-५२॥
translation: Every single warrior was attended by seven or eight women who applied oil and massaged his body and bathed him on the lovely banks of the river.
word_meanings: सप्त च seven or, अष्ट च eight, प्रमदाः women, एकम् one by one, पुरुषम् man, उच्छाद्य applied oil and massaged the body, वल्गुषु in the lovely, नदीतीरेषु on the banks of the river, स्नापयन्ति bathed them, स्म अपि also.

text: संवाहन्त्य: समापेतुर्नार्यो रुचिरलोचना: । परिमृज्य तथान्योन्यं पाययन्ति वराङ्गना: ॥२-९१-५३॥
translation: Some women with beautiful eyes quickly approached them for massaging. The best of ladies wiped their bodies dry and gave each other wine to drink.
word_meanings: रुचिरलोचनाः with beautiful eyes, नार्यः women, संवाहन्त्यः massaging, समापेतुः quickly approached, वराङ्गनाः best of ladies, तथा like that, परिमृज्य wiped the water, अन्योन्यम् to each other, पाययन्ति made them drink.

text: हयान् गजान् खरानुष्ट्रांस्तथैव सुरभे: सुतान् । अभोजयन् वाहनपास्तेषां भोज्यं यथाविधि ॥२-९१-५४॥
translation: The attendants of draughtanimals fed the horses, elephants, donkeys, camels and oxen their appropriate food.
word_meanings: वाहनपाः attendants of draughtanimals, हयान् horses, गजान् elephants, खरान् donkeys, उष्ट्रान् camels, तथैव similarly, सुरभेः the Surabhi's, सुतान offsprings, यथाविधि duly, तेषाम् for them, भोज्यम् food, अभोजयन् fed.

text: इक्षूंश्च मधुलाजांश्च भोजयन्ति स्म वाहनान् । इक्ष्वाकुवरयोधानां चोदयन्तो महाबला: ॥२-९१-५५॥
translation: The draughtaimals of the illustrious warriors of Ikshvaku kings were urged by the highly energetic attendants to eat more and more of parched grain mixed with sugarcane and honey.
word_meanings: महाबलाः of highly energetic attendants, इक्ष्वाकुवरयोधानाम् of the illustrious warriors of Ikshvaku race, वाहनान् the draughtanimals, चोदयन्तः provoking them to eat, इक्षूंश्च sugarcane, मधुलाजांश्च honey and parched grain, भोजयन्ति स्म were fed.

text: नाश्वबन्धो ऽश्वमाजानान्न गजं कुञ्जरग्रह: । मत्तप्रमत्तमुदिता नमू: सा तत्र सम्बभौ ॥२-९१-५६॥
translation: The horserider no longer recognised the horse or the mahout the elephant and the whole army was inebriated with drinking and pleasure.
word_meanings: अश्वबन्धः horserider, अश्वम् horse, न अजानात् no longer recognised, कुञ्जरग्रहः mahout, गजम् elephant, न not recognised, तत्र there, सा that, चमूः whole army, मत्तप्रमत्तमुदिता fully drunk had forgotten in their joy, सम्बभौ shone.

text: तर्पिता: सर्वकामैस्ते रक्तचन्दनरूषिता: । अप्सरोगणसंयुक्ता: सैन्या वाचमुदैरयन् ॥२-९१-५७॥
translation: All the armymen with their desires gratified and anointing their bodies with red sandal paste surrounded by apsaras exclaimed.
word_meanings: सर्वकामैः by all horseriders, तर्पिताः gratified, रक्तचन्दनरूषिताः smeared with red sandal paste, अप्सरोगणसम्युक्ताः surrounded by apsaras, ते सैन्याः those soldiers, वाचम् these words, उदैरयन् exclaimed.

text: नैवायोध्यां गमिष्यामो न गमिष्याम दण्डकान् । कुशलं भरतस्यास्तु रामस्यास्तु तथा सुखम् ॥२-९१-५८॥
translation: We will neither return to Ayodhya, nor enter Dandaka (forest). May Bharata and Rama be happy.
word_meanings: अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, न गमिष्यामः will not return, दण्डकान् to Danadaka forest, न गमिष्यामः will not go, भरतस्य to Bharata, कुशलम् welfare, अस्तु तथा be like this, रामस्य Rama, सुखम् happy, अस्तु will be.

text: इति पादातयोधाश्च हस्त्यश्वारोह बन्धका: । अनाथास्तं विधिं लब्ध्वा वाचमेतामुदैरयन् ॥२-९१-५९॥
translation: Having enjoyed the hospitality of Bharadwaja the foot soldiers, horse and elephant riders made utterances ignoring their leaders.
word_meanings: पादातयोधाश्च foot soldiers, हस्त्यश्वरोहबन्धकाः horse and elephant riders, तम् विधिम् that hospitality, लब्धवा having received, अनाथाः इति no longer recognising their leaders, एताम् such, वाचम् utterances, उदीरयन् made.

text: सम्प्रहृष्टा विनेदुस्ते नरास्तत्र सहस्रश: । भरतस्यानुयातार: स्वर्गोयमिति चाब्रुवन् ॥२-९१-६०॥
translation: The exceedingly delighted soldiers of Bharata's retinue in their thousands cried out with excitement This is the very heaven.
word_meanings: भरतस्य Bharata's, अनुयातारः followers, ते नराः those men, तत्र there, सहस्रशः in their thousands, सम्प्रहृष्टाः highly exited with delight, विनेदुः shouted, अयम् this is, स्वर्गः heaven, इति thus, अब्रुवन् च started uttering.

text: नृत्यन्ति स्म हसन्ति स्म गायन्ति स्म च सैनिका: । समन्तात् परिधावन्ति माल्योपेता: सहस्रश: ॥२-९१-६१॥
translation: Those thousands of soldiers wearing flower garlands ran about dancing, singing, and laughing.
word_meanings: सहस्रशः in thousands, सैनिकाः soldiers, माल्योपेताः wearing flower garlands, नृत्यन्ति स्म danced, हसन्ति स्म laughed, गायन्ति स्म sang, समन्तात् all over, परिधावन्ति ran about.

text: ततो भुक्तवतां तेषां तदन्नममृतोपमम् । दिव्यानुद्वीक्ष्य भक्ष्यांस्तानभवद्भक्षणे मति: ॥२-९१-६२॥
translation: Glancing at the ambrosial food, a desire arose in the minds of those soldiers to eat once again although they had already partaken it.
word_meanings: ततः then, अमृतोपमम् like nectar, तत् अन्नम् that food, भुक्तवताम् of those who had partaken, तेषाम् for them, दिव्यान् heavenly, तान् भक्ष्यान् those eatables, उद्वीक्षय glancing, भक्षणे to partake, मतिः in their minds, अभवत् desire arose.

text: प्रेष्याश्चेष्ट्यश्च वध्वश्च बलस्थाश्च सहस्रश: । बभूवुस्ऺते भृशं दृप्ता: सर्वे चाहतवासस: ॥२-९१-६३॥
translation: Messengers, maidservants, female attendants, and soldiers -- all of them in their thousands dressed in fresh garments felt exceedingly proud of themselves.
word_meanings: सहश्रसः in their thousands, प्रेष्याः messengers, चेट्यश्च maidservants, वध्वश्च female attendants, बलस्थाः army attendants, ते they, सर्वे च all of them, अहतवाससः dressed in unworn (new) garments, भृशम् exceedingly, दृप्ताः बभूवुः felt proud of themselves.

text: कुञ्जराश्च खरोष्ट्राश्च गोश्वाश्च मृगपक्षिण: । बभूवु: सुभृतास्तत्र नान्यो ह्यन्यमकल्पयत् ॥२-९१-६४॥
translation: There the elephants, donkeys and camels, cows and horses and also beasts and birds were wellnourished. No one troubled the other.
word_meanings: तत्र there, कुञ्जराश्च elephants, खरोष्ट्राश्च donkeys and camels, गोऽश्वाश्च cows and horses, मृगपक्षिणः beasts and birds, सुभृताः बभूवु were wellnourished, अन्यः अन्यम् one to the other, न अकल्पयत् हि did not trouble.

text: नाशुक्लवासास्तत्रासीत् क्षुधितो मलिनो ऽपि वा । रजसा ध्वस्तकेशो वा नर: कश्चिददृश्यत ॥२-९१-६५॥
translation: In that army there was none who could be seen without wearing garments of sparkling white, who was hungry or dirty or with decayed hair.
word_meanings: तत्र there, अशुक्लवासाः wearing nonwhite (dirty) dress, क्षुधितः hungry, मलिनोऽपि dirty, न आसीत् none was there, कश्चित् नरः anybody, रजसा with dust, ध्वस्तकेशो वा with decayed hair, नादृश्यत could not be seen.

text: आजैश्चापि च वाराहैर्निष्ठानवरसञ्चयै: । फलनिर्यूहसंसिद्धै: सूपैर्गन्धरसान्वितै: ॥२-९१-६६॥
पुष्पध्वजवती: पूर्णा: शुक्लस्यान्नस्य चाभित: । ददृशुर्विस्मितास्तत्र नरा लौही: सहस्रश: ॥२-९१-६७॥
translation: There the soldiers beheld in amazement thousands of iron containers decked with flags and flowers and filled with white rice, mutton, pork, choicest condiments, fruit juice, fragrant and tasty soup.
word_meanings: तत्र there, नराः men, आजैश्चापि with mutton, वाराहैश्च pork, निष्ठानवरसञ्चयैः with choicest condiments, फलनिर्यूह संसिद्दैः with various fruit juices, गन्धरसान्वितैः with fragrant and tasteful, सूपैः with soups, पूर्णाः filled with, शुक्लस्य white, अन्नस्य rice, लौहीः best of iron containers, अभितः on all sides, विस्मिताः were amazed, ददृशुः beheld.

text: बभूवुर्वनपार्श्वेषु कूपा: पायसकर्दमा: । ताश्च कामदुघा गावो द्रुमाश्चासन् मधुस्रुत: ॥२-९१-६८॥
translation: Along the edge of the forest, wells were filled with thick payasam. There were wishfulfilling cows and honeydripping trees.
word_meanings: वनपार्श्वेषु along the edge of the forest, पायसकर्दमाः drink of milk and rice, कूपाः wells, बभूवुः were formed, गाव: cows, ताः those, कामदुघाः wishfulfilling, द्रुमाश्च trees, मधुश्च्युतः dripping honey, आसन् became.

text: वाप्यो मैरेयपूर्णाश्च मृष्टमांसचयैर्वृता: । प्रतप्तपिठरैश्चापि मार्गमायूरकौक्कुटै: ॥२-९१-६९॥
translation: The wells were found filled with datepalm liquor and surrounded by pots of well cooked meat of peacocks, chicken and other animals.
word_meanings: वाप्यः wells, मैरेयपूर्णाश्च filled with datepalm liquor, प्रतप्तपिठरैः with hot pots (filled with cooked meat), मार्गमायूरकौक्कुटैः meat of peacock, chicken and deer, मृष्णमांसचयैः meat of other animals, वृताः surrounded by.

text: पात्रीणां च सहस्राणि स्थालीनां नियुतानि च । न्यर्बुदानि च पात्राणि शातकुम्भमयानि च ॥२-९१-७०॥
स्थाल्य: कुम्भ्य: करम्भ्यश्च दधिपूर्णा: सुसंस्कृता: । यौवनस्थस्य गौरस्य कपित्थस्य सुगन्धिन: ॥२-९१-७१॥
ह्रदा: पूर्णा रसालस्य दघ्न: श्वेतस्य चापरे । बभूवु: पायसस्यान्ये शर्करायाश्च सञ्चया: ॥२-९१-७२॥
translation: There were thousands of pots, lakhs of plates, crores of vessels -- all made of gold and filled with wellgarnished food. Curd was kept in earthern pots like jugs and jars and pots with a wide mouth. Tanks were formed, some filled with white curd of good flavour and of the colour of woodapple, some with white curd blended with spices and some with payasam and heaps of barely powder mixed with sugar.
word_meanings: पात्रीणाम् vessels, सहस्राणि in thousands, स्थालीनाम् plates, नियुतानि in lakhs, शातकुम्भमयानि made of gold, पात्राणि pots (cups), सुसंस्कृताः wellcleansed, स्थाल्यः earthern jugs, कुम्भ्यः jars, करम्भ्यश्च pots with a wide mouth, यौवनस्थस्य not very ripe, गौरस्य white, सुगन्धिनः of good flavour, कपित्थस्य curds of the colour of wood apple, पूर्णाः filled with, ह्रदाः tanks, रसालस्य blended with spices, श्वेतस्य white, दध्नः curds, अपरे च some more tanks, पायसस्य sweets made from milk and rice cooked together (payasam), अन्ये some other tanks, शर्करायावसञ्चयाः food prepared from barley mixed with sugar, बभूवुः were formed.

text: कल्कांश्चूर्णकषायांश्च स्नानानि विविधानि च । ददृशुर्भाजनस्थानि तीर्थेषु सरितां नरा: ॥२-९१-७३॥
translation: The soldiers saw on the river banks at landing places levigated powder, fragrant powder and extracts and other bathing requisites of different kinds stored in receptacles.
word_meanings: नराः men (soldiers), सरिताम् rivers, तीर्थेषु landing places, कल्कान् levigated powder, चूर्णकषायांश्च powder and extract, भाजनस्थानि in receptacles, विविधानि of different kinds, स्नानानि च bathing requisites, ददृशुः were seen.

text: शुक्लानंशुमतश्चापि दन्तधावनसञ्चयान् । शुक्लांश्चन्दनकल्कांश्च समुद्गेष्ववतिष्ठत: ॥२-९१-७४॥
दर्पणान् परिमृष्टांश्च वाससां चापि सञ्चयान् । पादुकोपानहश्चैव युग्मानि च सहस्रश: ॥२-९१-७५॥
आञ्जनी: कङ्कतान् कूर्चान् शस्त्राणि च धनूंषि च । मर्मत्राणानि चित्राणि शयनान्यासनानि च ॥२-९१-७६॥
translation: There the soldiers beheld on every side stacks of toothbrushing sticks, white and bristled, white lumps of sandal paste placed in dishes made of leaves, well cleaned mirrors, collection of clothes, several pairs of footwear, collyrium boxes, combs, brushes for cleaning moustaches, weapons, parasoles, bows and shining armour, different kinds of couches, and seats. There were pools of drinking water for donkeys, camels, elephants and horses and excellent landing places filled with flowering lotuses and water lilies. The lakes were of transparent waters resembling the hue of the sky easy and comfortable for swimming. There they saw heaps of soft grass as green as sapphire and kadamva trees for animals to refresh themselves under.
word_meanings: ते they (soldiers), तत्र there, सर्वशः on every side, शुक्लान् pure white, अंशुमतश्चापि bristled, दन्तधावनसञ्चयान् stacks of toothbrushing sticks, समुद्गेषु in dishes made of leaves, अतिष्ठतः placed, शुक्लान् pure white, चन्दनकल्कांश्च lumps of sandal paste, परिमृष्टान् very wellcleaned, दर्पणान् च mirrors, वाससाम् clothes, सञ्चयान् चापि collection, पादुकोपानहाम् foot wear for the feet, सहस्रशः in thousands, युग्मानि च of pairs, आञ्जनीः collyrium boxes, कङ्कतान् combs, कूर्चान् brushes for cleaning moustaches, शस्त्राणि च weapons, धनूंषि च bows, मर्मत्राणानि shields, चित्राणि armours for protecting vital parts, शयनानि couches, आसनानि च seats, खरोष्ट्रगजवाजिनाम् for donkeys, camels, elephants and horses, प्रतिपानह्रदान् pools of drinking water, अवगाह्यसुतीर्थान् excellent bathing places, सोतपलपुष्करान् filled with flowering lotuses and lilies, आकाशवर्णप्रतिमान् resembling the hue of the sky (blue), स्वच्छतोयान् pure and tranparent waters, सुखप्लवान् good and comfortable tanks for swimming in, ह्रदान् lakes, पशूनाम् for animals, निर्वापार्थान् for refreshing, नीपवैडूर्यवर्णांश्च like kadamva trees as green as the sapphire, मृदून् soft, यवसञ्चयान् heaps of grass collected together, ददृशुः beheld.

text: प्रतिपानह्रदान् पूर्णान् खरोष्ट्रगजवाजिनाम् । अवगाह्य सुतीर्थांश्च ह्रदान् सोत्पलपुष्करान् ॥२-९१-७७॥
translation: There the soldiers beheld on every side stacks of toothbrushing sticks, white and bristled, white lumps of sandal paste placed in dishes made of leaves, well cleaned mirrors, collection of clothes, several pairs of footwear, collyrium boxes, combs, brushes for cleaning moustaches, weapons, parasoles, bows and shining armour, different kinds of couches, and seats. There were pools of drinking water for donkeys, camels, elephants and horses and excellent landing places filled with flowering lotuses and water lilies. The lakes were of transparent waters resembling the hue of the sky easy and comfortable for swimming. There they saw heaps of soft grass as green as sapphire and kadamva trees for animals to refresh themselves under.
word_meanings: ते they (soldiers), तत्र there, सर्वशः on every side, शुक्लान् pure white, अंशुमतश्चापि bristled, दन्तधावनसञ्चयान् stacks of toothbrushing sticks, समुद्गेषु in dishes made of leaves, अतिष्ठतः placed, शुक्लान् pure white, चन्दनकल्कांश्च lumps of sandal paste, परिमृष्टान् very wellcleaned, दर्पणान् च mirrors, वाससाम् clothes, सञ्चयान् चापि collection, पादुकोपानहाम् foot wear for the feet, सहस्रशः in thousands, युग्मानि च of pairs, आञ्जनीः collyrium boxes, कङ्कतान् combs, कूर्चान् brushes for cleaning moustaches, शस्त्राणि च weapons, धनूंषि च bows, मर्मत्राणानि shields, चित्राणि armours for protecting vital parts, शयनानि couches, आसनानि च seats, खरोष्ट्रगजवाजिनाम् for donkeys, camels, elephants and horses, प्रतिपानह्रदान् pools of drinking water, अवगाह्यसुतीर्थान् excellent bathing places, सोतपलपुष्करान् filled with flowering lotuses and lilies, आकाशवर्णप्रतिमान् resembling the hue of the sky (blue), स्वच्छतोयान् pure and tranparent waters, सुखप्लवान् good and comfortable tanks for swimming in, ह्रदान् lakes, पशूनाम् for animals, निर्वापार्थान् for refreshing, नीपवैडूर्यवर्णांश्च like kadamva trees as green as the sapphire, मृदून् soft, यवसञ्चयान् heaps of grass collected together, ददृशुः beheld.

text: आकाशवर्णप्रतिमान् स्वच्छतोयान् सुखप्लवान् । नीलवैडूर्य्यवर्णांश्च मृदून् यवससञ्चयान् ॥२-९१-७८॥
translation: There the soldiers beheld on every side stacks of toothbrushing sticks, white and bristled, white lumps of sandal paste placed in dishes made of leaves, well cleaned mirrors, collection of clothes, several pairs of footwear, collyrium boxes, combs, brushes for cleaning moustaches, weapons, parasoles, bows and shining armour, different kinds of couches, and seats. There were pools of drinking water for donkeys, camels, elephants and horses and excellent landing places filled with flowering lotuses and water lilies. The lakes were of transparent waters resembling the hue of the sky easy and comfortable for swimming. There they saw heaps of soft grass as green as sapphire and kadamva trees for animals to refresh themselves under.
word_meanings: ते they (soldiers), तत्र there, सर्वशः on every side, शुक्लान् pure white, अंशुमतश्चापि bristled, दन्तधावनसञ्चयान् stacks of toothbrushing sticks, समुद्गेषु in dishes made of leaves, अतिष्ठतः placed, शुक्लान् pure white, चन्दनकल्कांश्च lumps of sandal paste, परिमृष्टान् very wellcleaned, दर्पणान् च mirrors, वाससाम् clothes, सञ्चयान् चापि collection, पादुकोपानहाम् foot wear for the feet, सहस्रशः in thousands, युग्मानि च of pairs, आञ्जनीः collyrium boxes, कङ्कतान् combs, कूर्चान् brushes for cleaning moustaches, शस्त्राणि च weapons, धनूंषि च bows, मर्मत्राणानि shields, चित्राणि armours for protecting vital parts, शयनानि couches, आसनानि च seats, खरोष्ट्रगजवाजिनाम् for donkeys, camels, elephants and horses, प्रतिपानह्रदान् pools of drinking water, अवगाह्यसुतीर्थान् excellent bathing places, सोतपलपुष्करान् filled with flowering lotuses and lilies, आकाशवर्णप्रतिमान् resembling the hue of the sky (blue), स्वच्छतोयान् pure and tranparent waters, सुखप्लवान् good and comfortable tanks for swimming in, ह्रदान् lakes, पशूनाम् for animals, निर्वापार्थान् for refreshing, नीपवैडूर्यवर्णांश्च like kadamva trees as green as the sapphire, मृदून् soft, यवसञ्चयान् heaps of grass collected together, ददृशुः beheld.

text: निर्वापार्थान् पशूनां ते ददृशुस्तत्र सर्वश: ॥२-९१-७९॥
translation: There the soldiers beheld on every side stacks of toothbrushing sticks, white and bristled, white lumps of sandal paste placed in dishes made of leaves, well cleaned mirrors, collection of clothes, several pairs of footwear, collyrium boxes, combs, brushes for cleaning moustaches, weapons, parasoles, bows and shining armour, different kinds of couches, and seats. There were pools of drinking water for donkeys, camels, elephants and horses and excellent landing places filled with flowering lotuses and water lilies. The lakes were of transparent waters resembling the hue of the sky easy and comfortable for swimming. There they saw heaps of soft grass as green as sapphire and kadamva trees for animals to refresh themselves under.
word_meanings: ते they (soldiers), तत्र there, सर्वशः on every side, शुक्लान् pure white, अंशुमतश्चापि bristled, दन्तधावनसञ्चयान् stacks of toothbrushing sticks, समुद्गेषु in dishes made of leaves, अतिष्ठतः placed, शुक्लान् pure white, चन्दनकल्कांश्च lumps of sandal paste, परिमृष्टान् very wellcleaned, दर्पणान् च mirrors, वाससाम् clothes, सञ्चयान् चापि collection, पादुकोपानहाम् foot wear for the feet, सहस्रशः in thousands, युग्मानि च of pairs, आञ्जनीः collyrium boxes, कङ्कतान् combs, कूर्चान् brushes for cleaning moustaches, शस्त्राणि च weapons, धनूंषि च bows, मर्मत्राणानि shields, चित्राणि armours for protecting vital parts, शयनानि couches, आसनानि च seats, खरोष्ट्रगजवाजिनाम् for donkeys, camels, elephants and horses, प्रतिपानह्रदान् pools of drinking water, अवगाह्यसुतीर्थान् excellent bathing places, सोतपलपुष्करान् filled with flowering lotuses and lilies, आकाशवर्णप्रतिमान् resembling the hue of the sky (blue), स्वच्छतोयान् pure and tranparent waters, सुखप्लवान् good and comfortable tanks for swimming in, ह्रदान् lakes, पशूनाम् for animals, निर्वापार्थान् for refreshing, नीपवैडूर्यवर्णांश्च like kadamva trees as green as the sapphire, मृदून् soft, यवसञ्चयान् heaps of grass collected together, ददृशुः beheld.

text: व्यस्मयन्त मनुष्यास्ते स्वप्नकल्पं तदद्भुतम् । दृष्ट्वातिथ्यं कृतं तादृक् भरतस्य महर्षिणा ॥२-९१-८०॥
translation: The men were amazed when they beheld the wonderful hospitality extended by maharshi Bharadwaja to Bharata, as if all this happened in a dream world.
word_meanings: ते मनुष्याः those men, महर्षिणा by the sage, भरतस्य to Bharata, कृतम् provided, तादृक् such, स्वप्नकल्पम् like a dream, अद्भुतम् wonderful, तत् that, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, दृष्ट्वा beholding, व्यस्मयन्त were amazed.

text: इत्येवं रममाणानां देवानामिव नन्दने । भरद्वाजाश्रमे रम्ये सा रात्रिर्व्यत्यवर्त्तत ॥२-९१-८१॥
translation: As they were enjoying themselves in Bharadwaja's hermitage like the gods in the garden of Indra the night wore off.
word_meanings: इत्येवम् like this, नन्दने in the garden of Indra, देवानामिव as for gods, रम्ये in the lovely, भरद्वाजाश्रमे in Bharadwaja's hermitage, रममाणानाम् enjoying so, सा रात्रिः that night, व्यत्यवर्तत passed off.

text: प्रतिजग्मुश्च ता नद्यो गन्धर्वाश्च यथागतम् । भरद्वाजमनुज्ञाप्य ताश्च सर्वा वराङ्गना: ॥२-९१-८२॥
translation: Those rivers, the gandharvas and all those lovely women took leave of sage Bharadwaja and returned to where they had come from.
word_meanings: ताः नद्यः those rivers, गन्धर्वाश्च and the gandharvas, सर्वाः all, ताः of them, वराङ्गनाश्च lovely women too, भरद्वाजम् Bharadwaja's, अनुज्ञाप्य obtaining permission, यथागतम् from whereever they had come, प्रतिजग्मुश्च returned.

text: तथैव मत्ता मदिरोत्कटा नरास्तथैव दिव्यागुरुचन्दनोक्षिता: । तथैव दिव्या विविधा: स्रगुत्तमा: पृथक् प्रकीर्णा मनुजै: प्रमर्दिता: ॥२-९१-८३॥
ततस्तां रजनीं व्युष्य भरत: सपरिच्छद: । कृतातिथ्यो भरद्वाजं कामादभिजगाम ऺह ॥२-९२-१॥
translation: Bharata with his retinue received the hospitality and spent the night at Bharadwaja's ashram. Then he approached Bharadwaja on his own.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, कृतातिथ्यः having received the hospitality, सपरिच्छदः with his retinue, भरतः Bharata, तां रजनीम् that night, उष्य having spent, कामात् intention of, भरद्वाजम् Bharadwaja, अभिजगाम ह approached.

text: तमृषि: पुरुषव्याघ्रं प्राञ्जलिं प्रेक्ष्य चागतम् । हुताग्निहोत्रो भरतं भरद्वाजो ऽभ्यभाषत ॥२-९२-२॥
translation: Seeing Bharata, the best among men, who stood with folded palms, sage Bharadwaja, who had just completed his firesacrifice, said to him:
word_meanings: हुताग्निहोत्रः who had completed his firesacrifice, भरद्वाजः ऋषिः sage Bharadwaja, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् tiger among men, प्राञ्जलिम् with folded palms, आगतम् arrived, तं भरतम् to Bharata, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, अभ्यभाषत spoke.

text: कच्चिदत्र सुखा रात्रिस्तवास्मद्विषये गता । समग्रस्ते जन: कच्चिदातिथ्ये शंस मे ऽनघ ॥२-९२-३॥
translation: O sinless one hope, you spent the night at our hermitage well? Tell me whether all your people enjoyed the hospitality?
word_meanings: अत्र here, अस्मद्विषये at our place, तव to you, रात्रिः night, सुखम् happily, गता कच्चित् hope you spent, हे अनघ O sinless one, आतिथ्ये in the matter of hospitality, ते जनः your people, समग्रः कच्चित् all well, मे शंस tell me.

text: तमुवाचाञ्जलिं कृत्वा भरतो ऽभिप्रणम्य च । आश्रमादभिनिष्क्रान्तमृषिमुत्तमतेजसम् ॥२-९२-४॥
translation: Bharata saluted with folded palms the sage of great powers. And emerging from the hermitage, replied:
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, आश्रमात् from the hermitage, अभिनिष्क्रान्तम् emerging, उत्तमतेजसम् great power, तम् ऋषिम् that sage, अञ्जलिं कृत्वा with palms joined together, अभिप्रणम्य च and saluting him, उवाच said:

text: सुखोषितो ऽस्मि भगवन् समग्रबलवाहन: । तर्पित: सर्वकामैश्च सामात्यो बलवत्त्वया ॥२-९२-५॥
translation: O holy one, I with my ministers and the entire army of men and animals passed the night happily. All our desires have been gratified by you.
word_meanings: भगवन् O holy one, सामात्यः with my ministers, समग्रबलवाहनः with the entire army and animals, त्वया by you, बलवत् exceedingly, सर्वकामैः with all desires, तर्पितः gratified, सुखोषितः अस्मि passed pleasantly.

text: अपेतक्लमसन्तापा: सुभिक्षा: सुप्रतिश्रया: । अपि प्रेष्यानुपादाय सर्वे स्म सुसुखोषिता: ॥२-९२-६॥
translation: All of us including the messengers were released from fatigue and heat. We were wellfed and wellhoused and the night was wellspent.
word_meanings: प्रेष्यान् अपि even the messengers, उपादाय including, सर्वे all of us, अपेतक्लमसन्तापाः freed from fatigue and heat, सुभिक्षाः wellnourished, सुप्रतिश्रयाः wellhoused, सुसुखोषिताः स्मः we passed (the night) happily

text: आमन्त्रये ऽहं भगवन् कामं त्वामृषिसत्तम । समीपं प्रस्थितं भ्रातुर्मैत्रेणेक्षस्व चक्षुषा ॥२-९२-७॥
translation: O venerable one O excellent of the ascetics I seek your leave. As I am proceeding to see my brother, bless me with a kindly look.
word_meanings: भगवन् O venerable one, ऋषिसत्तमः O excellent of the ascetics, अहम् I, त्वाम् you, कामम् greatly, आमन्त्रये I take leave of you, भ्रातुः brother's, समीपम् to, प्रस्थितम् set out, मैत्रेण friendly, चक्षुषा with eye, ईक्षस्व you may consider.

text: आश्रमं तस्य धर्मज्ञ धार्मिकस्य महात्मन: । आचक्ष्व कतमो मार्ग: कियानिति च शंस मे ॥२-९२-८॥
translation: O knower of righteousness Tell me which path leads to the hermitage of that righteous and magnanimous one (Rama)? And how far is it (from here)?
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञ O knower of righteous ways, धार्मिकस्य of the righteous, तस्य महात्मनः of that magnanimous one, आश्रमम् hermitage, आचक्ष्व tell me, कतमः which, मार्गः is the path कियान् how far, इति च that one also, मे to me, शंस tell.

text: इति पृष्टस्तु भरतं भ्रातृदर्शनलालसम् । प्रत्युवाच महातेजा भरद्वाजो महातपा: ॥२-९२-९॥
translation: Thus questioned, the great sage, brilliant Bharadwaja replied to Bharata who was yearning to see his brother:
word_meanings: महातेजाः brilliant, महातपाः a great sage, भरद्वाजः Bharadwaja, इति thus, पृष्टः questioned, भ्रातृदर्शनलालसम् yearning to see his brother, भरतम् to Bharata, प्रत्युवाच replied.

text: भरतार्द्धतृतीयेषु योजनेष्वजने वने । चित्रकूटो गिरिस्तत्र रम्यनिर्दरकानन: ॥२-९२-१०॥
translation: O Bharata, three and a half yojanas from here in the lonely forest stands mount Chitrakuta, with its charming streams and woodlands
word_meanings: भरत O Bharata, अर्धतृतीयेषु three and a half, योजनेषु yojanas (one yojana is equivalent to eight miles), तत्र there, अजने lonely, वने forest, रम्यनिर्झरकाननः with charming streams and woodlands, चित्रकूटः Chitrakuta, गिरिः mountain (is there).

text: उत्तरं पार्श्वमासाद्य तस्य मन्दाकिनी नदी । पुष्ऺिपतद्रुमसञ्छन्ना रम्यपुष्पितकानना ॥२-९२-११॥
translation: On its northern side flows the river Mandakini which is densely covered with flowering trees and lovely blossoming woods (on its banks).
word_meanings: तस्य its, उत्तरं पार्श्वम् northern side, आसाद्य having reached, पुष्पितद्रुमसञ्चन्ना covered with flowering trees, रम्यपुष्पितकानना with lovely, blossoming woods, मन्दाकिनी नदी there is river Mandakini.

text: अनन्तरं तत्सरितश्चित्रकूटश्च पर्वत: । तयो: पर्णकुटी तात तत्र तौ वसतो ध्रुवम् ॥२-९२-१२॥
translation: O dear child, beyond that river lies mount Chitrakuta on which there is a hut made of leaves where, for sure, they both dwell.
word_meanings: तत्सरितः that river, अनन्तरम् beyond, चित्रकूटः Chitrkuta, पर्वतः mountain, तयोः their, पर्णकुटी leafy hut, तात O dear child, तौ both of them, तत्र there, वसतः are living, ध्रुवम् this is certain.

text: दक्षिणेनैव मार्गेण सव्यदक्षिणमेव वा । गजवाजिरथाकीर्णां वाहिनीं वाहिनीपते । वाहयस्व महाभाग ततो द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् ॥२-९२-१३॥
translation: O distinguished lord of the army, if you lead your army full of elephants, horses and chariots through the southern path or towards the southwest, you will come across Rama there.
word_meanings: वाहिनीपते lord of the army, महाभाग O distinguished one, गजवाजिरथाकीर्णाम् consisting of elephants, horses and chariots, वाहिनीम् army, दक्षिणेनैव to its south, मार्गेण through the path, सव्यदक्षिणमेव वा or towards southwest, वाहयस्व lead, ततः thereafter, राघवम् Rama, द्रक्षयसि you will see.

text: प्रयाणमिति तच्छ्रुत्वा राजराजस्य योषित: । हित्वा यानानि यानार्हा ब्राह्मणं पर्य्यवारयन् ॥२-९२-१४॥
translation: When they heard about the journey, the wives of Dasaratha descended from their chariots worthy of them and stood around the brahmin, Bharadwaja.
word_meanings: इति thus, प्रयाणम् about journey, श्रुत्वा having heard, यानार्हाः chariots worthy of them, राजराजस्य king of kings, Dasaratha's, योषितः wives, यानानि carriages, हित्वा leaving, ब्राह्मणम् that brahmin, पर्यवारयन् stood around.

text: वेपमाना कृशा ऺदीना सह देव्या सुमित्रया । कौसल्या तत्र जग्राह कराभ्यां चरणौ मुने: ॥२-९२-१५॥
translation: Among them was Kausalya, trembling, emaciated and desolate, along with Sumitra. They grasped the feet of sage Bharadwaja with their hands.
word_meanings: तत्र among them, कृशा emaciated, दीना desolate, कौसल्या Kausalya, वेपमाना trembling, मुनेः sage's, चरणौ feet, सुमित्रया देव्या सह along with Sumitra, जग्राह grasped.

text: असमृद्धेन कामेन सर्वलोकस्य गर्हिता । कैकेयी तस्य जग्राह चरणौ सव्यपत्रपा ॥२-९२-१६॥
translation: Kaikeyi with her unfulfilled desire and despised in all the worlds overcome with shame, also grasped his feet.
word_meanings: असमृद्धेन with unfulfilled, कामेन with desire, सर्वलोकस्य for all the worlds, गर्हिता despised, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, सव्यपत्रपा overcome with shame, तस्य his, चरणौ feet, जग्राह grasped.

text: तं प्रदक्षिणमागम्य भगवन्तं महामुनिम् । अदूराद्भरतस्यैव तस्थौ दीनमनास्तदा ॥२-९२-१७॥
translation: She reverently circumambulated that great and divine ascetic and stood not far away from Bharata with a sad heart.
word_meanings: तदा then, भगवन्तम् divine, तं महामुनिम् that great ascetic, प्रदक्षिणं आगम्य reverently circumambulated, दीनमनाः with a sad heart, भरतस्य from Bharata, अदूरादेव not far away, तस्थौ stood.

text: तत: पप्रच्छ भरतं भरद्वाजो दृढव्रत: । विशेषं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि मातऽणां तव राघव ॥२-९२-१८॥
translation: Then Bharadwaja, firm in his vows, said to Bharata, I want to know about your mothers individually.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, दृढव्रतः firm in vows, भरद्वाजः Bharadwaja, भरतम् Bharata, पप्रच्छ enquired, राघव O Bharata, तव your, मात्रूणाम् mothers, विशेषम् individually, ज्ञातुम् to know, इच्छामि want desiring.

text: एवमुक्तस्तु भरतो भरद्वाजेन धार्मिक: । उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा वाक्यं वचनकोविद: ॥२-९२-१९॥
translation: Thus asked by the sagacious Bharadwaja, Bharata, proficient in speech, replied with palms folded in reverence:
word_meanings: धीमता by the sagacious, भरद्वाजेन by Bharadwaja, एवम् thus, उक्तः asked, वचनकोविदः proficient in speech, भरतः Bharata, प्राञ्जलि: भूत्वा with palms joined together in reverence, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said.

text: यामिमां भगवन् दीनां शोकानशनकर्शिताम् । पितुर्हि महिषीं देवीं देवतामिव पश्यसि ॥२-९२-२०॥
translation: O venerable sage, this queen you are looking at, forlorn and emaciated due to grief and fasting, and who resembles a goddess is Kausalya, the principal queen of my father. As Aditi bore Dhata, she bore Rama, the best among men who walks with the powerful stride of a lion.
word_meanings: भगवन् O venerable one, दीनाम् desolate, शोकानशनकर्शिताम् emaciated due to grief and fasting, पितुः father's, महिषीम् principal queen, देवतामिव resembling a goddess, याम् इमाम् देवीम् that this queen, पश्यसि you are seeing, एषा she, कौसल्या is Kausalya, अदितिः Aditi, धातारं यथा like Dhata, सिंहविक्रान्तगामिनम् walking with the powerful stride of a lion, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् tiger among men, तं रामम् that Rama, सुषुवे gave birth.

text: एषा तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं सिंहविक्रान्तगामिनम् । कौसल्या सुषुवे रामं धातारमदितिर्यथा ॥२-९२-२१॥
translation: O venerable sage, this queen you are looking at, forlorn and emaciated due to grief and fasting, and who resembles a goddess is Kausalya, the principal queen of my father. As Aditi bore Dhata, she bore Rama, the best among men who walks with the powerful stride of a lion.
word_meanings: भगवन् O venerable one, दीनाम् desolate, शोकानशनकर्शिताम् emaciated due to grief and fasting, पितुः father's, महिषीम् principal queen, देवतामिव resembling a goddess, याम् इमाम् देवीम् that this queen, पश्यसि you are seeing, एषा she, कौसल्या is Kausalya, अदितिः Aditi, धातारं यथा like Dhata, सिंहविक्रान्तगामिनम् walking with the powerful stride of a lion, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् tiger among men, तं रामम् that Rama, सुषुवे gave birth.

text: अस्यावामभुजं श्लिष्टा यैषा तिष्ठति दुर्मना: । कर्णिकारस्य शाखेव शीर्णपुष्पा वनान्तरे ॥२-९२-२२॥
translation: This lady plunged in grief, resembling the branch of a karnikara tree in the midst of the forest with blossoms withered and leaning on the left arm of Kausalya, is queen Sumitra, mother of two heroes, comparable to gods in beauty and possessing true prowess -- Lakshmana and Satrughna.
word_meanings: या एषा this woman, दुर्मनाः plunged in grief, वनान्तरे in the midst of the forest, शीर्णपुष्पा with blossoms withered, कर्णिकारस्य of the karnikara tree, शाखेव like a branch, अस्याः this Kausalya's, वामभुजम् left arm, श्लिष्टा leaning, तिष्ठति standing, कुमारौ two princes, देववर्णिनौ equal to gods in beauty, वीरौ heroes, सत्यपराक्रमौ possessing no vain prowess, लक्षणशत्रुघ्नौ Lakshmana and Satrughna, उभौ both, एतस्या देव्या: this queen's, सुतौ sons.

text: एतस्यास्तु सुतौ देव्या: कुमारौ देववर्णिनौ । उभौ लक्ष्मणशत्रुघ्नौ वीरौ सत्यपराक्रमौ ॥२-९२-२३॥
translation: This lady plunged in grief, resembling the branch of a karnikara tree in the midst of the forest with blossoms withered and leaning on the left arm of Kausalya, is queen Sumitra, mother of two heroes, comparable to gods in beauty and possessing true prowess -- Lakshmana and Satrughna.
word_meanings: या एषा this woman, दुर्मनाः plunged in grief, वनान्तरे in the midst of the forest, शीर्णपुष्पा with blossoms withered, कर्णिकारस्य of the karnikara tree, शाखेव like a branch, अस्याः this Kausalya's, वामभुजम् left arm, श्लिष्टा leaning, तिष्ठति standing, कुमारौ two princes, देववर्णिनौ equal to gods in beauty, वीरौ heroes, सत्यपराक्रमौ possessing no vain prowess, लक्षणशत्रुघ्नौ Lakshmana and Satrughna, उभौ both, एतस्या देव्या: this queen's, सुतौ sons.

text: यस्या: कृते नरव्याघ्रौ जीवनाशमितो गतौ । राजपुत्रविहीनश्च स्वर्गं दशरथो गत: ॥२-९२-२४॥
translation: She is my mother Kaikeyi who is irascible, lacks the power of discrimination, proud, boastful of her beauty, ambitious of wealth, ignoble in the guise of a noble woman, wicked and intent on sinful acts. Behold her. You may know that because of her, Rama and Lakshmana the best of men entered the forest which may cause their destruction and king Dasaratha attained heaven. She alone is the root of this great calamity that I am presently confronting.
word_meanings: यस्याः कृते on whose account, नरव्याघ्रौ best of men (Rama and Lakshmana), इतः from here, जीवनाशम् destruction of life, गतौ obtained, राजा दशरथः king Dasaratha, पुत्रविहीनश्च deprived of his son, स्वर्गम् heaven, गतः attained, आत्मन: mine, महत् great, व्यसनम् calamity, यतोमूलम् the root cause of, पश्यामि I see, क्रोधानाम् irascible, अकृतप्रज्ञाम् is not discerning, दृप्ताम् proud, सुभगमानिनीम् considers herself beautiful, ऐश्वर्यकामाम् ambitious of wealth, अनार्याम् ignoble, आर्यरूपिणीम् in the guise of a noble woman, एताम् she, नृशंसाम् wicked, पापनिश्चयाम् intent on sinful acts, मम my, मातरम् mother, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, विद्धि you may know.

text: क्रोधनामकृतप्रज्ञां दृप्तां सुभगमानिनीम् । ऐश्वर्यकामां कैकेयीमनार्य्यामार्यरूपिणीम् ॥२-९२-२५॥
translation: She is my mother Kaikeyi who is irascible, lacks the power of discrimination, proud, boastful of her beauty, ambitious of wealth, ignoble in the guise of a noble woman, wicked and intent on sinful acts. Behold her. You may know that because of her, Rama and Lakshmana the best of men entered the forest which may cause their destruction and king Dasaratha attained heaven. She alone is the root of this great calamity that I am presently confronting.
word_meanings: यस्याः कृते on whose account, नरव्याघ्रौ best of men (Rama and Lakshmana), इतः from here, जीवनाशम् destruction of life, गतौ obtained, राजा दशरथः king Dasaratha, पुत्रविहीनश्च deprived of his son, स्वर्गम् heaven, गतः attained, आत्मन: mine, महत् great, व्यसनम् calamity, यतोमूलम् the root cause of, पश्यामि I see, क्रोधानाम् irascible, अकृतप्रज्ञाम् is not discerning, दृप्ताम् proud, सुभगमानिनीम् considers herself beautiful, ऐश्वर्यकामाम् ambitious of wealth, अनार्याम् ignoble, आर्यरूपिणीम् in the guise of a noble woman, एताम् she, नृशंसाम् wicked, पापनिश्चयाम् intent on sinful acts, मम my, मातरम् mother, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, विद्धि you may know.

text: ममैतां मातरं विद्धि नृशंसां पापनिश्चयाम् । यतो मूलं हि पश्यामि व्यसनं महदात्मन: ॥२-९२-२६॥
translation: She is my mother Kaikeyi who is irascible, lacks the power of discrimination, proud, boastful of her beauty, ambitious of wealth, ignoble in the guise of a noble woman, wicked and intent on sinful acts. Behold her. You may know that because of her, Rama and Lakshmana the best of men entered the forest which may cause their destruction and king Dasaratha attained heaven. She alone is the root of this great calamity that I am presently confronting.
word_meanings: यस्याः कृते on whose account, नरव्याघ्रौ best of men (Rama and Lakshmana), इतः from here, जीवनाशम् destruction of life, गतौ obtained, राजा दशरथः king Dasaratha, पुत्रविहीनश्च deprived of his son, स्वर्गम् heaven, गतः attained, आत्मन: mine, महत् great, व्यसनम् calamity, यतोमूलम् the root cause of, पश्यामि I see, क्रोधानाम् irascible, अकृतप्रज्ञाम् is not discerning, दृप्ताम् proud, सुभगमानिनीम् considers herself beautiful, ऐश्वर्यकामाम् ambitious of wealth, अनार्याम् ignoble, आर्यरूपिणीम् in the guise of a noble woman, एताम् she, नृशंसाम् wicked, पापनिश्चयाम् intent on sinful acts, मम my, मातरम् mother, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, विद्धि you may know.

text: इत्युक्त्वा नरशार्दूलो बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा । स निशश्वास ताम्राक्षो नाग: क्रुद्ध इव श्वसन् ॥२-९२-२७॥
translation: Thus spoke Bharata, the best of men, with his eyes reddened and voice choked with sobs and hissing like a king cobra.
word_meanings: ताम्राक्षः with reddened eyes, नरशार्दूलः tiger among men, सः that Bharata, बाष्पगद्गदया in a voice choked with tears, गिरा with words, इति thus,उक्त्वा having said, कृद्धः angry, श्वसन् sighing, नागः इव like a king cobra, निश्स्वास heaved sighs.

text: भरद्वाजो महर्षिस्तं ब्रुवन्तं भरतं तथा । प्रत्युवाच महाबुद्धिरिदं वचनमर्थवत् ॥२-९२-२८॥
translation: Hearing the words of Bharata, the great sage, wise Bharadwaja replied with meaningful words:
word_meanings: महाबुद्धि: wise, महर्षिः great sage Maharshi, भरद्वाजः Bharadwaja, तथा thus, ब्रुवन्तम् speaking, तं भरतम् to that Bharata, अर्थवत् significant, इदं वचनम् these words, प्रत्युवाच replied.

text: न दोषेणावगन्तव्या कैकेयी भरत त्वया । रामप्रव्राजनं ह्येतत् सुखोदर्कं भविष्यति ॥२-९२-२९॥
translation: O Bharata, you should not find fault with Kaikeyi. Rama's banishment will prove a great source of happiness in future (for mankind).
word_meanings: भरत O Bharata, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, त्वया by you, दोषेण with any fault, न अवगन्तव्या should not be imputed, एतत् this, रामप्रव्राजनम् banishment of Rama, सुखोदर्कम् of great felicity, भविष्यति हि will become.

text: देवानां दानवानां च ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम् । हितमेव भविष्यद्धि रामप्रव्राजनादिह ॥२-९२-३०॥
translation: Banishment of Rama will bring about the welfare of the gods, the demons, and the sages of purified souls.
word_meanings: इह now, रामप्रव्राजनात् by banishing Rama, देवानाम् of gods, दानवानां च of demous, भावितात्मनाम् of purified souls, ऋषीणां rishis', हितमेव also welfare, भविष्यद्धि shall become.

text: अभिवाद्य तु संसिद्ध: कृत्वा चैनं प्रदक्षिणम् । आमन्त्र्य भरत: सेन्यं युज्यतामित्यचोदयत् ॥२-९२-३१॥
translation: Having paid obeisance, the accomplished Bharata circumambulated sage Bharadwaja, look leave of him, and ordered his army to get ready.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, एनम् him, अभिवाद्य having paid obeisance, संसिद्धः getting ready for the journey, प्रदक्षिणं च कृत्वा having circumambulated, आमन्त्र्य having taken leave of him, युज्यताम् इति Be harnessed, सैन्यम् the army, अचोदयत् urged.

text: ततो वाजिरथान् युक्त्वा दिव्यान् हेमपरिष्कृतान् । अध्यारोहत् प्रयाणार्थी बहून् बहुविधो जन: ॥२-९२-३२॥
translation: Different groups of people intending to depart harnessed excellent horsechariots decorated with gold.
word_meanings: ततः then, बहुविधः different types, जनः people, प्रयाणार्थी wishing to proceed, दिव्यान् excellent, हेमपरिष्कृतान् decorated with gold, युक्तान् harnessed, वाजिरथान् horsechariots, अध्यारोहत् mounted.

text: गजकन्या गजाश्चैव हेमकक्ष्या: पताकिन: । जीमूता इव घर्मान्ते सघोषा: सम्प्रतस्थिरे ॥२-९२-३३॥
translation: The male and female elephants wearing golden girths and decorated with pennants, set forth with their bells sounding like thunderclouds at the end of summer.
word_meanings: हेमकक्ष्याः with golden girths, पताकिनः with pennants, गजकन्याः female elephants, गजाश्चैव also male elephants, घर्मान्ते at the close of summer, जीमूताः इव like thunderclouds, सघोषाः with sounds, सम्प्रतस्थिरे set forth.

text: विविधान्यपि यानानि महान्ति च लघूनि च । प्रययु: सुमहार्हाणि पादैरेव पदातय: ॥२-९२-३४॥
translation: Various types of costly carriages, large and small, set forth, while the infantry marched on.
word_meanings: महन्ति च large ones, लघूनि च small ones, विविधानि of various kinds, सुमहार्हाणि costly, यानानि had carriages, प्रययुः set forth, पदातयः footsoldiers, पादैरेव set out on foot it self.

text: अथ यानप्रवेकैस्तु कौसल्याप्रमुखा: स्त्रिय: । रामदर्शनकांक्षिण्य: प्रययुर्मुदितास्तदा ॥२-९२-३५॥
translation: The women headed by Kausalya, eager to see Rama, proceeded delightfully in distinguished carriages.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, कौसल्याप्रमुखाः headed by Kausalya, स्त्रियः women, रामदर्शनकाङ्क्षिण्यः eager to see Rama, मुदिताः delightfully, तदा then, यानप्रवेकैः in distinguished carriages, प्रययुः went.

text: चन्द्रार्कतरुणाभासां नियुक्तां शिबिकां शुभाम् । आस्थाय प्रययौ श्रीमान् भरत: सपरिच्छद: ॥२-९२-३६॥
translation: Magnanimous Bharata got into an auspicious palanquin of the splendour of the Sun and the Moon kept ready and proceeded amidst escorts.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् majestic, भरतः Bharata, चन्द्रार्कतरुणाभासाम् with the splendour of the Sun and the Moon, निर्युक्ताम् kept ready, शुभाम् auspicious, शिबिकाम् palanquin, आस्थाय having got in, सपरिच्छदः with retinue, प्रययौ proceeded.

text: सा प्रयाता महासेना गजवाजिरथाकुला । दक्षिणां दिशमावृत्य महामेघ इवोत्थित: ॥२-९२-३७॥
translation: That vast army teeming with elephants, horses and chariots proceeded southward spreading like a lofty cloud that had risen in the sky, traversing through the forests full of birds and beasts, passing through the mountains and streams on the other side of the river Ganga.
word_meanings: गजवाजिरथाकुला teeming with elephants, horses and chariots, सा महासेना that vast army, उत्थितः that has arisen, महामेघ इव like a lofty cloud, दक्षिणां दिशम् southward, आवृत्य having spread, मृगपक्षिभिः with birds and beasts, जुष्टानि visited, वनानि forests, व्यतिक्रम्य traversing, गङ्गाया: river Ganga's, परवेलायाम् on the other side, गिरिष्वपि through mountains also, नदीषु च and streams, प्रयाता proceeded.

text: वनानि तु व्यतिक्रम्य जुष्टानि मृगपक्षिभि: । गङ्गाया: परवेलायां गिरिष्वपि नदीषु च ॥२-९२-३८॥
translation: That vast army teeming with elephants, horses and chariots proceeded southward spreading like a lofty cloud that had risen in the sky, traversing through the forests full of birds and beasts, passing through the mountains and streams on the other side of the river Ganga.
word_meanings: गजवाजिरथाकुला teeming with elephants, horses and chariots, सा महासेना that vast army, उत्थितः that has arisen, महामेघ इव like a lofty cloud, दक्षिणां दिशम् southward, आवृत्य having spread, मृगपक्षिभिः with birds and beasts, जुष्टानि visited, वनानि forests, व्यतिक्रम्य traversing, गङ्गाया: river Ganga's, परवेलायाम् on the other side, गिरिष्वपि through mountains also, नदीषु च and streams, प्रयाता proceeded.

text: सा सम्प्रहृष्टद्विजवाजियोधा वित्रासयन्ती मृगपक्षिसङ्घान् । महद्वनं तत्प्रतिगाहमाना रराज सेना भरतस्य तत्र ॥२-९२-३९॥
translation: Bharata's army of soldiers, elephants and horses, all in high spirits, looked splendid while entering the forest full of frightening flocks of birds and beasts. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्विनवतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetysecond sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सम्प्रहृष्टद्विपवाजियोधा with soldiers, elephants and horses in high spirits, मृगपक्षिसङ्घान् flocks of birds and beasts, वित्रासयन्ती frightening, भरतस्य Bharata's, सा सेना that army, तत्र there, तत् that, महत् great, वनम् forest, प्रतिगाहमाना while entering, रराज looked splendid.

text: तया महत्या यायिन्या ध्वजिन्या वनवासिन: । अर्द्दिता यूथपा मत्ता: सयूथा: सम्प्रदुद्रुवु: ॥२-९३-१॥
translation: On seeing the great army marching, the exited leaders of herds of elephants inhabiting the forest were frightened and ran off with their herds.
word_meanings: यायिन्या while on the march, महत्या by the great, तया that, ध्वजिन्या by the army, वनवासिनः foresters, मत्ताः exited, यूथपाः the leaders of herds, अर्दिताः were frightened, सयूथाः with herds, सम्प्रदुद्रुवुः ran off.

text: ऋक्षा: पृषतसङ्घाश्च रुरवश्च समतन्त: । दृश्यन्ते वनराजीषु गिरिष्वपि नदीषु च ॥२-९३-२॥
translation: Bears, herds of dappled gazelle and antelopes could be seen everywhere in the stretches of the forest, also on the mountains and on the river banks.
word_meanings: वनराजीषु in the stretches of the forest, गिरिष्वपि also on the mountains, नदीषु च at the river banks, समन्ततः on all sides, ऋक्षाः bears, पृषतसङ्घाश्च herds of dappled gazelle, रुरवश्च antelopes, दृश्यन्ते could be seen

text: स सम्प्रतस्थे धर्मात्मा प्रीतो दशरथात्मज: । वृतो महत्या नादिन्या सेनया चतुरङ्गया ॥२-९३-३॥
translation: Bharata the righteous son of Dasaratha, proceeded with great delight in the company of the clamouring army of four divisions.
word_meanings: धर्मत्मा the righteous, सः दशरथात्मजः that son of Dasaratha (Bharata), प्रीतः was delighted, नादिन्या clamouring, महत्या great, चतुरङ्गया of four divisions, सेनया with army, वृतः surrounded by, सम्प्रतस्थे proceeded.

text: सागरौघनिभा सेना भरतस्य महात्मन: । महीं सञ्छादयामास प्रावृषि द्यामिवाम्बुद: ॥२-९३-४॥
translation: The army of the magnanimous Bharata, resembling the waves of the ocean, covered the earth as the clouds cover the sky during the rainy season.
word_meanings: महात्मनः of the magnanimous one, भरतस्य Bharata's, सागरौघनिभा resembling the waves of ocean, सेना the army, प्रावृषि during the rainy season, अम्बुदः cloud, द्यामिव like the sky, महीम् the earth, सञ्छादयामास covered.

text: चिरकालमित्यनेन कदाचिल्लक्ष्यत इति गम्यते ॥२-९३-५॥
स यात्वा दूरमध्वानं सुपरिश्रान्तवाहन: । उवाच भरत: श्रीमान् वसिष्ठं मन्त्रिणां वरम् ॥२-९३-६॥
translation: With his draught animals extremely wearied by covering a great distance, the majestic Bharata said to Vasistha, the best of counsellors:
word_meanings: श्रीमान् the majestic one, सः भरतः that Bharata, दूरम् great, अध्वानम् distance, यात्वा having travelled, सुपरिश्रान्तवाहनः with draught animals extremely wearied, मन्त्रिणाम् among counsellors, वरम् the best, वसिष्ठम् addressing Vasistha, उवाच said.

text: यादृशं लक्ष्यते रूपं यथा चैव श्रुतं मया । व्यक्तं प्राप्ता: स्म तं देशं भरद्वाजो यमब्रवीत् ॥२-९३-७॥
translation: Looking at these surroundings and from what I had heard, it is clear that we have reached the region indicated by Bharadwaja.
word_meanings: यादृशम् whichever, रूपम् the appearance, लक्ष्यते is being observed, मया by me, यथा as, श्रुतं चैव has been heard, यम् about which region, भरद्वाजः Bharadwaja, अब्रवीत् spoke, तं देशम् that region, प्राप्ताः स्म we have reached, व्यक्तम् this is clear.

text: अयं गिरिश्चित्रकूट इयं मन्दाकिनी नदी । एतत् प्रकाशते दूरान्नीलमेघनिभं वनम् ॥२-९३-८॥
translation: This mountain is Chitrakuta and this river, Mandakini. The forest shines from a distance like a blue cloud.
word_meanings: अयम् गिरिः this is the mountain, चित्रकूटः is Chitrakuta, इयं नदी this is the river, मन्दाकिनी Mandakini, दूरात् from a distance, एतत् this, नीलमेघनिभम् like a blue cloud, वनम् forest, प्रकाशते is shining.

text: गिरे: सानूनि रम्याणि चित्रकूटस्य सम्प्रति । वारणैरवमृद्यन्ते मामकै: पर्वतोपमै: ॥२-९३-९॥
translation: The enchanting ridges of mount Chitrakuta are now trampled by my mountainlike elephants.
word_meanings: सम्प्रति now, मामकैः relating to me, पर्वतोपमैः resembling mountains, वारणैः with elephants, चित्रकूटस्य गिरेः Chitrkuta mountain's, रम्याणि enchanting, सानूनि ridges, अवमृद्यन्ते are being trampled.

text: मुञ्चन्ति कुसुमान्येते नगा: पर्वतसानुषु । नीला इवातपापाये तोयं तोयधरा घना: ॥२-९३-१०॥
translation: The trees on the mountain ridges are shedding flowers, like dense blue rainclouds showering water at the end of summer.
word_meanings: पर्वतसानुषु on the mountain ridges, एते नगाः these trees, आतपापाये at the end of summer, नीलाः blue, घनाः dense, तोयधराः rainclouds, तोयम् इव like showers, कुसुमानि flowers, मुञ्चन्ति are shedding.

text: किन्नराचरितं देशं पश्य शत्रुघ्न पर्वतम् । मृगै: समन्तादाकीर्णं मकरैरिव सागरम् ॥२-९३-११॥
translation: O Satrughna, behold this mountain frequented by kinneras and abounding in animals like great crocodiles in the ocean.
word_meanings: शत्रुघ्न O Satrughna, मकरैः with great crocodiles, सागरम् इव like ocean, समन्तात् everywhere, मृगैः with animals, आकीर्णम् abounding, किन्नराचरितम् frequented by kinneras, देशम् region, पर्वतम् mountain, पश्य behold.

text: एते मृगगणा भान्ति शीघ्रवेगा: प्रचोदिता: । वायुप्रविद्धा शरदि मेघराजिरिवाम्बरे ॥२-९३-१२॥
translation: Incited by the clamour of the army, these swiftrunning herds of deer expelled from their retreats resemble mass of clouds in the autumnal sky shattered by the wind.
word_meanings: प्रचोदिताः incited, शीघ्रवेगाः swiftfooted, एते these, मृगगणाः herds of deer, शरदि autumnal, अम्बरे sky, वायुप्रविद्धा expelled, मेघराजिरिव like mass of clouds, भान्ति are appearing.

text: कुर्वन्ति कुसुमापीडान् शिरस्सु सुरभीनमी । मेघप्रकाशै: फलकैर्दाक्षिणात्या यथा नरा: ॥२-९३-१३॥
translation: Like the people of the south, the trees on the mountain ridges with branches, brilliant like clouds, are crowned with fragrant flowers as adornments.
word_meanings: अमी these mountain ridges, मेघप्रकाशैः looking brilliant like clouds, फलकैः shields, दाक्षिणात्याः belonging to southern region, नराः यथा like people, शिरस्सु on their heads, सुरभीन् fragrant, कुसुमापीडान् flower adornments, कुर्वन्ति are making.

text: निष्कूजमिव भूत्वेदं वनं घोरप्रदर्शनम् । अयोध्येव जनाकीर्णा सम्प्रति प्रतिभाति मा ॥२-९३-१४॥
translation: This forest, dreadful in appearance was devoid of twittering of birds. But now it appears to me like Ayodhya thronged with people.
word_meanings: घोरप्रदर्शनम् dreadful in appearance, इदं वनम् this forest, निष्कूजमिव भूत्वा devoid of any twittering of birds, सम्प्रति now, जनाकीर्णा thronged with people, अयोध्येव like Ayodhya, मा to me, प्रतिभाति it appears.

text: खुरैरुदीरितो रेणुर्दिवं प्रच्छाद्य तिष्ठति । तं वहत्यनिल: शीघ्रं कुर्वन्निव मम प्रियम् ॥२-९३-१५॥
translation: While the dust kicked by the hooves of the horses enveloped the forest, the wind, as if to please me, is quickly blowing them away.
word_meanings: खुरैः by the hooves, उदीरितः kicked, रेणुः dust, दावम् the forest, प्रच्छाद्य having enveloped, तिष्ठति is set, अनिलः wind, मम to me, प्रियम् pleasure, कुर्वन् इव as if to give, शीघ्रम् quickly, तम् that dust, वहति transporting it.

text: स्यन्दनांस्तुरगोपेतान् सूतमुख्यैरधिष्ठितान् । एतान् सम्पतत: शीघ्रं पश्य शत्रुघ्न कानने ॥२-९३-१६॥
translation: Behold, O Satrughna, these chariots, commanded by excellent charioteers, harnessed with horses are flying through the forest.
word_meanings: शत्रुघ्न O Satrughna, कानने in the forest, शीघ्रम् quickly, सम्पततः flying, सूतमुख्यैः by excellent charioteers, अधिष्ठितान् commanded by, तुरगोपेतान् drawn by horses, एतान् these, स्यन्दनान् chariots, पश्य behold.

text: एतान् वित्रासितान् पश्य बर्हिण: प्रियदर्शनान् । एतमाविशत: शीघ्रमधिवासं पतत्ऺित्रण: ॥२-९३-१७॥
translation: Behold, these lovely frightened peacocks and other birds hurriedly entering their nests.
word_meanings: प्रियदर्शनान् pleasant to look, वित्रासितान् frightened, एतम् अधिवासम् their nests, शीघ्रम् hurriedly, आविशतः entering, एतान् these, बर्हिणः peacocks, पतत्रिणः birds, पश्य behold.

text: अतिमात्रमयं देशो मनोज्ञ: प्रतिभाति मा । तापसानां निवासो ऽयं व्यक्तं स्वर्गपथो यथा ॥२-९३-१८॥
translation: Being the abode of ascetics, this region looks very charming like the pathway to heaven.
word_meanings: अयं देशः this region, अतिमात्रम् very, मनोज्ञः charming, मे to me, प्रतिभाति appears, स्वर्गपथो यथा like pathway to heaven, अयम् this one, व्यक्तम् clearly, तापसानाम् ascetics', निवासः abode.

text: मृगा मृगीभि: सहिता बहव: पृषता वने । मनोज्ञरूपा लक्ष्यन्ते कुसुमैरिव चित्रिता: ॥२-९३-१९॥
translation: In this forest many a dappled deer with their mates looking as if painted with flowers are seen wandering about with a charming appearance.
word_meanings: वने in this forest, बहवः many, पृषताः मृगाः spotted deer, कुसुमैः with flowers, चित्रिता इव as if painted, मनोज्ञरूपाः of charming appearance, मृगीभिः does, सहिताः in the company of, दृश्यन्ते are seen.

text: साधुसैन्या: प्रतिष्ठन्तां विचिन्वन्तु च कानने । यथा तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ दृश्येते रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥२-९३-२०॥
translation: Let the soldiers set out and properly search the forest till such time the best of men, Rama and Lakshmana, are found.
word_meanings: पुरुषव्याघ्रौ best of men, तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ those Rama and Lakshmana, यथा how, दृश्येते they could be seen, सैन्याः soldiers, साधु properly, प्रतिष्ठन्ताम् let them proceed, कानने in the forest, विचिन्वन्तु च be searched.

text: भरतस्य वच: श्रुत्वा पुरुषा: शस्त्रपाणय: । विविशुस्तद्वनं शूरा धूमं च ददृशुस्तत: ॥२-९३-२१॥
translation: Hearing the words of Bharata, those valiant warriors with weapons in their hands entered the forest. Therafter, they observed a spiral of smoke rising.
word_meanings: भरतस्य Bharata's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, शस्त्रपाणयः with weapons in their hands, शूराः valiant, पुरुषाः men, तत् that, वनम् forest, विविशुः entered, ततः then, धूमम् smoke, ददृशुश्च observed.

text: ते समालोक्य धूमाग्रमूचुर्भरतमागता: । नामनुष्ये भवत्याग्निर्व्यक्तमत्रैव राघवौ ॥२-९३-२२॥
translation: Having seen the column of smoke, they returned and informed Bharata, saying, 'In a place bereft of men, fire cannot exist. Clearly Rama and Lakshmana must be here only.'
word_meanings: ते they, धूमाग्रम् column of smoke, समालोक्य having seen, भरतम् to Bharata, आगताः returned, ऊचुः communicated, अमनुष्ये in a place bereft of men, अग्नि: fire, न भवति cannot exist, व्यक्तम् clearly, राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, अत्रैव are here only.

text: अथ नात्र नरव्याघ्रौ राजपुत्रौ परन्तपौ । मन्ये रामोपमा: सन्ति व्यक्तमत्र तपस्विन: ॥२-९३-२३॥
translation: In case the two princes, Rama and Lakshmana, the best of men, and subduers of enemies are not residing here then evidently it must be some other ascetics like Rama.
word_meanings: अथ otherwise, नरव्याघ्रौ tigers among men, परन्तपौ subduers of enemies, राजपुत्रौ princes, अत्र न if they are not here, अत्र here, रामोपमाः resembling Rama, अन्ये other, तपस्विनः सन्ति ascetics are there, व्यक्तम् evident.

text: तच्छ्रुत्वा भरतस्तेषां वचनं साधुसम्मतम् । सैन्यानुवाच सर्वांस्तानमित्रबलमर्दन: ॥२-९३-२४॥
translation: Having heard these words acceptable to the pious, Bharata, the crusher of enemy forces, addressed the entire army:
word_meanings: अमित्रबलमर्दनः who crushes the hostile armies, भरतः Bharata, तेषाम् their, साधुसम्मतम् acceptable to the pious, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सर्वान् entire, तान् सैन्यान् to that entire army, उवाच said.

text: यत्ता भवन्तस्तिष्ठन्तु नेतो गन्तव्यमग्रत: । अहमेव गमिष्यामि सुमन्त्रो गुरुरेव च ॥२-९३-२५॥
translation: All of you carefully watch here. Do not proceed any further. Sumantra, the preceptor and myself shall go forward.
word_meanings: भवन्तः all of you, यत्ताः alertly, तिष्ठन्तु stay, इतः from here, अग्रतः forward, न गन्तव्यम् you should not proceed, अहमेव myself alone, गमिष्यामि I shall go, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, गुरुरेव च preceptor Vasistha also.

text: एवमुक्तास्तत: सर्वे तत्र तस्थु: समन्तत: । भरतो यत्र धूमाग्रं तत्र दृष्टिं समादधात् ॥२-९३-२६॥
translation: At this command, all of them halted. Then Bharata fixed his gaze on the source of the smoke.
