word_meanings: ततः thereafter, एवम् thus, उक्ताः spoken, सर्वे all of them, समन्ततः everyside, तत्र there, तस्थुः halted, भरतः Bharata, धूमाग्रम् column of smoke, यत्र where it is seen, तत्र there, दृष्टिम् gaze, समादधात् fixed.

text: व्यवस्थिता या भरतेन सा चमूर्निरीक्षमाणापि च धूममग्रत: । बभूव हृष्टा नचिरेण जानती प्रियस्य रामस्य समागमं तदा ॥२-९३-२७॥
translation: The army thus halted by Bharata, gazing at the space before them rejoiced at the thought that not long before they would rejoin their beloved Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रिनवतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetythird sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: या the army, भरतेन by Bharata, व्यवस्थिता has been halted, चमूः army, अग्रतः in the forefront, भूमिम् the space, निरीक्षमाणाऽपि च even though gazing at, न चिरेण not long before, तदा then, प्रियस्य of the beloved, रामस्य Rama's, समागमम् union, जानती knowing, हृष्टा बभूव rejoiced.

text: दीर्घकालोषितस्तस्मिन् गिरौ गिरिवनप्रिय: । वैदेह्या: प्रियमाकांक्षन् स्वं च चित्तं विलोभयन् ॥२-९४-१॥
translation: Rama, resembling the gods, who had been living there for long developed a liking for the mountains and forests. With a desire to please Sita and his own mind, he showed her the wonderful Chitrakuta mountain as Indra did to his wife Sachi.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, अमरसङ्काशः one who resembles the gods, गिरिवनप्रियः one fond of mountains and forests, तस्मिन् in that, गिरौ on the mountain, दीर्घकालोषितः who had been living for a long time, दाशरथिः Rama, वैदेह्याः Sita's, प्रियम् pleasure, आकाङ्क्षन् desiring, स्वम् own, चित्तम् mind, विलोभयन् to please, चित्रम् wonderful, चित्रकूटम् Chitrakuta mountain, भार्याम् to his consort, पुरन्दरः Indra (breaker of fortresses), शचीमिव like Sachi, अदर्शयत् showed.

text: अथ दाशरथिश्चित्रं चित्रकूटमदर्शयत् । भार्य्याममरसङ्काश: शचीमिव पुरन्दर: ॥२-९४-२॥
translation: Rama, resembling the gods, who had been living there for long developed a liking for the mountains and forests. With a desire to please Sita and his own mind, he showed her the wonderful Chitrakuta mountain as Indra did to his wife Sachi.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, अमरसङ्काशः one who resembles the gods, गिरिवनप्रियः one fond of mountains and forests, तस्मिन् in that, गिरौ on the mountain, दीर्घकालोषितः who had been living for a long time, दाशरथिः Rama, वैदेह्याः Sita's, प्रियम् pleasure, आकाङ्क्षन् desiring, स्वम् own, चित्तम् mind, विलोभयन् to please, चित्रम् wonderful, चित्रकूटम् Chitrakuta mountain, भार्याम् to his consort, पुरन्दरः Indra (breaker of fortresses), शचीमिव like Sachi, अदर्शयत् showed.

text: न राज्याद्भ्रंशनं भद्रे न सुहृद्भिर्विनाभव: । मनो मे बाधते दृष्ट्वा रमणीयमिमं गिरिम् ॥२-९४-३॥
translation: O gentle one, when I behold this lovely mountain, neither the expulsion from the kingdom nor being away from friends pains my mind.
word_meanings: हे भद्रे O gentle one, इमम् this, रमणीयम् lovely, गिरिम् mountain, दृष्ट्वा beholding, राज्यात् from the kingdom, भ्रंशनम् expulsion, मे मनः my mind, न बाधते does not pain, सुहृद्भिर्विनाभवः separation from friends, न does not pain.

text: पश्येममचलं भद्रे नानाद्विजगणायुतम् । शिखरै: खमिवोद्विद्धैर्द्धातुमद्भिर्विभूषितम् ॥२-९४-४॥
translation: O auspicious one, you may behold this mountin abounding in flocks of birds of every kind and its peaks adorned wtih minerals and as if piercing the sky.
word_meanings: भद्रे O auspicious one, नानाद्विजगणायुतम् abounding in flocks of birds of every kind, खम् the sky, उद्विद्धैरिव as if piercing, धातुमद्भि: with minerals, शिखरैः peaks, विभूषितम् adorned, इमम् this, अचलम् mountain, पश्य you may see.

text: केचिद्रजतसङ्काशा: केचित् क्षतजसन्निभा: । पीतमाञ्जिष्ठवर्णाश्च केचिन्मणिवरप्रभा: ॥२-९४-५॥
translation: This mountain with its peaks is adorned with various minerals. Some of the regions have the radiance of silver and bronze, some look bloodred or maddercrimson, some sparkle like the rarest of gems while others shine like topaz or crystal or a flower of ketaka plant or shimmer like stars and quicksilver.
word_meanings: धातुविभूषिताः adorned with minerals, अचलेन्द्रस्य of this lord of the mountains, केचित् some, देशाः regions, रजतसङ्काशाः similar to (the radiance of) silver, केचित् some regions, क्षतजसंनिभाः are having bloodred colour, पीतमाञ्जिष्टवर्णाश्च (some) colour of maddercrimson, केचित् some, मणिवरप्रभाः sparkle like the best of gems, पुष्यार्ककेतकाभाश्च shining like topaz, or crystal or a flower of ketaka plant, केचित् some, ज्योतीरसप्रभाः shimmering like stars or quicksilver, विराजन्ते shining.

text: पुष्पार्ककेतकाभाश्च केचिज्ज्योतीरसप्रभा: । विराजन्ते ऽचलेन्द्रस्य देशा धातुविभूषिता: ॥२-९४-६॥
translation: This mountain with its peaks is adorned with various minerals. Some of the regions have the radiance of silver and bronze, some look bloodred or maddercrimson, some sparkle like the rarest of gems while others shine like topaz or crystal or a flower of ketaka plant or shimmer like stars and quicksilver.
word_meanings: धातुविभूषिताः adorned with minerals, अचलेन्द्रस्य of this lord of the mountains, केचित् some, देशाः regions, रजतसङ्काशाः similar to (the radiance of) silver, केचित् some regions, क्षतजसंनिभाः are having bloodred colour, पीतमाञ्जिष्टवर्णाश्च (some) colour of maddercrimson, केचित् some, मणिवरप्रभाः sparkle like the best of gems, पुष्यार्ककेतकाभाश्च shining like topaz, or crystal or a flower of ketaka plant, केचित् some, ज्योतीरसप्रभाः shimmering like stars or quicksilver, विराजन्ते shining.

text: नानामृगगणद्वीपितरक्ष्वृक्षगणैर्वृत: । अदुष्टैर्भात्ययं शैलो बहुपक्षिसमायुत: ॥२-९४-७॥
translation: This mount Chitrakuta is swarmed by flocks of birds and herds of several kinds of animals like tigers, panthers and bears of every kind giving up their cruel nature.
word_meanings: अयं शैलः this mountain, अदुष्टैः without being cruel, नानामृगगणद्वीपितरर्क्ष्वृक्षगणैः with herds of several kinds of animals like tigers, panthers and bears, वृतः surrounded by, बहुपक्षिसमायुतः united with flocks of birds, भाति is shining.

text: आम्रजम्ब्वसनैर्लोध्रै: प्रियालै: पनसैर्धवै: । अङ्कोलैर्भव्यतिनिशैर्बिल्वतिन्दुकवेणुभि: ॥२-९४-८॥
translation: This mountain is spread over with various kinds of flowering trees and trees laden with fruits, shady and enchanting, mango, roseapples, asanas, lodhras, priyalas, jackfruit trees, dhavas, ankolas, lovely tinisas, bilva trees, tinduka and bamboo, kashmaya, arishta and varuna, madhukas, tilaka trees, badari and myrobalan trees, nipa trees, cane, danvas, and promegranate trees, the mountain looks splendid.
word_meanings: अयं गिरिः this mountain, पुष्पवद्भिः covered with flowers, फलोपेतैः laden with fruits, छायावद्भिः shady, मनोरमैः enchanting, आम्रजम्ब्वसनैः mango, roseapples, asana trees, लोध्रैः lodhra trees, प्रियालैः priyala trees, पनसैः jackfruit trees, धवैः dhava trees, अङ्कोलैः ankola trees, भव्यतिनिशैः lovely tinisa trees, बिल्वतिन्दुकवेणुभिः bilva trees, tinduka and bamboo, काश्मर्यारिष्टवरुणैः kashmaya, arishta and varuna तथा similarly,मधूकैः madhuka trees, तिलकैः tilaka trees, बदर्यामलकै: badari and myrobalan trees, नीपैः kodamva trees, वेत्रधन्वनबीजकैः cane, danvas, and promegranates, एवमादिभि: with these kinds of trees, आकीर्णः spread over, श्रियम् splendour, पुष्यति enhancing.

text: काश्मर्यरिष्टवरुणैर्मधूकैस्तिलकैस्तथा । बदर्य्यामलकैर्नीपैर्वेत्रधन्वनबीजकै: ॥२-९४-९॥
translation: This mountain is spread over with various kinds of flowering trees and trees laden with fruits, shady and enchanting, mango, roseapples, asanas, lodhras, priyalas, jackfruit trees, dhavas, ankolas, lovely tinisas, bilva trees, tinduka and bamboo, kashmaya, arishta and varuna, madhukas, tilaka trees, badari and myrobalan trees, nipa trees, cane, danvas, and promegranate trees, the mountain looks splendid.
word_meanings: अयं गिरिः this mountain, पुष्पवद्भिः covered with flowers, फलोपेतैः laden with fruits, छायावद्भिः shady, मनोरमैः enchanting, आम्रजम्ब्वसनैः mango, roseapples, asana trees, लोध्रैः lodhra trees, प्रियालैः priyala trees, पनसैः jackfruit trees, धवैः dhava trees, अङ्कोलैः ankola trees, भव्यतिनिशैः lovely tinisa trees, बिल्वतिन्दुकवेणुभिः bilva trees, tinduka and bamboo, काश्मर्यारिष्टवरुणैः kashmaya, arishta and varuna तथा similarly,मधूकैः madhuka trees, तिलकैः tilaka trees, बदर्यामलकै: badari and myrobalan trees, नीपैः kodamva trees, वेत्रधन्वनबीजकैः cane, danvas, and promegranates, एवमादिभि: with these kinds of trees, आकीर्णः spread over, श्रियम् splendour, पुष्यति enhancing.

text: पुष्पवद्भि: फलोपेतैश्छायावद्भिर्मनोरमै: । एवमादिभिराकीर्ण: श्रियं पुष्यत्ययं गिरि: ॥२-९४-१०॥
translation: This mountain is spread over with various kinds of flowering trees and trees laden with fruits, shady and enchanting, mango, roseapples, asanas, lodhras, priyalas, jackfruit trees, dhavas, ankolas, lovely tinisas, bilva trees, tinduka and bamboo, kashmaya, arishta and varuna, madhukas, tilaka trees, badari and myrobalan trees, nipa trees, cane, danvas, and promegranate trees, the mountain looks splendid.
word_meanings: अयं गिरिः this mountain, पुष्पवद्भिः covered with flowers, फलोपेतैः laden with fruits, छायावद्भिः shady, मनोरमैः enchanting, आम्रजम्ब्वसनैः mango, roseapples, asana trees, लोध्रैः lodhra trees, प्रियालैः priyala trees, पनसैः jackfruit trees, धवैः dhava trees, अङ्कोलैः ankola trees, भव्यतिनिशैः lovely tinisa trees, बिल्वतिन्दुकवेणुभिः bilva trees, tinduka and bamboo, काश्मर्यारिष्टवरुणैः kashmaya, arishta and varuna तथा similarly,मधूकैः madhuka trees, तिलकैः tilaka trees, बदर्यामलकै: badari and myrobalan trees, नीपैः kodamva trees, वेत्रधन्वनबीजकैः cane, danvas, and promegranates, एवमादिभि: with these kinds of trees, आकीर्णः spread over, श्रियम् splendour, पुष्यति enhancing.

text: शैलप्रस्थेषु रम्येषु पश्येमान् रोमहर्षणान् । किन्नरान् द्वन्द्वशो भद्रे रममाणान् मनस्विन: ॥२-९४-११॥
translation: O auspiciouslooking one, behold these highspirited kinneras in pairs who are sporting on the picturesque hill plateaus causing thrills.
word_meanings: भद्रे O auspicious one, रम्येषु in the beautiful, शैलप्रस्थेषु on the plateau, द्वन्द्वशः in pair, रममाणान् sporting, रोमहर्षणान् thrilling, मनस्विनः highspirited, इमान् these, किन्नरान् kinneras, पश्य behold.

text: शाखावसक्तान् खङ्गांश्च प्रवराण्यम्बराणि च । पश्च विद्याधरस्त्रीणां क्रीडोद्देशान् मनोरमान् ॥२-९४-१२॥
translation: Behold the captivating sporting retreats of Vidyadharis, with their swords and best garments hung on the branches of the trees.
word_meanings: विद्याधरस्त्रीणाम् by Vidyadhara women, शाखावसक्तान् hanging from the branches, खड्गांश्च swords, प्रवराणि best, अम्बराणि च garments, मनोरमान् captivating, क्रीडोद्धेशान् sporting retreats, पश्य behold.

text: जलप्रपातैरुद्भेदैर्निष्यन्दैश्च क्वचित् क्वचित् । स्रवद्भिर्भात्ययं शैल: स्रवन्मद इव द्विप: ॥२-९४-१३॥
translation: Behold a waterfall here and a fountain there gushing from the earth and in other places, the mountain looks like an elephant rutting ichor.
word_meanings: अयम् this, शैलः mountain, क्वचित् क्वचित् here and there, स्रवद्भिः by the flowing, जलप्रपातैः waterfalls, उद्भेदैः sprouting from the earth, निष्यन्दैश्च fountains, स्रवन्मदः emitting the ichor, द्विपः इव like the elephant, भाति shining.

text: गुहासमीरणो गन्धान् नानापुष्पभवान् वहन् । घ्राणतर्प्पणमभ्येत्य कं नरं न प्रहर्षयेत् ॥२-९४-१४॥
translation: The breeze from the caves carrying the fragrance of many flowers is satisfying the sense of smell. Who will not find it delightful?
word_meanings: नानापुष्पभवान् produced from many flowers, गन्धान् fragrance, वहन् carrying, गुहासमीरणः breeze from the caves, घ्राणतर्पणम् satisfying the sense of smell, अभ्येत्य going towards, कं नरम् which man, न प्रहर्षयेत् would not delight?

text: यदीह शरदो ऽनेकास्त्वया सार्द्धमनिन्दिते । लक्ष्मणेन च वत्स्यामि न मां शोक: प्रधक्ष्यति ॥२-९४-१५॥
translation: O flawless one, if I am to live here for many years to come with you and Lakshmana, no grief will consume me.
word_meanings: अनिन्दिते O flawless one, त्वया with you, लक्ष्मणेन च सार्धम् and in the company Lakshmana, इह here, अनेकाः many, शरदः autumns, वत्स्यामि यदि if I am to live, माम् me, शोकः grief, न प्रधक्ष्यति will not consume.

text: बहुपुष्पफले रम्ये नानाद्विजगणायुते । विचित्रशिखरे ह्यस्मिन् रतवानस्मि भामिनि ॥२-९४-१६॥
translation: O lovely Sita, I am enamoured of this delightful mountain with its enchanting peaks laden with abundance of flowers and fruits and flocked by different kinds of birds.
word_meanings: भामिनि O lovely Sita, बहुपुष्पफले laden with abundance of flowers and fruits, नानाद्विजगणायुते flocked by different kinds of birds, विचित्रशिखरे on enchanting mountain peaks, रम्ये delightful, अस्मिन् on this mountain, रतवान् अस्मि हि I am fond of.

text: अनेन वनवासेन मया प्राप्तं फलद्वयम् । पितुश्चानृणता धर्मे भरतस्य प्रियं तथा ॥२-९४-१७॥
translation: By living in the forest I have achieved a twofold benefitdischarge of debt of my father with regard to righteousness and causing happiness to Bharata.
word_meanings: अनेन by this, वनवासेन staying in the forest, धर्मे with regard to righteousness, पितुः to father, अनृणता discharge of debt, तथा also, भरतस्य Bharata's, प्रियम् pleasure, फलद्वयम् twofold benefit, मया by me, प्राप्तम् have been obtained.

text: वैदेहि रमसे कच्चिच्चित्रकूटे मया सह । पश्यन्ती विविधान् भावान् मनोवाक्कायसंयतान् ॥२-९४-१८॥
translation: O Sita, are you enjoying by being with me here on this Chitrakuta and observing various objects gratifying to the body, mind and speech?
word_meanings: हे वैदेहि O Sita, मनोवाक्कायसम्मतान् gratifying to body, speech and mind, विविधान् various, भावान् objects, पश्यन्ती observing, चित्रकूटे on Chitrakuta, मया सह along with me, रमसे कच्चित् are you enjoying?

text: इदमेवामृतं प्राहू राज्ञि राजर्षय: परे । वनवासं भवार्थाय प्रेत्य मे प्रपितामहा: ॥२-९४-१९॥
translation: My greatgrandfathers and ancient royal sages used to say that living in the forest is like enjoying nectar for a king for the best existence after death.
word_meanings: मे my, प्रपितामहाः greatgrandfathers, परे ancestors, राजर्षयः royal sages, प्रेत्य after death, भवार्थाय for best existence, इदम् this, वनवासमेव living in the forest, राज्ञि for the king, अमृतम् like nectar, प्राहुः said.

text: शिला: शैलस्य शोभन्ते विशाला: शतशो ऽभित: । बहुला बहुलैर्वर्णैर्नीलपीतसितारुणै: ॥२-९४-२०॥
translation: Several hundreds of massive rocks of the mountain look splendid all around, in blueblack, yellow, white and red colours.
word_meanings: बहुलैः several, नीलपीतसितारुणैः blueblack, yellow, white and red, वर्णैः colours, बहुलाः many, विशालाः massive, शैलस्य mountain's, शिलाः rocks, शतशः in hundreds, अभितः on all sides, शोभन्ते are looking splendid.

text: निशि भान्त्यचलेन्द्रस्य हुताशनशिखा इव । ओषध्य: स्वप्रभालक्ष्या भ्राजमाना: सहस्रश: ॥२-९४-२१॥
translation: Herbs in thousands on this king of the hills shine in the night with the splendour of their own lustre, like flames of fire.
word_meanings: स्वप्रभालक्ष्म्या with the splendour of their own lustre, भ्राजमानाः illuminating, सहस्रशः in thousands, अचलेन्द्रस्य of this lord of the hills (Chitrakuta's), ओषध्यः herbs, निशि in the night, हुताशनशिखा इव like flames of fire, भान्ति shine.

text: केचित् क्षयनिभा देशा: केचिदुद्यानसन्निभा: । केचिदेकशिला भान्ति पर्वतस्यास्य भामिनि ॥२-९४-२२॥
translation: O lovely Sita Some regions of the mountain look like dwellingplaces, some others are like flowergardens and some are shining like a single rock.
word_meanings: भामिनि O lovely Sita, अस्य this, पर्वतस्य mountain's, केचित् some, देशाः regions, क्षयनिभाः like dwellings, केचित् some, उद्यानसन्निभाः like flower gardens, केचित् some, एकशिलाः in the form of a single rock, भान्ति are shining.

text: भित्त्वेव वसुधां भाति चित्रकूट: समुत्थित: । चित्रकूटस्य कूटो ऽसौ दृश्यते सर्वत: शुभ: ॥२-९४-२३॥
translation: This Chitrakuta mountain stands erect as if it has arisen by splitting open the earth and its peak looks graceful from every side.
word_meanings: चित्रकूटः Chitrakuta mountain, वसुधाम् this earth, भित्त्वा splitting open, समुत्थितः इव as if rising from, भाति shining, चित्रकूटस्य Chitrakuta's, असौ this, कूटः peak, सर्वतः on every side, शुभः gracious, दृश्यते is seen.

text: कुष्ठपुन्नागस्ऺथगरभूर्जपत्रोत्तरच्छदान् । कामिनां स्वास्तरान् पश्य कुशेशयदलायुतान् ॥२-९४-२४॥
translation: Behold those excellent couches of lovers spread with leaves of kustha, sthagara, punnaga and bhurja and covered with lotus petals.
word_meanings: कुष्ठस्थगरपुन्नाग भूर्जपत्रोत्तरच्छदान् covered with leaves of kustha, sthagara, punnaga and bhurja, कुशेशयदलायुतान् covered with lotus petals, कामिनाम् lovers, स्वास्तरान् excellent couches, पश्य behold.

text: मृदिताश्चापविद्धाश्च दृश्यन्ते कमलस्रज: । कामिभिर्वनिते पश्य फलानि विविधानि च ॥२-९४-२५॥
translation: O Lady, behold those lotus garlands crushed and cast aside by lovers and also many fruits (tasted by them and) lying there.
word_meanings: वनिते O lady, कामिभिः by lovers, मृदिताश्च crushed, अपविद्धाश्च cast aside, कमलस्रजः lotus garlands, विविधानि many, फलानि च fruits, दृश्यन्ते can be seen, पश्य behold.

text: वस्वौकसारां नलिनीमत्येतीवोत्तरान् कुरून् । पर्वतश्चित्रकूटो ऽसौ बहुमूलफलोदक: ॥२-९४-२६॥
translation: This Chitrakuta mountain, with abundance of roots, fruits and water surpasses in beauty Vasvaukasara, the capital city of Kubera or Nalini, his celestial garden or the land of Uttarakuru.
word_meanings: बहुमूलफलोदकः with abundance of roots, fruits and water, असौ this, चित्रकूट: पर्वत: Chitrakuta mountain, वस्वौकसाराम् Vasvaukasara, the capital city of Kubera, नलिनीम् Nalini, the celestial lake of Kubera, उत्तरान् कुरून् the land of Uttarakuru, अत्येतीव surpasses.

text: इमं तु कालं वनिते विजह्रिवांस्त्वया च सीते सह लक्ष्मणेन च । रतिं प्रपत्स्ये कुलधर्मवर्द्धनीं सतां पथि स्वैर्नियमै: परै: स्थित: ॥२-९४-२७॥
translation: O my beloved Sita, by spending time with you and Lakshmana following the path of the virtuous with utmost restraint and by enhancing the righteousness of my race, I shall obtain great felicity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुर्नवतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetyfourth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: वनिते सीते O my beloved Sita, इमं कालम् this time, त्वया च with you, लक्ष्मणेन सह and also with Lakshmana, विजह्रिवान् wandering about, स्वैः by my own, परैः utmost, नियमैः restraint, सताम् virtuous men's, पथि path, स्थितः following, कुलधर्मवर्धनीम् as enhancing the righteousness of my race, रतिम् felicity, प्रपत्स्ये I shall obtain.

text: अथ शैलाद्विनिष्क्रम्य मैथिलीं कोसलेश्वर: । अदर्शयच्छुभजलां रम्यां मन्दाकिनीं नदीम् ॥२-९५-१॥
translation: Then Rama, the lord of Kosala, descended from the mountain and showed Sita the charming river Mandakini of sacred waters.
word_meanings: अथ then, कोसलेश्वरः lord of Kosala (Rama), शैलात् from the mountain, विनिष्क्रम्य having descended, शुभजलाम् of sacred water, रम्याम् charming, मन्दाकिनीं नदीम् river Mandakini, मैथिलीम् to Sita, अदर्शयत् showed.

text: अब्रवीच्च वरारोहां चारुचन्द्रनिभाननाम् । विदेहराजस्य सुतां रामो राजीवलोचन: ॥२-९५-२॥
translation: Lotus-eyed Rama said to the heavy-hipped daughter of the king of Videha, whose face resembled the beautiful Moon.
word_meanings: राजीवलोचनः lotus-eyed, रामः Rama, वरारोहाम् to the heavy-hipped, चारुचन्द्रनिभाननाम् to her whose face resembled the beautiful Moon, विदेहराजस्य of the king of Videha, सुताम् daughter, अब्रवीच्च said.

text: विचित्रपुलिनां रम्यां हंससारससेविताम् । कमलैरुपसम्पन्नां पश्य मन्दाकिनीं नदीम् ॥२-९५-३॥
translation: Look at this enchanting river Mandakini with its variegated sandbanks frequented by geese and swans and adorned with lotuses.
word_meanings: विचित्रपुलिनाम् of variagated sandbanks, रम्याम् enchanting, हंससारससेविताम् frequented by geese and swans, कमलैः with lotus, उपसम्पन्नाम् adorned with, मन्दाकिनीं नदीम् river Mandakini, पश्य look.

text: नानाविधैस्तीररुहैर्वृतां पुष्पफलद्रुमै: । राजन्तीं राजराजस्य नलिनीमिव सर्वत: ॥२-९५-४॥
translation: See this river sparkling with trees of every kind laden with fruits and flowers growing on its banks. Everywhere it resembles the lake Nalini of Kubera.
word_meanings: सर्वतः everywhere, नानाविधैः of various kinds, तीररुहैः growing on its banks, पुष्पफलद्रुमैः trees, laden with fruits and flowers, वृताम् surrounded by, राजराजस्य Kubera's, नलिनीम् इव like fragrant lake Nalini, राजन्तीम् sparkling.

text: मृगयूथनिपीतानि कलुषाम्भांसि साम्प्रतम् । तीर्थानि रमणीयानि रतिं सञ्जनयन्ति मे ॥२-९५-५॥
translation: The herds of deer have just drunk water by descending down the landing places and the waters are still turbid. This sight produces great pleasure in me.
word_meanings: साम्प्रतम् just now, मृगयूथनिपीतानि drunk by herds of deer, कलुषाम्भांसि of turbid waters, रमणीयानि lovely, तीर्थानि landing places, मे to me, रतिम् pleasure, सञ्जनयन्ति is producing.

text: जटाजिनधरा: काले वल्कलोत्तरवासस: । ऋषयस्त्ववगाहन्ते नदीं मन्दाकिनीं प्रिये ॥२-९५-६॥
translation: O my beloved rishis with matted locks and wearing deer skins and bark of trees as upper cloth bathe in the river Mandakini for performing morning ablutions in time.
word_meanings: प्रिये O my beloved, जटाजिनधराः with matted locks and wearing deer skins, वल्कलोत्तरवाससः bark as upper cloth, ऋषयः rishis, काले at the appointed hour, मन्दाकिनीं नदीम् the river Mandakini, अवगाहन्ते are immersing.

text: आदित्यमुपतिष्ठन्ते नियमादूर्द्ध्वबाहव: । एते परे विशालाक्षि मुनय: संशितव्रता: ॥२-९५-७॥
translation: O largeeyed Sita, some other ascetics of rigid austerities worship the sungod according to tradition, lifting up their arms and invoking the Sun.
word_meanings: विशालाक्षि O largeeyed Sita, संशितव्रताः of rigid austerities, एते परे some other, मुनयः ascetics, नियमात् according to tradition, ऊर्ध्वबाहवः lifting up their arms, आदित्यम् Sungod, उपतिष्ठन्ते are worhipping.

text: मारुतोद्धूतशिखरै: प्रनृत्त इव पर्वत: । पादपै: पत्ऺत्रपुष्पाणि सृजद्भिरभितो नदीम् ॥२-९५-८॥
translation: With the trees whose tops are swayed by the wind, the mountain was as if dancing, shedding leaves and flowers all around the river.
word_meanings: मारुतोद्धूतशिखरैः tree tops swayed by the wind, नदीमभितः around the river, पत्रपुष्पाणि leaves and flowers, सृजद्भिः shedding, पादपैः with trees, पर्वतः mountain, प्रनृत्त इव seems dancing.

text: क्वचिन्मणिनिकाशोदां क्वचित्पुलिनशालिनीम् । क्वचित्सिद्धजनाकीर्णां पश्य मन्दाकिनीं नदीम् ॥२-९५-९॥
translation: Behold this river Mandakini whose waters here are transparent like crystals, there sparkling with sand dunes and elsewhere crowded with siddhas.
word_meanings: क्वचित् at some places, मणिनिकाशोदाम् with water transparent as crystals, क्वचित् at some other places, पुलिनशालिनीम् sparkling with sand dunes, क्वचित् at some places, सिद्धजनाकीर्णाम् filled with siddhas (those acomplished in spiritual pursuits), मन्दाकिनीं नदीम् river Mandakini, पश्य see.

text: निर्द्धूतान् वायुना पश्य विततान् पुष्पसञ्चयान् । पोप्लूयमानानपरान् पश्य त्वं जलमध्यगान् ॥२-९५-१०॥
translation: Look at the scattered heaps of flowers shaken off by the wind and large quantities of flowers floating on the waters.
word_meanings: वायुना by the wind, निर्धूतान् shaken off, विततान् scattered, पुष्पसञ्चयान् heaps of flowers, पश्य see, जलमध्यगान् in the midst of waters, पोप्लूयमानान् floating, अपरान् other masses of flowers, त्वम् you, पश्य see.

text: तांश्चातिवल्गुवचसो रथाङ्गाह्वयना द्विजा: । अधिरोहन्ति कल्याणि विकूजन्त: शुभा गिर: ॥२-९५-११॥
translation: O my auspicious Sita, sweetvoiced Chakravaka birds singing in most pleasant tones are alighting on those heaps of flowers.
word_meanings: कल्याणि O my auspicious Sita, वल्गुवचसः of sweetvoiced, रथाङ्गाह्वयनाः birds named Chakravaka, द्विजाः birds, शुभाः most pleasant, गिरः tones, निष्कूजन्तः uttering, तान् on those (heaps of flowers), अधिरोहन्ति alighting.

text: दर्शनं चित्र कूटस्य मन्दाकिन्याश्च शोभने । अधिकं पुरवासाच्च मन्ये च तव दर्शनात् ॥२-९५-१२॥
translation: My lovely Sita, I consider watching this mount Chitrakuta and river Mandakini in your presence more delightful than living in Ayodhya.
word_meanings: शोभने my lovely Sita, तव your, दर्शनात् in presence, चित्रकूटस्य Chitrakuta's, मन्दाकिन्याश्च Mandakini's, दर्शनम् viewing, पुरवासाच्छ compared to living in Ayodhya, अधिकम् is greater, मन्ये I consider.

text: विधूतकलुषै: सिद्धैस्तपोदमशमान्वितै: । नित्यविक्षोभितजलां विगाहस्व मया सह ॥२-९५-१३॥
translation: The waters of river Mandakini is perpetually agitated by siddhas who are endowed with asceticism, selfrestraint and tranquillity and who are cleansed of sins by taking bath in the river. Plunge with me into this river.
word_meanings: विधूतकलुषैः cleansed of sins, तपोदमशमान्वितैः endowed with asceticism, selfrestraint and tranquillity, सिद्धैः with siddhas, नित्यविक्षोभितजलाम् with perpetually agitated waters, मया सह with me, विगाहस्व enter.

text: सखीवच्च विगाहस्व सीते मन्दाकिनीं नदीम् । कमलान्यवमज्जन्ती पुष्कराणि च भामिनि ॥२-९५-१४॥
translation: O lovely Sita, like a companion plunge into this river Mandakini, submerging the red and white lotuses, and enjoy sporting.
word_meanings: भामिनि O lovely, सीते Sita, कमलानि red lotuses, पुष्कराणि च white lotuses, अवमज्जन्ती submerging, सखीवत् like a friend, मन्दाकिनीं नदीम् Mandakini river, विगाहस्व you may enter.

text: त्वं पौरजनवद्व्यालानयोध्यामिव पर्वतम् । मन्यस्व वनिते नित्यं सरयूवदिमां नदीम् ॥२-९५-१५॥
translation: O my lovely lady Always think this river Mandakini as Sarayu and this mount Chitrakuta as Ayodhya and these wild animals as its inhabitants.
word_meanings: वनिते O my lovely lady, त्वम् you, व्यालान् wild animals, पौरजनवत् as inhabitants of Ayodhya, पर्वतम् mountain, अयोध्यामिव as Ayodhya, इमाम् this, नदीम् river, सरयूवत् as Sarayu, नित्यम् always, मन्यस्व think of.

text: लक्ष्मणश्चापि धर्मात्मा मन्निदेशे व्यवस्थित: । त्वं चानुकूला वैदेहि प्रीतिं जनयथो मम ॥२-९५-१६॥
translation: With righteous Lakshmana obedient and you, O Sita, agreeable to me, you both bring me great pleasure.
word_meanings: वैदेहि O Sita, धर्मात्मा righteous, लक्ष्मणश्चापि Lakshmana also, मन्निदेशे at my command, व्यवस्थितः obedient, त्वं च you also, अनुकूला agreeable, मम to me, प्रीतिम् pleasure, जनयथः are causing.

text: उपस्पृशंस्त्रिषवणं मधुमूलफलाशन: । नायोध्यायै न राज्याय स्पृहये ऽद्य त्वया सह ॥२-९५-१७॥
translation: Bathing thrice in your company at the time of prayers and partaking honey, roots and fruits, I do not yearn either for Ayodhya or for the kingdom.
word_meanings: त्रिषवणम् thrice at the time of prayers, उपस्पृशन् bathing, मधुमूलफलाशनः honey, roots and fruits, त्वया सह in your company, अद्य now, अयोध्यायै for Ayodhya, न स्पृहये I do not yearn for, राज्याय न nor even the kingdom.

text: इमां हि रम्यां मृगयूथशालिनीं निपीततोयां गजसिंहवानरै: । सुपुष्पितै: पुष्पधरैरलङ्कृतां न सो ऽस्ति य: स्यादगतक्लम: सुखी ॥२-९५-१८॥
translation: With this enchanting Mandakini teeming with herds of deer, whose waters are drunk by elephants, lions and monkeys, decorated with heaps of flowers fallen from the trees in full bloom, who will not feel happy and free from fatigue.
word_meanings: रम्याम् enchanting, मृगयूथशालिनीम् teeming with herds of deer, गजसिंहवानरैः with elephants, lions and monkeys, निपीततोयाम् its waters being drunk by, सुपुष्पिताम् in full bloom, पुष्पभरैः with multitude of flowers, अलङ्कृताम् decorated, इमाम् this (river Mandakini), यः who, गतक्लमः with fatigue gone, सुखी happy, न स्यात् will not find himself, सः that one, नास्ति does not exist.

text: इतीव रामो बहुसङ्गतं वच: प्रियासहाय: सरितं प्रति ब्रुवन् । चचार रम्यं नयनाञ्जनप्रभं स चित्रकूटं रघुवंशवर्द्धन: ॥२-९५-१९॥
translation: Rama, the perpetuator of the Raghu dynasty, describing the river Mandakini at length appropriately in this manner, wandered in the company of his beloved consort on mount Chitrakuta looking black like collyrium. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे पञ्चनवतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetyfifth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: रघुवंशवर्धनः perpetuator of Raghu dynasty, सः रामः that Rama, इतीव in this manner, सरितं प्रति about Mandakini river, बहु at length, सङ्गतम् appropriate, वचः words, ब्रुवन् speaking, प्रियासहायः in the company of his beloved, नयनाञ्जनप्रभम् resembling collyrium in hue, रम्यम् delightful, चित्रकूटम् Chitrakuta, चचार wandered about.

text: तां तथा दर्शयित्वा तु मैथिलीं गिरिनिम्नगाम् । निषसाद गिरिप्रस्थे सीतां मांसेन छन्दयन् ॥२-९६-१॥
translation: Rama showed Sita, the princess of Mithila the river Mandakini flowing in the mountain, gratified her by offering meat (to eat) and sat on the mountain slope.
word_meanings: मैथिलीम् princess of Mithila, तां सीताम् to Sita, तथा in that way, गिरिनिम्नगाम् mountainriver, दर्शयित्वा having shown, मांसेन with meat, छन्दयन् gratifying, गिरिप्रस्थे on the mountainslope, निषसाद sat.

text: इदं मेध्यमिदं स्वादु निष्टप्तमिदमग्निना । एवमास्ते स धर्मात्मा सीतया सह राघव: ॥२-९६-२॥
translation: Offering Sita several kinds of preparations to eat, righteous Rama, seated in her company remarked, This meat is savoury, this meat roasted on fire is sacred.
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा righteous, स राघवः that Rama, इदम् this, मेध्यम् sacred meat, इदम् this, स्वादु is savoury, इदम् this one, अग्निना with fire, निष्टप्तम् roasted, एवम् uttering this way, सीतया सह in the company of Sita, आस्ते was seated.

text: तथा तत्रासतस्तस्य भरतस्योपयायिन: । सैन्यरेणुश्च शब्दश्च प्रादुरास्तां नभस्स्पृशौ ॥२-९६-३॥
translation: Now as Rama was sitting there, the tumult and the dust raised by the approaching army of Bharata reached the sky.
word_meanings: तथा thus, तस्य that Rama, तत्र there, आसतः while sitting, उपयायिनः approaching, भरतस्य Bharata's, सैन्यरेणुश्च dust raised by the army, शब्दश्च and tumult, नभस्पृशौ both reaching the sky, प्रादुरास्ताम् was generated.

text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे त्रस्ता: शब्देन महता तत: । अर्दिता यूथपा मत्ता: सयूथा दुद्रुवुर्दिश: ॥२-९६-४॥
translation: Meanwhile, the mighty leaders of the elephantherds were agitated, and frightened by the loud noise, fled away from there in different directions.
word_meanings: एकस्मिन् अन्तरे meanwhile, मत्ताः mighty, यूथपाः leaders of elephantherds, महता with a loud, शब्देन noise, त्रस्ताः were frightened, अर्दिताः agitated सयूथाः with herds, ततः from there, दिशः in different directions, दुद्रुवुः fled away.

text: स तं सैन्यसमुद्धूतं शब्दं शुश्राव राघव: । तांश्च विप्रद्रुतान् सर्वान् यूथपानन्ववैक्षत ॥२-९६-५॥
translation: Rama heard the sound generated by the army and saw those leaders of herds fleeing away.
word_meanings: सः राघवः that Rama, सैन्यसमुद्बूतम् generated by the army, तं शब्दम् that sound, शुश्राव heard, विप्रद्रुतान् fleeing, तान् those, सर्वान् all, यूथपान् च leaders of herds, अन्ववैक्षत saw.

text: तांश्च विद्रवतो दृष्ट्वा तं च श्रुत्वा च निस्वनम् । उवाच राम: सौमित्रिं लक्ष्मणं दीप्ततेजसम् ॥२-९६-६॥
translation: Seeing those animals fleeing and hearing the clamour, Rama addressed Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, who was blazing with energy.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, विद्रुवतः running, तान् them, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तम् them, निस्वनं also sound, श्रुत्वा having heard, दीप्ततेजसम् blazing with energy, सौमित्रिम् son of Sumitra, लक्ष्मणम् addressing Lakshmana, उवाच said.

text: हन्त लक्ष्मण पश्येह सुमित्रा सुप्रजास्त्वया । भीमस्तनितगम्भीरस्तुमुल: श्रूयते स्वन: ॥२-९६-७॥
translation: O Lakshmana, the worthy son of Sumitra, fearful and tumultuous clamour like rumbling sound of clouds is heard. What a wonder Go and see.
word_meanings: हन्त Oh what a wonder, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, सुमित्रा Sumitra, त्वया by you, सुप्रजाः has a worthy son, इह here, भीमस्तनितगम्भीरः fearful rumbling of clouds, तुमुलः tumultous, स्वनः sound, इह here, श्रूयते is being heard, पश्य see.

text: गजयूथानि वा ऽरण्ये महिषा वा महावने । वित्रासिता मृगा: सिंहै: सहसा प्रद्रुता दिश: ॥२-९६-८॥
translation: Herds of elephants and buffaloes in the great woods and wild beasts frightened by lions are running in different directions.
word_meanings: अरण्ये in the forest, गजयूथानि herds of elephants, महावने in the great woods, महिषाः वा buffaloes, मृगाः wild beasts, वित्रासिताः frightened, सिंहैः by lions, सहसा quickly, दिशः in directions, प्रद्रुताः running.

text: राजा वा राजमात्रो वा मृगयामटते वने । अन्यद्वा श्वापदं किञ्चित् सौमित्रे ज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥२-९६-९॥
translation: O Lakshmana, do ascertain if any king or prince has come for hunting or whether any ferocious animal has entered this forest, shouldn't you?
word_meanings: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, राजा वा king or, राजपुत्रो वा or prince, वने in the forest, मृगयाम् अटते is hunting, वा or, किञ्चित् any, अन्यत् other, श्वापदम् ferocious animal, ज्ञातुम् to know, अर्हसि ought to

text: सुदुश्चरो गिरिश्चायं पक्षिणामपि लक्ष्मण । सर्वमेतद्यथातत्त्वमचिराज्ज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥२-९६-१०॥
translation: O Lakshmana, this mountain is highly inaccessible even to birds. Find out exactly and quickly what this is all about.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, अयम् this, गिरिः mountain, पक्षिणामपि even to birds, सुदुश्चरः is highly inaccessible, एतत् सर्वम् all this, यथातत्त्वम् exactly, अचिरात् quickly, ज्ञातुम् to know, अर्हसि ought to.

text: स लक्ष्मण: संत्वरित: सालमारुह्य पुष्पितम् । प्रेक्षमाणो दिश: सर्वा: पूर्वां दिशमुदैक्षत ॥२-९६-११॥
translation: Lakshmana hurriedly climbed a flowering sala tree, surveyed in all directions and fixed his gaze on the east.
word_meanings: सः लक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, सन्त्वरितः hurriedly, पुष्पितम् flowering, सालम् Sala tree, आरुह्य climbing, सर्वाः all, दिशः directions, प्रेक्षमाणः seeing, पूर्वं दिशम् the eastern direction, उदैक्षत looked.

text: उदङ्मुख: प्रेक्षमाणो ददर्श महतीं चमूम् । रथाश्वगजसम्बाधां यत्तैर्युक्तां पदातिभि: ॥२-९६-१२॥
translation: Turning his face to the north, he beheld a vast army consisting of chariots, elephants and horses and a wellequipped infantry.
word_meanings: उदङ्मुखः facing the north, प्रेक्षमाणः seeing, रथाश्वगजसम्बाधाम् with chariots, elephants and horses, यत्तै: wellequipped, पदातिभिः with infantry, युक्ताम् consisting of, महतीम् vast, चमूम् army, ददर्श beheld.

text: तामश्वगजसम्पूर्णां रथध्वजविभूषिताम् । शशंस सेनां रामाय वचनं चेदमब्रीत् ॥२-९६-१३॥
translation: He (Lakshmana) informed Rama about the army full of horses and elephants and decorated with chariotbanners and said these words:
word_meanings: अश्वगजसम्पूर्णाम् full of horses and elephants, रथध्वजविभूषिताम् decorated with chariotbannars, तां सेनाम् of the army, रामाय to Rama, शशंस informed, इदम् these, वचनं च words also, अब्रवीत् said.

text: अग्निं संशमयत्वार्य: सीता च भजतां गुहाम् । सज्यं कुरुष्व चापं च शरांश्च कवचं तथा ॥२-९६-१४॥
translation: O noble one, put out the sacred fire (Agnihotra) and let Sita take refuge in the cave. String your bow and keep the arrows ready. Put on your armour.
word_meanings: आर्यः O noble one, अग्निम् sacredfires (Agnihotra), संशमयतु put off, सीता च Sita also, गुहाम् cave, भजताम् let take refuge, चापम् bow, सज्यम् with string, कुरुष्व make ready, तथा so also, शरांश्च arrows also, कवचम् armour (put on).

text: तं राम: पुरुषव्याघ्रो लक्ष्मणं प्रत्युवाच ह । अङ्गावेक्षस्व सौमित्रे कस्येमां मन्यसे चमूम् ॥२-९६-१५॥
translation: Rama the best among men replied to Lakshamana, Oh, Lakshmana, look properly and tell me to whom do you think this army might belong
word_meanings: पुरुषव्याघ्रः best among men, रामः Rama, तं लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, प्रत्युवाच ह replied so, अङ्ग Oh, सौमित्रे Lakshmana, अवेक्षस्व look, इमाम् this, चमूम् army, कस्य of whom, मन्यसे do you think.

text: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् । दिधक्षन्निव तां सेनां रुषित: पावको यथा ॥२-९६-१६॥
translation: Hearing the words of Rama, enraged Lakshmana, like a flaming fire as if he would reduce the army to ashes, replied:
word_meanings: रामेण by Rama, एवं in that manner, उक्तः having been said, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, पावको यथा like a fire, रुषितः was wrathful, तां सेनाम् that army, दिधक्षन्निव as if he wanted to burn down, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: सम्पन्नं राज्यमिच्छंस्तु व्यक्तं प्राप्याभिषेचनम् । आवां हन्तुं समभ्येति कैकेय्या भरत: सुत: ॥२-९६-१७॥
translation: It is evident that Kaikeyi's son Bharata, who has been consecrated, is coming to slay both of us desiring the prosperous kingdom (to be without obstacles).
word_meanings: कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi's, सुतः son, भरतः Bharata, अभिषेचनम् प्राप्य having been consecrated, राज्यम् kingdom, सम्पन्नम् endowed with prosperity (without obstacles), इच्छन् desiring, आवाम् both of us, हन्तुम् to slay, समभ्येति is coming, व्यक्तम् this is evident.

text: एष वै सुमहान् श्रीमान् विटपी सम्प्रकाशते । विराजत्युद्गतस्कन्ध: कोविदारध्वजो रथे ॥२-९६-१८॥
translation: There on that chariot, is a banner shining brilliantly with the emblem of a lofty majestic Kovidara tree with a large trunk.
word_meanings: एषः this, सुमहान् lofty, श्रीमान् majestic, उद्गतस्कन्धः atop with large trunk, विटपी tree, सम्प्रकाशते रथे on chariot, कोविदारध्वजः with his standard bearing the emblem of Kovidara tree, विराजति shining brilliantly.

text: भजन्त्येते यथा काममश्वानारुह्य शीघ्रगान् । एते भ्राजन्ति संहृष्टा गजानारुह्य सादिन: ॥२-९६-१९॥
translation: These men mounted on swiftlymoving horses are following the post. The riders of elephants mounted on the elephants look cheerful.
word_meanings: एते these, यथाकामम् at their will, शीघ्रगान् swiftlymoving, अश्वान् horses, आरुह्य having mounted, भजन्ति are following, एते these, सादिनः riders of elephants, गजान् elephants, आरुह्य having mounted, संहृष्टाः cheerfully, भ्राजन्ति are shining.

text: गृहीतधनुषौ चावां गिरिं वीरश्रयावहै । अथवेहैव तिष्ठाव: सन्नद्धावुद्यतायुधौ ॥२-९६-२०॥
translation: O mighty warrior, let both of us take up the bows and station ourselves on this mountain or we shall stay here itself armed with weapons fully prepared for the battle.
word_meanings: वीर O mighty warrior, आवाम् both of us, गृहीतधनुषौ by taking up the bows, गिरिम् on this mountain, श्रयावहै take refuge, अथवा or, सन्नद्धौ fully prepared (for battle), उद्यतायुधौ with weapons in readiness, इहैव here itself, तिष्ठावः stay here.

text: अपि नौ वशमागच्छेत् कोविदारध्वजो दणे ॥२-९६-२१॥
अपि द्रक्ष्यामि भरतं यत्कृते व्यसनं महत् । त्वया राघव सम्प्राप्तं सीतया च मया तथा ॥२-९६-२२॥
translation: O Rama, will this Kovidara emblem come into our possession in the battle? Can I see Bharata, the cause of the calamity that has befallen you, Sita and me?
word_meanings: राघव O Rama, रणे in battle, कोविदारध्वजः Kovidara banner, नौ our, वशम् possession, अप्यागच्छेत् will it come, यत्कृते on whose account, त्वया by you, सीतया by Sita, तथा also, मया च by me, महत् great, व्यसनम् calamity, सम्प्राप्तम् has befallen, such, भरतम् Bharata, अपि द्रक्ष्यामि can I see.

text: यन्निमित्तं भवान् राज्याच्च्युतो राघव शाश्वतात् । सम्प्राप्तो ऽयमरिर्वीर भरतो वध्य एव मे ॥२-९६-२३॥
translation: O that mighty warrior Bharata, on whose account you have been banished from the perpetual kingdom, comes here as a foe and as for me, he deserves to be slain.
word_meanings: हे वीर O mighty warrior, राघव Rama, भवान् you, यन्निमित्तम् on whose account, शाश्वतात् from the perpetual, राज्यात् from kingdom, च्युतः deprived, अयम् such, सम्प्राप्तः has come here, अरिः foe, भरतः Bharata, मे to me, वध्य एव deserves to be slain.

text: भरतस्य वधे दोषं नाहं पश्यामि राघव । पूर्वापकारिणां त्यागे न ह्यधर्मो विधीयते ॥२-९६-२४॥
translation: O Rama, I do not see anything wrong in slaying Bharata. In killing one who had done harm is not an act of unrighteousness.
word_meanings: राघव O Rama, भरतस्य Bharta's, वधे in slaying, अहम् I, दोषम् wrong, न पश्यामि do not see, पूर्वापकारिणम् one who has done harmful act earlier, हत्वा in slaying, अधर्मेण with unrighteousness, न युज्यते is not attached.

text: पूर्वापकारी भरतस्त्यक्तधर्मश्च राघव । एतस्मिन्निहते कृत्स्नामनुशाधि वसुन्धराम् ॥२-९६-२५॥
translation: O Rama, Bharata has abandoned righteousness and has harmed you. When he is slain, you shall rule over the whole earth.
word_meanings: राघव O Rama, भरतः Bharata, पूर्वापकारी had done harm earlier, त्यक्तधर्मश्च abandoned righteousness, एतस्मिन् when such a person, निहते after having been slain कृत्स्नाम् the whole, वसुन्धराम् earth, अनुशाधि you shall rule.

text: अद्य पुत्रं हतं सङ्ख्ये कैकेयी राज्यकामुका । मया पश्येत् सुदु:खार्त्ता हस्तिभग्नमिव द्रुमम् ॥२-९६-२६॥
translation: Let that Kaikeyi, greedy for the kingdom, see in great anguish her son who shall be slain by me today in a battle like a tree felled by an elephant.
word_meanings: राज्यकामुका greedy for the kingdom, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, अद्य today, संख्ये in a battle, मया by me, हतम् slain, पुत्रम् son, हस्तिभग्नम् felled by an elephant, द्रुमम् इव like a tree, सुदुःखार्ता extremely afflicted, पश्येत् let her see.

text: कैकेयीं च वधिष्यामि सानुबन्धां सबान्धवाम् । कलुषेणाद्य महता मेदिनी परिमुच्यताम् ॥२-९६-२७॥
translation: I shall also slay Kaikeyi with her attendants and relations. Let the earth be cleansed of the great sin today.
word_meanings: सानुबन्धाम् with her attendants, सबान्धवाम् with her relations, कैकेयीं च also Kaikeyi, वधिष्यामि will slay, अद्य today, मेदिनी the earth, महता by a great, कलुषेण of the sin, परिमुच्यताम् let it be cleansed.

text: अद्येमं संयतं क्रोधमसत्कारं च मानद । मोक्ष्यामि शत्रुसैन्येषु कक्षेष्विव हुताशनम् ॥२-९६-२८॥
translation: O protector of honour, today I shall vent my suppressed anger and dishonour on the enemy's army like a fire on the thicket.
word_meanings: मानद O protector of honour (Rama), संयतम् suppressed, इमम् this, क्रोधम् anger, असत्कारं च dishonour, हुताशनम् fire, कक्षेष्विव like a thicket, अद्य today, शत्रुसैन्येषु in the army of enemies, मोक्ष्यामि I shall release.

text: अद्यैतच्चित्रकूटस्य काननं निशितै: शरै: । भिन्दन् शत्रुशरीराणि करिष्ये शोणितोक्षितम् ॥२-९६-२९॥
translation: Today I shall rend the bodies of enemies with my sharpened arrows and spatter the forest of Chitrakuta mountain with their blood.
word_meanings: अद्य today, निशितैः by the sharpened, शरैः with arrows, शत्रुशरीराणि bodies of enemies, छिन्दन् rending, चित्रकूटस्य Chitrakuta's, एतत् काननम् this forest, शोणितोक्षितम् spattered with blood, करिष्ये I shall do.

text: शरैर्निर्भिन्नहृदयान् कुञ्जरांस्तुरगांस्तथा । श्वापदा: परिकर्षन्तु नरांश्च निहतान् मया ॥२-९६-३०॥
translation: Let the wild beasts drag away the elephants, horses and men to be killed by me with their hearts transfixed with my arrows.
word_meanings: शरैः with arrows, निर्भिन्नहृदयान् with hearts transfixed, कुञ्जरान् elephants, तथा and, तुरगान् horses, मया by me, निहतान् killed, नरांश्च also men, श्वापदाः also wild beasts, परिकर्षन्तु let them drag off.

text: शराणां धनुषश्चाहमनृणो ऽस्मि महामृधे । ससैन्यं भरतं हत्वा भविष्यामि न संशय: ॥२-९६-३१॥
translation: Having slain Bharata and his army in this great forest, I shall doubtless discharge my debt to my arrows and bow. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षण्णवतितमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the ninetysixth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: अस्मिन् in this, महावने great forest, अहम् I, ससैन्यम् with army, भरतम् Bharata, हत्वा having slain, शराणाम् of the arrows, धनुषश्च of the bow, अनृणः discharging my debt, भविष्यामि shall become, संशंयः doubt, न not.

text: सुसंरब्धं तु सौमित्रिं लक्ष्मणं क्रोधमूर्च्छितम् । रामस्तु परिसान्त्व्याथ वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥२-९७-१॥
translation: Thereafter, Rama pacified Lakshmana, son of Sumitra who was violently agitated. He said to him who had swooned with rage:
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, रामस्तु as for Rama, सुसंरब्धम् violently agitated, क्रोधमूर्छितम् swooned with rage, सौमित्रिम् to Sumitra's son, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, परिसान्त्व्य having pacified, इदम् this, वचनं च word, अब्रवीत् said.

text: किमत्र धनुषा कार्यमसिना वा सचर्मणा । महेष्वासे महाप्राज्ञे भरते स्वयमागते ॥२-९७-२॥
translation: When sagacious Bharata of great strength has come here, where is the need for a bow or a sword or a shield.
word_meanings: महेष्वासे of great strength, महाप्राज्ञे sagacious, भरते Bharata, स्वयम् himself, अत्र here, आगते has come, धनुषा with bow, सचर्मणा with shield, असिना वा or with sword, किं कार्यम् where is the need?

text: पितु: सत्यं प्रतिश्रुत्य हत्वा भरतमागतम् । किं करिष्ऺयामि राज्येन सापवादेन लक्ष्मण ॥२-९७-३॥
translation: O Lakshmana, having sworn that I would make father's word true, what shall I do with the kingdom earned slanderously by slaying Bharata who has come (to see me)?
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, पितुः father's, सत्यम् truth, प्रतिश्रुत्य having sworn, आगतम् one who has come here, भरतम् Bharata, हत्वा having slain, सापवादेन with slander, राज्येन with a kingdom, किं करिष्यामि what shall I do?

text: यद्द्रव्यं बान्धवानां वा मित्राणां वा क्षये भवेत् । नाहं तत् प्रतिगृह्णीयां भक्षान् विषकृतानिव ॥२-९७-४॥
translation: I shall never accept any wealth obtained by destroying kith and kin or friends which is akin to taking food prepared with poison.
word_meanings: यत् द्रव्यम् the wealth, बान्धवानां वा of kith and kin, मित्राणां वा or friends', क्षये भवेत् is obtaind through destruction, तत् that one, अहम् I, विषकृतान् prepared with poison, भक्षान् इव like eatables, न प्रतिगृह्णीयाम् I shall not accept.

text: धर्ममर्थं च कामं च पृथिवीं चापि लक्ष्मण । इच्छामि भवतामर्थे एतत् प्रतिश्रृणोमि ते ॥२-९७-५॥
translation: O Lakshmana, on the oath of righteousness, I wish wealth and pleasure as well as this kingdom for the sake of you all.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, धर्मम् righteousness, अर्थं च prosperity (wealth) also, कामं च desire, पृथिवीं चापि earth (kingdom) also, भवताम् अर्थे for your sake, इच्छामि I want, एतत् all this, ते to you, प्रतिशृणोमि I swear.

text: भ्रातऽणां सङ्ग्रहार्थं च सुखार्थं चापि लक्ष्मण । राज्यमप्यहमिच्छामि सत्येनायुधमालभे ॥२-९७-६॥
translation: O Lakshmana, I desire this kingdom only for the unity and happiness of my brothers. I swear on the weapon I hold.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, भ्रात्रूणाम् brothers', संग्रहार्थम् remain united, सुखार्थं चापि and also for happiness, अहम् I, राज्यमपि even kingdom, इच्छामि I desire, सत्येन truly, आयुधम् weapons, अलभे I hold.

text: नेयं मम मही सौम्य दुर्ल्लभा सागराम्बरा । नहीच्छेयमधर्मेण शक्रत्वमपि लक्ष्मण ॥२-९७-७॥
translation: O gentle Lakshmana, lordship of this earth with the sea as its garment is not difficult to obtain (for me). But I do not desire even Indrahood by unrighteous means.
word_meanings: सौम्य O gentle, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, सागराम्बरा with the sea as garment, इयम् this, मही earth, मम to me, दुर्लभा difficult, न not, अधर्मेण unrighteously, शक्रत्वमपि even Indrahood, न इच्छेयं हि I do not desire.

text: यद्विना भरतं त्वां च शत्रुघ्नं चापि मानद । भवेन्मम सुखं किञ्चिद्भस्म तत् कुरुतां शिखी ॥२-९७-८॥
translation: O protector of honour even if there were to be some happiness which I could enjoy without you, Bharata, and Satrughna, let it be reduced to ashes by fire.
word_meanings: मानद O bestower of honour (Lakshmana), यत् any happiness, भरतम् Bharata, त्वां च you also, शतृघ्नं चापि Satrughna too, विना without leaving, मम to me, भवेत् happens, तत् that, किञ्चित् सुखम् some happines, शिखी fire, भस्म as ashes, कुरुताम् let it be reduced.

text: मन्येऽहमागतोऽयोध्यां भरतो भ्रातृवत्सल: । मम प्राणात् प्रियतर: कुलधर्ममनुस्मरन् ॥२-९७-९॥
translation: O best among men, O valiant one I think Bharata who is affectionate towards his brothers and who is dearer to me than my life, must have returned to Ayodhya and has heard that I had been exiled along with you and Janaki, wearing barks and matted locks. Remembering the duties of the race with an afflicted mind and with agitated senses he has come here to see me. He has not come with any other intention.
word_meanings: वीर O valiant one, पुरुषर्षभ best among men, भ्रातृवत्सलः affectionate towards brothers, मम to me, प्राणात् more than life, प्रियतरः dearer, भरतः Bharata, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, आगतः had returned, माम् me, जानक्या with Janaki, त्वया च with you, सहितम् in the company of, जटावल्कलधारिणम् wearing barks and matted locks, प्रव्राजितम् having been exiled, श्रुत्वा hearing, कुलधर्मम् duties of race, अनुस्मरन् remembering, स्नेहेन with devotion, आक्रान्तहृदय: mind possessed by, शोकेन with distress, आकुलितेन्द्रियः with agitated senses, द्रष्टुम् to see, अभ्यागतः has arrived, अहम् I, मन्ये consider, एषः भरतः this Bharata, अन्यथा for any other reason, न आगतः has not come.

text: श्रुत्वा प्रव्राजितं मां हि जटावल्कलधारिणम् । जानक्या सहितं वीर त्वया च पुरुषर्षभ ॥२-९७-१०॥
translation: O best among men, O valiant one I think Bharata who is affectionate towards his brothers and who is dearer to me than my life, must have returned to Ayodhya and has heard that I had been exiled along with you and Janaki, wearing barks and matted locks. Remembering the duties of the race with an afflicted mind and with agitated senses he has come here to see me. He has not come with any other intention.
word_meanings: वीर O valiant one, पुरुषर्षभ best among men, भ्रातृवत्सलः affectionate towards brothers, मम to me, प्राणात् more than life, प्रियतरः dearer, भरतः Bharata, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, आगतः had returned, माम् me, जानक्या with Janaki, त्वया च with you, सहितम् in the company of, जटावल्कलधारिणम् wearing barks and matted locks, प्रव्राजितम् having been exiled, श्रुत्वा hearing, कुलधर्मम् duties of race, अनुस्मरन् remembering, स्नेहेन with devotion, आक्रान्तहृदय: mind possessed by, शोकेन with distress, आकुलितेन्द्रियः with agitated senses, द्रष्टुम् to see, अभ्यागतः has arrived, अहम् I, मन्ये consider, एषः भरतः this Bharata, अन्यथा for any other reason, न आगतः has not come.

text: स्नेहेनाक्रान्तहृदय: शोकेनाकुलितेन्द्रिय: । द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो ह्येष भरतो नान्यथा गत: ॥२-९७-११॥
translation: O best among men, O valiant one I think Bharata who is affectionate towards his brothers and who is dearer to me than my life, must have returned to Ayodhya and has heard that I had been exiled along with you and Janaki, wearing barks and matted locks. Remembering the duties of the race with an afflicted mind and with agitated senses he has come here to see me. He has not come with any other intention.
word_meanings: वीर O valiant one, पुरुषर्षभ best among men, भ्रातृवत्सलः affectionate towards brothers, मम to me, प्राणात् more than life, प्रियतरः dearer, भरतः Bharata, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, आगतः had returned, माम् me, जानक्या with Janaki, त्वया च with you, सहितम् in the company of, जटावल्कलधारिणम् wearing barks and matted locks, प्रव्राजितम् having been exiled, श्रुत्वा hearing, कुलधर्मम् duties of race, अनुस्मरन् remembering, स्नेहेन with devotion, आक्रान्तहृदय: mind possessed by, शोकेन with distress, आकुलितेन्द्रियः with agitated senses, द्रष्टुम् to see, अभ्यागतः has arrived, अहम् I, मन्ये consider, एषः भरतः this Bharata, अन्यथा for any other reason, न आगतः has not come.

text: अम्बां च कैकयीं रुष्य परुषं चाप्रियं वदन् । प्रसाद्य पितरं श्रीमान् राज्यं मे दातुमागत: ॥२-९७-१२॥
translation: Auspicious Bharata, angry with Kaikeyi and having spoken to her unpleasant, bitter words and having propitiated our father, has come here to offer me the kingdom.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् auspicious Bharata, अम्बाम् mother, कैकयीम् at Kaikeyi, रुष्य angered, परुषम् harshly, अप्रियं च bitterly, वदन् speaking, पितरम् father, प्रसाद्य having propitiated, मे to me, राज्यम् kingdom, दातुम् to offer, आगतः has come.

text: प्राप्तकालं यदेषोऽस्मान् भरतो द्रष्टुमिच्छति । अस्मासु मनसाप्येष नाप्रियं किञ्चिदाचरेत् ॥२-९७-१३॥
translation: Finding the time appropriate, Bharata has come to see us. Even in his mind he would have never thought of causing any harm to us in any way.
word_meanings: एषः भरतः this Bharata, अस्मान् us, यत् द्रष्टुम् इच्छति should he desire to see, प्राप्तकालम् this is appropriate time, एषः he, अस्मासु in us, मनसा अपि even by thought, किंचित् even a little, अप्रियम् harm, नाचरेत् will not do.

text: विप्रियं कृतपूर्वं ते भरतेन कदा नु किम् । ईदृशं वा भयं तेऽद्य भरतं योऽत्र शङ्कसे ॥२-९७-१४॥
translation: Why are you suspicious of Bharata? Has he done anything disagreeable to you any time in the past?
word_meanings: अत्र here, यः such you, अद्य now, भरतम् about Bharata, शङ्कसे you suspect, ते to you, भरतेन by Bharata, कदा नु at any time anything, किम् विप्रियम् anything disagreeable, ईदृशम् such, भयं वा or fear, कृतपूर्वम् has been done in the past.

text: नहि ते निष्ठुरं वाच्यो भरतो नाप्रियं वच: । अहं ह्यप्रियमुक्त: स्यां भरतस्याप्रिये कृते ॥२-९७-१५॥
translation: You must not speak any harsh or unpleasant words against Bharata. If you do, they will be deemed to be directed against me.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, ते to you, निष्ठुरम् harsh word, न वाच्यः must not speak, अप्रियम् harsh, वचः words, न not, भरतस्य to Bharata, अप्रिये unpleasant act, कृते if it has been done, अहम् I, अप्रियम् harsh words, उक्तः स्यां हि has been told.

text: कथं नु पुत्रा: पितरं हन्यु: कस्याञ्चिदापदि । भ्राता वा भ्रातरं हन्यात् सौमित्रे प्राणमात्मन: ॥२-९७-१६॥
translation: Whatever be the calamity, O Lakshmana, how will sons slay their father, or a brother kill his own brother who is as dear to him as his own life?
word_meanings: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, कस्यां चित् आपदि in whatever calamity, पुत्र: son, पितरम् father, कथं नु how, हन्युः can slay, भ्राता वा or a brother, आत्मनः as his own, प्राणम् life, भ्रातरम् his own brother, हन्यात् will kill?

text: यदि राज्यस्य हेतोस्त्वमिमां वाचं प्रभाषसे । वक्ष्यामि भरतं दृष्ट्वा राज्यमस्मै प्रदीयताम् ॥२-९७-१७॥
translation: If you are saying all these words only for the sake of the kingdom, then I shall ask Bharata when I see him to offer this kingdom to you.
word_meanings: राज्यस्य हेतोः for the sake of a kingdom, त्वम् you, इमां वाचम् these words, प्रभाषसे यदि if you are saying भरतम् Bharata, दृष्टवा seeing, अस्मै for him, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रदीयताम् be given, वक्ष्यामि I shall tell.

text: उच्यमानोऽपि भरतो मया लक्ष्मण तत्त्वत: । राज्यमस्मै प्रयच्छेति बाढमित्येव वक्ष्यति ॥२-९७-१८॥
translation: O Lakshmana if I earnestly exhort Bharata to offer this kingdom to you, then on hearing those words, he would say, 'Certainly so'.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, भरतोऽपि Bharata also, अस्मै to him, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रयच्छ give, इति thus, उच्यमानः having been told, तद्वच: that word, बाढम् इत्येव certainly so, वक्ष्यति will say.

text: तथोक्तो धर्मशीलेन भ्रात्रा तस्य हिते रत: । लक्ष्मण: प्रविवेशेव स्वानि गात्राणि लज्जया ॥२-९७-१९॥
translation: Having heard the words uttered by his brother, Rama of virtuous disposition, Lakshmana who was devoted to his brother's welfare, shrank.
word_meanings: धर्मशीलेन by a man of virtuous disposition, भ्रात्रा by brother, तथा thus, उक्तः uttered, तस्य his brother's, हिते in welfare, रतः devoted, लक्ष्मणः Lakshamana, लज्जया with a sense of shame, स्वानि his own, गात्राणि limbs, प्रविवेशेव entered.

text: तद्वाक्यं लक्ष्मण: श्रुत्वा व्रीडित: प्रत्युवाच ह । त्वां मन्ये द्रष्टुमायात: पिता दशरथ: स्वयम् ॥२-९७-२०॥
translation: Hearing the words of Rama, Lakshmana was abashed and said I think it is our father, king Dasaratha who has come here personally to see you.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तद्वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, व्रीलितः abashed, प्रत्युवाच ह replied, पिता father, दशरथः Dasaratha, त्वां you, द्रष्टुम् to see, स्वयम् personally, आयातः has come, मन्ये I think.

text: व्रीडितं लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा राघव: प्रत्युवाच ह । एष मन्ये महाबाहुरिहास्मान् द्रष्टुमागत: ॥२-९७-२१॥
translation: Observing Lakshmana's abashment, Rama said I think the mightyarmed king Dasaratha has come to see all of us here.
word_meanings: व्रीलितम् ashamed, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा seeing, राघवः Rama, प्रत्युवाच ह replied, महाबाहुः mightyarmed, एषः this king Dasaratha, अस्मान् us, द्रष्टुम् to see, इह here, आगतः has come, मन्ये I think.

text: अथवा नौ ध्रुवं मन्ये मन्यमान: सुखोचितौ । वनवासमनुध्याय गृहाय प्रतिनेष्यति ॥२-९७-२२॥
translation: Or rather having thought of the adversities of dwelling in a forest and also by realising that both of us are accustomed to comforts, I think he has certainly come to take us back home.
word_meanings: अथवा or rather, नौ both of us, सुखोचितौ accustomed to comforts, मन्यमानः treating, वनवासम् dwelling in the forest, अनुध्याय having thought of, गृहाय to home, प्रतिनेष्यति take back, ध्रुवम् this is certain, मन्ये I think.

text: इमां वाप्येष वैदेहीमत्यन्तसुखसेविनीम् । पिता मे राघव: श्रीमान् वनादादाय यास्यति ॥२-९७-२३॥
translation: Our father, the prosperous Dasaratha, after withdrawing this princess Vaidehi who is brought up in luxury from the forest (to Ayodhya), will return.
word_meanings: मे पिता my father, श्रीमान् prosperous, एषः राघवः this Raghava, अत्यन्त सुखसेविनीम् brought up in every luxury, इमाम् this lady, वैदेहीम् वा or princess Vaidehi, वनात् from the forest, आदाय यास्यति will take her back.

text: एतौ तौ सम्प्रकाशेते गोत्रवन्तौ मनोरमौ । वायुवेगसमौ वीर जवनौ तुरगोत्तमौ ॥२-९७-२४॥
translation: O valiant warrior, you can see those two splendid horses of high pedigree, charming, swift and equal to wind in speed are shining (in the army).
word_meanings: वीर O valiant one, गोत्रवन्तौ both of them of high pedigree, मनोरमौ charming, वायुवेगसमो windswift, जवनौ both swift, तौ those, एतौ these two, तुरगोत्तमौ splendid horses, सम्प्रकाशेते are shining.

text: स एष सुमहाकाय: कम्पते वाहिनीमुखे । नाग: शत्रुञ्जयो नाम वृद्धस्तातस्य धीमत: ॥२-९७-२५॥
translation: There is that huge and aged elephant named Satrunjaya which belogns to our sagacious father proceeding at the head of the army.
word_meanings: सुमहाकायः huge, शत्रुञ्जयः named Satrunjaya, धीमतः of the sagacious, तातस्य father's, सः that, वृद्धः aged, नागः elephant, एषः here it is, वाहिनीमुखे at the head of the army, कम्पते moving about.

text: न तु पश्यामि तच्छत्ऺत्रं पाण्डरं लोकसत्कृतम् । पितुर्दिव्यं महाबाहो संशयो भवतीह मे ॥२-९७-२६॥
translation: I do not see, O long-armed one! that splendid white canopy of my father, well-respected by men. And this gives rise to doubts in my mind.
word_meanings: महाबाहो O long-armed one, पाण्डुरम् white in colour, लोकसत्कृतम् well-respected by men, दिव्यम् splendid, पितुः father's, तत् then, छत्रं तु canopy, न पश्यामि I do not see, इह in this matter, मे to me, संशयः doubt, भवति is arising.

text: प्रथममर्धमुत्तरार्धेन योजनीयम् ॥२-९७-२७॥
अवतीर्य्य तु सालाग्रात्तस्मात्स समितिञ्जय: । लक्ष्मण: प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा तस्थौ रामस्य पार्श्वत: ॥२-९७-२८॥
translation: Lakshmana, the conqueror of foes, descended from the top of the sala tree and stood by the side of Rama with folded palms.
word_meanings: समितिञ्जयः conqueror of the enemy, सः लक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, तस्मात् सालाग्रात् from the top of that sala tree, अवतीर्य having descended, प्राञ्जलिः भूत्वा with folded palms, रामस्य Rama's, पार्श्वतः by the side of, तस्थौ stood.

text: भरतेनापि सन्दिष्टा सम्मर्दो न भवेदिऺति । समन्तात्तस्य शैलस्य सेना वासमकल्पयत् ॥२-९७-२९॥
translation: Let not the hermitage be crowded commanded Bharata, and the army encamped around the mountain.
word_meanings: सम्मर्दः crowding, न भवेत् let it not happen, इति thus, भरतेनापि by Bharata also, सन्दिष्टा instructed, सेना army, तस्य शैलस्य that mountain's, समन्तात् around, आवासम् encampment, अकल्पयत् made.

text: अध्यर्द्धमिक्ष्वाकुचमूर्योजनं पर्वतस्य सा । पार्श्वे न्यविशदावृत्य गजवाजिरथाकुला ॥२-९७-३०॥
translation: Bharata's army full of horses, elephants and chariots covering a distance of more than one and a half yojanas encamped by the side of the mountain.
word_meanings: गजवाजिरथाकुला with throngs of horses, elephants and chariots, सा that, इक्ष्वाकुचमूः the army of the descendant of Ikshvaku, अध्यर्धयोजनम् a distance more than one and a half yojanas, पर्वतस्य mountain's, पार्श्वे by the side of, आवृत्य having surrounded, न्यविशत् encamped.

text: सा चित्रकूटे भरतेन सेना धर्मं पुरस्कृत्य विधूय दर्प्पम् । प्रसादनार्थं रघुनन्दनस्य विराजते नीतिमता प्रणीता ॥२-९७-३१॥
translation: The army brought by Bharata, the great moralist, was shining around Chitrakuta mountain following dharma, and casting off all pride, in order to please Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तनवतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetyseventh sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: धर्मम् righteousness, पुरस्कृत्य adopting, दर्पम् pride, विधूय casting aside, रघुनन्दनस्य Rama's, प्रसादनार्थम् to propitiate, नीतिमता by a moralist, भरतेन by Bharata, प्रणीता having been brought, सा that, सेना army, चित्रकूटे on Chitrakuta, विराजते was shining.

text: निवेश्य सेनां तु विभु: पद्भ्यां पादवतां वर: । अभिगन्तुं स काकुत्स्थमियेष गुरुवर्त्तकम् ॥२-९८-१॥
translation: On encamping the army, lord Bharata, the best among men, wished to approach on foot Rama who was devoted to his father.
word_meanings: विभुः the lord, पादवताम् among the bipeds, वरः best, सः that Bharata, सेनाम् army, निवेश्य after encamping, गुरुवर्तकम् devoted the preceptor (father), काकुत्थ्सम् Rama, पद्भ्याम् on foot, अभिगन्तुम् to approach, इयेष wished.

text: निविष्टमात्रे सैन्ये तु यथोद्देशं विनीतवत् । भरतो भ्रातरं वाक्यं शत्रुघ्नमिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-९८-२॥
translation: After the army encamped in the assigned places, Bharata said to his brother Satrughna thus:
word_meanings: सैन्ये army, यथोद्देशम् in assigned places, निविष्टमात्रे after encamping, भरतः Bharata, भ्रातरम् brother, शत्रुघ्नम् to Satrughna, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: क्षिप्रं वनमिदं सौम्य नरसङ्घै: समन्तत: । लुब्धैश्च सहितैरेभिस्त्वमन्वेषितुमर्हसि ॥२-९८-३॥
translation: O dear Satrughna, you should explore this forest quickly along with groups of our people and hunters as well.
word_meanings: सौम्य O dear Satrughna, नरसङ्घै: with groups of people, सहितैः accompanied by, लुब्धैश्च in the company of hunters as well, त्वम् you, क्षिप्रम् quickly, इदं वनम् this forest, समन्ततः all over, अन्वेषितुम् to explore, अर्हसि should.

text: गुहो ज्ञातिसहस्रेण शरचापासिधारिणा । समन्वेषतु काकुत्स्थावस्मिन् परिवृत: स्वयम् ॥२-९८-४॥
translation: Let Guha, surrounded by a thousand kinsmen and armed with bows, arrows and swords look for Rama.
word_meanings: गुहः Guha, शरचापासिधारिणा armed with bows, arrows and swords, ज्ञातिसहस्रेण with a thousand kinsmen, परिवृतः surrounded by, स्वयम् himself, अस्मिन् in this forest, काकुत्स्थम् Rama, समन्वेषतु explore.

text: अमात्यै: सह पौरैश्च गुरुभिश्च द्विजातिभि: । वनं सर्वं चरिष्यामि पद्भ्यां परिवृत: स्वयम् ॥२-९८-५॥
translation: 'I myself shall go on foot surrounded by ministers, citizens, preceptors and brahmins and search the entire forest.
word_meanings: स्वयम् I myself, अमात्यैः सह with counsellors, पौरैश्च with citizens, गुरुभिश्च with preceptors, द्विजातिभिः with brahmins, परिवृतः surrounded by, सर्वम् entire, वनम् forest, पद्भ्याम् on foot, चरिष्यामि I shall move about.

text: यावन्न रामं द्रक्ष्यामि लक्ष्मणं वा महाबलम् । वैदेहीं वा महाभागां न मे शान्तिर्भविष्यति ॥२-९८-६॥
translation: 'I shall not rest in peace until I see Rama, powerful Lakshmana and illustrious princess of Videha (Sita).
word_meanings: रामम् Rama, महाबलम् powerful, लक्ष्मणं वा Lakshmana, महाभागां illustrious, वैदेहीं च Sita, यावत् till such time, न द्रक्ष्यामि I do not see, मे to me, शान्ति peace, न भविष्यति shall not come.

text: यावन्न चन्द्रसङ्काशं द्रक्ष्यामि शुभमाननम् । भ्रातु: पद्मपलाशाक्षं न मे शान्तिर्भविष्यति ॥२-९८-७॥
translation: I shall not attain peace until I see my brother, Rama whose auspicious countenance looks radiant as the Moon and whose eyes as lotuspetals.
word_meanings: चन्द्रसङ्काशम् radiant as the Moon, पद्मपलाशाक्षम् eyes resembling lotuspetals, भ्रातुः brother Rama, शुभम् auspicious, आननम् face, यावत् till such time, न द्रक्ष्यामि I do not see, मे to me, शान्तिः peace, न भविष्यति shall not come.

text: यावन्न चरणौ भ्रातु: पार्थिवव्यञ्जनान्वितौ । शिरसा धारयिष्यामि न मे शान्तिर्भविष्यति ॥२-९८-८॥
translation: Peace shall not come to me until I hold on my head the feet of my brother, the insignia of royalty.
word_meanings: भ्रातुः brother's, पार्थिवव्यञ्जनान्वितौ bearing the signs of royalty, चरणौ feet, यावत् till such time, शिरसा with the head, न धारयिष्यामि I will not carry, मे to me, शान्ति: peace, न भविष्यति shall not come.

text: यावन्न राज्ये राज्यार्ह: पितृपैतामहे स्थित: । अभिषेकजलक्लिन्नो न मे शान्तिर्भविष्ऺयति ॥२-९८-९॥
translation: I shall not attain peace until Rama, who is worthy of this kingdom, is sprinkled with the holy water of coronation and assumes the ancestral kingdom.
word_meanings: राज्यार्हः one who is worthy of this kingdom, अभिषेकजलक्लिन्नः wet with the holy waters of consecration, पितृपैतामहे pertaining to our father and forefathers, राज्ये in the kingdom, यावत् till such time, न स्थितः is not established, मे my, शान्तिः peace, न भविष्यति shall not attain.

text: सिद्धार्थ: खलु सौमित्रिर्यश्चन्द्रविमलोपमम् । मुखं पश्यति रामस्य राजीवाक्षं महाद्युति ॥२-९८-१०॥
translation: Lakshmana, one who beholds the highly effulgent countenance of Rama, resembling the spotless Moon and whose eyes resemble red lotuses, is blessed indeed
word_meanings: यः who, चन्द्रविमलोपमम् like the spotless Moon, राजीवाक्षम् whose eyes resemble red lotuses, महाद्युति of great effulgence, रामस्य Rama's, मुखम् countenance, पश्यति beholds, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, सिद्दार्थः खलु blessed indeed.

text: कृतकत्या महाभागा वैदेही जनकात्मजा । भर्तारं सागरान्ताया: पृथिव्या याऽनुगच्छति ॥२-९८-११॥
translation: Sita, the illustrious daughter of Janaka and princess of Videha, has accomplished her purpose by following Rama, the lord of this earth bounded by the ocean.
word_meanings: या that Sita, सागरान्तायाः bounded by the ocean, पृथिव्याः of the earth, भर्तारम् Rama as lord, अनुगच्छति who is following, महाभागा illustrious lady, जनकात्मजा daughter of Janaka, वैदेही princess of Videha (Sita), कृतकृत्या has accomplished her purpose.

text: सुभगश्चित्रकूटोऽसौ गिरिराजोपमो गिरि: । यस्मिन् वसति काकुत्स्थ: कुबेर इव नन्दने ॥२-९८-१२॥
translation: Like Kubera in the Nandana garden, Rama lives here on mount Chitrakuta which is indeed blessed like the Himalaya, king of the mountains.
word_meanings: काकुत्स्थ: Rama, यस्मिन् on which, कुबेरः Kubera, the lord of wealth, नन्दने इव like in the Nandana garden, वसति staying, असौ such, गिरिराजोपमः comparable to the king of the mountains, Himavan, चित्रकूटः गिरिः Chitrakuta mountain, सुभगः is fortunate.

text: कृतकार्यमिदं दुर्गं वनं व्यालनिषेवितम् । यदध्यास्ते महातेजा राम: शस्त्रभृतां वर: ॥२-९८-१३॥
translation: Fortunate is this inaccessible forest which is inhabited by wild animals to have become the dwelling place of the most radiant Rama, the foremost among the wielders of weapons.
word_meanings: शस्त्रभृताम् among those who wield weapons, वरः the foremost, महातेजाः most radiant, रामः Rama, यत् that, अध्यास्ते is dwelling, व्यालनिषेवितम् inhabited by wild animals, दुर्गम् inaccessible, इदं वनम् this forest, कृतकार्यम् accomplished its task.

text: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा भरत: पुरुषर्षभ: । पद्भ्यामेव महाबाहु: प्रविवेश महद्वनम् ॥२-९८-१४॥
translation: Having said thus, the best of men, mightyarmed and highly energetic Bharata entered the great forest on foot.
word_meanings: महातेजा: a man of great radiance, पुरुषर्षभः best of men, महाबाहुः mightyarmed, भरतः Bharata, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having said, महत् great, वनम् forest, पद्भ्यामेव on foot alone, प्रविवेश entered.

text: स तानि द्रुमजालानि जातानि गिरिसानुषु । पुष्पिताग्राणि मध्येन जगाम वदतां वर: ॥२-९८-१५॥
translation: Bharata, the best among the eloquent, made his way amidst multitude of trees grown on mountain slopes with their tops in full bloom.
word_meanings: वदताम् among the eloquent, वर: best, सः that, गिरिसानुषु on mountain slopes, जातानि growing, पुष्पिताग्राणि tops of trees in bloom, तानि those, द्रुमजालानि मध्येन through the midst of multitude of trees, जगाम went.

text: समीपत्वात्तन्मूलदर्शनमिति न पुनरुक्ति: ॥२-९८-१६॥
तं दृष्ट्वा भरत: श्रीमान् मुमोह सहबान्धव: । अत्र राम इति ज्ञात्वा गत: पारमिवाम्भस: ॥२-९८-१७॥
translation: On seeing the smoke, majestic Bharata in the company of relatives concluded that Rama was staying there and rejoiced like a man who had reached the other bank of the river.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् the majestic, सह बान्धवः with relatives, भरतः Bharata, तम् that smoke, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रामः Rama, अत्र इति here he is, ज्ञात्वा having known, अम्भसः of waters, पारम् the other bank, गतः इव having reached, मुमोद rejoiced.

text: स चित्रकूटे तु गिरौ निशम्य रामाश्रमं पुण्यजनोपपन्नम् । गुहेन सार्द्धं त्वरितो जगाम पुनर्निवेश्यैव चमूं महात्मा ॥२-९८-१८॥
translation: Having heard of Rama's hermitage on the Chitrakuta mountain inhabited by pious men, magnanimous Bharata, commanded his army to stay at a distance, and quickly proceeded with Guha. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टनवतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetyeighth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: महात्मा the magnanimous one, सः that Bharata, चित्रकूटे गिरौ on Chitrakuta mountain, पुण्यजनोपपन्नम् inhabited by pious men, रामाश्रमम् Rama's hermitage, निशम्य having heard about, चमूम् the army, निवेश्यैव having camped at a distance, पुनः again, गुहेन सार्धम् with Guha, त्वरितः quickly, जगाम went.

text: निविष्टायां तु सेनायामुत्सुको भरतस्तदा । जगाम भ्रातरं द्रष्टुं शत्रुध्नमनुदर्शयन् ॥२-९९-१॥
translation: Eager to see his brother, Bharata encamped the army and set out showing the hermitage to Satrughna.
word_meanings: तदा then, सेनायाम् when the army, निविष्टायाम् encamped, भरतः Bharata, उत्सुकः with eagerness, शत्रुघ्नम् Satrughna, अनुदर्शयन् showing, भ्रातरम् brother, द्रष्टुम् to see, जगाम went.

text: ऋषिं वसिष्ठं सन्दिश्य मातऽर्मे शीघ्रमानय । इति त्वरितमग्रे स जगाम गुरुवत्सल: ॥२-९९-२॥
translation: Bharata, deeply devoted towards elders, indicated to sage Vasistha to bring along the mothers, and proceeded ahead quickly.
word_meanings: गुरुवत्सलः devoted towards elders, सः Bharata, मे my, मातृ़ः mothers, शीघ्रम् quickly, आनय bring, इति thus, ऋषिम् rishi, वसिष्ठम् Vasistha, सन्दिश्य having conveyed, त्वरितम् quickly, अग्रे ahead, जगाम proceeded.

text: सुमन्त्रस्त्वपि शत्रुघ्नमदूरादन्वपद्यत । रामदर्शनजस्तर्षो भरतस्येव तस्य च ॥२-९९-३॥
translation: Sumantra, who was overeager, like Bharata, to see Rama, followed Satrughna who was not far from him.
word_meanings: सुमन्त्रस्त्वपि Sumantra on his part, शत्रुघ्नम् to Satrughna, अदूरात् not far from, अन्वपद्यत followed, रामदर्शनजः arising from seeing Rama, तर्षः overeager, तस्य च for him also, भरतस्येव is like that of Bharata.

text: गच्छन्नेवाथ भरतस्तापसालयसंस्थिताम् । भ्रातु: पर्णकुटीं श्रीमानुटजं च ददर्श ह ॥२-९९-४॥
translation: While walking, Bharata beheld a hut made of leaves looking like a hermit's cottage.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, श्रीमान् the majestic one, भरतः Bharata, गच्छन्नेव while walking, तापसालयसंस्थिताम् situated like huts of hermits, भ्रातुः brother's, पर्णकुटीम् hut made of leaves, उटजं च thatched cottage, ददर्श ह beheld.

text: शालायास्त्वग्रतस्तस्या ददर्श भरतस्तदा । काष्ठानि चावभग्नानि पुष्पाण्युपचितानि च ॥२-९९-५॥
translation: In front of that hut Bharata beheld shattered logs of wood and also flowers plucked.
word_meanings: तदा then, भरतः Bharata, तस्याः शालायाः that leafy hut's, अग्रतः in front of, अवभग्नानि shattered, काष्ठानि logs of wood, उपचितानि plucked, पुष्पाणि च also flowers, ददर्श beheld.

text: सलक्ष्मणस्य रामस्य ददर्शाश्रममीयुष: । कृतं वृक्षेष्वभिज्ञानं कुशचीरै: क्वचित् क्वचित् ॥२-९९-६॥
translation: Bharata beheld here and there knots of kusa grass and strips of bark tied on trees as signs to ascertain the way to the hermitage of Rama and Lakshmana.
word_meanings: सः he, आश्रमम् hermitage, ईयुषः of a man proceeding towards, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, रामस्य Rama's, क्वचित् क्वचित् here and there, वृक्षेषु on trees, कुशचीरैः with kusa grass and strips of bark, कृतम् rendered, अभिज्ञानम् as a sign to ascertain, ददर्श beheld.

text: ददर्श च वने तस्मिन् महत: सञ्चयान् कृतान् । मृगाणां महिषाणां च कऺरीषै: शीतकारणात् ॥२-९९-७॥
translation: He also beheld large heaps of dried cakes of dung of buffaloes and deer for use against cold in the forest.
word_meanings: सः that Bharata, तस्मिन् वने in that forest, शीतकारणात् due to cold, मृगाणाम् deer's, महिषाणां च also of buffaloes, करीषैः dried cakes of dung, कृतान् prepared, महतः large, सञ्चयान् heaps, ददर्श beheld.

text: गच्छन्नेव महाबाहुर्द्युतिमान् भरतस्तदा । शत्रुघ्नं चाब्रवीद्धृष्टस्तानमात्यांश्च सर्वश: ॥२-९९-८॥
translation: Walking on, the longarmed, effulgent and delighted Bharata said to Satrughna and the ministers surrounding him:
word_meanings: महाबाहुः longarmed, द्युतिमान् effulgent, भरतः Bharata, तदा then, गच्छन्नेव while going, हृष्टः rejoiced, शत्रुघ्नं च to Satrughna, सर्वशः all around, तान् those, अमात्यांश्च to the ministers, अब्रवीत् said.

text: मन्ये प्राप्ता: स्म तं देशं भरद्वाजो यमब्रवीत् । नातिदूरे हि मन्येऽहं नदीं मन्दाकिनीमित: ॥२-९९-९॥
translation: We must have reached the region about which Bharadwaja had spoken. I think river Mandakini is not far from here.
word_meanings: यम् about which, भरद्वाजः Bharadwaja, अब्रवीत् had spoken, तं देशम् that region, प्राप्ताः स्म we must have reached, मन्ये I think, मन्दाकिनीं नदीं Mandakini river, इतः from here, नातिदूरे not far, अहम् I, मन्ये think.

text: उच्चैर्बद्धानि चीराणि लक्ष्मणेन भवेदयम् । अभिज्ञानकृत: पन्था विकाले गन्तुमिच्छता ॥२-९९-१०॥
translation: Here are long bark garments fastened on lofty places as marks of identification left by Lakshmana, to locate the path at odd times which may be needed while going out.
word_meanings: चीराणि long bark garments, उच्चैः on lofty places (trees), बद्धानि have been fastened, अयम् this, अकाले at odd times, गन्तुम् to move out, इच्छता wishing, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, अभिज्ञानकृतः marks of identification, पन्थाः भवेत् it must have been the path.

text: इदं चोदात्तदन्तानां कुञ्जराणां तरस्विनाम् । शैलपार्श्वे परिक्रान्तमन्योन्यमभिगर्जताम् ॥२-९९-११॥
translation: This must be the place on the hillside on which mighty tuskers wander about trumpeting and charging at one another.
word_meanings: शैलपार्श्वे on the hillside, इदम् this, उदात्तदन्तानाम् of the largetusked, तरस्विनाम् swift अन्योन्यम् charging at one another, अभिगर्जताम् trumpeting, कुञ्जराणाम् elephants', परिक्रान्तम् place.

text: यमेवाधातुमिच्छन्ति तापसा: सततं वने । तस्यासौ दृश्यते धूम: सङ्कुल: कृष्णवर्त्मन: ॥२-९९-१२॥
translation: Here is the thick smoke emanating from the blacktrailed fire maintained perpetually by the ascetics living in the forest.
word_meanings: वने in the forest, तापसाः ascetics, सततम् always, यमेव only whom, आधातुम् to maintain, इच्छन्ति wishing, तस्य that, कृष्णवर्त्मनः of blacktrailed fires, असौ this, सङ्कुलः thick, धूमः smoke, दृश्यते is seen.

text: अत्राहं पुरुषव्याघ्रं गुरुसंस्कारकारिणम् । आर्यं द्रक्ष्यामि संहृष्टो महर्षिमिव राघवम् ॥२-९९-१३॥
translation: I shall see here with a delighted heart the venerable Rama, the best of men, who renders great hospitality (to elders) and who resembles a maharshi.
word_meanings: अहम् I, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् the best of men, Rama, गुरुसत्कारकारिणम् rendering great hospitality, आर्यम् venerable, महर्षिमिव like a great sage, राघवम् to Rama, संहृष्टः with a delighted heart, अत्र here, द्रक्ष्यामि I shall see.

text: अथ गत्वा मुहूर्तं तु चित्रकूटं स राघव: । मन्दाकिनीमनुप्राप्तस्तं जनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥२-९९-१४॥
translation: Bharata walked for a short distance towards mount Chitrkuta when he reached river Mandakini. And then said to his ministers:
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, सः राघवः that Bharata, चित्रकूटम् towards Chitrakuta (mountain), मुहूर्तम् for a moment, गत्वा having gone, मन्दाकिनीम् river Mandakini, अनुप्राप्तः having reached, तं जनम् to those people, इदम् those words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: जगत्यां पुरुषव्याघ्र आस्ते वीरासने रत: । जनेन्द्रो निर्जनं प्राप्य धिङ्मे जन्म सजीवितम् ॥२-९९-१५॥
translation: Rama, the lord of men, a tiger among men, is sitting on the ground in a 'heroic' (yogic) posture in this secluded forest. O fie upon my birth and my life
word_meanings: जनेन्द्रः the lord of men, पुरषव्याघ्रः a tiger among men, निर्जनम् a place devoid of people, प्राप्य having reached, वीरासने in 'heroic' posture, रतः remaining, जगत्याम् on the ground, आस्ते is sitting, मे my, सजीवितम् life, जन्म birth, धिक् fie upon.

text: मत्कृते व्यसनं प्राप्तो लोकनाथो महाद्युति: । सर्वान् कामान् परित्यज्य वने वसति राघव: ॥२-९९-१६॥
translation: Effulgent Rama, the lord of the world, had to renounce all desires and undergo this calamity of living in the forest on my account.
word_meanings: लोकनाथः lord of the world, महाद्युतिः effulgent, राघवः Rama, मत्कृते on my account, व्यसनम् calamity, प्राप्त: has faced, सर्वान् all, कामान् desires, परित्यज्य renouncing, वने in the forest, वसति is living.

text: इति लोकसमाक्रुष्ट: पादेष्वद्य प्रसादयन् । रामस्य निपतिष्यामि सीताया लक्ष्मणस्य च ॥२-९९-१७॥
translation: Reviled by the world, I shall now fall at the feet of Sita, Rama and Lakshmana seeking their grace.
word_meanings: इति thus, लोकसमाक्रुष्टः reviled by the world, अद्य now, प्रसादयन् seeking the grace, रामस्य Rama's, सीतायाः Sita's, लक्ष्मणस्य च and Lakshmana's, पादेषु at the feet, निपतिष्यामि shall fall down.

text: एवं स विलपंस्तस्मिन् वने दशरथात्मज: । ददर्श महतीं पुण्यां पर्णशालां मनोरमाम् ॥२-९९-१८॥
translation: Lamenting in this way Bharata beheld in that forest an excellent, sacred and enchanting hut covered with a lot of leaves of sala, palmyra and aswakarna trees like a sacrificial altar spread with soft kusa grass. Goldplated bows that resembled the thunderbolt of Indra, powerful and capable of achieving great targets and oppressing the enemies, adorned the hut. Arrows glittering like the rays of the Sun, were dreadful, with blazing heads and stored in quivers adorned it like the hooded serpents illumining the city of Bhogavati (in the nether world). A pair of swords in scabbards made of excellent silver, two shields of different colours with golden spots, fingerguards made of skin of iguana decorated with gold were hanging there. It was impregnable to enemy hordes like the cave of a lion to the deer.

translation: Lamenting in this way Bharata beheld in that forest an excellent, sacred and enchanting hut covered with a lot of leaves of sala, palmyra and aswakarna trees like a sacrificial altar spread with soft kusa grass. Goldplated bows that resembled the thunderbolt of Indra, powerful and capable of achieving great targets and oppressing the enemies, adorned the hut. Arrows glittering like the rays of the Sun, were dreadful, with blazing heads and stored in quivers adorned it like the hooded serpents illumining the city of Bhogavati (in the nether world). A pair of swords in scabbards made of excellent silver, two shields of different colours with golden spots, fingerguards made of skin of iguana decorated with gold were hanging there. It was impregnable to enemy hordes like the cave of a lion to the deer.
word_meanings: एवम् in that way, संविलपन् lamenting, दशरथात्मजः son of Dasaratha (Bharata), तस्मिन् वने in that forest, महतीम् great, पुण्याम् sacred, मनोरमाम् enchanting, सालतालाश्वकर्णानाम् of sala, palmyra and aswakarna trees, बहुभिः by abundance of, मृदुभिः by soft, पर्णैः with leaves, आवृताम् covered, अध्वरे in the sacrifice, कुशैः with kusa grass, तीर्णाम् spread over, विशालाम् spacious, वेदिमिव like altar, शक्रायुधनिकाशैः resembling the thunderbolt of Indra, भारसाधनैः capable of achieving targets, रुक्मपृष्ठैः goldplated, महासारै: by powerful, शत्रुबाधकैः oppressing the enemies, कार्मुकैः with bows, शोभिताम् glittering, सर्पैः with serpents, भोगवतीम् इव like Bhogavati, अर्करश्मिप्रतीकाशैः like the rays of the Sun, घोरैः by dreadful, दीप्तवदनैः with tips blazing, तूणीगतैः stored in quivers, शरैः with arrows, शोभिताम् adorned with, महारजतवासोभ्याम् scabbards made of silver, असिभ्याम् with a pair of swords, विराजिताम् was shining, रुक्मबिन्दुविचित्राभ्याम् of different colours with golden spots, चर्मभ्याम् with shields, ताम् all of them, काञ्चनभूषितैः decorated with gold, चित्रैः different kinds, आसक्तै: hung, गोधाङ्गुलित्रैः fingerguards made of skin of iguana, मृगैः with the deer, सिंहगुहामिव like the cave of a lion, अरिसङ्घै: with hordes of enemies, अनाधृष्याम् impregnable, पर्णशालाम् hut made of leave, तस्मिन् वने in that forest, ददर्श saw.

text: प्रागुदक्प्रवणां वेदिं विशालां दीप्तपावकाम् । ददर्श भरतस्तत्र पुण्यां रामनिवेशने ॥२-९९-२४॥
translation: Bharata beheld at Rama's residence a sacred and spacious altar sloping to the northeast, with a burning fire upon it.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, तत्र there, रामनिवेशने at Rama's residence, प्रागुदक्प्रवणाम् sloping to the northeast, विशालाम् spacious, दीप्तपावकाम् having flaming fire, पुण्याम् sacred, वेदिम् altar, ददर्श beheld.

text: निरीक्ष्य स मुहूर्त्तं तु ददर्श भरतो गुरम् । उटजे राममासीनं जटामण्डलधारिणम् ॥२-९९-२५॥
