text: तत: पर्णकुटीद्वारमासाद्य जगतीपति: । परिजग्राह बाहुभ्यामुभौ भरतलक्ष्मणौ ॥२-१०२-३२॥
translation: Rama, lord of the earth, reached the door of the leafhut and took Bharata and Lakshmana in his arms.
word_meanings: ततः then, जगतीपतिः lord of the earth (Rama), पर्णकुटीद्वारम् the door of leafhut, आसाद्य having reached, बाहुभ्याम् with his arms, भरतलक्ष्मणौ Bharata and Lakshmana, उभौ both, परिजग्राह took hold of.

text: तेषां तु रुदतां शब्दात् प्रतिश्रुत्को ऽभवद्गिरौ । भ्रातऽणां सह वैदेह्या: सिंहानामिव नर्दताम् ॥२-१०२-३३॥
translation: The mountain echoed with the sound of lamentations of all the brothers along with Sita which resembled the roar of lions.
word_meanings: वैदेह्या सह with Sita, रुदताम् of those lamenting people, तेषां भ्रात्रूणाम् all the brothers', शब्दात् with the sound, नर्दताम् roaring, सिंहानामिव like the lions, शब्दात् with sound, गिरौ in the mountain, प्रतिशब्दः अभवत् was echoed.

text: महाबलानां रुदतां कुर्वतामुदकं पितु: । विज्ञाय तुमुलं शब्दं त्रस्ता भरतसैनिका: ॥२-१०२-३४॥
translation: The soldiers of Bharata were alarmed on hearing the tumultuous sounds raised by those mighty brothers offering libations of water and lamenting.
word_meanings: महाबलानाम् of mighty ones, पितुः to father, उदकम् libations of water, कुर्वताम् of those offering, रुदताम् lamenting brothers', तुमुलम् tumultous, शब्दम् sound, विज्ञाय having come to know, भरतसैनिकाः soldiers of Bharata, त्रस्ताः were alarmed.

text: अब्रुवंश्चापि रामेण भरत: सङ्गतो ध्रुवम् । तेषामेव महाञ्छब्द: शोचतां पितरं मृतम् ॥२-१०२-३५॥
translation: They said, 'Bharata must have joined Rama. That loud noise must be their wailing over their deceased father'.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, रामेण with Rama, सङ्गतः joined, घृवम् this is certain, मृतम् deceased, पितरम् about father, शोचताम् lamenting, तेषामेव their only, महान् loud, शब्दः noise, अब्रुवन् च अपि they said.

text: अथ वासान् परित्यज्य तं सर्वे ऽभिमुखा: स्वनम् । अप्येकमनसो जग्मुर्यथास्थानं प्रधाविता: ॥२-१०२-३६॥
translation: Then all of them left their camps with one single thought (of seeing Rama) in their minds and ran in the direction from where that sound emanated.
word_meanings: सर्वे all of them, अथ thereafter, वासान् their camps, परित्यज्य leaving, तं स्वनम् that sound, अभिमुखाः towards, एकमनसः अपि with only one thought in their minds, यथास्थानम् from their respective places, प्रधाविताः ran, जग्मुः went.

text: हयैरन्ये गजैरन्ये रथैरन्ये स्वलङ्कृतै: । सुकुमारास्तथैवान्ये पद्भिरेव नरा ययु: ॥२-१०२-३७॥
translation: Some rode horses, some, elephants, while others mounted welldecorated chariots, while the young went on foot.
word_meanings: अन्ये some, हयैः on horses, अन्ये गजैः some on elephants, सुकुमाराः delicate men, अन्ये others, स्वलङ्कृतैः welldecorated, रथैः on chariots, तथैव similarly, अन्ये other, नराः men, पद्भिरेव on foot, ययुः went.

text: अचिरप्रोषितं रामं चिरविप्रोषितं यथा । द्रष्टुकामो जन: सर्वो जगाम सहसाश्रमम् ॥२-१०२-३८॥
translation: The whole multitude of people at once rushed towards the hermitage wishing to see Rama as if he had left long ago though he had gone on exile very recently.
word_meanings: सर्वः all, जनः people, अचिरप्रोषितम् exiled recently, रामम् Rama, चिरविप्रोषितं यथा as if he had left long ago, द्रष्टुकामः with a desire to see him, सहसा quickly, आश्रमम् towards the hermitage, जगाम went.

text: भ्रातऽणां त्वरितास्तत्र द्रष्टुकामा: समागमम् । ययुर्बहुविधैर्यानै: खुरनेमिस्वनाकुलै: ॥२-१०२-३९॥
translation: Eager to see the union of brothers, all those people went by every sort of vehicle filled with the sounds of hooves and wheels.
word_meanings: तत्र there, भ्रातृ़णाम् of brothers, समागमम् union of, द्रष्टुकामाः people wishing to see, त्वरिताः hastily, खुरनेमिस्वनाकुलैः filled with the sounds of the hooves and wheels, बहुविधैः by every sort of, यानै: on vehicle, ययुः went.

text: सा भूमिर्बहुभिर्यानै: खुरनेमिसमाहता । मुमोच तुमुलं शब्दं द्यौरिवाभ्रसमागमे ॥२-१०२-४०॥
translation: The earth crushed by several vehicles, hooves (of horses) and wheels (of chariots) emitted tumultuous sounds like the sky in the gathering stormclouds.
word_meanings: बहुभि: by several, यानैः by vehicles, खुरनेमि समाहता crushed with hooves and wheels, सा भूमिः the earth, अभ्रसमागमे at the gathering of stormclouds, द्यौरिव like the sky, तुमुलम् tumultous, शब्दम् sound, मुमोच emitted.

text: तेन वित्रासिता नागा: करेणुपरिवारिता: । आवासयन्तो गन्धेन जग्मुरन्यद्वनं तत: ॥२-१०२-४१॥
translation: Frightened by the sound, the elephants followed by their females, spreading all the way the odour of the ichor, moved to other forests.
word_meanings: तेन by that (sound), वित्रासिताः frightened, करेणुपरिवारिताः followed by the female elephants, नागाः elephants, गन्धेन with the odour of ichor, आवासयन्तः odorising, ततः from there, अन्यत् वनम् to another forest, जग्मुः went.

text: वराहवृकसङ्घाश्च महिषा: सर्प्पवानरा: । व्याघ्रगोकर्णगवया: वित्रेसु: पृषतैः सह ॥२-१०२-४२॥
translation: Hearing that sound, hosts of boars and deer, buffaloes, serpents and apes, tigers, antelopes with ears like the cows', gavayas as well as dappled antelopes were all frightened.
word_meanings: वराहवृकसङ्घाश्च with host of boars and wolves, महिषाः buffaloes, सर्पवानराः serpents and apes, व्याघ्रगोकर्णगवयाः tigers, antelopes with ears like cows', gavayas, पृषतैः सह along with spotted deer, वित्रेसुः were frightened.

text: रथाङ्गसाह्वा नत्यूहा: हंसा: कारण्डवा: प्लवा: । तथा पुंस्कोकिला: क्रौञ्चा विसंज्ञा भेजिरे दिश: ॥२-१०२-४३॥
translation: Ducks, watercranes, geese, karandavas, cranes, male cuckoos and kraunchas fled senselessly in different directions.
word_meanings: रथाङ्गसाह्वाः ducks, नत्यूहा watercranes, हंसाः geese, कारण्डवाः karandavas, प्लवाः cranes, तथा similarly, पुंस्कोकिलाः male cuckoos, क्रौञ्चाः kraunchas, विसंज्ञाः senselessly, दिशः diffrent directions, भेजिरे fled.

text: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्तैराकाशं पक्षिभिर्वृतम् । मनुष्यैरावृता भूमिरुभयं प्रबभौ तदा ॥२-१०२-४४॥
translation: The sky was filled with birds frightened by the sound and the earth covered with people. Both looked extremely beautiful.
word_meanings: तेन शब्देन by that sound, वित्रस्तैः frightened, पक्षिभिः by birds also, वृतम् filled with, आकाशम् the sky, मनुष्यैः by people, आवृता covered, भूमिः the earth, उभयम् both, तदा प्रबभौ greatly shone.

text: ततस्तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं यशस्विनमरिन्दमम् । आसीनं स्थण्डिले रामं ददर्श सहसा जन: ॥२-१०२-४५॥
translation: All at once the people saw the illustrious Rama, the best of men, and the subduer of enemies squatting on the bare earth.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, जनः people, पुरुषव्याघ्रं best of men, यशस्विनम् illustrious, अरिन्दमम् one who is destroyer of enemies, स्थण्डिले on the bare earth, आसीनम् squatted, तम् that, रामम् Rama, सहसा at once, ददर्श beheld.

text: विगर्हमाण: कैकेयीं सहितो मन्थरामपि । अभिगम्य जनो रामं बाष्पपूर्णमुखो ऽभवत् ॥२-१०२-४६॥
translation: All those men with faces full of tears, reproaching Kaikeyi and Manthara (all the way), approached Rama.
word_meanings: जनः all men, मन्थरासहिताम् including Manthara, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, विगर्हमाणः censuring, रामम् to Rama, अभिगम्य having reached, बाष्पपूर्णमुखः with face filled with tears, अभवत् became.

text: तान्नरान् बाष्पपूर्णाक्षान् समीक्ष्याथ सुदु:खितान् । पर्य्यष्वजत धर्मज्ञ: पितृवन्मातृवच्च स: ॥२-१०२-४७॥
translation: Thereafter, beholding those people deeply afflicted, their eyes full of tears, Rama embraced them as if they were his own father and mother.
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञः knower of righteousness, सः that Rama, अथ thereafter, बाष्पपूर्णाक्षान् eyes filled with tears, सुदुःखितान् deeply afflicted, तान्नरान् those people, समीक्ष्य having seen, पितृवत् like a father, मातृवच्च like a mother, पर्यष्वजत embraced.

text: स तत्र कांच्चित् परिषस्वजे नरान्नराश्च केचित्तु तमभ्यवादयन् । चकार सर्वान् सवयस्य बान्धवान् यथार्हमासाद्य तदा नृपात्मज: ॥२-१०२-४८॥
translation: Rama embraced some, while others paid him obeisance. Therafter, he honoured his erstwhile companions and relations in accordance with their status.
word_meanings: सः Rama, तत्र there, कांश्चित् some, नरान् men, परिषस्वजे embraced, केचित्तु as for some, नराश्च men, तम् that Rama, अभ्यवादयन् paid obeisance, तदा then, सः that, नृपात्मजः king's son, सर्वान् all of them, आसाद्य having reached, वयस्यबान्धवान् friends and relations, यथार्हम् as deserved, चकार made.

text: स तत्र तेषां रुदतां महात्मनां भुवं च खं चानुनिनादयन् स्वन: । गुहा गिरीणां च दिशश्च सन्ततं मृदङ्गघोषप्रतिम: प्रशुश्रुवे ॥२-१०२-४९॥
translation: The weeping and the tumult of those magnanimous people made the earth, sky, mountaincaves and all quarters reverberate incessantly like the beating of drums. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्व्युत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundred and second sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: तत्र there, रुदताम् weeping, तेषां महात्मनाम् those magnanimous persons, स्वनः that tumult, भुवं च the earth, खं च the sky, गिरीणाम् of mountains, गुहाश्च caves, दिशश्च the directions, अनुनिनादयन् reverberating, मृदङ्गघोषप्रतिमः like beating of drums, सन्ततम् incessantly, प्रशुश्रुवे was heard.

text: वसिष्ठ: पुरत: कृत्वा दारान् दशरथस्य च । अभिचक्राम तं देशं रामदर्शनतर्षित: ॥२-१०३-१॥
translation: Longing to see Rama, Vasistha, headed by the wives of Dasaratha, set out on foot (where Rama was offering libations).
word_meanings: वसिष्ठः Vasistha, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, दारान् wives, पुरतः in front of, कृत्वा having placed, रामदर्शनतर्षितः longing to see Rama, तं देशम् that place, अभिचक्राम set out on foot.

text: राजपत्न्यश्च गच्छन्त्यो मन्दं मन्दाकिनीं प्रति । ददृशुस्तत्र तत्तीर्थं रामलक्ष्मणसेवितम् ॥२-१०३-२॥
translation: The wives of the king while proceeding slowly towards the river Mandakini beheld the bathing place frequented by Rama and Lakshmana.
word_meanings: राजपत्न्यश्च king's wives also, मन्दाकिनीं प्रति towards the river Mandakini, मन्दम् slowly, गच्छन्त्यः while proceeding, तत्र there, रामलक्ष्मणसेवितम् frequented by Rama and Lakshmana, तत् तीर्थम् that bathing place, ददृशुः beheld.

text: कौसल्या बाष्पपूर्णेन मुखेन परिशुष्यता । सुमित्रामब्रवीद्दीना याश्ऺचान्या राजयोषित: ॥२-१०३-३॥
translation: Kausalya, with eyes filled with tears and her face emaciated, addressing Sumitra and the other wives of the king sadly said:
word_meanings: कौसल्या Kausalya, बाष्पपूर्णेन filled with tears, परिशुष्यता emaciated, मुखेन with her countenance, दीना in desolation, सुमित्राम् to Sumitra, याः अन्याः the other, राजयोषितः to wives of the king, अब्रवीत् said.

text: इदं तेषामनाथानां क्लिष्टमक्लिष्टकर्मणाम् । वने प्राक्केवलं तीर्थं ये ते निर्विषयीकृता: ॥२-१०३-४॥
translation: This is a sacred place to the east of the forest used by the unfortunate Rama, and Lakshmana of untiring energy and Sita expelled from the country and undergoing suffering.
word_meanings: इदम् this one, ये ते those, निर्विषयीकृताः expelled from the country, तेषाम् their, आक्लिष्टकर्मणाम् men performing deeds with untiring energy, अनाथानाम् unfortunate ones, क्लिष्टम् sufferings, प्राक्कलनम् to the east of, वने in the forest, तीर्थम् sacred place.

text: इत: सुमित्रे पुत्रस्ते सदा जलमतन्द्रित: । स्वयं हरति सौमित्रिर्मम पुत्रस्य कारणात् ॥२-१०३-५॥
translation: O Sumitra, your son Lakshmana, free from laziness, always carries water from here for the sake of my son.
word_meanings: सुमित्रे O Sumitra, ते पुत्रः your son, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, मम पुत्रस्य my son's, कारणात् on account, सदा always, अतन्द्रितः without indolence, इतः from this place, जलम् water, स्वयम् himself, हरति carries.

text: जघन्यमपि ते पुत्र: कृतवान्न तु गर्हित: । भ्रातुर्यदर्थसहितं सर्वं तद्विहितं गुणै: ॥२-१०३-६॥
translation: Your son, though engaged in servile tasks (like bringing water), is not to be held contemptible because all the services intended for the benefit of his brother are prompted by virtue.
word_meanings: ते पुत्रः your son, जघन्यम् servile task, अपि although, कृतवान् has done, गर्हितः तु is indeed contemptible, न not, यत् the service, भ्रातुः to brother, अर्थसहितम् for the benefit of, तत् सर्वम् all that, गुणैः with virtues, विहितम् is endowed with.

text: अद्यायमपि ते पुत्र: क्लेशानामतथोचित: । नीचानर्थसमाचारं सज्जं कर्म प्रमुञ्चतु ॥२-१०३-७॥
translation: This your son unaccustomed to, and undeserving of, any suffering may now give up this mean and distressing duty entrusted to him.
word_meanings: क्लेशानाम् of suffering, अतथोचितः unaccustomed, अयम् this, ते पुत्रः अपि your son also, अद्य now, नीचानर्थसमाचारम् mean and distressing, सज्जम् commenced, कर्म work, this service, प्रमुञ्चतु cease to perform.

text: दक्षिणाग्रेषु दर्भेषु सा ददर्श महीतले । पितुरिङ्गुदिपिण्याकं न्यस्तमायतलोचना ॥२-१०३-८॥
translation: That largeeyed Kausalya beheld the cakes of ingudi pulp placed by Rama for his father on a spread of darbha grass whose blades pointed toward the south.
word_meanings: आयतलोचना largeeyed, सा that Kausalya, दक्षिणाग्रेषु pointed towards south, दर्भेषु blades of darbha grass, महीतले on the ground, पितुः father's, न्यस्तम् placed, इङ्गुदिपिण्याकम् cakes of ingudi pulp, ददर्श beheld.

text: तं भूमौ पितुरार्तेन न्यस्तं रामेण वीक्ष्य सा । उवाच देवी कौसल्या सर्वा दशरथस्त्रिय: ॥२-१०३-९॥
translation: Seeing the pinda (edible offering made to the departed soul) placed on the ground for his father by the distressed Rama, queen Kausalya, addressing all the wives of Dasaratha, said:
word_meanings: देवी queen, सा कौसल्या that Kausalya, आर्तेन distressed, रामेण by Rama, पितुः to father, न्यस्तम् placed, तम् that pinda (pindaofferings made to the departed soul), भूमौ on the ground, वीक्ष्य seeing, सर्वाः all, दशरथस्त्रियः to wives of Dasaratha, उवाच said.

text: इदमिक्ष्वाकुनाथस्य राघवस्य महात्मन: । राघवेण पितुर्दत्तं पश्यतैतद्यथाविधि ॥२-१०३-१०॥
translation: Have darsan of this pinda offered by Rama according to tradition to his magnanimous father, Dasaratha, lord of the Ikshvaku race.
word_meanings: राघवेण by Rama, इक्ष्वाकुनाथस्य for the sake of lord of the Ikshvaku race, महात्मनः of the magnanimous, पितुः father, राघवस्य for Dasaratha, यथाविधि according to tradition, दत्तम् given, इदम् this pinda, पश्यत look at.

text: तस्य देवसमानस्य पार्थिवस्य महात्मन: । नैतदौपयिकं मन्ये भुक्तभोगस्य भोजनम् ॥२-१०३-११॥
translation: I do not think that this is an appropriate food for that godlike and great lord of the earth who enjoyed all luxury.
word_meanings: देवसमानस्य of a man equal to god, भुक्तभोगस्य of one who enjoyed every luxury, महात्मनः of the magnaniouous, तस्य पार्थिवस्य of that lord of the earth, एतत् this, भोजनम् food, औपयिकम् is appropriate, न मन्ये I don't think.

text: चतुरन्तां महीं भुक्त्वा महेन्द्रसदृशो विभु: । कथमिङ्गुदिपिण्याकं स भुङ्क्ते वसुधाधिप: ॥२-१०३-१२॥
translation: How can Indralike Dasaratha, having ruled the earth bounded by four oceans, eat a cake of ingudi pulp?
word_meanings: महेन्द्रसदृशः resembling Indra, विभुः king, सः वसुधाधिपः that lord of the earth, चतुरन्ताम् with four corners, महीम् the earth, भुक्त्वा having enjoyed, इङ्गुदिपिण्याकम् the cake of pulp of ingudi, कथम् how, भुक्ते can he eat?

text: अतो दु:खतरं लोके न किञ्चित् प्रतिभाति मा । यत्र राम: पितुर्दद्यादिङ्गुदीक्षोदमृद्धिमान् ॥२-१०३-१३॥
translation: Rama (who was once) highly prosperous, had to offer the cake of ingudi pulp to his father. Nothing appears more painful to me than this in this world.
word_meanings: यत्र at a point, ऋद्धिमान् (formerly) prosperous, रामः Rama, पितुः to father, इङ्गुदिक्षोदम् cake of ingudi nuts, दद्यात् may offer, अतः more than this, लोके in this world, दुःखतरम् more painful, किञ्चित् anything, मा to me, न प्रतिभाति does not appear.

text: रामेणेङ्गुदिपिण्याकं पितुर्दत्तं समीक्ष्य मे । कथं दु:खेन हृदयं न स्फोटति सहस्रधा ॥२-१०३-१४॥
translation: Seeing the offering of cake of ingudi pulp by Rama to his father, how is it that my heart does not break into a thousand pieces in sorrow?
word_meanings: रामेण by Rama, पितुः to father, दत्तम् offered, इङ्गुदिपिण्याकम् cake of ingudi pulp, समीक्ष्य on seeing, मे हृदयम् my heart, दुःखेन out of sorrow, सहस्रधा into a thousand pieces, कथम् how, न स्फोटति not breaking?

text: श्रुतिस्तु खल्वियं सत्या लौकिकी प्रतिभाति मा । यदन्न: पुरुषो भवति तदन्नास्तस्य देवता: ॥२-१०३-१५॥
translation: The wellknown saying in this world is that 'whatever food a man partakes, his gods also partake the same'. This dictum appears true (now).
word_meanings: पुरुषः man, यदन्नः भवति whatever is his food, तस्य his, देवताः gods, तदन्नाः they have the same food, इयम् this, लौकिकी wellknown in the world, श्रुतिस्तु saying, सत्या as truthful, मा about (to) me, प्रतिभाति खलु occurs to me.

text: एवमार्त्तां सपत्न्यस्ता जग्मुराश्वास्य तां तदा । ददृशुश्चाश्रमे रामं स्वर्गच्युतमिवामरम् ॥२-१०३-१६॥
translation: The cowives, having thus consoled the distressed Kausalya, went to the hermitage. There they beheld Rama who looked like a god dislodged from heaven.
word_meanings: तदा then, ताः those, सपत्न्यः cowives, एवम् in this way, आर्ताम् distressed, ताम् her, आश्वास्य having consoled, जग्मुः went, आश्रमे in the hermitage, स्वर्गच्युतम् fallen from heaven, अमरमिव like a god, रामम् Rama, ददृशुश्च beheld.

text: सर्वभोगै: परित्यक्तं रामं सम्प्रेक्ष्य मातर: । आर्त्ता मुमुचुरश्रूणि सस्वरं शोककर्शिता: ॥२-१०३-१७॥
translation: Beholding Rama devoid of all luxury, his mothers afflicted with grief, and overcome with sorrow, cried aloud, tears streaming down.
word_meanings: शोककर्शिताः emaciated due to grief, मातरः mothers, सर्वभोगैः with all luxuries, परित्यक्तम् devoid of, रामम् Rama, सम्प्रेक्ष्य having seen, आर्ताः overcome with sorrow, सस्वरम् in loud voice, अश्रूणि tears, मुमुचुः shed.

text: तासां राम: समुत्थाय जग्राह चरणान् शुभान् । मातऽणां मनुजव्याघ्र: सर्वासां सत्यसङ्गर: ॥२-१०३-१८॥
translation: Rama, the best among men and true to his promise, rose and touched the auspicious feet of all his mothers (in reverence).
word_meanings: मनुजव्याघ्रः best among men, सत्यसङ्गरः true to his promise, रामः Rama, समुत्थाय having risen, सर्वासाम् to all, तासां मात्रूणाम् of those mothers, शुभान् auspicious, चरणान् feet, जग्राह clasped.

text: ता: पाणिभि: सुखस्पर्शैर्मृद्वङ्गुलितलै: शुभै: । प्रममार्जू रज: पृष्ठाद्रामस्यायतलोचना: ॥२-१०३-१९॥
translation: Those largeeyed queens, their palms with delicate fingers and with auspicious hands with a pleasant touch, wiped the dust from the back of his body.
word_meanings: आयतलोचनाः largeeyed ones, ताः they, सुखस्पर्शैः with pleasant touch, मृद्वङ्गुलितलैः with palms having delicate fingers, शुभैः by auspicious, पाणिभिः with hands, रामस्य Rama's, पृष्ठात् from the back of the body, रजः the dust, प्रममार्जुः wiped.

text: सौमित्रिरपि ता: सर्वा: मातऽ: सम्प्रेक्ष्य दु:खित: । अभ्यवादयतासक्तं शनै रामादनन्तरम् ॥२-१०३-२०॥
translation: On seeing his mothers, Lakshmana, too, was overcome with grief and with devotion followed Rama and slowly bowed to them with reverence.
word_meanings: सौमित्रिरपि Lakshmana also, सर्वाः all, ताः मात्रृ़ः those mothers, सम्प्रेक्ष्य after seeing, दुःखितः overcome with grief, रामात् अनन्तरम् following Rama, शनैः slowly, आसक्तम् with devotion, अभ्यवादयत् bowed with reverence.

text: यथा रामे तथा तस्मिन् सर्वा ववृतिरे स्त्रिय: । वृत्तिं दशरथाज्जाते लक्ष्मणे शुभलक्षणे ॥२-१०३-२१॥
translation: All the queens treated Lakshmana, born of Dasaratha and endowed with auspicious qualities, with the same love as they did to Rama.
word_meanings: सर्वाः all, स्त्रियः wives, दशरथात् of Dasaratha, जाते born, शुभलक्षणे possessing auspicious qualities, तस्मिन् लक्ष्मणे in the matter of Lakshmana, रामे यथा just as in the case of Rama, तथा similarly, वृत्तिम् conduct, ववृतिरे treated.

text: सीतापि चरणांस्तासामुपसंगृह्य दु:खिता । श्वश्रूणामश्रुपूर्णाक्षी सा बभूवाग्रत: स्थिता ॥२-१०३-२२॥
translation: Sita, too, overcome with grief, grasped the feet of her mothersinlaw and stood before them, her eyes full of tears.
word_meanings: सा सीतापि that Sita too, दुःखिता overcome with sorrow, तासाम् by those, श्वश्रूणाम् of mothersinlaw, चरणान् feet, उपसङ्गृह्य grasping, अश्रुपूर्णाक्षी eyes suffused with tears, अग्रतः before them, स्थिता बभूव stood.

text: तां परिष्वज्य दु:खार्त्तां माता दुहितरं यथा । वनवासकृशां दीनां कौसल्या वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥२-१०३-२३॥
translation: Like a mother to her daughter, Kausalya embraced the wretched Sita, who was afflicted with sorrow, and emaciated due to her stay in the forest, and said to her:
word_meanings: कौसल्या Kausalya, दुःखार्ताम् anguished, वनवासकृशाम् emaciated due to her stay in the forest, दीनाम् poor, ताम् her, माता mother, दुहितरं यथा like a daughter, परिष्वज्य having embraced, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: विदेहराजस्य सुता स्नुषा दशरथस्य च । रामपत्नी कथं दु:खं सम्प्राप्ता निर्जने वने ॥२-१०३-२४॥
translation: How is it that Sita, daughter of Janaka, king of Videha, daughterinlaw of Dasaratha and wife of Rama, has to undergo such hardships in the lonely forest.
word_meanings: विदेहराजस्य of the king of Videha, सुता daughter, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, स्नुषा daughterinlaw, रामपत्नी Rama's wife, निर्जने in desolation, वने in the forest, कथम् how, दुःखम् grief, सम्प्राप्ता had undergone.

text: पद्ममातपसन्तप्तं परिक्लिष्टमिवोत्पलम् । काञ्चनं रजसा ध्वस्तं क्लिष्टं चन्द्रमिवाम्बुदै: ॥२-१०३-२५॥
translation: O Sita, after looking at your countenance, which is like a lotus, scorched by the sunshine, or like a withered waterlily or gold defiled by dust or the Moon obscured by the clouds, the fire of sorrow is burning my mind. The grief in my mind is like fire kindled from the arani (sacrificial faggots) that consumes its own souree. (On a circular wood piece, a wooden stick is placed and churned to produce fire specially in sacrifices is called arani.)
word_meanings: वैदेहि O Sita, आतपसन्तप्तम् scorched by sunshine, पद्मम् इव like lotus, परिक्लिष्टम् withered, उत्पलमिव like waterlily, रजसा by dust, ध्वस्तम् defiled, काञ्चनम् इव like gold, अम्बुदैः with clouds, क्लिष्टम् obscured, चन्द्रम् इव like the Moon, ते मुखम् your countenance, प्रेक्ष्य on seeing, व्यसनारणिसम्भवः kindled from the faggots of calamities, शोकः grief, अग्निः fire, आश्रयमिव like the stick, its refuge, माम् me, मनसि in the mind, भृशम् greatly, दहति burning.

text: मुखं ते प्रेक्ष्य मां शोको दहत्यग्निरिवाश्रयम् भृशं मनसि वैदेहि व्यसनारणिसम्भव: ॥२-१०३-२६॥
translation: O Sita, after looking at your countenance, which is like a lotus, scorched by the sunshine, or like a withered waterlily or gold defiled by dust or the Moon obscured by the clouds, the fire of sorrow is burning my mind. The grief in my mind is like fire kindled from the arani (sacrificial faggots) that consumes its own souree. (On a circular wood piece, a wooden stick is placed and churned to produce fire specially in sacrifices is called arani.)
word_meanings: वैदेहि O Sita, आतपसन्तप्तम् scorched by sunshine, पद्मम् इव like lotus, परिक्लिष्टम् withered, उत्पलमिव like waterlily, रजसा by dust, ध्वस्तम् defiled, काञ्चनम् इव like gold, अम्बुदैः with clouds, क्लिष्टम् obscured, चन्द्रम् इव like the Moon, ते मुखम् your countenance, प्रेक्ष्य on seeing, व्यसनारणिसम्भवः kindled from the faggots of calamities, शोकः grief, अग्निः fire, आश्रयमिव like the stick, its refuge, माम् me, मनसि in the mind, भृशम् greatly, दहति burning.

text: ब्रुवन्त्यामेवमार्त्तायां जनन्यां भरताग्रज: । पादावासाद्य जग्राह वसिष्ठस्य च राघव: ॥२-१०३-२७॥
translation: While Rama's mother was uttering such words in anguish, Rama reached Vasistha and clasped his feet with reverence.
word_meanings: आर्तायां while in anguish, जनन्याम् mother, एवम् in this way, ब्रुवन्त्याम् while speaking, भरताग्रजः Bharata's elder brother, राघवः Rama, आसाद्य having approached, वसिष्ठस्य Vasistha, पादौ feet, जग्राह clasped.

text: पुरोहितस्याग्निसमस्य वै तदा बृहस्पतेरिन्द्र इवामराधिप: । प्रगृह्य पादौ सुसमृद्धतेजस: सहैव तेनोपविवेश राघव: ॥२-१०३-२८॥
translation: Rama touched the feet of the family priest Vasistha, a man equivalent to effulgent fire like Indra, the lord of the gods, does to Brihaspati and sat down along with him.
word_meanings: तदा then, राघवः Rama, अग्निसमस्य of a man equivalent to fire, सुसमृद्ध तेजसः of exceeding brilliance, पुरोहितस्य family priest's, पादौ feet, अमराधिपः king of the gods, इन्द्रः Indra, बृहस्पतेरिव like Brihaspati's feet, प्रगृह्य clasping, तेन सहैव with him, उपविवेश sat down.

text: ततो जघन्यं सहितै: समन्त्रिभि: पुरप्रधानैश्च सहैव सैनिकै: । जनेन धर्मज्ञतमेन धर्मवानुपोपविष्टो भरतस्तदाग्रजम् ॥२-१०३-२९॥
translation: After Vasistha and Rama sat down, righteous Bharata sat close to his elder brother. Behind him sat his companions, leading citizens, soldiers and righteous men.
word_meanings: तदा then, ततः जघन्यम् then behind them, धर्मवान् righteous, सः भरतः सहितैः along with Bharata, मन्त्रिभिः with counsellors पुरप्रधानैश्च with leading citizens, सैनिकैस्सहैव along with soldiers as well, धर्मज्ञतमेन most knowledgeble one in the ways of righteousness, जनेन by men, अग्रजम् elder brother, Rama, उपोपविष्टः sat down near him.

text: उपोपविष्टस्तु तथा स वीर्यवांस्तपस्विवेषेण समीक्ष्य राघवम् । श्रिया ज्वलन्तं भरत: कृताञ्जलिर्यथा महेन्द्र: प्रयत: प्रजापतिम् ॥२-१०३-३०॥
translation: Beholding Rama attired like an ascetic but radiant with a majestic glow, the extremely valiant Bharata sat near him with folded palms like the great Indra purified by religious austerities sits near Brahma, the creator.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् extremely powerful, सः that, भरतः Bharata, तपस्विवेषेण dressed as an ascetic, श्रिया with majesty, ज्वलन्तम् radiating, राघवम् Rama, प्रयतः purified by religious austerities, महेन्द्रः great Indra, प्रजापतिं यथा like Brahma, the creator, समीक्ष्य having looked at, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, तदा then, उपोपविष्टः तु sat next to him.

text: किमेष वाक्यं भरतो ऽद्य राघवं प्रणम्य सत्कृत्य च साधु वक्ष्यति । इतीव तस्यार्यजनस्य तत्त्वतो बभूव कौतूहलमुत्तमं तदा ॥२-१०३-३१॥
translation: All noble people were truly filled with great curiosity as to what Bharata was going to speak, after paying his homage and honouring Rama.
word_meanings: एषः this, भरतः Bharata, अद्य now, राघवम् to Rama, प्रणम्य having paid his homage, सत्कृत्य च also honouring him, साधु of good, किं वाक्यम् what words, वक्ष्यति will speak, इतीव thus as if, तदा of that, तस्य those, आर्यजनस्य of nobility, तत्त्वतः truly, उत्तमम् great, कौतूहलम् curiosity, बभूव arose.

text: स राघव: सत्यधृतिश्च लक्ष्मणो महानुभवो भरतश्च धार्मिक: । वृता: सुहृद्भिश्च विरेजुरध्वरे यथा सदस्यै: सहितास्त्रयो ऽग्नय: ॥२-१०३-३२॥
translation: Rama who was steadfast in truth, Lakshmana of great dignity and righteous Bharata surrounded by their friends were as resplendent as three sacrificial fires encircled by officiating priests. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्य्रुत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the one hundredthird sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सत्यधृतिः steadfast in truth, सः राघवश्च that Rama, महानुभावः a man of great dignity, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, धार्मिकः practising righteouness, भरतश्च Bharata as well, सुहृद्भिः by their friends, वृताः surrounded by, अध्वरे in the sacrifice, सदस्यैः with the officiating priests सहिताः along with, त्रयः the three, अग्नयः यथा like fires, विरेजुः were resplendent.

text: तं तु राम: समाज्ञाय भ्रातरं गुरुवत्सलम् । लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा प्रष्टुं समुपचक्रमे ॥२-१०४-१॥
translation: Rama with his brother Lakshmana having consoled Bharata who is ever devoted to elders began to question:
word_meanings: भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह along with Lakshmana, रामः Rama, गुरुवत्सलम् to one devoted to elders, भ्रातरम् to brother, तम् that Bharata, समाश्वास्य having consoled, प्रष्टुम् to question, समुपचक्रमे commenced.

text: किमेतदिच्छेयमहं श्रोतुं प्रव्याहृतं त्वया । यस्मात्त्वमागतो देशमिमं चीरजटाजिनी ॥२-१०४-२॥
translation: I want to hear what brought you to this region with your barkrobes, matted locks and antelope skin.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, चीरजटाजिन: wearing barkrobes, matted locks and antelope skin, यस्मात् for what reason, इमं देशम् to this region, आगतः have come, एतत् किम् what is it, त्वया by you, प्रव्याहृतम् being related, अहम् I, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छेयम् I desire.

text: किं निमित्तमिमं देशं कृष्णाजिनजटाधर: । हित्वा राज्यं प्रविष्टस्त्वं तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥२-१०४-३॥
translation: What made you come to this region, leaving the kingdom and wearing deer skin and matted hair? You should tell me everything.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, राज्यम् kingdom, हित्वा leaving, कृष्णाजिनजटाधरः wearing deer skin and matted hair, किन्निमित्तम् for what reason, इमं देशम् this region, प्रविष्टः have entered, तत् that, सर्वम् everything, वक्तुम् to tell, अर्हसि behoves you.

text: इत्युक्त: कैकयीपुत्र: काकुत्स्थेन महात्मना । प्रगृह्य बलवद्भूय: प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥२-१०४-४॥
translation: Thus enquired by the magnanimous Rama, Bharata, joining his palms tightly, replied:
word_meanings: महात्मना by the magnanimous, काकुत्स्थेन by Rama, इति thus, उक्तः uttered, कैकयीपुत्रः son of Kaikeyi, Bharata, प्राञ्जलिः joining the palms in reverence, भूयः again, बलवत् strongly, प्रगृह्य holding, वाक्यम् this statement, अब्रवीत् said.

text: आर्य्यं तात: परित्यज्य कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम् । गत: स्वर्गं महाबाहु: पुत्रशोकाभिपीडित: ॥२-१०४-५॥
translation: O my revered sire our mighty father, having performed an impossible task of banishing you to the forest, and tortured by grief due to separation from his son, went to heaven.
word_meanings: महाबाहुः mightyarmed, तातः father, आर्यं my esteemed brother, परित्यज्य having abandoned, सुदुष्करम् impossible to perform, कर्म task, कृत्वा having done, पुत्रशोकाभिपीडितः tortured by the grief due to separation from his son, स्वर्गम् heaven, गतः went.

text: स्त्रिया नियुक्त: कैकेय्या मम मात्रा परन्तप । चकार सुमहत्पापमिदमात्मयशोहरम् ॥२-१०४-६॥
translation: O Rama, tormentor of enemies having been instigated by a woman, my mother Kaikeyi, committed this great sin of destroying his (Dasaratha's) reputation.
word_meanings: परन्तप O tormentor of enemies, Rama, मम my, मात्रा mother, स्त्रिया woman, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, नियुक्तः instigated, आत्मयशोहरम् destroying his reputation, सुमहत् great, इदं पापम् this sin, चकार commited.

text: सा राज्यफलमप्राप्य विधवा शोककर्शिता । पतिष्यति महाघोरे निरये जननी मम ॥२-१०४-७॥
translation: My mother, formented with grief and with the fruit of the kingdom forfeited, and cursed with widowhood, will fall into the dreadful hell.
word_meanings: मम my, जननी mother, सा that lady, राज्यफलम् fruit of kingodm, अप्राप्य without acquiring, विधवा widow, शोककर्शिता formented with grief, महाघोरे dreadful, निरये hell, पतिष्यति will fall.

text: तस्य मे दासभूतस्य प्रसादं कर्त्तुमर्हसि । अभिषिञ्चस्व चाद्यैव राज्येनप मघवानिव ॥२-१०४-८॥
translation: It behoves you to grant me a favour. I am like your servant. Now get yourself coronated in the kingdom like Indra.
word_meanings: तस्य such, दासभूतस्य servant I am, मे to me, प्रसादम् favour, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि behoves you, अद्येव now itself, मघवानिव like Indra, राज्येन in the kingdom, अभिषिञ्चस्व be coronated.

text: इमा: प्रकृतय: सर्वा विधवा मातरश्च या: । त्वत्सकाशमनुप्राप्ता: प्रसादं कर्त्तुमर्हसि ॥२-१०४-९॥
translation: All these subjects and your widowed mothers have come to you. It behoves you to grant them this favour.
word_meanings: इमाः these, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः subjects, विधवाः widows, मातरश्च those mothers, त्वत्सकाशम् to your proximity, अनुप्राप्ताः have reached, प्रसादम् favour, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि behoves you.

text: तदानुपूर्व्या युक्तं च युक्तं चात्मनि मानद । राज्यं प्राप्नुहि धर्मेण सकामान् सुहृद: कुरु ॥२-१०४-१०॥
translation: O bestower of honour by the law of primogeniture and as a worthy successor it is appropriate that you should accept the kingdom righteously and fulfil the desire of your friends.
word_meanings: मानद O bestower of honour, तत् for that reason, आनुपूर्व्या by succession, युक्तम् appropriate, आत्मनि in you, युक्तं च is appropriate, राज्यम् kingdom, धर्मेण righteously, प्राप्नुहि you may obtain, सुहृदः friends, सकामान् having fulfilled their desire, कुरु make them.

text: भवत्वविधवा भूमि: समग्रा पतिना त्वया । शशिना विमलेनेव शारदी रजनी यथा ॥२-१०४-११॥
translation: Like an autumnal night with the immaculate Moon, let this entire earth cease to be a widow by securing you as her lord.
word_meanings: समग्रा this entire, भूमिः earth, शारदी relating to autumn, रजनी यथा like night, पतिना as lord, त्वया by you, विमलेन by the immaculate, शशिना इव like the Moon, अविधवा भवतु let it be a widow no more.

text: एभिश्च सचिवै: सार्द्धं शिरसा याचितो मया । भ्रातु: शिष्यस्य दासस्य प्रसादं कर्त्तुमर्हसि ॥२-१०४-१२॥
translation: With my head bowed down, I beseech you along with all these ministers to show favour to me who is your brother, disciple and slave.
word_meanings: एभिः by these, सचिवैः सार्धम् with ministers, मया by me, शिरसा with head bowed down, याचितः has been besought, भ्रातुः of a brother, शिष्यस्य of a disciple, दासस्य of a slave, प्रसादम् favour, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि it behoves you.

text: तदिदं शाश्वतं पित्र्यं सर्वं प्रकृतिमण्डलम् । पूजितं पुरुषव्याघ्र नातिक्रमितुमर्हसि ॥२-१०४-१३॥
translation: O best among men, it does not behove you to transgress the prayers of the whole order of subjects and ministers to assume this hereditary and perpetual order.
word_meanings: पुरुषव्याघ्रः O best among men, तत् for that reason, शाश्वतम् eternal, पित्र्यम् hereditary, पूजितम् venerable, सर्वम् entire, इदम् this order, प्रकृतिमण्डलम् the whole order of subjects, अतिक्रमितुम् to transgress, न अर्हति it does not behove you.

text: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहु: सबाष्प: कैकयीसुत: । रामस्य शिरसा पादौ जग्राह विधिवत्पुन: ॥२-१०४-१४॥
translation: Having said thus, the mightyarmed Bharata, in accordance with tradition, grasped with tearful eyes the feet of Rama again with his head.
word_meanings: महाबाहुः mightyarmed, कैकयीसुतः Kaikeyi's son, Bharata, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having said, सबाष्पः with tearful eyes, रामस्य Rama's, पादौ feet, पुनः again, विधिवत् in accordance with tradition, शिरसा with his head, जग्राह grasped.

text: तं मत्तमिव मातङ्गं नि:श्वसन्तं पुन:पुन: । भ्रातरं भरतं राम: परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत् ॥२-१०४-१५॥
translation: Rama embraced his brother Bharata who repeatedly heaved sighs and resembled an elephant in rut, and said:
word_meanings: रामः Rama, पुनः पुनः repeatedly, निःश्वसन्तम् heaving sighs, मत्तम् in rut, मातङ्गम् इव resembling an elephant, भ्रातरम् brother, तं भरतम् that Bharata, परिष्वज्य embracing, इदम् this word, अब्रवीत् said.

text: कुलीन: सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तेजस्वी चरितव्रत: । राज्यहेतो: कथं पापमाचरेत्त्वद्विधो जन: ॥२-१०४-१६॥
translation: How can a man like you, born of a noble race, endowed with energy, powerful and adherent to vows, commit a sin for the sake of a kingdom?
word_meanings: कुलीनः a man of noble birth, सत्वसम्पन्नः endowed with energy, तेजस्वी powerful, चरितव्रतः adherent to one's vows, त्वद्विधः like you, जनः a man, राज्यहेतोः for the sake of kingdom, पापम् sin, कथम् how, आचरेत् will commit?

text: न दोषं त्वयि पश्यामि सूक्ष्ममप्यरिसूदन । न चापि जननीं बाल्यात्त्वं विगर्हितुमर्हसि ॥२-१०४-१७॥
translation: O destroyer of enemies, I do not find even slightest fault with you. Like a child, it does not behove you to reproach your mother.
word_meanings: अरिसूदन O destroyer of enemies, त्वयि in you, सूक्ष्ममपि slightest, दोषम् fault, न पश्यामि I do not find, त्वम् you, बाल्यात् out of childishness, जननीं your mother, विगर्हितुम् to reproach, नार्हसि चापि does not behove you.

text: कामकारो महाप्राज्ञ गुरूणां सर्वदा ऽनघ । उपपन्नेषु दारेषु पुत्रेषु च विधीयते ॥२-१०४-१८॥
translation: O sagacious and sinless one, it is laid down (in sastras) that elders when married can always act at their free will towards their wives and sons.
word_meanings: महाप्राज्ञ sagacious, अनघ sinless, गुरूणाम् of elders, उपपन्नेषु when married, दारेषु in relation to their wives, पुत्रेषु च also sons, सर्वदा always, कामकारः acting at will, विधीयते is laid down.

text: वयमस्य यथा लोके सङ्ख्याता: सौम्य साधुभि: । भार्य्या: पुत्राश्च शिष्याश्च त्वमनु ज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥२-१०४-१९॥
translation: O handsome one, you should treat us the way the virtuous treat their wives, sons and disciples in this world.
word_meanings: सौम्य O handsome one, लोके in this world, भार्याः wives, पुत्राश्च sons, शिष्याश्च disciples, साधुभिः by virtuous men, यथा as, संख्याताः have been treated, वयम् we, अस्य for this (king Dasaratha, etc), त्वं you, अनुज्ञातुं to permit, अर्हसि it behoves you.

text: वने वा चीरवसनं सौम्य कृष्णाजिनाम्बरम् । राज्ये वापि महाराजो मां वासयितुमीश्वर: ॥२-१०४-२०॥
translation: O handsome one, king Dasaratha is alone competent to accommodate me in the forest wearing bark robes and antelope skin as garment or install me in the kingdom.
word_meanings: सौम्य O handsome one, चीरवसनम् dressed in bark robes, कृष्णाजिनाम्बरम् with antelope skin as garment, माम् me, महाराजः the maharaja (Dasaratha), वने वा either in the forest, राज्ये वापि or in the kingdom, वासयितुम् to accommodate me, ईश्वरः is competent.

text: यावत्पितरि धर्मज्ञे गौरवं लोकसत्कृतम् । तावद्धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठ जनन्यामपि गौरवम् ॥२-१०४-२१॥
translation: O best among the protectors of righteousness the honour shown to our father who is conversant with the ways of righteousness and much revered by the world ought to be shown towards our mother also.
word_meanings: धर्मभृताम् among the protectors of righteousness, श्रेष्ठ best, धर्मज्ञे conversant with the ways of righteousness, पितरि in father, लोकसत्कृतम् revered by the world, यावत् how much, गौरवम् honour, जनन्यामपि even for mother, तावत् that much, गौरवम् honour, should be shown.

text: एताभ्यां धर्मशीलाभ्यां वनं गच्छेति राघव । मातापितृभ्यामुक्तो ऽहं कथमन्यत् समाचरे ॥२-१०४-२२॥
translation: O Bharata, I have been commanded by our righteous father and mother to go to the forest. How can any one act otherwise?
word_meanings: राघव O Bharata, धर्मशीलाभ्याम् of righteous conduct, एताभ्याम् by these two, मातापितृभ्याम् by the father and mother, वनम् to forest, गच्छ go, इति thus, उक्तः having been told, अहम् I, अन्यत् other than this, कथम् how, समाचरेत् can act?

text: त्वया राज्यमयोध्यायां प्राप्तव्यं लोकसत्कृतम् । वस्तव्यं दण्डकारण्ये मया वल्कलवाससा ॥२-१०४-२३॥
translation: You shall rule the kingdom wellhonoured by the people in Ayodhya and I shall live in Dandaka forest wearing bark as garments.
word_meanings: त्वया by you, अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, लोकसत्कृतम् honoured by the the world, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्तव्यम् is to be obtained, मया by me, वल्कलवाससा with barkrobes as garments, दण्डकारण्ये in Dandaka forest, वस्तव्यम् I must live.

text: एवं कृत्वा महाराजो विभागं लोकसन्निधौ । व्यादिश्य च महातेजा दिवं दशरथो गत: ॥२-१०४-२४॥
translation: The maharja of great radiance made this division in the presence of people and after commanding thus, ascended heaven.
word_meanings: महाराजः great king, महातेजाः of great splendour, दशरथः Dasaratha, लोकसन्निधौ in the presence of people, एवम् in this way, विभागम् apportionment, कृत्वा having made, व्यादिश्य च having commanded, दिवम् to heaven, गतः went.

text: स च प्रमाणं धर्मात्मा राजा लोकगुरुस्तव । पित्रा दत्तं यथाभागमुपभोक्तुं त्वमर्हसि ॥२-१०४-२५॥
translation: The proclamation of that righteous king revered by the world shall be your guide. You should enjoy that portion bestowed by father.
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा righteous, लोकगुरुः revered by the world, सः राजा that king, तव your, प्रमाणम् proclamation, त्वम् you, पित्रा by father, दत्तम् bestowed, यथाभागम् that portion, उपभोक्तुम् to enjoy, अर्हसि behoves you.

text: चतुर्दशसमा: सौम्य दण्डकारण्यमाश्रित: । उपभोक्ष्ये त्वहं दत्तं भागं पित्रा महात्मना ॥२-१०४-२६॥
translation: O handsome one, as for myself, I shall enjoy the portion bestowed on me by my magnanimous father and shall take refuge in the Dandaka forest for fourteen years.
word_meanings: सौम्य O handsome one, अहं तु as for myself, चतुर्दश fourteen, समाः years, दण्डकारण्यम् Dandaka forest, आश्रितः taking refuge, महात्मना magnanimous, पित्रा by father, दत्तम् bestowed, भागम् portion, उपभोक्ष्ये I will enjoy.

text: यदब्रवीन्मां नरलोकसत्कृत: पिता महात्मा विबुधाधिपोपम: । तदेव मन्ये परमात्मनो हितं न सर्वलोकेश्वरभावमप्यहम् ॥२-१०४-२७॥
translation: I think what my great father, who is honoured by all men, and an equal to Indra, ordered is for my highest welfare. The will of the overlord of the world should not be done away with. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुरुत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the one hundredfourth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: नरलोकसत्कृतः honoured by the men of the world, पिता father, महात्मा highsouled, विबुधाधिपोपमः equal to the king of the gods, यत् whatever, अब्रवीत् said, माम् to me, तदेव that only, परमात्मन: the ulitimate, हितं good, मन्ये I regard it, सर्वलोकेश्वर: the will of the lord of all the worlds, भावमप्ययम् न should not be allowed to vanish.

text: तत: पुरुषसिंहानां वृतानां तै: सुहृद्गणै: । शोचतामेव रजनी दु:खेन व्यत्यवर्त्तत ॥२-१०५-१॥
translation: That night passed off painfully for the four lion like brothers as they lamented, surrounded by their hosts of friends.
word_meanings: ततः then, तैः by them, सुहृद्गणैः with hosts of friends, वृतानाम् surrounded by, पुरुषसिंहानाम् lions of men (best of men), शोचतामेव while they were lamenting, रजनी night, दुःखेन painfully, व्यत्यवर्तत passed off.

text: रजन्यां सुप्रभातायां भ्रातरस्ते सुहृद्वृता: । मन्दाकिन्यां हुतं जप्यं कृत्वा राममुपागमन् ॥२-१०५-२॥
translation: When the night dawned, those brothers surrounded by their friends made (morning) ablutions and, after the prayers, returned to Rama.
word_meanings: रजन्याम् that night, सुप्रभातायाम् had dawned, ते भ्रातरः those brothers, सुहृद्वृताः surrounded by friends, मन्दाकिन्याम् on the bank of Mandakini river, हुतम् morning oblations, जप्यम् prayers, कृत्वा having performed, रामम् to Rama, उपागमन् returned.

text: तूष्णीं ते समुपासीना न कश्चित्किञ्चिदब्रवीत् । भरतस्तु सुहृन्मध्ये रामं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥२-१०५-३॥
translation: All of them sat together silently and no one uttered a word. Bharata alone from among them addressed Rama saying:
word_meanings: ते they, तूष्णीम् silently, समुपासीनाः sat togethr, कश्चित् any one, किञ्चित् a little, न अब्रवीत् did not speak, भरतस्तु Bharata on his part, सुहृन्मध्ये from among the friends, रामम् addressing Rama, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: सान्त्विता मामिका माता दत्तं राज्यमिदं मम । तद्ददामि तवैवाहं भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यमकण्टकम् ॥२-१०५-४॥
translation: This kingdom was given to me for the satisfaction of my mother. I am bestowing it back on you. Enjoy it without any obstacles.
word_meanings: मामिका my own, माता mother, सान्त्विता has been pacified, इदम् this, राज्यम् kingdom, मम to me, दत्तम् was given, तत् that kingdom, अहम् I, तवैव to you alone, ददामि am giving, अकण्टकम् without obstacles, राज्यम् kingdom, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy.

text: महतेवाम्बुवेगेन भिन्न: सेतुर्जलागमे । दुरावारं त्वदन्येन राज्यखण्डमिदं महत् ॥२-१०५-५॥
translation: Like a dyke bursts under pressure by the great surge of waters during the rainy season, this vast kingdom cannot be sustained by any one except yourself.
word_meanings: जलागमे during the rainy season, महता great, अम्बुवेगेन by the surge of waters, भिन्नः burst सेतुः इव like a dyke, इदम् this, महत् vast, राज्यखण्डम् kingdom, त्वदन्येन other than yourself, दुरावारम् insupportable.

text: गतिं खर इवाश्वस्य तार्क्ष्यस्येव पतत्ऺित्रण: । अनुगन्तुं न शक्तिर्मे गतिं तव महीपते ॥२-१०५-६॥
translation: O lord of the earth as an ass cannot follow the pace of a horse or a bird, the pace of Tarkshya (Garuda), I do not have the capability to follow you.
word_meanings: महीपते O lord of the earth, Rama, अश्वस्य horse's, गतिम् pace, खर इव like an ass, तार्क्ष्यस्य Tarkshya's (the holy eagle, Garuda) pace, पतत्रिणः इव like a bird, तव गतिम् your pace, अनुगन्तुम् to follow, मे to me, शक्तिः power, न do not have.

text: सुजीवं नित्यशस्तस्य य: परैरुपजीव्यते । राम तेन तु दुर्जीवं य: परानुपजीवति ॥२-१०५-७॥
translation: O Rama, the life of a man on whom others depend for their sustenance is a happy life and the life of one who depends on others for his own mintenance is miserable.
word_meanings: राम Rama, यः who, परैः by others, नित्यशः always, उपजीव्यते depends for sustenance, तस्य his, सुजीवम् happy life, यः who, परान् on others, उपजीवति depends for sustenance, तेन तु as for him, दुर्जीवम् is a hard life.

text: यथा तु रोपितो वृक्ष: पुरुषेण विवर्द्धित: । ह्रस्वकेन दुरारोहो रूढस्कन्धो महाद्रुम: ॥२-१०५-८॥
translation: O mightyarmed Rama, a man plants a tree, rears it till it grows into such a large tree with a big trunk that it becomes difficult for a dwarf to climb. When the tree flowers but does not bear fruit, the man who planted it gets no pleasure out of the purpose for which the tree was planted. Being a mighty protector, do not chastise us who are your servants. This is a simile. You may better comprehend its implications. (The meaning of the simile is that if you do not assume the throne, the desire of our father, who nurtured you right from your childhood and hoped that one day you will become king and rule the people, will be in vain.)
word_meanings: महाबाहो O mightyarmed one, वृषभः mighty, भर्ता protector, त्वम् you, भृत्यान् servants, अस्मान् us, न शाधि हि if you do not rule, पुरुषेण by a man, रोपितः planted, विवर्धितः reared, ह्रस्वकेण by a dwarf दुरारोहः difficult to climb, रूढस्कन्दः with a big trunk, महाद्रुमः large tree, वृक्षः tree, यदा when, पुष्पितः भूत्वा it having blossomed, फलानि fruit, यथा as, न विदर्शयेत् does not bear, यस्य हेतोः for such purpose, प्ररोपितः it has been planted, सः he, तां प्रीतिम् that pleasure, नानुभवेत् does not feel, एषा this one, उपमा simile, तम् अर्थम् its meaning, वेत्तुम् know, अर्हसि behoves you.

text: स यथा पुष्पितो भूत्वा फलानि न विदर्शयेत् । स तां नानुभवेत्प्रीतिं यस्य हेतो: प्ररोपित: ॥२-१०५-९॥
translation: O mightyarmed Rama, a man plants a tree, rears it till it grows into such a large tree with a big trunk that it becomes difficult for a dwarf to climb. When the tree flowers but does not bear fruit, the man who planted it gets no pleasure out of the purpose for which the tree was planted. Being a mighty protector, do not chastise us who are your servants. This is a simile. You may better comprehend its implications. (The meaning of the simile is that if you do not assume the throne, the desire of our father, who nurtured you right from your childhood and hoped that one day you will become king and rule the people, will be in vain.)
word_meanings: महाबाहो O mightyarmed one, वृषभः mighty, भर्ता protector, त्वम् you, भृत्यान् servants, अस्मान् us, न शाधि हि if you do not rule, पुरुषेण by a man, रोपितः planted, विवर्धितः reared, ह्रस्वकेण by a dwarf दुरारोहः difficult to climb, रूढस्कन्दः with a big trunk, महाद्रुमः large tree, वृक्षः tree, यदा when, पुष्पितः भूत्वा it having blossomed, फलानि fruit, यथा as, न विदर्शयेत् does not bear, यस्य हेतोः for such purpose, प्ररोपितः it has been planted, सः he, तां प्रीतिम् that pleasure, नानुभवेत् does not feel, एषा this one, उपमा simile, तम् अर्थम् its meaning, वेत्तुम् know, अर्हसि behoves you.

text: एषोपमा महाबाहो तमर्थं वेत्तुमर्हसि । यदि त्वमस्मान् वृषभो भर्त्ता भृत्यान्न शाधि हि ॥२-१०५-१०॥
translation: O mightyarmed Rama, a man plants a tree, rears it till it grows into such a large tree with a big trunk that it becomes difficult for a dwarf to climb. When the tree flowers but does not bear fruit, the man who planted it gets no pleasure out of the purpose for which the tree was planted. Being a mighty protector, do not chastise us who are your servants. This is a simile. You may better comprehend its implications. (The meaning of the simile is that if you do not assume the throne, the desire of our father, who nurtured you right from your childhood and hoped that one day you will become king and rule the people, will be in vain.)
word_meanings: महाबाहो O mightyarmed one, वृषभः mighty, भर्ता protector, त्वम् you, भृत्यान् servants, अस्मान् us, न शाधि हि if you do not rule, पुरुषेण by a man, रोपितः planted, विवर्धितः reared, ह्रस्वकेण by a dwarf दुरारोहः difficult to climb, रूढस्कन्दः with a big trunk, महाद्रुमः large tree, वृक्षः tree, यदा when, पुष्पितः भूत्वा it having blossomed, फलानि fruit, यथा as, न विदर्शयेत् does not bear, यस्य हेतोः for such purpose, प्ररोपितः it has been planted, सः he, तां प्रीतिम् that pleasure, नानुभवेत् does not feel, एषा this one, उपमा simile, तम् अर्थम् its meaning, वेत्तुम् know, अर्हसि behoves you.

text: श्रेणयस्त्वां महाराज पश्यन्त्वग्र्याश्च सर्वश: । प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यं राज्ये स्थितमरिन्दमम् ॥२-१०५-११॥
translation: O great king and subduer of enemies, may all the leading guilds of traders and other subjects behold you all over installed in the kingdom like the resplendent Sun.
word_meanings: महाराज O great king, राज्ये in the kingdom, स्थितम् installed, अरिन्दमम् subduer of enemies, त्वाम् you, अग्य्राः leading, श्रेणयः guilds of traders, etc, सर्वशः all over, प्रतपन्तम् with resplendence, आदित्यम् इव like Sun, पश्यन्तु let them see.

text: तवा ऽनुयाने काकुत्स्थ मत्ता नर्दन्तु कुञ्जरा: । अन्त:पुरगता नार्यो नन्दन्तु सुसमाहिता: ॥२-१०५-१२॥
translation: O Rama, let the elephants following you, intoxicated with ichor, be heard trumpeting. Let the women of the inner apartment rejoice with composed minds (when they hear of your return).
word_meanings: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha (Rama), तव your, अनुयाने following you, मत्ताः intoxicated with ichor, कुञ्जराः elephants, नर्दन्तु may trumpet, अन्तःपुरगताः of the inner apartment, नार्यः women, सुसमाहिताः with composed minds, नन्दन्तु may rejoice.

text: तस्य साध्वित्यमन्यन्त नागरा विविधा जना: । भरतस्य वच: श्रुत्वा रामं प्रत्यनुयाचत: ॥२-१०५-१३॥
translation: Hearing the words of Bharata beseeching Rama to return, various classes of people of the city of Ayodhya, in approbation exclaimed well said.
word_meanings: रामं प्रति about Rama, अनुयाचतः while beseeching, तस्य भरतस्य that Bharata's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, नागराः pertaining to the city, विविधाः various classes, जनाः people, साधु इति as well said, अमन्यन्त exclaimed.

text: तमेवं दु:खितं प्रेक्ष्य विलपन्तं यशस्विनम् । राम: कृतात्मा भरतं समाश्वासय दात्मवान् ॥२-१०५-१४॥
translation: Having seen the illustrious Bharata lamenting that way, Rama, a man of firm determination and selfpossession, consoled him thus:
word_meanings: कृतात्मा man of firm determination, आत्मवान् selfpossessed, रामः Rama, एवम् in this way, विलपन्तम् lamenting, यशस्विनम् illustrious, दुःखितम् depressed, तं भरतम् that Bharata, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, समाश्वासयत् consoled him.

text: नात्मन: कामकारो ऽस्ति पुरुषो ऽयमनीश्वर: । इतश्चेतरतश्चैनं कृतान्त: परिकर्षति ॥२-१०५-१५॥
translation: A man is neither independent nor competent to do any act on his free will. Fate pulls him this way or the other.
word_meanings: आत्मनः by oneself, कामकारः to do at free will, नास्ति is not there, अयम् this, पुरुषः man, अनीश्वरः is not independent, कृतान्तः fate, एनम् him, इतश्च from this way, इतरतश्च or the other way, परिकर्षति is pulled.

text: सर्वे क्षयान्ता निचया: पतनान्ता: समुच्छ्रया: । संयोगा विप्रयोगान्ता मरणान्तं च जीवितम् ॥२-१०५-१६॥
translation: All accumulations of wealth deplete at the end. Every man who attains elevated positions falls at the end. Every union culminates in separation. Every life ends in death.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, निचयाः accumulations of wealth, क्षयान्ताः deplete at the end, समुच्छ्रयाः elevated positions, पतनान्ताः degrade at the end, संयोगाः union, विप्रयोगान्ताः end in separation, जीवितम् life, मरणान्तम् has death at the end.

text: यथा फलानां पक्वानां नान्यत्र पतनाद्भयम् । एवं नरस्य जातस्य नान्यत्र मरणाद्भयम् ॥२-१०५-१७॥
translation: The only fear of a ripened fruit is the fear of falling down (from the tree). In the same way every man who is born has no other fear except the fear of death.
word_meanings: पक्वानाम् ripened, फलानाम् fruits, पतनात् from falling down, अन्यत्र no other, भयम् fear, यथा as how, न not, एवम् in the same way, जातस्य of one who is born, नरस्य for a man, मरणात् more than death, अन्यत्र from any other source, भयम् fear, न not.

text: यथागारं दृढस्थूणं जीर्णं भूत्वा ऽवसीदति । तथैव सीदन्ति नरा जरामृत्युवशङ्गता: ॥२-१०५-१८॥
translation: Even a house constructed with sturdy pillars gets dilapidated and ultimately decays. In the same way people under the sway of old age and death are destroyed (at last).
word_meanings: दृढस्थूणम् with sturdy pillars, आगारम् house, यथा as, जीर्णं भूत्वा after getting dilapidated, अवसीदति decays, तथैव in the same way, नराः people, जरामृत्युवशंगताः under the sway of old age and death, सीदन्ति are destroyed.

text: अत्येति रजनी या तु सा न प्रतिनिवर्त्तते । यात्येव यमुना पूर्णा समुद्रमुदकाकुलम् ॥२-१०५-१९॥
translation: A night that once passe off does not return like the waters of river Yamuna that flow into the ocean filled with water (the water do not flow back into Yamuna).
word_meanings: या such, रजनी night, अत्येति passes off, सा that one, न प्रतिनिवर्तते does not return, पूर्णा filled with waters, यमुना river Yamuna, उदकाकुलम् waterfilled, समुद्रम् to the ocean, यात्येव flows forever.

text: अहोरात्राणि गच्छन्ति सर्वेषां प्राणिनामिह । आयूंषि क्षपयन्त्याशु ग्रीष्मे जलमिवांशव: ॥२-१०५-२०॥
translation: The passing days and nights quickly decrease the life span of all living beings in this world, like sunrays drying up the water in summer.
word_meanings: इह in this world, गच्छन्ति are passing, अहोरात्राणि days and nights, ग्रीष्मे in summer, अंशवः rays of the sun, जलमिव like the water, सर्वेषाम् all, प्राणिनाम् living things', आयूंषि life span, आशु are quickly, क्षपयन्ति are decaying.

text: आत्मानमनुशोच त्वं किमन्यमनुशोचसि । आयुस्ते हीयते यस्य स्थितस्य च गतस्य च ॥२-१०५-२१॥
translation: Whether you are static or moving, your lifespan decreases. Therefore, you should only grieve about yourself and not for any one else.
word_meanings: स्थितस्य च whether you stand, गतस्य च or moving, यस्य whosoever, आयुः life span, हीयते decreases, आत्मानम् about you, त्वम् you, अनुशोच grieve, अन्यम् about others, किम् why, अनुशोचसि are you grieving?

text: सहैव मृत्युर्व्रजति सह मृत्युर्निषीदति । गत्वा सुदीर्घमध्वानं सहमृत्युर्निवर्तते ॥२-१०५-२२॥
translation: Death follows a man wherever he goes. When he sits, death sits with him. Even after travelling a very long distance, the man returns along with death.
word_meanings: मृत्युः death, सहैव along with you, व्रजति is moving, सह मृत्युः along with death, निषीदति a man sits, सुदीर्घम् very long, अध्वानम् way, गत्वा having gone, सहमृत्युः with death, निवर्तते is returning.

text: गात्रेषु वलय: प्राप्ता: श्वेताश्चैव शिरोरुहा: । जरया पुरुषो जीर्ण: किं हि कृत्वा प्रभावयेत् ॥२-१०५-२३॥
translation: Wrinkels form on the body and hair turns grey in old age. In this way, decayed with age, what can a man do to have control over death.
word_meanings: गात्रेषु in man's limbs, वलय: wrinkles, प्राप्ताः are formed, शिरोरुहाश्चैव hair also, श्वेताः becomes grey, जरया with old age, जीर्णः one decays, पुरुषः a man, किं हि what, कृत्वा having done, प्रभावयेत् can influence.

text: नन्दन्त्युदित आदित्ये नन्दन्त्यस्तमिते रवौ । आत्मनो नावबुध्यन्ते मनुष्या जीवितक्षयम् ॥२-१०५-२४॥
translation: People rejoice when the Sun rises and rejoice when the Sun sets. But they are unaware of the decline of the life span of their own.
word_meanings: मनुष्याः people, आदित्ये the Sun, उदिते rises, नन्दन्ति rejoice, रवौ when the Sun, आस्तमिते sets, नन्दन्ति rejoice, आत्मनः their own, जीवितक्षयम् decline of life span, नावबुद्ध्यन्ते are not aware of.

text: हृष्यन्त्यृतुमखं दृष्ट्वा नवं नवमिहागतम् । ऋतूनां परिवर्त्तेन प्राणिनां प्राणसंक्षय: ॥२-१०५-२५॥
translation: At the advent of each new season men feel delighted to see the newly blossomed flowers and fruits. But with the change of the scasons the life span also diminishes.
word_meanings: ऋतुमुखम् setting of a season, दृष्ट्वा having seen, इह now, नवं नवम् something new (flowers and fruits), आगतम् have arrived, हृष्यन्ति feel delighted, ऋतूनाम् of seasons, परिवर्तेन by changes, प्राणिनाम् of living beings', प्राणसङ्क्षयः life span decreases.

text: यथा काष्ठं च काष्ठं च समेयातां महार्णवे । समेत्य च व्यपेयातां कालमासाद्य कञ्चन ॥२-१०५-२६॥
translation: In a mighty ocean, two pieces of logs meet one another, float together and in due course get separated. In the same way wives, sons, relatives and riches remain together for some time and thereafter get separated. Their separation is certain.
word_meanings: यथा as, महार्णवे in a mighty ocean, काष्ठं च a piece of wood, काष्ठं च another piece of wood, समेयाताम् might meet, समेत्य having met, कञ्चन कालम् for a short span, आसाद्य remaining together, व्यपेयातां च get separated, एवम् in the same way, भार्याश्च wives, पुत्राश्च sons, ज्ञातयश्च relatives, धनानि च riches, समेत्य after coming together, व्यवधावन्ति get separated, एषाम् their, विनाभवः separation, ध्रुवो हि is certain.

text: एवं भार्याश्च पुत्राश्च ज्ञातयश्च घनानि च । समेत्य व्यवधावन्ति ध्रुवो ह्येषां विनाभव: ॥२-१०५-२७॥
translation: In a mighty ocean, two pieces of logs meet one another, float together and in due course get separated. In the same way wives, sons, relatives and riches remain together for some time and thereafter get separated. Their separation is certain.
word_meanings: यथा as, महार्णवे in a mighty ocean, काष्ठं च a piece of wood, काष्ठं च another piece of wood, समेयाताम् might meet, समेत्य having met, कञ्चन कालम् for a short span, आसाद्य remaining together, व्यपेयातां च get separated, एवम् in the same way, भार्याश्च wives, पुत्राश्च sons, ज्ञातयश्च relatives, धनानि च riches, समेत्य after coming together, व्यवधावन्ति get separated, एषाम् their, विनाभवः separation, ध्रुवो हि is certain.

text: नात्र कश्चिद्यथाभावं प्राणी समभिवर्त्तते । तेन तस्मिन्न सामर्थ्यं प्रेतस्यास्त्यनुशोचत: ॥२-१०५-२८॥
translation: No living being in this world can act as he likes. Therefore, no one should grieve for the dead.
word_meanings: अत्र then in this world, कश्चित् प्राणी any living being, यथाभावम् as one likes, न समभिवर्तते does not go, तेन therefore, प्रेतस्य for the dead, अनुशोचतः for one who grieves, तस्मिन् in the matter of death, सामर्थ्यम् capability, नास्ति not there.

text: यथा हि सार्थं गच्छन्तं ब्रूयात् कश्चित् पथि स्थित: । अहमप्यागमिष्यामि पृष्ठतो भवतामिति ॥२-१०५-२९॥
translation: Like a man standing on the wayside says to a passing caravan, 'I am following you', and follows them, the road taken by our fathers and forefathers is certain for every one and cannot be violated by a person treading that path. (So) why should a man grieve?
word_meanings: गच्छन्तम् while passing, सार्थम् caravan, (कच्चित्) पथि on the wayside, स्थितः standing, अहमपि I also, भवताम् your, पृष्ठतः behind, आगमिष्यामि I am coming, इति thus, यथा as, ब्रूयात् one may say, एवम् in this way, पूर्वैः by ancestors, गतः taken, पितृपैतामहः folowed by fathers and forefathers, मार्गः the path, ध्रुवः is certain, यस्य whosoever, व्यतिक्रमः violation, नास्ति not possible, तम् that very road, आपन्नः following, कथम् why, शोचेत् should one grieve?

text: एवं पूर्वैर्गतो मार्ग: पितृपैतामहो ध्रुव: । तमापन्न: कथं शोचेद्यस्ऺय नास्ति व्यतिक्रम: ॥२-१०५-३०॥
translation: Like a man standing on the wayside says to a passing caravan, 'I am following you', and follows them, the road taken by our fathers and forefathers is certain for every one and cannot be violated by a person treading that path. (So) why should a man grieve?
word_meanings: गच्छन्तम् while passing, सार्थम् caravan, (कच्चित्) पथि on the wayside, स्थितः standing, अहमपि I also, भवताम् your, पृष्ठतः behind, आगमिष्यामि I am coming, इति thus, यथा as, ब्रूयात् one may say, एवम् in this way, पूर्वैः by ancestors, गतः taken, पितृपैतामहः folowed by fathers and forefathers, मार्गः the path, ध्रुवः is certain, यस्य whosoever, व्यतिक्रमः violation, नास्ति not possible, तम् that very road, आपन्नः following, कथम् why, शोचेत् should one grieve?

text: वयस: पतमानस्य स्रोतसो वा ऽनिवर्तिन: । आत्मा सुखे नियोक्तव्य: सुखभाज: प्रजा: स्मृता: ॥२-१०५-३१॥
translation: Like the flow of water which never reverts to its source, age passes. Therefore, a man must employ his self in righteous acts that bring him happiness. By doing so, it is said, people will always be happy.
word_meanings: स्रोतसो वा like the flow, अनिवर्तिनः never returns, वयसः of age, पतमानस्य while declining, आत्मा mind, सुखे in happiness (in the righteous act as source of hapiness), नियोक्तव्यः is to be established, प्रजाः people, सुखभाजः tend to be happy, स्मृताः it is said.

text: धर्मात्मा स शुभै: कृत्स्नै: क्रतुभिश्चाप्तदक्षिणैः । धूतपापो गत: स्वर्गं पिता न: पृथिवीपति: ॥२-१०५-३२॥
translation: Our righteous father and lord of the earth, Dasaratha, attained heaven by giving abundant charities and performing several sacrifices in accordance with tradition.
word_meanings: न: our, पिता father, धर्मात्मा righteous one, स: पृथिवीपतिः that lord of the earth, दशरथ: Dasratha, शुभैः by auspicious, कृत्स्नैः wholly, आप्तदक्षिणैः by offering charities, क्रतुभिः by performing sacrifices, स्वर्गं to heaven, गतः went.

text: भृत्यानां भरणात् सम्यक् प्रजानां परिपालनात् । अर्थादानाच्च धर्मेण पिता नस्त्रिदिवं गत: ॥२-१०५-३३॥
translation: Our father nourished his dependents, splendidly governed his subjects and accepted wealth through righteous ways. Because of these pious acts, he could go to heaven.
word_meanings: नः our, पिता father, भृत्यानाम् of dependents, भरणात् by nourishing, सम्यक् splendidly, प्रजानाम् subjects, परिपालनात् by governing, धर्मेण in righteous ways, अर्थानाम् of the wealth, आदानात् accepting, त्रिदिवम् heaven, गतः went.

text: कर्मभिस्तु शुभैरिष्टै: क्रतुभिश्चाप्तदक्षिणै: । स्वर्गं दशरथ: प्राप्त: पिता न: पृथिवीपति: ॥२-१०५-३४॥
translation: Dasaratha, our father and lord of the earth, reached heaven by performing auspicious acts and offering abundant charities in sacrifices.
word_meanings: नः our, पिता father, पृथिवीपतिः lord of the earth, दशरथः Dasaratha, शुभैः auspicious, कर्मभिः with acts, आप्तदक्षिणैः with abundant charities, इष्टैः offerings of, क्रतुभिश्च with sacrifices, स्वर्गम् heaven, प्राप्तः reached.

text: इष्ट्वा बहुविधैर्यज्ञैर्भोगांश्चावाप्य पुष्कलान् । उत्तमं चायुरासाद्य स्वर्गत: पृथिवीपति: ॥२-१०५-३५॥
translation: King Dasaratha, lord of the earth, having performed various kinds of sacrifices and securing a long life, enjoyed abundance of pleasures and attained heaven.
word_meanings: पृथिवीपतिः lord of the earth, बहुविधैः by several kinds of, यज्ञैः with sacrifices, इष्ट्वा having performed, पुष्कलान् abundance of, भोगान् pleasures, अवाप्य च having enjoyed, उत्तमम् excellent, आयुश्च life also, आसाद्य having obtained , स्वर्गतः went to heaven.

text: आयुरुत्तममासाद्य भोगानपि च राघव: । स न शोच्य: पिता तात: स्वर्गत: सत्कृत: सताम् ॥२-१०५-३६॥
translation: O dear our father, king Dasaratha, who was honoured by the virtuous and enjoyed the best of pleasures attained heaven after a long life. Therefore, he is not to be grieved over.
word_meanings: तात O dear, सताम् for the virtuous, सत्कृतः honoured, उत्तमम् best of, आयुः life, भोगानपि pleasures, आसाद्य having enjoyed, स्वर्गतः attained the heaven, पिता father, स राघवः that Dasaratha, न शोच्यः is not to be grieved.

text: स जीर्णं मानुषं देहं परित्यज्य पिता हि न: । दैवीमृद्धिमनुप्राप्तो ब्रह्मलोकविहारिणीम् ॥२-१०५-३७॥
translation: Our father, king Dasaratha, abandoned the wornout mortal body, and obtained divine prosperity of wandering in the world of Brahma.
word_meanings: नः our, पिता father, सः king Dasaratha, जीर्णम् wornout, मानुषं देहम् mortal body, परित्यज्य having abandoned, ब्रह्मलोकविहारिणीम् wandering in the world of Brahma, दैवीम् divine, ऋद्धिम् treasure, अनुप्राप्तः हि obtained.

text: तं तु नैवंविध: कश्चित् प्राज्ञ: शोचितुमर्हति । तद्विधो यद्विधश्चापि श्रुतवान् बुद्धिमत्तर: ॥२-१०५-३८॥
translation: No one like you or me should ever mourn about this highly sagacious and learned king who was proficient in scriptural knowledge.
word_meanings: श्रुतवान् proficient in scriptural knowledge, बुद्धिमत्तरः highly sagacious, एवंविधः like this, प्राज्ञः learned man, कश्चित् none, तत्विध: like you, मद्विधश्चापि like me, तम् about him, शोचितुम् to mourn, नार्हति not proper.

text: एते बहुविधा: शोका विलापरुदिते तथा । वर्जनीया हि धीरेण सर्वावस्थासु धीमता ॥२-१०५-३९॥
translation: A wise man, holding on to his fortitude in all circumstances, should avoid such occasions of grief, these words of lamentation and this crying.
word_meanings: धीरेण courageously, धीमता by a wise man, बहुविधाः different, एते these, शोकाः griefs, तथा also, विलापरुदिते words of lamentation and this crying, सर्वावस्थासु in all circumstances, वर्जनीयाः हि should be avoided.

text: स स्वस्थो भव माशोचीर्यात्वा चावस तां पुरीम् । तथा पित्रा नियुक्तो ऽसि वशिना वदतां वर ॥२-१०५-४०॥
translation: O foremost of the eloquent, compose yourself. Do not grieve. Return to the city (Ayodhya) and reside there. You have been commanded so by our father who was a man of selfcontrol.
word_meanings: वदताम् वर the foremost of the eloquent, सः that you, स्वस्थः भव compose yourself, शोचेः in grief, मा not, यात्वा having returned, तां पुरीम् to that city (Ayodhya), आवस reside, वशिना by a man of selfcontrol, पित्रा by father, तथा like that, नियुक्तः असि you have been commanded.

text: यत्राहमपि तेनैव नियुक्त: पुण्यकर्मणा । तत्रैवाहं करिष्यामि पितुरार्य्यस्य शासनम् ॥२-१०५-४१॥
translation: I shall also stick to the command of our noble father who was a man of sacred deeds.
word_meanings: अहमपि I also, पुण्यकर्मणा by a man of sacred deeds, तेनैव by him (king Dasaratha), यत्र wherever one, नियुक्तः have been commanded, तत्रैव that one only, आर्यस्य noble, पितुः father's, शासनम् order, करिष्यामि shall do.

text: न मया शासनं तस्य त्यक्तुं न्याय्यमरिन्दम । तत् त्वयापि सदा मान्यं स वै बन्धु: स न: पिता ॥२-१०५-४२॥
translation: O subduer of enemies, I cannot violate the order of the king. You also must respect it for he is our father and friend indeed.
word_meanings: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, मया by me, तस्य his, शासनम् order, त्यक्तुम् to discard, न न्याय्यम् is not proper, त्वयापि by you also, तत् that one, सदा always, मान्यम् to be respected, सः he, नः for us, बन्धुः वै relation indeed, सः he, पिता father.

text: तद्वच: पितुरेवाहं सम्मतं धर्मचारिण: । कर्मणा पालयिष्यामि वनवासेन राघव ॥२-१०५-४३॥
translation: O Bharata, I will, therefore, obey the command of our venerable father, the champion of righteousness, by living in the forest.
word_meanings: राघव O Bharata, तत् therefore, अहम् I, धर्मचारिणः of the champion of righteousness, पितुः father's, सम्मतम् acceptable, वचः एव word only, वनवासेन by dwelling in the forest, कर्मणा by that act, पालयिष्यामि I will obey.

text: धीर्मिकेणानृशंसेन नरेण गुरुवर्त्तिना । भवितव्यं नरव्याघ्र परलोकं जिगीषता ॥२-१०५-४४॥
translation: O best of men, if a man aspires to conquer the higher world, he should remain virtuous, compassionate and obedient to his preceptors.
word_meanings: नरव्याघ्र O best of men, परलोकम् the next world, जिगीषता by one who aspires to conquer, नरेण by a man, धार्मिकेण by being virtuous, नृशंसेन compassionate, गुरुवर्तिना obedient to preceptors, भवितव्यम् shall happen.

text: आत्मानमनुतिष्ठ त्वं स्वभावेन नरर्षभ । निशाम्य तु शुभं वृत्तं पितुर्दशरथस्य न: ॥२-१०५-४५॥
translation: O best of men, having seen the auspicious life of our father Dasaratha and his conduct, you also stick to your own duty.
word_meanings: नरर्षभ O best of men, नः our, पितुः father, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, शुभम् auspicious, वृत्तम् conduct, निशाम्य having seen, त्वम् you, आत्मानम् yourself, स्वभावेन with your duty, अनुतिष्ठ stick to.

text: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं महात्मा पितुर्निदेशप्रतिपालनार्थम् । यवीयसं भ्रातरमर्थवच्च प्रभुर्मुहूर्ताद्विरराम राम: ॥२-१०५-४६॥
translation: Rama, the magnanimous lord, addressed his younger brother Bharata with words full of significance, saying, Obey father's command and remained silent in a moment. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे पञ्चोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the one hundredfifth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: महात्मा magnanimous, प्रभुः competent, रामः Rama, यवीयसम् younger, भ्रातरम् brother, इत्येवम् in this way, पितुः father's, निदेशप्रतिपालनार्थम् to obey the command of his father, अर्थवत् significant, वचनम् words, उक्त्वा having said, मुहूर्तात् in a moment, विरराम became silent.

text: एवमुक्त्वा तु विरते रामे वचनमर्थवत् । ततो मन्दाकिनीतीरे रामं प्रकृतिवत्सलम् । उवाच भरतश्चित्रं धार्मिको धार्मिकं वच: ॥२-१०६-१॥
translation: Rama remained silent after saying these meaningful words on the bank of river Mandakini. Then the Bharata, conforming to righteousness, replied in clear words to the virtuous Rama who was affectionate by nature.
word_meanings: रामे when Rama, एवम् in this way, अर्थवत् meaningful, वचनम् words, उक्त्वा having uttered, विरते had rested, ततः then, धार्मिकः righteous one, भरतः Bharata, मन्दाकिनी river Mandakini, तीरे on the bank, प्रकृतिवत्सलम् affectionate by nature, धार्मिकम् virtuous, रामम् Rama, धार्मिकम् conforming to righteouness, चित्रम् clear, वचः words, उवाच said.

text: को हि स्यादीदृशो लोके यादृशस्त्वमरिन्दम । न त्वां प्रव्यथयेद्दु:खं प्रीतिर्वा न प्रहर्षयेत् ॥२-१०६-२॥
सम्मतश्चासि वृद्धानां तांश्च पृच्छसि संशयान् ॥२-१०६-३॥
translation: O subduer of enemies, you are of such nature that neither sorrow pains you nor pleasure delights you. There are none in this world like you. You are loved by the elders, for you seek their counsel whenever you have doubts.
word_meanings: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies (Rama), त्वम् you, यादृशः of such nature, ईदृशः of such person, लोके in the world, कोहि स्यात् who he may be, त्वाम् you, दुःखम् sarrow, न प्रव्यथयेत् does not pain, प्रीतिः pleasure, न वा प्रहर्षयेत् does not delight, वृद्धानाम् for the elders, सम्मतः असि beloved, तांश्च them, संशयान् doubts, पृच्छसि ask them.

text: यथा मृतस्तथा जीवन् यथा ऽसति तथा सति । यस्यैष बुद्धिलाभ: स्यात्परितप्येत केन स: ॥२-१०६-४॥
translation: One should accept life and death, vice and virtue equally. How can one be afflicted when he has gained such an intellect?
word_meanings: मृतः the dead, यथा as, जीवन् while living, तथा in the same way, असति about evil man, यथा same way सति about virtuous man, तथा like that, यस्य to whom, एषः this, बुद्धिलाभः gains of intellect, स्यात् becomes, सः he, केन by what, परितप्येत is distressed.

text: परावरज्ञो यश्च स्यात्तथा त्वं मनुजाधिप । स एवं व्यसनं प्राप्य न विषीदितुमर्हति ॥२-१०६-५॥
translation: O lord of men, it is not proper for a person like you who knows the past and the future of human beings to feel distressed and lament over it.
word_meanings: मनुजाधिप O lord of men, यः who त्वं यथा like you, परावरज्ञः knower of past and future, सः that person, एव this, व्यसनम् distress, प्राप्य having obtained, विषीदितुं to lament, न अर्हति is not proper.

text: अमरोपम सत्त्वस्त्वं महात्मा सत्यसङ्गर: । सर्वज्ञ: सर्वदर्शी च बुद्धिमांश्चासि राघव ॥२-१०६-६॥
translation: O magnanimous Rama, your nature is divine and you are true to your promises. You are omniscient, allseeing and wise.
word_meanings: राघव Rama, महात्मा the magnanimous one, त्वम् you, अमरोपमसत्त्वः resemble gods in nature, सत्यसङ्गरः true to your promis, सर्वज्ञः allknowing, सर्वदर्शी च allseeing, बुद्धिमांश्च असि you are a man of wisdom.

text: न त्वामेवङ्गुणैर्युक्तं प्रभवाभवकोविदम् । अविषह्यतमं दु:खमासादयितुमर्हति ॥२-१०६-७॥
translation: It is not proper for a virtuous man like you, who is cognizant in matters of life and death, to be overwhelmed by such insufferable grief.
word_meanings: एवं गुणैः by such virtues, युक्तम् endowed with, प्रभवाभवकोविदम् cognizant of life and death, त्वाम् you, अविषह्यतमम् insufferable, दुःखम् grief, आसादयितुम् to reach, नार्हति not proper.

text: प्रोषिते मयि यत्पापं मात्रा मत्कारणात्कृतम् । क्षुद्रया तदनिष्टं मे प्रसीदतु भवान्मम ॥२-१०६-८॥
translation: When I was away from home, my meanminded mother committed a sin for my sake which I never wished. You may pardon me graciously.
word_meanings: मयि me, प्रोषिते when I was away from home, क्षुद्रया by the meanminded, मात्रा by mother, मत्कारणात् for my sake, यत् पापम् which sin, कृतम् has been committed, तत् that one, मे to me, अनिष्टम् that disagreeable act, भवान् you, मम me, प्रसीदतु graciously pardon.

text: धर्मबन्धेन बद्धो ऽस्मि तेनेमां नेह मातरम् । हन्मि तीव्रेण दण्डेन दण्डार्हां पापकारिणीम् ॥२-१०६-९॥
translation: I am bound by a bond of righteousness for which I am unble to slay my mother who deserves severe punishment for her sinful acts.
word_meanings: धर्मबन्धेन by a bond of righteousness, बद्धः अस्मि I am bound, तेन for that reason, इह now, दण्डार्हाम् deserving punishment, पापकारिणीम् doing sinful acts, इमां मातरम् this mother, तीव्रेण severe, दण्डेन punishment, न हन्मि do not slay.

text: कथं दशरथाज्जात: शुद्धाभिजनकर्मण: । जानन् धर्ममधर्मिष्ठं कुर्य्यां कर्म जुगुप्सितम् ॥२-१०६-१०॥
translation: How shall I, born to Dasaratha of noble race and righteous deeds, with the knowledge of dharma, do such a reprehensible and unrighteous deed?
word_meanings: शुद्धाभिजनकर्मणः of noble race and righteous deeds, दशरथात् from Dasaratha, जातः born of, धर्मम् righteousness, जानन् knowing, अधर्मिष्ठम् unrighteous, जुगुप्सितम् reprehensible, कर्म deed, कथम् how, कुर्याम् shall I do?.

text: गुरु: क्रियावान् वृद्धश्च राजा प्रेत: पितेति च । तातं न परिगर्हेयं दैवतं चेति संसदि ॥२-१०६-११॥
translation: King Dasaratha, my father and preceptor, is godlike to me. Devoted to meritorious acts, he departed from this world in his old age. For this reason, I cannot reproach him (publicly) in this assembly (of men).
word_meanings: गुरुः preceptor, क्रियावान् one who is devoted to meritorious acts, वृद्धश्च old, राजा king, प्रेतः departed soul, पिता father, इति च for this, दैवतं चेति as a god, संसदि in the assembly, तातम् father, न परिगर्हेयम् I cannot reproach.

text: को हि धर्मार्थयोर्हीनमीदृशं कर्म किल्बिषम् । स्त्रिया: प्रियं चिकीर्षु: सन् कुर्याद्धर्मज्ञ धर्मवित् ॥२-१०६-१२॥
translation: O Rama, conversant with righteousness, will any one who knows the meaning of righteousness, do such a sinful act contrary to dharma and artha to please a woman?
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञ O knower of ways of righteousness, धर्मवित् knower of righeousness, को हि who indeed, स्त्रियाः for the sake of a women, प्रियम् pleasure, चिकीर्षुः सन् desirous of doing, धर्मार्थयोः for dharma and artha, हीनम् bereft of, किल्बिषम् sinful, ईदृशम् this kind of, कर्म act, कुर्यात् will do?

text: अन्तकाले हि भूतानि मुह्यन्तीति पुराश्रुति: । राज्ञैवं कुर्वता लोके प्रत्यक्षं सा श्रुति: कृता ॥२-१०६-१३॥
translation: There is an ancient saying that at the time of death, the intellect of people is deluded. By conducting himself in this way, king Dasaratha has proved it.
word_meanings: भूतानि living beings, अन्तकाले at the time of death, मुह्यन्ति are deluded, इति thus, पुराश्रुतिः ancient saying, एवम् in this way, कुर्वता by doing, राज्ञा by the king, सा श्रुतिः that adage, लोके in this world, प्रत्यक्षं explicitly, कृता has been made.

text: साध्वर्थमभिसन्धाय ऺक्रोधान्मोहाच्च साहसात् । तातस्य यदतिक्रान्तं प्रत्याहरतु तद्भवान् ॥२-१०६-१४॥
translation: Our father has trangressed righteousness due to anger or delusion or recklessness. Therefore, you may think over the matter prudently and set it right.
word_meanings: क्रोधात् due to anger, मोहात् due to delusion, साहसात् due to a spirit of adventure, तातस्य father's, यत् अतिक्रान्तम् whichever trangression, तत् that, भवान् you, साधु prudently, अर्थम् meaning, अभिसन्धाय having thought over, प्रत्याहरतु will set it right.

text: पितुरपतनहेतुत्वात्तदेवापत्यत्वेन सम्मतम् ॥२-१०६-१५॥
तदपत्यं भवानस्तु मा भवान् दुष्कृतं पितु: । अभिपत्ता कृतं कर्म लोके धीरविगर्हितम् ॥२-१०६-१६॥
translation: So be a worthy son and let not the sinful act committed by our father and condemned by men of wisdom be approved by you.
word_meanings: भवान् you, तत् अपत्यम् अस्तु be such a son, लोके in this world, धीरविगर्हितम् condemned by men of wisdom, दुष्कृतम् sinful, पितुः father's, कृतम् committed, कर्म act, भवान् you, अभिपत्ता an approver, मास्तु let not become.

text: कैकेयीं मां च तातं च सुहृदो बान्धवांश्च न: । पौरजानपदान् सर्वांस्त्रातु सर्वमिदं भवान् ॥२-१०६-१७॥
translation: Protect this entire kingdom, Kaikeyi, me and father, our friends and relations, citizens of the city and inhabitants of the countryside.
word_meanings: भवान् you, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, मां च me, तातं च father also, नः our, सुहृदः friends, बान्धवांश्च relations, सर्वान् all, पौरजानपदान् inhabitants of the city and countryside, सर्वम् entire, इदम् this kingodm, त्रातु protect.

text: क्व चारण्यं क्व च क्षात्ऺत्र क्व जटा: क्व च पालनम् । ईदृशं व्याहतं कर्म न भवान् कर्तुमर्हति ॥२-१०६-१८॥
translation: Where is the forest and where is kshatriya's duty? Where are matted locks and where is governance of the kingdom? It does not behave you to do such acts antithetical to each other.
word_meanings: अरण्यं च the forest, क्व where, क्षात्रं च kshatriya'a duty, क्व where, जटाः matted locks, क्व where, पालनं च governance of the kingdom, क्व where, भवान् you, ईदृशम् such, व्याहतम् repulsive, कर्म act, कर्तुम् to do, न अर्हति not proper.

text: एष हि प्रथमो धर्म: क्षत्ऺित्रयस्याभिषेचनम् । येन शक्यं महाप्राज्ञ प्रजानां परिपालनम् ॥२-१०६-१९॥
translation: O sagacious one, the primary duty of a kshatriya is to be crowned. This enables him to rule his subjects.
word_meanings: महाप्राज्ञ O sagacious one, येन by whom, प्रजानाम् of the subjects', परिपालनम् governance, शक्यम् is possible, एषः this one, क्षत्रियस्य kshatriya's, अभिषेचनम् to be crowned, प्रथमः primary, धर्मः हि duty indeed.

text: कश्च प्रत्यक्षमुत्सृज्य संशयस्थमलक्षणम् । आयतिस्थं चरेद्धर्मं क्षत्ऺत्रबन्धुरनिश्चितम् ॥२-१०६-२०॥
translation: Will any kshatriya, setting aside his first duty, follow an uncertain course of piety which is contrary to his dharma and whose impact may be felt in a remote future.
word_meanings: कः who, क्षत्रबन्धुः a kshatriya, प्रत्यक्षम् first duty, उत्सृज्य abandoning संशयस्थम् doubtful, अलक्षणम् inauspcious, आयतिस्थम् standing at a remote future, अनिश्चितम् uncertain, धर्मम् righteousness, चरेत् will follow?

text: अथ क्लेशजमेव त्वं धर्मं चरितुमिच्छसि । धर्मेण चतुरो वर्णान् पालयन् क्लेशमाप्नुहि ॥२-१०६-२१॥
translation: If you so desire to follow the path of dharma acquired out of physical exertion, then bear the trouble of governing the four castes of the social order righteously.
word_meanings: अथ or, त्वम् you, क्लेशजम् born of physical exertion, धर्ममेव righteousness, चरितुम् to follow, इच्छसि यदि if you desire, चतुरः four, वर्णान् castes of social order, धर्मेण righteously, पालयन् governing, क्लेशम् exhaustion, आप्नुहि obtain.

text: चतुर्णामाश्रमाणां हि गार्हस्थ्यं श्रेष्ठमाश्रमम् । प्राहुर्धर्मज्ञ धर्मज्ञास्तं कथं त्यक्तुमर्हसि ॥२-१०६-२२॥
translation: O Rama, you are the one who knows his duty. The knowers of dharma maintain that the life of a householder is the foremost among the four modes of life. How can you renounce it?
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञ one who is cognizant of duty, गार्हस्थ्यम् life a of householder, चतुर्णाम् the four, आश्रमाणाम् among modes of life, श्रेष्ठम् foremost, आश्रमम् mode of life, धर्मज्ञाः knowers of dharma, प्राहुः हि say, तम् that one, त्यक्तुम् to renounce, कथम् how, अर्हसि are entitled?

text: श्रुतेन बाल: स्थानेन जन्मना भवतो ह्यहम् । स कथं पालयिष्यामि भूमिं भवति तिष्ठति ॥२-१०६-२३॥
translation: Being younger to you in knowledge, position and birth, how can I rule the earth when you are present?
word_meanings: अहम् I, श्रुतेन in knowledge, स्थानेन in position, जन्मना in birth, भवतः compared to you, बालः हि am younger, सः such me, भवति when you, तिष्ठति while living, भूमिम् the earth, कथम् how, पालयिष्यामि can I rule?

text: हीनबुद्धिगुणो बालो हीन: स्थानेन चाप्यहम् । भवता च विनाभूतो न वर्त्तयितुमुत्सहे ॥२-१०६-२४॥
translation: I am a child, deficient in intelligence and virtue and even inferior in position. Deserted by you, I do not wish to live.
word_meanings: हीनबुद्धिगुणः deficient in intelligence and virtue, स्थानेन चापि even in position, हीनः low, बालः child, अहम् I, भवता by you, विनाभूतः deserted, वर्तयितुम् to live, न उत्सहे I do not desire.

text: इदं निखिलमव्यग्रं राज्यं पित्र्यमकण्टकम् । अनुशाधि स्वधर्मेण धर्मज्ञ सह बान्धवै: ॥२-१०६-२५॥
translation: O one, conversant with righteousness rule unhindered this entire kingdom along with our relations inherited from our father.
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञ O one, conversant with righteousness, पित्य्रम् relating to our father, निखिलम् entire, इदं राज्यम् this kingdom, अव्यग्रम् quietly, अकण्टकम् without hindrance बान्धवैस्सह with the relations, स्वधर्मेण in accordance with your duty, अनुशाधि rule .
