word_meanings: रामः Rama, तेषाम् their, वचनम् words, आज्ञाय having understood, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said, धर्मचक्षुषाम् through righteous vision, सुहृदाम् friends, एवम् in this way, वचनम् words, निबोध understand.

text: एतच्चैवोभयं श्रुत्वा सम्यक् सम्पश्य राघव । उत्तिष्ठ त्वं महाबाहो मां च स्पृश तथोदकम् ॥२-१११-२३॥
translation: O mightyarmed son of the Raghus, you have heard both (them and me). Carefully think over. Arise. Touch me and sip water.
word_meanings: महाबाहो O mightyarmed one, राघव Bharata, एतत् all this, उभयं चैव both, श्रुत्वा having heard, सम्यक् carefully, सम्पश्य having thought over, त्वम् you, उत्तिष्ठ arise, मां च me, तथा as also, उदकम् water, स्पृश touch.

text: अथोत्थाय जलं स्पृष्ट्वा भरतो वाक्यमब्रवीत् । श्रृण्वन्तु मे परिषदो मन्त्रिण: श्रेणयस्तथा ॥२-१११-२४॥
translation: Then Bharata stood up and performed achamana (sipping of water) and said 'let the assembly of learned men, counsellors and guildsmen hear me'.
word_meanings: अथ then, भरतः Bharata, उत्थाय having stood up, जलम् water, स्पृष्ट्वा having touched, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, परिषदः O men of the assembly, मन्त्रिणः O counsellors, तथा also, श्रेणयः O guildsmen, मे me, श्रुण्वन्तु listen.

text: न याचे पितरं राज्यं नानुशासामि मातरम् । आर्यं परमधर्मज्ञं नानुजानामि राघवम् ॥२-१११-२५॥
translation: I never asked my father to confer the kingdom on me. I never urged my mother to seek the kingdom for me. I never supported the exile of my esteemed brother Rama, who is supreme in the knowleldge of righteousness.
word_meanings: पितरम् my father, राज्यम् kingdom, न याचे did not ask, मातरम् mother, नानुशासामि did not urge, परमधर्मज्ञम् supremely knowleldgeable in ways of righteousness, आर्यम् esteemed, राघवम् Rama, नानुजानामि I did not consent.

text: यदि त्ववश्यं वस्तव्यं कर्त्तव्यं च पितुर्वच: । अहमेव निवत्स्यामि चतुर्दश समा वने ॥२-१११-२६॥
translation: If it is absolutely essential to live in the forest in accordance with the command of my father, I myself shall also dwell in the forest for fourteen years.
word_meanings: अवश्यम् absolutely, वस्तव्यं यदि if it is essential to live in the forest, पितुः father's, वचः words, कर्तव्यं च must be done, अहमेव I myself, चतुर्दश समाः fourteen years, वने in the forest, निवत्स्यामि I will reside.

text: धर्मात्मा तस्य तथ्येन भ्रातुर्वाक्येन विस्मित: । उवाच राम: सम्प्रेक्ष्य पौरजानपदं जनम् ॥२-१११-२७॥
translation: On hearing the genuine sentiments of his brother, righteous Rama was astonished. He said to the inhabitants from towns and villages:
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा righteous, रामः Rama, तस्य his, भ्रातुः brother's, तथ्येन genuine, वाक्येन with words, विस्मितः was astonished, पौरजानपदम् inhabiting the towns and villages, जनम् people, सम्प्रेक्ष seeing, उवाच said.

text: विक्रीतमाहितं क्रीतं यत् पित्रा जीवता मम । न तल्लोपयितुं शक्यं मया वा भरतेन वा ॥२-१११-२८॥
translation: Neither Bharata nor I can in any way annul anything which was sold, pledged or bought by my father during his lifetime.
word_meanings: मम my, जीवता while living, पित्रा by father, यत् what, विक्रीतम् was sold, आहितम् pledged, क्रीतम् bought, तत् that, लोपयितुं to annul, मया वा by me or, भरतेन वा or Bharata, न शक्यम् not possible.

text: अपधिर्न मया कार्य्यो वनवासे जुगुप्सित: । युक्तमुक्तं च कैकेय्या पित्रा मे सुकृतं कृतम् ॥२-१११-२९॥
translation: As far as living in the forest is concerned it is reprehensible to keep a subsitute for me and it shall not be done. Kaikeyi has acted rightfully and my father has taken the proper decision.
word_meanings: मया by me, वनवासे in the matter of living in the forest, जुगुप्सितः reprehensible, उपधिः placing a substitute, न कार्यः shall not be done, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, युक्तम् rightly, उक्तम् spoken, मे पित्रा by my father, सुकृतम् good deed, कृतम् has been done.

text: जानामि भरतं क्षान्तं गुरुसत्कारकारिणम् । सर्वमेवात्र कल्याणं सत्यसन्धे महात्मनि ॥२-१११-३०॥
translation: I know Bharata as a man of forbearance and one who honours elders. Everything will turn out well for this great soul wedded to truth.
word_meanings: भरतम् Bharata, क्षान्तम् a man of forbearance, गुरुसत्कारकारिणम् honours elders, जानामि I know, सत्यसन्धे true to his word, महात्मनि great, अत्र for him, सर्वमेव everything, कल्याणम् will be auspicious.

text: अनेन धर्मशीलेन वनात् प्रत्यागत: पुन: । भ्रात्रा सह भविष्यामि पृथिव्या: पतिरुत्तम: ॥२-१११-३१॥
translation: On returning from the forest, I shall become the supreme lord of this earth along with this virtuous brother.
word_meanings: वनात् from the forest, पुनः again, प्रत्यागतः when returned, धर्मशीलेन of virtuous conduct, अनेन भ्रात्रा सह along with this brother, पृथिव्याः of the earth, उत्तमः supreme, पतिः lord, भविष्यामि I shall become.

text: वृतो राजा हि कैकेय्या मया तद्वचनं कृतम् । अनृतन्मोचयानेन पितरं तं महीपतिम् ॥२-१११-३२॥
translation: The king (Dasaratha) was solicited by Kaikeyi and I shall abide. Therefore, you also release the lord of the earth, our father from the charge of falsehood. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकादशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundredeleventh sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: राजा the king (Dasaratha), कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, वृतो हि has been solicited, मया by me, तद्वचनं those words, कृतम् are followed, अनेन for that reason, महीपतिम् the lord of the earth, तं पितरम् that father, अनृतात् from falsehood, मोचय you may release.

text: तमप्रतिमतेजोभ्यां भ्रातृभ्यां रोमहर्षणम् । विस्मिता: सङ्गमं प्रेक्ष्य समवेता महर्षय: ॥२-११२-१॥
translation: The great sages assembled there were amazed at witnessing the meeting of the two brothers (Rama and Bharata) of umparalleled briliance.
word_meanings: समवेताः those who had assembled, महर्षयः the great sages, अप्रतिमतेजोभ्यां of both men of unparalleled brilliance, भ्रातृभ्याम् of brothers (Rama and Bharata), तम् that, रोमहर्षणम् thrilled, सङ्गमम् their meeting, प्रेक्ष्य witnessing, विस्मिताः were amazed.

text: अन्तर्हितास्त्वृषिगणा: सिद्धाश्च परमर्षय: । तौ भ्रातरौ महात्मानौ महात्मानौ काकुत्स्थौ प्रशशंसिरे ॥२-११२-२॥
translation: The hosts of sages, siddhas and devarshis watching invisible the two Kakutstha brothers extoled them.
word_meanings: अन्तर्हिताः remaining invisible, मुनिगणाः hosts of sages, सिद्धाश्च siddhas, परमर्षय: devarshis, महात्मानौ magnanimous, भ्रातरौ brothers, तौ those two, काकुत्स्थौ Kakutsthas, प्रशशंसिरे lauded.

text: स धन्यो यस्य पुत्रौ द्वौ धर्मज्ञौ धर्मविक्रमौ । श्रुत्वा वयं हि सम्भाषामुभयो: स्पृहयामहे ॥२-११२-३॥
translation: On hearing their dialogue we are deeply drawn towards them, these two sons of king Dasaratha who was fortunate to have these practioners of righteousness and whose strength is dharma.
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञौ practioners of righteousness, धर्मविक्रमौ whose strength is righteousness, द्वौ both, यस्य whose, पुत्रौ two sons, सः he (Dasaratha), धन्यः is fortunate, वयम् we, संभाषाम् their conversation, श्रुत्वा having heard, उभयोः in respect of both of them, स्पृहयामहे हि we are attached.

text: ततस्त्वृषिगणा: क्षिप्रं दशग्रीववधैषिण: । भरतं राजशार्दूलमित्यूचु: सङ्गता वच: ॥२-११२-४॥
translation: Thereafter hosts of rishis desiring the speedy destruction of tenheaded Ravana said these words to Bharata, the best of kings.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, क्षिप्रम् quickly, दशग्रीववधैषिणः men desiring the destruction of tenheaded Ravana, ऋषिगणाः hosts of rishis, राजशार्दूलम् best of kings, भरतम् Bharata, इति thus, वचः words, ऊचुः uttered.

text: कुले जात महाप्राज्ञ महावृत्त महायश: । ग्राह्यं रामस्य वाक्यं ते पितरं यद्यवेक्षसे ॥२-११२-५॥
translation: O Bharata, born in an illustrious race, highly sagacious and a man of virtuous conduct and great renown, accept Rama's proposal if you have any regard for your father.
word_meanings: कुले जात O born in an illustrious race, महाप्राज्ञ O highly sagacious one, महावृत्त of virtuous conduct, महायशः O man of great renown, ते your, पितरम् father, अवेक्षसे यदि if you look at your father, रामस्य Rama's, वाक्यम् words, ग्राह्यम् have to be accepted.

text: सदानृणमिमं रामं वयमिच्छामहे पितु: । अनृणत्वाच्च कैकेय्या: स्वर्गं दशरथो गत: ॥२-११२-६॥
translation: We always desire that Rama should discharge his debt to his father. Dasaratha, who by redeeming himself of his obligation to Kaikeyi, had ascended heaven.
word_meanings: वयम् we, इमं रामम् this Rama, सदा always, पितुः as regards his father, अनृणम् free from debt, इच्छामहे we desire, दशरथः Dasaratha, कैकेय्याः to Kaikeyi, अनृणत्वाच्च by discharging his obligation, स्वर्गम् heaven, गतः ascended.

text: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं गन्धर्वा: समहर्षय: । राजर्षयश्चैव तदा सर्वे स्वांस्वां गतिं गता: ॥२-११२-७॥
translation: Then the great rishis, gandharvas and royal sages having said this, returned to their respective abodes.
word_meanings: तदा then, समहर्षयः with great rishis, गन्धर्वाः gandharvas, राजर्षयश्चैव and royal sages, एतावत् upto this extent, वचनम् word, उक्त्वा having spoken, सर्वे all, स्वां स्वाम् to their respective, गतिम् abode, गताः went.

text: ह्लादितस्तेन वाक्येन शुभेन शुभदर्शन: । राम: संहृष्टवदनस्तानृषीनभ्यपूजयत् ॥२-११२-८॥
translation: Of pleasing appearance, Rama, gladdened by the auspicious statements (of the sages), paid them homage with a cheerful countenance.
word_meanings: शुभदर्शनः of auspicious appearance, रामः Rama, शुभेन by the auspicious, तेन वाक्येन by that statement, ह्लादितः was gladdened, संहृष्टवदनः with delightful countenance, तान् ऋषीन् those rishis, अभ्यपूजयत् paid homage.

text: स्रस्तगात्रस्तु भरत: स वाचा सज्जमानया । कृताञ्जलिरिदं वाक्यं राघवं पुनरब्रवीत् ॥२-११२-९॥
translation: Before Bharata, with his limbs trembling and with palms folded (in reverence) was ready to depart, he said to Rama:
word_meanings: सः भरतत्तु as for Bharata, त्रस्तगात्रः limbs trembling, कृताञ्जलिः with palms folded (in reverence), सज्जमानया got ready, वाचा words, पुनः again, राघवम् to Rama, इदं वाक्यम् these word, अब्रवीत् said.

text: राजधर्ममनुप्रेक्ष्य कुलधर्मानुसन्ततिम् । कर्त्तुमर्हसि काकुत्स्थ मम मातुश्च याचनाम् ॥२-११२-१०॥
translation: O Rama, keeping in view the code of kings and tradition of our family, it behoves you to consider my supplication and that of my mother.
word_meanings: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, राजधर्मम् code of kings, कुलधर्मानुसन्ततिम् to abide by the traditional code of our family, अनुप्रेक्ष्य having considered, मम my, मातुश्च also mother's, याचनाम् supplication, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि behoves you.

text: रक्षितुं सुमहद्राज्यमहमेकस्तु नोत्सहे । पौरजानपदांश्चापि रक्तान् रञ्जयितुं तथा ॥२-११२-११॥
translation: I do not venture to protect this kingdom all by myself and keep the inhabitants of the towns and villages who are loyal to you pleased.
word_meanings: अहम् I, एकस्तु am alone, सुमहत् this vast, राज्यम् kingdom, रक्षितुम् to protect, रक्तान् loyal पौरजानपदान् inhabitants of the town and villages, रञ्जयितुम् to please, नोत्सहे I do not venture.

text: ज्ञातयश्च हि योधाश्च मित्राणि सुहृदश्च न: । त्वामेव प्रतिकांक्षन्ते पर्जन्यमिव कर्षका: ॥२-११२-१२॥
translation: All our relatives, warriors, friends and wellwishers long to see you like farmers yearn for the raincloud.
word_meanings: नः our, ज्ञातयश्च relatives, योधाश्च warriors, मित्राणि friends, सुहृदश्च wellwishers, त्वामेव you alone, कर्षकाः farmers, पर्जन्यमिव like rainbearing cloud, प्रतिवीक्षन्ते are longing.

text: इदं राज्यं महाप्राज्ञ स्थापय प्रतिपद्य हि । शक्तिमानसि काकुत्स्थ लोकस्य परिपालने ॥२-११२-१३॥
translation: O sagacious Rama, accept this kingdom and ensure its stability. You are powerful enough to govern this world. So accept this kingdom and restore its stability.
word_meanings: महाप्राज्ञ O sagacious one, इदं राज्यम् this kingdom, प्रतिपद्य after accepting, स्थापय establish, काकुत्स्थ Kakutstha, लोकस्य this world's, परिपालने in governance, शक्तिमान् असि you are powerful.

text: इत्युक्त्वा न्यपतद् भ्रातु: पादयोर्भरतस्तदा । भृशं सम्प्रार्थयामास राममेव प्रियंवद: ॥२-११२-१४॥
translation: Having said this, Bharata, fell at the feet of his brother, and speaking sweetly, he profusely entreated Rama.
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, तदा then, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, भ्रातुः brother's, पादयोः at the feet, न्यपतत् fell, प्रियंवदः one who speaks sweetly, Bharata, रामम् एव Rama alone, भृशम् profusely, सम्प्रार्थयामास entreated him.

text: तमङ्के भ्रातरं कृत्वा रामो वचनमब्रवीत् । श्यामं नलिनपत्राक्षं मत्तहंसस्वरं स्वयम् ॥२-११२-१५॥
translation: Rama took his in his arms Bharata who had a darkblue complexion, whose eyes were like petals of lotus and whose voice was the voice of an amorous swan.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, श्यामम् dark complexioned, नलिनपत्राक्षम् man with eyes like lotus petals, मत्तहंस स्वरम् voice of an amorous swan, तं भरतम् to that Bharata, स्वयम् personally, अङ्के into his lap, कृत्वा drawing, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: आगता त्वामियं बुद्धि: स्वजा वैनयिकी च या । भृशमुत्सहसे तात रक्षितुं पृथिवीमपि ॥२-११२-१६॥
translation: O child, this wisdom of yours is both inborn and imbibed through training. With this, you are perfectly capable of protecting the earth.
word_meanings: तातः O child, स्वजा innate, वैनयिकी च though training (received from a preceptor), या बुद्धि: such wisdom, त्वाम् you, आगता reached, पृथिवीम् to the earth, रक्षितुम् अपि even to protect, भृशम् perfectly, उत्सहसे you are capable.

text: अमात्यैश्च सुहृद्भिश्च बुद्धिमद्भिश्च मन्त्रिभि: । सर्वकार्याणि सम्मन्त्र्य सुमहान्त्यपि कारय ॥२-११२-१७॥
translation: After due consultation with ministers, friends, counsellors and prudent persons, accomplish all tasks, however formidable they may appear.
word_meanings: अमात्यैश्च with ministers, सुहृद्भिश्च with friends, बुद्धिमद्भि: with the prudent, मन्त्रिभिश्च with the counsellors, सम्मन्त्र्य consulting, सुमहन्त्यपि however great they might appear, सर्वकार्याणि all endeavours, कारय you may get them done.

text: लक्ष्मीश्चन्द्रादपेयाद्वा हिमवान् वा हिमं त्यजेत् । अतीयात् सागरो वेलां न प्रतिज्ञामहं पितु: ॥२-११२-१८॥
translation: The Moon might lose its splendour, snow might abandon the Himavat mountain, the ocean might overstep its shores, but I shall not forsake the promise made to my father.
word_meanings: चन्द्रात् from the Moon, लक्ष्मीः splendour, अपेयाद्वा might withdraw, हिमवान् Himavat mountain, हिमम् snow, त्यजेद्वा might abandon, सागरः ocean, वेलाम् its shores, अतीयात् might overstep, अहम् I, पितुः to father, प्रतिज्ञाम् promise, न shall not forsake.

text: कामाद्वा तात लोभाद्वा मात्रा तुभ्यमिदं कृतम् । न तन्मनसि कर्त्तव्यं वर्त्तितव्यं च मातृवत् ॥२-११२-१९॥
translation: Dear brother, whether out of affection or greed, your mother has done this for your sake. It should not agitate your mind. You should conduct yourself as one should towards one's mother.
word_meanings: तात child, कामाद्वा either out of affection, लोभाद्वा or out of covetousness, मात्रा by your mother, तुभ्यम् for your sake, इदम् this, कृतम् was done, तत् that, मनसि in your mind, न कर्तव्यम् should not be taken seriously, मातृवत् as to one's own mother, वर्तिव्यम् you should conduct.

text: एवं ब्रुवाणं भरत: कौसल्यासुतमब्रवीत् । तेजसादित्यसङ्काशं प्रतिपच्चन्द्रदर्शनम् ॥२-११२-२०॥
translation: On hearing this, Bharata replied to the son of Kausalya who looked like the Sun or the new Moon in brilliance:
word_meanings: भरतः Bharata, एवम् in this way, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, तेजसा in brilliance, आदित्यसङ्काशम् resembling the Sun, प्रतिपच्चन्द्रदर्शनम् appearance like the new Moon, कौसल्यासुतम् to the son of Kausalya, अब्रवीत् said.

text: अधिरोहार्य पादाभ्यां पादुके हेमभूषिते । एते हि सर्वलोकस्य योगक्षेमं विधास्यत: ॥२-११२-२१॥
translation: O noble one, place your feet on these sandals decorated with gold. They will secure the prosperity and safety of the entire world.
word_meanings: आर्य O noble one, हेमभूषिते decorated with gold, पादुके sandals, पादाभ्याम् from your feet, अधिरोह get into, एते these, सर्वलोकस्य of the entire world, योगक्षेमम् safety, विधास्यतः हि are going to secure.

text: सो ऽधिरुह्य नरव्याघ्र: पादुके ह्यवरुह्य च । प्रायच्छत् सुमहातेजा भरताय महात्मने ॥२-११२-२२॥
translation: Rama, the best of men, one with great brilliance, put on and then put off the sandals and presented them to the magnanimous Bharata.
word_meanings: नरव्याघ्रः the best of men, सुमहातेजाः of great brilliance, सः that Rama, पादुके sandals, अधिरुह्य putting on, अवरुह्य च putting off, महात्मने to the magnanimous, भरताय to Bharata, प्रायच्छत् gave.

text: स पादुके सम्प्रणम्य रामं वचनमब्रवीत् । चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि जटाचीरधरो ह्यहम् ॥२-११२-२३॥
translation: Bharata bowed before the sandals and said to Rama, 'O tormentorr of enemies, O hero, wearing matted locks and bark garments, living on fruits and roots, placing the responsibility of ruling the kingdom on your sandals and looking forward to your arrival, I shall reside outside the city for fourteen years.'
word_meanings: सः that Bharata, पादुके to the sandals, सम्प्रणम्य bowing down, रामम् to Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said, परन्तप O tormentor of enemies, वीर O hero, रघुनन्दन Rama, अहम् I, चतुर्दश वर्षाणि fourteen years, जटाचीरधरः wearing matted locks and bark garments, फलमूलाशनः living on fruits and roots, तव your, पादुकयोः on your sandals, न्यस्तराज्यतन्त्रः placing the responsibility of ruling this kingdom, तव your, आगमनम् arrival, आकाङ्क्षन् looking forward, नगरात् from the city, बहिः outside, वसन् residing, भवेयम् I shall remain.

text: फलमूलाशनो वीर भवेयं रघुनन्दन । तवागमनमाकांक्षन् वसन् वै नगराद्बहि: ॥२-११२-२४॥
translation: Bharata bowed before the sandals and said to Rama, 'O tormentorr of enemies, O hero, wearing matted locks and bark garments, living on fruits and roots, placing the responsibility of ruling the kingdom on your sandals and looking forward to your arrival, I shall reside outside the city for fourteen years.'
word_meanings: सः that Bharata, पादुके to the sandals, सम्प्रणम्य bowing down, रामम् to Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said, परन्तप O tormentor of enemies, वीर O hero, रघुनन्दन Rama, अहम् I, चतुर्दश वर्षाणि fourteen years, जटाचीरधरः wearing matted locks and bark garments, फलमूलाशनः living on fruits and roots, तव your, पादुकयोः on your sandals, न्यस्तराज्यतन्त्रः placing the responsibility of ruling this kingdom, तव your, आगमनम् arrival, आकाङ्क्षन् looking forward, नगरात् from the city, बहिः outside, वसन् residing, भवेयम् I shall remain.

text: तव पादुकयोर्न्यस्तराज्यतन्त्र: परन्तप । चतुर्दशे हि सम्पूर्णे वर्षे ऽहनि रघूत्तम । न द्रक्ष्यामि यदि त्वां तु प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम् ॥२-११२-२५॥
translation: O best of the Raghus, if I do not behold you on the day after completion of fourteen years I shall enter the blazing fire.
word_meanings: रघूत्तम O best of the Raghus, चतुर्दशे when fourteen, वर्षे years, संपूर्णे have passed, अहनि on that day, त्वाम् you, न द्रक्ष्यामि यदि if I do not behold, हुताशनम् blazing fire, प्रवेक्ष्यामि I shall enter.

text: तथेति च प्रतिज्ञाय तं परिष्वज्य सादरम् । शत्रुघ्नं च परिष्वज्य भरतं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥२-११२-२६॥
translation: 'Be it so', assured Rama and then affectionately embracing both Bharata and Satrughna, said to Bharata:
word_meanings: तथेति be it so, प्रतिज्ञाय having promised, तम् to that Bharata, सादरम् affectionately, परिष्वज्य having embraced, शत्रुघ्नम् Satrughna, परिष्वज्य having embraced, भरतं च also Bharata, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: मातरं रक्ष कैकेयीं मा रोषं कुरु तां प्रति । मया च सीतया चैव शप्तो ऽसि रघुसत्तम ॥२-११२-२७॥
translation: Look after your mother, O chief of the Raghus Do not be angry with her. Swear in my name and in the name of Sita. So saying, eyes filled with tears, Rama took leave of his brother.
word_meanings: रघुसत्तम O chief of the Raghus, मातरम् mother, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, रक्ष protect, तां प्रति to her, रोषम् anger, मा कुरु do not show, मया च by me, सीतया चैव on Sita, शप्तः असि are being sworn, इति like this, उक्त्वा having said, अश्रुपरीताक्षः with the eyes filled with tears, भ्रातरम् brother, विससर्ज ह took leave of.

text: इत्युक्त्वा ऽश्रुपरीताक्षो भ्रातरं विससर्ज ऺह ॥२-११२-२८॥
translation: Look after your mother, O chief of the Raghus Do not be angry with her. Swear in my name and in the name of Sita. So saying, eyes filled with tears, Rama took leave of his brother.
word_meanings: रघुसत्तम O chief of the Raghus, मातरम् mother, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, रक्ष protect, तां प्रति to her, रोषम् anger, मा कुरु do not show, मया च by me, सीतया चैव on Sita, शप्तः असि are being sworn, इति like this, उक्त्वा having said, अश्रुपरीताक्षः with the eyes filled with tears, भ्रातरम् brother, विससर्ज ह took leave of.

text: स पादुके ते भरत: प्रतापवान् स्वलङ्कृते सम्परिपूज्य धर्मवित् । प्रदक्षिणं चैव चकार राघवं चकार चैवोत्तमनागमूर्द्धनि ॥२-११२-२९॥
translation: The valiant and righteous Bharata, worshipped the welldecorated sandals and after circumambulating Rama reverentially placed them atop the best of elephants.
word_meanings: प्रतापवान् the valiant, धर्मवित् knower of righteousness, सः भरतः that Bharata, स्वलङ्कृते welldecorated, ते those, पादुके sandals, सम्परिपूज्य having worshipped, राघवम् to Rama, प्रदक्षिणम् circumambulation, चकार performed, ते those sandals, उत्तमनागमूर्धनि atop the best of elephants, चकार made.

text: अथानुपूर्व्यात् प्रतिनन्द्य तं जनं गुरूंश्च मन्त्रिप्रकृतीस्तथानुजौ । व्यसर्जयद्राघववंशवर्द्धन: स्थिर: स्वधर्मे हिमवानिवाचल: ॥२-११२-३०॥
translation: Inflexibly fixed in his own code of righteouness, like the Himavat mountain, Rama, the enhancer of the progeny of the Raghu dynasty, paid respect due to the preceptors, ministers and subjects in accordance with their rank, blessed his younger brothers, Bharata and Satrughna and sent them forth.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, राघववंशवर्धनः one who enhances the progeny of the Raghu dynasty, स्वधर्मे in his code of righteousness, हिमवान् Himavat, अचलः इव like the unshakable mountain, स्थिरः firm, तं जनम् those people, अनुपूर्व्या in accordance with their rank, प्रतिनन्द्य having greeted, गुरूंश्च to preceptors, मन्त्रिप्रकृतीः ministers and subjects, तथा like that, अनुजौ wishing his younger brothers Bharata and Satrughna, व्यसर्जयत् sent them forth.

text: तं मातरो बाष्पगृहीतकण्ठ्यो दु:खेन नामन्त्रयितुं हि शेकु: । स त्वेव मातऽरभिवाद्य सर्वा रुदन् कुटीं स्वां प्रविवेश राम: ॥२-११२-३१॥
translation: His mothers were unable to bid him farewell their throats were choked with tears of sorrow but Rama himself paid obeisance to them and entered his hut in tears. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वादशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundredtwelfth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: दुःखेन in their grief, बाष्पगृहीतकण्ठ्य throats choked with sobs, मातरः mothers, तम् to him, अमन्त्रयितुं to bid farewell, न शेकुर्हि were not able, सः that, राघवः एव Rama himself, सर्वाः all, मात़ृ़: mothers, अभिवाद्य paying obeisance, रुदन् weeping, स्वाम् his, कुटीं hut, प्रविवेश entered.

text: तत: शिरसि कृत्वा तु पादुके भरतस्तदा । आरुरोह रथं हृष्ट: शत्रुघ्नेन समन्वित: ॥२-११३-१॥
translation: Then Bharata accompanied by Satrughna, placing the sandals on his head in delight, boarded the chariot.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, तदा then, भरतः Bharata, पादुके sandals, शिरसि upon his head, कृत्वा having placed, हृष्टः in delight, शत्रुघ्नेन with Satrughna, समन्वितः accompanied by, रथम् chariot, आरुरोह boarded.

text: वसिष्ऺठो वामदेवश्च जाबालिश्च दृढव्रत: । अग्रत: प्रययु: सर्वे मन्त्रिणो मन्त्रपूजिता: ॥२-११३-२॥
translation: Vasishta, Vamadeva, Jabali of rigorous penance and all the ministers honoured for their counsel proceeded ahead.
word_meanings: वसिष्ठः Vasistha, वामदेवश्च Vamadeva, दृढव्रतः of rigid penance, जाबालिश्च Jabali, मन्त्रपूजिताः honoured for their counselling, सर्वे मन्त्रिणः all the ministers, अग्रतः in the forefront, प्रययुः proceeded.

text: मन्दाकिनीं नदीं रम्यां प्राङ्मुखास्ते ययुस्तदा । प्रदक्षिणं च कुर्वाणाश्चित्रकूटं महागिरिम् ॥२-११३-३॥
translation: All of them circumambulated the mighty mountain Chitrakuta and proceeded east towards the charming river Mandakini.
word_meanings: तदा then, ते they, चित्रकूटं महागिरिम् mighty mountain, Chitrakuta, प्रदक्षिणम् circumambulation, कुर्वाणाः doings, प्राङ्मुखाः facing eastward, मन्दाकिनीम् river Mandakini, रम्याम् charming, नदीम् to river, ययुः proceeded.

text: पश्यन् धातुसहस्राणि रम्याणि विविधानि च । प्रययौ तस्य पार्श्वेन ससैन्यो भरतस्तदा ॥२-११३-४॥
translation: Beholding a thousand varieties of beautiful minerals, Bharata with his army proceeded alongside the mountain.
word_meanings: तदा then, भरतः Bharata, रम्याणि beautiful, विविधानि various, धातुसहस्राणि a thousand varieties of minerals, पश्यन् beholding, ससैन्यः with army, तस्य that mountain's, पार्श्वे alongside, प्रययौ went.

text: अदूराच्चित्रकूटस्य ददर्श भरतस्तदा । आश्रमं यत्र स मुनिर्भरद्वाज: कृतालय: ॥२-११३-५॥
translation: Not far from Chitrakuta mountain, Bharata beheld a hermitage where sage Bharadwaja resided.
word_meanings: तदा then, भरतः Bharata, चित्रकूटस्य of Chitrakuta, अदूरात् not far from there, यत्र where, मुनिः sage, सः भरद्वाजः that Bharadwaja, कृतालयः made his residence, आश्रमम् hermitage, ददर्श beheld.

text: स तमाश्रममागम्य भरद्वाजस्य बुद्धिमान् । अवतीर्य रथात् पादौ ववन्दे भरतस्तदा ॥२-११३-६॥
translation: On approaching the hermitage of sage Bharadwaja, Bharata alighted from the chariot, and prostrated at his feet.
word_meanings: तदा then, बुद्धिमान् sagacious, सः भरतः that Bharata, भरद्वाजस्य Bharadwaja's, तम् आश्रमम् that hermitage, आगम्य having reached, रथात् from the chariot, अवितीर्य alighting, पादौ at his feet, ववन्दे prostrated.

text: ततो हृष्टो भरद्वाजो भरतं वाक्यमब्रवीत् । अपि कृत्यं कृतं तात रामेण च समागतम् ॥२-११३-७॥
translation: Then Bhardwaja asked Bharata in delight, My son, have you accomplished your task? Did you meet Rama?
word_meanings: ततः then, हृष्टः delighted, भरद्वाजः Bharadwaja, भरतम् to Bharata, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, तात O child, कृत्यम् the task, अपि कृतम् has it been accomplished?, रामेण च with Rama, अपि समागतम् have you met?

text: एवमुक्त: स तु ततो भरद्वाजेन धीमता । प्रत्युवाच भरद्वाजं भरतो भ्रातृवत्सल: ॥२-११३-८॥
translation: Having been thus addressed by wise Bharadwaja, Bharata, devoted to righteousness, replied:
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, धीमता by the wise, भरद्वाजेन by Bharadwaja, एवम् in this way, उक्तः having been addressed, धर्मवत्सलः devoted to righteousness, भरतः Bharata, भरद्वाजम् to Bharadwaja, प्रत्युवाच replied.

text: स याच्यमानो गुरुणा मया च दृढविक्रम: । राघव: परमप्रीतो वसिष्ठं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥२-११३-९॥
translation: Entreated by me and by preceptor (Vasistha), the highly pleased Rama with his firmness of mind replied to Vasistha:
word_meanings: गुरुणा by the preceptor (Vasistha), मया by me, याच्यमानः entreated, दृढविक्रमः of firmness of mind, राघवः Rama, परमप्रीतः highly pleased, वसिष्ठम् to Vasistha, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: पितु: प्रतिज्ञां तामेव पालयिष्यामि तत्त्वत: । चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि या प्रतिज्ञा पितुर्मम ॥२-११३-१०॥
translation: In sooth, I shall honour the words of promise given by my father and live in the forest for fourteen years, as promised.
word_meanings: चतुर्दश वर्षाणि हि fourteen years indeed, मम पितुः to my father, या प्रतिज्ञा that promise, पितुः of my father, तां प्रतिज्ञाम् एव that promise only, तत्त्वतः truly, पालयिष्यामि shall honour.

text: एवमुक्तो महाप्राज्ञो वसिष्ठ: प्रत्युवाच ह । वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकुशलं राघवं वचनं महत् ॥२-११३-११॥
translation: On hearing him, Vasistha a great intellectual and highly eloquent one replied to Rama, skilled in words of deep significance.
word_meanings: एवम् in this way, उक्तः spoken, महाप्राज्ञः great intellectual, वाक्यज्ञः eloquent, वसिष्ठः Vasistha, वाक्यकुशलम् skilled in words, राघवम् Rama, महत् of deep significance, वचनम् words, प्रत्युवाच ह replied.

text: एते प्रयच्छ संहृष्ट: पादुके हेमभूषिते । अयोध्यायां महाप्राज्ञ योगक्षेमकरे तव ॥२-११३-१२॥
translation: O extremely sagacious one, bestow with pleasure your sandals decked with gold for security and safety of Ayodhya.
word_meanings: महाप्राज्ञ O extemely sagacious one, संहृष्टः with pleasure, अयोध्यायाम् of Ayodhya, योगक्षेमकरे securing safety and security, एते these two, हेमभूषिते decorated with gold, तव पादुके your pair of sandals, प्रयच्छ bestow.

text: एवमुक्तो वसिष्ठेन राघव: प्राङ्मुख: स्थित: । पादुके अधिरुह्यैते मम राज्याय वै ददौ ॥२-११३-१३॥
translation: Thus addressed by Vasistha, Rama stood facing eastward wearing these sandals. and bestowed them on me for the sake of ruling the kingdom.
word_meanings: वसिष्ठेन by Vasistha, एवम् in this way, उक्तः having spoken, राघवः Rama, प्राङ्मुखः स्थितः standing eastward, एते these, पादुके sandals, अधिरुह्य wearing, मम to me, राज्याय for the sake of ruling the kingdom, ददौ bestowed.

text: निवृत्तो ऽहमनुज्ञातो रामेण सुमहात्मना । अयोध्यामेव गच्छामि गृहीत्वा पादुके शुभे ॥२-११३-१४॥
translation: I am now returning to Ayodhya with these auspicious sandals permitted by the magnanimous Rama.
word_meanings: सुमहात्मना by the highly magnanimous, रामेण by Rama, अनुज्ञातः having been permitted, अहम् I, निवृत्तः am returning, शुभे auspicious, पादुके sandals, गृहीत्वा taking, अयोध्यामेव to Ayodhya only, गच्छामि am going.

text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं भरतस्य महात्मन: । भरद्वाज: शुभतरं मुनिर्वाक्यमुवाच तम् ॥२-११३-१५॥
translation: Hearing the auspicious words of the magnanimous Bharata, sage Bharadwaja said to him in words still more auspicious.
word_meanings: महात्मनः of the magnanimous, भरतस्य Bharata's, शुभम् auspicious, एतत् all these, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, भरद्वाज: Bharadwaja, मुनिः sage, शुभतरम् the more auspicious, वाक्यम् words, तम् addressing Bharata, उवाच said.

text: नैतच्चित्रं नरव्याघ्र शीलवृत्तवतां वर । यदार्यं त्वयि तिष्ठेत्तु निम्ने सृष्टमिवोदकम् ॥२-११३-१६॥
translation: O best of men, foremost among men of excellent character and dispositon, it is not surprising that all noble qualities come to reside in you naturally like water poured flowing downward.
word_meanings: नरव्याघ्र O best of men, शीलवृत्तवताम् among men of excellent character and dispositon, वर foremost, सृष्टम् poured out, उदकम् water, निम्ने इव like downward, आर्यम् noble, त्वयि in you, यत् तिष्ठेत् reside, एतत् that one, चित्रम् surprising, न not.

text: अमृत: स महाबाहु: पिता दशरथस्तव । यस्य त्वमीदृश: पुत्रो धर्मज्ञो धर्मवत्सल: ॥२-११३-१७॥
translation: With you as his son, endowed with qualities of righteousness and devotion to duty, your mightyarmed father Dasaratha is not dead. (He lives through you).
word_meanings: यस्य of whom, धर्मज्ञः knower of righteousness, धर्मवत्सलः one who is devoted to duty, ईदृशः endowed with such qualties, त्वम् you, पुत्रः as son, सः such, महाबाहुः mightyarmed man, तव your, पिता father, दशरथः Dasaratha, अमृतः is not dead.

text: तमृषिं तु महात्मानमुक्तवाक्यं कृताञ्जलि: । आमतन्त्रयितुमारेभे चरणावुपगृह्य च ॥२-११३-१८॥
translation: Hearing the words of the magnanimous Bharadwaja, Bharata paid his respect, folding his palms, and clasping the feet of the sage and sought his permission to leave.
word_meanings: कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, उक्तवाक्यम् having spoken thus, महात्मानम् magnanimous one, तं ऋषिम् that sage, चरणौ feet, उपगृह्य clasping, आमन्त्रयितुम् to take leave of, आरेभे he commenced.

text: तत: प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा भरद्वाजं पुन:पुन: । भरतस्तु ययौ श्रीमानयोध्यां सह मन्त्रिभि: ॥२-११३-१९॥
translation: Then illustrious Bharata circumambulated the sage several times in homage before he set out for Ayodhya with his counsellors.
word_meanings: ततः then, श्रीमान् the illustrious, भरतः Bharata, पुन पुनः again and again, भरद्वाजम् to Bharadwaja, प्रदक्षिणम् circumambulation, कृत्वा having done, मन्त्रिभिस्सह along with the counsellors, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, ययौ set out.

text: यानैश्च शकटैश्चैव हयैर्नागैश्च सा चमू: । पुनर्निवृत्ता विस्तीर्णा भरतस्यानुयायिनी ॥२-११३-२०॥
translation: The vast army of Bharata with all its carriages, carts, horses and elephants following him again turned back towards Ayodhya.
word_meanings: भरतस्य Bharata's, विस्तीर्णा vast, सा चमूः that army, अनुयायिनी following, यानैश्च with carriages, शकटैश्चैव with carts, हयैः with horses, नागैश्च with elephants, पुनः again, निवृत्ता turned back towards Ayodhya.

text: ततस्ते यमुनां दिव्यां नदीं तीर्त्वोर्मिमालिनीम् । ददृशुस्तां पुन: सर्वे गङ्गां शुभजलां नदीम् ॥२-११३-२१॥
translation: Thereafter, all of them crossed the divine river Yamuna wreathed in waves and, beheld the Ganga of sacred waters once again.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, ते सर्वे all of them, दिव्याम् divine, ऊर्मिमालिनीम् wreathed with waves, यमुनां नदीम् river Yamuna, तीर्त्वा having crossed, शुभजलाम् of auspicious waters of, तां गङ्गां that Ganga, नदीम् river, पुनः again, ददृशुः beheld.

text: तां रम्यजलसम्पूर्णां सन्तीर्य सहबान्धव: । शृङ्गिबेरपुरं रम्यं प्रविवेश ससैनिक: ॥२-११३-२२॥
शृङ्गिबेरपुराद्भूयस्त्वयोध्यां संददर्श ह ॥२-११३-२३॥
translation: Bharata along with his kins and his army crossed the Ganga with its overflowing, wonderful waters and entered the beautiful city of Sringiberapura and from there he proceeded until he beheld the city of Ayodhya.
word_meanings: रम्यजलसंपूर्णाम् overflowing with wonderful waters, ताम् to Ganga , सहबान्धवः with relations, सन्तीर्य having crossed, ससैनिकः with army, रम्यम् beautiful, शृङ्गिबेरपुरम् Sringiberapura, प्रविवेश entered, शृङ्गिबेरपुरात् from Sringiberapura, भूयः again, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, सन्ददर्श ह beheld.

text: अयोध्यां च ततो दृष्ट्वा पित्रा भ्रात्रा विवर्जिताम् । भरतो दु:खसन्तप्त: सारथिं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥२-११३-२४॥
translation: On seeing the city of Ayodhya bereft of his father and brothers, Bharata, consumed with grief, said to the charioteer:
word_meanings: ततः then, भरतः Bharata, पित्रा by father, भ्रात्रा by brothers, विवर्जिताम् deserted, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, दुःख सन्तप्तः consumed with grief, सारथिम् to the charioteer, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: सारथे पश्य विध्वस्ता सायोध्या न प्रकाशते । निराकारा निरानन्दा दीना प्रतिहतस्वरा ॥२-११३-२५॥
translation: O charioteer, look, Ayodhya is in shapeless shambles. It is silent and cheerless. It is dull and desolate. It shines no more. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रयोदशोरशततमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the hundredthirteenth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सारथे O charioteer, विध्वस्ता ruined, सा आयोध्या that Ayodhya, निराकारा formless, निरानन्दा cheerless, दीना desolate, प्रतिहतस्वरा silent, न प्रकाशते does not shine, पश्य see.

text: स्त्रिग्धगम्भीरघोषेण स्यन्दनेनोपयान् प्रभु: । अयोध्यां भरत: क्षिप्रं प्रविवेश महायशा: ॥२-११४-१॥
translation: Bharata, the renowned lord (of Ayodhya) travelled on the chariot that produced a deep, soothing, sound. And entered Ayodhya soon.
word_meanings: महायशः renowned, प्रभुः lord, भरतः Bharata, स्निग्धगम्भीरघोषेण with its deep, soothing sound, स्यन्दनेन by the chariot, उपयान् while travelling, क्षिप्रम् soon, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, प्रविवेश entered.

text: बिडालोलूकचरितामालीननरवारणाम् । तिमिराभ्याहतां कालीमप्रकाशां निशामिव ॥२-११४-२॥
translation: Ayodhya was like a dark, lightless night enveloped in gloom, ranged by cats and owls, its people and elephants out of sight.
word_meanings: बिडालोलूकचरिताम् ranged by cats and owls, आलीननरवारणाम् where people and elephants were out of sight, तिमीराभ्याहताम् enveloped in darkness, अप्रकाशाम् without light, कालीम् black, निशामिव like night.

text: राहुशत्रो: प्रियां पत्नीं श्रिया प्रज्वलितप्रभाम् । ग्रहेणाभ्युत्थिते नैकां रोहिणीमिव पीडिताम् ॥२-११४-३॥
translation: (The city looked) like Rohini, the beloved consort of the Moon, the star which was majesticlly radiating flaming brilliance and now, tormented by the exalted Rahu which has eclipsed the Moon, shines alone.
word_meanings: श्रिया with majesty, प्रज्वलितप्रभाम् radiating with lustre, अभ्युत्थितेन exalted, ग्रहेन by cruel planet, पीडिताम् tormented, राहुशत्रोः enemy of Rahu, (the Moon's), प्रियाम् beloved, पत्नीम् to wife, एकाम् alone, रोहिणीमिव like the star Rohini.

text: अल्पोष्णक्षुब्धसलिलां धर्मोत्तप्तविहङ्गमाम् । लीनमीनझषग्राहां कृशां गिरिनदीमिव ॥२-११४-४॥
translation: (It appeared) like a lean mountainstream with scant, hot and turbid waters, with scorched aquatic birds and with small and large fishes and crocodiles dead due to the heat of the Sun.
word_meanings: अल्पोष्णक्षुब्धसलिलां with scant, hot and turbid waters, घर्मोत्तप्तविहङ्गमाम् the aquatic birds scorched by the Sun's heat, लीनमीनझषग्राहाम् small fish, large fish and crocodiles perished, कृशाम् dried up, गिरिनदीमिव like a mountainstream.

text: विधूमामिव हेमाभामध्वराग्ने: समुत्थिताम् । हविरभ्युक्षितां पश्चात् शिखां विप्रलयं गताम् ॥२-११४-५॥
translation: It was like the flame of a sacrificial fire, smokeless and golden as it rises, that dies down after the oblation of clarified butter has been sprinkled.
word_meanings: विधूमाम् smokeless, हेमाभाम् with the splendour of gold, समुत्थिताम् rising, पश्चात् later on, हविरभ्युक्षिताम् sprinkled with sacrificial offering of clarified butter, विप्रलयम् extinction, गताम् obtained, अध्वराग्नेः sacrificial fire's, शिखामिव like flames.

text: विध्वस्तकवचां रुग्णजवाजिरथध्वजाम् । हतप्रवीरामापन्नां चमूमिव महाहवे ॥२-११४-६॥
translation: warriors slain in the great battle (the city appeared desolate).
word_meanings: महाहवे in a great battle, विध्वस्तकवचाम् armours scattered, रुग्णगजवाजिरथध्वजाम् injured elephants, horses and shattered chariots and banners standards, हतप्रवीराम् with heroic warriors slain, आपन्नाम् in great distress, चमूमिव like the army.

text: सफेना सस्वना भूत्वा सागरस्य समुत्थिताम् । प्रशान्तमारुतोद्घातां जलोर्मिमिव निस्वनाम् ॥२-११४-७॥
translation: It was like an ocean wave that had risen foaming and roaring but, swept by a gentle breeze, had fallen silent.
word_meanings: सफेनाम् filled with foam, सस्वनाम् भूत्वा with roaring sounds, समुत्थिताम् risen, प्रशान्तमारुतोद्धूताम् swept by the gentle breeze, निस्स्वनाम् silent, सागरस्य ocean's, जलोर्मिमिव like a wave.

text: त्यक्तां यज्ञायुधै: सर्वैरभिरूपैश्च याजकै: । सुत्याकाले विनिर्वृत्ते वेदिं गतरवामिव ॥२-११४-८॥
translation: It was like a sacrificial altar deserted by all its appliances and learned priests, fallen silent once the time of the Soma extraction had ended.
word_meanings: सर्वैः all, यज्ञायुधैः with sacrificial appliances, अभिरूपैः learned, याजकैः with priests, सुत्याकाले the time of extraction of Soma juice, विनिर्वृते has come to an end, त्यक्ताम् deserted, गतरवाम् sounds ceased, वेदिम् इव like an altar.

text: गोष्ठमध्ये स्थितामार्त्तामचरन्तीं तृणं नवम् । गोवृषेण परित्यक्तां गवां पत्तिमिवोत्सुकाम् ॥२-११४-९॥
translation: the midst of the herd despairs and no longer grazes the new grass.
word_meanings: गोवृषेण by a bull, परित्यक्ताम् forsaken, उत्सुकाम् longing (for the bull), गवाम् of cows, गोष्ठमध्ये in the midst of the herd, स्थिताम् standing, आर्ताम् despaired, नवं new, तृणम् grass, अचरन्तीं no longer grazing, पक्तिमिव like a cow.

text: प्रभाकराद्यै: सुस्निग्धै: प्रज्वलद्भिरिवोत्तमै: । वियुक्तां मणिभिर्जात्यैर्नवां मुक्तावलीमिव ॥२-११४-१०॥
translation: It was like a new pearl necklace from which the finest, glossy, radiant gems and rubies had been detached.
word_meanings: सुस्निग्धै: by the most glossy, प्रज्वलद्भिरिव by the radiant, उत्तमैः by the excellent ones, जात्यैः by those of the finest class, प्रभाकराद्यैः rubies and other gems, मणिभिः with precious stones, वियुक्ताम् detached, नवाम् new, मुक्तावलीमिव like a pearl necklace.

text: सहसा चलितां स्थानान्महीं पुण्यक्षयाद्गताम् । संहृतद्युतिविस्तारां तारामिव दिवश्च्युताम् ॥२-११४-११॥
translation: It was like a star, its spreading radiance dimmed, suddenly dislodged from its place and fallen from heaven to earth when its store of merit is exhausted.
word_meanings: पुण्यक्षयात् due to exhaustion of merit, स्थानात् from its place, सहसा suddenly, महीम् the earth, गताम् reached, संवृतद्युतिविस्ताराम् with its extensive lustre dimmed, दिवः from the earth, च्युताम् fallen, तारामिव like a star.

text: पुष्पनद्धां वसन्तान्ते मत्तभ्रमरनादिताम् । द्रुतदावाग्निविप्लुष्टां क्लान्तां वनलतामिव ॥२-११४-१२॥
translation: with the melodious humming of intoxicated bees and suddenly shrivelling, ravaged by the fastspreading forest fire.
word_meanings: वसन्तान्ते at the end of spring, द्रुतदावाग्नि विप्लुष्टाम् ravaged by the fastspreading forest fire, पुष्पनद्धाम् laden with flowers, मत्तभ्रमरनादिताम् with the melodious hum of intoxicated bees, क्लान्ताम् withered away, वनलतामिव like a woodland creeper.

text: सम्मूढनिगमां स्तब्धां संक्षिप्तविपणापणाम् । प्रच्छन्नशऺशिनक्षत्रां द्यामिवाम्बुधरैर्वृताम् ॥२-११४-१३॥
translation: Ayodhya with its markets and shops closed, and its merchants in a daze looked like the sky covered with clouds obscuring the Moon and stars.
word_meanings: सम्मूढनिगमाम् dazed merchants, स्तब्धाम् stilled, संक्षिप्तविपणापणाम् with markets and shops closed, अम्बुधरैः with clouds, वृताम् covered, प्रच्छन्नशशिनक्षत्राम् obscuring the moon and stars, द्यामिव like the sky.

text: क्षीणपानोत्तमैर्भिन्नै: शरावैरभिसंवृताम् । हतशौण्डामिवाकाशे पानभूमिमसंस्कृताम् ॥२-११४-१४॥
translation: (Ayodhya looked) like an uncleansed drinking place with broken pitchers emptied of excellent wine scattered around and with drunkards lying dead in the open.
word_meanings: आकाशे lying in the open, क्षीणपानोत्तमैः with excellent wine exhausted, भग्नैः by the broken, शरावैः by pitchers, अभिसंवृताम् surrounded by, हताशौण्डाम् with drunkards dead, ध्वस्ताम् scattered, असंस्कृताम् uncleansed, पानभूमि इव like a drinking place.

text: वृक्णभूमितलां निम्नां वृक्णपात्रै: समावृताम् । उपयुक्तोदकां भग्नां प्रपां निपतितामिव ॥२-११४-१५॥
translation: (Ayodhya appeared) like a ruined well, its foundations broken and sunken into the earth, its water used up, with broken pots scattered around, its riven surface forming a dale.
word_meanings: वृक्णभूमितलाम् surface riven, वृक्णपात्रैः with broken pots, समावृताम् scattered around, निम्नाम् like a dale, उपयुक्तोदकाम् water used up, भग्नाम् broken, निपतिताम् sunken, प्रपामिव like a well.

text: विपुलां विततां चैव युक्तपाशां तरस्विनाम् । भूमौ बाणैर्विनिष्कृत्तां पतितां ज्यामिवायुधात् ॥२-११४-१६॥
translation: It was like a powerful man's bowstring, broad and stretched taut with its loops, severed by arrows and fallen from the weapon to the ground.
word_meanings: विपुलाम् extensive, वितताम् stretched, युक्तपाशाम् attached with nooses, तरस्विनाम् of a powerful man, बाणैः with arrows, विनिष्कृत्ताम् severed, आयुधात् from the weapon, भूमौ on the ground, पतिताम् fallen, ज्यामिव like a bowstring.

text: सहसा युद्धशौण्डेन हयारोहेण वाहिताम् । निक्षिप्तभाण्डामुत्सृष्टां किशोरीमिव दुर्बलाम् ॥२-११४-१७॥
शुष्कतोयां महामत्स्यै: कूर्मैश्च बहुभिर्वृताम् । प्रभिन्नतटविस्तीर्णां वापीमिव हृतोत्पलाम् ॥२-११४-१८॥
translation: It was like a reservoir with its water dried up, filled with great fish and tortoises, its broad banks split and its lotuses withered.
word_meanings: शुष्कतोयाम् water dried up, बहुभिः a lot of, महामत्सैः with large fishes, कूर्मैश्च with tortoises, वृताम् filled, प्रभिन्नतटविस्तीर्णाम् vast area around the bank split, हृतोत्पलाम् waterlilies withered, वापीमिव like a circular reservoir of water.

text: पुरुषस्याप्रहृष्टस्य प्रतिषिद्धानुलेपनाम् । सन्तप्तामिव शोकेन गात्रयष्टिमभूषणाम् ॥२-११४-१९॥
translation: It was like the skeletal frame of a dejected man, scorched with grief, denied unguents and stripped of ornaments.
word_meanings: प्रतिषिद्धानुलेपनां with no oil massaged (on the body), शोकेन with grief, सन्तप्ताम् scorched, अभूषणाम् without ornaments, अप्रहृष्टस्य in dejection, पुरुषस्य man's, गात्रयष्टिमिव body like a stick (skeletal).

text: प्रावृषि प्रविगाढायां प्रविष्टस्याभ्रमण्डलम् । प्रच्छन्नां नीलजीमूतैर्भास्करस्य प्रभामिव ॥२-११४-२०॥
translation: It was like the radiance of the sun obscured by black clouds when it has entered the mass of clouds in the depth of the rainy season.
word_meanings: प्रविगाढायाम् deep, पावृषि in the rainy season, अभ्रमण्डलम् orb of clouds, प्रविष्टस्य entered, भास्करस्य the Sun's, नीलजीमूतैः by black clouds, प्रच्छन्नाम् obscured, प्रभामिव like the radiance.

text: भरतस्तु रथस्थ: सन् श्रीमान् दशरथात्मज: । वाहयन्तं रथश्रेष्ठं सारथिं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥२-११४-२१॥
translation: Illustrious Bharata, son of Dasaratha, seated in his chariot, addressed the charioteer as he drove the most excellent of chariots saying:
word_meanings: श्रीमान् illustrious, दशरथात्मजः son of Dasaratha, भरतस्तु Bharata, रथस्थस्सन् seated in the chariot, रथश्रेष्ठम् the most excellent of chariots, वाहयन्तम् driving, सारथिम् to the charioteer, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: किं नु खल्वद्य गम्भीरो मूर्च्छितो न निशम्यते । यथापुरमयोध्यायां गीतवादित्रनिस्वन: ॥२-११४-२२॥
translation: How is it that in Ayodhya, the deep and allpervasive songs and sounds of musical instruments of the former days are not heard now?
word_meanings: अयोध्यायाम् In Ayodhya, अद्य now, यथापुरम् as in the past, गम्भीरः deep, मूर्छितः allpervasive, गीतवादित्रनिस्वनः songs and sounds of musical instruments, न निशम्यते are not heard, किं नु खलु what could be the reason?

text: वारुणीमदगन्धश्च माल्यगन्धश्च मूर्च्छित: । धूपितागरुगन्धश्च न प्रवाति समन्तत: ॥२-११४-२३॥
translation: The breeze no longer carries the intoxicating odour of spirituous liquor, the pervading fragrance of flower garlands and agaru (incense).
word_meanings: वारुणीमदगन्धश्च the intoxicating odour of spirituous liquor, माल्यगन्धश्च the fragrance of flower garlands, धूपितागरुगन्धश्च the fragrance of agaru or incense, समन्ततः everywhere, मूर्छितः pervading, न प्रवाति does not blow.

text: यानप्रवरघोषश्च स्निग्धश्च हयनिस्वन: । प्रमत्तगजनादश्च महांश्च रथनिस्वन: । नेदानीं श्रूयते पुर्यामस्यां रामे विवासिते ॥२-११४-२४॥
translation: After Rama's the exile the clatter of excellent carriages, the pleasing neighing of horses and trumpeting of elephants in rut and the rattle of chariots are no longer heard now.
word_meanings: रामे Rama, विवासिते having been exiled, इदानीम् now, अस्यां पुर्याम् in this city, यानप्रवरघोषश्च clatter of excellent carriages, स्निग्धः pleasant, हयनिस्वनश्च neighing of horses, प्रमत्तगजनादश्च trumpeting of elephants in rut, महान् great, रथनिस्वनः च rattle of chariots, न श्रूयते are not heard.

text: चन्दनागरुगन्धांश्च महार्हाश्च नवस्रज: । गते हि रामे तरुणा: सन्तप्ता नोपभुञ्जते ॥२-११४-२५॥
translation: Since Rama has departed, the young men in distress do not enjoy expensive incense of agaru and sandalwood paste and garlands of fresh flowers.
word_meanings: रामे Rama, गते having departed, तरुणाः the young men, संतप्ताः distressed, चन्दनागरुगन्धांश्च incense of agaru and sandalwood paste, महार्हा: expensive, नवस्रजश्च garlands of fresh flowers, नोपभुञ्जते do not enjoy.

text: बहिर्यात्रां न गच्छन्ति चित्रमाल्यधरा नरा: । नोत्सवा: सम्प्रवर्त्तन्ते रामशोकार्दिते पुरे ॥२-११४-२६॥
translation: This city is stricken with grief on account of Rama's departure. Men do not go out on pleasure jaunts wearing garlands of variegated flowers. Festivities are not celebrated.
word_meanings: रामशोकार्दिते stricken with grief on account of separation from Rama, पुरे in the city, नराः men, चित्रमाल्यधराः wearing garlands of variegated flowers, बहिः outside, यात्राम् pleasure jaunts, न गच्छन्ति do not go, उत्सवाः festivites, न सम्प्रवर्तन्ते are not celebrated.

text: सह नूनं मम भ्रात्रा पुरस्यास्यद्युतिर्गता । नहि राजत्ययोध्येयं सासारेवार्जुनी क्षपा ॥२-११४-२७॥
translation: Certainly splendour has left along with my brother. Like the night when the rain pours down during the waning of the Moon, Ayodhya shines not.
word_meanings: अस्य पुरस्य of this city, द्युतिः splendour, मम my, भ्रात्रा सह along with brother, गता had left, नूनम् certainly, इयम् this, अयोध्या Ayodhya, सासारा with rain pouring down, अर्जुनी relating to the waning Moon, क्षपा इव like night, न राजति हि does not gleam.

text: कदा नु खलु मे भ्राता महोत्सव इवागत: । जनयिष्यत्ययोध्यायां हर्षं ग्रीष्म इवाम्बुद: ॥२-११४-२८॥
translation: When will my brother return to Ayodhya like a carnival and cause delight to every one like summer clouds?
word_meanings: मे भ्राता my brother, महोत्सव इव like a carnival, आगतः having returned, ग्रीष्मे in summer, अम्बुदः इव like clouds, अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, हर्षम् delight, कदा when, जनयिष्यति नु खलु will cause.

text: तरुणैश्चारुवेषैश्च नरैरुन्नतगामिभि: । सम्पतद्भिरयोध्यायां नाभिभान्ति महापथा: ॥२-११४-२९॥
translation: The highways of Ayodhya thronged with groups of elegantly attired young men or adults with their majestic gait, do not shine.
word_meanings: अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, महापथाः highways, चारुवेषैः by those elegantly attired, उन्नतगामिभिः with their majestic gait, सम्पतद्भिः by those coming together in groups, तरुणैः young men, नरैः men, नाभिभान्ति is not shining.

text: एवं बहुविधं जल्पन् विवेश वसतिं पितु: । तेन हीनां नरेन्द्रेण सिंहहीनां गुहामिव ॥२-११४-३०॥
translation: Thus mourning in several ways, Bharata entered his fathers' palace (now) bereft of the king like a cave without the lion.
word_meanings: एवम् thus, बहुविधम् in several ways, जल्पन् talking, तेन by that, नरेन्द्रेण by the king, हीनाम् bereft of, सिंहहीनाम् without a lion, गुहामिव like a cave, पितुः father's, वसतिम् residence, विवेश entered.

text: तदा तदन्त:पुरमुज्झितप्रभं सुरैरिवोत्सृष्टमभास्करं दिनम् । निरीक्ष्य सर्वन्तु विविक्तमात्मवान् मुमोच बाष्पं भरत: सुदु:खित: ॥२-११४-३१॥
ततो निक्षिप्य मातऽ: स अयोध्यायां दृढव्रत: । भरत: शोकसन्तप्तो गुरूनिदमथाब्रवीत् ॥२-११५-१॥
translation: After keeping his mothers in Ayodhya, the griefstricken Bharata who was firm in his vows, said to the elders:
word_meanings: दृढव्रतः firm in his vows, सः भरतः that Bharata, ततः thereafter, मातृ़ mothers, अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, निक्षिप्य having kept, शोकसन्तप्तः striken with grief, गुरून् to the elders, अथ thereafter, अब्रवीत् said.

text: नन्दिग्रामं गमिष्यामि सर्वानामन्त्रये ऽद्य व: । तत्र दु:खमिदं सर्वं सहिष्ये राघवं विना ॥२-११५-२॥
translation: I take leave of all of you. I am going to Nandigrama where I shall keep company with grief on account of Rama's absence.
word_meanings: अद्य now, नन्दिग्रामम् to Nandigrama, गमिष्यामि I am going, वः you, सर्वान् all, आमन्त्रये seeking leave of, तत्र there, राघवं विना without Rama, इदम् this, सर्वम् all, दुःखम् grief, सहिष्ये I will endure.

text: गतश्च हि दिवं राजा वनस्थश्च गुरुर्मम । रामं प्रतीक्षे राज्याय स हि राजा महायशा: ॥२-११५-३॥
translation: King Dasaratha has gone to heaven. My elder brother and guru is in the forest. I shall await his return for ruling the kingdom since he alone is the illustrious king of Ayodhya.
word_meanings: राजा the king, दिवम् to heaven, गतः has gone, मम गुरुः my brother, वनस्थः is in the forest, राज्याय for the kingdom, रामम् for Rama, प्रतीक्षे I am awaiting, महायशाः the illustrious one, सः he, राजा हि alone is the king.

text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं भरतस्य महात्मन: । अब्रुवन् मन्त्रिण: सर्वे वसिष्ठश्च पुरोहित: ॥२-११५-४॥
translation: Hearing the auspicious words of the magnanimous Bharata the counsellors, priests including Vasistha replied:
word_meanings: महात्मनः of the great soul, भरतस्य Bharata's, शुभम् auspicious, एतत् these, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, सर्वे all, मन्त्रिणः counsellors, पुरोहितः the priest, वसिष्ठश्च also, अब्रुवन् spoke.

text: सुभृशं श्लाघनीयं च यदुक्तं भरत त्वया । वचनं भ्रातृवात्सल्यादनुरूपं तवैव तत् ॥२-११५-५॥
translation: O Bharata, the words you have uttered out of devotion to your brother which befit you alone are highly praiseworthy.
word_meanings: भरतः O Bharata, त्वया by you, भ्रातृवात्सल्यात् out of devotion towards your brother, यत् वचनम् the words, उक्तम् uttered, सुभृशम् highly, श्लाघनीयं praiseworthy, तत् that one, तवैव you alone, अनुरूपम् befits.

text: नित्यं ते बन्धुलुब्धस्य तिष्ठतो भ्रातृसौहृदे । आर्यमार्गं प्रपन्नस्य नानुमन्येत क: पुमान् ॥२-११५-६॥
translation: You are always attached to your relations, firmly established in the welfare of your brothers and are pursuing a noble path. Who would not approve of this?
word_meanings: बन्धुलुब्धस्य attached to your relations, नित्यम् always, भ्रातृसौहृदे in the welfare of your brothers, तिष्ठतः established, आर्यमार्गम् noble path, प्रपन्नस्य following, ते to you, कः पुमान् which man, नानुमन्येत would not approve?

text: मन्त्रिणां वचनं श्रुत्वा यथाभिलषितं प्रियम् । अब्रवीत्सारथिं वाक्यं रथो मे युज्यतामिति ॥२-११५-७॥
translation: On hearing the pleasing words of the counsellors which were in conformity with his desire, Bharata said to his charioteer, 'Harness my chariot'.
word_meanings: यथाभिलषितम् in accordance with his desire, प्रियम् agreeable, मन्त्रिणाम् counsellors', वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सारथिम् to the charioteer, मे रथः my chariot, युज्यताम् be harnessed, इति thus, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: प्रहृष्टवदन: सर्वा मातऽ: समभिवाद्य स: । आरुरोह रथं श्रीमान् शत्रुघ्नेन समन्वित: ॥२-११५-८॥
translation: With a cheerful countenance illustrious Bharata paid obeisance to all his mothers and, acompanied by Satrughna, ascended the chariot.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् illustrious, सः Bharata, प्रहृष्टवदनः with cheerful countenance, सर्वाः all, मातृ़ः mothers, समभिवाद्य paying obeisance, शत्रुघ्न with Satrughna, समन्वितः accompanied by, रथम् the chariot, आरुरोह ascended.

text: आरुह्य च रथं शीघ्रं शत्रुघ्नभरतावुभौ । ययतु: परमप्रीतौ वृतौ मन्त्रिपुरोहितै: ॥२-११५-९॥
translation: Highly pleased, Bharata and Satrughna ascended the chariot and, surrounded by counsellors and priests, set out speedily.
word_meanings: शत्रुघ्नभरतौ Satrughna and Bharata, उभौ both, शीघ्रम् speedily, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य च having ascended, परमप्रीतौ highly pleased, मन्त्रिपुरोहितैः with counsellors and priests, वृतौ surrounded by, ययतुः proceeded.

text: अग्रतो गुरवस्तत्र वसिष्ठप्रमुखा द्विजा: । प्रययु: प्राङ्मुखा: सर्वे नन्दिग्रामो यतो ऽभवत् ॥२-११५-१०॥
translation: Preceded by preceptors, like Vasistha and other brahmins, all of them proceeded eastward in the direction of Nandigrama.
word_meanings: तत्र there, गुरवः preceptors, वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः headed by Vasistha, सर्वे all, द्विजाः brahmins, प्राङ्मुखाः eastward, नन्दिग्रामः Nandigrama, यतः wherever, अभवत् existed, that side, अग्रतः ahead of, प्रययुः went.

text: बलं च तदनाहूतं गजाश्वरथसङ्कुलम् । प्रययौ भरते याते सर्वे च पुरवासिन: ॥२-११५-११॥
translation: When Bharata left, the army with hordes of elephants, horses and chariots and inhabitants of Ayodhya followed him unbidden.
word_meanings: भरते Bharata, याते having gone, तदनाहूतम् unbidden, गजाश्वरथसङ्कुलम् crowded with elephants, horses and chariots, बलं च army also, प्रययौ set off, सर्वे all, पुरवासिनः च also the inhabitants of Ayodhya.

text: रथस्थ: स हि धर्मात्मा भरतो भ्रातृवत्सल: । नन्दिग्रामं ययौ तूर्णं शिरस्याधाय पादुके ॥२-११५-१२॥
translation: Righteous Bharata who was deeply attached to his brother proceeded speedily towards Nandigrama on the chariot bearing the sandals of Rama on his head.
word_meanings: भ्रातृवत्सलः deeply attched to his brother, धर्मात्मा a righteous man, सः भरतः that Bharata, रथस्थः while riding on the chariot, पादुके sandals, शिरसि on head, आदाय bearing, तूर्णम् speedily, नन्दिग्रामम् Nandigrama, ययौ went.

text: ततस्तु भरत: क्षिप्रं नन्दिग्रामं प्रविश्य स: । अवतीर्य्य रथात्तूर्णं गुरूनिदमुवाच ह ॥२-११५-१३॥
translation: Bharata entered Nandigrama quickly, alighted from the chariot and then, addressing, the preceptors, said:
word_meanings: ततः then, सः भरतः that Bharata, क्षिप्रम् swiftly, नन्दिग्रामम् Nandigrama, प्रविश्य having entered, तूर्णम् at once, रथात् from the chariot, अवतीर्य having alighted, गुरून् to the preceptors, इदम् these words, उवाच ह spoke.

text: एतद्राज्यं मम भ्रात्रा दत्तं संन्यासवत् स्वयम् । योगक्षेमवहे चेमे पादुके हेमभूषिते ॥२-११५-१४॥
translation: My brother gave me this kingdom as a trust. He gave me the sandals decorated with gold for securing the prosperity and security (of the kingdom).
word_meanings: एतत् राज्यम् all this kingdom, भ्रात्रा by my brother, स्वयम् by himself, सन्नयासवत् like a trust, मम to me, दत्तम् given, योगक्षेमवहे prosperity and security, हेमभूषिते decorated with gold, इमे पादुके च these sandals also bestowed.

text: भरत: शिरसा कृत्वा संन्यासं पादुके तत: । अब्रवीद्दु:खसन्तप्त: सर्वं प्रकृतिमण्डलम् ॥२-११५-१५॥
translation: Then Bharata placed the sandals held in trust on his head and, overcome with grief, he addressed the concourse of subjects:
word_meanings: ततः then, भरतः Bharata, सन्न्यासम् held in trust, पादुके sandals, शिरसा on head, कृत्वा having placed, दुःखसंतप्तः overcome with grief, सर्वम् all, प्रकृतिमण्डलम् addressing the concourse of subjects, अब्रवीत् said.

text: छत्रं धारयत क्षिप्रमार्यपादाविमौ मतौ । आभ्यां राज्ये स्थितो धर्म: पादुकाभ्यां गुरोर्मम ॥२-११५-१६॥
translation: Hold the royal paresol now. This is the accepted symbol of the exalted feet of my brother. These sandals shall establish righteousness in the kingdom.
word_meanings: क्षिप्रम् at once, छत्रम् royal parasol, धारयत you may hold, इमौ these, आर्यपादौ as exalted feet of my brother, मतौ accepted, मम गुरोः my esteemed brother's, आभ्यां पादुकाभ्याम् with these sandals, राज्ये in the kingdom, धर्मः righteousness, स्थितः is established.

text: भ्रात्रा हि मयि संन्यासो निक्षिप्त: सौहृदादयम् । तमिमं पालयिष्यामि राघवागमनं प्रति ॥२-११५-१७॥
translation: This kingdom has been given me by my brother out of affection as a trust. I shall safeguard it until Rama's return.
word_meanings: भ्रात्रा by my brother Rama, अयम् this (kingdom), संन्यासः on trust, सौहृदात् out of affection, मयि in me, निक्षिप्तः has been deposited, तम् such, इमम् this trust, राघवागमनं प्रति till Rama returns, पालयिष्यामि I will rule.

text: क्षिप्रं संयोजयित्वा तु राघवस्य पुन: स्वयम् । चरणौ तौ तु रामस्य द्रक्ष्यामि सहपादुकौ ॥२-११५-१८॥
translation: 'I myself shall see soon Rama's feet reunited with these sandals.
word_meanings: क्षिप्रम् soon, पुनः again, राघवस्य of Rama, स्वयम् by myself, संयोजयित्वा reunited, सहपादुकौ with sandals, रामस्य Rama's, तौ चरणौ those feet, द्रक्ष्यामि shall behold.

text: ततो निक्षिप्तभारो ऽहं राघवेण समागत: । निवेद्य गुरवे राज्यं भजिष्ये गुरुवृत्तिताम् ॥२-११५-१९॥
translation: The burden of this kingdom has been cast on me. On reunion with Rama, I shall hand it over to my brother, my guru and shall be engaged in his service.
word_meanings: ततः then, निक्षिप्तभारः with the burden cast on me, अहम् I, राघवेण with Rama, समागतः reunited, राज्यम् kingdom, गुरवे to my guru (Rama), निवेद्य making over, गुरुवृत्तिताम् engaged in serving guru, भजिष्ये I shall obtain.

text: राघवाय च संन्यासं दत्त्वे मे वरपादुके । राज्यं चेदमयोध्यां च धूतपापो भवामि च ॥२-११५-२०॥
translation: Restoring the sacred sandals, the kingdom and this city of Ayodhya held as a trust by me, I shall be cleansed of the sin.
word_meanings: सन्यासम् this trust, इमे वरपादुके these sacred sandals, इदं राज्यं च and this kingdom, अयोध्यां च and Ayodhya, राघवाय to Rama, दत्त्वा having given back, धूतपापः cleansed of the sin, भवामि च I shall become.

text: अभिषिक्ते तु काकुत्स्थे प्रहृष्टमुदिते जने । प्रीतिर्मम यशश्चैव भवेद्राज्याच्चतुर्गुणम् ॥२-११५-२१॥
translation: After Rama is coronated and the people are delighted and pleased, the renown and pleasure for me will be fourfold (what is obtained from ruling the kingdom).
word_meanings: काकुस्त्थे Rama, अभिषिक्ते having been coronated, जने people, प्रहृष्टमुदिते having been delighted and pleased, मम to me, राज्यात् of the kingdom, चतुर्गुणम् four times, प्रीतिः joy, यशश्चैव and renown, भवेत् will be (greater than by ruling).

text: एवं तु विलपन् दीनो भरत: स महायशा: । नन्दिग्रामे ऽकरोद्राज्यं दु:खितो मन्त्रिभि: सह ॥२-११५-२२॥
translation: Thus lamenting in desolation and grief, the illustrious Bharata lived in Nandigrama along with his counsellors and started ruling the kingdom.
word_meanings: महायशाः illustrious, सः भरतः that Bharata, दीनः lonely, एवम् in this way, विलपन् lamenting, दुःखितः in grief, मन्त्रिभिस्सह along with the counsellors, नन्दिग्रामे from Nandigrama, राज्यम् kingdom, अकरोत् ruled.

text: स वल्कलजटाधारी मुनिवेषधर: प्रभु: । नन्दिग्रामे ऽवसद्वीर: ससैन्यो भरतस्तदा ॥२-११५-२३॥
translation: Bharata, the warrior and lord, wore bark garments and matted locks and lived the life of an ascetic in Nandigrama along with his army.
word_meanings: प्रभुः lord, वीरः warrior, सः भरतः that Bharata, तदा then, वल्कलजटाधारी wearing bark garments and matted locks, मुनिवेषधरः dressed as an ascetic, ससैन्यः with his army, नन्दिग्रामे in Nandigrama, अवसत् lived.

text: रामागमनमाकाङ्क्षन् भरतो भ्रातृवत्सल: । भ्रातुर्वचनकारी च प्रतिज्ञापारगस्तथा ॥२-११५-२४॥
translation: Bharata who was attached to his brother and ever obedient to him, fulfilled his vow. He coronated the sandals and lived at Nandigrama longing for the return of Rama.
word_meanings: तदा then, भ्रातृवत्सलः attached to his brother, भरतः Bharata, रामागमनम् return of Rama, आकाङ्क्षन् longing, भ्रातुः brother's, वचनकारी च obeying his word, प्रतिज्ञापारगः fulfilling his vow, अथ thereafter, पादुके to the sandals, अभिषिच्य having coronated, नन्दिग्रामे in Nandigrama, तथा like that, अवसत् lived.

text: पादुके त्वभिषिच्याथ नन्द्रिग्रामे ऽवसत्तदा । भरत: शासनं सर्वं पादुकाभ्यां न्यवेदयत् ॥२-११५-२५॥
ततस्तु भरत: श्रीमानभिषिच्यार्य्यपादुके । तदधीनस्तदा राज्यं कारयामास सर्वदा ॥२-११५-२६॥
translation: After the coronation of the sandals of his esteemed brother Rama, illustrious Bharata ruled the kingdom, subordianating himself to them.
word_meanings: ततः then, श्रीमान् illustrious, भरतः Bharata, आर्यपादुके sandals of his esteemed brother, अभिषिच्य having consecrated, सर्वदा always, तदधीनः subordinating himself to them, राज्यम् kingdom, कारयामास ruled.

text: तदा हि यत्कार्य्यमुपैति किञ्चिदुपायनं चोपहृतं महार्हम् । स पादुकाभ्यां प्रथमं निवेद्य चकार पश्चाद्भरतो यथावत् ॥२-११५-२७॥
translation: Whenever an issue, however small, arose, Bharata kept the sandals informed. Whenever a valuable gift was presented, he offered it to the sandals before he accepted it. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे पञ्चदशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundredfifteenth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सः भरतः Bharata, तदा then, यत्किञ्चित् however small, कार्यम् deed, उपैति arises, उपहृतम् brought, महार्हम् expensive, उपायनम् gifts, प्रथमम् at first, पादुकाभ्याम् to the sandals, निवेद्य after offering, पश्चात् later, यथावत् appropriately, चकार carried out the work.

text: प्रतिप्रयाते भरते वसन् रामस्तपोवने । लक्षयामास सोद्वेगमथौत्सुक्यं तपस्विनाम् ॥२-११६-१॥
translation: After Bharta, had departed, Rama who was living in the penancegrove of ascetics observed that the ascetics were filled with apprehensions, and were eager (to leave that forest).
word_meanings: भरते Bharata, प्रतिप्रयाते had departed, रामः Rama, तपोवने in the grove of ascetics, अथ then, तपस्विनाम् of ascetics, सोद्वेगम् filled with apprehension, औत्सुक्यम् eagerness (with intense desire to leave that forest), लक्षयामास observed.

text: ये तत्र चित्रकूटस्य पुरस्तात्तापसाश्रमे । राममाश्रित्य निरतास्तानलक्षयदुत्सुकान् ॥२-११६-२॥
translation: Rama observed that the sages who earlier sought to stay with him near his hermitage under his protection on chitrakuta were filled with anxiety (now).
word_meanings: तत्र there, पुरस्तात् in front of, चित्रकूटस्य of Chitrakuta, तापसाश्रमे in the hermitage, रामम् Rama, आश्रित्य sought his protection, निरताः intent on staying, तान् them, उत्सुकान् anxious, अलक्षयत् observed.

text: नयनैर्भुकुटीभिश्च रामं निर्दिश्य शङ्किता: । अन्योन्यमुपजल्पन्त: शनैश्चक्रुर्मिथ: कथा: ॥२-११६-३॥
translation: Those sages, glancing at Rama with suspicious eyes, knitting their eyebrows and murmering among themselves, conversed secretly.
word_meanings: शङ्किताः suspicious, नयनैः with eyes, भृकुटीभिश्च by knitting their eyebrows, रामम् of Rama, निर्दिश्य glancing, अन्योन्यम् to each other, उपजल्पन्तः conversing, मिथः mutually, कथाः incidents, चक्रुः narrated.

text: तेषामौत्सुक्यमालक्ष्य रामस्त्वात्मनि शङ्कित: । कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदमृषिं कुलपतिं तत: ॥२-११६-४॥
translation: Having observed their anxiety, Rama apprehending somethig in his mind approached the chief of the hermitage with folded palms and said:
word_meanings: ततः then, रामस्तु as for Rama, तेषाम् their, औत्सुक्यम् anxiety, आलक्ष्य having observed, स्या स्वात्मनि in his mind, शङ्कितः suspecting, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms in reverence, कुलपतिम् the chief of the hermitage, ऋषिम् that sage, इदम् these words, उवाच said.

text: न कच्चिद्भगवन् किञ्चित्पूर्ववृत्तमिदं मयि । दृश्यते विकृतं येन विक्रियन्ते तपस्विन: ॥२-११६-५॥
translation: O revered sire, have you seen any change in my conduct? For what reason are the sages looking perturbed?
word_meanings: भगवत् O revered one, मयि in me, पूर्ववृत्तम् earlier conduct, किञ्चित् nothing, इदम् this, विकृतम् change, न दृश्यते कच्चित् not noticed, येन by what, तपस्विनः sages, विक्रियन्ते are perturbed.

text: प्रमादाच्चरितं कच्चित्किञ्चिन्नावरजस्य मे । लक्ष्मणस्यर्षिभिर्दृष्टं नानुरूपमिवात्मन: ॥२-११६-६॥
translation: Have the sages found my younger brother Lakshmana doing something unbecoming of him through inadvertence?
word_meanings: मे अवरजस्य my younger brother's, लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, प्रमादात् through inadvertance, आत्मनः himself, नानुरूपं unbefitting, चरितम् conduct, ऋषिभिः by sages, दृष्टं कच्चित् has been seen.

text: कच्चिच्छुश्रूषमाणा व: शुश्रूषणपरा मयि । प्र(म)मादाभ्युचितां वृत्तिं सीता युक्तं न वर्तते ॥२-११६-७॥
translation: Has Sita devoted in her service to me and engaged in serving you failed to follow the conduct befitting a woman?
word_meanings: वः to you, शुश्रूषमाणा engaged in serving, मयि in me, शुश्रूषणपरा devoted to service, सीता by Sita, प्रमदाभ्युचिताम् befitting a woman, वृत्तिम् conduct, युक्तम् properly, न वर्तते कच्छित् is not following.

text: अथर्षिर्जरया वृद्धस्तपसा च जरां गत: । वेपमान इवोवाच रामं भूतदयापरम् ॥२-११६-८॥
translation: Hearing those words, an ascetic old in age and austerities, as though trembling said to Rama who is compassionate to all beings:
word_meanings: अथ then, जरया in old age, वृद्धः grown old, तपसा च also in austerities, जराम् old age, गतः attained, ऋषिः ascetic, वेपमान इव as though trembling, भूतदयापरम् compassionate to all beings, रामम् to Rama, उवाच said.

text: कुत: कल्याणसत्त्वाया: कल्याणाभिरतेस्तथा । चलनं तात वैदेह्यास्तपस्विषु विशेषत: ॥२-११६-९॥
translation: O dear child, how can goodnatured Sita who is always engaged in performing auspicious deeds, especially towards ascetics be associated with violation of duty?
word_meanings: तात O dear child, कल्याणसत्त्वायाः of a lady of auspicious nature, तथा also, कल्याणाभिरतेः ever engaged in performing auspicious deeds, वैदेह्याः Sita's, चलनम् violation of duty, विशेषतः especially, तपस्विषु in respect of ascetics, कुतः how ?

text: त्वन्निमित्तमिदं तावत्तापसान् प्रति वर्तते । रक्षोभ्यस्तेन संविग्ना: कथयन्ति मिथ: कथा: ॥२-११६-१०॥
translation: There is apprehension for ascetics from the demons on acount of your presence here. That is why they are conversing with one another about the likely fallout.
word_meanings: त्वन्निमित्तम् for your sake, रक्षोभ्यः on account of rakshasas, तापसान् to ascetics, इदम् this fear, प्रतिवर्तते तावत् is arising, तेन by that, संविग्नाः they are scared, मिथ: mutually, कथाः incidents, कथयन्ति are exchanging.

text: रावणावरज: कश्चित् खरो नामेह राक्षस: । उत्पाट्य तापसान् सर्वान् जनस्थाननिकेतनान् ॥२-११६-११॥
translation: O dear child, Khara, one of the brothers of Ravana is dwelling in nearby 'Janasthana'. He is impudent, reportedly winner of battles, cruel, sinful, a maneater and haughty. He has uprooted all the ascetics from Janasthana. He will not tolerate even you.
word_meanings: तात O dear child, इह here, रावणावरजः Ravana's brother, धृष्टश्च impudent, जितकाशी च appearing victorious, नृशंसः cruel one, पुरुषादकः cannibal, अवलिप्तश्च haughty, पापश्च a sinner, खरो नाम by name Khara, जनस्थाननिकेतनान् residents of 'Janasthanam', सर्वान् all, तापसान् ascetics, उत्पाट्य having uprooted, त्वां च you also, न मृष्यते will not pardon.

text: धृष्टश्च जितकाशीं च नृशंस: पुरुषादक: । अवलिप्तश्च पापश्च त्वां च तात न मृष्यते ॥२-११६-१२॥
translation: O dear child, Khara, one of the brothers of Ravana is dwelling in nearby 'Janasthana'. He is impudent, reportedly winner of battles, cruel, sinful, a maneater and haughty. He has uprooted all the ascetics from Janasthana. He will not tolerate even you.
word_meanings: तात O dear child, इह here, रावणावरजः Ravana's brother, धृष्टश्च impudent, जितकाशी च appearing victorious, नृशंसः cruel one, पुरुषादकः cannibal, अवलिप्तश्च haughty, पापश्च a sinner, खरो नाम by name Khara, जनस्थाननिकेतनान् residents of 'Janasthanam', सर्वान् all, तापसान् ascetics, उत्पाट्य having uprooted, त्वां च you also, न मृष्यते will not pardon.

text: त्वं यदाप्रभृति ह्यस्मिन्नाश्रमे तात वर्तसे । तदाप्रभृति रक्षांसि विप्रकुर्वन्ति तापसान् ॥२-११६-१३॥
translation: O dear child, ever since you started residing in this hermitage rakshasas have been tormenting the ascetics.
word_meanings: तात O dear child, त्वम् you, यदाप्रभृति from the time, अस्मिन् आश्रमे in this hermitage, वर्तसे started residing, तदाप्रभृति since that time, रक्षांसि rakshasas, तापसान् the ascetics, विप्रकुर्वन्ति are tormenting.

text: दर्शयन्ति हि बीभत्सै: क्रूरैर्भीषणकैरपि । नानारूपैर्विरूपैश्च रूपैर्विकृतदर्शनै: ॥२-११६-१४॥
translation: They appear in various distorted forms now rapacious, now fearful, now deformed.
word_meanings: बीभत्सैः in distorted appearance, क्रूरैः by cruel, भीषणकैरपि by frightening, नानारूपैः in various forms, विरूपैश्च by deformaed appearance, विकृतदर्शनैः detestable looks, रूपैः in forms, दर्शयन्ति they exhibit.

text: अप्रशस्तैरशुचिभि: सम्प्रयोज्य च तापसान् । प्रतिघ्नन्त्यपरान् क्षिप्रमनार्य्या: पुरत: स्थिता: ॥२-११६-१५॥
translation: Those wicked rakshasas employ forbidden and dirty means against ascetics and kill them by suddenly appearing in front of them.
word_meanings: अनार्याः the wicked rakshasas, पुरतः in front of, स्थिताः standing, तापसान् ascetics, अप्रशस्तै: forbidden, अशुचिभिः dirty things, सम्प्रयोज्य employing, अपरान् some other ascetics, प्रतिघ्नन्ति are killing.

text: तेषु तेष्वाश्रमस्थानेष्वबुद्धमवलीय च । रमन्ते तापसांस्तत्र नाशयन्तो ऽल्पयेतस: ॥२-११६-१६॥
translation: These debased rakshasas, concealing themselves in various ashram sites take delight in harassing and killing the ascetics.
word_meanings: अल्पचेतसः debased ones, तेषु तेषु in different, स्थानेषु in ashram sites, अबुद्धम् without being perceived, अवलीय च after concealing themselves, तत्र there, तापसान् the ascetics, नाशयन्तः while destroying, रमन्ते are taking delight.

text: अपक्षिपन्ति स्रुग्भाण्डानग्नीन् सिञ्चन्ति वारिणा । कलशांश्च प्रमृद्नन्ति हवने समुपस्थिते ॥२-११६-१७॥
translation: When sacrifices are about to start, they throw away the sacrificial ladels and vessels containing sacrificial materials and sprinkle water on sacrificial fire. They also break down the earthen vessels used in the sacrifice.
word_meanings: हवने the sacrifices, समुपस्थिते are about to commence, स्रुग्भाण्डान् the sacrificial ladels and vessels containing sacrificial materials, अवक्षिपन्ति throw away, वारिणा with water, अग्नीन् the fire for oblation, सिञ्चन्ति are drenching, कलशांश्च waterpots, प्रमदेन्तीध्नन्ति destroy.

text: तैर्दुरात्मभिरामृष्टानाश्रमान् प्रजिहासव: । गमनायान्यदेशस्य चोदयन्त्यृषयो ऽद्य माम् ॥२-११६-१८॥
translation: Now all these sages are urging me to abandon this hermitage infested by these wicked rakshasas and move to another region.
word_meanings: अद्य now, ऋषयः sages, दुरात्मभिः by those beings of wicked nature, तैः by those rakshasas, अमृष्टान् infested with, आश्रमान् the hermitages, प्रजिहासवः those who want to flee, अन्यदेशस्य to another region, गमनाय to go, माम् me, चोदयन्ति are urging.

text: तत्पुरा राम शारीरीमुपहिंसां तपस्विषु । दर्शयन्ति हि दुष्टास्ते त्यक्ष्याम इममाश्रमम् ॥२-११६-१९॥
translation: O Rama, those vile creatures resort to physical violence against ascetics, we have therefore, resolved to quit this ashram.
word_meanings: राम O Rama, ते दुष्टाः those vile creatures, तपस्विषु to these sages, शारीराम् physical, उपहिंसाम् violence, पुरा दर्शयन्ति हि they show in the begining, तत् for that reason, इमम् आश्रमम् this ashram, त्यक्ष्यामः we are going to quit.

text: बहुमूलफलं चित्रमविदूरादितो वनम् । पुराणाश्रममेवाहं श्रयिष्ये सगण: पुन: ॥२-११६-२०॥
translation: Not very far from here stands an ancient ashram in a lovely forest abounding in roots and fruits and I with my companions will seek shelter there.
word_meanings: इतः from here, अविदूरात् not very far, बहुमूलफलम् abounding in roots and fruits, चित्रम् वनम् lovely woods, अहम् I, पुनः again, सगणः with my companions, पुराणाश्रममेव the ancient ashram, श्रयिष्ये I will seek shelter.

text: खरस्त्वय्यपि चायुक्तं पुरा तात प्रवर्त्तते । सहास्माभिरितो गच्छ यदि बुद्धि: प्रवर्त्तते ॥२-११६-२१॥
translation: Dear child, Khara will also misbehave with you as usual. (Therefore), if you so decide you may come along with us.
word_meanings: तात O dear child, खरः Khara, त्वय्यपि च with you also, अयुक्तम् improperly, पुरा प्रवर्तते behaves at the outset, बुद्धि: प्रवर्तते यदि if you so like, इतः from here, अस्माभिः सह along with us, गच्छ you may go.

text: सकलत्रस्य सन्देहो नित्यं यत्तस्य राघव । समर्थस्यापि वसतो वासो दु:खमिहाद्य ते ॥२-११६-२२॥
translation: O Rama, even though you are always vigilant and capable in all possible ways to defend youself, a doubt arises in our mind. It is perilous for you to live here with your wife.
word_meanings: राघव O Rama, नित्यम् always, यत्तस्य since for a man, समर्थस्यापि हि सतः even though capable, सकलत्रस्य a man accompanied by his wife, ते to you, सन्देहः doubtful, अद्य now, इह here, वासः living, दुःखम् is painful.

text: इत्युक्तवन्तं रामस्तं राजपुत्रस्तपस्विनम् । न शशाकोत्तरैर्वाक्यैरवरोद्धुं समुत्सुक: ॥२-११६-२३॥
translation: It was not possible for prince Rama to hold back by mere words that ascetic who was saying like this and was anxious to quit the hermitage.
word_meanings: राजपुत्रः son of a king, राम Rama, इति thus, उक्तवन्तम् saying this, समुत्सुकम् anxious, तं तपस्विनम् that sage, उत्तरैः in the form of a reply, वाक्यैः by words, अवरोद्धुम् to hold him back, न शशाक was unable.

text: अभिनन्द्य समापृच्छ्य समाधाय च राघवम् । स जगामाश्रमं त्यक्त्वा कुलै: कुलपति: सह ॥२-११६-२४॥
translation: The leader of the group quit the hermitage along with his companions after paying respect to Rama, convincing him and taking leave of him.
word_meanings: सः कुलपतिः that chief of ascetics, राघवम् to Rama, अभिनन्द्य having greeted, समापृच्छ्य having taken leave, समाधाय having convinced, कुलैस्सह along with his group, आश्रमम् hermitage, त्यक्त्वा after abandoning, जगाम went.

text: राम: संसाध्य त्वृषिगणमनुगमनाद्देशात्तस्मात् कुलपतिमभिवाद्य ऋषिम् । सम्यक्प्रीतैस्तैरनुमत उपदिष्टार्थ: पुण्यं वासाय स्वनिलयमुपसम्पेदे ॥२-११६-२५॥
translation: Rama, followed the sages for some distance to bid them farewell. He paid obeisance to the chief of the group and having grasped the instruction of the highly pleased sages, he with their consent returned to his holy hermitage.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, तस्मात् देशात् from that region, अनुगमनात् by following them for some distance, ऋषिगणम् the sages, संसाध्य bidding them farewell, कुलपतिम् chief of the groups, ऋषिम् that sage, अभिवाद्य having paid obeisance, सम्यक् properly, प्रीतैः by the pleased, तैः by them, अनुमतः having been consented, उपदिष्टार्थः having grasped their instruction, वासाय to reside, पुण्यम् holy, स्वं निलयम् his own hermitage, उपसम्पेदे approached.

text: आश्रमं त्वृषिविरहितं प्रभु: क्षणमपि न विजहौ स राघव: । राघवं हि सततमनुगतास्तापसाश्चार्षचरितधृतगुणा: ॥२-११६-२६॥
translation: Lord Rama, did not leave that hermitage deserted by the sages even for a moment. Those who had adopted the traditions of the sages and had acquired many virtues followed Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षोडशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundredsixteenth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: प्रभुः the lord, सः राघवः that Rama, ऋषिविरहितम् deserted by the sages, आश्रमम् hermitage, क्षणमपि for a moment also, न जहौ did not leave, आर्षचरिते following the tradition of sages, धृतगुणाः fixed in many virtues, तापसाश्च even the sages, सततम् always, राघवम् to Rama, अनुगताः हि followed remained.

text: राघवस्त्वथ यातेषु तपस्विषु विचिन्तयन् । न तत्रारोचयद्वासं कारणैर्बहुभिस्तदा ॥२-११७-१॥
translation: When the ascetics had departed, Rama thought over the matter well and did not like to reside there for many reasons.
word_meanings: अथ then, राघवस्तु as for Rama, तपस्विषु ascetics, यातेषु when departed, विचिन्तयन् thinking over, बहुभिः for many, कारणैः reasons, तदा then, तत्र there, वासम् to reside, नारोचयत् did not like.

text: इह मे भरतो दृष्टो मातरश्च सनागरा: । सा च मे स्मृतिरन्वेति तान्नित्यमनुशोचत: ॥२-११७-२॥
translation: It is here that Bharata, mothers along with citizens of Ayodhya have visited me. That memory soaked with grief is chasing me.
word_meanings: मे to me, इह here, भरतः Bharata, दृष्टः has been seen, सनागराः with the citzens of Ayodhya, मातरश्च mothers also, नित्यम् always, तान् about them, अनुशोचतः filled with grief, मे to me, सा स्मृतिः च that memory, अन्वेति is chasing.

text: स्कन्धावारनिवेशेन तेन तस्य महात्मन: । हयहस्तिकरीषैश्च उपमर्द्द: कृतो भृशम् ॥२-११७-३॥
translation: Due to the encampment of the army of the magnanimous Bharata (here), this place has been filled with the dung of horses and elephants and made exceedingly dirty.
word_meanings: महात्मनः magnanimous, तस्य Bharata's, तेन by that, स्कन्धावारनिवेशेन with the encampment of army, हयहस्तिकरीषैश्च with the dung of horses and elephants, भृशम् exceedingly, उपमर्थः dirty, कृतः has been made.

text: तस्मादन्यत्र गच्छाम इति सञ्चिन्त्य राघव: । प्रातिष्ठत स वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च सङ्गत: ॥२-११७-४॥
translation: We shall, therefore, go to some other place, having resolved thus, Rama accompanied by Sita and Lakshmana set forth.
word_meanings: तस्मात् therefore, अन्यत्र to some other place, गच्छाम let us go, इति thus, सञ्चिन्त्य having resolved, सः that, राघवः Rama, वैदेह्या with Sita, लक्ष्मणेन with Lakshmana, सङ्गतः accompanied by, प्रातिष्ठत set forth.

text: सो ऽत्रेराश्रममासाद्य तं ववन्दे महायशा: । तं चापि भगवानत्रि: पुत्रवत् प्रत्यपद्यत ॥२-११७-५॥
translation: Having reached the hermitage of the revered sage Atri, illustrious Rama prostrated before him and Atri also received him as his son.
word_meanings: महायशाः illustrious one, सः रामः that Rama, अत्रेः Atri's, आश्रमम् hermitage, आसाद्य having reached, तम् to that sage, ववन्दे prostrated, भगवान् the revered, अत्रिः Atri, अपि also, तं him as well, पुत्रवत् like a son, प्रत्यपद्यत received.

text: स्वयमातिथ्यमादिश्य सर्वमस्य सुसत्कृतम् । सौमित्रिं च महाभागां सीतां च समसान्त्वयत् ॥२-११७-६॥
translation: That sage Atri himself extended to Rama the hospitality befitting him in all possible ways and treated Lakshmana and highly virtuous Sita with kind words.
word_meanings: (अस्य of Rama), सुसत्कृतम् rendered befitting hospitality, सर्वम् in all ways, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, स्वयम् himself, आदिश्य च having ordered, महाभागाम् highly virtuous, सीतां च Sita, सौमित्रिं च also Lakshmana, समसान्त्वयत् treated with kind words.

text: पत्नीं च समनुप्राप्तां वृद्धामामन्त्र्य सत्कृताम् । सान्त्वयामास धर्मज्ञ: सर्वभूतहिते रत: ॥२-११७-७॥
translation: Conversant in the ways of righteousness and eagaged in the welfate of all beings, sage Atri called out his aged wife who is revered by all and spoke kind words to her.
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञः knower of the ways of righteousness, सर्वभूतहिते in the welfare of all beings, रतः engaged, समनुप्राप्ताम् who had just come there, सत्कृताम् revered by all, वृद्धाम् aged, पत्नी च his wife also, आमन्त्र्य called out, सान्त्वयामास said kind words.

text: अनसूयां महाभागां तापसीं धर्मचारिणीम् । प्रतिगृह्णीष्व वैदेहीमब्रवीदृषिसत्तम: । रामाय चाचचक्षे तां तापसीं धर्मचारिणीम् ॥२-११७-८॥
translation: Atri, who was excellent among the sages said to his ascetic wife who was highly virtuous and an adherent of righteousness, Welcome Sita. Thereafter, he related to Rama a story about his asetic wife who follows the ways of righteousness.
word_meanings: ऋषिसत्तमः excellent among the sages (Atri), वैदेहीम् Sita, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व receive, महाभागाम् highly virtuous, तापसीम् female ascetic, धर्मचारिणीम् who adheres to righteousness, अनसूयाम् to Anasuya, अब्रवीत् said, धर्मचारिणीम् who followed the ways of righteousness, तां तापसीम् about his ascetic wife Anasuya, रामाय to Rama, आचचक्षे च related.

text: दशवर्षाण्यनावृष्ट्या दग्धे लोके निरन्तरम् । यया मूलफले सृष्टे जाह्नवी च प्रवर्त्तिता ॥२-११७-९॥
