translation: O blameless one (Rama), once this world was consecutively ravaged by drought for ten years. It was the virtuous Anasuya who created roots and fruits and caused Ganga to flow. She was engaged in severe mortifications and selfimposed religious observances. She practised severe asceticism for ten thousand years bathed in her vows. Solicited on behalf of the gods, she removed all impediments and converted ten nights into one. She is like a your mother to you.
word_meanings: अनघ O blameless one (Rama), लोके in this world, दशवर्षाणि ten years, अनावृष्ट्या by drought, निरन्तरम् constantly, दग्धे devastated, यया by whom, मूलफले roots and fruits, सृष्टे were created, जाह्नवी च Ganga, प्रवर्तिता caused to flow, उग्रेण rigid, तपसा with mortifications, युक्ता engaged, नियमैश्च अपि with selfimposed religious observances, अलङ्कृता decorated, यया by whom, दशवर्षसहस्राणि for ten thousand years, महत् severe, तपः asceticism, तप्तम् was practised, देवकार्यनिमित्तम् for the sake of gods, सन्त्वरमाणया by her eagerly, यया by whom, प्रत्यूहां impediments, निवर्तिताः have been averted, दशरात्रं ten nights, रात्रिः as night, कृता was converted, सा such, व्रतैः स्नाता bathed in her vow, इयम् अनसूया this Anasuya, ते to you, मातेव like a mother.

text: उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता नियमैश्चाप्यलङ्कृता । दशवर्षसहस्राणि यया तप्तं महत्तप: ॥२-११७-१०॥
अनसूया व्रतै: स्नाता प्रत्यूहाश्च निवर्त्तिता: । देवकार्यनिमित्तं च यया संत्वरमाणया । दशरात्रं कृता रात्रि: सेयं मातेव ते ऽनघ ॥२-११७-११॥
translation: O blameless one (Rama), once this world was consecutively ravaged by drought for ten years. It was the virtuous Anasuya who created roots and fruits and caused Ganga to flow. She was engaged in severe mortifications and selfimposed religious observances. She practised severe asceticism for ten thousand years bathed in her vows. Solicited on behalf of the gods, she removed all impediments and converted ten nights into one. She is like a your mother to you.
word_meanings: अनघ O blameless one (Rama), लोके in this world, दशवर्षाणि ten years, अनावृष्ट्या by drought, निरन्तरम् constantly, दग्धे devastated, यया by whom, मूलफले roots and fruits, सृष्टे were created, जाह्नवी च Ganga, प्रवर्तिता caused to flow, उग्रेण rigid, तपसा with mortifications, युक्ता engaged, नियमैश्च अपि with selfimposed religious observances, अलङ्कृता decorated, यया by whom, दशवर्षसहस्राणि for ten thousand years, महत् severe, तपः asceticism, तप्तम् was practised, देवकार्यनिमित्तम् for the sake of gods, सन्त्वरमाणया by her eagerly, यया by whom, प्रत्यूहां impediments, निवर्तिताः have been averted, दशरात्रं ten nights, रात्रिः as night, कृता was converted, सा such, व्रतैः स्नाता bathed in her vow, इयम् अनसूया this Anasuya, ते to you, मातेव like a mother.

text: तामिमां सर्वभूतानां नमस्कार्य्यां यशस्विनीम् । अभिगच्छतु वैदेही वृद्धामक्रोधनां सदा । अनसूयेति या लोके कर्मभि: ख्यातिमागता ॥२-११७-१२॥
translation: 'She is renowned throughout this world for her deeds as Anasuya, (one who is free from anger). Aged, illustrious she is free frm anger, worthy of adoration by all beings. Let Sita approach her'.
word_meanings: सर्वभूतानाम् for all beings, नमस्कार्याम् worthy of adoration, यशस्विनीम् illustrious lady, वृद्धाम् aged, सदा always, अक्रोधनाम् free from anger, ताम् to such a woman, इमाम् this Anasuya, वैदेही Sita, अभिगच्छतु let her approach, या who, कर्मभिः with deeds, आनसूयेति as Anasuya, ख्यातिम् renown, आगता has acquired.

text: एवं ब्रुवाणं तमृषिं तथेत्युक्त्वा स राघव: । सीतामुवाच धर्मज्ञामिदं वचनमुत्तमम् ॥२-११७-१३॥
translation: Hearing those words of the sage, Rama said be it so and said to righteous Sita these choice words.
word_meanings: सः राघवः that Rama, एवम् in this way, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, तम् ऋषिम् that sage, तथेति be it so, उक्त्वा having said, धर्मज्ञाम् wise in the ways of righteousness, सीताम् Sita, उत्तमम् excellent, इदं वचनम् these words, उवाच said.

text: राजपुत्रि श्रुतं त्वेतन्मुनेरस्य समीरितम् । श्रेयोर्थमात्मन: श्रीघ्रमभिगच्छ तपस्विनीम् ॥२-११७-१४॥
translation: O princess, you have heard the message of the sage. Without delay approach the ascetic (Anasuya) for your welfare.
word_meanings: राजपुत्रि O princess (Sita), अस्य मुनेः of this sage, इदं समीरितम् this saying, श्रुतम् has been heard, आत्मनः for your, श्रेयोऽर्थम् for your welfare, शीघ्रम् without delay, तपस्विनीम् ascetic, अभिगच्छ you may approach.

text: सीता त्वेतद्वच: श्रुत्वा राघवस्य हितैषिण: । तामत्रिपत्नीं धर्मज्ञामभिचक्राम मैथिली ॥२-११७-१५॥
translation: Having heard the words of Rama, intended for her welfare, Sita, daughter of the king of Mithila, approached the consort of Atri (Devi Anasuya), knower of righteousness, and reverently circumambulated her.
word_meanings: मैथिली daughter of the king of Mithila, सीता तु Sita, हितैषिणः wishing her welfare, राघवस्य Rama's, एतद्वचः words, शृत्वा hearing, धर्मज्ञाम् knower of righteousness, ताम् to that, अत्रिपत्नीम् wife of Atri (Devi Anasuya), अभिचक्राम circumamabulated in reverence.

text: शिथिलां वलितां वृद्धां जरापाण्डरमूर्द्धजाम् । सततं वेपमानाङ्गी प्रवाते कदली यथा ॥२-११७-१६॥
तां तु सीता महाभागामनसूयां पतिव्रताम् । अभ्यवादयदव्यग्रा स्वनाम समुदाहरत् ॥२-११७-१७॥
translation: Highly chaste and fortunate Anasuya was very old and feeble. Her skin was wrinkled and her hair turned grey due to old age. Her body was constantly trembling like a plantain tree in a stormy wind. Pronouncing her name to such Anasuya, Sita made obeisance to her with utmost concentration.
word_meanings: सीता Sita, शिथिलाम् feeble, वलिताम् with wrinkles, वृद्धाम् old, जरापाण्डुरमूर्धजाम् hair turned grey due to old age, प्रवाते in stormy wind, कदलीं यथा like a plantain tree, सततम् constantly, वेपमानाङ्गीम् her body trembling, महाभागाम् highly fortunate, पतिव्रताम् chaste woman, ताम् अनसूयाम् that Anasuya, अव्यग्रा without haste, अभ्यवादयत् made obeisance, स्वनाम her name, समुदाहरत् pronounced.

text: अभिवाद्य च वैदेही तापसीं तामनिन्दिताम् । बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा हृष्टा पर्यपृच्छदनामयम् ॥२-११७-१८॥
translation: Sita offered her obeisance to the blameless ascetic, Anasuya, folding her palms and enquired of her wellbeing in delight.
word_meanings: वैदेही Sita, अनिन्दिताम् blameless, तां तापसीम् to that asceetic (Anasuya), अभिवाद्य after paying her homage, बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा folding the palms, हृष्टा delighted lady, अनामयम् wellbeing, पर्यपृच्छत् enquired.

text: तत: सीतां महाभागां दृष्ट्वा तां धर्मचारिणीम् । सान्त्वयन्त्यब्रवीद्धृष्टा दिष्ट्या धर्ममवेक्षसे ॥२-११७-१९॥
translation: Anasuya was delighted to see the glorious Sita who was always engaged in righteous acts and said in kind words, You are fortunate. You are observing your rightful duty.
word_meanings: ततः then, महाभागाम् glorious lady, धर्मचारिणीम् engaged in righteous acts, तां सीताम् that Sita, सान्त्वयन्ती consoling, हृष्टा in delight, अब्रवीत् said, दिष्ट्या fortunately, धर्मम् rightful duty, अवेक्षसे you are observing.

text: त्यक्त्वा ज्ञातिजनं सीते मानमृद्धिं च भामिनि । अवरुद्धं वने रामं दिष्ट्या त्वमनुगच्छसि ॥२-११७-२०॥
translation: O noble Sita, by the grace of heaven you are following Rama, forsaking your kinsmen and wealth and confining yourself to the forest.
word_meanings: भामिनः सीते O noble Sita, त्वम् you, दिष्ट्या by the grace of heaven, ज्ञातिजनम् your kins, मानम् pride, ऋद्धं च wealth, त्यक्त्वा after forsaking, वने in the forest, अवरुद्धम् confined, रामम् Rama, अनुगच्छसि you are following.

text: नगरस्थो वनस्थो वा पापो वा यदि वा शुभ: । यासां स्त्रीणां प्रियो भर्ता तासां लोका महोदया: ॥२-११७-२१॥
translation: One who is devoted to her husband, whether he be in the city or in the forest, whether he is sinful or virtuous, will attain the most prosperous worlds.
word_meanings: यासाम् those, स्त्रीणाम् women, नगरस्थः in the city, वनस्थो वा or in the forest, पापो वा or sinful, यदि वा or, शुभः virtuous, भर्ता husband, प्रियः dear, तासाम् for them, महोदयाः highly promising, लोकः worlds.

text: दु:शील: कामवृत्तो वा धनैवा परिवर्जित: । स्त्रीणामार्यस्वभावानां परमं दैवतं पति: ॥२-११७-२२॥
translation: For a woman of noble nature her husband, whether he be licentious or of bad character or devoid of riches, is her supreme lord.
word_meanings: आर्यस्वभावानाम् of noble nature, स्त्रीणाम् for women, दुश्शीलः a man of bad character, कामवृत्तो वा or licentious, धनैः with riches, परिवर्जितो वा or devoid of, पतिः husband, परमम् is supreme, दैवतम् is deity.

text: नातो विशिष्टं पश्यामि बान्धवं विमृशन्त्यहम् । सर्वत्रयोग्यं वैदेहि तप:कृतमिवाव्ययम् ॥२-११७-२३॥
translation: O Sita, on reflection I know of none who is a better friend than the husband. He, like an imperishable penance, once acquired is never lost.
word_meanings: वैदेहि Sita, अहम् I, सर्वत्र all over, विमृशन्ती reflecting, कृतम् performed, अव्ययम् imperishable, योग्यम् befitting, तपः इव like austerities, अतः more than husband, विशिष्टम् better, बान्धवम् relation, न पश्यामि I do not see.

text: न त्वेनमवगच्छन्ति गुणदोषमसत्स्त्रिय: । कामवक्तव्यहृदया भर्तृनाथा श्चरन्ति या: ॥२-११७-२४॥
translation: Those wicked women whose minds are overpowered by carnal desires, ranging at will as lords of their husbands, do not understand about vice and virtue.
word_meanings: याः those women, कामवक्तव्यहृदयाः with minds overpowerd by carnal desires, भर्तृनाथाः as lords of their husbands, चरन्ति ranging at will, असत्त्स्रियः such wicked women, एवम् in this way, गुणदोषम् vice and virtue, न अवगच्छन्ति do not understand.

text: प्राप्नुवन्त्ययशश्चैव धर्मभ्रंशं च मैथिलि । अकार्यवशमापन्ना: स्त्रियो या: खलु तद्विधा: ॥२-११७-२५॥
translation: O Sita, those women under the control of unworthy acts are dislodged from the path of righteousness and get infamy.
word_meanings: मैथिलि O Sita, तद्विधाः such, स्त्रियः women, अकार्यवशम् the influence of unworthy acts, आपन्नः having obtained, अयशश्च infamy, पाप्नुवन्ति are obtaining, धर्मभ्रंशं च dislodged from the state of righteousness.

text: त्वद्विधास्तु गुणैर्युक्ता दृष्टलोकपरावरा: । स्त्रिय: स्वग चरिष्यन्ति यथा धर्मकृतस्तथा ॥२-११७-२६॥
translation: Women like you who are endowed with virtues and can distinguish between good and bad in this world, like those who perform virtuous deeds, will move about in heaven.
word_meanings: गुणैः with virtues, युक्ताः endowed with, दृष्टलोकपरावरा who can distinguish between good and bad in the world, त्वद्विधाः like you, स्त्रियस्तु women, धर्मकृतः doing virtuous deeds, यथा as to how, तथा that way, स्वर्गे in heaven, चरिष्यन्ति will range about.

text: तदेवमेनं त्वमनुव्रता सती पतिव्रतानां समयानुवर्तिनी । भवस्व भर्त्तु: सहधर्मचारिणी यशश्च धर्मं च तत: समाप्स्यसि ॥२-११७-२७॥
सा त्वेवमुक्ता वैदेही त्वनसूया ऽनसूयया । प्रतिपूज्य वचो मन्दं प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमे ॥२-११८-१॥
translation: When Anasuya thus addressed Vaidehi who is free from any malice, she worshipped Anasuya and started speaking in a gentle tone.
word_meanings: अनसूया one who is free from malice, सा वैदेही that Vaidehi, अनसूयया by Anasuya, एवम् in this way, उक्ता when addressed, वचः those words, प्रतिपूज्य having worshipped, मन्दम् in a gentle tone, प्रवक्तुम् to tell, उपचक्रमे commenced.

text: नैतदाश्चर्य्यमार्याया यन्मां त्वमनुभाषसे । विदितं तु ममाप्येतद्यथा नार्य्या: पतिर्गुरु: ॥२-११८-२॥
translation: It is no wonder that a noble lady like you should instruct me this way. It is known to me that a husband is a guru to his wife.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, माम् to me, यत् अभिभाषसे you are instructing, एतत् all this, आर्यायाः for a noble lady like you, आश्चर्यम् wonder, न not, नार्या for a woman, पतिः husband, गुरुः the revered one, यथा as, एतत् all this, ममापि to me, विदितं तु also known.

text: यद्यप्येष भवेद्भर्ता ममार्ये वृत्तवर्जित: । अद्वैधमुपचर्तव्यस्तथाप्येष मया भवेत् ॥२-११८-३॥
translation: O noble lady, even if my husband is devoid of good conduct, he should be obeyed without showing any hesitation.
word_meanings: आर्ये O noble lady, एषः मम भर्ता my husband, वृत्तवर्जितः devoid of good conduct, यद्यपि भवेत् even if it happens, तथापि even then, एषः he, मया by me, अद्वैधम् without hesitation, उपचर्तव्यः should be obeyed.

text: किं पुनर्यो गुण: श्लाघ्य: सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रिय: । स्थिरानुरागो धर्मात्मा मातृवत्पितृवत्प्रिय: ॥२-११८-४॥
translation: What to speak of a husband if he is worthy of applause for his virtues, is compassionate, a subduer of the senses, righteous and ever affectionate like a mother and a father?
word_meanings: यः such a man, गुणश्लाघ्यः is worthy of applause for his virtues, सानुक्रोश: compassionate, जितेन्द्रियः subdued his senses, स्थिरानुरागः ever affectionate, धर्मात्मा righteous man, मातृवत् like a mother, पितृवत् like a father, प्रियः is dear, किं पुनः where is the need to say.

text: यां वृत्तिं वर्त्तते राम: कौसल्यायां महाबल: । तामेव नृपनारीणामन्यासामपि वर्त्तते ॥२-११८-५॥
translation: Mighty Rama shows the same behaviour and treatment towards the other consorts of the king as he does towards his own mother Kausalya.
word_meanings: महाबलः mighty, रामः Rama, कौसल्यायाम् in Kausalya, यां वृत्तिम् such treatment, वर्तते behaves, अन्यासाम् with others, नृपनारीणामपि consorts of the king, तामेव the same way, वर्तते behaves.

text: सकृद्दृष्टास्वपि स्त्रीषु नृपेण नृपवत्सल: । मातृवद्वर्त्तते वीरो मानमुत्सृज्य धर्मवित् ॥२-११८-६॥
translation: Heroic Rama is affectionate towards king Dasaratha and is conversant with righteousness. Renouncing the sense of selfrespect he honours all the women on whom his father had cast his glance even once just as his own mother.
word_meanings: नृपवत्सलः affectionate towards king Dasaratha, धर्मवित् one who is conversant with righteousness, वीरः heroic Rama, नृपेण by king, सकृत् only once, दृष्टासु seen, स्त्रिष्वपि in any woman, मानम् pride, उत्सृज्य setting aside, मातृवत् like a mother, वर्तते abides.

text: आगच्छन्त्याश्च विजनं वनमेवं भयावहम् । समाहितं मे श्वश्र्वा च हृदये तद्धृतं महत् ॥२-११८-७॥
translation: When departing for this frightful and desolate forest, the great (advice) imparted by my motherinlaw is firmly fixed in my mind.
word_meanings: एवम् in this way, भयावहम् frightful, विजनम् desolate, वनम् forest, आगच्छन्त्याः when I was coming, मे to me, श्वश्वा by motherinlaw, समाहितम् imparted, तत् that, महत् wise instruction, हृदये in my heart, धृतम् is firmly grasped.

text: पाणिप्रदानकाले च यत्पुरा त्वग्निसन्निधौ । अनुशिष्टा जनन्या ऽस्मि वाक्यं तदपि मे धृतम् ॥२-११८-८॥
translation: When I have been taught by my mother earlier, at the time of bestowal of my hand to Rama in the presence of the sacrificial fire (as witness) is etched in my mind.
word_meanings: पुरा formerly, पाणिप्रदानकाले च at the time of bestowal of my hand to Rama, अग्नि सन्निधौ in the presence of sacrificial marriage fire, जनन्या by my mother, यत् वाक्यम् that word, अनुशिष्टा आस्मि I have been taught, तदपि that also, मे to me, धृतम् hold

text: नवीकृतं च तत्सर्वं वाक्यैस्ते धर्मचारिणि । पतिशुश्रूषणान्नार्य्यास्तपो नान्यद्विधीयते ॥२-११८-९॥
translation: O righteous one (Anasuya), after listening to your words the instructions given by my motherinlaw and my mother are renewed (remembered again). For a woman, no other penance is laid down (in scriptures) except service to her husband.
word_meanings: धर्मचारिणि O follower of righteous duty (Anasuya), ते वाक्यैः your words, तत् सर्वम् all that, नवीकृतम् renewed (reminded afresh), नार्याः for women, पतिशुश्रूषणात् more than obedience to her husband, अन्यत् other, तपः ascetic practice, न विधीयते is not laid down.

text: सावित्री पतिशुश्रूषां कृत्वा स्वर्गे महीयते । तथावृत्तिश्च याता त्वं पतिशुश्रूषया दिवम् ॥२-११८-१०॥
translation: Having served her husband (faithfully), Savitri is honoured in heaven. You also, by following the same path of serving your husband, shall reach the heaven.
word_meanings: पतिशुश्रूषाम् service to her husband, कृत्वा having rendered, सावित्री Savitri, स्वर्गे in heaven, महीयते is honoured, तथावृत्ति: having followed the same path, त्वं च you also, पतिशुश्रूषया through serving your husband, दिवम् to heaven, याता shall go.

text: वरिष्ठा सर्वनारीणामेषा च दिवि देवता । रोहिणी न विना चन्द्रं मुहूर्त्तमपि दृश्यते ॥२-११८-११॥
translation: Rohini, the very best among all women and the goddess of heaven, is never seen in the sky separated from the moon even for a moment.
word_meanings: सर्वनारीणाम् among all women, वरिष्ठा the very best, देवता goddess, एषा रोहिणी this Rohini, दिवि in the sky, चन्द्रं विना without the Moon, मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, न दृश्यते is not seen.

text: एवंविधाश्च प्रवरा: स्त्रियो भर्तृदृढव्रता: । देवलोके महीयन्ते पुण्येन स्वेन कर्मणा ॥२-११८-१२॥
translation: Execellent women such as these, firm in their vows to their husband are highly revered in the world of gods through their own meritorious deeds.
word_meanings: एवंविधाः such women, प्रवराः excellent, भर्तृदृढव्रताः firm in their vows to their husbands, स्त्रियः women, पुण्येन by merit, स्वेन by their own, कर्मणा deeds, देवलोके in the world of the gods, महीयन्ते are highly revered.

text: ततो ऽनसूया संहृष्टा श्रुत्वोक्तं सीतया वच: । शिरस्याघ्राय चोवाच मैथिलीं हर्षयन्त्युत ॥२-११८-१३॥
translation: Thereafter hearing Sita's words, Anasuya affectionately kissed her forehead and said this in order to make her happy:
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, सीतया by Sita, उक्तम् spoken, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, अनसूया Anasuya, संहृष्टा highly rejoiced, मैथिलीम् to Sita, शिरसि on her forehead, अघ्राय having kissed, हर्षयन्ती in order to make her happy, उवाच said.

text: नियमैर्विविधैराप्तं तपो हि महदस्ति मे । तत्संश्रित्य बलं सीते छन्दये त्वां शुचिस्मिते ॥२-११८-१४॥
translation: O Sita of pure conduct, I have great ascetic power obtained through practising various austerities. With its strength I shall give what you want for your enjoyment.
word_meanings: शुचिव्रते O woman of pure conduct, सीते O Sita, विविधैः by various, नियमैः by austerities, आप्तम् obtained, महत् great, तपः ascetic power, मे to me, अस्ति हि is there to my credit, तत् बलम् that ascetic power, संश्रित्य having resorted to, त्वाम् you, छन्दये I shall cause your enjoyment.

text: उपपन्नं मनोज्ञं च वचनं तव मैथिलि । प्रीता चास्म्युचितं किं ते करवाणि ब्रवीहि मे ॥२-११८-१५॥
translation: O Sita, I am glad to hear your befitting and pleasing words. Tell me what appropriate thing you desire and I shall give you.
word_meanings: मैथिलि O Sita, तव वचनम् your words, उपपन्नम् are befitting, मनोज्ञं च also pleasing, प्रीता आस्मि I am pleased, उचितम् appropriate thing, किं what, ते to you, करवाणि shall I do, मे to me, ब्रवीहि tell.

text: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विस्मिता मन्दविस्मया । कृतमित्यब्रवीत्सीता तपोबलसमन्विताम् ॥२-११८-१६॥
translation: On hearing her words Sita was surprised. With a gentle smile she said, to Anasuya who was endowed with ascetic power, 'I think you have already granted me the boons'.
word_meanings: सीता Sita, तस्याः her, तद्वचनम् those words, शुत्वा having heard, विस्मिता was surprised, मन्दविस्मया with a gentle smile, तपोबलसमन्विताम् endowed with ascetic power, कृतमिति has been done, अब्रवीत् said.

text: सा त्वेवमुक्ता धर्मज्ञा तया प्रीततरा ऽभवत् । सफलं च प्रहर्षं ते हन्त सीते करोम्यहम् ॥२-११८-१७॥
translation: When Sita said so, Anasuya who knew her righteous duty was immensely pleased. and replied, 'What a joy I shall make the words you have spoken come true'.
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञा knower of righteous ways, सा she (Anasuya), तया by Sita, एवम् in this way, उक्ता having been addressed, प्रीततरा अभवत् she was immensely pleased, सीते O Sita, हन्त what a joy, प्रहर्षम् my delight, ते to you, सफलम् fruitful, अहम् I, करोमि shall do.

text: इदं दिव्यं वरं माल्यं वस्त्रमाभरणानि च । अङ्गरागं च वैदेहि महार्हं चानुलेपनम् ॥२-११८-१८॥
translation: O princess of Videha, O Sita, I bestow on you this best garland of the gods, raiment, jewellery, fragrant unguents, and precious ointment for anointing your body with. All this will beautify your limbs. It is convenient (to use) and will never fade.
word_meanings: वैदेहि O princess of Videha, सीते Sita, दिव्यम् divine, वरम् best, इदं माल्यम् this garland, वस्त्रम् raiment, आभरणानि च jewellery, अङ्गरागं च fragrant unguents, महार्हम् precious, अनुलेपनं च ointment for anointing the body, मया by me, दत्तम् is bestowed, इदम् all this, तव to your, गात्राणि limbs, शोभयेत् will beautify, नित्यम् always, अनुरूपम् convenient, असंक्लिष्टम् भविष्यति will never impair.

text: मया दत्तमिदं सीते तव गात्राणि शोभयेत् । अनुरूपमसंक्लिष्टं नित्यमेव भविष्यति ॥२-११८-१९॥
translation: O princess of Videha, O Sita, I bestow on you this best garland of the gods, raiment, jewellery, fragrant unguents, and precious ointment for anointing your body with. All this will beautify your limbs. It is convenient (to use) and will never fade.
word_meanings: वैदेहि O princess of Videha, सीते Sita, दिव्यम् divine, वरम् best, इदं माल्यम् this garland, वस्त्रम् raiment, आभरणानि च jewellery, अङ्गरागं च fragrant unguents, महार्हम् precious, अनुलेपनं च ointment for anointing the body, मया by me, दत्तम् is bestowed, इदम् all this, तव to your, गात्राणि limbs, शोभयेत् will beautify, नित्यम् always, अनुरूपम् convenient, असंक्लिष्टम् भविष्यति will never impair.

text: अङ्गरागेण दिव्येन लिप्ताङ्गी जनकात्मजे । शोभयिष्यसि भर्त्तारं यथा श्रीविष्णुमव्ययम् ॥२-११८-२०॥
translation: O daughter of Janaka, you will enhance the glory of your husband by anointing your body with this divine, fragrant unguent to your body like Lakshmi enhancing the glory of eternal Visnu.
word_meanings: जनकात्मजे O daughter of Janaka, दिव्ये O divine lady, अङ्गरागेण with fragrant unguent, लिप्ताङ्गी anointing to your body, श्रीः Lakshmi, अव्ययम् imperishable, विष्णुम् Vishnu, यथा how, भर्तारम् your husband, शोभयिष्यसि you will enhance the glory.

text: सा वस्त्रमङ्गरागं च भूषणानि स्रजस्तथा । मैथिली प्रतिजग्राह प्रीतिदानमनुत्तमम् ॥२-११८-२१॥
translation: That princess from Mithila accepted the incomparable gifts of love, the raiment, fragrant unguents, jewellery and also the garland.
word_meanings: सा मैथिली that princess from Mithila, वस्त्रम् raiment, अङ्गरागं च fragrant unguent, भूषणानि jewellery, तथा and, स्रजः garlands, अनुत्तमम् incomparable, प्रीतिदानम् gifts of love, प्रतिजग्राह accepted.

text: प्रतिगृह्य च तत् सीता प्रीतिदानं यशस्विनी । श्लिष्टाञ्जलिपुटा तत्र समुपास्त तपोधनाम् ॥२-११८-२२॥
translation: Illustrious Sita accepted the gifts of love and with palms folded in reverence sat beside her, an ascetic.
word_meanings: यशस्विनी illustrious lady, सीता Sita, तत् that, प्रीतिदानम् gifts of love, प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, श्लिष्टाञ्जलिपुटा with hands folded like a dish in reverence, तत्र there, तपोधनाम् ascetic, समुपास्त sat beside her.

text: तथा सीतासुपासीनामनसूया दृढव्रता । वचनं प्रष्टुमारेभे काञ्चित् प्रियकथामनु ॥२-११८-२३॥
translation: Anasuya who was firm in her vows commenced to ask Sita this way about a certain tale (that was close to her heart).
word_meanings: दृढव्रता firm in her vows, अनसूया Anasuya, तथा in that way, उपासीनाम् sitting, सीताम् Sita, कांचित् certain, प्रियकथामनु relating to a dear tale (that was close to her heart), प्रष्टुम् to ask, वचनम् these words, आरेभे commenced.

text: स्वयंवरे किल प्राप्ता त्वमनेन यशस्विना । राघवेणेति मे सीते कथा श्रुतिमुपागता ॥२-११८-२४॥
translation: O Sita, I have heard that you have been won by the illustrious Rama in the swayamvara. At least that is the story which reached my ears.
word_meanings: सीते O Sita, त्वम् you, यशस्विना by the illustrious one, राघवेण by Rama, स्वयंवरे in the swayamvara (the choice of the husband by a princess in the public), प्राप्ता किल are obtained, इति कथा so runs the story, मे my, श्रुतिम् my ear, उपागता reached.

text: तां कथां श्रोतुमिच्छामि विस्तरेण च मैथिलि । यथानुभूतं कार्त्स्न्येन तन्मे त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥२-११८-२५॥
translation: O daughter of Mithila, I would like to hear the story in detail. You should tell me the whole story as you experienced it.
word_meanings: मैथिलि O daughter of the king of Mithila, ताम् that story, विस्तरेण in detail, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि I wish, तत् that one, त्वम् you, यथाऽनुभूतम् as you experienced, कात्स्न्येन entirely, वक्तुम् अर्हसि you should tell me.

text: एवमुक्ता तु सा सीता तां ततो धर्मचारिणीम् । श्रूयतामिति चोक्त्वा वै कथयामास तां कथाम् ॥२-११८-२६॥
translation: 'Listen' said Sita, thus addressed, and began relating the story to Anasuya, a performer of austerities.
word_meanings: एवम् thus, उक्ता addressed, सा सीता that Sita, ततः then, श्रूयताम् इति listen, उक्त्वा having said, ताम् that, धर्मचारिणीम् to one who practiced righteousness, तां कथाम् that story, कथयामास related.

text: मिथिलाधिपतिर्वीरो जनको नाम धर्मवित् । क्षत्ऺत्रधर्मे ह्यभिरतो न्यायत: शास्ति मेदिनीम् ॥२-११८-२७॥
translation: There is a king in Mithila, Janaka by name. He is heroic and is conversant with righteousness. Engaged in the duties of a kshatriya, he is rules the earth with justice.
word_meanings: मिथिलाधिपतिः king of Mithila, वीरः a warrior, धर्मवित् one conversant wtih righteousness, जनको नाम by name Janaka, क्षत्रधर्मे in the duties of kshatriya, अभिरतः engaged, न्यायतः rightly, मेदिनीम् this earth, शास्ति was ruling.

text: तस्य लाङ्गलहस्तस्य कर्षत: क्षेत्रमण्डलम् । अहं किलोत्थिता भित्त्वा जगतीं नृपते: सुता ॥२-११८-२८॥
translation: When he was ploughing the circular plot of land for performing a sacrifice, it is said I emerged from the earth by breaking it and therefore I became his dauhghter.
word_meanings: तस्य his, लाङ्गलहस्तस्य of a man holding a plough in hand, क्षेत्रमण्डलम् the circular plot of land for performing sacrifice, कर्षतः while ploughing, अहम् I, नृपतेः king's, सुता as daughter, जगतीम् the earth, भित्वा breaking, उत्थिता किल arose, as they say.

text: स मां दृष्ट्वा नरपतिर्मुष्टिविक्षेपतत्पर: । पांसुकुण्ठितसर्वाङ्गीं जनको विस्मितो ऽभवत् ॥२-११८-२९॥
translation: Engaged in sowing fistfuls of seeds, king Janaka found me covered with dust and was astonished.
word_meanings: मुष्टिविक्षेपतत्परः eager to sow fistfuls of seeds, नरपतिः king, सः जनकः that Janaka, पांसुकुण्ठितसर्वाङ्गीं with my body covered with dust, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा having seen, विस्मितः अभवत् was astonished.

text: अनपत्येन च स्नेहादङ्कमारोप्य च स्वयम् । ममेयं तनयेत्युक्त्वा स्नेहो मयि निपातित: ॥२-११८-३०॥
translation: As he had no children, he, on his own accord, lifted me up and placing me on his lap, saying, This is my daughter, he began showering (lots of) love on me.
word_meanings: अनपत्येन being childless, स्वयम् himself, स्नेहात् out of affection, अङ्कम् in his lap, आरोप्य placing, इयम् this one, मम तनया is my daughter, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, मयि in me, स्नेहः affection, निपातितः showered

text: अन्तरिक्षे च वागुक्ता प्रति मा ऽमानुषी किल । एवमेतन्नरपते धर्मेण तनया तव ॥२-११८-३१॥
translation: 'O king, she is an incomparable divine being. By right she is your daughter'. These were the words (Janaka) heard from out of the sky.
word_meanings: नरपते O king, एतत् this, एवम् in this way, अप्रतिमा incomparable, अमानुषी not a human being, तव to you, धर्मेण by right, तनया daughter, अन्तरिक्षे from out of the sky, वाक् word, उक्ता was uttered.

text: तत: प्रहृष्टो धर्मात्मा पिता मे मिथिलाधिप: । अवाप्तो विपुलामृद्धिं मामवाप्य नराधिप: ॥२-११८-३२॥
translation: Thereafter, my father and the righteous lord of Mithila was delighted in possessing me when a noble thought struck his mind.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, धर्मात्मा righteous, नराधिप: the king, मिथिलाधिपः the lord of Mithila, मे पिता my father, प्रहृष्टः was delighted, माम् me, अवाप्य having got, विपुलाम् noble, बुद्धिम् thought, अवाप्तः obtained.

text: दत्ता चास्मीष्टवद्देव्यै ज्येष्ठायै पुण्यकर्मणा । तया सम्भाविता चास्मि स्निग्धया मातृसौहृदात् ॥२-११८-३३॥
translation: Bestowed as the choicest one of meritorious acts on the chief queen, I was brought up by her, by nature affectionate, with the love of a mother.
word_meanings: पुण्यकर्मणा by a man of meritorious acts, ज्येष्ठायै to the chief, देव्यैः queen, इष्टवत् as the choicest one, दत्ता अस्मि I was given, स्निग्धया by a lady endowed with affection, तया by her, मातृसौहृदात् with the love of a mother, सम्भाविता अस्मि I was nourished.

text: पतिसंयोगसुलभं वयो दृष्ट्वा तु मे पिता । चिन्तामभ्यगमद्दीनो वित्तनाशादिवाधन: ॥२-११८-३४॥
translation: When my father saw I had attained the marriageable age, he was immersed in sorrow like an indigent man who had lost all his wealth.
word_meanings: मे पिता my father, पतिसंयोगसुलभम् a proper time for uniting with a husband, वयः age, दृष्ट्वा having observed, दीनः desolate, वित्तनाशात् due to loss of wealth, अधनः इव like an poor man, चिन्ताम् sorrow, अभ्यगमत् obtained.

text: सदृशाच्चापकृष्टाच्च लोके कन्यापिता जनात् । प्रधर्षणमवाप्नोति शक्रेणापि समो भुवि ॥२-११८-३५॥
translation: Even though he was an Indra on earth, as a father of an unmarried girl he would be humiliated by men who are his equal or inferior in this world.
word_meanings: भुवि on earth, शक्रेण with Indra, समोऽपि though equal, कन्यापिता the father of an unmarried girl, सदृशाः equal, अपकृष्टात् by an inferior, जनात् from men, लोके in this world, प्रधर्षणाम् humiliation, अवाप्नोति will receive.

text: तां धर्षणामदूरस्थां दृष्ट्वा चात्मनि पार्थिव: । चिन्तार्णवगत: पारं नाससादाप्लवो यथा ॥२-११८-३६॥
translation: Having perceived that the humiliation is not very far, king Janaka was plunged in a sea of sorrow like one who cannot reach the shore without a float.
word_meanings: पार्थिवः the king, तां धर्षणाम् that humiliation, आत्मनि in him, अदूरस्थाम् not very far, दृष्ट्वा having observed, चिन्तार्णवगतः submerged in a sea of sorrow, अप्लवो यथा like one without a float, पारम् the shore, नाससाद did not reach.

text: अयोनिजां हि मां ज्ञात्वा नाध्यगच्छद्विचिन्तयन् । सदृशं चानुरूपं च महीपाल: पतिं मम ॥२-११८-३७॥
translation: The ruler of the earth knew that I was not born from a woman's womb, and could not find a suitable husband for me after deep reflection.
word_meanings: महीपालः the ruler of earth, माम् me, अयोनिजाम् not born from the womb, ज्ञात्वा having known, मम for me, सदृशम् equal, अनुरूपं च suitable, पतिम् husband, विचिन्तयन् thinking over, नाध्यगच्छत् did not find.

text: तस्य बुद्धिरियं जाता चिन्तयानस्य सन्ततम् । स्वयं वरं तनूजाया: करिष्यामीति धीमत: ॥२-११८-३८॥
translation: After constantly pondering over the matter, the wise king arrived at the decision to perform a swayamvara for his daughter.
word_meanings: सन्ततम् constantly, चिन्तयानस्य pondering deeply, धीमतः wise, तस्य his, तनूजायाः for the daughter, स्वयंवरम् swayamvara, करिष्यामि I shall perform, इति thus, इयं बुद्धि: this thought, जाता was born.

text: महायज्ञे तदा तस्य वरुणेन महात्मना । दत्तं धनुर्वरं प्रीत्या तूणी चाक्षयसायकौ ॥२-११८-३९॥
translation: Magnanimous Varuna out of his affection had given him, on the occasion of a great sacrifice, an excellent bow with inexhaustible arrows and a pair of quivers.
word_meanings: तदा then, महायज्ञे at a great sacrifice, तस्य to him, महात्मना by the magnanimous, वरुणेन by Varuna, प्रीत्या with affection, धनुर्वरम् an excellent bow, दत्तम् was given, अक्षयसायकौ with two inexhaustible arrows, तूणी च and two quivers.

text: असञ्चाल्यं मनुष्यैश्च यत्नेनापि च गौरवात् । तन्न शक्ता नमयितुं स्वप्नेष्वपि नराधिपा: ॥२-११८-४०॥
translation: Because of its weight, no human could move that bow despite great effort nor were the kings capable of bending it even in their dreams.
word_meanings: गौरवात् because of weight, मनुष्यैः by a human, यत्नेनापि even with great effort, असञ्चाल्यम् cannot be moved, तत् that bow, नराधिपाः lords of men, स्वप्नेष्वपि even in their dreams, नमयितुम् to bend, न शक्ताः were not capable.

text: तद्धनु: प्राप्य मे पित्रा व्याहृतं सत्यवादिना । समवाये नरेन्द्राणां पूर्वमामन्त्र्य पार्थिवान् ॥२-११८-४१॥
translation: My truthful father, after having acquired the bow, invited all the princes and placed the great bow before them in the assembly where he declared:
word_meanings: सत्यवादिना by a truthful man, मे पित्रा by my father, पूर्वम् previously, पार्थिवान् kings, आमन्त्र्य having invited, नरेन्द्राणाम् of kings, समवाये in the assembly, तत् धनुः that bow, प्राप्य having acquired, व्याहृतम् addressed them.

text: इदं च धनुरुद्यम्य सज्यं य: कुरुते नर: । तस्य मे दुहिता भार्या भविष्यति न संशय: ॥२-११८-४२॥
translation: Whatever man lifts this bow and strings it, to him my daughter shall become his wife—of this there is no doubt.
word_meanings: यः नर: any man, इदं धनुः this bow, उद्यम्य having lifted, सज्यं च string the bow, कुरुते who could do, तस्य to him, मे दुहिता my daughter, भार्या wife, भविष्यति shall become, संशयः न no doubt about it.

text: तच्च दृष्ट्वा धनु: श्रेष्ठं गौरवाद्गिरिसन्निभम् । अभिवाद्य नृपा जग्मुरशक्तास्तस्य तोलने ॥२-११८-४३॥
translation: Beholding the mighty bow resembling a mountain in weight, the kings, unable to lift it, paid their homage and left.
word_meanings: नृपाः the kings, गौरवात् due to heavy weight, गिरिसन्निभम् resembling a mountain, तत् धनुः श्रेष्ठम् that mighty bow, दृष्ट्वा beholding, तस्य its, तोलने in lifting, अशक्ताः were unable, अभिवाद्य paying obeisance, जग्मुः went away.

text: सुदीर्घस्य तु कालस्य राघवो ऽयं महाद्युति: । विश्वामित्रेण सहितो यज्ञं द्रष्टुं समागत: । लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा राम: सत्यपराक्रम: ॥२-११८-४४॥
translation: After a long time, resplendent Rama whose prowess was truth, arrived along with his brother Lakshman and sage Viswamitra in order to witness the sacrifice.
word_meanings: सुदीर्घस्य कालस्य after a long time, राघवः Rama, महाद्युतिः resplendent, सत्यपराक्रमः whose prowess was truth, अयं रामः this Rama, भ्रात्रा with his brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह along with Lakshmana, विश्वामित्रेण सहितः together with Viswamitra, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, द्रष्टुम् to observe, समागतः arrived.

text: विश्वामित्रस्तु धर्मात्मा मम पित्रा सुपूजित: । प्रोवाच पितरं तत्र भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥२-११८-४५॥
translation: Having accepted the honour extended by my father, righteous Viswamitra spoke to him about those two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana.
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा the righteous man, विश्वामित्रस्तु as for Viswamitra, मम पित्रा by my father, सुपूजितः wellhonoured, तत्र there, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ to Rama and Lakshmana, पितरम् to my father, प्रोवाच uttered.

text: सुतौ दशरथस्येमौ धनुर्दर्शनकांक्षिणौ । धनुर्दर्शय रामाय राजपुत्राय दैविकम् ॥२-११८-४६॥
translation: 'Both these sons of king Dasaratha wish to see the bow. Show the divine bow to prince Rama'.
word_meanings: दशरथस्य king Dasaratha's, सुतौ sons, इमौ both these, धनुर्दर्शकाङ्क्षिणौ are desirous of seeing the bow, राजपुत्राय to this king's son, रामाय to Rama, दैविकम् divine, धनुः bow, दर्शय show.

text: इत्युक्तस्तेन विप्रेण तद्धनु: समुपानयत् । निमेषान्तरमात्रेण तदानम्य स वीर्य्यवान् ॥२-११८-४७॥
translation: At the words of that ascetic, my father brought out the bow. Mighty and valiant Rama bent it and strung it and drew it in the twinkling of an eye.
word_meanings: तेन विप्रेण by that ascetic, इति thus, उक्तः uttered, ततो then, धनुः bow, उपानयत् brought, महाबलः mighty one, वीर्यवान् valiant man, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in the twinkling of an eye, तत् that one, आनम्य having bent, झडिति instantly, ज्याम् the string, समारोप्य pulling it, पूरयामास drew it.

text: ज्यां समारोप्य झटिति पूरयामास वीर्यवत् ॥२-११८-४८॥
translation: At the words of that ascetic, my father brought out the bow. Mighty and valiant Rama bent it and strung it and drew it in the twinkling of an eye.
word_meanings: तेन विप्रेण by that ascetic, इति thus, उक्तः uttered, ततो then, धनुः bow, उपानयत् brought, महाबलः mighty one, वीर्यवान् valiant man, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in the twinkling of an eye, तत् that one, आनम्य having bent, झडिति instantly, ज्याम् the string, समारोप्य pulling it, पूरयामास drew it.

text: तेन पूरयता वेगान्मध्ये भग्नं द्विधा धनु: । तस्य शब्दो ऽभवद्भीम: पतितस्याशनेरिव ॥२-११८-४९॥
translation: When Rama was stringing the bow with force, it was broken into two in the middle and fell down with a dreadful sound like that of thunder.
word_meanings: पूरयता while stringing, तेन by Rama, वेगात् with force, धनुः bow, मध्ये in the middle, द्विधा into two, भग्नम् was broken, तस्य its, भीमः dreadful, शब्दः sound, पतितस्य fallen, अशनेरिव like that of a thunder, अभवत् arose.

text: ततो ऽहं तत्र रामाय पित्रा सत्याभिसन्धिना । निश्चिता दातुमुद्यम्य जलभाजनमुत्तमम् ॥२-११८-५०॥
translation: Then, my father steadfast in truth, held a vessel of pure water and declared his decision to offer me to Rama.
word_meanings: ततः then, तत्र there, सत्याभिसन्धिना by one steadfast in truth, पित्रा by my father, उत्तमम् pure, जलभाजनम् watervessel, उद्यम्य having raised, अहम् I, रामाय to Rama , दातुम् to give, निश्चिता decided.

text: दीयमानां न तु तदा प्रतिजग्राह राघव: । अविज्ञाय पितुश्छन्दमयोध्याधिपते: प्रभो: ॥२-११८-५१॥
translation: Then Rama did not accept the offer of my father straightaway before he knew the opinion of his father Dasaratha, king of Ayodhya.
word_meanings: तदा then, राघवः Rama, अयोध्याऽधिपतेः of the king of Ayodhya, प्रभोः lord, पितुः his father's, छन्दम् opinion, अविज्ञाय without knowing, दीयमानाम् being offered by father, न तु प्रतिजग्राह did not accept.

text: तत: श्वशुरमामन्त्र्य वृद्धं दशरथं नृपम् । मम पित्रा त्वहं दत्ता रामाय विदितात्मने ॥२-११८-५२॥
translation: Thereafter, my fatherinlaw, the aged king Dasaratha was invited and my father offered me to Rama known for his sagacity.
word_meanings: ततः then, मम पित्रा by my father, श्वशुरम् fatherinlaw, वृद्धम् aged, दशरथं नृपम् king Dasaratha, आमन्त्र्य having invited, अहम् I, विदितात्मन: of a man who is known for his sagacity, रामाय to Rama, दत्ता I was given.

text: मम चैवानुजा साध्वी ऊर्मिला प्रियदर्शना । भार्य्यार्थे लक्ष्मणस्यापि दत्ता पित्रा मम स्वयम् ॥२-११८-५३॥
translation: My father, on his own accord, bestowed Urmila, my younger sister of chaste and of pleasing appearance as wife to Lakshmana.
word_meanings: मम my, अनुजा younger sister, साध्वी chaste, प्रियदर्शना pleasing appearance, ऊर्मिला Urmila, भार्यार्थे as wife, मम पित्रा by my father, स्वयम् of his own accord, लक्ष्मणस्यापि for Lakshman, दत्ता was given.

text: एवं दत्तास्मि रामाय तदा तस्मिन् स्वयम्वरे । अनुरक्तास्मि धर्मेण पतिं वीर्यवतां वरम् ॥२-११८-५४॥
translation: In this way my father bestowed me on Rama in that swayamvara and I remain devoted to my husband who is the foremost among the valiant in treading the path of righteousness. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टादशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the one hundredeighteenth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: तदा then, तस्मिन् स्वयंवरे in that swayamvara, रामाय for Rama, एवम् in this way, दत्ता अस्मि was bestowed, वीर्यवताम् among valiant, वरम् foremost, पतिम् husband, धर्मेण in accordance with righteousness, अनुरक्ता अस्मि I remain devoted.

text: अनसूया तु धर्मज्ञा श्रुत्वा तां महतीं कथाम् । पर्य्यष्वजत बाहुभ्यां शिरस्याघ्राय मैथिलीम् ॥२-११९-१॥
translation: Then righteous Anasuya, having heard the great story of Sita, kissed her on the forehead and embraced her with both the arms.
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञा knower of righteousness, अनसूया तु Anasuya on her part, ताम् all that, महतीं कथाम् great narrative, श्रुत्वा having heard, मैथिलीम् Sita, शिरसि on head, आघ्राय having smelt, बाहुभ्याम् with arms, पर्यष्वजत embraced.

text: व्यक्ताक्षरपदं चित्रं भाषितं मधुरं त्वया । यथा स्वयम्वरं वृत्तं तत्सर्वं हि श्रुतं मया । रमे ऽहं कथया ते तु दृढं मधुरभाषिणि ॥२-११९-२॥
translation: You have related wonderfully and sweetly your Swayamvara with each word and each syllable uttered clearly. I have heard everything as it happened. O sweetspeaking Sita, I have greatly enjoyed your story.
word_meanings: त्वया by you, व्यक्ताक्षरपदम् with each word and each syllable uttered clearly, चित्रम् wonderful, मधुरम् sweet, भाषितम् spoken, स्वयंवरम् the ceremony in which the bride chooses the groom of her own accord, यथा as, वृत्तम् it happened, तत्सर्वं all that, मया by me, श्रुतं हि has been heard, मधुरभाषिणि O sweetspeaking, Sita, ते your, कथया in the story, अहम् I, दृढम् रमे I enjoy greatly.

text: रविरस्तं गत: श्रीमानुपोह्य रजनीं शिवाम् । दिवसं प्रतिकीर्णानामाहारार्थं पतत्ऺित्रणाम् । सन्ध्याकाले निलीनानां निद्रार्थं श्रूयते ध्वनि: ॥२-११९-३॥
translation: The resplendent Sun has set. The auspcious night is drawing near. The birds who forage far and wide for food during the day return to their nests to rest for the night. You can hear them twittering.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् resplendent, रविः Sun, शिवाम् auspicious, रजनीम् night, उपोह्य after drawing near, अस्तगतः has set, दिवसम् during day, आहारार्थम् for the sake of food, प्रतिकीर्णानाम् forage far and wide, सन्ध्याकाले in the twilight, निद्रार्थम् for the sake of sleep, निलीनानाम् resting, पतत्रिणाम् of birds, ध्वनिः sound, श्रूयते is heard.

text: एते चाप्यभिषेकार्द्रा मुनय: कलशोद्यता: । सहिता उपवर्तन्ते सलिलाप्लुतवल्कला: ॥२-११९-४॥
translation: The sages also are returning in groups with waterpitchers filled with water and their bark robes soaked with water after their ceremonial bath.
word_meanings: एते मुनयः च these sages, अभिषेकार्द्राः wet through ablution, कलशोद्यताः carrying waterpitchers, सलिलाप्लुतवल्कलाः their bark robes soaked with water, सहिता: in groups, उपवर्तन्ते are returning.

text: ऋषीणामग्निहोत्रेषु हुतेषु विधिपूर्वकम् । कपोताङ्गारुणो धूमो दृश्यते पवनोद्धत: ॥२-११९-५॥
translation: The ascetics have duly offered oblations to the fire in Agnihotra sacrifices and the smoke, tawny like the pigeon's body, emanates wafted by the wind.
word_meanings: ऋषीणाम् of the ascetics, अग्निहोत्रेषु in Agnihotra sacrifices, विधिपूर्वकम् duly, हुतेषु oblations offered, कपोताङ्गारुणः tawny like the pigeon's body, धूमः smoke, पवनोद्धतः raised by the wind, दृश्यते is seen.

text: अल्पपर्णाहि तरवो घनीभूता: समन्तत: । विप्रकृष्टेपि देशे ऽस्मिन्न प्रकाशन्ति वै दिश: ॥२-११९-६॥
translation: The trees with sparse leaves all over have grown dense, the quarters in the distant region are no longer discernible by the senses.
word_meanings: समन्ततः on all sides, अल्पपर्णाः with sparse leaves, तरवः trees, घनीभूताः have grown dense, विप्रकृष्टेन्द्रिये with disturbed senses, अस्मिन् देशे in this region, दिशः the four quarters, न प्रकाशन्ति वै no longer look bright.

text: रजनीचरसत्त्वानि प्रचरन्ति समन्तत: । तपोवनमृगा ह्येते वेदितीर्थेषु शेरते ॥२-११९-७॥
translation: The night rangers have started moving everywhere and the deer in the penance grove are beginning to sleep around the sacred altars.
word_meanings: रजनीचरसत्वानि the beings that range by night, समन्ततः everywhere, प्रचरन्ति are wandering, एते तपोवनमृगाः these deer of the penance grove, वेदितीर्थेषु around sacred altars, शेरते are sleeping.

text: सम्प्रवृद्धा निशा सीते नक्षत्रसमलङ्कृता । जोत्स्नाप्रावरणश्चन्द्रो दृश्यते ऽभ्युदितो ऽम्बरे ॥२-११९-८॥
translation: O Sita, adorned with stars, the night has commenced. You can see the moon rising in the sky spreading his mantle of light.
word_meanings: सीते O Sita, नक्षत्रसमलङ्कृता adorned with stars, निशा night, सम्प्रवृत्ता has commenced, ज्योत्स्नाप्रावरणः spread with the mantle of moonlight, चन्द्रः moon, अम्बरे in the sky, अभ्युदितः is rising, दृश्यते is appearing.

text: गम्यतामनुजानामि रामस्यानुचरी भव । कथयन्त्या हि मधुरं त्वयाहं परितोषिता ॥२-११९-९॥
translation: With my permission you may go now and be a companion of Rama. I am thoroughly contented with your story told so sweetly.
word_meanings: गम्यताम् you may go now, अनुजानामि I give you my consent, रामस्य to Rama, अनुचरी भव be his companion, मधुरम् sweetly, कथयन्त्या storytelling, त्वया by you, अहम् I, परितोषिता thoroughly contented.

text: अलङ्कुरु च तावत्त्वं प्रत्यक्षं मम मैथिलि । प्रीतिं जनय मे वत्से दिव्यालङ्कारशोभिता ॥२-११९-१०॥
translation: O Sita, adorn yourself in my presence. Dear child, permit me the pleasure of adorning you with these divine ornaments.
word_meanings: मैथिलि O Sita, त्वम् you, मम my, प्रत्यक्षं तावत् in my presence, अलङ्कुरु adorn yourself, वत्से dear child, दिव्यालङ्कारशोभिता adorned with divine ornaments, मे to me, प्रीतिम् delight, जनय cause me.

text: सा तथा समलंकृत्य सीता सुरसुतोपमा । प्रणम्य शिरसा तस्यै रामं त्वभिमुखी ययौ ॥२-११९-११॥
translation: Sita, adorned, looked like the daughter of a god. She bowed at the feet of Anasuya in reverence and set out to meet Rama.
word_meanings: सुरसुतोपमा resembling the daughter of a god, सा सीता that Sita, तथा in that way, समलङ्कुत्य having adorned, तस्यै to her, शिरसा with her head, प्रणम्य saluting with reverence, रामम् to Rama, अभिमुखी towards, ययौ went.

text: तथा तु भूषितां सीतां ददर्श वदतां वर: । राघव: प्रीतिदानेन तपस्विन्या जहर्ष च ॥२-११९-१२॥
translation: Rama, the most eloquent among men, saw Sita adorned, and rejoiced at the gifts of love given by the ascetic Anasuya.
word_meanings: वदताम् among those eloquent one, वरः excellent, राघवः Rama, तथा in that way, भूषिताम् adorned, सीताम् Sita, ददर्श beheld, तपस्विन्याः of the female ascetic, प्रीतिदानेन with gifts of love, जहर्ष च rejoiced.

text: न्यवेदयत्तत: सर्वं सीता रामाय मैथिली । प्रीतिदानं तपस्विन्या वसनाभरणस्रजम् ॥२-११९-१३॥
translation: Sita the princess of Mithila related everything to Rama and showed him the gifts of love given by ascetic Anasuya -- raiment, jewellery and garlands.
word_meanings: मैथिली the princess of Mithila, सीता Sita, ततः there after, तपस्विन्याः of ascetic Anasuya, प्रीतिदानम् gifts of love, वसनाभरणस्रजम् raiment, jewellery and garlands, सर्वम् everything, रामाय to Rama, न्यवेदयत् related.

text: प्रहृष्टस्त्वभवद्रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महारथ: । मैथिल्या: सत्क्रियां दृष्ट्वा मानुषेषु सुदुर्लभाम् ॥२-११९-१४॥
translation: Rama the great charioteer and Lakshmana were exceedingly gratified to see the honour conferred on Sita, rare among mortals.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, महारथः great charioteer, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana also, मानुषेषु among mortals, सुदुर्लभाम् very difficult to obtain, मैथिल्याः to Sita, सत्क्रियाम् the honour, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रहृष्टः अभवत् was gratified.

text: ततस्तां शर्वरीं प्रीत: पुण्यां शशिनिभानन: । अर्चितस्तापसै: सिद्धैरुवास रघुनन्दन: ॥२-११९-१५॥
translation: Thereafter, the descendant of Raghu, whose countenance resembled the Moon, having received the hospitality of the accomplished ascetics, passed that holy night in delight.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, शशिनिभाननः face like the Moon, रघुनन्दनः the descendant of Raghu, सिद्धैः by the acomplished, तापसैः by ascetics, अर्चितः hospitality having been extended, प्रीतः in delight, पुण्याम् holy, तां शर्वरीम् that night, उवास passed.

text: तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायामभिषिच्य हुताग्निकान् । आपृच्छेतां नरव्याघ्रौ तापसान् वनगोचरान् ॥२-११९-१६॥
translation: Night over, the two best men, Rama and Lakshmana, after their ablution took leave of the ascetics inhabiting the forest who offered morning oblations to the fire .
word_meanings: तस्याम् that, रात्र्याम् night, व्यतीतायाम् had passed away, नरव्याघ्रौ the two great men, अभिषिच्य having bathed, हुताग्निकान् who performed their fireofferings, वनगोचरान् inhabiting the forest, तापसान् ascetics, अपृच्छेताम् took leave of.

text: तावूचुस्ते वनचरास्तापसा धर्मचारिण: । वनस्य तस्य सञ्चारं राक्षसै: समभिप्लुतम् ॥२-११९-१७॥
translation: The righteous ascetics dwelling in the forest informed both Rama and Lakshmana that part of the forest infested by demons.
word_meanings: वनचराः dwellers in the forest, धर्मचारिणः following the righteousness, ते तापसाः those ascetics, तस्य वनस्य of that forest, सञ्चारम् movement, राक्षसैः with demons, समभिप्लुतम् inundated, तौ addressing both of them, ऊचुः said.

text: रक्षांसि पुरुषादानि नानारूपाणि राघव । वसन्त्यस्मिन् महारण्ये व्यालाश्च रुधिराशना: ॥२-११९-१८॥
translation: O Rama, this great forest is haunted by carnivorous demons who can assume any form and by blooddrinking wild animals.
word_meanings: राघव O Rama, अस्मिन् महारण्ये in this great forest, पुरुषादानि maneaters, नानारूपाणि in various forms, रक्षांसि demons, रुधिराशनाः blooddrinking, व्यालाश्च wild animals, वसन्ति are living.

text: उच्छिष्टं वा प्रमत्तं वा तापसं धर्मचारिणम् । अदन्त्यस्मिन् महारण्ये तान्निवारय राघव ॥२-११९-१९॥
translation: O Rama, in this great forest demons will devour the ascetics if they find them impure or intoxicated or indolent. Prevent them.
word_meanings: राघव Rama, अस्मिन् महारण्ये in this great forest, उच्छिष्टं वा or impure, प्रमत्तं वा or not alert, तापसम् an ascetic, अदन्ति they (eat) devour, तान् them, निवारय prevent them.

text: एष पन्था महर्षीणां फलान्याहरतां वने । अनेन तु वनं दुर्गं गन्तुं राघव ते क्षमम् ॥२-११९-२०॥
translation: O Rama, this is the one path in the forest used by the ascetics to gather fruits. You can safely cross the otherwise impassable forest through this path.
word_meanings: राघव Rama, एषः वने in the forest, फलानि fruits, आहरताम् of those gathering, महर्षीणाम् ascetics, एष पन्थाः this path, अनेन through this path, दुर्गम् impassable, वनम् the forest, गन्तुम् to go, ते to you, क्षमम् is safe.

text: इतीव तै: प्राञ्जलिभिस्तपस्विभिर्द्विजै: कृत: स्वस्त्ययन: परं तप: । वनं सभार्य्य: प्रविऺवेश राघव: सलक्ष्मण: सूर्य्यमिवाभ्रमण्डलम् ॥२-११९-२१॥
translation: The ascetics offered their blessings to Rama the tormentor of enemies. Thereafter, accompanied by his wife and Lakshmana, he entered the great forest like the Sun entering the mass of clouds. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे श्रीमद्वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये चतुर्विंशत्सहस्रिकायां संहितयां श्रीमदयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनविंशत्युत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundrednineteenth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: प्राञ्जलिभिः (paying obeisance) with folded hands, तपस्विभिः by ascetics, तैः द्विजैः by those brahmins, इतीव thus, कृतस्वस्त्ययनः obtaining their blessings, परन्तपः tormentor of enemies, राघवः Rama, सभार्यः with his wife, सलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, सूर्यः Sun, अभ्रमण्डलम् इव like entering the mass of clouds, वनम् forest, प्रविवेश entered.
